reviews.author: Christofer
reviews.text:
Very nice all-inclusive resort with beautiful pools and great location by the sea. The resort offers several pool areas, including an adults only section, several restaurants, coffee shop, a small store, evening entertainment, etc

Modern and clean rooms providing most amenities you need during the stay. The rooms has a complimentary mini-bar which is supposed to be refilled every day but at least during our stay it was not. Wine bottle part of the minibar, but no opener available in the room.

Pool towels provided and the pool bar has a good selection of drinks.

The buffe restaurant is excellent providing a large variety of dishes for breakfast, lunch, and dinner. Some difficulties to get cutleries and coffee gives a lower score on services.

The mexican BlueAgave restaurant provides great service however we expected the food to be more spicy or having more flavors.

The rock bottom is the Flora restaurant offering traditional dominican food. It was extremely difficult to get a reservation at this restaurant, still it was not half full when eating there and despite many empty tables we were placed at the ”worst” location. We asked to change table and were allowed to do so but with very grumpy staff as a result. Food was average, service almost acceptable although the waiter looked like she just wanted to end her shift, and after finishing main course we were told they did only have one dessert left.

The location and facilities are top class but there are many annoying small things missing or areas with low quality services which gives the lower overall grade.

reviews.author: Anna Chang
reviews.text:
This was our first time in Punta Cana and we were initially concerned that the reviews were incentivized but the positive reviews turned out to be true!
We felt everyone was really kind and genuine.
First shoutout to Santo at Flor- he was very warm and provided us an amazing Mediterranean lunch at Sante.
Our rooms were spacious and clean.
Food was great- buffet had a wide selection for all meals and reservation required restaurants were decent quality: Mina steakhouse (would recommend skirt steak and picanha) Flor (recommend the flower basket, slow cooked ribs) Sante ( recommend the salmon, octopus salad, heard the shrimp rice was good too).
The spa was pretty good- thank you to my masseuse Dorka who was so nice!
The beach was amazing. Definitely the highlight. We had access to affiliated Melia resorts.
Overall this is an excellent deal.
The only thing that left us feeling off and disgusted was one of the girls in our group had her check out card labeled as Kim II Joong. This didn't feel like a reflection of the hotel chain as a whole but whoever wrote that should be held accountable for being unprofessional and frankly racist. Maybe it was an honest mistake, but the room number was correct.
We felt no discrimination during our stay except for this instance.

reviews.author: Laura Thomas
reviews.text: I recently stayed here with my sister to celebrate my 50th birthday.  The resort is gated which made us feel safer and the grounds are beautiful and maintained daily.  We had an Oceanfront room in the reserve adult only section,  it was worth the extra money.  I loved waking up to the water view every morning.  We had our own concierge,  Harry,  who was amazing! The food was good, nothing exceptional but good. We were not impressed with the restaurant that was only for the guests staying at the reserve, we both agreed that the other restaurants were better.  The resort is large and we never felt like it was overcrowded. The pools are beautiful and they maintain the beach. It's more of a quieter resort,  so if you are looking for something that has a lot of activities,  this is not the place for you. They do have a few daily activities but not much. Everyone we encountered that worked at the resort was so nice and helpful.  Fernando,  who i believe ia the activities director,  was very fun and personable.  I highly recommend this resort if you are looking for a place to unwind.

reviews.author: Mike Conigliaro
reviews.text:
Had a wonderful stay at the resort last week.  Yje resort and grounds are beuituful The room was located in the Reserve adult only section of the the hotel.  The room itself was large and well appointed.  Only small issue I had was the air conditioning.  It only went to 69 degrees, which is still a little warm at night.  Our concierge was Yinesca,  who helped with our dinner reservations and made the stay very pleasant. We loved all the pools, and never had any issue with seats.  The towel program is fantastic.  Need a towel...take a towel.  The reserve side if the beach was nice, and like the pool hasd no issues with finding sun loungers.

As for the restaurants,  we really enjoyed the steak house, Italian and Mexican restaurants.  This may surprise some, but we were not impressed with Sante, the Reserve restaurant.  It's that the food was "bad", just not impressive.  Several people.we.spoke with agreed.  On the other hand, we thought the buffet was surprisingly good.

Overall it was a very nice experience.

reviews.author: Lily Must
reviews.text:
Love it here! We’ve only been here a few days so far and everyone’s been so friendly! Melbine from blue agave got us in without a reservation and hooked us up with another restaurant for the next night. So friendly. And wander served us at Minu and was also sweet and friendly! Our safe broke and they came and fixed it real quick. The bedroom was so clean and all the staff is just so sweet. The beach itself they actually clean it every morning so that keeps the seaweed down.
We would love to come again!

reviews.author: Sarah Squire
reviews.text:
Yuderi is amazing at the beach bar! He made our entire vacation. He is quick, friendly and we never had to worry about our beds being ready for us in the morning. He is the reason for the high rating! He deserves a huge raise.

Regarding the resort- it is beautiful, clean and easy to get around.

Service at the restaurants is slow. Often took 20+ minutes to get water or drinks filled. Food was great overall tho.

We did the reserve, it is nice to have a private pool and sante restaurant, but I would argue the buffet on the main side was much better for breakfast lunch and dinner. Room service food was also amazing, and quick which was a huge plus.

The concierge service was not worth it. We came for my birthday, and we were greeted with balloons in room which was amazing, but after that, we barely saw our concierge Gustavo. He set our reservations daily, at times we did not want and we had to argue to get the restaurants we wanted to eat at, because he was just picking for us for the first 3 days. We had wanted to book excursions but ended  up just handling it ourselves because he was not to be found.

Overall, the Dominican is amazing and I’d recommend this resort.

reviews.author: Shuma B
reviews.text:
We had a fantastic experience at Blue Agave! The food was absolutely delicious, and the service was outstanding. Melqui went above and beyond to accommodate dietary intolerances within our group, making sure everyone felt comfortable and well taken care of. His attentiveness and kindness really made our visit special. Thank you, Melqui—we truly appreciated your help!

We had a lovely experience at tokimeku asian restaurant. The Al carte menu was amazing & our host Romeris was very accomodating and lovely throughout our stay this week. She really catered us well at Sante Restaurant too.

Big shout out to our favourite staff - Norjandro! Always delighted to see him at breakfast & lunch at Sante restaurant. We loved his humor & kindness. Thank you!

Marcus at the pool bar was lovely - really good at making drinks!

reviews.author: Cindy Rivera
reviews.text:
Overall, we had a great trip! We did have a small situation with our room at the beginning of our stay, but the staff worked with us and helped make things better so we could still enjoy our vacation.

What truly made this trip memorable was the amazing staff. We especially want to recognize a few people who went above and beyond for us. Suleidy always took such great care of us at our favorite restaurants — keeping us well fed, our drinks full, and always greeting us with a smile. She was incredibly friendly and made every meal even more enjoyable.

At the main swim-up bar, Jonothan made our days so much fun! He remembered us by name and always made sure we were having an amazing time.

We also met Elvis during our trip, who helped us with our room situation and truly turned things around for us. His kindness and hospitality gave us an experience we’ll always remember ❤️

Thank you to everyone who helped make our stay special. We had an amazing time and made memories we’ll never forget!

reviews.author: Amanda Wontor
reviews.text: The staff here has been wonderful. Servers, bartenders, hostesses - everyone has been polite and welcoming. Daniela at Mascalzone was especially great. She was able to seat us 2hrs earlier than our reservation so our almost 2yr old, who was exhausted after a day of swimming, could have dinner before he fell asleep. She treated him (and us) with kindness, giving him a high-five and crayons and was very sweet. The food was great, too! Our server, Yuleni provided top-notch service! Jean at Flora was awesome, too. Our son slept through dinner, so we asked for a cup of milk to bring back to the room for when he woke up.  He gave us a whole milk container. We felt like our son has been a priority for the staff here, which is really great to see at a resort that primarily caters to adults. Jeremy and Luis at Ginger (hotel lobby bar and coffee bar) were fun to hang out with while we ordered a few drinks (alcoholic and non-alcoholic - craft cocktails with plenty of options, including fruit juices and smoothies). They make great mojitos and espresso martinis! Overall, we highly recommend this resort, especially for families with very little ones who love to swim (and try new food!).

reviews.author: Jayce Smith
reviews.text: Andrés is the best! No exaggeration. Amazing service, fun energy, and really became a friend to us. From check in to check out. We were celebrating a birthday and graduation and he surprised us with so many gifts and special accommodations for the celebrations. Above and beyond. Truly made it feel special.  Overall the resort is 5 stars as long as you aren’t use to the MOST extreme luxury resorts. That said, the place is beautiful. Plus Surprisingly good daily Activities to do and pools are big. Had some small issues with the room, but they were resolved quickly. def a step above the other options of lost resort’s around DR. Some staff are more welcoming and friendly than others but they all do a great job and have great service. Food you don’t need to worry about, I suppose it is “hit or miss” but there’s plenty of hits that it does not matter food will still be good👍🏾

reviews.author: Russell Maulick
reviews.text:
Our 15th time to this hotel. We celebrated our 37th wedding anniversary with our DR friends. Perfect time of the year to visit this resort. We saw friends we missed the last time we visited. We would like to mention them by name. Juan Pena, Lewis de la Cruz, Antonio and Olga at the ginger bar, Jonathan, Jesus, Eddy, Jorge and Luis at the pool bar, Gilberto, Martin and Pedro at the 96 degree beach bar, Teofino, Maria, Rosanna, Hirlenne,Yoleidy, Emily. Gerardo the best omelet maker at lunch box, Milton and Yuleni at Mascalzone, Franklin, the Chef and our busboy at Sante where we had a fantastic and memorable anniversary dinner, and can't forget to mention Julin who brought our morning pot of coffee promptly at 7am every day, as he did in November 2024. We met so many nice people from all over. We made so many happy memories. Can't wait to go back. Almost forgot to mention Gladys and Dorka at the YHI spa who were exceptional. Forgive me if I left someone out. We love everyone there
I

reviews.author: Devon Lehmkuhl
reviews.text: Me and my partner enjoyed our short stay at Paradisus. The staff were very welcoming and made  the stay excellent. It’s very clean and many things to do. Breakfast at Sante was very good and Romeris was very attentive and took good care of us. Cristian and Yinesca were both our concierge and were always available to answer our questions and booking reservations at the resort restaurants with ease.

reviews.author: Tomie Gibson
reviews.text: Our room was absolutely beautiful. Harry our butler was so kind, attentive and made sure we had everything we needed. The food on the buffet and for breakfast and lunch was not very good. However the dinners we had were great. We didn’t love that you had to sit down to eat lunch. There was no where to go and grab a snack for around the pool. Overall we loved our visit other then the food. My husband golfed and said the course was beautiful and I got a massage and that was also great.

reviews.author: Sean Phelps
reviews.text:
Overall great experience. The rooms were above average, but when they made up the rooms they would sometimes give us new towels and sometimes not; unpredictable turn over service.
The workers were very friendly and took the effort to be friendly with me.
Punta Cana is a great place to relax for a week, beautiful location with lots of places to enjoy it!

reviews.author: Jan G
reviews.text: We enjoyed private, quiet, pool by our suites! Magnificent! Our server, at 36 degrees,  throughout the entire 8 days was beyond perfection. Jose was attentive, calm, peaceful. He served adults and children our favourite drinks everyday. His friendliness and cheerful attitude was what is ur vacation so appreciated. We cannot say enough about our friend Jose! Thank you Jose for many happy memories for our family vacation.

reviews.author: PETER A
reviews.text: Best Service I've received, Yamilet and Melvin at Blue Agave made our day very special. We Celebrated my Birthday here and these two Staff members went above and beyond their hospitality and attentive nature are something to be admired. Very well done!

reviews.author: Biokaris Nunez
reviews.text: The hotel is beautiful, right on the beach, very clean. We had the ocean front room and it exceeded our expectations. It was a villa steps from the water. The service was good throughout the hotel, no complaints! Antonia, Jason, Michael at the Celsius bar, really made our experience unforgettable. And our concierge Zenovia, went above and beyond.

reviews.author: chris espelien
reviews.text:
This place is beautiful. The plaza, the beach, the pools.. all beautiful and clean. The rooms were acceptable: decent size and nice enough, with visible signs of poor workmanship on repairs. The food was mediocre to bad, and was a general disappointment. The coffee was good. Majority of employees speak only Spanish.

For my money, there are better options. I will not return here.

reviews.author: Rodrigo Olyntho
reviews.text:
Amazing experience at Tokimeku! From the moment we arrived, we felt genuinely welcomed. A special thank you to Romeris for the warm hospitality and for guiding us through the menu with excellent recommendations — it truly made a difference.

Also, a big thanks to Maria and José, who took such great care of us throughout the evening. The service was attentive, friendly, and made us feel completely at ease.

The food was outstanding, and the overall atmosphere made the experience even more memorable. Highly recommended — we will definitely be back!

reviews.author: Zineb Benkirane
reviews.text:
We had an absolutely wonderful stay at Melia Paradisus Palma Real Golf & Spa and would highly recommend it.

The location is fantastic, with some of the most beautiful, soft white sand beaches and consistently gorgeous weather that made the entire experience feel like a true escape. The grounds are stunning—lush, green, and impeccably maintained, creating a serene and luxurious atmosphere throughout the resort. The standard rooms were very spacious and included a private balcony and sunbeds, with nice amenities and modern decor, with high quality marble flooring.

What really stood out, though, was the staff. Everyone was incredibly warm and welcoming, and the level of service was consistently on par. A special thank you to Jesus, Jose and the kind ladies at the kids’ club, who was especially kind, attentive, and with whom my children had a blast!

The breakfast buffet was very very nice with multiple options. We really appreciated that there à la carte restaurants included included our favorite Blue Agave, the Japanese and Italian, and the food across the board was very good, with an opportunity for improvement at Kanna lunch when the bbq meat was consistently undercooked. The lunch and dinner buffets, though good, were the same every day. The only small note would be the Hibachi Japanese restaurant—the chef didn’t include any of the usual entertainment, which would have made the experience even more enjoyable.

Another great perk was the sports amenities, including the top of the line gym that I enjoyed every morning and the Rafael Nadal Tennis Center, which added something unique and elevated to the stay.

Overall, this is a beautiful resort that delivers on quality, service, and atmosphere. We can’t wait to come back!

reviews.author: David Kolumber
reviews.text:
Absolute satisfaction. From the very beginning everything was perfectly organized – transfer to the hotel, staff taking care of our luggage, and escorting us to the reception. At check-in we were offered an upgrade, but without any pressure at all. When we declined because of the price, it was completely fine.

The receptionist noticed (probably because of our wedding rings) and asked whether we really wanted two separate beds as booked. Of course, we wanted one bed as a couple, and after a very short wait she arranged a different room (1228) without any issue. The room was spacious, bright, and very comfortable. The only minor technical issue was the air conditioning, which occasionally didn’t work perfectly. The room had an excellent location, and even though there were music events in the hotel area, nothing could be heard inside. Only after a few days we noticed some noise from the room above us, likely due to a change of guests.

We mostly dined in the main restaurant. The food selection was extensive and of very high quality. I would like to commend the entire staff, especially the hostess Jessica and Laura, who appeared to be in a supervisory role. Even though she seemed to be there privately, she immediately stepped in to resolve a small issue when it arose – exactly the kind of attitude guests appreciate. Overall, the staff was attentive, professional, and genuinely engaged.

One small remark: when everything is running smoothly, it feels unnecessary for another supervisor to publicly reprimand staff, as it slightly disrupts the otherwise pleasant atmosphere.

The adults-only pool was excellent. Only once were children allowed in for a special occasion, but it started raining shortly after, so it didn’t really matter.

The stay was outstanding even without any upgrade. The only thing I would suggest is offering a late check-out option. Due to high occupancy, we had to wait several hours in the bar after check-out. Food and drinks were still available, but it’s not quite the same when you can no longer use everything. That said, I fully understand this given how busy the hotel was. Considering the size of the resort, the number of guests, and how smoothly everything operated, the organization was truly exemplary.

Overall, I rate the hotel extremely highly. Excellent value for money, high-quality services, and very attentive staff – including remembering our usual drinks at the pool bar. I can recommend this hotel one thousand percent.

reviews.author: Jeffrey Hoffman
reviews.text:
Just back from an incredible stay at Paradisus Palma Real. Beautiful, upscale resort on one of the best beaches in Punta Cana. This is definitely a sun-lovers resort - huge pools surrounded by ample seating. It feels more regal than tropical. Food and drink quality was outstanding - particularly the steakhouse.

Alam, our concierge, made us feel like we were his only focus. Responsive, friendly and invested in our group having a wonderful vacation. At the beach, Rafael took care of our every need - he had shaded chairs ready each morning and ensured everyone in the group had a drink in hand at every moment. Jairo taught a great dance lesson and the rest of the entertainment team worked hard to keep guests involved in activities such as morning yoga/stretch, painting, water sports and dancing.

We've stayed at half-a-dozen resorts in the Bavaro beach area and Paradisus Palma Real is now at the top of our favorites list. We are already planning our next trip!

reviews.author: Denisha Campbell
reviews.text:
The experience here was AMAZING! For my birthday everyone made sure that I felt special and that I was celebrated! The resort was very clean and the staff was incredible and made me feel special! It was a great time and I would certainly come back! They even had a special cake for me for my
Birthday! I’m feel so amazing! Drinks were strong and the food grew on me! Y Antonia,  Junior, y Irvin de animación fueron mi fantástico! Una experiencia muy bonita  y agradable por que celebraron my cumpleaño !!

reviews.author: Ruma Begum
reviews.text:
We had a lovely stay and the service really stood out.

Nojandro  was incredibly friendly and attentive – he remembered our complex dietary requirements and always made us feel comfortable at Sante, with great humour and service.

Romeris was excellent at both Sante and Tokimeku, very accommodating and attentive to our needs.

Marcus at the bar was great too, keeping things fun with different drinks that all tasted amazing.

Melqui also provided great service at the Mexican restaurant – very friendly and made the experience memorable.

Overall, amazing staff who made our stay special – thank you!

reviews.author: VIP Vichitra Indian Production
reviews.text:
We had a wonderful stay at this resort. The pool area was beautiful, clean, and very well maintained — perfect for relaxing throughout the day. The beach was equally impressive, with soft sand and stunning water that made every moment feel like a true vacation.

What truly made the experience special was the welcoming and friendly hotel team. Every staff member we interacted with was professional, attentive, and genuinely cared about making our stay comfortable and enjoyable. Their warm hospitality created a very positive atmosphere.

Overall, this resort offers the perfect combination of a great pool, a gorgeous beach, and excellent service. We would definitely love to return and highly recommend it to anyone looking for a relaxing and memorable getaway.

reviews.author: Annie Medina
reviews.text: So far, everything has been fantastic. We just finished dinner at Blue Agave, and all three of my children talked about how their meals (chicken tacos, chicken burrito, quesabirria) were the best they’ve ever had. Yamilet was lovely and worked to find something for all of us and to ensure everyone was sated (second helpings for some!) Overall, a wonderful experience.

reviews.author: Roddy M
reviews.text: The resort was beautiful. All of the workers were nice and approachable the entire stay. They were fluent in Spanish and English. There was 24/7 room service, however the wait was normally 35-55 mins. The restaurants were okay. We liked Blue Agave (Mexican) and Olio (Mediterranean) the most for their flavor. Overall, it was a calm beautiful relaxing honeymoon for us. Just wish the food was a little better. And I wish my husband didn’t make me fill out the review lol. Ciao!

reviews.author: Donald Buckle
reviews.text:
Luis and luis
in the ginger bar is fantastic. My wife loves his Expresso Martinis. Rosa Maria also has such a welcoming smile.
Junior and Antonia at the Fahrenheit always went out of thier way to make sure my experience was exceptional. Always welcoming with a smile and great service. They never missed a beat.

reviews.author: Jamie-Lynn Huitema
reviews.text:
What a fantastic resort ! Definitely exceeded expectations.
Resort and amenities are fabulous.
Food was great. So many options to choose from and a great place to try something new as it was all too notch.
Highly recommend Sante for breakfast and lunch in the adults only section.
My waitress Katherine, and her manager Santo always ensured my needs were met.

Honestly I highly recommend this resort to anyone. I was in the Reserve section and the upgrade was well worth it.

As a solo traveler I felt safe.

reviews.author: Damilola Waite
reviews.text: This resort has been amazing! Diana took us on a bike tour around the resort and surrounding area, and it was informative and fun! Wander (server at Kanna restaurant) helped teach us Spanish, but also provided the best service we received this entire time! Jean at front desk was friendly and helpful. Eddy and Jonathan at the beach/pool bar area were amazing, went above and beyond for drinks, and remembered our repeat orders. We will definitely come back!!

reviews.author: Katie A.
reviews.text: I would give them 100 starts if I could. Everything was memorable from start to finish. Fernando in particular was so kind and made sure we had everything we needed. The entire hotel staff we interacted with were very helpful. Their service is truly outstanding.

reviews.author: Sindi Blitzer
reviews.text:
The hotel grounds are beautiful and well maintained.

In general, the beach, restaurants, and pools are gorgeous. Surprisingly, the buffet was amazing for all meals. We especially enjoyed the dinner specials.

We stayed in the adults only section. The rooms and pool are beautiful.

I do need to give a shout out to some of the staff. At the buffet Yanira, Maria, and Yosica were very attentive. We spent a lot of time with the  sommeliers Gustav and Juan at The Winery. They were very knowledgeable, entertaining, and honestly made our vacation. Our room was kept pristine by Marisol, a warm beautiful person,  and Jose our concierge made sure we were happy during our stay.

I would recommend this hotel to my friends and family.

If you are a Club Melia member, they are phasing us out. Do not expect ANY special treatment or additional perks, such as welcome drinks,  baskets in your room, our our private snack and beverage area.   I was literally told that since those things were not written in our contract, they were not required to provide them.  To get those types of perks, you have to switch your membership to Circle. I was extremely upset by this, the reason I bought my membership was for the "special treatment".  Without it, we are ordinary guests like everyone else.

reviews.author: Tonya Shahsavari
reviews.text:
After coming annually for 10 years, we had not visited in awhile. There have been some changes in the service level. However,  Angelo is awesome! Once we found him or he found us (lol) he made pur stay feel like previous visits.

Also, our concierge, Ariel, was very helpful and made reservations, etc seamless..

The beach and resort are still beautiful.  ❤️

reviews.author: Cristina Tina
reviews.text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ 4/5 – Paradisus Palma Real Golf & Spa Resort

We had a really great experience at Paradisus Palma Real and it’s definitely the kind of resort where you have so many facilities and activities that you never feel the need to leave the property.

The hotel was very clean, and the WiFi was surprisingly amazing — it worked perfectly even on the beach, which is pretty rare for such a large resort. We also got a complimentary room upgrade, which made the start of our vacation even better 😊

The food was diverse and tasty: fish, seafood, sushi every day, lots of fresh fruit, and different meat options cooked to your preference.( thank you Edisson and Jimbert). The included drinks were also varied and good — wine, beer, Aperol Spritz, Cuba Libre, Margarita, Piña Colada, and more.

The resort is divided into 3 sections: adults only, family, and VIP, each with different wristbands and some restaurants/facilities with restricted access. There were a few places we couldn’t access depending on the bracelet category, but honestly we didn’t really feel limited because there were still plenty of restaurants, pools, and bars available to us.

The pools are a huge plus — basically every accommodation area has its own pool, plus one massive main pool. There’s always something happening and it’s impossible to get bored. They also have a coffee shop, sports bar, and live shows/concerts every evening

The beach was also beautiful, clean, and very well maintained, with gorgeous turquoise water and plenty of space to relax . The only downside was the slightly annoying “sunbed reservation culture” — many guests would leave towels or personal items on loungers very early in the morning to keep them occupied for hours, even when nobody was actually there.

Overall, a really good all-inclusive resort for relaxation, fun, and variety. Big like 👍

reviews.author: Josemary Gutierrez
reviews.text: Best experience ever for my kids at the Kidsdom with Alexandra, Lizbeth and Yésica. They are truly professional and trust worthy my kids were in great hands. They had so much fun they spent all day at the kids club and did not want to spend time with us. I will definitely return to this hotel and trust my kids with the ladies.

reviews.author: Jacob Vega
reviews.text: This is the first resort I ever go to and I'm in love with it. I'm here with my girlfriend having a great time. The rooms are beautiful, the pools are beautiful, the hospitality is beyond anything I've seen in New York (I'm from New York, the hospitality is hit or miss). In The Lunch Box (one of the eateries) there's this one waiter Edison that made me and my girlfriend feel very welcome. He's very nice and funny, super enjoyable, always asked us to sit in his section of tables and made sure every detail was perfect. Table crooked? Fixed the table. Water empty? Instant refill. Dont drink? Whip you up any beverage of your liking. Genuinely I'm gonna miss this place, but I'm gonna miss Edison a lot when I leave, he's a homie. I hope they give him the FATTEST raise

reviews.author: Melissa Smith
reviews.text:
Top notch service for an all-inclusive resort! The people they have working are excellent. They are very attentive and remember you from day to day. The beach and ocean are gorgeous. I love the adults only section, though some kids definitely trickled in and it dampened some of the experience....

The food in some of the restaurants is excellent, I would definitely talk to the customers and ask where they have had good meals! It makes all the difference!

I would definitely stay again and doing the adults only section is definitely worth it! Especially if you are looking for a break from kids, but wanting to stay on this side of Punta Cana.

(4 star for the room because they didn't always clean it fully when I asked. But otherwise the room was amazing!)

reviews.author: Nidia Sousa
reviews.text:
Had an amazing time at Paradisus Palma real resort. The whole experience was incredible. The staff were amazing and friendly.  What really stood out was the  animation team which includes, Irvin, Henry, Yan, cooper and pollito.
They are all so passionate about their job and how engaging they were—they made sure everyone felt included and had an amazing time. You could tell they truly love what they do, and it made the whole experience even more special. We had an amazing time. Honestly, the nights wouldn’t have been the same without them. If you ever get the chance to experience it, don’t miss out—you’ll leave with memories you won’t forget.

reviews.author: Jenni Beck
reviews.text: We had an absolutely wonderful vacation at Paradisus! Being a Reserve member made all the difference and I definitely suggest splurging on it! We had our own butler, Adriel, that made our experience that much better! We spent each day at the beach in the Reserve only area and had our own personal bar and lounge beds. Martin and Pedro were our beach waiters and they were absolutely PHENOMENAL and treated us so well!! We are so sad to leave them but can’t wait to come back! 🩵

reviews.author: Priyadarshini Manning
reviews.text:
Celebrated my husband’s birthday at Mina Steakhouse and WOW…what an experience from start to finish. The food was absolutely incredible, every bite better than the last, but what truly set the night apart was the top-tier service. The staff was attentive, (especially our server Jean Carlos), welcoming, and kept the drinks flowing without ever making us feel rushed.

And the surprise birthday cake? What the heck…a cake!!! Such a thoughtful and memorable touch that made the night feel extra special. Seeing the biggest smile on my husband’s face said it all.

This dinner truly became the cherry on top of our entire vacation. If you’re looking for an unforgettable dining experience, this is it. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Vilmaliz Rivera
reviews.text:
At the Farenheit Bar by the pool. Service by Antonia was great! Marcos y Junior were very good with their service as well. Antonia takes pride in the drinks she prepared as well as presentation. She is very personable and service with a smile. An asset as a host at the bar area. Thank you! At the Kicks Sports Bar they are not happy if you don’t have a drink in hand ☺️ we were at the main plaza and they come around often to make sure you are having a good time and there’s nothing lacking. My husband and I appreciate all the attention not only to us but to everyone here especially Luis. Thank you!
Restaurant Tokimeku was excellent! Great Hibachi service! Idelka is an excellent server. Very gracious and humble.
At Lunchbox - Rosanna y Yanira are always there to serve us with a smile with excellent service to make us always make us feel at home and like family. We hold them very close to our heart ❤️❤️

reviews.author: Drew Talens
reviews.text: Wow. I don’t even know where to start. When we arrived we talked to people in the Reserve about our reservation. We didn’t need a tour because we had already toured the property. Our pillows smelled like sweat or piss when we first arrived. So we went to the front desk and they got us new pillows. Took almost 4 hours for us to receive our Luggage from the front desk and when we went up to them they still had our luggage. We had been waiting in our rooms waiting for someone to bring us our luggage. My parents room was good but for my sister and I we called 4-5 days in a row to get a new fridge since everything in the fridge was warm. One of the days maintenance came in and checked out the fridge and said he’d be right back. Yea he didn’t come back at all that day. We had to confront our concierge to finally get it fixed for us. On Wednesday after golfing with my dad we wanted to stop by the SportsBar. We waited almost 15 mins before my dad went up to the bar and get us drinks. Never even took our order after that so we just left. Well guess what Today’s friday and the same thing happened again except this time our whole family sat down. I guess it was swift change so no one wanted to help us. I’ve never seen workers leave so fast once a shift change happened. However she did get us beverages but no one took our order for 15 mins after that so we went to Lunchbox for the buffet. Overall this has been a horrible experience and I definitely won’t be coming back. Horrible Service. Barely attentive staff. Something needs to change because I read a review from 2 months ago basically saying the same thing. Disgraceful. 0/10.

reviews.author: Gino Portelli
reviews.text: We thoroughly enjoyed our stay at the Paradisus Palm Real in Punta Cana!  The staff across the whole resort were amazing. We stayed in the Reserve portion of the resort which provided us with excellent service and one on one attention. The pool was beautiful and very quiet. As a reserve guest we got to eat at the private Sante restaurant for breakfast and lunch. The staff there were especially kind and attentive to any needs we had. We loved everything and will be back again!

reviews.author: Dj Negrote
reviews.text: The Paradisus Palma Real is a hotel that makes you feel welcome from the first moment. The check-in was fast, organized and with a very friendly treatment, which marks an excellent start to the stay. The food is first class, with a lot of variety, well prepared and with flavors that are really enjoyed in every restaurant. I also want to highlight the bar boy, always attentive, friendly and with an incredible attitude, preparing the drinks with quality and making every moment feel more special. In general, the service is very good, but the most striking thing about my experience was the animation team. Everyone is cheerful and dedicated, but Fernando Chispa is on another level. He has a contagious energy, natural charisma and a way of connecting with people that you don’t see every day. It not only animates, it transforms the environment and makes each activity feel unique. You can tell that he loves what he does, always with a smile, motivating everyone and giving more than 100% at every moment. He is one of those people who elevate the entire hotel experience and leave a real mark on the guests. Without a doubt, someone who makes a difference and who makes you want to come back

reviews.author: ewqrfdsa nbadaesf
reviews.text: The Blue Agave was the highlight of our trip. We have special dietary restrictions and the staff and chef were very happy to accommodate. The food was fantastic and the service was impeccable. Highly recommended to anyone visiting the Paradisus Palma Real.

reviews.author: Debra Ferrier
reviews.text:
Melqui at Blue agave was awesome. So attentive.  Great attitude.  Seemed to love his job and couldn’t wait to make us happy.  Gave us recommendations that were so delicious.   He deserves a RAISE.
Basilio, butler on adult only side was just the best ever!  He was nice, attentive, always around when you needed him and quick to answer any request.  You should ask for him!!!

reviews.author: Jenna Grounds
reviews.text:
My stay at Paradisus Palma Real was absolutely wonderful and exceeded my expectations. This was the perfect destination for a long vacation, offering a beautiful balance of relaxation, luxury, and exceptional service from beginning to end.

The resort grounds are stunning, meticulously maintained, and create a peaceful tropical atmosphere that makes it easy to unwind. One of the things I appreciated most was how spacious and comfortable the rooms were. The accommodations felt luxurious and thoughtfully designed, with plenty of room to relax. The room was well equipped with everything I needed throughout my stay, making it feel like a home away from home. The beach doesn’t have sargassum as it is cleaned throughout the day and there is a barrier.

The food was consistently excellent across the resort. The hibachi restaurant was one of the highlights of my trip, and Eddy made the experience especially memorable with his great energy and entertaining performance. I also thoroughly enjoyed the Mexican restaurant and the steakhouse, both of which served delicious meals with excellent service. There was a great variety of dining options available, and I always found something enjoyable to eat.

What truly made this vacation special was the incredible staff. A huge thank you to my concierge, Yaleidi, who went above and beyond to ensure that my stay was enjoyable and stress free. Yaleidi was attentive, responsive, and always willing to help with any request. I would also like to recognize Laura, the supervisor, who worked alongside my concierge to make sure I had the best possible experience. Her professionalism and dedication to guest satisfaction did not go unnoticed. Christian was another concierge who was incredibly helpful, friendly, and welcoming throughout my stay as he is easy to locate. Also - Gustavo made sure any little thing I needed was taken care of and checked on me throughout the day. (You can always find him)

The level of hospitality provided by the team made me feel genuinely valued as a guest. Everyone I interacted with was kind, professional, and committed to creating a memorable experience. The service, accommodations, dining, and overall atmosphere all came together to create an unforgettable vacation. Rafael at the beach bar is the absolute BEST!!

I would highly recommend Paradisus Palma Real to anyone looking for a luxury all inclusive resort in Punta Cana. Whether you are visiting for a romantic getaway, a family vacation, or simply a chance to relax and recharge, this resort delivers an exceptional experience. I look forward to returning in the future. If you are an adult, I 100000% recommended upgrading to the reserve because of the value and benefits.

Oh, also the destination inclusive activity was amazing!

reviews.author: Brianna Szymanski
reviews.text:
We had a great stay at Paradise Palma Golf Resort. The rooms were clean, comfortable, and refreshed daily, which made a big difference throughout our trip.

We played a round of golf during our stay. The course was decent, not the best we have ever played, but still enjoyable. Where this place really stands out is the service. It was top notch across the board.

The food completely blew us away. There were quite a few restaurants to choose from every night and such a wide variety of options. Everything we had was delicious. The drinks were always great as well.

A special shoutout to Martin, our server on the beach. He was outstanding, always attentive and made sure we had a drink in hand without ever needing to ask. He truly elevated our experience.

Overall, we had an amazing trip and would absolutely come back. Thanks again, Martin.

reviews.author: Richard Vieira
reviews.text:
This hotel is very luxurious. Reception friendly and efficient, rooms extremely clean and huge. Staff friendly and helpful. Entertainment professional and lots of fun. Meals very good, you can always find food of your liking, specialty restaurants available and easy to book. Beach beautiful white sand and expansive for walking. Enough chairs and sunshade without having to get up early and reserving with towels. Pools large, clean with morning exercise programs. Drinks and bars provided fast friendly service.
We had a great attentive concierge name Guillermo who was always available even though entertaining other guests. He was very accommodating even with our last minute requests.
Planning to return to this hotel without question.

reviews.author: Sogand Ajami
reviews.text:
Stayed for 7 nights ( First week of DEC 2025)

Great resort with amazing staff, but buffet needs improvement

Overall, my stay at the resort was perfect. The staff were incredibly friendly and helpful, and the entire property was very clean and well maintained. The à la carte restaurants were very good and offered great quality and service.

The only area that really needs improvement is the buffet. The quality of the buffet food was low, and most of the time it didn’t feel fresh. Items like ribs, pork, chicken, and fish were often cold, which was disappointing.

Recommendation:
It would be great if the resort added soft-drink fountains and self-serve coffee machines. This would reduce the pressure on servers and allow them to provide better, more attentive service. Guests could still order alcoholic and specialty drinks from the staff, while handling simple beverages themselves.

Overall, I enjoyed my stay and hope to see these improvements in the future.

reviews.author: Lisa Rodriguez
reviews.text: Our time at Meliá was amazing!  Antonia was terrific.  She took care of us like family and  made sure our stay was phenomenal.  If you have a chance visit Meliá and ask for Antonia she’ll ensure your time is memorable and special.

reviews.author: Aswini Singh
reviews.text: This hotel exceeded our expectations . The rooms were spotless, the staff were incredibly friendly and attentive, and the food selection was outstanding.  Our check in was smooth and enjoyable. The atmosphere was relaxing, the property was beautiful and the amenities are top notch. We loved both the pool and the beach access. Staff were constantly cleaning even the washrooms at the beach were cleaned constantly and surprisingly there was no sand in these washrooms. Perfect place to unwind and enjoy stress free vacation.

reviews.author: Joe Romano
reviews.text: We just got back from Paradisus Palma Real Punta Cana. I must say that if I went off peoples reviews I would have missed out on this beautiful and clean resort. The amazing beach with its beautiful sand and pools at every turn, wow such an amazing resort. The staff were always friendly and special thank you to Guillermo our concierge who was not only our concierge but an outstanding Gentleman and a man I know can call my family . He was attentive and always available for me and my family, anything we needed. I would also like to give a special Thank you to Rosanna our pool waitress who was entertaining and always made sure we were ok. Wander and junior fantastic, enthusiastic and always helpful thank you ( gracias) for everything. Food I honestly can say was very good, from the buffet to à la carte. I feel there was plentiful. All in all I would recommend this resort and I will be returning. Do not hesitate to book you will miss out on paradise!!! Also special thanks to Henler and Danielle from the circle Melia. Give it a go and see for yourself! To many things to list. Adios

reviews.author: Jenna MacDougall
reviews.text:
Beautiful resort. Lots of room and accommodations. Always a chair at the beach. The resort manager Diego was fantastic after we had an a la carte mixup and got us in to another asap. The Italian/pizza restaurant was incredible and our waitress Wilemena lovely.
This is a resort i would consider coming back to.
*the swim up room was worth every penny

reviews.author: Gracyn Venturi
reviews.text: We stayed here for our honeymoon! We honestly can’t say enough amazing things about this resort and the staff! Especially at Sante! We ate here for breakfast, lunch, and dinner and Romeris was amazing! Romeris sang everyday to us because my husband is Italian and she sang Laura Pausini in her beautiful voice! We will definitely be back here to visit the amazing staff! Shoutout to Napo for the amazing eggs and breakfast every morning!  Luce was also amazing and so friendly!

reviews.author: Iris Gosse
reviews.text: We had the most incredible experience at Paradisus. The resort was absolutely stunning and the staff were so friendly, with the biggest shoutout to our favourite bar tender Jose at 36 degrees. He went so far above and beyond to serve our family and made our week here so enjoyable. He made the most incredible margaritas, and kept us all smiling and laughing all week! Thanks Jose!!!

reviews.author: Alfredo E. Lamboy Rivera
reviews.text:
Excellent service! I have a grate experience in all of the restaurants. Martha in the Lunch box. Excellent! Jonathan and Jorge at the pool bar. Excellent! Emmanuel the chef at the Italian restaurant come to the table and we have the pleasure to meet him. The food was amazing. Wilmina was our waiter. Excellent! Celia at the steakhouse. Excellent!
Anthony at Ginger in the Lobby deserves more than excellent! He was above and beyond!!!

Thank you all!

reviews.author: Yuliya P
reviews.text:
We had a great stay at this resort. The kids club was a huge highlight for our family. The staff were friendly, engaging, and made our kids feel comfortable right away. There were plenty of fun activities,

The swim-up pool was another favorite, thanks especially to Arisleida, who was incredibly friendly, attentive, and always made sure we were taken care of.

Great service, great atmosphere, and a perfect family getaway. We would definitely return!

reviews.author: LM
reviews.text: I had a great experience at the resort. The staff was friendly, the activities were fun, and the atmosphere was amazing. My favorite part was meeting Fernando from the entertainment team. He taught me how to dance bachata with patience and good energy, and he made my vacation even more special. I will always remember that experience.✨

reviews.author: Bob Blevins
reviews.text:
This is our fourth time coming to this resort and I’ve always had a great experience with the exception of this time. 90% of the staff is extremely rude and will not engage you in any conversation. The buffet workers avoid making eye contact with you because they don’t want to bring you any water and if you ask for some they make you feel like it is a bother. We were at the pool and they ran out of towels to use, there were four workers at a bar that was not busy at all. I asked one of them if I could call someone and get some more towels so my wife and I could lay out. This particular pool was very close to the sister property next-door, the worker pointed to a White hut and said go over there and get a towel, so I did and the gentleman that were there argued with me and said I could not have one because my wristband was from next-door. Ultimately, they ended up giving me two towels. I went back to my chairs and the lady that I asked for the towels did nothing to replenish the towels at that station. She was more concerned with playing on her phone than helping any vacationer.

This is one example of many experiences. I was paying for A total of three rooms which equates to just under $15,000 for this vacation, including airfare. Next year, I will take that money and go to Resort that welcomes me.

This is very sad because this was our favorite place to vacation.

I strongly encourage everyone to read the reviews before you spend your money here. If service is important to you, this is not the place to come.

reviews.author: Gabriela Medrano
reviews.text: Ramon was amazing! He served us at our cabana on the beach. So attentive, so kind, so fun, I can’t say enough!! Please ask for Ramon when you attend this resort. We felt so special and so worth it!

reviews.author: Cecilia Osimanti
reviews.text:
We booked Paradisus as a family trip to celebrate a birthday.  Overall, the resort gets 2 stars from me, which I really wish I  could give more. My breakdown is below:

The Food:  for being a 5-star resort, I was expecting better food. The best food we had while on our trip was off the resort on an excursion (which wasn't even food based).  It was a real let down that we are more rice and beans at Paradisus Palma Real than anything else. The room service was below sub-par, and very inconsistent with quality and even ingredients.

The Atmosphere:  the pools were fine. Many options to choose from. The point where the atmosphere really diminished my enjoyment of a beach vacation was the bar tender on the Reserve side of the beach who consistently yipped to get attention and customers. This started the moment he got into the bar to the second he left. Non-stop. Every day. Consierge doesn't care about it, either.

Consierge:  there's a number of restaurants that are on property that I would have loved to try, but was unable to due to "no reservations" available. We got "the last reservation available on property" on Sunday, to find out that we were one of two couples in the restaurant. While I could understand limited reservations due to being packed, this resort was short of full and the demand for the restaurants was equally low.

The Spa:  I had a wonderful time at the spa, which I would like to give 5-stars to. This is the only thing saving my review from being a 1-star review.

Farming Reviews:  while dining, we were asked by waitstaff to complete a review of her services. When the QR code was scanned, it brought you to a document to review the entire resort. This felt scammy and left an overall bad taste in my mouth.

I will not return here, nor can I recommend others stay here.

reviews.author: Ricardo manuel Ramirez
reviews.text: This is my second time staying at this hotel, and honestly, it is still beautiful, very nice, and well maintained. The food is excellent, everything tastes great, and the staff is always kind and attentive. This time, I had the opportunity to meet new members of the entertainment team, and they are truly professional and do an amazing job. I met Fernando Chispa, who taught me bachata perfectly; now I know how to dance bachata, and I feel like a genius on the dance floor. I would definitely love to come back again.

reviews.author: Luigi Iannello
reviews.text:
We stayed at Paradisus Palma Real over New Year’s Eve and had an amazing experience. The resort is beautiful, spotless, and extremely well maintained, with great amenities, pools, and beach access. The staff was incredibly attentive, friendly, and always willing to help, which truly elevated our stay.
The food selection was outstanding, with a wide variety of high-quality options, and the New Year’s Eve celebration was a highlight—fantastically organized with great food, entertainment, and a fun, festive atmosphere. Highly recommend, and we would definitely return!

reviews.author: Madelyn Son
reviews.text: I had such a wonderful stay at this resort. The rooms and facilities are clean, the views cannot be beaten, drinks fresh, and the warm smiles on all the staff member’s faces really make you feel like you are in paradise. During my stay I participated in a few activities that Fernando ran, and those moments were the highlight of my entire trip. His bright energy and genuine kindness will never be forgotten!

reviews.author: Anne Page
reviews.text:
Jeffrey and Arisleida at 90 Degrees pool bar are the BEST EVER! They were the hardest working bartenders we have ever experienced. They got to know us personally, we got to know them personally, and they made our experience AMAZING. They made us feel like we want to come back to THIS resort and not experience a different one the next time we come back to Punta Cana. Jeffrey and Arisleida are the most genuine people, and we love them!

Our experience at Paradisus Punta Cana was amazing. It has a beautiful beach, beautiful commons, amazing food at ALL the restaurants, and I couldn’t have hoped for a better vacation. I highly recommend Paradisus.

reviews.author: Minerva Velazquez
reviews.text: Irvin is the best !  He talked to us everyday. We exercise with him everyday. He’s a great dancer and would dance with all of us older women. He’s gorgeous and has a great personality and looks are  great to look at. I would come just because of the service we received. .

reviews.author: Liana Stern
reviews.text: As someone who has traveled to a variety of places and stayed at many hotels, I was blown away from the service of Paradisus from the moment I arrived to the entrance. The dedication and willingness to help and accommodate from all the staff was something I have never experienced before! we stayed at the reserve side which I would definitely recommend. The reserve has a seperate beach and pool which was amazing, and bars that have higher shelf liquor and an extra restaurant with better food, and a fully inclusive mini bar restocked every day, which was so worth it! We had a small issue with our meal at Sante, and the staff there (Miasel, Melqui) went above and beyond to make up for this, and the chef made us a special dinner with lobster, champagne and more. Christopher was our concierge and he texted us every morning with the actives and found us in person every day to ask if we needed anything. He also decorated the bathtub with a happy birthday sign made out of flower petals! Johan, Alfredo and Fernando from the Entertainment team were great dancers and super fun to be around. Yuderi, Martin, Gilberto, Rafael, who were amazing beach servers and bartenders at the Reserve beach and made our bed/drinks everyday. Maximo who worked at the winery was very knowledgeable and fun to talk to. Pool bartenders, Alberto, Jonathan, and Jorge were amazing as well. Other bartenders and waiters that went above and beyond were, Miguel, Jhojan, Diorgenis, Victor, Jean, Eduardo, Luis, Yefry, Jean, Miguel, Richard, and Manolo. I have never had that much of a positive experience with a resort staff until I came here. I will definitely be back on service alone, but not to mention the amount of space in the room and the size of the pools. Everything was modern, up to date, and we had an amazing time. The food was a hit or miss, but that's expected at an all inclusive. 10/10 stay, thank you to all!

reviews.author: Manoj Kumar
reviews.text:
Rosanna was the best server and person who took care of us. Excellent customer service. Great personality.
Luisa by the pool side gave us the excellent customer service. Very friendly. She took good care of my family. Also on the go.
Luis in the kicks bar, Vianny and Parra,  were awesome. Treat us with best customer service and personality.

reviews.author: Elesa Aurelio
reviews.text:
Dana is such a lovely and sweet girl. She has a talent for dancing. I loved her aqua fitness, Salsa, and the music & dance at night. Mini Cooper was a great instructor too!

Mostly, I enjoyed the excellent food at The Lunch Box Buffet and the Flora Restaurant for local cuisine. I had an excellent stay and will definitely be returning.

Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Bill
reviews.text:
I am currently staying at Paradisus Palma Real and unfortunately this has been a disappointing experience.

The restaurants try to position themselves as upscale, but the service does not support that image. Staff at the restaurants and beach bars are often inattentive and slow. It doesn’t feel organized or guest-focused, especially for a resort in this price range.

What bothers me most is that every day a private company takes over the main courtyard area of the resort. Regular guests are pushed out of that space and made to feel unwelcome. That changes the atmosphere completely and makes it feel like hotel guests come second.

Cleanliness is also below what I would expect from a property marketed as luxury.

I still have five more days left in my stay, but I already wish I could go home. Sadly, I would not return.

reviews.author: Nora Shohayeb
reviews.text:
We are so disappointed by this hotel. The website looks so fancy and luxurious. This is not a 5 stars hotel. It is a 2 or 3 stars. The service is bad and slow. The room we got is not what we saw online. It is very old and not renovated. It is spacious and has a nice view of the sea but it is not renovated as the website claims.
The food is bad. The buffet food is cold and tasteless. The dinner restaurant are hard to book and are not that good.
Every time we go to the buffet or a restaurant, I ask for a high chair for my baby. It takes the staff 10-15 min to get it and some of the staff even ignore us.
The room service is almost non existent. I ordered a latte. It came after one hour and was not latte as the menu shows online. Just bad coffee and milk on the side.
All the good places in this hotel are for members.
There are lots of noise at the beach at night. We couldn’t sleep at all.
There are no food on the beach, just cheap and bad juices.
This hotel is a scam. I wouldnt recommend it and will never come back to the dominican Republic.
We paid lots of money to come here, and everything was disappointing.

reviews.author: Carol Blaser
reviews.text: Rafael was our man!! He took care of us down at the beach! Everyday he had us set up and provided all the drinks you wanted!! His happy face made our vacation at the Paradisus Palma Real exceptional! Gracious

reviews.author: Jeani G
reviews.text:
We had great service from Rosanna at the Lunchbox. She had a very pleasant demeanor.  Also, attentive to making sure our service was exemplary.

Our concierge Zenovia, spent quality time on making our vacation move smoothly along. She made our dinner reservations, excursions and birthday decorations in the room which made for a special vacation. Time well spent.

reviews.author: Kaya
reviews.text: Everyone was so nice! Rosanna Maria and Janita were so kind every-time we came to the buffet— always had our drinks ready before we even sat down! With all the people they handle everyday I can’t believe that they remember our preferences. Thank you for being so attentive and making our stay so wonderful and memorable.

reviews.author: Alek Karpoff
reviews.text:
I’m currently staying at Paradisus Palma Real and overall, the experience has been very positive. The beach is beautiful, with wide, comfortable sun chairs that make it easy to fully relax. The property itself is spacious and well-maintained, and the rooms are large and comfortable. The restaurants have been a highlight - both the food and service are very good - and I’ve been especially impressed by the quality of the bar service and the drinks. Overall, we’re having a great time.

That said, there are a few downsides. The buffet has been the biggest disappointment: the food quality at lunch and dinner is not on par with the rest of the resort, and the lack of service there is noticeable - you have to find your own table and chase down drinks, which takes away from the experience. Similarly, there’s no real service on the beach. While staff are present, they seem to focus on serving “VIP” guests, leaving others without attention.

Another issue is the number of local vendors on the beach. There are a lot of them, and they approach frequently - every few minutes - which can become quite disruptive. Some are loud, playing videos or calling out, which makes it harder to relax and enjoy the setting.

Despite these drawbacks, it’s still a very good vacation spot overall. The positives outweigh the negatives, and I would come back.

reviews.author: Amber Margaretten
reviews.text: This resort was amazing. Luciana was amazing at breakfast! Jorge was an amazing bartender! Raul was fantastic on the beach. Ironelis was amazing in the spa. Maria was fantastic at lunch. Starling and Socrates were fantastic in Flora.

reviews.author: Michelle A
reviews.text: The best time! We loved everything! Our only issue, which was minor, was maintenance of the rooms. The pool and beach service was the best, Dilania, took the best care of us everyday! Would easily come back again.

reviews.author: Laura Mims
reviews.text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Angelo absolutely MADE our experience. From the moment we got to our Bali beds, he treated us like VIPs—so attentive, so kind, and genuinely happy to take care of us. He kept the drinks coming, checked on us at just the right times, and somehow always showed up exactly when we needed something.

His customer service was next-level—friendly, professional, and so thoughtful. You can tell he truly cares about making guests have an amazing time, and he went above and beyond to make sure we were comfortable, relaxed, and enjoying every minute.

If you’re lucky enough to have Angelo taking care of you, you’re in for a 5-star experience. He’s a total standout and a huge reason our day was perfect. Thank you, Angelo—you’re incredible!

reviews.author: Luis Rodriguez
reviews.text: Rosanna was great! This has been our fourth time coming and this time we had a group of 14 guests in total. Everyone was very pleasant and hospitable to our group. A large table was always set up for the 14 people. We will definitely come back again!

reviews.author: Island Hopper 16
reviews.text: Luis is amazing, Fior, is the greatest server in this place. She is amazing, make sure you see her at Kicks. The food and service is amazing!  If looking for a place to eat and have a great drink stop by!

reviews.author: Jordan Hernandez
reviews.text:
I had an absolutely amazing experience at Paradisus Palma Real—specifically in The Reserve section. Mi esposa Elisabeth and I celebrated our honeymoon here, and the excitement was felt in every moment—from the incredible staff to ourselves, it truly made the experience even more special.

I want to give a huge shoutout to Adriel (concierge) and Hilberto (beach bartender), who truly made this stay unforgettable.

Their service was phenomenal from start to finish—attentive, professional, and genuinely welcoming. Adriel ensured every detail of our stay was seamless and stress-free, always going above and beyond. Hilberto kept the experience lively and enjoyable by the beach, delivering great drinks and even better energy.

The entire setting in the Dominican Republic was nothing short of breathtaking. The scenery felt picture-perfect every single day—beautiful beaches, stunning views, and an atmosphere that truly felt like paradise.

Overall, an incredible experience. I highly recommend this resort, and especially want to recognize Adriel and Hilberto for their exceptional hospitality!

reviews.author: Nia Sciarretta
reviews.text: We had a wonderful time. The rooms were bright and airy and the pool (especially the adults only pool) was clear and pretty. But—the beach access was the clear highlight. Jeyson took such good care of us on the beach and made sure we were hydrated and happy without ever being pushy. Our only real complaint was that the food was adequate at best.

reviews.author: Astrid Rosario
reviews.text: The hotel is good for taking nice photos; it's pretty and offers activities, but the service was terrible and ruined my stay. I spoke with them and booked a room, and when I arrived, they gave me the wrong room three times. It wasn't the one I requested. After I showed them the receipt for the oceanfront room that was supposed to be child-friendly, they told me they couldn't give me that room, but when I called and bought it, they said yes. In the end, they gave me a room I didn't even want. They made me run around a lot on my first day when all I wanted was to relax. Also, the website promised many things the hotel had, like horses, and when I arrived, they told me they didn't have any of that. The website listed many things, but they had almost none of it. I'm very disappointed, to be honest. If you go, look around and write down the name of the person who serves you.

reviews.author: Dylan Holton
reviews.text: Absolutely phenomenal, must go to the 90 degrees bar. The best service by far, very fun and wonderful service by Arisleida and Alberto. Would 100% recommend this resort and especially these bartender. Lorenna and Louis at Blue Agave were amazing servers and definitely had the BEST food in the resort!

reviews.author: Sean Nikmorad
reviews.text:
Enjoyed a great steak dinner at Mina Steakhouse at the Paradisus Palma Real resort.   Enjoyed top sirloin, mai tai, cheesecake, and a couple sides.   Everything was great, including the service which was by a gentlemen named Roberto who was very attentive and cheerful.

The resort is fantastic, clean, with an amazing location on the beach ,with friendly staff everywhere you need them.  The Lunchbox buffet was a highlight for food.
The only con was room service food which was under satisfactory, but it didn't affect the overall experience.

We also enjoy great live music in the evenings and great swimming options with plenty of nearby attractions.

reviews.author: Blake Kimbrough
reviews.text: Wonderful stay here at a beachfront suite at the reserve. Bartender on the beach was especially great. Only issue was that we reserved a grand reserve suite ocean front suite but it was NOT in the adults only area as we were expecting. Literally had a DJ bumping tunes to a group of kids in the pool. The room may look good online in pictures, but I do not recommend the ocean front grand suites if you’re looking for a quiet, adults only getaway. Otherwise a fantastic spot; highly recommend reserve so your butler can arrange your itinerary/reservations etc.

reviews.author: Tee Keita
reviews.text:
The personal is RUDE.

I have to say my experience was so/so. The check-in process was awful. Jean was lost and Gheiddy was rude. They weren't helpful and made us ready to leave the hotel. Furthermore, it was 3:05pm and we were told we had to wait longer to get the room. Our room didn't get ready until 4.30pm when the check-in time is supposed to be at 3. We were provided a room and before we checked in, it was changed. Then, the key wasn't working. We had to go back to get it activated. They mixed up our personal information during check-in and my Melia information is attached to my sister's information. The bell boy that we had was acting like he didn't want to help us at all and that he was bothered.

The fridge wasn't working, we called multiple times for the issue and no one addressed it (even when we were told that someone was on the way), we had the green button on to receive room service and we didn't. It was my birthday and I spoke to several people at the concierge desk  (Franklin and Andres) and I was told that the hotel doesn't celebrate birthdays anymore. I even requested to receive the information for their outside vendor which I've never received so I was unable to have something done for my birthday. I ended up getting a cake from outside myself Angela was helpful and had them sing happy birthday to me at my dinner reservation and she sent me a bottle of champagne in my room.

I travel alot and I take the time to review hotels for future travelers.

The hotel is very beautiful and clean but for the service alone that I've receive, I would never recommend someone to stay at this property,

The ONLY great part of my experience was the ladies at the buffet. They were always smiling, ready to help and genuinely cared. Yafreisy deserves ALL her flowers and the 3 ladies working with her. Yafreisy always greeted us with a smile, made sure we were all set and she even had them sing happy birthday to me a desert. She is AMAZING and they truly deserve all their flowers! She is the only reason why I even considered giving my review 3 stars. She deserves 10 stars.

reviews.author: J.Rene Martinez
reviews.text: Lunch Box buffet is amazing, excellent variety of food and drinks. Yafreisy gave us an amazing service during our entire stay, she’s very nice and professional. We definitely will return.

reviews.author: Grisleidy Santos
reviews.text: I had an amazing stay at this resort! From the moment I arrived, the staff made me feel welcomed and taken care of. The property is absolutely beautiful clean, well-maintained, and with stunning views that made it easy to relax and unwind. What really stood out to me was the customer service. Everyone was friendly, attentive, and willing to go the extra mile to make sure guests had a great experience. And the food was 10/10 and all the waiters.

reviews.author: Cynthia Stevens
reviews.text: The customer service was amazing! Everyone made sure I was covered for drinks, everytime it was empty they refilled and knew what I liked. Great music and great pool table. I would like to thank the team Luis, Diorgeniz, Raysa, Miguel , Fior for making the experience memorable!

reviews.author: Richard and Sophie Lee
reviews.text:
Wonderful vacay at this resort, esp compared to the Majestic Mirage in December!

Great friendly helpful staff everywhere, from the room to the restaurants, bars, pools and beach!
Special call outs to Wander at Kanna/Mina restaurants and Jorge at Ginger lobby bar!

reviews.author: McKenna Busateri
reviews.text: I got to stay here with my husband for 5 days for a work conference. The resort was beautiful and the reserve suite we stayed in was very nice with a luxury feel. The food was variable; our favorites were the Japanese and Italian restaurants. The bartenders were very friendly and made the trip! Beautiful, well-kept beach. We would return.

reviews.author: nik
reviews.text:
Spent a week here and it was great. Definitely worth a visit. The resort is spacious. The room is as well with a fantastic view of the pool with beach in the background. Staff is very courteous and helpful despite the language barrier.
This being my first all inclusive I didn't know what to expect in terms of cost thankfully everything is included expect for tips.
Once you're in the hotel there is no real reason to leave the complex.

However a few things to be aware of laundry service is offered but  kind of an awkward process, which involved a back and forth between housekeeping and staff over the course of several days to have my clothes serviced. Despite that being a headache customer service was able to provide a discount for the inconvenienced, which I appreciated.

The ocean is very picturesque but the water usually filled with seaweed and unusually sandy which for me wasn't it. So poolside with drink in hand was how I spent most days.

reviews.author: Patricia Pena
reviews.text: Really liked the atmosphere. Gorgeous resort. The Restaurants they have for dinner are really good and we loved Tokimeku restaurant. Ideika and Jose were very friendly serving us and helping with the dietary restrictions. Highly recommend for a relaxing place to stay.

reviews.author: Alexis Ayala
reviews.text: My wife and I attended the adult private pool at the resort and it was the most beautiful experience we had. The pool, the people, the scenery, and the staff was just exquisite. Darlin, Alberto, and Antonia had the best service my wife and I had ever experienced; amazing people to relate to. With that being said,  we cannot wait to come back and have an amazing time ! Cheers !

reviews.author: Erica Varela
reviews.text:
Our honeymoon couldn’t be better. From the amazing food, to the entertainment and the amenities of the hotel. The staff made it even better. The concierges: Harry M. & Ana Azcona were very attentive, everything we needed they were there. The bartenders: Luis (pool bar) & Jorge (ginger bar) more than their amazing cocktails, they do make you feel welcome. The buffet servers (lunch box): Jimbert & Rocio, were very attentive and always with a smile and good conversations made our mornings better. The spa therapists: Iro & Alba gave us the most amazing massage.  Carlos & Dana, the merengue teacher, made us dance and have a good time.

We will definitely come back and will bring family and friends too. Thanks all!

reviews.author: Bob McKee
reviews.text: Our dinner at The Blue Agave, was absolutely fabulous.  From the first warm welcoming smile from Maria the hostess  we knew we were in for a treat.  Melqui , our server was outstanding.  He was genuine and friendly and helpful with our selections. I was a little chilly and he had the kitchen hold  order so my husband could go to our room to get me a wrap.  Everything came out hot and delicious.It  was all the better because of his expertise and consistent commitment to us having a wonderful dinner. Five stars!!

reviews.author: Guilherme
reviews.text:
Hotel is overrated. The price charged is completely unrealistic for what it offers. Upon arrival, the guy who took our luggage to the room left angry and slammed the door because he didn’t receive a tip. The room was supposed to be for a honeymoon from the start, but they gave us a room with two single beds and did not allow us to change it—unless we paid an extra U$$800.
There’s no coconut water, no freezers around the resort to grab drinks freely. There’s no ice cream. There’s no heated pool. It was hard to even find a bar that had food. You have to order food and wait for it to be prepared, sometimes taking more than 20 minutes. There’s no ice cream.
I tried to book a restaurant for dinner, but there was no availability—not even for the next day. And the restaurants don’t allow reservations more than two days in advance. I went to get a beer at the beach kiosk, and they said my reservation didn’t cover beach beer. I went to another bar to get wine, but the wines are extremely expensive (yes, they charge for wine at an “all-inclusive” resort).
The room amenities are low quality. Liquid soap. There’s no music, no parties, no shows. It claims to be adults-only, but there are lots of children. Food service is only available at certain hours at the buffet (the only place with food for those who couldn’t get restaurant reservations). I asked for a Corona at a bar, and they said I wasn’t entitled to it.
This is the worst all-inclusive resort I’ve ever been to. The price for this ? Almost U$$3.000 for 7 days and for my honeymoon!

reviews.author: Danson
reviews.text: Buffet was absolutely amazing!! The cooks were great and informative but the service was absolutely incredible!! We enjoyed Milton, Maria, Yanira, Yineiry so much we would come back for service and experience each year bc of them!!

reviews.author: Anthony J. Kostelnak
reviews.text: We enjoyed our 5-night stay at the Paradisus. The food, beach, and grounds were all well maintained. The highlight of the trip was Martin, the beach bartender and attendant. Every morning he had our seats ready, remembered our drinks, and just made the whole experience easy and relaxing. Great guy — he’s the reason we’d go back.

reviews.author: Merly Cramer
reviews.text: The Hotel is very nice, clean , modern and full of amenities. We paid for a bali bed in Kana beach wich is in front of the beach. We had Esmelin and Raysa as a servers. They were very nice and treat as like queens. Very attentive and helpfull. Their attitude was great. Highly recommended when you go to Kana beach. Herreique also was their manager. He was very sweet and helpful.

reviews.author: 2 Wheeled Rider
reviews.text: We had a great time at the Paradisus Palma Real. Rafael made sure we had a great spot on the beach each day and we never went without a drink. It was also fun talking motocross with him. The report had more pools and bars than I could count. The weather was excellent the entire stay. Alam was our host for the stay and went above and beyond. He also could not be nicer. He made sure we had dinner reservations each night, got us whatever we needed for the room and answered any and all questions with a smile. We had a great time!

reviews.author: Rory FitzSimons
reviews.text:
Jensy @the Rum Republic and his team Miguel & Ozuna made the most fantastic drinks and created a wonderfully enjoyable atmosphere to hang out. Their knowledge of rum is most impressive!
Christopher our concierge made everything easy and took the stress off.
Special shoutout to Jean who knew ALL the restaurants and gave us excellent pointers on what to try!

reviews.author: DEBRA FRIEDLAND
reviews.text: We’re a family of 7 at Paradisus Palma Real.  Everything and everyone is wonderful.  At the breakfast buffet currently and receiving exceptional service from Roseanna and yanira.   Terrific service.   We’ll definitely be back!

reviews.author: Alexis Wafford
reviews.text:
Giving two starts because the property is so beautiful and in most cases the service was good. However the experience here was disappointing.

Let’s start with check in, I have the Amex platinum so I requested the room upgrade and the lady at the front told me they had upgraded my room, cool so I’m passed off to my concierge and then he looks at the room number and is confused and runs back to the desk to ask why I didn’t get an upgraded room and the same lady that informed me I had a upgrade told the concierge there were none available. So the lady just flat out lied to me.

Next the concierge. I stayed a total of 4 nights and was only able to reserve a restaurant on one night (reservation only restaurants) and it was horrible.
