He was supposed to follow up on multiple nights with our reservations and didn’t, so we ended up having to eat at the buffet just about every night, which was just decent, a lot of the food was cold but the desserts/fruit were good, omelet station and meat grill was about the best thing going since it’s freshly made. Service is good in the buffet and at Ginger though but unfortunately I didn’t get to experience many restaurants to provide any reviews on those.

Also they send this pre arrival form, that I don’t understand the point of. I informed them of my birthday and they told me I’d get a cake, never received that.. and also requested extra water in my room which they completely ignored and continuously had to request water.

What else, housekeeping was pretty good except for like one day where we didn’t get our room cleaned until 6pm which was annoying. Bell boys were great.

The only other issue I had was late check out, my Amex portal has guaranteed late checkout for THC AND FHR, however they informed me that it was not available for our room? I’ll definitely be reviewing through the Amex portal as well because this was not the best experience. I would love to give this property another chance when I return but not so sure about that.

reviews.author: lisa venuti
reviews.text: Antonia is a wonderful  waitress She is always smiling, very warm and welcoming. She was so attentive to our large group And made our experience at the reserve pool that much  Personal and great.

reviews.author: Brittany Rhodenhiser
reviews.text: We are here now with 6 adults and 5 kids and have had the best time! The service and rooms are fantastic. Go see Jason at the beach, he will keep the cold drinks flowing! Also Melvin at Blue Agave is amazing. They take such pride in their jobs and truly are a blast to be around!! We love Paradisus!

reviews.author: Gabriel Solomon
reviews.text:
My family and I have been coming to Punta Cana every January for the past five years, and after trying several resorts, Paradisus Palma Real remains our favorite.

The property is beautiful, well maintained, and relaxing, with stunning grounds, great pools, and a gorgeous beach. What truly sets this resort apart, however, is the outstanding level of personal service.

Upon arrival, we were assigned Ana Azcona, a personal guest concierge, which made the entire stay effortless. Even though we arrived before check-in, everything was handled smoothly — wristbands were provided, luggage was stored, and we were able to enjoy lunch and the pool immediately. Throughout our stay, Ana checked in regularly, arranged specialty restaurant restaurant reservations, and was available by phone or text anytime we needed assistance. The experience felt seamless, attentive, and truly luxurious.

Our family also has kosher dietary requirements, and the care shown by the head chef, Pedro was extraordinary. He provided dedicated cookware and utensils, sourced approved ingredients, and prepared our meals fresh in front of us so we felt completely comfortable. This level of accommodation is rare and allowed our family to fully relax and enjoy every meal together.

We return to Paradisus Palma Real year after year not only because the resort is beautiful, but because the staff consistently goes above and beyond to make families feel genuinely cared for.

We are already looking forward to our next visit and highly recommend this resort to anyone seeking exceptional service, personalized attention, and a truly memorable family vacation.

reviews.author: cathy zatyrka
reviews.text:
Andreina at the Kicks  restaurant was so incredible. - stand out service!!! She made us feel so welcomed every time we saw her. She is a great server and her attention to details is amazing!
Thanks for making our stay our TOP notch!!

reviews.author: Anisha Lobo
reviews.text: Participated in the Mamajuana activity with Juan and Irvin at Rum Republic which was great! They explained how the drink is made and the history of the drink. They even provided a homemade version which was delicious. Great experience!

reviews.author: SHELLY RAY
reviews.text:
Overall, I had a fun and enjoyable stay. The room was comfortable, the resort was quiet and relaxing, offered different activities such as yoga, paddle fitness, and workshops. The customer service was beyond excellent and everyone was very helpful, especially Carlos Alberto, who communicated with us every day, gave a great tour and made us feel very welcome.
I’ll start with all the pros: We went during off season, so the resort was not too crowded, extremely quiet with few children, wait times were minimal and service staff was excellent. The resort is beautiful and massive, with several pools and direct beach access. There were several things to do, although I had many external excursions planned, I wish i had more time to enjoy resort events. I experienced the paddle fitness class which was so much fun-the instructor was funny and it was a nice group experience. The coffee making taller was another quick but enjoyable experience. The room was clean and comfortable, and met all my needs. All the restaurants and the lobby were located in the central plaza so it was easy to navigate around the resort. Next, the excursions offered were all very fun and transportation was included.
I felt that my experience was parallel to the price I paid. Getting the Reserve would not have been worth it.

Now for the cons: The major issue being the food. There was breakfast, lunch, and dinner buffet, several gourmet restaurant options but I would rate the quality and taste of the food as less than ideal. The taste of the various meats-chicken, salmon, steak mainly - were very bland. If they wanted to keep food bland its fine, but then they should offer different local condiments for guests who want more flavor. I have had authentic Dominican food and I was disappointed that there wasn’t anything tasty or authentic at the restaurant. Even the salmon lacked something as basic as salt. The restaurants were disappointing as well, there wasn’t any flavor or authenticity and the desserts tasted very cheap. There were only 3 options for ice cream-lemon, vanilla, coconut-and they all tasted the same. The cafe near the lobby had great drink options, but the pastries left on display had bugs flying around and made the food appear less than appealing. The best food I ate was outside the resort at a nearby restaurant, Citrus, though taking the major risk of going out into the city.
Next, the check in process took a little longer than expected, and after they activated my bracelet, it didnt work to open my room.
Also, there was live music every single day, but no singer. Only on Friday there was a live band which was the most enjoyable performance.
On our final day, we went for breakfast and it was completely packed. The service was understaffed and we had to ask for every thing like utensils, cups for coffee etc.

reviews.author: John Berrios
reviews.text: Had such a great time due to the friendly and welcoming staff. The beach staff made this experience such a great time that we are coming back due their hospitality. Adriel, Gilberto, Rafael and Raul are the main reason we will be returning. This was such a great trip that I will be dragging my entire family here next year to experience this amazing resort. Can’t wait to see these lovely people again. A huge thanks again to our concierge Adriel. He made sure my wife’s birthday was one she’ll never forget. I would recommend this resort to the world. THANK YOU AND UNTIL NEXT TIME!!!!

reviews.author: Shawn Colley
reviews.text: Our 2nd time at this property and it’s always a pleasure! Julia and Juan at 36 Degrees poolside bar took great care. Alan at The Kanna Beach Club had the same attention to detail for the family. Juan Peña, the Guest Experience Manager made sure the entire stay was well worth every second. Thank you.

reviews.author: Ang Peterson
reviews.text: We had an amazing dinner at Mina Meat Haus during our stay at Paradisus Palma Real Golf & Spa Resort.  Celia was a wonderful server with the warmest smile, and Ruben made the experience even more fun with his great attitude and friendly service.  The food was delicious, the vibe was awesome, and it’s now one of our favorite restaurants here!

reviews.author: Mitch Keesler
reviews.text: Alberto and Grivin were fantastic in the adult pool, great service and drinks were awesome. They definitely added to the experience in the pool. Highly recommend to visit the swim up bar at the adult pool.

reviews.author: pc hammer
reviews.text: Loved this resort! The buffet maybe tried too hard to be “fancy”, blueagave nailed simplicity and delicious. Rooms were incredible, entire resort spotless, service great. Suggest including a gluten free ice cream so every restaurant has a dessert for the people with celiac. Can’t wait to return!

reviews.author: Alex Loomis
reviews.text:
Paradissus Palma Real was an amazing experience from start to finish. The resort itself is beautiful, clean, and relaxing, with great pools, a gorgeous beach, and a fun but laid-back atmosphere. Everything felt well maintained and comfortable.

The staff really made the trip special. The waiters were friendly, attentive, and always made sure we had drinks and everything we needed without ever feeling rushed. A special shoutout to Milton, who went above and beyond every single time—super professional, genuinely kind, and always remembered us. He made every meal and bar stop better.

The cooks also deserve a lot of credit. The food was consistently delicious, fresh, and well prepared. There was a great variety, and you could tell the kitchen staff cared about quality and presentation.

Overall, Paradisus Palma Real delivers excellent service, great food, and an unforgettable vacation vibe. I would absolutely come back and highly recommend it to anyone visiting the Dominican Republic.

reviews.author: Marc Ranger
reviews.text: Our might at the Blue Agave was fantastic. Great service from Melqui who is very professionnel and welcoming. Me and my wife had a great experience. Congratulations to all the Blue Agave team and a special thank you to the restaurant’s manager, Virtudes. She made us feel so welcome.

reviews.author: Scott
reviews.text:
Firstly, the ratings are heavily skewed because the waitresses and waiters supposedly need reviews with their names on it, but it doesn't review them, it reviews the entire hotel, so people put a 5 Star on it so those quickly glancing at the hotel to decide where to go, will see the review and think it applies to the entire hotel, when it really was just about that one server.  Scam.

The AC in the rooms are improperly installed.  They don't drain the condensation generated from cooling the room to the outside.  So, the rooms get incredibly humid, despite being a lower temperature, so everything gets sticky and uncomfortable.

Food is terrible.  I felt that everything I had was "I guess I can eat that" rather than a "I want to eat that" or "This looks great to try".

Paid the extra money for a Concierge that couldn't get a reservation for any decent times.  But that's a whole other thing.  You have to get a reservation at their restaurants for dinner, or you have to go to their buffet which is essentially recycled food.  The room service food was horrible.  They clearly just re-plated the leftover food that wasn't eaten during the buffet and warmed it up.

One of our guests got an infection from drinking some of the water.  Had to go on antiparasitics to get cured.

Service at the restaurants, if you could get in to them, was slow and uninspired.

I have been to half a dozen 5 Star Hotels in Cancun, Jamaica, Cabo, Aruba, etc.  This is NOT worthy of 5 Stars.  3 sure, 4 maybe, 5... Absolutely not.  I wouldn't return here if it was half the price.

The best food we had was off the hotel grounds.

Also, don't use their excursion desk for SCUBA diving, as the company they work with is not PADI certified.

reviews.author: Almira Hodzic
reviews.text: Excellent customer service at Kick bar . We felt so welcomed and Luis supervisor was great example of great leader. His team Adriana and Fior were going above and beyond to make our drinks made to our request and very quick. Great example of making your customers priority! Bravo Team!!

reviews.author: Trudy Fahie
reviews.text: Love the resort and the Club Melia experience.  We have been greeted many times by Emily who is the hostess at several restaurants.  She is friendly, helpful and has excellent service skills!  Our concierge, José, has been very responsive, professional and helpful.  Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Al S
reviews.text: Only knock was food listed at al la cartel was not always available or not the same meat as described. Overall very relaxing. Yafreisy was amazing in the buffet and the older guy on the egg station mo ed fast!!!  Highly recommend hotel for relaxing vibes!

reviews.author: Todd Begerowski
reviews.text:
The resort itself was beautiful and we truly enjoyed our reserve pool room. We enjoyed the service, meals, and entertainment theu out the resort.
I have to mention Gilberto at the reserve bar.  He himself made our trip with his service, friendliness, and by far he made the best Dirty Banana drinks! Thank you Gilberto! You helped make our trip exceptional!

reviews.author: Cindy Tolentino
reviews.text: Fior at Paradisus Palma real kicks was amazing her and the bartenders at the kicks bar were amazing. Super cool and amazing very attentive and caring friendly and always willing to get us what we nee. They were amazing again

reviews.author: Zackery Tenorio
reviews.text:
We had a wonderful stay here at the Paradisus Palma Real. The room was lovely and clean, came stocked with a minibar and waters/snacks.

The best part of the experience was the attentiveness of the staff. Rafael in the Reserve section of the beach was one of the best and most friendly employees I have ever worked with, made great drinks and gave us excellent recommendations on things to do.

Adriel our Reserve concierge was also exceptionally helpful. He was available to us morning and night and helped make us reservations for dinner, transportation and even activities. His help really made this trip a 10/10 experience.

Amenities and things to do at this hotel are great. Would stay here again!

reviews.author: Polina Lemberg
reviews.text:
Would like to share my recent experience  about Paradisus Palma Real hotel in DR.
I can only say that beach was beautiful  and very comfortable beach chairs.
The reservation to restaurants is not good.
It is hard to get a spot for time you are prefer.
We lived in the first room at building number 2.
One day I saw roaches in the rest room.
First time I ask the front desk receptionist and informed him about the issue, the result was zero.
I asked again a different person at the front desk, and was informed that nobody took care about roaches.
The most upsetting for me was that the last day of vacation I saw roach at headboard in the bed.
It is really disgusting.
In few restaurants the service was bed.
The waitress messed up with order and bring different fishes which we not ordered.
The restaurant we visit once Olio,  make me more upset ever.
Lady who serves us was very slow and not polite.
We was waiting to get appetizers 40 minutes,
Main course we also waited for half in our.
Different waiters served people who came much later us  quickly.
When we ordered the dessert and waiting 20 minutes, I decided to leave.
I can’t believe that such a famous hotel had been served quest with very lousy, unprofessional and  not pleasant attitude.
Not recommended to choose Paradisus Palma Real hotel in DR.

reviews.author: Anthony Cambria Jr
reviews.text:
Our first visit to this resort, and I must say—we were truly impressed by the level of service.
A special thank you to Raul on the beach and @AndresBalbuena, our personal concierge. Raul provided exceptional service and made our cabana experience absolutely enjoyable. Our friends have known him for over ten years, and thanks to them we were fortunate to meet him—he did not disappoint.
@AndresBalbuena took care of us from the moment we arrived, ensuring we were comfortably settled in our room, handling dinner reservations, and escorting us wherever we needed to go. His attention to detail, professionalism, and genuine care made our entire stay seamless.
This resort is truly a gem 💎
A quick note for anyone who purchased a timeshare years ago: be cautious. Resort names, access levels, and permitted areas can change over time. What may have once been sold as a “top-tier” or “second-best” package may not guarantee the same access today. It’s important to carefully review how your contract is written. That said, the grounds are immaculate, and the staff across the resort are incredibly kind and welcoming.

reviews.author: Patrick Campo
reviews.text:
My family and I just spent a week at Paradisus Palma Real and had a great experience overall.
The rooms were excellent—spacious, well laid out, and comfortable, with a separate bedroom and living area. The main pool is large and lively, but there are also several smaller pools if you’re looking for something quieter. The beach was beautiful and active, and the all‑inclusive setup was a real bonus. Service throughout the resort was consistently good.
Breakfast and lunch were mostly buffet‑based, and after a day or two you quickly find a rhythm that works. Dinner is a bit different: there are several restaurants, but reservations are required and they fill up fast. Our concierge, Rosmery de Jesus, was fantastic and made a huge difference. One tip is to download WhatsApp and exchange numbers—it made communication much easier. Rosmery was able to secure dinner reservations for us, which was no small feat, and every restaurant we visited was excellent and a lot of fun.
You can take a golf cart to the Rafa Nadal Tennis Center, which is a brand‑new and excellent addition. We played at night under the lights and also did morning drills with a pro. There’s also an off‑campus spa that’s easily accessible by golf cart.
All in all, it was a great experience and I would definitely go back. Being so well taken care of by Rosmery made the trip even better.

reviews.author: David Beachley
reviews.text:
Jose  36 degrees

José is wonderful.  He really added to the enjoyment of her stay.  We spent a good bit of time out on our patio by the pool and he was always friendly and accommodating.  He  does anything he can to accommodate everybody.

reviews.author: Linda S
reviews.text: Been here at Paradisus Palma Real for a week now. We have a beautiful swim up room. Julia and Jose have been taking care of us poolside. They are the best. Good service and drinks! Julia has gone above and beyond!

reviews.author: Wladmir Silva
reviews.text:
Wonderful experience!
Absolutely perfect experience! This hotel delivers the best cost-benefit stay with a trulv luxurious touch. Our concierge from Expedia, Aurora, was simply amazing - warm, professional, and genuinely caring. She made us feel completely at home.
Our daughters (7 and 4 vears old) fell in love with the kids' area - a first for them! They couldn't wait to go back, which says a lot
We also spent an unforgettable night at Fun Republic, part of the hotel's entertainment complex - pure fun for the whole family! Just a tip: don't foraet socks and tennis shoes for the kids' activities.
Aurora was 10 out of 10 - truly the best in town!
A huge thank you to the amazing team at the kids’ club — my daughters absolutely loved their time there! It was the first time they truly wanted to stay and enjoy all the creative activities and fun games these super professionals prepared. We’re so grateful for the care, joy, and energy you brought to their days.
Thank you to all of you and to Paradisus Palma Real in Punta Cana for making our stay unforgettable! 🌴✨

reviews.author: Sarah Sheehan
reviews.text: I really loved eating at Blue Agave. Yamilet was such a great server. She recommended the best food and we really enjoyed our dinner.

reviews.author: Lidiya Vynnytska
reviews.text:
Location and beach is the only nice thing about this place. They must have paid to people for the review here, otherwise I am not sure how someone would enjoy this place.
After 16 hours door to door travel from the UK we came here on 4th of April with the hope to finally have some rest. Instead I spent 3 hours back and forth with the front manager in duty trying to fit our family of 4 into room that has only one bed. She was absolutely unprofessional and lied to my face that they have no other rooms and that BA had sold us room with wrong description and we should deal with travel agent as they can’t do anything about it since their hotel in 100% capacity. Apparently junior suit with the separate living room and sofa bed meant to be in 1 room with the bench to sleep on as a sofa bed.
In addition we spent 2 days trying to have extra bed delivered to our room for my child.
Service in the main restaurant is appalling, they are lucking on all basic items every day, takes forever to get any drinks. (I would say there is no service). Rooms are generally not looked after.
We came to this hotel as they had golf and tennis, just so you know none is within the hotel and you need to pay extra to play it.
And highlight of the first day was when I came to the beach and they said they do not have any towels left🤬. Seriously, I had better service received in the 3 star hotels. This hotel charge you $550 per night as a 5*, however the place is generally mismanaged in every possible place. Would not recommend this place to anyone.

reviews.author: Carlos Santos
reviews.text:
Amazing experience! The staff was super friendly and attentive. The food was varied and delicious every day. My room was very comfortable and had everything I needed.

I loved how close all the amenities were — easy to get around the property. The gym was spotless, well-organized, and had everything for a good workout.

Only suggestion: it would be great to have more sports bars on-site.

Highly recommend this hotel and would definitely stay again!

reviews.author: Tiffany
reviews.text:
We picked this resort for the beach and the location, and both were spectacular. Being only 30 minutes from the airport was a huge added bonus after our long travel day from CA. The water changes colors all day and is absolutely breathtaking.
​The Room: We didn't get our requested King bed, but we pushed two fulls together and the cleaning crew was kind enough to make it work for us (Wyoming King style!).
​The Staff: Great service across the board; our concierge was especially helpful.
​The Food: Lots of variety; some spots are better than others, so try a few different restaurants.

reviews.author: Sarah Agner
reviews.text:
Melqui was the best server! Our food was wonderful and he was very attentive the entire time. He made sure we had everything that we needed and more. Order the churros!!! That is by far the best dessert!!
Reynaldo at the coffee shop was the best!!! He greeted me with a smile every morning (and afternoon!) for my coffee order. His coffee was the best, you can tell he puts time and effort into every drink he makes for people. We will definitely be back, and the coffee shop will be my first stop!!

reviews.author: The Conways
reviews.text: Rafael was AMAZING and provided exceptional service in the Reserve section of the beach. Very attentive to our requests for location, towels, and drinks. Checked on us frequently to ensure we were comfortable and topped up. Ensured my wife and I were relaxed. Rafael went above and beyond his duties, and made our trip that much better. THANK YOU! I highly recommend speaking with Rafael as a Reserve member when you want to enjoy the beach. Be sure to be kind and tip well! :)

reviews.author: Brandon Moore
reviews.text: My girlfriend, family and I had an amazing week at the Grand Cana. Everything was top notch including the personnel! Our trip was made that much better with our concierge Yolando, daily lunch server Kendal, our nightly drink with Delvin, and our adult swim up bar crew, Arisleida, Jefry, and Alberto! I have been to Melia in Punta Cana on multiple occasions and it is more fun each time!

reviews.author: Visa El
reviews.text: This place is a beautiful place. But definitely need better service. Apart from maybe 4 servers that were pretty awesome. They didn't have the room we wanted. Food was mediocre at best. Manager put our family of 4 n a double double room instead the 2 bedroom master suite.. With King? A little disappointed with the service. But shout outs to Guillermo, Martha from lunch box and the 4 or 5 special ones who understands and know what customer service is all about.I don't blame the workers at all. Most of them work really hard.. It's leadership n management that should make adjustments, pay attention to details when it comes to first time family guests and train their staff better. Not a fan of nickel n dimen of non premium members. They wanted to sell us on membership/subscription? They need to treat first time guests and families with the best experience as a first impression, if they want to win family subscription? Make first time guest feel like they already a premium patron. You will probably have a member for life? Adios!

reviews.author: Maxime Pouliot
reviews.text: We would like to take a moment to express our sincere gratitude for the exceptional service (Ricki de la cruz ) we received during our stay. Our server was truly outstanding — dynamic, kind, attentive and genuinely wonderful. This kind of service makes all the difference in our experience and we are truly grateful. A big thank you, it means more than you know!

reviews.author: Hannah Otten
reviews.text:
We had a great time on our girl's trip. Our goal was to rest and relax while not doing a whole lot. Mission accomplished. The food was excellent and there were always things to do on the resort.

Fernando Chispa and Ay Ay Ay were always so fun and ready to get us involved in activities. They taught us to dance and made sure we had everything we needed. Our catamaran trip to a private beach for yoga was great too!

Our concierge, Adriel, made our dinner reservations and texted us activities every morning. He even made sure we made it to dinner on time and stayed hydrated.

Great service. We look forward to coming back soon!

reviews.author: Janine Palma
reviews.text: Rosanna, Maria, Yalgeny, and Yanira provided amaaaaazing service at the buffet!! We looked forward to seeing them every breakfast and lunch. Always smiling and happy to help us. They made our trip so much brighter and I want to thank all the staff and chefs at the buffet for making such a great first time experience for me. I hope to be back soon ❤️

reviews.author: Florencia Ayelen Ciro
reviews.text:
Great instalations, people are well distributed so the pools and bars are not super crowded, and the Only adults section is chill and relaxing.
Also Good food and beach area is long and broad, lots of space. Loved the place!

Update after stay:
I had to reduce the rating because even if the place is beautiful, the service is so lacking and unresponsive that is not what you would expect for a hotel of this category.
Coffee during breakfast takes 40min, room service and replenishments take 3 hours, there is no non-alcoholic beverages in any bar.

reviews.author: Amber Wason
reviews.text: A perfect vacation. We had the best service from Maira, Yeensen, Ettison and loved every moment. They took such good care of us, were so so sweet with our family. And we loved vacationing with a kids club! Yesica, Lizabeth and Sujeidy babysat our kids all week and allowed us to have some time to relax on vacation with 3 under the age of 4. Could not recommend this place more!

reviews.author: Estrella Sagarzazu
reviews.text:
Excellent service ant the coffee shop.  Alexandra is a great worker, friendly and always with a smile.

Chef Carlos Cruz gave us the opportunity to taste pastelón dominicano. He brought it to our table of 20 and personally walked us through how it’s prepared, making the experience even more special.

reviews.author: Emma Cameron
reviews.text:
We stayed in the reserve which is the adult only part of this hotel. The room was super clean and the beach was great.  Our concierge was very helpful.  Service was a bit hit and miss and the food was mostly good.  I am a vegetarian and there were occasions where there was no vegetarian option but I mostly managed to find something to eat.

We came for our 25th wedding anniversary and the staff made a deal effort to make us feel special on the day.

reviews.author: Wayne Tragni
reviews.text: This is our sixth time at this luxury resort.  It was an incredible.  The staff was always available to assist.   The beach bartender,  Gilberto was the absolute best.  He took care of our party of 8 like we were family.   Looking forward to our return.

reviews.author: geoffrey mason
reviews.text: Jose julio valdez was my waiter at Sante. Did a great job, attentive and very personable. In fact the whole staff were wonderful. But wanted to single out Jose. He is a real asset to the hotel and you should be proud to have him as an employee

reviews.author: Pa Girl
reviews.text: Amazing space great rooms phenomenal food however service is slow and you can barely get a smile out of most of the staff. We were fortunate enough to have met some nice servers but most were lacking training and hospitality. Had two dinners that took over 2 hours to receive our food. That said I can only hope the management takes this review and seeks additional training it could most definitely be a 5 star resort

reviews.author: YARA P VEGA-ROLON
reviews.text: The kidsdom is the perfect place for parents to sit back and enjoy some adult time. I’m a very picky parent when it comes to leaving my child with someone. And they were so loving, friendly and amazing with my kid. All of them are very experienced and have a good vibe and energy. Ask for Charlina, Yoly or Sujeidy!!

reviews.author: Milana Kuranova
reviews.text: I’ve been here when I was 8 but very nice service!! I went to the pool but the pool is very deep and I am not that tall enough when I was young, but I definitely love the pool!! I went to the beach but it’s very nice but crowded lol, I went inside there but it’s really nice in here!! So tropical and so natural out there!! There some hotels too when I’ve been there!!! But nice hallways too as well!! Very nice memories!!!

reviews.author: Abby
reviews.text:
We came Mena expecting relaxation, but what we didn’t expect was to enter a full-blown carnivore paradise. From the moment we sat down, it felt like the cows had personally volunteered for greatness—because WOW. Every bite of steak was so perfectly cooked, I briefly considered proposing to the chef 💍🥩

The service? Impeccable. Junior treated us like VIPs, even though we definitely showed up looking like we just rolled out of the pool (because we did). Somehow, Junior still made us feel like royalty… slightly sunburnt, very well-fed royalty.

reviews.author: Steve Liberg
reviews.text:
Excellent atmosphere! The beaches are amazing and clean! Angelo was a great server and took care of us and made sure we had drinks or answered any questions we had about the resort!

Thanks!
Steve L.

reviews.author: Lisa Durocher
reviews.text: Reserve dinners were delicious with excellent service. We spent most days at the pool and the swim up bar service by Arisleida was top notch. Friendly and super at what she does. Took great care of us every day. She is an incredible and very hard worker.

reviews.author: Erick Zarabozo
reviews.text: Great place for R&R. The staff is very friendly and welcoming. The beaches were beautiful, and clean with plenty of lounge chairs and gazeebos to enjoy the day comfortably in the open. Special thanks to Maria at the Rum Republic who made our evenings so special and created a very friendly environment. Great experience overall.

reviews.author: Anthony White
reviews.text:
I'm not sure how this resort has such a high rating. The hotel service is good and that's about it. The rooms are nice, but you only have a glass door in the water closet for privacy. Your significant other will hear EVERYTHING when you are using the toilet.

The food and the service was horrible. A lot of the food dishes are local, and the American food is bland and unseasoned. Mashed potatoes at breakfast (yeah breakfast), were literally boiled and smashed, not blended. They did not have any butter or seasoning. The ribeye steak at one of the resaurants was tough and only about .5" thick.

Some of the restaurants are not open every day. The steak restaurant was closed when we arrived Saturday. The large buffet was closed as well two of the days that we were there.

There aren't many activities here. They had a cheesy concert in front of the main pool. Speaking of pools, the pools and the beach close at 6:00 PM. Really, I couldn't believe it.

I will definitely do more homework if I go back to the DR. Don't believe these reviews.

reviews.author: Travis Fanning
reviews.text: The experience we had at Paradisus Palma Real has been incredible. It's been the best vacation of our lives. The property is lovely but the only thing that makes it better is the wonderful people. Bernardo , Marget, Jason, Luis, Edison and Cristal. They made our trip one to remember and will have us return to the resort again next year.

reviews.author: Belmonte Liquors
reviews.text:
Jeyson Soriano has been so attentive to our needs! Such a great person! We look forward to seeing him on our next trip!
Fior was so attentive to my daughter and Luis was exceptional !Hipolito was such a pleasure to work with! I wish there were more people in the world like him! Reynaldo was a great Host every morning!

reviews.author: Lillian Calderon
reviews.text:
Alberto and Leticia were Amazing on the adults part of the resort.  6/5 recommendations!!  Love them both. Know how to keep a party going.

At the ginger bar, the one and only Luis makes the most delicious drinks ever. Highly recommend his services at the ginger bar. Amazing friend!! This is the second time coming to Paradisus and they try have incredible workers. Walquiria was amazing at the bar too.

By the beach side of the resort, Olga and Joel were truly amazing!! Provided great hospitality.

reviews.author: D'Navia
reviews.text: Luis at Kicks Sports bar was So fun, welcoming, attentive, and entertaining from start to finish. You made our Mother’s Day trip feel extra special and we had such a great time. Thank you again for the incredible service and energy 🤍

reviews.author: CAMILLA SANTANA
reviews.text: Service great all around! Ariel as concierge was super helpful for anything regarding hotel information or reservations. Martin on the beach was so sweet and so accommodating with drinks and cabana set up. Truly a pleasure and would recommend to anyone interested in a super relaxing vacay!

reviews.author: Andrea Toledano
reviews.text: Great experience at Kicks! Diorgeny and yiri were attentive, making sure I had a drink in my hand as soon as my current drink was running low. They were great conversationalists and bartenders made my experience at the resort exceptional!!!! Definitely recommend :)

reviews.author: Matthew Kan
reviews.text:
Avoid this hotel if you always speak English, but not Spanish. Most of the stuff here only speak Spanish they don’t even speak minimum English. It is very hard for me to communicate what I need to them.

Check in process was difficult. You have to pausing the check-in time 3 pm. My room is still not ready. It was ready until 4 pm.

Food is okay they didn’t really chip out on the selections of ingredients however it is not tasty compared to its competitor.

The beach is nice, however, it is always lacking towel provided to you.

Poor service: as I’ve mentioned previously language is an issues. However, I also find that they are very eager of tips if you don’t pay tips you don’t get good service which I think is a big no-no in this all-inclusive hotel that’s unprofessional. Plus, even when I put on the do not disturb light or one of the staff still knocks our door to ask if we need to refill our mini bar. Really unprofessional.

Overall, as a Hilton Gold member and Marriott Bonvoy Diamond member. I would not recommend this hotel to anyone even if they have discount.

I have no idea why it has 4.8 stars on google review actually. Tell me if you have a different opinion.

reviews.author: Kimberly Fabian
reviews.text:
Kicks sports bar- great time nightly. Fior is the best! Luis is a a sweetheart!

Alam on concierge dropped the ball multiple times. A tad disappointed with the attentiveness.

Buffet was garbage besides lunch. Most servers are rude or don’t know any English to explain what anything is.

No drink service on the beach, however vendors nonstop trying to sell you things.

Views, pool, and resort itself are beautiful and the nightly entertainment is a good time!

reviews.author: Lisa-Marie Braxton
reviews.text: Really wonderful resort. The restaurants on site are great. Thus far we went to fresca and mascalzone.  At mascalzone the hostess Daniella was great and attentive. The restaurant staff we had was wilimina who was wonderful. Definitely worth the stay here.

reviews.author: Thomas Garza
reviews.text:
Pools-awesome,  restaurants-meh,  buffet-ok, beach-outstanding service was good as long as you tipped. For excursions,  if you don't go to the first person you talk to, They get mad and blow up your phone.  Waiters and waitresses- every nice. The grounds were beautiful
Shows we're also good.

reviews.author: Jen Flory
reviews.text:
We recently stayed at Paradisus Palma Real – The Reserve, and while the property itself is beautiful, our overall experience didn’t quite live up to expectations.
The grounds are absolutely gorgeous and very well maintained—no complaints there. However, the service was inconsistent. Some staff members were warm, pleasant, and helpful, while others seemed inconvenienced and uninterested in assisting guests.
Dining was one of the biggest disappointments. Upon arrival, we were asked for our preferred restaurants, but when it came time to confirm reservations, none of our requests were available. We were left choosing between limited openings or the buffet. Food quality overall was underwhelming, including room service. The one highlight was the omelette bar, which was consistently good.
One bright spot of the trip was the main pool swim-up bar. The bartenders—Eddy, Jorge, and Dalania—were fantastic and truly made our last day enjoyable.
The room itself was another letdown. It felt very humid and never fully cooled, which made it uncomfortable at times. Additionally, our room wasn’t ready at check-in, and when we finally got access, the minibar hadn’t been stocked. While not a major issue on its own, it added to the overall feeling that the experience didn’t match the resort’s reputation.
We were honestly surprised by the high ratings, as we’ve had much better experiences at other Caribbean resorts. While the property looks incredible on paper, it didn’t deliver in several key areas.
Overall, not worth the hype.

reviews.author: Linda gaskell
reviews.text:
This is a wonderful all-inclusive hotel. Architecturally beautiful with stunning green landscaping.  Great that there is a large adults only area.  Swimming and tennis and golf facilities are excellent.  2 x 40m pools to swim in as well as leisure pools which offer fun activities.  Staff throughout the resort are fabulous; genuinely friendly and attentive to our needs.
Special thanks to Delania who looked after us by the pool every day and left us wanting for nothing.  Lovely lady 👌
also thanks to the concierge staff and luggage staff.  SO HELPFUL and FRIENDLY.   I would be very happy to return here.

reviews.author: Warda Hagi
reviews.text: Everyone provided such amazing service, Roylin in the gift shop was very helpful, food was delicious, atmosphere was spectacular. I loved my experience here! The only critique I have is it was very difficult trying to get in contact with service on the phone, and when we were able to connect with someone to request something, they would not fulfill the request after agreeing.

reviews.author: Daniel De la cruz
reviews.text:
I had a great experience at the Paradisus resort. One of the highlights was definitely the bar—excellent atmosphere, high-quality drinks, and friendly, attentive service.
I’d like to give a special mention to Fernando “Chispa,” the entertainer. His energy, charisma, and positive attitude truly stand out. He makes every activity more fun and helps create a lively, welcoming vibe for all guests.
Overall, Paradisus is a wonderful resort and a place I’d happily return to. 🌴🍹

reviews.author: Jonna Coleman
reviews.text: One of our best vacations to date! Beautiful location. Amazing staff. Everything was always clean. And the food was excellent!  Sante with Romaris and Gustavo was a daily routine and they always remembered us and knew our “usual”. We felt like royalty. So many great things to say about our whole experience!  Our consierge Francisco was a dream!  He made sure we had everything we needed before we knew we needed it!  The Japanese restaurant also had a great hibachi!  We had a blast. So many laughs and we met some other guests and made new friends. The steak house was to die for. The winery was wonderful and so classy. I could gush about the Paradisus Palma Real for paragraphs!  We will be back!!  One suggestion to management … some better bourbon/whiskey selections would be a bonus. But other that I don’t think I’d change a thing!!!

reviews.author: Soumya Poduri
reviews.text:
Update: After my initial review, the resort manager took time to personally speak with us, listen to our concerns, and work toward addressing them. That effort was appreciated, and some staff did go out of their way to make us comfortable. Housekeeping made sure they did not use strong chemicals so it felt safe for our kids.

Eduard (customer relations) is new and is committed to elevating this property to Melia luxury standards.
Despite some initial hiccups we had a great time and hospitality was on point after our conversation with Eduard.

I am writing this review as I am staying at this property. I think all the positive reviews are from the folks staying at the reserve side - maybe?. We've stayed at luxury Melia resorts and this ain't one. Rooms are old and worn (they do not look like the images on the website at all), staff is rude, they didn't honor any of the extras that we were supposed to get with our booking, they never stocked our minibar, and the room had an extremely strong odor of chemicals when we entered - we had to air it for many hours and it still lingered (housekeeping didn't want to do anything about it - after several calls, we gave up). May be we are paying brown tax - because I see several reviews where folks got excellent service. I actually had to tell the person who was at the towel booth to be polite and not be rude to me. Food is decent for an all inclusive. Location is great - it is one of the resorts that clears all the sargassum using an automatic weed harvester.

reviews.author: Alysson & Christopher
reviews.text:
The reserve section is a must. The service is impeccable, the staff is amazing and shoutout to Yeison, Markos, Theo and Jendry, you made our week unforgettable.

Santé restaurant was also a MUST, the staff is amazing, Juan, Gustavo and all the others were so welcoming and kind. The food is always different and incredible. The reserve is a must if you want to eat well Everyday, for breakfast, lunch and dinner! 10/10, we’ll come back for suuure

reviews.author: Dominick Dalessandro
reviews.text: Daliah was amazing!  Best service we have had all week!  She was personable, welcoming and such a pleasure!  Our only regret was we didn’t meet her the first few days here!  She was always checking in on us!  Got us drinks whenever we needed them!  In fact she had them ready for when we were finished!  She was phenomenal! Such a pleasure!! Thank you!!

reviews.author: Jake Schuldt
reviews.text:
We stayed at the resort for 3 nights in late November. The airport is only about 25 minutes away, so the ride in is fairly short. The resort is clean, beautiful, and quite large, but once you familiarize yourself with the main areas it's easily walkable. The staff was okay, definitely not as friendly as most other places I've been, but not bad. The basic room we got was plenty spacious, very nice, clean, and had some extra toiletries and stuff that made it on the higher end of rooms I've stayed in. Surprisingly nice and decently spacious gym.

A major disappointment for us was the food. The buffet food was mostly all cold. We tried the Dominican restaurant for a reserved dinner one night, the steak was horrible. It tasted like the cheapest cut of meat boiled. By the end of the stay, all I could really eat was omelettes and fruit. The coffee was burnt and gross everywhere. There isn't any quick dining places like many resorts for safe options, and being a bit far from the downtown area, it left us filling up on drinks.

The drink selection was impressive for an all-inclusive resort, having some mid-tier options, like Jameson, Tito's, etc at many bars. The bars were spread out well, except for the beach (none we saw). The beach is very spacious but full of salesmen for off-site excursions. I had some drinks and got suckered into one for a buggy ride, and it was more than the asking price and not worth it. Avoid them at all costs.

Top gotchas:
- the "club" they mention is just the sports bar where they move the DJ inside.
- there is no 24/7 bar. The main lobby bar is advertised as such and wasn't open late.
- the time of year we went, everything was eerily empty. It was nice for getting drinks, but I feel like that affected the food quality.
- don't buy anything from people going around with flyers. Go through Viator or the front desk.
- only one small convenience store in side.
- no hot tubs
- signage is non-existent, so it's hard to know where and when you can eat
- cabanas on the beach were all empty but we got asked to move as they were reservation only (again no signage)

reviews.author: Michelle Wierzbicki
reviews.text: Rafael and Alam are amazing! They made our trip. Rafael had our beach chair set up every day waiting for us and was always present with a refreshing drink!  Alam took care of everything we needed from dinner reservations, to breakfast in the room, and anything else we needed. What a truly awesome and friendly guy.  Great trip to Melia Palma Real!!

reviews.author: Michael H
reviews.text: Rosanna, its the best hostess at the main pool,  very attentive and always a smile.  Remembers your drink of choice, and never walks past without checking on you.  Makes your stay worth it and would come back just because of the amazing staff throughout the property. When you're here you are family and they treat you as such.  Highly recommend, give it a try if you're on the fence, its our first visit to the Dominican Republic and to an all inclusive. Definitely caters to the adult side of things.

reviews.author: diane kolessar
reviews.text: We stayed at The Reserve area of this resort & enjoyed our stay a great deal.  We had Alam as our concierge.  He was attentive, gracious & friendly & was there for all our needs.  He took care of our dinner reservations.  All the restaurants & bars were very good.  We especially liked the Mexican & the Italian.  All the servers were great.  Would recommend this resort, especially the Reserve section. Ask for Alam--he's the best!

reviews.author: Linsy Grozdanich
reviews.text:
Excellent service by Yamilet at blueagave!  She had excellent recommendations and catered to our every need!

Rafael at the beach was amazing all week!  He’s our guy!

reviews.author: Bernard Miraflor
reviews.text: First of all thank you to Idelka our server. She is absolutely amazing. To Eddy and Rodolfo for the amazing food. We ordered T bone steak it was so delicious. Lastly, thank you to Romeris for her wonderful service.

reviews.author: Ravi B
reviews.text:
Checked in late with a baby, and despite informing the hotel in advance, the room was not ready.

To make matters worse, none of the basic room amenities were functioning properly — the telephone, fridge, hair dryer, and even the safe lock. We contacted concierge four separate times, but since the room telephone wasn’t working, we were forced to walk from an extreme end of the property to the lobby each time and then wait to get assistance — an unacceptable experience when traveling with an infant.

2 days and 6 times we complained about replacing the fridge, each time they said they will send someone but no one showed up. All my baby food got spoiled. Room service was so slow that a few times my baby slept crying.

Basic 101- travelling couple with an infant - allotted us a room with 2 twin bed instead of a king bed and no baby crib (despite requesting it 3 weeks prior)

We requested a room change and also asked multiple times for the devices to be replaced. Even after giving the hotel over 24 hours to resolve these issues, no action was taken and there was no follow-up.

A property that calls itself 5-star should at the very least ensure basic room functionality and timely service. Unfortunately, both basic amenities and service response were severely lacking. This experience was frustrating, exhausting, and far below the standard expected of a hotel in this category.

I am at the hotel while writing this. Lets see if management reads this and resolves this.

Location wise its a great resort, service was poor.

reviews.author: Scott Miller
reviews.text: The staff at the Reserve pool bar nearest the ocean, we're very pleasant and helpful. They come around to see if you need anything. The lady always had a smile. The bartender was very nice also.

reviews.author: noah de booij
reviews.text:
The hotel is very beautiful and very Well located only 30 minutes away from the airport.
We stayed for 10 days and had overall a very good expérience.
The highlight of it all was Martin. He took care of is everyday at the beach and made sure we always had our sunbeds ready. He is a gem!
Only thing that i would like to point out is the service in the restaurants that can be a lot better.

reviews.author: Wayne Parrish
reviews.text: We just experienced an excellent meal and exceptional service by Yeensen at Mascalzone, at the Italian restaurant at Paradisus Palma Real in Bovaro, the Dominican Republic. Yeensen’s attention to detail was exquisite - my wife had barely put down her wineglass before he was refilling it, despite serving several tables. We complimented his work to Milton, his boss, and promised we will be back before heading home!

reviews.author: Frayner Mariano
reviews.text:
Excellent stay at Paradisus! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
Amazing experience. The pool is wonderful—super clean and perfect for total relaxation.
But what truly made the difference was Fernando "Chispa". He is a top-tier entertainer with incredible energy that brightens your day. He made our vacation so much more fun! Without a doubt, a huge asset to the hotel.

reviews.author: Olivia Thomas
reviews.text: Second time visiting this resort. The beach, pools, and resort in general are lovely! Food can range from good to okay, depending on what restaurant you go to. Some staff members can seem bothered by questions that are asked, which at time makes it uncomfortable. Overall, we enjoy our time at Paradisus Palma Real.

reviews.author: Theresa Malfitano
reviews.text: Ramon was our beach server and was excellent!  This is our second time staying at the Paradisis and so glad Ramon was still here!  He took care of us (4 adults and 4 kids) the whole week!  With drinks and chairs and overall amazing attitude Ramon was awesome. Seek him out on your visit!!

reviews.author: Sara Jones
reviews.text:
Delania provided excellent service by the pool every day of our trip. She remembered our drink orders, had great energy and made us feel welcome!

The buffet should have been refreshed more frequently and some of the restaurants were a bit disappointing. We loved our room and all of the pool bars. The service was excellent with everyone we encountered.

reviews.author: Ruben Felipe
reviews.text: The service in this Resort is VIP status all the way.  Recommend 100% - It’s very accommodating and friendly.  Food is amazing and the staff is great.  Want to thank specifically Rosanna and Yanira for their espectacular service. in the buffet.  Treatment and service was amazing!!

reviews.author: Marc Millecam
reviews.text: Arismendis negueis Jean was the greatest server ever!! Our 4th anniversary st the Paridisus Palma Real, was a romantic dinner on the beach. Service was spectacular and the food was amazing!! 10 out of 10 is only a start. Highly recommend for your special occasion. Thanks!!

reviews.author: Tara Schmitz
reviews.text: The resort was absolutely fabulous. The views were unmatched. There was plenty of seating and we never felt rushed anywhere. The Mina restaurant was spectacular and Yudelquis was the sweetest server. We did parasailing and lounged by the ocean reading and relaxing. We would highly recommend this resort.

reviews.author: K H
reviews.text:
Kicks Bar was amazing... especially Luis! He went out of his way to bring me a Dirty Monkey because I have never tried it. Its not even on their menu. Their blender was broken and he went to a whole other bar to make it for me and personally handed me one! Always ask for Luis!

Also!!! At the adult pool bar there is Marileisy. She kept the banana mama drinks coming without me even having to ask. There was a wedding party present and the staff worked hard to make sure we had a good time. Alberto kept hosing us down with champagne at request.

reviews.author: Graziele Sodré
reviews.text:
Extremely disappointing experience — not recommended for honeymoon

We arrived at the hotel after more than 12 hours of travel expecting to finally relax and start our honeymoon in a beautiful place. Unfortunately, the experience began in a very frustrating way.

When we checked in, we were given a room with two single beds that could not be joined, even though we are a couple on our honeymoon. On top of that, the air conditioning was not working and the phone in the room also did not work, which meant we couldn’t even call reception for help.

After going to reception and asking for assistance, we waited over an hour with no solution. We were exhausted from the long journey and the situation became extremely stressful. Only after insisting several times did the staff offer a solution.

The “solution” was moving us to a lower category room, which felt like a downgrade. When we entered the new room, it had a strong smell of mold, so strong that I had to take an allergy medication. Because we were extremely tired, we had no choice but to accept it.

To make things worse, because we spent so much time trying to solve the room issue, we missed the reservation time for the restaurants, which closes at 5 pm. Now the hotel staff is being very bureaucratic about where we are allowed to have dinner.

This is supposed to be our honeymoon, and unfortunately what should have been a special experience has been extremely disappointing. I chose this hotel because of the good reviews, but our reality has been the opposite.

For couples planning a honeymoon, I would honestly not recommend this hotel. The service and the way this situation was handled were far below what we expected.

reviews.author: Ryan Fitzpatrick
reviews.text: This hotel was very disappointing. The food was subpar at best, and not edible at worst. The staff were mostly friendly but the service at the restaurants was slow, illogical and disorganized. Many of them didn’t seem to care.  The hot water in our room rarely worked and the shower pressure was pathetic. Lastly there was very little to do for kids. The pools were cold but there were very few shallow areas and nothing substantial to help entertain kids for a week. After reading the reviews I was very excited that we had found a gem but I will not be coming back

reviews.author: Amanda Urquidez-Cabrera
reviews.text: The Blue Agave food was very good. The staff (Alquenio and Lorena) were welcoming, attentive, and made the entire experience enjoyable from start to finish.

reviews.author: Shawn Johal
reviews.text: Reynaldo the captain - just wow! Such incredible service at all times. Always going above and beyond. Cristal in the coffee shop was so sweet. Yamira and Patricia in the buffet were so attentive. Would come back just to see these wonderful people!

reviews.author: Trenton Sullivan
reviews.text: This was not my favorite resort.  Nothing blew me away.  Service in the DR is... different.  Staff is not mean butt they aren't overly helpful.  I don't need someone doting on me every moment. At the same time there were several times I'd have an empty water glass or no coffee and several stag would just walk on past. Our concierge was fine but not a helpful or attentive as others in our area.  Our fridge never worked and they never came to address it. Food was above average for an all inclusive and the drinks were really really good.

reviews.author: Sarah Lewis
reviews.text: Melqui was an amazing server at Blue Agave. He was so attentive and joyous in his work! Food was pretty good and fast. Hotel is very clean!

reviews.author: Ravil Troncoso
reviews.text: One of the best Hotel we have stayed. Steak Retaurant is a must if you want to enjoy good food. The server Celia and the Supervisor Raider were on top of every detail of my wife birthday

reviews.author: Stephanie Johnson (Hidden Star)
reviews.text: Rafael was the best waiter on the beach!! Best service, never had an empty drink, he saved our beach chairs every morning!! Top notch guy!! Made our days so much better!!

reviews.author: Latoya Cheves
reviews.text: Overall - Great place for a vacation. Staff are friendly. The compound is clean and has all amenities you’d want. The Italian food restaurant was Mui Buena

reviews.author: Matthew Lindenbaum
reviews.text:
Rosanna, Yania, and Maria were wonderful and attentive all throughout our trip.  Thank you!

Jendry, our personal concierge, was outstanding.  He made our trip go so smoothly and made sure all of our activities and reservations were exactly as we wanted them.

Juan, the omelette chef was fantastic too.

reviews.author: wyatt Flicek
reviews.text:
This resort has been a amazing experience. The workers are family. Antonio is the best. He made us feel like true family. Was so welcoming and fun. He made the ginger bar the ginger bar. All the workers Luis, Clari, Katnerine, Mileygi, yislmeiry, Amgie are part of our new family. That was what made the trip so special for me and my family. Such a friendly atmosphere. Antonio is top notch.
Rooms are awesome and relaxing, the beach is beautiful and kept vary clean. Restaurants are all awesome.

reviews.author: Allan Plaskey
reviews.text:
Melqui at Blue Agave was excellent! Service was great and the dishes were delicious
Tried the chicken enchiladas, quesabirria and chicken flautas

Yanira and Maria at the Buffett were outstanding
Courteous and kind

Guerillmo our concierge was very good
Helpful and kind

reviews.author: Michael Baird
reviews.text: Service is impeccable. Rosanna from the pool bar is the best. She takes great care of us every day. She always remembers what our favorite drinks are. And our cups are never empty. The resort is very clean. Housekeeping does an immaculate job. Coffee station Kathryn and Christal are the best. Luis at the main pool bar also took good care of us. 10 out of 10 recommend

reviews.author: Pradeepa Jayaprakash
reviews.text:
I am currently staying at Paradisus Palma Real Punta Cana, with checkout scheduled for December 26. I never imagined I would be writing a review like this during my holiday — and especially on Christmas Eve — but the experience so far has been deeply disappointing and has truly spoiled what was meant to be a special vacation.

It has become very clear that guests are treated differently based on bracelet color. While I understand the concept of tiered service, what I have experienced as a green-bracelet guest goes far beyond differences in amenities. I have repeatedly been ignored by servers, had difficulty getting restaurant reservations, and have been treated with noticeably less courtesy, while guests with brown bracelets are openly prioritized right in front of us.

One situation was especially upsetting. At one of the restaurants, when I tried to order dessert, the server abruptly took the menu out of my hands without any explanation. This is unacceptable in any hospitality environment, let alone a resort that advertises itself as “luxury.”

As an Asian guest, I am also left wondering whether some of this treatment may be influenced by racial bias or expectations around tipping. Either possibility is troubling. No guest should feel pressured to tip just to receive basic service, and no one should be treated differently because of their appearance, nationality, or perceived spending level.

Tiered service should never mean neglect, rudeness, or a lack of basic respect. Every paying guest deserves professionalism, courtesy, and dignity — regardless of bracelet color.

Sadly, this situation has overshadowed my stay and taken away much of the joy from what should have been a relaxing holiday vacation. Until these issues are addressed, I cannot recommend Paradisus Palma Real, particularly for travelers booking through third-party partners such as Costco Travel.

— A disappointed holiday guest

reviews.author: Steven Gonzalez
reviews.text: One of the best hotels I have ever stayed at. The Flora restaurant is amazing. In particular the service from Kelvin and Melina were excellent. The food was also so tasty and good proportions. I  Definitely recommend the restaurant and hotel!!!!!

reviews.author: Junior Ramirez
reviews.text: My partner and I had a spectacular time here at the resort. One person that stood out the most was Antonia! She is one of the bartenders at the pool bar and she was amazing! She took great care of us and just made our experience better. She always looked out for us whenever we passed by! Thank you!!!

reviews.author: Samra Desevic
reviews.text:
From the moment we arrived, the service at this hotel was truly unmatched. The staff provided constant attention in the most professional and warm way — always present when needed, but never intrusive. Every detail felt thoughtfully handled, making our stay incredibly relaxing.

I have to highlight Arisleda, who was nothing short of amazing. She consistently checked up on us, made sure we had everything we needed, and went above and beyond to make us feel cared for. Her kindness, attentiveness, and genuine hospitality elevated our entire experience. It’s rare to meet someone so dedicated to their guests’ comfort.

I also want to mention Rosanna , who greeted us daily for breakfast and gave us the best service we would have asked for at the lunch box ! She made us feel so welcomed

If you’re looking for a hotel with exceptional service and staff who truly care, this is the one. We will absolutely be returning

reviews.author: Lisa Fussell
reviews.text: Mina was a phenomenal restaurant! Junior was our waiter, and he took excellent care of us. He anticipated our needs before we even had to ask. Our food was delicious and perfectly cooked. The selection of food was good, and our food arrived in good timing, was promptly served, and cooked to perfection. We had a wonderful experience and would highly recommend.

reviews.author: L Young
reviews.text: The staff at the "Ginger Signature Bar" was awesome. They provided us with exceptional service and a very good time. The "Blue Agave" is also great. The food and the service by Jasiel and Alquinio was exceptional.

reviews.author: Ryan Taft
reviews.text:
Staff friendliness was at the bottom end of acceptable, but did not meet my expectations at all. English ability enough to get by but difficult too often for me. Food was ok, rooms were very nice. Trash in bushes. Pool bar had 1x3' chunk of the top broken off with a giant rusty chunk of steel sticking out (right where people get in and out, very dangerous). We were there 5 days, it never got covered/roped off/fixed, nothing. The broken chunk was laying in the bushes behind the nearby bathroom. Solicitors on the beach very aggressive. One of them FREAKED OUT when I told him to leave us alone, started cursing at top of his lungs and even took steps towards me. For a few seconds we thought he was going to attack us. Totally ruined the beach for us. On checkout we told the staff that an overgrown palm tree was completely blocking the view from our balcony and suggested trimming it slightly. The staff did not thank me for letting them know, didn't care, and I'm positive that tree is not getting trimmed.

Comparing to prior experience in Mexico, I was disappointed and would not go back.

reviews.author: Jay Walker
reviews.text:
I returned to Paradisus in the Dominican Republic to celebrate my 50th birthday, and after seven years away, I can say it absolutely did not disappoint! From the moment I arrived, the front desk provided an immediate, warm welcome that set the tone for the entire stay.
The highlight of my trip was being paired with the most amazing concierge, Alam. He is truly exceptional. Alam has an incredible spirit and a way of making you feel like his absolute priority, even though he was managing several other guests. He ensured every single one of my needs was taken care of with genuine care.
Alam’s level of service "caused an uproar" in the best way possible—he truly made the experience memorable. Anyone lucky enough to be helped by him will be well taken care of.
The resort itself is beautiful and breathtaking. It was the perfect backdrop to commemorate my 50th birthday. I had a truly amazing time and I will absolutely be back!

reviews.author: Rebecca Tarwater
reviews.text: Yuleidi, Lia, and Romeris did a phenomenal job at the Asian hibachi restaurant!!! Adalia was an excellent cook and entertainer!! Better habachi than I have ever had in the states or anywhere. Thank you for a great experience!

reviews.author: Jesse Monette
reviews.text: The company I work for hosted a customer appreciation trip . 950 customers plus another 100 plus employees.  Hands down an amazing experience.  The resort is awesome. Room was very clean and extremely roomy . Food was great at the buffet  and anyone of the restaurants. Maria, The hostess at the buffet is a gem and made sure my Spanish was on point. Every night was a party in the courtyard and sports bar. Tons of entertainment.  Never a dull night.  My guy Luis at the swim up bar makes some mean cocktails. Only wish we stayed longer!

reviews.author: Melanie Madden
reviews.text:
Luciana was great for our breakfast service every morning. So cheerful and helpful. She met our every need no matter the request.
Guillermo was our concierge and was so helpful and attentive throughout our stay. He sought to make our experience a great one as we celebrated our 20th wedding anniversary.

reviews.author: Alexis Mason
reviews.text: PARADISUS is amazing! All around 5 stars. Rooms are clean, the grounds are pristine, and the service is awesome. Special shout out to Rosanna,she was a welcoming and friendly face to see each day!

reviews.author: Parker Wheeler
reviews.text: Jeyson serving drinks on the beach from the Celsius bar has taken amazing care of us all week. Would recommend finding Jeyson when you are here, he is ready with our drink orders every morning. Thanks for a great time!

reviews.author: Joel Lambiotte
reviews.text: Rafael was the best! Amazing person all around! Couldn't have asked for a better server and friend to have around the beach! He made our time a great experience.

reviews.author: Ana Milena Bello
reviews.text: We have dinner in  the Flora restaurant, wich is the Dominican one. We have a very good experience, the food was delicious and the attention was exceptional.  Our server Melina was very  good she made sure we had a great service. Please ask for her in flora.

reviews.author: Mia Carosone
reviews.text: The Rum Bar is so nice and the workers are super friendly! Maria is the best! The adult pool Alberto and Yefry are super good and make the best drinks, the best servers!!!!

reviews.author: felix bolduc
reviews.text:
Amazing experience !
The reserve section is the best, awsome services from Martin and Yuderi at the beach ! They are there for the people and to ensure you feel pempered and notice. Best drink at the beach, best food at santé and all 6 night restaurants.

Santé was awsome, great services, food and very welcoming, even for our dog ! 🐕

And can't go without a say, thank you to the team of the hotel and specially to our great concierge, Alam!

reviews.author: Ed Barbour
reviews.text:
Family of 4 six night vacation 24-30 Dec 2025, we chose the (EJS) Reserve Junior Suite Garden View category room x 2 for two parents + 21 y/o daughter and 18 y/o son Christmas vacation.  This cost a lot but we enjoyed every minute.  Each restaurant offered delicious meals, we almost always ordered different entries, and shared the starters and desserts loved the whole food experience.  The pool experience was great, as long as you’re familiar with the resort style land grab, pick where you want to spend the day before you go to breakfast! That said, the pools and beach always have enough places to relax for everyone.  The staff throughout the property was always pleasant, helpful and accommodating, I could not ask for more from them.

Our visit included Father/son golf at Cocotal twice, easy going atmosphere, practice range is available, start time is not absolute, the reviews on cost are accurate, I was glad we brought our own clubs, drinks and food might be included in the cost of golf but we just drank water so maybe not.

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay.

reviews.author: Carrie Jefferson
reviews.text: Julia & Jose are amazing!  They've really  made our stay - their service is impeccable every time.  We are super excited to see them every time we return and we've been coming for the last 5 years.  Truly fantastic staff.

reviews.author: Sean Mack
reviews.text: Angelo and team did a great job with pro riding outstanding customer experience at The Reserve poolside bar.  All welcomed us every morning and throughout the day to make sure we were enjoying our vacation. I'm sure they will continue to set the bar high of expectations. Well done, my friends!

reviews.author: Alicia Oleary
reviews.text:
Jeyson at the beach is 10/10 for service!
Super friendly, and always made sure that our drinks were never empty and always bought a friendly smile!
He also remembered us throughout the entire week!  Highly recommend

reviews.author: Robert
reviews.text: Maria, Stormin, and Anica were the very best. Sat us down and the service was great. Nice beach view. The food was served quickly and delicious. Great spot!

reviews.author: Stacey Goodwin
reviews.text:
Angelo,

Waiter at the beach was Excellent. He’s very attentive and helpful. He makes you feel comfortable with Dominican language and communication. He helped set up excursions for us. He’s smile was a daily joy.

reviews.author: Cristie Schultz
reviews.text: Incredible hotel. Perfect for our large group. Great beach, big clean rooms and overall an incredible experience. Jhojan was our beach server and took such great care of our big group on the beach throughout our trip. Super friendly and attentive. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Sophie A.
reviews.text: Staying here was a dream! All the staff were incredibly nice. Fernando and the entertainment crew were amazing. They all went above and beyond to make our stay memorable.

reviews.author: sam baum
reviews.text: Beautiful hotel. Clean pool and beach. Food was great. Alan, our concierge, was fantastic. He went above and beyond everyday. He got us reservations every night, and made my sister’s birthday extra special. 10/10!

reviews.author: CAROLINE ZILKHA BERAKHA
reviews.text:
We chose the hotel to celebrate my mother's 80th’s birthday and we couldn't have made a better choice! She was delighted and happy! We were a large group of 18 and the staff spared no effort in serving us in the best way possible, always with kind smiles. A special thank you to those who made our family dinners an exciting and special gathering: Rodolfo Barcellos (from day one in reservations)
Floranlly Caipio, Chame (restaurant manager)
Lizandro/Franklin/Antonio (guest desk)
Robson/Jean (front desk)
Restaurant staff:
Excepcional captain Romeris/ Kendry/Glenis/Alondra/Diane/Virturdes/Vamilet/ Fraimy/Alexan/Melvin/Melquis and the entire polite and kind team. Thank you very much and until next time!

reviews.author: Sydney Kirsch
reviews.text: Great family trip! You have to hit the pool table when you’re not at the beach. The service was especially amazing - everyone is so friendly and accommodating. Reynaldo makes the best coffee!!!

reviews.author: Michelle Correa
reviews.text: Raul!!!! What can we say he made our trip so much more enjoyable!!! He always greeted us with a smile was very attentive and overall just a joy. Thank you for your service!!

reviews.author: Shannon Doucette
reviews.text: Ramón is simply the best. So kind to our children and attentive to all of our needs. We sought him out for two different visits. You will not be disappointed if you have him!

reviews.author: daniel marc
reviews.text: We’ve been to many resorts in Punta Cana, and this was one of the best. Great location, very clean rooms, excellent facilities, and exceptionally friendly staff. A special mention to Gilberto at the Reserve Club, who truly made our stay even better. Everything was well organized and relaxing. Highly recommend, and we would definitely stay here again.

reviews.author: Livia Cruz
reviews.text: We stayed at the resort for 4 nights for my husband's birthday. We booked The Reserve section for reference. We arrived and had to wait for over an hour for our room, I believe it was close to 5 pm when it was ready. The room was nice enough. The biggest issue for us was the food. The Mexican restaurant served food that should not be for human consumption to be honest. The pork dish was all fat, we left mid-dinner because it was so bad. Most of the staff were not welcoming. Service was super slow at the beach, we actually had to get up and just go to the bar. I went to the coffee bar near the entrance for a drink and there were 3 women behind the counter and not one tried to help me..and when I left one yelled asking me to go back but I ignored it. Entertaining was okay but the DJ played the same songs every night...overall it was a very disappointing experience and we will not be back. If you are a foodie, avoid this place at all cost. Oh, and they will try to convince you to join presentation to become a Circle member...glad we did not go because we don't plan on staying at any other property of this group!

reviews.author: Kelsi Liberg
reviews.text: We had a great time this week.  Angelo was at the beach and was very attentive and professional.  He brought us drinks without asking and was always cheerful.

reviews.author: YANDRO GUTIERREZ
reviews.text:
This review is for:
Rosanna  Yanira, Maria Ortiz
They were amazing in the buffet restaurant. Unmatched service and always with the right attitude.

reviews.author: dan bednarski
reviews.text: We have not even stayed at the resort yet but the booking is trying to do a bait and switch on us for prices. We booked a stay at the hotel with flights. The next day, we get an email notifying us that there was an issue with booking our return flights and if we wanted the flights it would be $900 more (2 people). After rounds of complaints through their horrible booking system, they notify me that they are making a final offering for the same flights for $490 more than originally booked. All at the same time the couple that we booked with has not had a single issue and they paid the advertised rates. Blatant rip off.

reviews.author: Tracy Hough
reviews.text: Just got back home from an amazing vacation at an amazing resort.  Everything from the moment we arrived was perfect!!! We rented a cabana every day we were there and had the best attendant.  Hats off to Angelo, his friendly, cheerful personality would put a smile on your face.  Thank you Angelo for all the attention!!

reviews.author: Will Smith
reviews.text: The service here is exceptional. Every employee is incredibly attentive and remembers all the little details about your preferences, which makes for a truly wonderful experience. Dilania and Jorge at the pool bar were particularly attentive and ensured that we had an amazing week.

reviews.author: jurij vasilkovski
reviews.text: Ramon. Is the best. He will make sure your beach vacation is one to remember. Pleasant, always smilingly and the best sense of humor. He will put a smile on your face every time.

reviews.author: mike d
reviews.text:
There are pros and cons to this place, and I will list them accurately so that everyone can judge for themselves -
Pros - the place is located in a very beautiful area, the entire resort looks and feels like you're on vacation, and many of the pics you take will show very well, if its for social media posting or basic family pics,
The weather - depending on the time of year is usually great, you should be careful for excessive sun, the uv rating is extremely high, but understandably so,
Cons - I have been to this place 3 times over the past 20 years, and I remember when it 1st opened they had celebrities promoting it (JLo and the likes), and the service was absolutely amazing, where I had never experienced anything great like it before, that is why I chose to revisit more times, had a few family and friends do destination weddings here, and always highly recommend to everyone, but this last time I recently visited, I was let down and disappointed on so many levels that I don't see myself recovering from it, namely for these reasons -
I initially booked 5 rooms for a large family party, where their initial reservations told me I have to contact their corporate office because it was too much for them to handle, ok fine I did contact them, but trying to give them the down payment on my cc was a hassle because their company is based in Mexico and for some reason I had to reach out to my cc company where it still took 5 days to finally process, ok fine I received an email confirmation for the reservation booking,
