Come to the arrival day, I come there with my family, coming off the bus and all ready to start our vacation, where I end up stuck at the front reception desk for 2 and half hours because they cannot locate or find my reservation, and they're looking at me like I’m from another planet, thankfully I showed them the email confirmation, to which they still had to locate us 5 rooms, to which I originally requested that we all be together within the same building area, but no, we ended up being spread all over the place separately, and they charged me for the entire cost without deducting the down payment, to which they kept telling me they could not locate it in their system, to which I kept showing them my email and cc statement where it showed that it was charged, starting off my vacation on this foot made me severely agitated and only further annoyed my entire time spent there,
I spent everyday at the front reception for a minimum of an hour trying to resolve and have the hotel locate and credit my deposit back to my card, only to be met with everyone ‘deeply apologizing’ to me and giving me their whatsapp phone numbers, but even when I texted anyone on their whatsapp, no one ever replied or answered me back the entire time, I demanded a meeting with the head person/manager/boss/whatever, where I got a phone call on the room phone only to have them keep saying “hello – hello, can you hear me?  Are you there?” and then only hung up.  Told this to the front desk and they said they would send someone immediately to change the phone in the room – which was not the problem.  I had to threaten them on the last day that I was going to dispute the entire charge on my credit card, to which then they miraculously found the down payment, and then proceeded to deduct it from the total amount charged.

reviews.author: Michael Alvares
reviews.text: Great Resort! The food was good and the drinks even better. Thanks to our waiter yefri on the beach. Our room was fantastic. The resort was very clean and kept up to date. Wifi worked everywhere even on the beach

reviews.author: patriotic blade
reviews.text: Alberto and Antonia at the 90 degree pool were Amazing! Top notch service, great music. He was always singing and dancing and poured the best drinks. They were also very professional. With much love from Minnesota!

reviews.author: Mindy Lewis
reviews.text: Ramón at the beach was awesome!  Took great care of us. I wish we had found him sooner than our last day.  We rented a Bali bed and it was well worth every penny

reviews.author: Daniel Johnson
reviews.text: I would compare it to a 4-star resort, not 5 star.  The service was inconsistent (About 75% great, 25% not), the food options at the different restaurants were pretty similar, and our initial check-in was not good.  We'd paid for the "Family Concierge, Swim up, 2 bedroom master suite." We were supposed to have a special check in area and quicker service, but when we arrived they seemed very confused.  Communication between the staff was poor.

reviews.author: Yasmin Gutierrez
reviews.text: I stayed on the Reserve side of the resort, the views are gorgeous. But the service is spectacular, I ended up booking another day because my concierge Adriel was so attentive & provided exceptional service! If you are thinking about staying here, just book, you will not be disappointed.

reviews.author: Rusty Howell
reviews.text: We had a wonderful experience on the beach! Antonio and Yefrey provide great hospitality and attention to detail. Fresh towels, refilled ice and beverages without even needing to ask.

reviews.author: Laura Madaj
reviews.text: Amazing place with great food and service! Flora restaurant is the best one at the resort with unreal food and amazing staff, especially Cesar who was our waiter for the evening and gave excellent recommendations for food. Additionally, the best bar on site is the Rum Republic, and Miguel makes the most delicious cocktails!

reviews.author: roger forde
reviews.text:
⸻

I’ve been staying at the Paradisus Resort Palma Real, and my experience has been wonderful. The resort offers a welcoming atmosphere with great amenities, but what really stood out to me was the service I received at the sports bar.

Magda, the bartender there, provides exceptional service every time. She is not only attentive and professional but also incredibly friendly, which makes each visit enjoyable. Her warm personality and dedication truly add to the overall experience at the resort.

reviews.author: Yak427
reviews.text: Service was excellent, treated us like family. Made us feel welcome and great personal service. Rosanna was our waitress and made our experience one we won’t go

reviews.author: Anthony Altamura
reviews.text:
Today is Day 5 at Paradius Palma Real.   Our favorite restaurant is the Asian restaurant.   The food is delectable and the service is first rate.  Especially notable is the exceptional service provided by the manager Romeris.  She’s responsible for supervising the Hibachi and Japanese sushi parts of the Asian restaurant and does so flawlessly and with a smile.  ***** Food;  ***** service. We will be back!

Today is Day 6. We dined at the Italian Restaurant and absolutely loved it.  Our waiter, Felix, was exceptional.  He took care of all of our requests, quickly and with a smile that warms the soul. The food was surprisingly delicious.  We are NYC residents and know great Italian cuisine.

Tonight’s meal was on par with many top Italian restaurants in Manhattan.  The veal and eggplant parm starters were made to perfection.  The parm was so good that we reordered it in place of dessert.   Our pastas were expertly prepared (Al Dente, with fresh ingredients; simple and delicious).

Milton, the restaurant supervisor, was highly attentive and accommodating.

Bottom line: if you vacation at Paradius Palme Real Resort, you must dine at Italian Restaurant (Mascalzone)….ask for Felix as your waiter and make sure to order the eggplant parm and veal starters and any of the pastas.

reviews.author: Neil Rippey
reviews.text: Rafael, Gilberto, Raul and Pedro were awesome! Made the beach experience great everyday! Can’t wait to come back and hang out with these guys! Much appreciated fellas and job well done!

reviews.author: Wayne Howell III
reviews.text: We found the resort through Costco Travel, when we first arrived we knew we had picked a great place. When we got to the location our concierge(Emmanuel) took care of us from the check in desk. It’s full service with bellhops for luggage and servers that come to you. We bounced between buffets for breakfast and lunch. And for dinner we found Flora, Mina, and Blue Agave were our favorites. We were shocked to find that the package came with an excursion which was Yoga on a private beach. We kept more to the pools than the beach but did enjoy several sunsets at the beach. We didn’t have much desire to venture out as the daily events were engaging and fun with the bar tenders keeping you engaged at the bar with their drinks or conversation. The weather was great most days with only two days of sporadic rain or cool weather. We didn’t have a few issues with the room(lock battery low, phone not working, housekeeping missed our room) but all were fixed by our concierge within 30mins.

reviews.author: Suky
reviews.text: The service we experienced at the resort was truly exceptional. Although we had a very bumpy and rough start, the staff went above and beyond to make our stay superb. I wasn’t too impressed with the food overall, as there weren’t many kid-friendly options, but the Kanna Restaurant completely stood out. The dining experience there was top tier—Enrique and Richard were outstanding! Their warm service and attention to detail made such a great impression that we decided to return the very next day.

reviews.author: portiaellyse !
reviews.text: Rosanna, Yanira and Maria were our servers when we ate at the buffet. We first sat in Rosanna’s section our first day here and their service was so exceptional we kept going back to the same section.

reviews.author: Christopher Rubino
reviews.text: We had a swim up room and it was awesome. Very quiet and comfortable. The service from Arisleida at 34 degrees was excellent! Always so friendly and available for us. Our concierge Jose was excellent as well. Great relaxing stay

reviews.author: Mayte Lopez
reviews.text: I highly recommend this hotel!! We had a blast, the service and amenities are awesome. The kids club is the best one we have tried! Martha, Jessica, Jesus, Lisbeth y Alexandra are great with the kiddos. My kids (3 and 5 years olds) didn't want to leave.

reviews.author: raksha pandya
reviews.text:
The Punta Cana melia palm real
is a Fanstastic resort .
All staff has fanstastic customers services.
To name a few ,
Junior at breakfast, Diego the manager , chef Pedro making us vegetarian special rice . Reception staff also very attentive.

reviews.author: Fiorelda Doraku
reviews.text: Amazing staff. My daughter had a blast and would always like to stay there more. She said they were so caring and nice and we were so happy with the service. Kids had all sorts of activities every day, by the pool, at ghe beach, karaoke, crafts, games and a lot more fun things. Would 100% recommend

reviews.author: Karina Gervais
reviews.text: Yudery provided us an amazing service. Resort is clean, beach is beautiful, and rooms were wonderful. Lots of pools and chairs and great night entertainment. The buffet food could be better, it was cold, and sometimes not the freshest. But the restaurants were wonderful and fresh.

reviews.author: Chris OBrien
reviews.text: Dropped into Kicks a few times while we were at Punta Cana Palma Real. Luis was slinging drinks multiple times. Remembered our drink preferences and was always really friendly.  Always appreciate when a bartender can recall what your drink choices are. Great service!!

reviews.author: Janet Ragan
reviews.text: Jose and Julia were amazing. Great customer service. Very professional and Very attentive, once they recognize the drinks that I liked, they had them ready without me even having to ask for them when I walked up,they knew exactly what I wanted. Their customer service is outstanding!

reviews.author: Justin Drake
reviews.text: Rooms are very clean and spectacular . Kicks sports bar has an amazing staff that treats you like they have always known you. Great cocktails from the wonderful bartenders and the manager Luis goes above and beyond.

reviews.author: Shubhendu Tripathi
reviews.text:
I enjoyed the location but service wise - it’s kind of garbage . If you have been to any 5-7 star resorts in SE Asia, prepare to be underwhelmed. Other than a few good staff, most of the staff do not have a sense of what a good hospitality should be like. Better to go to Bahamas. And I say with full humility and keeping the bias out of it - for the money, this resort isn’t worth it .
For example - you get 24 hour in room dining - but the menu is only fries and soup.
Another example is - you pay for an all
Inclusive resort but most of the beaches - you have to pay in some kind of purchase to access .

reviews.author: Nicole Zudonyi
reviews.text: Amazing experience at The Lunch Box buffet! Food was excellent (surprising for a buffet!) and the service was even better. Sebastian, Rosanna and Fauri brought great energy and made sure we were taken care of our whole vacation! Don’t be disappointed if you can’t get a reservation elsewhere, the buffet is soo good!

reviews.author: Molly Powers
reviews.text: Entertainment was great, Jairo kept things fun! Loved having a choice between adult only and family areas. Right on the ocean was a big plus too! Paradise ☀️ 🌊

reviews.author: Kyle Williams
reviews.text: Resort is beautiful, food is way better than expected. Look for Dilania by the pool side for drinks, she so is amazing! Wonderful service and so nice. Would highly recommend this resort!

reviews.author: Winter Ng
reviews.text:
I have a wonderful time here for a getaway from the cold weather in Toronto.

I enjoyed 5 rounds of golf, 2 times on the Nadal Pickelball court.

The food and drink is amazing. The service is superb. Miguel from Rum Republic is outstanding!

reviews.author: Tara Peaden
reviews.text:
The Buffet was amazing and the best was the friendly staff. We never had to want to anything.   Friendly faces greeted us everyday.

reviews.author: Roxanne Lewis

reviews.text: We spent a week at paradisus palma real.  It was a great experience.  The kids loved the kids clubs and the resort's specialty cocktails were great.  I highly recommend going to the flora dominican restaurant.  Great local food and atmosphere.

reviews.author: Angelica DeHaven
reviews.text: Frank and Felix were great and made my birthday very fun. Hibachi food was very good.

reviews.author: Anant Arora
reviews.text: Loved the experience at this hotel. Rooms are clean and well done, we had a swim out master suite (highly recommended if you have small kids). Also the kidsdom is fantastic - the helpers there are amazing and kids always have fun.

reviews.author: Jennifer Becerra
reviews.text: Dilania brought out experience from good to great. She always had a smile on her face and was just such a delight to be around. Thank you!!!

reviews.author: Lynn Strangway
reviews.text: Kicks bar and Luis the supervisor gave us the BEST service, great drinks and food! We have been coming to Kicks everyday of our trip and have enjoyed their company and attention to great service. Thank you Luis, Vianny, Fior and KicksTeam!

reviews.author: Stacy Gemmell
reviews.text: Great resort with the most amazing staff! Dilanias drink service by the pool was spot on!  Her quick wit and smile were contagious and fun!

reviews.author: Rachel Lee
reviews.text:
I recently returned from a 4-day stay at Paradisus Palma Real and ended up in the ER. My experience was unfortunately overshadowed by a severe case of food poisoning or stomach flu that began on my final morning. The symptoms persisted throughout my travel day and flight home, which was incredibly difficult. For context, I ate at the main buffet six times and had dinner at Blue Agave the night before falling ill. I found the food quality to be below average overall, finding many of the "hot" buffet items frequently cold.

On a positive note, the resort itself was lovely. Our room was clean, well-located, and offered a beautiful balcony view of the pool. Note the walls are thin, so you could hear the neighboring room very well. The staff were kind and professional; however service in general felt very slow. I enjoyed the evening entertainment with dance shows.

reviews.author: Robin Napier
reviews.text:
We had the absolute pleasure of being taken care of by two incredible staff members during our stay — Rafael at the beach and Harry, our room concierge — and they truly made our vacation unforgettable.
Rafael took care of us every single day at the beach, and his service was nothing short of exceptional. He was so attentive, always making sure we were comfortable, had everything we needed, and felt completely pampered. We celebrated my birthday during the trip, and Rafael went above and beyond by surprising us with champagne and creating a beautiful beach setup that made the day feel even more special. His kindness, attention to detail, and warm energy will definitely be missed!
Harry, our room concierge, was just as amazing. He completely catered to us from the moment we arrived and made my birthday so memorable by decorating our room and surprising us with champagne and chocolate-covered strawberries. He handled everything with such genuine care and attentiveness — we never had to ask twice for anything. His thoughtful gestures and warm personality made us feel so welcomed and celebrated.
These two truly went above and beyond and are a huge part of why our stay was so incredible. We can’t wait to come back and see them again — they are gems of this resort!

reviews.author: Silvia Frey
reviews.text: We had a wonderful time celebrating our anniversary for a 5 night trip. Alam took care of us while we were there and answered any questions we had. He booked us dinner reservations and provided us with a few surprises as part of our anniversary celebration. We were very happy and would love to come back.

reviews.author: Sir_ Crabby (Sir_Crabby)
reviews.text:
Our visit was from 3/30-4/6. This makes our 3rd visit to DR. Unfortunately this resort was not a great stay. The food, quality, choices, and resort service was very disappointing.

Attention to detail and cleanliness needs addressed.

reviews.author: Antonio Di Biase
reviews.text:
Rosanna Yanira María... excellent 👌 service and attention to guests and beautiful smile 😁 everyday.  Always smiling.  Excelente.

Also, Brailenny and Ebony showed us excellent attention at the breakfast buffet ensuring we were well fed and coffee cups full!!!

reviews.author: Felix Joel
reviews.text: Yamilet our server was great. The food was really good. Smaller portions but very tasty. Got the chimichanga and it did not disappoint.

reviews.author: Kate Morris
reviews.text: Dilania and Raysa at the pool bar were amazing all week - recommended the best cocktails and making us laugh. The staff in Ginger were also excellent. The resort is beautiful and very clean.

reviews.author: Louise Marin
reviews.text:
Mascalzone, the Italian restaurant,  was exceptional - food and service. Felix, our server, was friendly and even tried to speak French, as we were. Felix was an excellent server and the food and wine was amazing!

The resort is somewhere we would definitely visit again.

reviews.author: amanda tepfer
reviews.text: Takimeku dinner excellent!  Service friendly and quick.  Best meal we had at resort so far!  Kudos to Alondra, Romeris, Jeison, and Luis Arias.  Thank you for such great hospitality 😀

reviews.author: Ernesto Ruiz
reviews.text: We had dinner at blue agave and it was fantastic! Meal really felt Mexican. Our server melquin was really nice and warm. Thank you! Will come again!

reviews.author: Nick Petroni
reviews.text:
My wife and I just returned from a 7-night stay at Paradisus Palma Real. We loved so much about our stay but wanted to point out a few of the highlights and maybe just a few slight notes.

Hotel:
The hotel itself was beautiful and felt very elevated. In fact each morning when I would walk through the lobby to grab coffee I either verbally or in my head said "damn, this place is so nice." I'm not big on social media, but I felt that just about every corner of the hotel was photo worthy.

Rooms:
We had a very spacious master king suite room with beautiful furnishings, panoramic windows and a large balcony.  The room felt very clean and provided a very pleasant place to be when we weren't roaming the hotel.

Restaurants:
The hotel has several awesome restaurants (Mexican, Italian, Asian, Steakhouse, Dominican, Mediterranean, Japanese) that provided excellent food and beautiful spaces to dine. We enjoyed the diverse offerings in fare and always looked forward to evening dinners.

Entertainment:
The hotel sort of mimics a cruise with a vast array of entertainment. There were daily activities (painting, water aerobics, yoga, etc) and nightly shows that were pretty full-scale productions. All were really wonderful and we were amazed at the talent.

Service:
The service was impeccable across the board. Whether it was front desk team, the waiters and waitresses, bartenders and entertainment team, they were all so wonderful. They all played such a huge part in making our trip one to remember. I do have to show out a few staff that went far and beyond to make everything extra special.

Bioli: Front Desk
Wander: Waiter Lunch & Dinner
Luis: Waiter Lunch & Dinner
Luis: Pool Bartender
Quintino: Pool Bartender
Guillermo: Guest Services
Juan: Breakfast/Lunch Waiter

Each of the aforementioned really made us feel special and well-appreciated throughout our stay. I could probably write another 10 paragraphs about these wonderful people, but just know you will be in good hands with the Paradisus Palma Real team.

A few quick notes on things weren't so great.

Concierge: Apparently, we were suppose to be provided with a guest services concierge at check-in who could serve as a POC for reservations, activities, transfer services and so on. That didn't happen. Not a big deal and we were pretty easily able to figure this out our own, but a concierge may have helped a bit.

The Beach: Nothing to do with the hotel, but the sea water is pretty well covered in sea weed.  The hotels do make an effort to alleviate the issue, but the seaweed is persistent. Just a callout if you're hoping to swim in the Caribbean.

Overall, our stay was amazing and we'd love to one day return.

reviews.author: Paul Penney
reviews.text: Melqui at the Blueagave was such a great server. The food was delicious. The whole team went over and above. Special shout out to Eduardo and Lewis!

reviews.author: Brenda Lester
reviews.text: Experience was excellent and we truly enjoyed ourselves. Great customer service and we really felt very welcome! Thanks so very much Guillermo Concierge. You're so awesome and we thank God for you!!

reviews.author: Nicholas Campbell
reviews.text: Romeris and Rosanna absolutely fantastic to us while we there. The property has been great.  Dinner spots amazing and plentiful. Buffet consistent, but not all food is hot both buffet and restaurants. House keeping does well.  I called for maintenance and they never came, something minor thankfully. Activities great!

reviews.author: Audrey Caron
reviews.text:
My 14th all inclusive experience. Would 100% recommend this hotel. We upgraded to The Reserve. I’m not sure if it’s worth. The private restaurant is nice for lunch, and the exclusive beach section and pool are nice. We just don’t know if we would recommend paying the upgrade.
There are many adult private pool sections. I would not come here if I had kids over 1 year old. There are no places for kids. A baby under 1 is fine, but other than that this is not a resort for kids.

Pros: the food was beyond excellent. (Better than Club Med Cancun). The Asian and Italian restaurants are EXCELLENT. The rooms are so beautiful with snacks and little extras (body lotion, etc). The pools are big. The chairs and sunbeds make the difference!! The beach section was beautiful! We walked further on the beach and the other hotels  did not have a machine to remove algae. This hotel removes algae every morning which makes a difference. The coffee at the Ginger bar is AMAZING. The drinks are AMAZING like I have never seen this. They are amazing at every bar.

Cons: the animation is not the best. The staff does not really seem to care if you give tip. Overall the staff is nice! There are A LOT of sellers on the beach and they are really annoying. Some of them even go into the resort which is too much. We understand it is their job but each day we were at the beach and the same vendors ask 3-4 times each if you want to buy their things or get a massage. It’s just harassement at this point. Each day we would have at least 30-40 vendors asking us to buy things.

Special mention to Andres which was so nice to us. Also special mention to Ciari I believe (hope I spell her name right). Also, Anthony every morning at the Ginger Bar for the coffee was so nice.

reviews.author: Diana Delgado
reviews.text: Love the hotel! We had a great experience at the restaurant Blue Agave and also Kicks! their staff is awesome; Erickson, Luis, Eduardo and Lorenna are the best!

reviews.author: Shelby Crabbe
reviews.text: Rosanna was amazing at the pool! She always made sure our drinks were filled and she got us chairs when we thought there was none! Just made us feel so at home and welcome!! Kept our spirits up!!!! also always made sure my umbrella was up because i have so much sun burn haha, 10/20 AMAZING!!!

reviews.author: Alexis Yori
reviews.text: My experience at blue agave was a great time! Yamilet was a very great fast efficient server and the service was very very quick food wise as well! I really enjoyed my time here! Really good chicken enchiladas and guacamole!

reviews.author: Adriana Cuesto
reviews.text: The food at Paradisus Resort is delicious and abundant, with options for all tastes and diets. The kids love the creative presentation, and the bars serve great cocktails and cold beers. And let's not forget Fernando, the animator who's a true showman - his energy is contagious! 👍

reviews.author: Gavin Crisell
reviews.text: Great service at the pool bar.  Jonathan,  George, Eddy and Victor top marks for a great service! Never waited for a drink and was all so friendly. Keep up the great work.

reviews.author: Karina Escobar
reviews.text:
Upon our arrival, we were greeted with a warm and friendly welcome. Your concierge, Guillermo, provided exceptional service throughout our stay and made us feel truly taken care of.

Our first room was amazing and exceeded our expectations. Unfortunately, we experienced a leak, and although the issue took four days to resolve, the staff eventually moved us to a different room.

The second room was comfortable and well‑maintained, but the oceanfront view was not the same as what we originally had. While we appreciated the accommodation, we did miss the quality of the view from our first room.

reviews.author: John Hart
reviews.text:
Awesome staff
Antonia was the best server at Reserve pool

We had 50 people for a pre wedding pool party and she took great care of everyone

reviews.author: Isaque Medeiros
reviews.text: Staff and rooms were excellent. Even the buffet was always enjoyable and were we treating like family by Yuderqui, Romeris and Yessica Carlos during our stay. I’ve visited all the Melia resorts and will not book elsewhere if there resort is in my travel plans.

reviews.author: Joli Assumma
reviews.text: We have had a lovely stay and thoroughly enjoyed everything the resort had to offer! Dinners and meals were great, and the staff was so warm and friendly to everyone - us included. We’d definitely love to stay again on our next visit!

reviews.author: Tarah Fenn
reviews.text:
This one is going to hurt a little bit. I have several reviews to fill out including Delta Vacations. This was not an inexpensive vacation. We booked through Delta Vacations and flew from Phoenix to Atlanta to Punta Cana. Not a quick trip either.

Upon arrival, room was not ready. Took 2 hours for room to be ready. Front desk said we would get an email. We never got an email. Just hovered until they were tired of seeing us. NOTE: Your band on your wrist is an indicator of what you are getting there.

Rooms are decent. Although you will never get me to understand why a thin curtain is a good use of privacy over a wall or door. Doesn't matter who you are traveling with, you want privacy!

When you arrive at the hotel, you should be pulled aside by a concierge that you DO NOT HAVE TO PAY FOR to be informed about what your activities are and how to make dinner reservations. Don't get me started on that process. If you are a commoner---you will need to get in line at 8AM promptly by the buffet to TRY (operative word) to nab a dinner reservation. If you are unlucky at nailing a reservation, you win the BUFFET only. It's NOT ok to only have that option BUT that is the option. Food is MEH. The Italian place was my favorite. Tipping is weird. Some people leave a dollar; other people leave 20. I tried not to be a douche, but I did spend over $8K for this vacation so sometimes you get $5 and have to deal with it.

You should get a calendar of events, things that are available to use, marked areas where you can and can't go (trust me it matters)! The hospitality at this hotel is lacking. I can't tell you how many times people looked me dead in the eyes and ignored my question or request. I had to scour the entire hotel for 9 beach towels before my excursion and then I told the manager, keep an entire cart of them at the front of the bell desk for others. Cleaning services were amazing, bar tenders were subpar and often forgot drinks (even if you tipped them ahead of time). Buffet service was the WORST. Numerous requests for coffee go unnoticed. Trust me, I was nice and polite, and it did not matter. So I just stopped tipping at the buffet.

Also, I honestly don't believe the Dominican Republic understands the value of the American dollar whatsoever. It's one thing to pay $6 for a bag of skittles at the gift shop. It is another thing entirely to price a sweatshirt at $60 that is literally the same one on Amazon for $22.99 on prime. MANY of the places we visited were dramatically overpriced. They see you as a sucker and take advantage. They also expect your tips. They are TRAINED to not have change. I watched it happen and I also watched a taxi driver deliver money to a hotel and clearly was in cahoots with the souvenir shop. DO NOT GO TO THEIR SHOPS.

The major plus is the beaches! Of course they are stunning! The pools are great, the swim up bars and the liquor are great! Make sure to check out Fun Republic on property. No one told us about it until the last day but was fun for mini golf. Cabanas cost $160 a day and that is why they are always empty. No one is paying that (again an overpriced dollar thing). Another thing the resort should do is have a FREE cabana day. I mean they sit there and do nothing. It's literally crazy that they block the beach to make you PAY!! LOL.

Overall, I would not come back to this resort. This was NOT a 5-star experience!

I had a wonderful time because of the people that I was with. My family and friends are what made this trip spectacular. Even if my expectations were not met, my family created memories and enjoyed each other.

Signed---a green band girl in a brown band world (IYKYK). :)

reviews.author: Nancy Sciglitano
reviews.text: saylis & alexandra was amazing every time we went for coffe in the coffee shop. The coffee shop is angers addition and the staff is so friendly and helpful!

Noise in the hallways early in the morning made it impossible to sleep in. Beach area was cramped, lots of garbage in beach area, no beach drink service. Many better options for your vacation.

Vert good experience at this hotel. The service is really good. They make us feel special,
We will back again.  Tonight we have our dinner at the italian Restaurant and Yenseen was really nice

However, the buffet and bar service could be much better — the staff there is not friendly at all.

For the price, the hotel offers good value, but they definitely need to work on improving staff attitude and service in the buffet and bars

reviews.author: Cristina Darha UNI-K Official

Your hotel is lucky to have him, and we will definitely be returning thanks to his exceptional service.”

reviews.author: Geraldine Fleurime
reviews.text: I had a wonderful stay, I mean everything was great.  From customer service, to cleanliness, food, servers especially Gabriel, Gabriel really made this an unforgettable experience, he’s very polite and very friendly. He does a very good job at being a server. His manager Virtudes very professional and welcoming.  I will definitely be looking forward to another stay at this hotel.

reviews.author: K A
reviews.text: Lunch box service was great. Juan the chef did an amazing job. Really appreciate the hospitality.

reviews.author: Belinda Mark
reviews.text:
Gueillermo our concierge was excellent!  He made our trip absolutely wonderful and attended to all of our needs quickly and with a smile 😊

The resort was lovely with super friendly staff.  The steakhouse Mila was our favourite!  Will definitely come again.

reviews.author: Aurelia Buras
reviews.text: Kicks Sports Bar, Luis is the best! Fast with drinks and making sure all our needs were taken care of. Thank you to Luis and his team!

reviews.author: Guille Navarro
reviews.text: Upon our arrival, we were immediately made to feel incredibly important. We were welcomed with a refreshing drink, and our check-in process was exceptionally smooth. Guillermo, our concierge, was remarkably attentive and considerate, exceeding all expectations to ensure our needs were met. He expertly arranged our restaurant reservations, activities, and even our excursion. Every member of the staff, from the luggage handlers to the beach waiters, was simply incredible. My husband and I are profoundly grateful for the opportunity to have vacationed in such a wonderful place.

reviews.author: Laura G
reviews.text: The food at Kanna was delicious and Maria was awesome server. Our burgers and fries were so good!

reviews.author: Michael Messinger
reviews.text:
First, the cons: The front desk personnel and check in experience was terrible. We really struggled to speak English with 3 different front desk people. The room we booked with a king bed wasn’t available and we received no compensation other than the option to pay to upgrade the following day if we came back after 5pm. Also, they didn’t tell us anything about the resort or amenities other than circling our room on the map, saying very quickly where the restaurants were, and good luck. So day 1 and day 2 started off really poorly. We felt we were bothering the staff trying to figure out the essentials. Then you walk out to the beach and notice it’s not very full… well the main beach has cabanas and beds that are private and cost $250/day for the Kanna club which no one even mentioned during check in. However, we spent the money, and it honestly saved the trip. It was the best service and experience we could have had. The ladies there were amazing and highly recommend. The pools need more beds if you want to spend a day there and are first come first serve. They ran out of towels and when asking the front desk how we could get a couple for our family, they just say sorry we can’t help you. Lastly, the concierge was hit or miss. They text you on WhatsApp which is nice but felt nervous we would miss out on dinner because it was either last minute or not able to send us confirmation. He did help us exchange money and with some reservations so not all bad. Apparently there is a water park off the main resort which they didn’t tell us but costs over $100/person per day.

Now, the pros… the resort was squeaky clean and elegant. The pools were very nice (although very cold). Restaurant food was very good but the buffet wasn’t great. Rooms were very nice and clean as well. We did have a cockroach next to the bed one night but that was the only issue. It was so clean and tidy throughout the resort we could overlook it. Overall the staff was nice but clearly they work for tips and expect it if they are going to help you. We did not get a chance to play golf or tennis which seemed really nice.

Pro tips:
- Spend a little more and rent the large cabanas and tip the ladies well.
- Bring lots of $5 bills. They will change your experience dramatically. The staff will go out of their way and remember you. Don’t bring 20s or higher thinking you can easily get change at the front desk. They will look annoyed and tell you sorry good luck.

reviews.author: Aerika Tan
reviews.text: Dilania was amazing. The nicest and most genuine worker here. Never ignored us and was always smiling. Giving us great drink recommendations.

reviews.author: Charla Carter
reviews.text: Angelo displays excellent customer service he has went above and beyond our expectation. We want to take him home with us. Grateful for his excellent 🙏🏾 ❤️ customer service

reviews.author: Christian Echevarria-Reina
reviews.text:
Total failure in customer service. We were trying to plan our wedding here but have since thought better of it.

We weren’t able to get ahold of the coordinator for wedding planning for weeks over email.

We were told by the general line that there were day passes and when we showed up security would not let us in to buy one. Turns out there is no such thing.

We called the general phone number and the person who answered was annoyed that we asked to be transferred to a number within the hotel.

When we finally spoke to the wedding department they put the blame on us for emailing what they said was a “general email” (there was not a specific email provided anywhere we could discern).

There seems to be a pervasive culture of finger pointing and bureaucracy in customer support where every person claims they are not in charge of X and that they do not know how to solve X.

It does not seem like they care very much about the customer experience.

reviews.author: Rockstar Golf Tours
reviews.text: Highlight of our stay at Paradisus Palma real was Kicks Sports Bar      Diorgenes and Luis Miguel ROCKED IT.  We had an amazing time, great vibe amazing service. I will be sending all my golf groups to Kicks.  These guys are the BEST they go way beyond so you got to hit this place John Rockstar Golf

reviews.author: Christine Kapo Ng
reviews.text:
I am staying here right now for my 40th birthday and I truly regret this decision. Upon check-in, we waited about 20 minutes until we were able to get to the desk (we were first in line). Everyone but us were offered beverages. When we finally go to the desk, I told him I was here for my 40th birthday and he just laughed at me and didn't really offer any amenities or special services. I tried to reach out to the hotel several times over the past few months to get a group rate and no one ever responded. All my friends booked their rooms individually.
We finally get to our room (which was very far away from the front desk) and both of our keys did not work. We try to go to eat at the Beach Club which stays open til 6pm (it is now 4:30pm), only to be told by an annoyed waiter that they stop serving in 15 minutes and if we don't order now we won't get any food. We order, some of the items are "sold out".
We tip him for helping us with the food and getting our friends drinks after 4:45pm, he then offers to help us make a reservation at the Mexican restaurant where he'll work that night. Another thing to note, you can only make restaurant reservations in the morning from 9a-4pm but didn't know that before arrival, we were not able to secure any reservations because the reservation desk was closed for the day. This is a huge flaw, when we book our room, we should be given the opportunity to make reservations for our first night so we have something to eat. The only other option is the buffet.
Luckily, our tipped server decides to help us and we get reservations to the Mexican restaurant. You walk in and there's good tequila bottles displayed everywhere but they're not for the "regular customers". You have to pay extra for Don Julio, Patron, Espalon - etc. We ordered a Margarita and a Paloma. They use premixed - homemade mixers, everything tastes weird and non-alcoholic. Food at dinner was fine, my vegetarian friend ordered the Mushroom tacos. We were all served our food and we were waiting for her plate to arrive so we can eat together. We asked about her plate and then the waiter says "oh it's sold out". Why would  you tell us now? So my friend can't eat when we all eat?
There are also no performances or entertainment at night. They had a saxaphone player at 730 play for like 20 minutes and then silent disco was offered.
Breakfast this morning was a mess, all the tables are not bussed and we had to walk around and grab our own utensils and cups so we could eat.
Service at the beach is slow, basically nonexistent... it seems like the waiters are only waiting on specific people (probably because they have been tipped). My biggest issue is, Tips are earned upon doing a good job - they seem to only do their job here once you Tip them.
Needless to say, this is not how I pictured my 40th birthday to go. I thought it would be relaxing with fun activities, delicious food and drinks. Now I am running around trying to figure out how to get water (because they didn't put any in my room) and how to get into my room (because the room key didn't work), how to make reservations (because the kiosks don't work), how to order a drink (because the wait staff doesn't want to take your order). This is truly disappointing for a place that isn't exactly cheap.
Please do better. And if you read everyone's reviews, they all point out specific people that made their experience better - most likely because they have all been tipped.
I stayed at the Paradisus La Perla in Mexico and that place was incredible. No complaints. I decided to come here because I was really expecting the same level of service, hospitality and quality of food and drinks because it is also a Paradisus. This is absolutely not the same at all.

reviews.author: Anand Sundararajan
reviews.text:
Overall, especially given that this experience was our honeymoon, this was by far the worst experience that I have experienced in a tropical resort. A few staff members improved our otherwise awful experience.

The problem started off in the beginning with our room.

1) This hotel has a clear, unwritten policy to confidently lie that complimentary upgrades are not available, especially when booking through Amex travel. We have clear proof of this unwritten policy as we came to know of several folks that were offered paid uogrades until they brought up complimentary upgrades and then magically, those rooms vanished. Now, despite this lie, we were given an "upgrade" to the Reserve, however, even this, considering the exceptionally poor customer service, did not make any improvement to our unremarkable stay.

2) Our concierge proved to be indifferent at best and unhelpful at worst.

3) Our honeymoon special consisted of two macaroons and some chocolate covered strawberries.

4) The location is very good, however, the inconsistency of service combined with an unclear tipping culture makes getting good service a near impossible task despite nearly $400 spent on tips over the course of a one week stay.

5) The food menus were poorly designed with no dietary restrictions or allergies in mind especially for vegetarians. Separately, the food was terrible.

6) Rooms were noisy and could hear everything from the neighbouring rooms.

7) The staff and middle management need clear training on how to de-escalate situations and actually find ways to make customers happy vs. trying to make everything the customer's fault. For example, getting our minibar refreshed or getting our room cleaned required multiple followups. The first question asked despite repeated follow-ups is whether we had left our "do not disturb" on.

8) We wasted our precious time filling out a form ahead of time and the staff were not informed of any of the requests on the form and there was no effort made to reach out regarding something as basic as an airport pick-up.

I would highly recommend that this resort take a fresh look at their staff training, menus and general approach to hospitality. The managerial staff can learn a thing or two from the servers and waiters who actually managed to put smiles on our faces. I will not visit any Melia or Paradisus property again in the future and waste my time / money.

reviews.author: Anastasiya Vardin
reviews.text:
As far as all-inclusives go, I'd give this resort a solid 4 out of 5. Here are my thoughts, broken down by category.

Family Friendliness: I would not strongly recommend this resort for families with young children. I traveled with a 1.5-year-old and felt there simply weren't enough activities for kids during the day or in the evening. The kids' club mainly accommodates children ages 3 and up, and you're required to leave your child there — something I wasn't yet comfortable doing with a toddler. There's also no water park or splash area; just your standard adult pools. This resort is better tailored for couples and adults.

Food: The quality of the food was generally great, though the buffet selection was identical from day to day. The seafood was the standout — the resort offered a wonderfully diverse selection of fish, octopus, sushi, and calamari. The meats were also excellent and well-prepared, with impressive variety including goat, beef, lamb, and chicken. The weak spot was the fried food, which was often lukewarm and stale, as if it had been sitting out too long.
We dined at three of the à la carte restaurants: Flora (Dominican), Agave (Mexican), and the Hibachi. The biggest surprise was Agave — the food was incredible. Flora, which is supposedly the crown jewel of the resort as it's owned by a famous chef, was actually the most disappointing. The service was poor and the food was just okay. We tried the goat and the beef; while the meat itself was well-prepared, the sides were embarrassingly sparse. My "salad" consisted of a few pieces of iceberg lettuce and two cherry tomatoes cut in half with no dressing — it looked like something you'd get at Taco Bell.

Drinks: We stayed at the Paradisus Palma Real (not the Circle Club, Kanna Club, or the Reserve), which meant none of the top-shelf liquor was available to us. This was one of the most disappointing aspects of our stay. For the price we paid, I expected access to better-quality spirits, especially when some other all-inclusives in the area include them. The cocktail variety across the resort also felt limited. The only bar that impressed me was Rum Republic, where they garnished my drink with a smoked cinnamon stick — it's little touches like that that I appreciate.

Room: We opted for the junior suite to have some separation between us and the crib, and the room itself was fantastic. The layout was well thought out, the soaking tub was huge and deep, and the mattress and down pillows were incredibly comfortable. My one major complaint: the room's eco-friendly motion sensors. In the middle of the night, the baby monitor and AC would shut off when no motion was detected, forcing me to get up multiple times to turn everything back on. That was extremely frustrating.

Final Thoughts: I wished the overall service had been friendlier. Many staff members didn't seem as warm or accommodating as what I've experienced at other resorts. The resort also doesn't have a single jacuzzi, which was a letdown — we had a few rainy, cooler days where one would have been perfect. Even the spa lacked saunas, pools, or hot tubs. When it comes to value for the money, I believe there are other resorts in the area that offer the same experience, or more, at a lower price.

reviews.text:
Definitely one of our better vacations. First the good and then the bad: The hotel itself was great and a lot of areas had been newly remodeled. Pool was great, drinks were not watered down. The resort is right on the beach and has a dedicated area with sun-beds. Food overall wasn’t bad but they definitely need more consistency. I’ve learned to not trust dairy products outside of the US…

Now for the bad. Vendors are pretty annoying and aggressive. They will approach you every couple of minutes on the beach… the hotel needs to put an end to this. Tips are expected TO GET decent service, not the other way around. You’re not tipping because they were attentive and took care of you, you’re tipping to get decent service. The performances on the property in the evenings were hit and miss but mostly enjoyable. The construction was pretty annoying and in certain parts of the hotel you could smell a strong acetone smell and the dust particles from the sawing. Also, when we arrived our luggage was a few days late and upon talking with one of the front desk employees, they arranged for us to be taken to a local store to get some essentials. The store was a small gift shop and had nothing of value and wasted a few hours of time. Everyone is just trying to make a buck off tips and will do anything to cut deals with friends or people on the outside to make a couple extra bucks.

With all that being said, it was worth it and wouldn’t hesitate to come back again. Just needs a little touching up from management.

🏝️🏝️🏝️An Unforgettable Stay at Paradisus Palma Real! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

My stay at Paradisus Palma Real was absolutely incredible from start to finish. The resort is stunning beautifully maintained grounds, lush tropical gardens, and a breathtaking beachfront that looks straight out of a postcard.

The staff deserve special mention everyone was warm, welcoming, and went above and beyond to make sure every detail was perfect. From the front desk to the restaurant teams, service was consistently top-notch.

The rooms were spacious, spotless, and luxurious, with comfortable beds and modern amenities. I especially loved waking up to ocean views and enjoying my morning coffee on the balcony.

The food and drinks were outstanding plenty of delicious options for every taste, from international buffets to elegant à la carte dining. The cocktails were creative and refreshing, and the atmosphere at every restaurant was lively yet relaxing.

Whether you’re looking to unwind by the pool, enjoy beach activities, or indulge at the spa, there’s something for everyone here. The entertainment team also did a fantastic job keeping guests engaged without it ever feeling intrusive.

Overall, Paradisus Palma Real delivers the perfect mix of luxury, relaxation, and world-class service. I can’t wait to come back🌺✨

reviews.text:
This was the 3rd Melia group hotel we’ve chosen for our vacation, initially in Grand Canaria, then Riviera Maya, and now in Punta Cana, despite the perfect experience we had with the first 2 hotels, Punta Cana was an absolute disappointment. I booked an ocean front suit which is among the most expensive room in their portfolio, and upon check in, we’ve been given room 9284, which was a nightmare, old, out dated, dirty, and so on. We had to leave the faucet running for five minutes to get hot water, beds were aweful, and it was an absolute mess. At check out, we realized that our room was not 9284 and the check in staff gave us the wrong room and their system shows our room was actually 9264. Not sure if it was an intentional error or not given that some rooms are renovated and some rooms not.

Melia hotels was our favourite hotel until this vacation, and going forward, we are going to explore other brands, since the consistency of quality for a 5-star group of hotels is the utmost priority to our family.

reviews.author: Corey Nelms
reviews.text:
During our stay at Paradisus Palma Real, the highlight of our pool days was hands-down the incredible service from Julia and Edickson at the 34° Pool Bar. From the moment we sat down, they made us feel like VIPs — remembering our names, our favorite drinks, and always greeting us with huge smiles and genuine warmth.

Their energy is contagious, their drinks are perfectly made, and they somehow keep the bar fun and lively while still making sure everyone gets quick service. Whether it was a tropical cocktail, a cold beer, or something off-menu, they made it flawlessly. They go above and beyond, and you can tell they truly love what they do.

If you’re at the resort, make your way to the 34° Pool Bar and look for Julia and Eddie — they’ll turn a good vacation into an unforgettable one.

reviews.text: Rosanna, Yanira and Maria were all wonderful every morning. They were very welcoming at the buffet and made sure we felt at home.

reviews.author: Ryan Sealy
reviews.text:
I had an unforgettable stay at Paradisus Palma Real Golf & Spa Resort! From the moment I arrived, I was blown away by the beauty of the property — the white sandy beaches, crystal-clear pools, and stunning gardens made it feel like paradise. 🌴

The rooms were spacious, spotless, and very comfortable, giving me everything I needed to relax and recharge. The staff was incredibly friendly and attentive, always greeting us with a smile and going above and beyond to make sure we had the best experience possible.

The food was absolutely delicious — fresh, flavorful, and beautifully presented at every meal. On top of that, the drinks were exceptional; refreshing cocktails by the pool and beach made the whole experience even better. 🍹

Between the gorgeous beachfront sunsets, relaxing by the pool, and exploring the peaceful lagoons and gardens, every moment here was memorable. Whether you’re looking for relaxation, amazing service, or picture-perfect views, this resort truly delivers.

I can’t recommend Paradisus Palma Real enough — I’ll definitely be coming back!

If you’re looking for an unforgettable day at the pool, 90 Degrees delivers — and the real stars of the show are Greivin and Leticia. These two are top-tier bartenders who bring energy, charisma, and killer cocktail skills to the table.

From the moment we arrived, they made us feel like VIPs. Our drinks were never empty, service was lightning fast, and the stories they shared? Absolutely hilarious and surprisingly heartfelt. They kept our whole group entertained without ever missing a beat behind the bar.

Whether you’re there for a casual drink or a wild night out, Greivin and Leticia know how to read the room and elevate the experience. Great drinks, great vibes, and hands-down some of the best bar staff I’ve ever encountered.

Highly recommend if you’re in the area — and especially if you want your night handled by professionals who know how to mix both drinks and a good time.

reviews.text:
Our family traveled at the end of May 2025 for one week and had a wonderful time. We were a group of 6 adults and two children. We had two deluxe rooms, one king and the other was two double beds and a sofa bed, overlooking the resort where the pool area is. We had one more deluxe King room overlooking the garden view which was nice and quiet. Rooms were spacious, well maintained and clean.

Staff overall was friendly, met us with smiles and a good time. We also did our share of tips which is important in these all inclusive hotels. Antonio the concierge and Luisa the hotel manager had done a great deal by accommodating our every need. They were very pleasant. Antonio sent us the activities for our family to enjoy each day and planned dinner reservations for us.

Shows were great in the evening. Kidsdom offered different activities for kids everyday, from cookie & pizza making, to flying kites and dance parties. They were very involved with the kids, and took good care of them by providing the necessary attention, if we wanted to enjoy a romantic couple's dinner together.

We did not have circle membership, however it seems as it was worth it to purchase to get extra perks such as better quality alcohol and services.

Overall highly recommend.

reviews.author: Luc Bibeau
reviews.text:
Paradisus Palma Real – Adults Only “The Reserve” (November 5–14, 2025)

Upon choosing Paradisus Palma Real in Punta Cana, my wife and I were initially hesitant about the resort’s scale. However, staying at The Reserve—the adults-only section—transformed our experience. This area brings the resort down to a human scale, offering a self-contained oasis with everything one could wish for, and then some.
Tennis courts were conveniently located a short walk away at an adjacent property, and the same area hosted the spa’s hydrotherapy pools. That said, excellent spa services were also available directly onsite. Guests can also enjoy a 27-hole golf course or access the renowned Rafael Nadal Tennis Center, both available for an additional fee.

What truly sets the resort apart is its people. Every staff member went out of their way to know us and ensure our comfort. A special mention goes to Martin, the best beach valet we’ve encountered in over 30 years of all-inclusive travel. His personal attention elevated our stay—our favorite beach spot was always ready, with fresh towels, drinks flowing, and everything impeccably clean, even on days we were away on excursions.

We’d also like to recognize Gustavo, Barnelis, and Luz along with the entire crew at Santé, our preferred spot for breakfast and lunch just steps from the beach. Barnelis, the always-smiling hostess, set the tone each morning, while Luz and Gustavo made sure service flowed perfectly throughout our meals. Their warmth, professionalism, and attention to detail made dining there an absolute pleasure.

Evening dining options were varied, including Japanese hibachi, Mexican, Italian, steakhouse, and international buffets. Most dishes were well executed, though not extraordinary—admittedly, our expectations are high as seasoned foodies. The fine dining restaurant, curated by local chef Leandro Díaz, offered refined takes on Dominican specialties and was a pleasant highlight. However, the overall evening dining service fell short of the resort’s otherwise high standards, which slightly impacted our overall rating.

Members of the hotel’s loyalty program enjoy a private area and an extended wine list accessible via points or direct payment. While the table wines (red, rosé, and white) were decent, true wine enthusiasts may prefer to explore the premium options.
Facilities throughout the resort were exceptional: multiple clean and expansive pools, many featuring swim-up bars; a well-equipped gym suited for maintaining fitness routines; and effortless access to non-motorized water sports equipment (with a refundable deposit). The Reserve guests also benefit from dedicated concierge service—ours, Yaleidy, consistently demonstrated care, attention, and professionalism.

Although our late flight arrival delayed initial check-in and the orientation tour, everything was quickly remedied the next morning. The resort also offers hospitality showers for guests with late departures—a thoughtful touch.

The beach itself was spectacular: clean, beautifully maintained each morning, and thoroughly enjoyable throughout the day. Entertainment staff kept things lively with optional activities at both beach and poolside.

In short, Paradisus Palma Real delivers a luxurious and relaxing experience where service excellence stands out, facilities impress, and staff genuinely care. While a few aspects of dining and evening service could improve, the overall experience far exceeded expectations.

Our rating: 4.8 out of 5. Highly recommended for couples seeking tranquility, attentive service, and an upscale beach escape.

reviews.author: PhillyR2
reviews.text:
I have just returned from my visit to the Paradisus Palma Real Golf & Resort Spa with a group of friends.  The experience was unforgettable in the best way possible.  The rooms were beautiful and the grounds were magical to walk around.  The food was incredible as well.  I feel what really made the resort so special though was the friendliness and professionalism of the staff there.

First there was Ariel, our concierge.  He really helped to make our visit there perfect.  Ariel was always checking in on our group and made sure we were taken care of and answered any questions we may have had.  Was nice to know we had someone we could reach out to and count on consistently.  He felt like part of our family as we had to leave.

When we would visit the beach we had our favorite attendent Yuderi, who made sure we got the drinks we needed and would help set up our chairs and lounging area.  He was always happy to greet us as we arrived and checked in on us to make sure we had everything we needed while taking in the sun on the beautiful beach.  He was outstanding.

There were 2 guys in the entertainment department that really stood out.  Their names were Joeffry and Fernando.  They were always out and about the resort leading dances and getting the guests to smile and enjoy themselves.    Super outgoing and had great positive energy that was infectious.

Our favorite spot to eat breakfast and lunch was Sante.  The atmosphere was beautiful and so was the service and staff.  Barnelis, the hostess, always greeted us with her infectious smile and charm.  Wendy, Gustavo, Reynaldo, and Jesus on the wait staff were also super friendly and kind.

We got to experience a rum tasting at Rum Republic Spice and Sugar Bar.  The tasting was lead by Maria who was very knowledgable with the different rums we tasted and Joeffry from the entertainment staff was there as well to help translate.  Was a very nice experience that ended with some traditional Dominican Republic dancers performing outside in the lobby who were wonderful to watch.

Morning coffee was very nice at Ginger Bar and Anthony never disappointed with his fantastic service there.

The staff and food at Flora, Mascalzone, Blue Agave, Between Lounge Bar, and The Winery were all incredible as well.  I wish I could remember our waiters and staff names but my memory fails me.  Great service though all around and delicious food!

We had an amazing time at Tokimeku.  Not only was the food delectable, the waiters, staff and cook were very entertaining.  Felix, our cook, was so much fun and Luis, our server was hilarious and kept us very happy throughout the meal.

Our visit to Mina, the steakhouse, was equally amazing and our server, Junior, was very nice and accommodating.

Kicks Sports and Fun Bar was always a nice stop for a nightcap before heading back to the room.

The resort was also spacious enough that although there were many guests there, it still felt as if you had the place to yourself.  It was very expansive and gorgeous.  I would definitely return.

Eriol was our concierge, he Catered for all our needs very quickly, securing our dinner reservations and ensure we get the best dining experience. All the other staff we came across were courteous and pleasant as well but a big thank you to ERIOL for going above and beyond by putting service above self. You did everything right and so there's nothing else we could have asked of you. My wife and I were happy and you made our wedding anniversary a special one. Take care and keep up the good work, God bless y'all.

reviews.author: Arianna Castillo
reviews.text: Beautiful hotel! Food was amazing! Rooms are extremely clean and impeccable. Our guest concierge Guillermo Joshua is an amazing person with lots to show and knows all about the hotel and all the activities the hotel provides to you. He is available at all times with any concerns.

reviews.author: Ami Soifer
reviews.text: Raul and Danny by the pool side bar have been absolutely fantastic.  Always service  with a smile.   Our family of 8 enjoy every time we see them.   They make sure we are hydrated, having fun and making some of the best drinks.  Thank you 🙏 for making our experience at Punta Cana Paradisus Palma Rael is relaxing.

reviews.author: David Chastain
reviews.text: My wife and I spent an amazing 5 days 4 night at Paradisus Palma Real. Everything was fantastic. Our concierge, Alam, made our stay exceptional. He took care of our every need. The nightly entertainment was good. Bars and restaurants very good. The beach and pools were fantastic. We got several upgrades through the hotel's partnership with American Express, so that was a great bonus. I highly recommend this report for families and adult-only travelers. Most of the spaces are mixed, but there are adults only segregated pools and guest rooms. Don't miss out on getting massage at the spa!

reviews.author: Nelly Rosario
reviews.text: I had a wonderful stay at Paradisus Punta Cana. The resort was beautiful, well-kept, and relaxing. The highlight of my trip was the amazing service by the pool. Jeffrey and Angelo were outstanding—attentive, friendly, and always went above and beyond to make sure we were comfortable and had everything we needed. Their hospitality made the experience even more enjoyable. I highly recommend this resort and look forward to returning.

reviews.author: Collin Seavers (vikings4532)
reviews.text: Our stay at Paradisius was great, we had a lovely room and excellent, 24/7 service with our host Alam. We stayed on the beach practically every day, and our guy Martin was the best! We also golfed at Cocotal which was great and a suprisingly up-kept course (just beware of the heat & humidity!).

reviews.author: Igor Vodyanchuk
reviews.text: Great resort and great people working here. Julia and Edickson at 36 Degrees bar are amazing. Mina restaurant is a great if you want a good steak. Thank you.

reviews.author: Jandalyn Guinn
reviews.text: Luis number 1 was very personable and catered to English as we are not bi lingual.

reviews.author: Melissa Oesch
reviews.text: We had a beautiful stay at the Paridisus Resort! Yafreisy and Ebony were wonderful servers quick with a smile and very attentive!

reviews.author: Wendy Jimenez
reviews.text: We love Palma Real! We have been coming here for years as Club Members and what we appreciate is that it is constantly updating and keeping things modern.  We had a swim up room and it was exactly what we needed for the kids. You have many options for food which is great. Jose Acosta was our concierge and he was in communication with us daily assuring we knew the activities, reservations and just to check in. He went above and beyond to ensure we had a stress free vacation. We highly recommend!

reviews.author: Romel Maldonado
reviews.text:
Great experience, my girlfriend and I opted to upgrade to the reserve. The adults only area of the resort. And it was so worth it! With it it included a concierge service. I had a wonderful experience thanks to the concierge. Cristian was incredibly kind and helpful, but what stood out the most was his warm gummy smile — it instantly reminded me of my grandfather, who I loved dearly. It made the interaction feel personal and comforting. Small gestures like that leave a lasting impression.

We went in July and woke up at 5am for the sunrise which can be seen beautifully from the beach area. Not crowded at that time with tons of space to lounge and beds with towels.

Thank you!

reviews.author: Luisa Goncalves
reviews.text: Location is amazing but definitely get the upgrade to the reserve! We had a waterfront room a must and service is unbelievable. Rooms are a little outdated but the view is great. Lots of options in food in this all inclusive property. Shout out to Starlin our waiter at Flora. Great and attentive! Very friendly and took great care of us.

reviews.author: B F
reviews.text:
Today is Day 2 of our stay. Yesterday, Samuel was very helpful to find our room and filled us in on meal times, rooms service and how to get around. This morning we had room service and Joel dropped our food and coffee off. It was good, breakfast food. Don’t sleep on the Dominican coffee…it’s delicious. I will try to update real-time as time permits.

Day 3: We chose to do an excursion that a company was selling on the beach. The excursion we did was the boogies. You basically follow a guide on an ATV and you drive a Razor. There are 3 stops: a coffee and chocolate place, a cave with beautiful blue water, and a beach. No regrets, however, it is poorly planned and we wasted lots of time getting there and back. The actual places we went were full of vendors that were nice, but fully expected you to buy something.  I would not recommend. Nothing against the resort as this is something we chose to do, but the vendors are on the beach.

reviews.author: Kaylee McCall
reviews.text: I loved staying this resort! Derny took care of us the entire trip at the members only pool and bar! He was the best and we looked forward to seeing him everyday!!!! Felix was amazing with our snacks everyday. Anayely was a great concierge. Great honeymoon!

reviews.author: Ulise Barias
reviews.text: I had a really good time with Lucia! Luis D! And Jorge! I love the experience here! They really do there best to put a lot of effort into getting you the right drink! Definitely felt at home! The energy they bring makes you want to keep coming back up here to the lobby bar!

reviews.author: kristina HuDSON
reviews.text: Staff and rooms were great!!! However this resorts water system had me dealthy sick for 5 days. Also do not eat the salads!! I’m afraid to travel after this experience with my heath from the water.

reviews.author: Stacy Kline
reviews.text: A truly outstanding stay! The rooms are clean and beautiful and the aesthetic of the property is stunning. What was the most stand out was the service. Cannot say enough how warm, welcoming, and attentive all of the staff are. Basilio was our concierge and took care of our every need. Arisleida at the beach always made sure we had a drink in hand and she was a joy to chat with. Would go back in a heartbeat!

reviews.author: Dillon
reviews.text: 5/5 stars. 90 degrees was the best bar at the resort, shoutout Jeffery & Arisleida, the absolute best service.

reviews.author: Carole Clare
reviews.text: We have been here at the hotel Palma Real Golf and Spa Resort Punta Cana for nearly 3 weeks and apart from the beautiful surroundings it's the people who have been looking after us so well that have made it so special, our shout out today goes to the guys around the adults only swimming pool by block 8, the bar person Wanda is lovely, so friendly (a beautiful soul) and does the best cocktails! Martin the server is so attentive and always asking if we want a drink and Pedro who's lust for life is infectious he "works in paradise" We want to thank them all for helping to make our stay so enjoyable. They are credit to your business highly recommend ❤️

reviews.author: Tyler Johnston
reviews.text: Alberto, Letty, and Raisa were amazing! We had a party of 25 people and they took care of us our entire trip while we were at the pool bar. He made our experience amazing and the resort is lucky to have them on the staff!

reviews.author: Brandon
reviews.text: Service was impeccable. Guillermo was a fantastic attendant, very responsive and incredibly nice. All the staff at the various restaurants and bars were friendly. Variety of food was good, lots of high end options also.

reviews.author: Patricia Allen
reviews.text: Melina was our server; she was great  the host and hostess were very friendly and nice.  We arrived prior to our reservation and they seated us next to the window.  Melina immediately brought out our appetizer and drinks.  She explained the menu in detail and in the meantime kept our drinks flowing! The food came out promptly, hot and delicious!  We would definitely come back!

reviews.author: Pascal Morel
reviews.text: The place is perfect, site is fantastic.  Food and service are excellent.  Rosanna is very kind and sweet.

reviews.author: Tiffany Beltre
reviews.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ 5/5 – Awesome Sports Bar at Paradisus Palma Real!

Kicks Sports Bar is a great spot to hang out if you’re staying at Paradisus Palma Real. Elidania was absolutely the BEST bartender. She made me fall in love with Gin & Tonic. The energy is fun and relaxed, with tons of big screens showing all kinds of sports — perfect for catching a game or just chilling with friends.

The service was excellent — super friendly and fast. Our server made us feel right at home, and the drinks were on point. The cocktails were well-made, and the local beers were served ice-cold.

The food was surprisingly great for a bar setting! We had the wings, sliders, and nachos — all delicious, fresh, and full of flavor.

There’s both indoor and outdoor seating, and the music added a nice vibe without being too loud. Whether you’re into sports or just looking for a cool place to relax, Kicks is definitely worth a visit.

Highly recommend checking it out while you’re at the resort!

reviews.author: Rebecca Hitchiner
reviews.text: Maria makes the best cocktails!! And Carlos from entertainment staff keeps the vibes going!

reviews.author: Simon Johansen
reviews.text:
One week visiting my family the Melia Punta Cana.

reviews.text: My wife and I stayed here for our anniversary and really enjoyed it.  We stayed in the Reserve section and it was definitely worth the extra cost.  Rafael made sure we had everything we needed while hanging out on the beach and pool.  Our concierge Zenovia made us reservations at different restaurants every night and booked us on a complimentary excursion trip that was very fun. Alberto served us and had our drink order memorized after one round at the bar. He was on it, friendly and took great care of us. We had a great time.

reviews.author: Rachel Freitas
reviews.text: Joanna, charlina, lisbath are amazing! They took care of our kids our whole trip. We were a very large group with 11 kids in all. The kids looked forward to each activity and the adults got to have some adult time during the activity time. The kids loved each of the activity leaders. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Chris Rollins
reviews.text:
After 10 years we return to continued excellence at Paradisus Palma Real, and once again this resort exceeded all of our expectations. From the moment we arrived, the beauty of the property was undeniable—the lush tropical gardens, the pristine turquoise waters, and the timeless elegance of the resort’s design reminded us why we fell in love with this place a decade ago.

But what truly sets Paradisus Palma Real apart is not only the magnificent setting, but the people who bring the experience to life. Over the years, this resort has continued to raise the bar for luxury and hospitality, and the credit goes to the incredible team whose passion and professionalism ensure that every guest feels valued and cared for.

We would like to recognize and sincerely thank the following outstanding team members who went above and beyond to make our stay so memorable:
•Rafelin, Eduardo, Franklin, Rosanna, Yanira, Daniel – Chef (Buffet), Anderson, Vicente, Baron, Leannie, Freilyn, Tony, Rosa, Maria, Cesar – Flora, José Murillo – Flora Chef, Enrique – Flora, Ebony, Richard – Chef, Maria – Mina, Melina – Flora, Jonathan – Flora, Raider – Flora, Gustavo – Santé, Jean – Flora / Santé,  Noriandro - Sante, Franklin - Sante, Jeffrey – Pool, and Angelo– Pool, and Fernando and Anderson, bringing the best entertainment.

Each one of these individuals made an impact on our experience. The culinary team—from the artistry of the buffet and specialty chefs to the vibrant flavors at Flora, Mina, and Santé—elevated dining to an unforgettable part of our stay. Poolside service, led with warmth and attentiveness, ensured that relaxation was always effortless. From warm greetings at every turn to the personal touches that showed genuine care, this team proved that hospitality here is not just a job, but a calling.

It is rare to find such consistency after so many years, but Paradisus Palma Real continues to shine as a world-class destination. The staff’s dedication, kindness, and professionalism reflect the very essence of five-star service.

To the team we recognized above: thank you for welcoming us back after 10 years and reminding us why Paradisus Palma Real is truly one of the best resorts in the Caribbean. You are the reason we will continue to return.

Five stars, without hesitation! 🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟

reviews.author: Beth Bombard
reviews.text: Blue Agave Mexican restaurant was fantastic.  The server, the food, ambience were all spot on!!

reviews.author: Life’s Good
reviews.text:
We spent 6 days at this amazing hotel and had a fantastic time from start to finish. The food was a definite highlight — with a great variety of delicious options and refreshing drinks available throughout our stay. Even though the Mediterranean restaurant was temporarily closed for renovations, there were still plenty of dining choices to enjoy every day.

The staff were consistently warm and welcoming, always ready to help with a smile. We especially appreciated the cabanas around the pool, which were a lovely touch and made for relaxing afternoons in the sun.

One small downside was that the cabana usage rules weren’t very well enforced. Unfortunately, a particular family managed to reserve the cabana closest to the pool every day, apparently overnight, which was frustrating — especially as I made an effort to be up as early as 6 AM to find a spot. It felt a bit unfair, and I hope the hotel can improve monitoring this in the future so everyone has a fair chance to enjoy these great amenities.

Despite that, we had an overall wonderful experience and would definitely return. Thank you for a lovely stay!

reviews.author: Ricardo Talbot
reviews.text:

Still, a great experience... Will repeat... Just not in the Reserve 😉.

reviews.author: Aida Kamali
reviews.text:
Paradisus Palma Real – Extremely Disappointing Experience

I would never recommend this hotel. We booked what was advertised as an all-inclusive package, but it was far from it. Food was only available at very limited times and in specific locations, leaving us with no real options throughout the day. The staff was unhelpful and in many cases outright rude. Service by the pool was nonexistent—no one ever checked on guests, and when we asked for help, most employees didn’t seem to know anything.

On top of that, there were no basic amenities such as a shop for essentials or even an emergency convenience store within the hotel. For a resort of this size and price, this was shocking. My husband and I travel four times a year for quick getaways, and this was by far the worst experience we’ve had anywhere.

We expected a relaxing, stress-free stay, but instead we dealt with poor service, lack of food options, and no sense of hospitality. This was our first and last visit to Paradisus Palma real
