reviews.author: larry fee
reviews.text:
We were at paradisus Palma real with our kids and grandkids for a week in July of 25.
The resort itself was great!  We had 2 deluxe suites and 2 two bedroom suites.  Accommodations were large, clean and well appointed.   The pools, beachfront, and restaurants were all wonderful.
What really stood out was the staff.  Our concierge for the week was Zanovia.  She was soo attentive.  Took  care of dinner reservations,  helped with transportation,  and personally took charge of throwing two birthday celebrations for us!  Cannot say enough things about how helpful she was!
All the staff was great!  Richard at the front, Arisleida at the pool/beach, and the lady at the buffet ( whose name I didn't get).
We'll go there again!

reviews.author: Ro Indy Realtor
reviews.text: I booked a junior suite on the adults only side as I was traveling for my birthday. When I arrived, I was advised that my room had been upgraded and I was put on the family side. There was a screaming baby next to my room. I opted for this room so that I didnt have to be around kids while traveling. They switched my room. I opened the door to a man walking with food in his hand. He yelled, ummm hello. I freaked out and closed the door so fast. They then put me in a 3rd room. The room was nice but I was smacked in the face with a mildew smell when I opened the door. At this point, I was exhausted and wanted to find food. I did make them aware kf the smell and they said housekeeping would check it out. I also let them know the hot water in the shower, tv, and fridge wasn't working. At this point, I was over it and my birthday trip was not pleasant. I made the best out of a bad situation. I wouldnt agree that it's a 5 star resort. They didnt offer a turn down service. The room came with a loofah, robes, slippers, toothbrush/toothpaste, shaving cream and razors. The room was nice outside of the mildew smell. It was amount 30 minutes away from the airport. I've been to plenty of resorts, and this by far had the best food. I was thoroughly impressed. The view was so beautiful. Everyone was so nice and helpful. I'd definitely want to visit the DR again. I also had an amazing massage. They have a company on-site that can help you with excursions. I didnt receive a welcome drink as advertised in my reservation. I put in the reservation when I booked that I was coming for my birthday. They didnt make me feel special at all. The last night, I walked in to a treat. At the restaurants, they sang hbd for other guests and when I asked if they could do the same for me bc it was my birthday, I was brushed off. I was able to get some beautiful pictures.

reviews.text: Okay we have a lot to talk about this place. First of all 5 of 5. If you want the nicest all inclusive in punta cana this is it. If you just want to kick it back at the resort there’s plenty to do here too! Bring cash to tip the staff and for anything you would like to buy. USD is acceptable everywhere. I’ll be writing a second review for sure because there’s so much I am missing stay tuned.

reviews.author: Dayne Hepner
reviews.text: The Ginger Bar team — Ismael, Antonio, Clari, Olga, Samaria, and Vianny — gave me outstanding service. Truly the best service I’ve received at any resort!

reviews.author: Cecilia Malcolm
reviews.text: Mr. Ayayaya has a great presence and is good entertainment. I had so much fun at the foam party and the Dominican night.

reviews.author: Kristin Vogler
reviews.text: We had an absolutely wonderful time at this resort! Alberto at the 90 degrees swim up bar provided us with so much entertainment and top notch drinks. Emmanuel, our concierge, took care of all our reservations and everything we needed. He was also so sweet and provided champagne, fruit and desert on the day of our anniversary! Would definitely recommend coming here for any vacation.

reviews.author: Zahra Wells
reviews.text: Carlos de animacion made this trip 10/10. I would definitely come back based on the service he provided.

reviews.author: Andrew Palma
reviews.text: The service was remarkable! We were attended by incredible staff. Notably, we were helped everyday by Raul at the beach who was incredibly attentive, supportive, and always willing to help with any and every need. One day, I left my wallet at the beach and he searched for me throughout the resort and ensured all of my possessions were safe. Chantal at the pool also took great care of us and made sure we had the best time. Randi at the bar made a special drink for my partner which we will make at home. Overall, an incredible experience thanks to Raul, Chantal, Randi and all the other staff

reviews.author: David McCracken
reviews.text: Highly recommend this resort, however I must be fully transparent about my review. We were on property for a short stay which was a benefit of my company making reservations at this property for some of our clients. I have no doubt that the service for everyone else Would have been equal to our better than the service we received but just want to make sure that readers of this review are aware of how we came to this property. We arrived for our three nights stay and were greeted at the check-in with a delicious refreshing welcoming drink, nonalcoholic. Our room was not quite ready however the staff directed us to one of the restaurants where we had lunch waiting for our room to be ready. We did receive an upgraded room which was the swim up suite in the family section. This room was absolutely amazing, being able to walk right out of bed a few steps and into the pool was incredible. Once our room was ready staff came and got us we got into our room we provided information about some of the events were happening on property we put on our swimsuits and began to enjoy but at that time seem to be our private pool. There was a large group on property which was using the convention center facilities which made the property seem less occupied. We were also there during one of the slower seasons so things may be slightly different and the busier seasons. The food and the à la cart restaurants was outstanding. The buffets were above average and typical buffet environment. The fresh omelettes were delicious and hot most all of the food during breakfast or lunch on the buffets was good and they seem to keep it rotating in and out. As mentioned it was not as busy so all of the buffets were not open at the same time although we were able to experience each of them on different days. The beach was wonderful lots of lounge chairs, this was during Sargasm season and they had the beach as clean as I believe they could keep it. Their barriers did a good job of keeping the sarcasm off of the beach and out of the water closest to the beach however there was still sarcasm around which is to be expected during the season. But that being said they were more than enough swimming pools and lounge chairs at the pools to enjoy them and also enough lounge chairs on the beach to enjoy the beach. Our checkout process was seamless we checked out online our luggage was picked up tagged and waiting for our transfer to the airport. A couple of things to keep in mind when you do the online checkout security will probably want to see the Email  before you leave the property. Also even though tipping is not required we felt very generous and blessed to have been able to stay there so we did tip most of the staff make sure you have plenty of ones as change was a little difficult to come by. Holly recommend reserving a room and upgrading to concierge service our concierge Eriol was amazing Definitely worth the extra cost in my opinion. We will return and continue to offer this property as one of our favorite for our clients

reviews.author: Bryan Mora
reviews.text:
Great service, it was a pleasure to have Yanira,maria,Fraimey as my waitress.

Muy bein servico.

reviews.author: Andres Castano
reviews.text: Great time at this resort. All the restaurants were amazing and the staff was super friendly.

reviews.author: siddhi shah
reviews.text: We enjoyed service every morning by Rosanna and Yahira and Maria . Excellent service every day . Always smiling

reviews.author: Sharon Reid
reviews.text: Wonder is an amazing waiter!!! He always takes great care of us and greets us with a big smile!

reviews.author: Lorena Rodriguez
reviews.text:
Flora restaurant was great!
Melina provided great recommendations and service with a smile.

reviews.author: Mariah Roman
reviews.text: Great margaritas at 90Degree Pool Bar thanks to Alberto! Great vibes too!

reviews.author: Trevor Kondra
reviews.text:
During our visit to the Dominican Republic, we had the pleasure of dining at an incredible buffet that truly exceeded our expectations — not just because of the delicious food, but because of the outstanding service.

Rosanna, Santo, and Yanira made our experience unforgettable. From the moment we arrived, they welcomed us with warm smiles and genuine hospitality, making us feel like family. They were attentive, friendly, and went above and beyond to ensure we were comfortable and happy throughout our meal. Whether it was recommending dishes, checking in on us regularly, or simply sharing kind words, their positive energy made all the difference.

The buffet itself was impressive, offering a wide variety of fresh, flavorful options — from local Dominican favorites to international cuisine — all beautifully presented and cooked to perfection. But what stood out even more was the way Rosanna, Santo, and Yanira made the atmosphere feel vibrant and joyful.

If you’re ever in the Dominican and looking for a place to enjoy great food paired with exceptional service, this buffet is a must-visit. Thanks to these three wonderful staff members, our meal wasn’t just satisfying — it was an experience we’ll remember for a long time.

reviews.author: gsarki
reviews.text: We had an amazing time! I couldn't recommend this hotel enough. Great service at the pool bar by Raul. The food, hotel and  hotel staff are all 20 out of 10 and we're already planning our next stay. Can't wait to come back!

reviews.author: Angela Carroll
reviews.text:
Cons:  bottled waters are never cold! you have to ask for ice every time!   room fridge not very cold.  restaurant portion sizes are very small except for hybachi and steak house.  Deserts are very small as well.   We had teenage boys and it was not enough food for them.   Not much alcohol in mixed drinks.  better off ordering cans.  Needs a bigger sports bar area - it was way too small.  No night club to hang out in.  We  went in July and beach had a lot of seaweed.  we never went in the water - very disappointing.  they were cleaning it up but it remained murky at the shoreline.  Some buffet food is sitting out and it's so hot there I wound't bother to eat certain things if you don't get there early enough.  most staff speaks english but some are very hard to understand.  we all had upset stomachs but never drank the water!

Pros:  Staff very friendly and helpful, some hard to understand.  Neat and clean beautiful resort.  Excellent entertainment at night!  Alot of fun!  Food was fairly good but didn't care for a few things.  buffet has a large selection.  Best food was hybachi,  steak house and italian (small portions tho). didn't care for mexican restaurant.  large beautiful pools.  Had to get a spot early at main pool.  beach has tons of spots with shade.

reviews.author: Brankica Bujic
reviews.text:
An Unforgettable Paradise at Paradisus Palma Real

From the moment we arrived, we were greeted with warm smiles and exceptional hospitality. The staff at Paradisus Palma Real truly go above and beyond to ensure every guest feels welcomed and cared for. Everyone was incredibly polite, attentive, and always ready to help with a cheerful attitude.

The resort itself is immaculate—everything from the rooms to the common areas is spotless and beautifully maintained. You can tell the team takes great pride in keeping the property pristine and inviting.

The food and drinks were another highlight of our stay. With a variety of dining options, every meal felt like a culinary adventure, offering something for every taste. The cocktails were perfectly crafted, and the service at the bars was always quick and friendly.

Overall, Paradisus Palma Real exceeded all our expectations. It’s the perfect place for relaxation, indulgence, and experiencing the best of all-inclusive luxury. We can’t wait to return!

reviews.author: ismary alvarez
reviews.text: Mr AYAYAYA  WHAT A BLAST IT IS TO BE WITH HIM.  He is the best bartender intertainer there is. You won’t have a dull time with him.

reviews.author: Kayla Gorin
reviews.text:
Very beautiful! Raul on the beach is amazing, we see him every year. I have been coming to this resort for 12 years and he has always given us amazing service. Raul is the best!

The kicks sports bar is also very fun! Service is great, very fun way to spend the night! Yiri is the best!

reviews.author: Mehul Desai
reviews.text: This was my 4th stay at an all inclusive resort with my wife and two sons. Our concierge, Cristian Gonzalez, went above and beyond to make sure we had an amazing experience. The best concierge so far. Our room had a small balcony compared to the photos and he found additional rooms to make sure it met our needs. He made all of dinner reservations and would check in at the restaurants to make sure we got a table. The resort is clean and quiet. It doesn't have as many activities as others we've been to, but we liked it. There were no lines at the various bars, which was great. The main pool is huge and didn't feel crowded during peak hours. If we had to complain about anything, we wish the main buffet would be available for dinner. As vegetarians, we find it easier to find food we like and can eat at buffets. Additionally, the hot tube on our balcony nor the tub in our bathroom held any water. The drain always stayed open. We didn't mention it to anyone there so can't say they didn't address the issue, but when paying $3,000+ I would like for these items to be tested and maintained.

reviews.author: Joseph Allen
reviews.text:
Palma real is the 2nd paradisus resort we have stayed at and they have both been wonderful. The drinks are well mixed (Raul and Dany at the Circle/ClubMelia pool are excellent!) and the food at the buffet is, for the most part, fresh and plentiful (Yafreisy and George Vargas took great care of us each morning for our group of 9). Every morning Geraldo at the omelette bar remembed my daughters order and had already started it before she walked up, she loved it! Our two younger kids loved the people who worked at Kidsdom (my kids were sad to say goodbye to Joanna) Lastly our concierge Ariel made sure we had dinner each night.

The pool is beautiful and the resort itself is always clean.

Would highly recommended

The people here are super nice, the service is great, the food Is phenomenal, and so are the drinks

reviews.text: The bar is very good, my favorite tender is Anthony. He is a very good drink maker. He made me a special drink which was very good. I love Anthony! Ismael is very good too. They speak Italian. Anthony brought all the joy to my vacation. I can’t wait to see Anthony again! Ismael is very awesome too.

reviews.text: Today I ate at Flora restaurant in Dr. Our wait staff Andrea was awesome. Very knowledgeable about the food we ordered. Her recommendation was the best I had since arriving. I would recommend everyone to eat here, ask for Andrea. So nice service with a smile 😃

reviews.author: ΒΑΣΙΛΗΣ ΣΜΥΡΝΙΩΤΑΚΗΣ
reviews.text:
From the moment we arrived, we were greeted with warm smiles and everyone was available to help us.

We stayed on the Reserve side in a second-floor with garden and pool view. The mini-bar was restocked daily as promised, and the housekeeping service was consistently excellent.

The beach in front of the resort was great and all the pools  was fantastic.

For dining, we especially enjoyed Sante for breakfast and lunch most days, and also had fantastic experiences at Mina, and Flora.

A special shout-out to our concierge, Adriel Cabrera, who went above and beyond to make our stay special. He provided daily updates on activities, made all dining reservations. His thoughtfulness made our trip unforgettable.

All in all, this was a 5-star experience—beautiful property, excellent service, and memories that will last a lifetime.

reviews.author: Renee Michelle
reviews.text: I needed this trip. I lost my brother, my mother, 2 cousins, a beloved aunt and my job all in 18 months, among other troubles. At check-in, it was recommended to my MIL Sylvia and I, seeing as we have stayed at Paradisus Palma Real several times before, to upgrade to the Reserve. We are so grateful that we accepted. It opened up for us more restaurants, private spaces, and a private concierge among other surprises. Reynaldo, Gustavo, Berneli at Sante are delightful. Rafael was our angel concierge at the beach. Kelvin was our experience manager, and everyone was wonderful with flawless communication. Alba at the Yhi spa is an experience not to be missed. Every space was spotless, I was comfortable going barefoot everywhere. The accomodations were 5 star. I was very pleased to see Melia choosing environmentally sustainable choices for amenities. Everyone makes magic here, with a sweet spirit. I am crying as I type this. 💠😭💠 We cannot come back soon enough. God bless the Dominican people.

reviews.author: Seth Peterson
reviews.text: Yaleidi Sims was my concierge and was amazingly helpful! She was very good at staying in contact with me and helped answer any questions I had. She assisted in looking for activities and excursions I had interest in. The resort was amazing with a couple great food options. The room was very nice and the beach had great seating.

The staff however make it truly an incredible experience. Vanessa, Raul and Derni made our trip memorable. Genuine kind humans that provided the absolute best service very grateful to them and to come here another year. Highly highly recommend.

reviews.text: We had a great time at the paradise Palma Real. The rooms are beautiful. The service is excellent and the food is extremely delicious. Also if you’re in the pool area, please visit Rosanna, She will get you the best drinks with the most beautiful smile thank you for all your service.

Rosanna, the waitress near the pool, was excellent! She made sure we had everything we needed and brought a big smile everyday. Her warmth and attention made our vacation especially memorable!

We spent most evenings at Kick’s, the sports bar. Tairon was there every night and took great care of us! By a day or two in, he quickly knew our drink orders and made us feel like regulars. His precision as a bartender was never lost, even when the bar was crowded.

The service at this Paradisus was top notch! From our room to the restaurants and admin team.

reviews.author: Haley T
reviews.text:
Overall this all inclusive was amazing. We stayed four nights, five nights for a girls Bachelorette trip.
Anthony who mans the coffee bar across from a Check-in was AMAZING. Made us feel fabulous every morning ready with coffee and smoothies.
Our group of 5 chose a Two Bedroom master suite with a walk out pool which are mostly private and we were so impressed when we arrived. The property was extremely clean and the staff was friendly and accommodating. We were very impressed with the cleanliness of the rooms and grounds. We chose Flora, the Dominican cuisine restaurant as our last reservation. Starling was fabulous and made the evening memorable. Highly recommend this restaurant as the food was delicious, there was not a single dish that missed.
Nightlight within the resort is slim and highly recommend going to Coco Bongo. 3/5 of us went and we felt very safe traveling to and from the resort and were impressed with the security at the gate.

Update- how could we forget our lovely service at the buffet which was 10/10. Breakfast, lunch, and dinner were all great. Rosanna and Yanira put a smile on our face everyday and were amazing.

5/5 ⭐️ highly recommend for girls trips, honeymoons, etc.

reviews.text: Had an amazing stay at a wonderful resort, it was like living a dream, the beach the weather everything, god bless Dominica, god bless the resort.

reviews.text: Luis, Luis, and Nathanael at Ginger Bar were spectacular! Besides making wonderful drinks, they were overly attentive and enthusiastic. reviews.author: Diego Kanawati Ortega
reviews.text:
Amazing experience! Great service, delicious food, excellent amenities, and very friendly and lovely staff. The pools are beautiful and clean, and the beach is stunning. This is a place we truly enjoyed and would love to visit again.

A special highlight goes to the very traditional drink from the Dominican Republic, presented in an improved local recipe: the Passion Mamajuana from the Rum Republic bar, crafted by Miguel. Don’t miss it!

A big shoutout to Vanessa, our amazing beach friend, who made sure we had everything we needed every single day. Her warm, caring energy made our beach time unforgettable. The concierge team was also incredible, checking in with us daily to make sure we were always comfortable and happy.💜

Be sure to visit Gerardo at the omelette station in the buffet.. his cooking is fantastic and he always serves with a smile! 💚And we can’t forget Jeison, one of the friendliest waiters ever, who greeted our family with such joy and excitement every time we saw him.🩵

Excellent service all around. We felt truly taken care of and can’t wait to come back again with our family! 🥰❤️

Starlin and Melina at Flora were the best servers we had on the resort. They both were very personable and helpful. The drinks were great!

reviews.author: Felix Govantes
reviews.text: The place and the employees were very nice. Jeffrey Richardson, one of the pool attendants, was the best I’ve seen. Angelo by the pool along with Jorge and Jonathan at the pool bar, Jose the bartender around the hotel, Jason at the buffet, and Virtudes at the Mexican restaurant also deserve credit for making are stay a pleasure.

reviews.author: Irena CB
reviews.text:
I feel like a lot of reviews here are not from real people so I’ll add mine. We stayed here for free on a company trip so we came with no expectations. Would we return if we had to pay? Probably not. Here are our honest impressions.

This is not a 5-star resort in American sense. We stayed in the “reserve” adults-only side. The rooms were nicely appointed but smelled somewhat musty. This side does have a decent restaurant for breakfast which is a perk because the food everywhere else is almost inedible. The pools and beach loungers are also somewhat nicer here and with somewhat better service. Nowhere close to 5-star but acceptable.

Unfortunately, the food and service are pretty poor all around. I don’t expect much from an all-inclusive but here everyone does the bare minimum and food is mediocre to inedible. They also force you to book days ahead for every dinner meal which is both inconvenient and annoying. The good thing is that Uber is easy and only a couple dollars to get to the downtown area with normal restaurants. We ended up doing that a couple times.

reviews.author: Janet Bahr
reviews.text: The food is amazing. Maira was so sweet! The resort is one of the prettist I have been too.

Rosanna, Yanira. Maria
Excellent service, always smiling, all 4 days we just seat where they serve

reviews.text: I enjoyed my stay here. The service was great everywhere. Our favorite restaurants for dinner were Blue Agave (Mexican) and Flora (Dominican), Santa was great for breakfast and lunch. I would have a vacation here again.

The resort itself is stunning with so many pools, restaurants, indoor outdoor activities and long stretch of white sand beaches. What truly made it exceptional were Anthony and Rosemary our incredible concierges and hospitality services arranged by Reynaldo. They flawlessly handled all our restaurant reservations and effortlessly organized every details. Their seamless service allowed us to fully relax and enjoy every moment, making our trip truly unforgettable. Highly recommend Paradisus Palma real.

reviews.author: susan miller

reviews.author: Janine Pottier

Excellent  Resort. We are so well cared for.
We ate at the Italian restaurant it was the best meal so far. The servers were efficient and oh so friendly. The TBone steak was huge and cooked to perfection. The roasted octopus was amazing.
Well done, team. We will be back.

reviews.author: Gilbert Roland
reviews.text:
The resort itself is stunning, with postcard-perfect scenery  at every turn think powdery white sands, crystal-clear turquoise waters, and lush tropical gardens. It’s the kind of beauty that takes your breath away!

The nightly entertainment was top-notch, offering everything from live music to dazzling shows that kept the energy high. And let’s talk about the staff unbelievably attentive, friendly, and always going above and beyond to make sure every moment was unforgettable.

Whether you’re looking to relax by the pool, indulge in gourmet dining, or enjoy exciting activities, this resort has something for everyone. Plus, it’s perfect for families,so much to do, and so many memories to make...Thank you!!!

reviews.author: Miguel Jiménez
reviews.text: I was at the hotel during my stay and was fortunate enough to meet Fernando Chipa, from the Entertainment Group. I want to highlight the excellent work he does as an entertainer: always cheerful, attentive, with lots of energy and creativity to keep everyone entertained. Thanks to him, my time at the hotel was even better and more fun. 100% recommended, a true professional.

reviews.author: Chris Manning
reviews.text: The staff at Sante was incredibly respectful. Anything you needed they would get to make sure you have the best experience ever. Enrique was the best very funny and love doing his job. We came for almost every meal to see him and the staff. 10/10 would recommend to anyone

reviews.author: Kathi Ohanlon
reviews.text: The  hotel was amazing and has something for everyone. Rosanna, Yanira and Fauri provided excellent service at the buffet.

reviews.author: Anthony byrd
reviews.text: Loved the bike tour with Irvin. Great experience would do it 10x over.

reviews.author: William
reviews.text: The resort is incredible, the rooms are modern and clean, the location is almost impossible to improve on. The food is outstanding and the service is great. Angelo took care of us the entire week we were here. He was pleasant, kind and attentive. Every time I needed anything he was already there to help. Anything I needed he was able to assist with. His excellent service is going to be a big part of why I come back to Paradisus again.

reviews.author: Christopher Fowee
reviews.text: Arisleida and Alberto at the 90 degrees pool bar were fantastic! Great service and good vibes.

reviews.author: Newton Santos
reviews.text:
The 90 Degrees stay cool Bar is SO GREAT. The Bartender in the pool are the greatest: Olga, Leticia, Dayra and Greivin. They are so special, Kindn and Helpful…simply the best!

The Kanna Restaurant is incredible, the food is great, everything they served is delicious. Starling is an excellent waiter, he is amazing, helpful and a great host.

reviews.author: Achint Srivastava
reviews.text: Great service. Very very beautiful resort. The pools are amazing. Rosanna, Yaniro and Maria were amazing at the buffet.

reviews.author: Lianne Weatherup
reviews.text: Beautiful resort, make sure you get your restaurant reservations made asap, they book up fast and a 9pm dinner with kids is tough. But the food is good, the staff is very friendly! Lots of activities for adults as well, but you need to pay attention to the schedule because it isn’t advertised very well! The Dominican night festivities was a real highlight! Martha, Joanna, and Susu were so great with the kids! However the nightly entertainment is loud and goes until 11pm so getting to sleep before that is challenging. You can also hear the tv’s from neighbouring rooms so definitely bring ear plugs.

reviews.author: Becky Funderburk
reviews.text: Fantastic service! Jairo is a fabulous “cruise director” always made sure everyone was having fun!

reviews.author: Julia Cash
reviews.text: The resort is beautiful and kept very clean. The staff is VERY kind and friendly, as well as helpful. The food is great, too, with tons of options available. My family upgraded to the Reserve group, and it was amazing. Our personal concierge, Adriel Cabrera, was fantastic. He made our meal reservations, gave us a personal tour of the resort, and was a friendly face during our stay. I also enjoyed Yuderi and Martin, bartenders at the Reserve beach. They were so kind and helpful! Also, Fernando was a great staff member. He went on a catamaran with us and became a friend!

reviews.author: Taylor Smith
reviews.text:
Beautiful resort and amenities. Food was better than expected at both the buffet and various restaurants (did the steakhouse, italian, and hibachi).

Shoutout to Melvin and Maria at the Rum Republic bar. Easily the best cocktails in the resort.

The one downside was maintenance. Our room had broken A/C, broken safe, and broken soundbar at the start, though all were resolved after a few calls to the front desk.

reviews.author: David Q
reviews.text: We had an excellent time at Paradisus Palma Real. The staff made us feel at home and welcome. They consistently asked if everything was okay, and said if we had any issue to please let them know. Felix at Mascalzone was a kind and excellent waiter.

reviews.author: Famille Bernier
reviews.text:

Wellington gave an outstanding support and he was really helpful for all our request.

Luisa Lopez, the maid who was doing our room, made sure we are always in an excellent room condition.

Thanks for everything, it will be a pleasure to coming back at the Paradisus Palma real Punta Cana

reviews.author: Ian BEYLINSON
reviews.text: Anthony was absolutely fantastic from start to finish. Professional, reliable, and incredibly knowledgeable. He went above and beyond to make sure everything was perfect, and his attention to detail really stood out. You can tell he genuinely cares about his work and the people he’s helping. I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend Anthony to anyone looking for top-notch service. Truly a five-star experience!

reviews.author: Chris Coles
reviews.text: Amazing service, quality of rooms and attention to detail - our daughters loved the kids club and Fun Republic in particular.

reviews.author: John Duraes
reviews.text:
We stayed the third week of March 2025 at the Paradisus Palma Real adults, only side of the hotel.
When we arrived the reception staff quickly got us checked in, served us champagne and made us feel comfortable. We were escorted to the restaurant while we waited for the room to be ready at 3 PM. They kept us updated on when the room would ready and as per the literature, we were in our room by 3:15pm.
The room was spacious, well appointed, the mini fridge well stocked. The room was always kept very clean by the housekeeping. Idelsy, our Housekeeper was wonderful, she turned down the beds at night left chocolate on a pillow, outstanding service.

Our room, overlook the beach, beautiful crystal blue waters, beautiful raked sand, and with plenty of available large, thick mattress, lounge chairs. The beach  staff were always friendly and ready to get what we needed.

Every member of the food service staff that we met were very cordial and kind to us. As we got known them, we feel like we are leaving behind a group of friends that really cared about us. They work very hard to make our vacation super enjoyable.

Compliments to the Chefs and the cooking staff. We had many excellent meals. The steaks and sea food were extremely well prepared and were excellent.

Compliments to the various bartenders and waitresses throughout out the hotel.

A special mention to Irvin, our Concierge. After our first meeting and throughout the week he was always available. He would meet us when we had breakfast and shared the day’s events. Some how he would find us at various times of day to check on us. He would schedule our events from golf tee times to parasailing to booking hairdresser appointments, restaurant reservations, etc. Thank you Irvin!!!!

Apologies if have spelled their name and or title.
Just to name a few of the staff:
* Hipólito - Assistant Manager
* Henri - Assistant Manager
* Eduardo - Lead waiter
* Gustavo - waiter
* Juan - waiter
* Barnelis - Hostess
*Rafael - Chef at the Sante
•
To all and the rest that I have failed to mention, THANK YOU!!!
Wishing all much health and success!!!

PS. If you come down to Palma Real, please take care of staff , they work so hard and such long hours.

John & Silvia

reviews.author: Joe Oliveiro
reviews.text:
I'm sharing my experience with this hotel. I would highly recommend against staying here.

I am writing to express my deep disappointment and frustration with the treatment I received from your nighttime supervisor, Samson, during my recent stay at Paradisus Palma Real Golf & Spa Resort. What should have been a memorable and pleasant experience was completely ruined by his unprofessionalism and lack of customer service.
To provide some context, I paid for an upgrade to my room to enhance my experience at your hotel. Part of this experience was meant to include my girlfriend spending the night with me, making my last evening truly special, as she was staying at a different hotel in Punta Cana with her family.

Prior to this incident, I spoke with my butler about bringing my girlfriend to spend the night. He informed me that it was possible but that I should confirm with the front desk. On March 21, I visited the front desk and was assured that my girlfriend could join me at any time as long as she was registered upon arrival for an additional fee of $135. I made it clear that this was not an issue, and I planned my evening accordingly.

When we arrived at the security gate, we were told that we needed to wait for permission to enter, which they said would take about five minutes. After waiting for 30 minutes, Samson, the nighttime supervisor, came out and outright refused to let us in, stating that he would not allow her to be registered. I tried to explain that I had received prior approval from the front desk and that I was fully prepared to pay the registration fee. His response was dismissive and unprofessional, stating that he was the supervisor and made the decisions.

I attempted to convey how important this evening was to me and how deeply disappointing it was to have our plans disrupted in such a manner. Instead of listening or trying to resolve the situation, he remained indifferent and continued to refuse entry. His lack of empathy and unwillingness to even consider my explanation was appalling.
What makes this experience even worse is that when I returned to the hotel alone to find out his name, he refused to properly identify himself. He mumbled his name so quickly and quietly that I could not understand him. I had to ask another staff member to confirm his name.

This entire experience was deeply upsetting and has left me with a very negative impression of what was otherwise a pleasant stay. The fact that I paid for an upgraded room and was assured that my girlfriend could be registered only to be treated so poorly is unacceptable.

I expect this matter to be taken seriously. This is not the level of service one expects from a hotel of your reputation and caliber. At the very least, I would appreciate an apology and a clear explanation of why your staff was not aligned on this policy.
I look forward to your prompt response and to hearing how you intend to address this matter.
Sincerely,

reviews.author: Claudia Curtis
reviews.text:
Our stay at Paradisus Palma Real in Punta Cana was overall fantastic, and we would absolutely recommend it, with a few small notes for future travelers. We stayed in a garden view room with a patio that led directly to the pool, which was a beautiful and relaxing setup. The room itself was spacious and comfortable, though it would really benefit from a second garbage can (the only one is in the small toilet area) and a few more hooks in the bathroom to hang towels and toiletry bags. Also, the strangest thing of all is - no wash cloths, and only 2 hand towels the whole time. Apparently it’s not common here, I would have packed my own wash cloths if I had known.  The check-in process was exceptionally smooth as we had a private one in the adults only reserve.
We did pop by the regularly check in desk with a question one day and their customer service could be improved—staff had trouble giving clear directions to restaurants and were not especially helpful over the phone when we tried to follow up on a missed call. However, once we settled in, the service throughout the resort more than made up for it. Dining was excellent overall, especially thanks to Wendy at Sarte and Celia at Mina, who went above and beyond to accommodate my severe dairy allergy with care and attention. While not every server was as knowledgeable about allergies, the food itself was outstanding across the property. We particularly loved the beef tacos at Kanna, the fried shrimp at Kicks, and the ribeye and popcorn shrimp at Sarte. The buffet also impressed us with fresh octopus, calamari, omelets, and fantastic burgers. I would caution though they have great little photos on the digital menus to indicate allergies you’re truly on your own to manage it.  One major disappointment, however, was the coffee—despite having a dedicated coffee bar on property, we struggled to find a truly good cup throughout our five-day stay. Given how strong the food scene was, the poor quality of the coffee stood out even more. On the bright side, the pools and landscaping were impeccably maintained every single day, creating a stunning and serene atmosphere. Emmanuel, our concierge, was thoughtful, patient, and incredibly helpful as we navigated the resort, but the true standout of our trip was Yuderi at the  beach. He was attentive, fast, funny, and always one step ahead, making sure we had comfortable Bali beds, fresh cocktails, and even surprised us with our favorite drinks after an afternoon swim. Thanks to people like Emmanuel and especially Yuderi, Paradisus Palma Real was a truly memorable and relaxing getaway.

reviews.author: Marcie Shaffer
reviews.text: Julia and Edison at the pool 36 degrees bar are awesome. Big shout out and many thanks.  The maid/mini bar service was hit or miss.  They didn't refill the coffee/creamer/beer/water unless we called. The food was excellent in both the restaurants and room. Unfortunately we woke up 3 mornings in a row with no air conditioning. Some days it was fixed in the afternoon and other days not till night. Overall it was a good, relaxing vacation and we will be back. We love how quiet and less crowded it is here.

reviews.author: Lara Carollo
reviews.text:
Rosanna Maria Yon was fantastic and we had the best service!

Flora was absolutely delicious, and the service was impeccable. They were very attentive and catered to dietary restrictions. Thank you to Franklin, Francesca and all the staff!

Also a huge thank you to Jonathan and Luis at the swim up pool bar! They took care of us all week and even played games with us! Such an awesome resort and had the best experience with great friends!

We also especially enjoyed the nightly entertainment but the silent disco was a favorite! Thank you all so much for the great memories!

reviews.author: Shayne Brizzard
reviews.text: This place is amazing! Angelo was amazing with beach side service! Overall staff was amazing. Beautiful views, great entertainment, and great rooms. Definitely recommend staying here. I will be back!

reviews.author: Mike Rlley
reviews.text: Jose and Julia are outstanding with their service! They were very attentive and were very kind to us.

reviews.author: Eryia Irving
reviews.text:
Jose Del Rosario y tairo bartender was very nice and personable. He ensured we were taken care of every day. If we ever needed anything he made sure to find a solution to our problems quickly. Jholfry and Fernando from activities team were also amazing! Very enthusiastic and fun! You can tell they truly enjoy what they do and care to make sure others are having a great time. Kelvin our butler through the reserve experience took great care of us as well. He was always a text away and took pride in delivering professional service. Overall a very clean and well kept resort!

Edited post: I made my original post before I left the resort and I just wanted to add in a few more names of the amazing staff I had the pleasure of meeting. So first off Gilberto and Yuderi at 96 degrees beach bar were such an amazing vibe! They will make sure you’re taken care of while you’re relaxing by the beach. Gustavo at Sante was so attentive and kind. We only requested to see him at breakfast due to his care and overall professionalism. And lastly Kelvin our Butler for the Reserve was pretty great as well. He took care of all our reservations and managed any questions/issues we ran into with urgency.

I didn’t get to talk about the food in my original post. But it wasn’t the best. There needs to be more food options throughout the day. The restaurants close too early and often times the food was served cold (specifically at Kanna). In the Lunch Box there was a server that had the worst attitude possible. He cooks the steaks and hamburgers.  He needs to be fired but he wasn’t wearing a name tag so I’m not sure who he was. The room service menu needs to be updated to include more options as well. If they get the food situation together the resort would legit be a 10/10 for location, beach access, staff, security (they don’t play around and they take pride in their job), and cleanliness.

This is not a party resort. It is more for relaxing. But you can get to downtown punta cana in about 15 minutes with a taxi for about $15-20 USD. Downtown has a decent nightlife and you can definitely have a good time. Overall I felt pretty safe and there was plenty of security around.

Last thing.. if you book the Reserve option (overall a nicer experience) it comes with a free excursion. It’s a boat ride to an island where you can do yoga with a professional instructor or just relax on the beach. They provide lunch and the option to go snorkeling. It is definitely worth it as it lasts about 3 hours.

reviews.author: Amy Milo
reviews.text:
I would give this place a thousand stars if I could. We stayed at a Paradisus in Mexico in March and had a fabulous time so we chose one in Punta Cana for this vacation in August and couldn't have been happier.  The rooms were fabulous and really clean. Food was great, and the staff was extremely friendly and accommodating.  The pools were huge and the perfect temp.  The drinks were strong and delicious. We upgraded to "reserve" when we got there. So private pools and restaurants as well as beach areas were ours for an additional $350 ish for a garden view. There were night time turn downs with chocolates on our pillows as well as our own concierge to book our dinners (which we didn't use much as we like to do things when the mood strikes) The resort was not very busy so reservations were not really necessary. And most of the time we were the only ones in the private pools. They did have some of the seaweed which I guess is pretty common now as we are polluting the oceans, but they were out every morning raking it up. We swam in the  ocean and had no issues with it, There were small clumps floating around but nothing terrible.
If you are looking for an affordable resort that has top notch amenities, this is it! Highly recommend!!!! (If you are traveling to the DR, do not forget to get your E ticket.  No one really tells you about it, but you must have it to board your flight from the US, and it is free. I used a site that charged $40 a person.  Don't make my mistake..go to a free site)

reviews.author: Deena F

reviews.author: HAJDIN HYSENAJ

reviews.author: Ana Assis
reviews.text:
Our experience at Paradisus Palma Real was truly exceptional from start to finish. Every detail from booking to check-out, was handled with professionalism and care, making our stay unforgettable for the entire family.

As loyal Circle by Meliá members since 2007, we are always impressed by the consistent excellence, personalized service, and warm hospitality that keep us coming back.

From the moment we arrived, check-in at the private lounge was smooth and welcoming. Our suite was immaculate, spacious, and beautifully maintained. Our concierge ensured every detail was taken care of, from special surprises to dinner reservations.

The staff is the heart of this resort. A few standout names:
•	Julia at Bar 36 Degrees provided incredible service with a warm smile.
•	The Entertainment team—Soranyi, Jairo, Jesus, Fernando Chipa, and Mr. AYAYAY—brought energy and joy daily. They were fantastic with our children and made us feel like family.
•	Soranyi and Joanna Santana at the Kids Club created a fun and nurturing space our child loved.
•	At Yhi Spa, Maria, Dorka, and Jaimy gave us the best treatments we’ve ever experienced.
•	Rosanna Hernandez, Osvaldo, and Junior Jose were always friendly and attentive.
•	At Blue Agave, Delvin, Melvin and bartender Salomón (maker of the best Paloma Cocktail) truly impressed.
•	Cocktails at Rum Republic with Juan Vicente was a highlight thanks to his professionalism and creativity.
•	We spent most days at the main pool bar, where Jonathan Rodriguez, Eddy De los Santos, Jorge Chan, Victor Feliz, and Luis Diaz brought fun, hospitality, and top-notch service.
•	Maria, Lucia, and both Luis bartenders at Bar Ginger also provided exceptional attention and care.

Paradisus Palma Real sets the standard for luxury, relaxation, and genuine hospitality. We’re so grateful for another perfect stay and can’t wait to return.

reviews.author: galit div
reviews.text: Absolutely amazing resort! The staff is incredibly friendly and attentive, especially Wellington, who refilled our minibar and snacks promptly with a warm smile. The rooms are spacious, new and well-maintained, the pools and beach are stunning, and the dining options are fantastic. The entire experience was relaxing and enjoyable—highly recommend!

Last but not least, great thanks to all the stuff there, and especially very grateful to the hotel for its customer service : Our initial arrival got delayed few days due to flight cancellation but hotel kindly accepted to extend our stay without any charges so we could enjoy 10 days initially planned, and for return as our flight were in the evening the hotel also generously permitted late check-out without any charges!
Many thanks, really highly appreciated that!!!

regards

Jason

reviews.text: From the moment I arrived at the Paradise Palma Real, It was like you came into a tropical paradise. I do want to throw a shout out to Angelo & Martin.  Those two make sure are staying at the beach was the best that it could be. Also, Christian or concierge was absolutely fantastic. A big thank you to him for making sure everything for our stay was taking care of from dinners to the beach or any thing we wanted at our rooms. I recommend this resort to anyone who’s looking for a beautiful, relaxing, enjoyable vacation. I will be back again next year if not before.

reviews.author: Johan González
reviews.text:
Flora Restaurant

Our experience at Flora Restaurant was truly exceptional. From the moment we arrived, we received a warm and friendly welcome from the staff, making us feel comfortable and well taken care of. The overall service was impeccable, but we would especially like to highlight the attention of Mr. César, who was our waiter. His professionalism, kindness, and attention to detail made our visit even more enjoyable.

As for the room, it simply exceeded our expectations. Not only is it spacious and elegant, but every detail has been carefully designed to provide comfort and luxury. Without a doubt, it is even better than one could imagine.

Furthermore, the service provided by the entire hotel team was excellent. We want to give special recognition to the front desk staff, who were always willing to help and ensured that our stay was unforgettable.

We highly recommend Flora Restaurant and the hotel to anyone looking for a high-quality experience with exceptional service and a welcoming atmosphere. We look forward to returning soon!

reviews.author: Rima O.
reviews.text: Amazing experience all around. Staff and amenities have been top notch. The kids especially enjoyed the kids club. We will be back

reviews.author: maurice Wright
reviews.text:
Just had dinner at Tokimeku from the a la carte menu. All good. The tuna and salmon sashimi were delicious!  Overall the meal was very satisfying and my family was happy with their choices. Jeison was a wonderful host!  Thank you.

Thanks also to Edito who has just been great in general. He seems to be everywhere and is always helpful and welcoming and has helped me practice my Spanish.

reviews.author: Tattoo Asylum
reviews.text: Blue Agave was a wonderful dining  experience for my 49th birthday.  From the moment we walked into the restaurant until we walked out.  We chose the family buffet style meal and everything was amazing. The plates came out perfectly prepared and perfectly timed. They made my birthday very special and it was delicious. What a wonderful experience! We would highly recommend!

reviews.author: Sophie Lee
reviews.text: Juan Guillermo, Circle by Melia, thank you for your exceptional service to me and my partner, you went above and beyond to make our holiday special, and we won’t forget you, one of the kindest people I’ve ever met, and I’m sure I will have the pleasure of seeing you again one day, we had the best time, and I put that down to you. reviews.author: Kaylie Vertichio
reviews.text: Jonathan and George were excellent bartenders!!! They were so nice and sweet and made sure we always had a drink in our hand! They even filled out yeti cups we bought!!! Made the pool such fun time!! Love them so much and will miss them!!!

reviews.author: Edwin Rodriguez
reviews.text: Amazing stay at The Reserve. Jensy, Miguel, y Ozuna at the Rum Republic bar are amazing, great service and drinks.

reviews.author: Landon
reviews.text:
Fanni, Cesar, Luz, Yahel, and Emmanuel were absolutely wonderful during our time in the Dominican Republic. From start to finish, they took incredible care of us, making sure we felt comfortable, supported, and welcomed throughout our stay. They were attentive, thoughtful, and went above and beyond to make sure everything we needed was taken care of — often before we even had to ask. Their kindness and professionalism made a real difference in our experience, and we are so grateful for everything they did. If you have the chance to work with any of them, you are truly in great hands. Thank you all again.

reviews.author: T B
reviews.text: We had an amazing experience at the Paradisus Palma Real resort, and one of the highlights was the incredible cocktails made by Maria and Miguel at Rum Republic. Every drink was perfectly balanced, creative, and served with a smile. They clearly have a passion for mixology and made our evenings at the bar something to look forward to. Not only were the drinks top-notch, but the friendly and welcoming attitude really elevated the whole experience. Cheers to great service

reviews.author: Yokarina Duarte
reviews.text:
The only aspect that fell short of expectations was the food. Considering the price, I anticipated a more diverse and higher-quality menu selection.

Overall out experience at this venue was outstanding. The facility was well-maintained, clean.

Andres at the front desk went above and beyond to assist us, ensuring that our dinner service was seamless. At the Flor Restaurant, Starlin and Cesar were exceptional, accommodating all of our food requests with professionalism and attentiveness.

Overall, the venue was top-notch, and the service team exceeded expectations.

reviews.author: Eli Hanania
reviews.text:

reviews.author: Melinda Chai

reviews.author: Eric Gorham
reviews.text:
This was our second trip to the Palma Real. We try and get away someplace warm the middle of January to celebrate my birthday. We stayed in the Reserve Section directly on the beach in building 8. In the 3 years between visits, the resort has undergone an extensive remodel that changed the pool areas. We were very fortunate to have the Reserve pool right outside our door. The staff was fantastic and so accommodating. The Reserve bars all had top shelf liquor and the cocktails were delicious. We had the opportunity to try all the restaurants and all were delightful, but do not miss out on Flora or Mina the steakhouse. Amazing apps, entrees and desserts!
The highlight of our stay though was our interaction with the server and bartender at the Reserve pool. Yeison, our poolside guy went out of our way to make sure the drinks stayed flowing and kept us constantly entertained. He was really great and a high point of the trip. Great kid and an amazing amount of hustle! Marcus, the bartender was also extremely entertaining and worked very hard to make sure our stay was the best. We shared many laughs when we took breaks from the sun in the tiki bar.
My wife and I have traveled most of the Caribbean and been to Mexico a dozen or so times. To call us jaded would be an understatement. We thoroughly rate this one of our top experiences and would highly recommend the Palma Real for the gorgeous grounds, the wonderful food and most importantly the gracious staff.

reviews.author: David Rosario

reviews.author: Jon McIver
reviews.text:
Our stay at Paradisus Palma Real was a delightful experience, largely thanks to our fantastic concierge, Emmanuel. From the moment we arrived, Emmanuel was attentive, friendly, and incredibly helpful in making our stay memorable.

The excursions were a highlight of our trip. We had an amazing time at Scape Park, where we explored natural wonders and enjoyed thrilling activities. The 3-hour catamaran trip was equally enjoyable, offering beautiful views and a relaxing atmosphere on the water.

While the breakfast and lunch options were satisfactory, the dinner restaurants truly stood out. The variety and quality of the meals in the evening were impressive, providing a wonderful culinary experience each night.

For families, there are plenty of activities to keep kids entertained. Our children had a great time with the various programs and events designed just for them.

The staff at Paradisus Palma Real were consistently nice and made us feel welcome throughout our stay. While the service was generally good, it did vary at times, but overall, we were pleased with the level of attention and care provided.

In summary, Paradisus Palma Real offers a wonderful vacation experience, especially with the help of a great concierge like Emmanuel, exciting excursions, delicious dinners, and enjoyable activities for kids. We look forward to returning in the future.

reviews.author: Shay Drori
reviews.text:
A Perfect Family Getaway – Especially for Kids!

We had an absolutely wonderful stay at this hotel, and I can confidently say it was one of the best family vacations we’ve ever had. The hotel itself is beautiful, well-maintained, and offers everything you could hope for in terms of comfort, dining, and relaxation. But what truly made our stay exceptional was the Kidsdom activities team.

From the moment we arrived, the Kidsdom staff went above and beyond to welcome our children with smiles, energy, and a genuine passion for what they do. The activities were creative, engaging, and perfectly tailored to different age groups. Every day our kids woke up excited to see what was in store—from crafts and games to music, dancing, and themed adventures. The team created a fun, safe, and nurturing environment that allowed us as parents to relax knowing our kids were not just entertained, but cared for.

A heartfelt thank you to the amazing Kidsdom team—you turned our trip into something truly special. We’re already looking forward to coming back!

reviews.author: Jessica Lynch
reviews.text: Me, my husband, and friends had a fantastic long weekend at the Paradisus Palma Real Gold & Spa Resort! Everyone was so attentive and kind. Cristian was our concierge and made everything so easy for us by making all our reservations for dinner and excursions. He consistently checked in on us to make sure we had what we needed and promptly answered  any questions we had. Miguel was our servicer for drinks at the pool and beach and was amazing as well! I highly recommend a stay here!

reviews.author: Jazz Dix
reviews.text: Yafreisy was an amazing waitress. We purposely went to her table every morning of our stay. She helped me with my Spanish and I helped her with her English. She was attentive, kind and so charming. My kids looked for her every morning. The omelettes and fresh fruit were our favorites!!! Paradisus is definitely a resort worth visiting over and over! Dinner at the Mina was amazing. Everything from starters to dessert was well made! Wander was attentive, kind, funny and a great waiter! The kids club staff was also amazing and fun!!

reviews.author: Cindy Rasines
reviews.text:
Our family vacation at Paradisus Palma Real was TERRIBLE extremely disappointing from the very beginning. We had booked a one-week stay, but we left after only three days due to multiple issues.

First, upon arrival, there was no staff available to assist us with our luggage. A large group had arrived before us, so we were left to carry our own bags, even though we had two small children (ages 2 and 5). This was unacceptable for a so-called luxury family resort.

The housekeeping service was another major failure. We checked in on Friday, and by Saturday at 3:30 p.m. our room still had not been cleaned. I specifically requested service since my 2-year-old uses diapers and the trash already smelled unpleasant from the previous day. No one came until 10:00 p.m., after I had to leave the trash bin outside the door and go to the lobby to complain. This level of neglect is completely inexcusable.

On Saturday morning, while having breakfast, we even found a small cockroach walking on our table — absolutely disgusting and unacceptable for any resort, let alone one that claims to be high-end.

To make matters worse, on Sunday night, while I was in the room with my children quietly watching TV, security knocked on our door to tell us that our baby had been crying and we were “making too much noise.” I was shocked, frustrated, and outraged. This is supposed to be a family resort — babies cry, and that is a normal part of family life. For security to harass us for this was humiliating and deeply upsetting.

This entire experience was uncomfortable, frustrating, and incredibly disappointing. I requested a refund because what was supposed to be a relaxing family vacation turned into a stressful nightmare. I will never return to this property and strongly advise families to reconsider before booking here.

reviews.text: Hope this review finds you and they don’t delete it.  When booking this resort I seen no negative reviews and it was a little sketchy. reviews.author: Ana Dossantos
reviews.text:
I recently had the pleasure of dining at Flora at the Paradisus Palma Real Golf & Spa Resort, and it was nothing short of an unforgettable experience. From the moment we walked in, the ambiance set the tone for an extraordinary evening. The space exuded an elegant yet relaxed atmosphere, perfectly complementing the flavors and authenticity of the food.

Flora's menu is a celebration of Dominican cuisine with a sophisticated, modern twist. Every dish we tried was not only flavorful but also a true representation of local ingredients and culinary traditions. The short rib was particularly outstanding—tender, perfectly braised, and full of deep, savory flavors. The dish was rich and comforting, yet refined, capturing the essence of island flavors with finesse.

reviews.text: Richard’s service at Mina Restaurant was outstanding. He was attentive, knowledgeable, and made us feel incredibly welcome. His recommendations were spot-on, and his friendly demeanor made the experience even more enjoyable.

We stayed two nights at Paradisus Palma Real and had the best time, especially at the 90 Degrees swim-up bar in the adults-only pool. We spent most of our day there and were lucky to be served by two amazing bartenders, Leticia and Greivin.

reviews.author: Camille Arnett
reviews.text: My mother and I have really enjoyed our stay at the Paradisus. Though our visit isn’t over I’m very happy with the service, accommodations, and overall environment. The resort is clean, quiet (moreso on weekdays), and absolutely beautiful. Pools and beach are lovely, staff is extremely friendly—I’ve had great experiences at several of the restaurants and at the spa. I’ve never been to an all-inclusive resort before but I’ve been on cruises and this resort has a lot of the appeal but also good structure so that you enjoy the day and time doesn’t just blur together. For instance, you have to reserve dinner spots at the restaurants (not to pay, just to ensure you have a spot), and while it might sound inconvenient, I find it quite nice to have something to structure your time around. Coffee is available all the time, same with alcohol. Tap water is not safe to drink so they have bottled water everywhere. Also, our room is much bigger than we expected, with a huge and deep balcony and a free standing tub. Watching the rain from the safety of the covered balcony was heavenly. A great escape overall.

reviews.author: Valentina Rosario
reviews.text: I had a great experience at Paradisus Palma Real. All the facilities from the pool, to the food, to the drinks, to the service were all top tier. Luis, Victor, Jonathan, and Eddy at the pool bar were a delight to be around. They were all so kind. Rosanna by the pool was always attentive, great personality, and a hard worker.

reviews.author: Danny Malouin
reviews.text:
Exceptional Stay at Meliá Paradisus Palma Real – Punta Cana

We just spent 10 days at the Meliá Paradisus Palma Real and it was incredible from start to finish.

Guillermo Joshua, our main concierge, was outstanding — warm, welcoming, and incredibly helpful. He guided us through our stay and even stepped in with medical assistance (I like to say he saved my life!). Truly the perfect host.

Jean made our transition into the Meliá Circle membership easy and exciting. We hadn’t planned on joining, but his insight and approach showed us the real value, and we’re glad we did.

Vanessa at the members pool and bar treated our family like royalty — attentive, genuine, and always with a smile.

The resort itself is beautiful: spotless grounds, fantastic rooms, and food that’s a solid 10/10 — the best buffet I’ve seen in over a decade.

We’ll definitely be back. Thank you to everyone who made this trip unforgettable!
Danny

reviews.author: Andrea Lorenzo
reviews.text: We had a lovely time at the Paradisus Palma Real in Punta Cana. We started off in the main adults-only hotel. When a series of things went wrong, we were moved to The Reserve - it was excellent after that. Great service and set up at the pool, lovely staff at Sante including Enrique, Rosa, and Gustavo, among others. I would recommend being at The Reserve.

reviews.author: Evie E
reviews.text: Friendly staff and great service. I recommend the asian restaurant Tokimeku. The cooking show was amazing, the cook Kendry was very entertaining and the food was delicious! The waitress Glenny and the supervisor Reynaldo were very attentive and made our experience even better. I had my birthday dinner here and they even brought out a cake for me.

reviews.author: Corydon
reviews.text: Melqui at Blue Agave was a fantastic server!  The resort is nice as well.

reviews.author: Dennis Koppen
reviews.text: You have a quality hire here. Arisleida was on top of our needs all through the day . A pleasure to be around.

reviews.author: Morgan Kenney
reviews.text: Yuderi & Martin provided wonderful service for us at the reserve beach and pool, and they always were so kind and had fun energy! I always felt cared for and enjoyed talking with them! Our concierge, Adriel, was so helpful with getting our dinners scheduled and was always a lot of fun to talk to. The staff set the tone of a fun and welcoming environment where you feel cared for receive excellent service. We went on a catamaran excursion with Fernando, who did every activity with us, including swimming and hanging out with us. I would come here again in a heartbeat!

reviews.author: Michael Gifford
reviews.text:
Went for 2 weeks to celebrate wife's 50th bday.  Couldn't of asked for a better trip.  The staff are extremely friendly and courteous.
Eriol our concierge went out of his way to make sure we had what we needed.  He also made our dinner reservations which was a plus.  Checked in daily to see how we were doing and loves his job.
The bartenders at all the Celcius bars are awesome.  They remember you and what you like and are always happy and dancing and having fun.
The food at every restaurant was outstanding with lots of choices.  Something for everyone.  Starting with the hostesses who were very sweet to our servers not one bad thing to say.
The grounds are immaculate and the beach is groomed constantly to keep seaweed away.
If you read any negative reviews take them with a grain of salt.  This place is the real deal.

reviews.author: Orest Melnyk
reviews.text:
Amazing Stay at Paradisus Palma Real!

We had a fantastic experience at Paradisus Palma Real. The stay was wonderful, with super-friendly staff who went above and beyond to make our trip memorable. The food was absolutely A+ delicious and full of variety!

One quick tip: Avoid drinking the tap water and be cautious with ice in your drinks. We heard about some guests feeling unwell, but we had no issues by being mindful.

Bring plenty of $5 bills for tipping it goes a long way in showing appreciation. That said, even if you don’t tip, the staff remains incredibly accommodating and kind.

For excursions, do your research beforehand. We did, and 2 out of the 3 we booked were a blast. Golfers, make sure to check the course conditions we found one we planned to play was underwater.

Overall, this is definitely a resort we’d love to return to. Hope this review helps you plan your trip. Paradisus Palma Real is absolutely worth putting on your radar!

reviews.author: Alex Reynolds
reviews.text:

reviews.text:
Absolutely wonderful resort to stay, no complaints whatsoever. Premium service, premium drinks and premium food!

The additional restaurants were great too, especially Mina steakhouse (server “Wander” and “Reynaldo”) were able to make our experience one to never forget!

Also two Bartenders at the Reserve beach bar, Pedro and Gilberto were the best thing about the resort. They made the drinks amazing and had a great time doing it!

reviews.author: Thor W
reviews.text:
Incredible vacation spot, best staff ever!  Everyone is just wonderfully friendly and helpful!  Our concierge for the week, Gustavo, provided absolutely impeccable service.  He coordinated our large group like seasoned professional and truly gave us a VIP experience.
Shout out to a few other special people who helped make the week wonderful.  Arisleida and Yefry who took care of us poolside, Robinson at the Spa, Luis boundless energy at lunch at Kanna, Maximo and Ismael outstanding dinner service.
The property itself is beautiful, rooms spacious and comfortable, food options endless and excellent, great activities and entertainment, but the service is what sets this place a level above, really wonderful people!

reviews.author: Norma Gadea
reviews.text: We had dinner tonight at Mascalzone restaurant at Paradisus Palma Real. The food was tasty and nicely presented; but the service was beyond excellent! Milton was constantly attentive to our table (and the restaurant was full). Ana and Jesus, our table attendants, provided us with excellent service and friendly attention.

reviews.author: Holly M
reviews.text: Travelled as a group of 4 Canadian women friends on a 4 night getaway at Paradisus Palma Real.  Our beach/ocean front suite in building 9 was out of this world (with great room service - a note and tip got answered every time!) Big, beautiful, clean & modern. The resort was so well laid out - everything felt close! Making dinner reservations was a bit challenging but we did get to try a few and enjoyed the Asian, Flora (Dominican) and Blue Agave (Mexican).  Nightly shows were entertaining and took place in the “street” in front of all the restaurants.   We all L O V E D the Ginger cafe and Bar. Special shout out to Anthony for making our mornings brighter with the most perfect speciality coffees! We started and ended every day at Ginger! At the main pool Arisleida was our girl! Find her - tip her well and enjoy her beautiful smile and positivity! She hands down is credited with enhancing our experience everyday.  Lastly the buffet -  it was filled with so many options for everyone on our trip including gluten and dairy free.  Georgie was also eager to brighten our mornings at the buffet and hook us up with mimosas.  The beach was pristine! Overall the property is lovely and they have some incredibly special people providing exceptional service.  I would recommend to anyone to give this place a try! Would absolutely return.

The best trip and service we ever had
Rosanna was the best server ever please give there a raise everyday she went above and beyond for us from breakfast lunch and the pool and beach service was nothing but amazing

reviews.text:
We overall had a good stay. I think staying Christmas week, they weren’t prepared for all the people. We were not able to get reservations at some of the restaurants even though we gave two days notice. My parents stayed at the adults only with a concierge and were treated with more priority. Us having two kids, we were not provided that option.

We really appreciated the Kidsdom. They took great care of my children and were open 10am-10pm. The flexibility of dropping them whenever was excellent and I could not rave about this more. Jesus and Alexandria there made the experience for my kids excellent.

Overall, I am unsure if we would return. I got food poisoning the last day. The rest of the family was fortunately okay.

reviews.text:

reviews.text: Celsius pool staff has been outstanding! From the staff (shout out to Arisledia, Louise and Rosanna) they went above and beyond to make our experience top notch. She made us feel like family and we will miss her very much.

reviews.author: Gregory Carpenter
reviews.text:
I am leaving my original posting below the line for reference. We had a few individuals who made our stay substantially better; it is my hope that Melia management can read this and know these individuals were a substantial reason we had a positive experience. First was Betzi. He was great at helping solve some of the restaurant reservation struggles we had on our visit. Though the technology issues we encountered persisted, he at least got us in front of the Customer Service Manager and we at least we felt heard.

The second individual was Yuderqui (aka Judy). Judy waited on us at the buffet a number of times and really should be a walking icon of customer service. Our first interaction, she pushed me to practice my Spanish and was equally interested in expanding her English skills. It feels odd to say, but we felt cared for and safe with Judy. Multiple times we saw people having conversations with her and found many of us had a great fondness of her way of interacting with us. Others in this area were similar, in my experience Judy was just above and beyond. Generally I do not like many people (it is just a me thing), but I found myself having some tears over saying goodbye.

I still feel the restaurant reservation system and technology needs fixed; however this was definitely a top vacation for us. I raised this to a four star review from three really because the employees we interacted with the most went above and beyond to make our visit better. Judy and Betzi stand out by name, but there are others from the bartenders to other staff at the buffet who work hard not only to get the job done, but make you feel a touch special.
_______________
I am really struggling with this review. We generally love the resort. Our room (5016) and pool access is fantastic! The cleanliness and staff attentiveness is generally fantastic as well. However we have had smaller issues that are compounding and leaving a sour taste with two days left in our trip.

The first is the technology which is poor on a number of fronts. A couple examples, the app on my phone recognizes we are checked in and reflects the room number, however will not allow access to any menus or application capabilities while onsite. I just keep getting popup errors. So my wife tried to order room service via a phone in the room, and the people on the other end neither knew where we were calling from nor could recognize where we were located when we told them. This is not a deal breaker, but frustrating at best and so room service has been unusable for us.

The bigger challenge we have had is that restaurant reservations seem impossible to make. People seem to figure it out, but we have gotten the runaround since arriving on Tuesday. We finally had reservations last night with a reservation card; however when the card was issued they listed the wrong room number (5106 instead of 5016) and since it did not match our actual room number they would not let us in. The buffet is fine, but we spent about $4000 for five nights and have only the buffet to show for it.

This morning I hit a breaking point when seated in a corner at the buffet. I finally grabbed my daughter and just relocated ourselves to a better table with a view. It stinks being a jerk, but I feel a bit stepped on and used in the dining situation for the amount of money spent on this trip. The buffet wait staff are good and this doesn't reflect on them. They tried to make it right, I just feel pushed around a bit and they received the brunt of the restaurant reservation system. The individuals taking reservations have been unhelpful and unempathetic to the situation. There is definitely a service shortfall in this area.

Without fixing those basics I can't see recommending the Paradisus Palma Real. As a luxury resort, those are not issues guests should experience. I will update this after our trip, but as of right now am not as happy as I expect at the price point.
