reviews.author: Soheil Maroufi
reviews.text:
We stayed at Paradisus Palma Real from July 26–31 with our small dog. While the hotel grounds were beautiful and the restaurant staff were friendly and professional, our overall experience was disappointing due to poor communication and rude behavior from management.

The website clearly states that bringing a dog costs $120 USD per night and includes services like food, treats, and bowls. Despite staff seeing our dog from day one, no one mentioned the charge or services until day 3, when I was suddenly asked to pay the full amount. I paid in full, but we still didn’t receive any of the promised services.

When I spoke to the supervisor (Rafelin), he was extremely rude, accused me of hiding the dog (which was clearly untrue), and dismissed our complaint by saying, “At least your dog drank water here.” We only received pet services for the last two nights, even though we paid for five.

Thankfully, the restaurant and cleaning staff helped make up for the frustration, and the buffet food was excellent.

⸻

Dear [Hotel Management / Guest Services],

I am writing to express my deep dissatisfaction with the pet services provided during my recent stay at your hotel.

I was charged for six nights for bringing my dog, yet I only received pet services for two days. This is extremely disappointing and unacceptable. I believe your team should be aware that your guests travel from all around the world to stay at your hotel, and in most other countries, customer service and client satisfaction are treated with much more care and professionalism.

Whenever I travel with my family, I always make sure to choose hotels that are pet-friendly. Unfortunately, my experience at your property was the worst I’ve ever had in terms of pet accommodation and service.

I had truly hoped to recommend your hotel chain to my friends, clients, and business partners in Canada, the United States, and Iran, but after this experience, I am certain that I will no longer do so.

I kindly ask you to review this matter seriously and take appropriate action. At the very least, I believe a partial refund for the unused pet services would be fair.

reviews.author: premier0731
reviews.text: Loved this vacation! Staff was amazing and accommodating. Room was clean and always stocked. Live entertainment most nights with bands, violinists, and singers. The Ginger Bar is amazing and Antonio makes the best milkshakes. Front desk staff was very helpful and patient. I would definitely recommend this resort and plan on returning next year.

reviews.author: John Zamora
reviews.text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Exceptional Service at Blue Agave – Thanks to Melqui!

During our stay at the Paradisus Palma Real, we had the pleasure of dining at Blue Agave, and our experience was made truly memorable thanks to our server, Melqui. From the moment we were seated, Melqui went above and beyond to ensure everything was perfect.

He was warm, attentive, and genuinely cared about making our evening special. He took the time to explain the menu, offered thoughtful recommendations, and anticipated our needs before we even had to ask. His friendly personality and professionalism stood out, making us feel both welcomed and well taken care of.

The food at Blue Agave was delicious, but what really made the evening shine was the service. Melqui’s attention to detail, kindness, and hospitality turned a wonderful meal into one of the highlights of our trip.

We are so grateful to him for making our night so enjoyable, and we highly recommend asking for Melqui if you have the chance to dine at Blue Agave. He truly represents the best of Paradisus Palma Real’s service and hospitality.

reviews.author: TROY JOHNSON
reviews.text: Altagrcia Jimenez was wonderful at providing exceptional service and treated us like family. Strongly suggest stopping by Kicks at Paradisus Real.

reviews.author: Meagan Harrington
reviews.text: We stayed at Paradisus in March 2025. We stayed in the master swim up suite which was beautifully updated and maintained. Having the swim out room was an amazing feature and made our vacation with a child that much better! My six year old daughter really enjoyed attending the kids club. Lisbeth, Sharlena, and Jesus greeted her with the biggest smiles and made her feel so welcome. They had fun activities each day, like pool games, cupcake decorating, cookie decorating, and colouring. After the first day, they remembered her name and greeted her by name any time they saw us in the hotel. It made her feel very welcome and special. She looked forward to attending activities each day and I always felt like she was safe and in good care with them. Thank you to the wonderful staff for making our vacation extra memorable :)

reviews.author: Cesar Daniel Acosta
reviews.text:
Review of Flora Restaurant
My wife and I recently had the pleasure of dining at Flora, and our experience was nothing short of exceptional thanks to our server, Andrea Santana. From the moment we were seated, Andrea's warm and welcoming demeanor made us feel right at home.
Andrea's expertise truly shone as she guided us through the menu, offering insightful recommendations and highlighting the delectable local dishes. Her passion for the cuisine was contagious, and her descriptions made our mouths water in anticipation.
Throughout the evening, Andrea provided impeccable service, attending to our every need with a smile. She effortlessly switched between languages to ensure both my wife and I felt comfortable and understood. Her attentiveness and genuine desire to please were evident in every interaction.
Andrea's over-the-top friendly service elevated our dining experience to new heights. She went above and beyond to ensure we had a memorable evening, offering personalized recommendations and sharing fascinating insights about the local culture.
We wholeheartedly recommend Flora to anyone seeking an unforgettable culinary adventure. Be sure to ask for Andrea Santana – her exceptional service and infectious enthusiasm will undoubtedly make your dining experience truly special.
Rating: 5 stars

reviews.author: Andy Sohl
reviews.text: We stayed at Paradisus Palma Real in January 2025.    We were overly impressed.  We stayed in the Ocean Front room in the reserve side.   The room was modern and clean.   The resort provided a variety of food and all dinner services were great.   We had no complaints on the quality.   We also had our own concierge service.   Zenovia communicated with us daily and set up reservations and anything else we would ask for     She was a pleasant addition to our trip.  Our favorite part of the trip by far was our beach service.   The guys were amazing.  Huge thanks to Rafael who had 4 beach beds made up daily, cold drinks and a pleasure to be around.     We would definitely visit again

reviews.text: Love this place experience 10/10 staff 10/10 and food to die for ! Rosanna was a sweetheart and so helpful !

reviews.text: We had an awesome vacation at Paradisus Palma Real in Punta Cana. Enrique was an excellent host dining at the Kanna restaurant.  Love the vibes, music, atmosphere and hospitality during our stay. Very pleasant vacation!!!

reviews.author: Michael Katz
reviews.text: Wonderful trip. Yaleidi was very helpful and booked all of our dinners and kept us informed every day about hotel activities. Beautiful and clean property. All of our dinners were excellent

reviews.author: Craig Ticchi
reviews.text: Alberto was the best bartender in the resort! He took care of my entire family for a whole week, waited on us and was very courteous and accommodating. 10/10.

reviews.author: Erica Jarrell
reviews.text:
Great value! Book now! You won’t regret it.

Went on a moms trip from Canada February 3rd to February 9th. When booking, treat yourself and spend the extra money for The Reserve experience. Our concierge, ‘Rom’ (short form name) was very personable and attentive. He went out of his way to ensure we had a great experience.

The receptionists at The Reserve check in could have been more knowledgeable. We were on the adults only side but they were circling rooms on the family side. There was a-lot of confusion. We are sure all the kinks will be worked out as they get more training. Also, being offered a welcome cocktail (instead of helping yourself) after a long travel day would enhance the experience.

Beach: steps away from the resort. Plenty of chairs and the comfiest beach beds which are included in The Reserve package. Martin always made sure our beach beds were set up with towels. Great service! Constructive feedback for hotel management would be: ensure the beach area around the chairs and beds is clean. I found myself picking up wrappers, bottle caps, etc. We don’t want that stuff to find its way to the ocean! The beach staff could have been a little more attentive with the cleanliness. A lot of drink cups and empty bottles were left laying around all day. A fresh beach rake around the area might be beneficial to the experience as well.

Nightly Activites: there’s so much to do but we spent each night having a cocktail before dinner at the ginger bar and Rum Republica. Miguel at Rum Republica was a cocktail master! He was always so welcoming and happy to see guests. The female bartender at Ginger was also amazing. We didn’t get her name but she was always smiling and welcoming.

Wanda and ALL the bartenders at Kick Sports Bar were so wonderful. So attentive and excellent at ensuring guests stayed hydrated. The DJ was so much fun! He took requests from all guests and ensured he played them all!

The nightly activity guys were so good at their jobs! They made sure to get guests up and interacting with the live music. They made the live music so much more enjoyable!

The gym was very well equipped and well air conditioned.

Rooms were modern and always clean.
The hotel itself is very clean and up-to date.

Overall, the food and staff were excellent and really enhanced our experience! So “Thank You”/ “Mucho Gracias” to all of them!!

We had the best vacation and can’t wait to stay at this hotel chain again! Our next stop may be the Paradisus in Cuba or Mexico!

reviews.author: Liz Rutter
reviews.text: The setting is beautiful but that's where it ends.  We are here for a wedding and the treatment we're receiving is incredibly poor. The concierge is a joke.  Tipped him as soon as we met have not heard from him once.  Since this is an all inclusive they're trying to make you as cheap as possible, they force you to eat at the truly disgusting buffet by saying there are no dinner reservations. Ever.  To get one dinner reservation at a restaurant I needed to l the BRIDE to schedule it,  unacceptable.  Blue Agave food was good,  drinks were not.  Room service is fine.  Gilberto at the pool bar is a delight. The rooms are tired, we have several more days here and if we game prepaid I would be looking for different accommodations for after the wedding.  We will not return.

reviews.author: Cameron McFarlane
reviews.text: Had a great experience at Paradisus Palma. The beach day was incredibly relaxing and the service was top tier. I’ve traveled to other islands and other all-inclusives but this was on another level. Find Angelo if you can!

reviews.author: Jack Martin
reviews.text: Mina Steak house and my waiter Antonio took very good care of me.

reviews.author: Chris Nuzzi
reviews.text:
My wife and I visited this resort with our 18-month old for a long weekend. Overall we were extremely pleased with our stay however we did come away with a few qualms.

What we enjoyed...
The resort itself is beautiful and the beach is equally fantastic. They take great care of the beach to ensure there's no trash and there was plenty of seating available. We stayed in a swim-up suit. The room was spacious, updated, and great positioning and access to the pool. There was pool service for drinks, but they didn't come around very often. The food was tasty and lots of options available at the buffet. The staff were also super friendly and went out of their way to accommodate us in every way possible.

What we didn't like...
- Our child eats lunch at 11:30, no restaurants were open at that point to serve lunch so we ended up having to order room service. The food was good, but it was a little disappointing that we couldn't eat at the buffet.
- The reservation system for on-site restaurants is limited and not accurate. It's very hard to get reservations for specific times. For example, we got a reservation to the mexican restaurant for 7:30pm when we wanted one for 6pm (again that's when our child has to eat before going to bed). We were told to just take the reservation and we could show up early to the restaurant and they could get us in. We showed up and there were only 3 other parties in the restaurant. They did seat us, but there were tons of empty tables, so we're not sure why they didn't have any reservations for the initial timeslot we wanted.
- When at the beach, no one came around to ask us for drinks. It seemed like it was only for Circle members. We also couldn't find a close place to get extra towels. Overall it was an inconvenience, but not a deal breaker.

reviews.author: Ana Murillo
reviews.text:
We had dinner at Mina while in Punta Cana. Service was amazing, Judy was very helpful and made our visit enjoyable. Will definitely be back!

Jose at the Bar 90, swim up bar, was excellent and took very good care of us while we were here!! It’s nice when they remember the drink you want!  Ask for Jose Hernandez, you won’t be disappointed!  Also, Rosanna, Maria, Luciana and Lenny.

reviews.author: Claudia Penalba, MD
reviews.text:
I loved the ambiance,  decorations and the service. The food was excellent. The appetizers were delicious and the main dish portions werw large and delicious as well.
I loved the dancing clases with Jairo, Jholfry, and Fernando,  they are so much fun. It is a must  to do!!!
The Dominican night was unforgettable!

reviews.author: Maritza Maldonado
reviews.text: The staff at the Ginger Bar in the lobby was amazing! They were all so helpful & fast. They took good care of our group. Highly recommend this resort but make sure you stop at the bar! Shout out to Ismael, Antonio, Dominga, Maria, Cfranchesca & Clary - they were a true delight!

reviews.author: Yessenia Franco
reviews.text: The service has been attentive and the rooms are beautiful. The food can be improved. The activities staff have been the best! Jholfry, Fernando and Jairo have made our vacation super fun and made sure we stayed active.

reviews.author: John Arceneaux
reviews.text: The beach staff at Paradisus Palma Real Resort were truly exceptional, and Raul, in particular, went above and beyond to ensure our experience was memorable. From the moment we arrived, Raul greeted us with a warm smile and helped us get settled by the beach. His attentiveness to our needs throughout the day made a huge difference—whether it was  delivering drinks, or offering great recommendations for local activities. Raul’s professionalism and friendly attitude created a welcoming atmosphere that made us feel like valued guests. The entire beach team was friendly, efficient, and always ready to assist, but Raul’s personal touch really stood out. If you’re staying at Palma Real Resort, make sure to ask for Raul—he’ll ensure you have the best beach experience possible!

reviews.author: Carly Krumholz
reviews.text: Love this resort!  Tokimeku was one of my favorite restaurants and Chef Julian and Frank were the best and so accommodating to all of the various allergies and requests.  This is my 3rd time and will definitely be back !

reviews.author: cassie waggoner
reviews.text: Currently staying here -By far the worst experience for a vacation ever. The entire resort is under construction, no main pool, no shops, no casino. None of this was told when booking.3 restaurants closed including The main restaurant for the reserve area we booked, also closed. Not allowed to swim in beach( I realize this isn’t their fault) but there is nothing to do. Our concierge can’t even bring us ice or water for days. Wasted 4 grand to be woken up by hammering at 7am and sit at a pool and beg for ice. Will never return here,highly suggest booking anywhere else in PC

reviews.author: Linda Moran
reviews.text: A Ivelicce and Rocio were very attentive and helpful. Great service!👍🏻

reviews.author: Jose Valldejuli
reviews.text: Went to Sante, Enrique and Misael were amazing. Got there late from the flight getting delayed. He helped us out and made our first night of the Honeymoon unforgettable. Great service awesome food.

reviews.author: Fern T.
reviews.text:
We returned a few days ago and had a fabulous stay at The Paradisus.
We were on the adults only side but not The Reserve.
The overall experience was excellent despite a few hiccups. One being the room was not exactly ready for us, as the mini fridge was not fully stocked when we checked in. The safe was left in the locked position but left open by the previous guest. Not knowing their code, it required service to be reset. Lastly, the hair dryer was broken and needed replacing. These are items that a routine check would have picked up on.
That said, all else was pretty much spot on.
The buffets were filled with many great options. I was surprised to find 2 whole salmon being carved upon demand for lunch.
Breakfast selections were usual egg stations plus other good options including some local foods like mangu. A plantain based dish. That was a nice find. Fruit was plentiful too. Yogurt, cereal also.
The restaurants...
The steak restaurant was excellent. The Dominican restaurant was as well. We hit it 2x. The Asian Fusion left a little to be desired. The meal was a bit over done. The show put on by the chef was the highlight there.
We didn't go to the Italian unfortunately.
The Brisas restaurant was not available to us.
The hospitality of the staff was top shelf. They all work hard and their aim is to make their guest happy. What's more is that they would go out of their way to make things right or to help you If needed.
The private pool (adult side) was fantastic. Plenty of chairs under umbrellas. No towel game. We did not use the Reserve pool. It was not available to us.
The beach was well kept and chairs under shade were plentiful during our stay. They have a berm to keep large amounts of seaweed off the beach. We did not see much at all.
The family side pool offered activities available to all.
The nightly shows are on a smaller scale but very entertaining.
If your looking for top shelf alcohol mixed drinks, you won't find that here. Perhaps if you paid extra for it. We are not big drinkers.
Yes the drinks might be a little watered down, like many all inclusives, but all were still good.
The resort layout is well done and we'll kept. It's a beautiful place.
It's not a large resort so there's not as much walking as some of the larger places.
The rooms on the adults side had an updated feel. Spacious and the bed was firm and comfortable.
I could say more...
I will simply say that we would return to The Paradisus.

reviews.author: Lorena Gentile
reviews.text: Yafreisy soler y yeison  The service was excellent. They were fantastic. Love them to death.

reviews.author: VANESSA CRUZ
reviews.text: Raul provided exceptional service that made our stay truly memorable. From the moment we arrived, he treated us like royalty, ensuring we felt special and welcomed. Remarkably, he remembered each of our drink preferences and always had our glasses filled before we even needed to ask. His attentiveness and willingness to assist us with anything we needed truly set him apart. Thank you, Raul, for turning our vacation into a such a memorable experience.

reviews.author: bipneet kaur
reviews.text: Santo Ávila made our trip very memorable. He was a great host and made vegetarian food for us in his restaurant BlueAgave.

reviews.author: michelle watterlund
reviews.text:
Angelo at the reserve Fahrenheit pool bar was so kind, accommodating, and attentive… as well singing and helping all the people around him enjoy their experience!
This side of the resort is good a quieter experience, which is much needed sometimes for couples!

reviews.author: Maria Banks
reviews.text: I’m currently staying at this hotel and unfortunately this has been the worst experience I’ve had at a hotel. The thing is, there’s been a series of events that have made me feel impresioned instead of relaxed. From rude employees, rooms with smelly sheets, leaks in the hallways, lack of entertainment, and the epitome of it all was that they didn’t allow me to make a reservation for the restaurants and told me to deal with it. Yes I did try talking to management about this experience yet I’m still waiting for response. Definitely a NO go!!

reviews.author: Lula Garner
reviews.text: Maira anna service was very good.  She was excellent! I would definitely recommend!

reviews.author: Lady Matos
reviews.text: Rosana and Yanira give you the best service in the hotel. They are awesome!!!

reviews.author: Food For Thought
reviews.text:
Everything at our stay in July was very nice. The resort, the food, the rooms and the service. Our only complaint was the beach
As beautiful as it is it Not a private beach for the resort. It’s a public beach. Meaning locals who are not staying at the beach have access to it. This we found to be very, very annoying. As soon as we got on the beach the first day we were hounded constantly to buy things, to have foot massages and to have hair braids put in
Even just have locals begging for money
I’d thought maybe the resort would try to do something about it but said they couldn’t. Anyway with that said we won’t be back since we can’t tolerate the public beach

reviews.author: Nicolas Lupo
reviews.text: If you plan at staying at Paradisus Palma Real, then I highly recommend looking for Luis the pool bartender, and Ariselda the pool server. These two employees know what quality service is like. They are highly attentive, friendly, and great people overall. Their service reflects perfection and exceeds expectations of professionalism.

reviews.author: Doris Mclean
reviews.text: Great location and beach. Beautiful hotel and we enjoyed the beautiful weather

reviews.author: Brian Shehaj
reviews.text: My experience at the flora restaurant was fantastic.  Very friendly employer in special santos Avila and juan alcantara  the supervisors. We receive the best lobster. I recomend this place.

reviews.author: Michelle Adames
reviews.text: I started my day either Ginger bar with there delicious coffee. A beautiful hotel from top to bottom highly recommend. Ismael, Antonio, Jorge, Clari, Olga. Such a pleasant staff!

reviews.author: Grace Gan
reviews.text: Very good hotel, close to the beach. Restaurant Kanna has very perfect!

reviews.author: Richard Jordan
reviews.text:
Restaurant Mina was our choice for dinner tonight, it was amazing ! Kelvin our waiter did a fantastic job and helped us through the menu. He brought the table a welcome drink that was truly unbelievable. Sandro the manager stopped by to greet us and talk for a bit as well. You can tell that the customer experience is paramount.
#Minaswasamazing

We returned back to Amelia and Rosanna Hernandez and Jessica were there to greet us as they took really good care of us the last trip. Their service is very good and we are soo happy to see them again.
#Rosanna

We had dinner at the winery and Juan and Maximo did a really great job pairing the wine with dinner. The food was amazing and we had such a great time.
#juanandmaximo

reviews.author: Lisa Berardi
reviews.text: This Hotel is beautiful 😍 and very accommodating.  Food is very good. Great rooms!

reviews.author: Bruce Cary
reviews.text: Milton, Ana and Felix at Mascalzone son excellente.  The Putanaesc was Philly-quality, and the service was outstanding.

reviews.author: Andrea Bernstein
reviews.text: The resort was beautiful and the service was fabulous especially from Alberto and Marileisy at the Reserve pool bar. Our concierge Basilio helped with all our dinner reservations and was so friendly and helpful. Thanks to all the staff at Paridisius Palma Real for making this a trip we won’t forget!

reviews.author: G Kar
reviews.text: Resort was great. The highlight for me was the prestine beach ( you can tell they pay to have it cleaned daily and also to make sure squatters don’t sit on hotel chairs). The restaurants were also great. Blue Agave was fantastic! Great service and great food.

reviews.author: Rita T
reviews.text:
We stayed here January 15 for a week and it's a beautiful place.
Maria Ortiz at the buffet was a fabulous server, she was attentive   smiles all the time and very welcoming.
Check in at front desk was fast and Louise and the young lady  sorry forgot her name. Were fantastic. The cleaning staff and refreshment restocking staff were amazing.
The food was delicious every day.
Jose Remirez took good care of us at check out time and made sure to get us on our transport bus with baggage he took wonderful care of us when leaving.
The only thing that needs to be changed is the way you book for restaurant reservations,  that was a mess with long line ups and can only book current day and next day.
Also the gentleman that was booking us for reservations on the Thursday morning midway in conversation started talking to a Spanish speaking woman who was already dealing with someone else and ignored us That was the only thing that was a disappointment 😞
We will definitely be back.

reviews.author: Ottilie Hunt
reviews.text: Everything was perfect and the service was exceptional! Especially Arrisleida, she was the best!

reviews.author: Lesley Lopez
reviews.text: Miguel was an incredible bartender! He took great care of us at Kicks Sports Bar at the Paradisius Palma Real Punta Cana… both in the afternoon and evening before dinner. His drink-making skills are top-notch—he crafted the most fabulous gin basil martini for us, and it was absolutely delicious. We highly recommend Miguel and his amazing cocktails! Five stars all the way!

reviews.author: Dina Dudarova
reviews.text:
We had an amazing experience!
Everything was up to the highest standards!
I also really recommend you to visit Rum Republic bar.
Miguel - bartender is a real artist and provides a superb service ! Try their rum fashioned. You won’t regret it!!!!

reviews.author: Carrie DeJohn
reviews.text: We had a Great time here! The staff is amazing!! The scenery is great! Would definitely come back.  The Kidsdom was great for our 5 yr old son Jackson.  They had activities everyday and at night. They treated our family so well!  Ms Joanna and her team is fantastic!!

reviews.author: Andrew Sargeant
reviews.text: If you are black or not white, I would not recommend staying at this five-star resort. Yes, the hotel looks appealing, but when it comes to customer service, the staff does not seem to prioritize assistance for anyone who is not white. While dining, I have noticed the staff going out of their way to cater to white guests who do not tip them, whereas black guests, despite tipping, have had to flag down staff just to get their attention. I have also observed that none of the white guests left tips, yet the staff continues to go above and beyond for them. This behavior is difficult to understand.

reviews.author: Violette de Bartillat
reviews.text:
Loving our stay.

The premises are beautiful, apartment very roomy and most of the staff super helpful.
Special thanks to the Kidsdom caregivers, Joanna, Alexandra and Jesus who went above and beyond to create a fun experience for our 3 kids. I’ll add we have a wide spread of needs from 18months to 8 y/o and 12 y/o.

Each of them found very engaging activities from painting to soccer, pool, pajama party and more..

Food was much better than most all inclusive restaurants we have been to.

reviews.author: Albin Sadiku
reviews.text:
Italian restaurant
The Supervisor Milton was an really friendly and courteous Person who told us about new things on the Menu which was Delicious so a big thanks to the Chef Tojelin Cueva who made us the best food we had in the 2 weeks we stayed here!
Also our Waiter was really friendly and always looked if we needed something!

Thanks for this Incredible Experience!

reviews.author: Brittany K
reviews.text: An absolutely gorgeous location with friendly, kind staff. Everything was wonderful. Louis at the pool bar was so great! Ismael at the coffee bar was so kind and creative. Eriol was fantastic making all our requests come true and helping us make the most of our time at Paradisus Palma!

reviews.author: Mike Kohn
reviews.text:
The service was very poor, the food was average at best to poor. Room service is an absolute mess they would either take forever or not answer (suppose to be 24hrs)

There are people trying to sell you stuff non stop, some of which are employees of the resort feigning friendly conversation  to upsell you excursions while you’re trying to eat breakfast.

I booked two rooms I was told would be adjoining they were next to each other but not adjoining. There is a bit of a language barrier, some employees spoke English fairly well and some seemed to not understand a single thing I said and would need to ask another employee. They’re all nice but this makes even simple things like ordering coffee a pain at times.

There are other things but I think I made my point. Would not recommend and def not coming back.

reviews.author: Paynes
reviews.text: The resort is just beautiful! The staff was so warm and welcoming, the food was really good and it just had a great vibe all around. The musicians that would play at night were spectacular as well. My wife and I had a great time!

reviews.author: Aravind Kalivaradhan
reviews.text: We visited Paradisus during the week of Thanksgiving. We had an excellent stay, and found really good service at their restaurants. Kicks was top notch. Every time we visited the Sports bar, Luis and his crew of Jose, Fior brought in that human touch that exemplified their dedication to making the experience for us first rate. They went out of their way to make it special. On one of the days, all the speciality restaurants were booked out and we didn't want the buffet food. But Luis and his team waited on us in a manner that made us wonder why we hadn't come earlier. Thank you Kicks team. Keep up your terrific work.

reviews.author: elisa risini
reviews.text:
We had the absolute best time — not just because of the beautiful location and the amazing resort, but mostly because of the incredible staff who took such great care of us and made us feel completely at home.

My family and I want to give a big thank you to a few special people who really made our stay unforgettable. For us, true luxury is all about how people make you feel, and this team went above and beyond.

First, a huge shoutout to Fernando Chiva — thank you for your energy, your positivity, and all the thoughtful little details that made such a difference. To Eddy at the main pool bar — thanks for making the best Cocoloco and for always being such a great person to chat with in the mornings. And to the two awesome guys at the winery — we could have talked with you for hours about wine and local Dominican traditions. Your great wine recommendations and warm conversation made every visit something we looked forward to.

And of course, thank you to everyone else who greeted us with a smile and made us feel the warmth and kindness of the Dominican Republic.

We’re already looking forward to coming back!

reviews.author: Julie Gerbrandt
reviews.text:
Rooms:
Once we got our originally reserved room it was amazing! We had 2 days that we had to stay in a different room but the front desk manager Carlos was very accommodating and tried to make up for us not having the correct room. Once we got into our swim-up room it was by far the best place I’ve stayed and made up for us staying in another room for the first 2 days. They do need to get the check-in figured out so this doesn’t happen.
Dining/entertainment: kicks sports bar had a few amazing staff. Juan and Anthony always took care of us and made amazing drinks. Anthony just kept making special drinks without us even asking. The food was quite good! And manager Luis Rosario made sure to have our favorite hockey game on when we wanted it.
Blue agave:
Melvin made our dining experience more than satisfactory. My son found that he didn’t like any of the menu options so he brought him the most amazing steak instead! Went above and beyond! Probably our best waiter so far!!
In Between Bar:
Jose was such a fantastic bartender. Made the best Paloma by far!
Mazcalzone:
Yensen was a wonderful waiter and met all of our needs to make our dining experience enjoyable!
34 Degrees:
Our bartender Julia… amazing! She is always there making sure we’re happy. Such a friendly girl and I am so happy she’s taking care of us every day. Such a hard worker!

reviews.author: H
reviews.text:
Would not recommend this resort.

Pros: Beautiful location. Look at the photos for how surreal the location and architecture is. The facilities are aesthetically beautiful.

There’s always some sort of entertainment in the square of the resort every night - eg acrobats, bands, DJ, etc. Pretty chill. And it changes daily.

Cons:
1) When we first arrived, we were told to leave our luggage at the entrance to the lobby for it to be taken to our room…It was never taken to our room. We waited in the room for hours until the evening and still our baggage hadn’t arrived despite contacting the concierge regarding such and being told someone will be by to drop the bags. We had to go and get our bags that were sitting where we left them. Because at a certain point we really just wanted to change clothes.
2) There aren’t many activities offered. Would have been nice to have more options offered. Some of the activities like the sports or dancing - no other guest tended to show up for which is not the resorts fault. But when we were there for one of the activities, the activities coordinator indicated they were leaving to get something and would be back (they never came back). Also ensure to get to activities somewhat on time because they can run out of materials. There are activities like painting certain objects which they can run out of said object. Spa is good but very expensive.
3) The safe and the room phone were not working. Someone came to try to fix the safe but not the room phone. The safe still had issues but was usable. Would recommend ordering breakfast room service the day before. It was nice sitting on the balcony and eating in the morning. But ended up having to order the food through the concierge since the phone to call room service didn’t work. Also had to ask the concierge for the room service menu since the QR code in the room that we were told was the menu didn’t include breakfast options.
4) Restaurants are not great. There are only about 2 places open for breakfast and lunch while there are more options for dinner. You do need to make reservations for dinner or else you cannot dine there. It was difficult to make a reservation prior to getting to the resort but if you do contact them you should be able to. There is a limited number of reservations but some places can be closed so either way you may not get the place you want to dine. Just give the resort a few options of the places you would want to dine at. Anyway, the food was ehhh. Not great. Not amazing. Mediocre. And most guests we spoke to had the same sentiment. If you are a foodie, would 100% say do not come here. Go to a resort in Mexico or somewhere else because this is not the place for you. Hibachi didn’t have much of a show (there wasn’t any egg juggling, no volcano onion fun, etc), the food was mostly cooked with some sort of sauce that made it all taste the same (sauce was not great tasting).  Steak house was somewhat better than the other places we went but still not amazing. Would recommend the ice cream - it was pretty good. Would recommend the lunch box as a slightly better lunch spot. Be mindful that some places don’t allow you to eat at the restaurant in swim suits so bring a coverup/other clothes unless you want to go back to the room following swimming.
5) Can get drinks by the pool. You can ask for a coconut to drink coconut water out of. But drinks like Coke tasted off and flat despite coming straight from the bottle and the bottle wasn’t expired. They do have a premixed pina colada which was ehh not amazing.

6) There is a casino and sauna that you are allowed to access but it’s at a different property “nearby” which you need to ask the front desk to have a golf cart take you over there. We did not try to check it out.

The sun was baking us for most of the day. Make sure to wear lots of sun screen.

If you have someone in your party who speaks Spanish, that’s ideal. Most staff knew at least a small amount of English but with most it was difficult to communicate without someone who can speak Spanish in the party.

reviews.author: MaryEllen Miller
reviews.text: Just returning from an amazing week at the Paradisus Palma Real-   We stayed in the Reserve section.    Beautiful grounds, fabulous food,  gorgeous beach.    Staff was amazing.   Arisledia, Jeison, Rafael and Pedro at the Reserve beach were the best!  Jose and the staff in the sport bar were excellent.    And we had a banquet while there and Jose went above and beyond to accommodate!    The staff truly made our trip so enjoyable!   Thanks for a great week!

reviews.author: Alex Egelson
reviews.text: Food poisoning twice in four days - food was terrible.  Front desk and concierge employees were extremely unhelpful, dismissive and unprofessional, both with our family and other guests before / after us.  On the other hand, the bellhops and third-party tour employees were terrific and tried their best to help.  Location was beautiful and room was very clean and comfortable, but the food and front desk / concierge staff ruined the trip for us.

reviews.author: Michael Viens
reviews.text:
Thank you for Yuderi and Christopher for all the services that we have.

Beautiful beach, hotel and service. 5 stars !

reviews.author: Frederick “Fred” Mertz
reviews.text: Awesome experience at the resort. The best service and the friendliest servers on the reserve beach. Raphael, Angelo, Gilberto, and Our concierge Franklyn were among the most professional and friendly resort staff we have had the pleasure of meeting. Fun crew…a visit here is a must

reviews.author: Costas Lopez
reviews.text: First time at the Paradisus and I was left impressed - we traveled here to celebrate my sister in law's wedding. The accommodations the staff had for our party and our family was above and beyond. The staff is super friendly and always provide amazing service with a smile and treat you like family. I'm going to miss starting my mornings with the delicious strong cups of coffee Maria Superville and Dominga make at the ginger bar.

reviews.author: Kayla Calvert
reviews.text:
For our first night we could not have asked for more from the Italian restaurant.

We had 3 adults and 3 children. The food was delicious, the service was outstanding.

Milton was kind and helpful when it came to handling a gluten allergy and the kitchen made sure the food was safe.

Fausto made sure we were all well taken care of.

Overall great experience!

reviews.author: Javier Mercado
reviews.text: Melqui was amazing server, great smile, attentive, informative and beyond. Great food, great staff. Thank you Melqui you deserve 5 stars.

reviews.author: Laurina D'Appollonio
reviews.text: All and all this is the best resort I have ever stayed at. Excellent staff, service, rooms, and food were all fantastic. The buffet was GREAT! Our waitresses, Rosanna and Yamira were so kind and awesome. everything was a 10/10! Starlin from Flora restaurant was also fantastic!

reviews.author: Steve Gorczyk
reviews.text: Had a wonderful 9 day stay at this amazing resort! Lots of food options and the buffet had so much to choose from. Adults only section had 3 pools to them selves, one with a swim up bar. Over all just a great time thanks to our concierge Kelvin who made sure we had reservations every night.

reviews.author: Sabrena Jinks
reviews.text: Our experience at the Winery was extremely extraordinary. Jonathan, Ismael & Maximo made it an absolute amazing time. The Winery is stocked with not only the finest of wines the education of the products is priceless. The meal was tasty to say the least. Thank for making this a memorable experience for our family. Sabrena

reviews.author: Caitlin Rowan
reviews.text:
GINGER BAR is a must! They make the best Espresso Martini's on the property! It's how we started every night out! Luis, Nathanael, and Luis Desa are incredibly attentive and make you feel so welcome. By the last night,  he didn't even asked what we wanted.. the Espresso Martini just Appeared! Thank you for your amazing customer service.
Also head to the Japanese Restaurant and go see Miguel, he made a specialty cocktail.. as I'm a whiskey Ginger drinker and couldn't find ginger ale anywhere on the property! This drink made my whole trip

reviews.author: Rebecca Stephens
reviews.text:
Consistently pressurised to write a review with team members looking over your shoulder whilst you completed. Unsurprising there are so many 5 star reviews when it forms part of competition winning…
We have a lot of feedback on this resort where we found the service to be quite poor overall but a longer review will take time

reviews.author: Kaydee Ali
reviews.text: Shout out to Basilio who did a great job ensuring all our Al la carte were booked timely.  He also met up with us everyday to ensure we were fine.   The resort is well maintained.  Rooms were nicely cleaned everyday.   Stayed in the Reserve section which was a 10 out of 10.  Beach was very nice.

reviews.author: Mike Reeves
reviews.text: Was greeted with open arms and kindness as the concierge tagged our bags and walked us to check in. Since check in is at 2pm we went to restaurant and sat for about an hour to eat lunch. Our concierge contacted us and we sinked on what’s app to make it easier to communicate. Our room was ready and we walked to building 3 and climbed 3 flights of stairs. I don’t mind stairs but I really don’t want to climb 3 flights up and down every time I leave my room. Which come to find out they use this technique to sell you upgrades. As I requested something on a lower floor. It became available for an upgraded fee. An additional $1200.00 for the week.  We finally heard from our concierge and we have to spend one night in our 3rd story room with stairs. To be moved across the courtyard to a room with an elevator. The elusive 1st floor room is still being used as an upgrade. Stay tuned till tomorrow as I will update on the elusive 1st floor room.

reviews.author: Yameen Rashid.
reviews.text:
Just returned from our family vacation. Positives: The rooms were updated and clean. The beach was beautiful with plenty of chairs for everyone. The pools were fun for our kids. The massages at the spa were amazing.
Negatives: service was poor. We were pretty much ignored our whole trip. We were told a personal concierge would meet us and check in with us. We never met any personal concierge. Nobody to help us book restaurants we had to figure it out as the days went on. Staff wasn’t happy friendly or helpful. When we asked people for something at the restaurant we were ignored a lot of workers pretended not to understand us and pointed to other people “go ask them instead”. Also food was not great. Breakfast and lunch were not good. Dinner options were better. Also no privacy for the bathrooms just a curtain.

reviews.author: Doug
reviews.text:
Jason & Teofloi are great bartenders at the Adult Only swim pool!!! They always were pleasant and were up for making any drinks we asked them!!! Made our stay excellent!!!!! Gracias!!!

The beach bartenders were great as well!!! Always very helpful and made drinks that kept us hydrated and enjoying our beach time!! Enjoyed our days in the sun!!!

reviews.author: Andrew
reviews.text: Raimon Rivas was an excellent host at the beach. He took such good care of us on our anniversary trip to DR in January 2024, that we came back in 2025 to the same spot. We’ll be back again - he and the whole staff at Palma are the best!

reviews.author: Michael Platte
reviews.text: Fun place with excellent service.  The staff is extremely friendly and accommodating.  They have a great beach with plenty of cabanas and beach chairs.  Rafael and Yuderi make sure you have a prime cabana and that you me glass is never empty.  Our concierge, Gustavo was extremely responsive and helpful.  This is a great place to relax and enjoy the DR.

reviews.author: Brooke Bruhn
reviews.text: We stayed in the Reserve, went to the beach reserve and Martin was fantastic! Every morning heading down to the beach, he made sure we had an amazing view of the ocean and had the drinks coming!  I would definitely ask for Martin when at the Reserve Beach! Irvin was our concierge, he was also just as amazing! Super relaxing hotel, nightly entertainment that was relaxed and fun!

reviews.author: Aaron Lewis
reviews.text: The Blue Agave Restaurant was fantastic. The service was marvelous. Santo, Delvin and Alvaro made the trip so enjoyable and memorable. They went out of their way to ensure that the evening was an anniversary to remember. We can’t wait to return. The best service I’ve ever had. We felt so pampered and surrounded by beautiful loving energy.

reviews.author: mojo beets
reviews.text: Excellent Hotel! Stayed in the Presidential Suite on the Reserve side. the room was amazing, our concierges Yinesca & Zenovia were the best, friendly and out going made us feel like family, always checking on us to see if there was anything they could do. The beach attendants at the reserve Yuderi & Martin were great everyday setting up our day beds with towels & a bucket of drinks. Yuderi brought us fresh coconut daily was great. They both checked on us through out the day. The restaurants were great . Ordered room service for breakfast was fantastic. Had a fun time with the Mixologist who came to our room "sorry forgot his name".lol. All the staff we encountered were very friendly. Can't wait to come back.

reviews.author: Luis
reviews.text: Great customer service and food with Luis at Kicks Bar

reviews.author: Ava Mackrill
reviews.text: our stay at paradisus palma in the dominican was AMAZING! it all started with our wonderful friend & travel agent choosing the perfect place for us to spend our honeymoon. we felt so taken care of through this resort’s luxurious accommodations and special extra touches & gifts on top of being an all-inclusive! our concierge made our stay & experience feel so personal, and she was so kind and quick to help with any questions or requests we had. if you stay here, ask for yaleidi to be your concierge! :) she was amazing and elevated our experience as a couple overall. we are leaving feeling so rested and well-fed with the wonderful dining and drink options they had to offer. such a beautiful resort from corner to corner! ❤️

reviews.author: T Moi
reviews.text: well appointed hotel within a very large complex. Staff is very friendly and helpful during our stay.

reviews.author: Michelle Herrera
reviews.text: Dining at Flora in Paradisus Palma Real was an unforgettable experience, thanks to the exceptional service from our server, Cesar. From the moment we arrived, he was warm, attentive, and incredibly knowledgeable, offering perfect recommendations. His genuine enthusiasm and ability to anticipate our needs made the meal even more enjoyable. The restaurant’s beautiful ambiance and delicious cuisine were enhanced by Cesar’s outstanding hospitality. If you visit Flora, be sure to ask for Cesar—he truly made our night special!

reviews.author: Ariana Torres
reviews.text: I had the pleasure of meeting Fernando Chipa during the rum tasting and painting activities at the hotel, and he truly made the experience. Fernando is incredibly , welcoming, and brings such a genuine, positive energy to everything he does. His wonderful personality made everyone feel comfortable and included, and you can tell he really enjoys connecting with guests

reviews.author: Lynn Matson
reviews.text: It was a lot of fun thank you to yorgelys, Ivelise y Rocio we will be back

reviews.author: James Baker
reviews.text: Rosanna, Julia and Jose made our time at the pool fun and always hydrated!

reviews.author: Adeline Edgal
reviews.text:
Exceptional service, friendly staff, awesome experience overall!!!  Would recommend this holiday to anyone and looking forward to the return visit

Kudos to the staff of Ginger Signature bar: Antonio, Angie, Dominga, Clari and Roysa for their 5 star service and who made my stay absolutely memorable!!!

reviews.author: Kapsool Seo
reviews.text: Definitely a language barrier but your room concierge people are great!! The resort is perfect.

reviews.author: Alex Rogers
reviews.text: Our stay was amazing at Palma Real. From start to finish we were treated quickly & respectfully. Our concierge Kelvin was super helpful & was well balanced on checking in periodically & letting us enjoy our time. The entire place was very clean & well maintained. We weren’t huge fans of the food except for Blue Agave. The Winery was a very nice experience though (special thanks to Jhonathan)! Highly recommend this place to anyone thinking of just enjoying their time without worrying about anything!

reviews.author: Darya Khodadoust
reviews.text:
We are currently on our last day at Palma Real and we have had the best time here! From the people, to the food, and the overall atmosphere it has been nothing but great. We spent most of our time at the main pool. We had a fantastic pool server Teofilo at the Celsius Bar and Grill who always made sure we were comfortable and ready for another drink. He was truly amazing and made our stay fantastic!

Our concierge Ariel was amazing with always making sure we knew the activities for the day and making every dinner reservation for us.

Overall, I recommend this resort! We are so sad to be leaving. It truly is an amazing and relaxing resort!

reviews.author: Dee Mills
reviews.text: We had a fabulous stay! The rooms were beautiful & well laid out! Ariel Benzo was our concierge for the week! He was amazing! He answered any questions we had promptly and  was very helpful with anything we needed! Fior at Kicks the sports bar looked after us exceptionally well every night! She was friendly, and quick and made our week there memorable!! There were a few hick ups but we were a group of 50 arriving and joining 10 that were already there for a wedding! But the wedding ceremony and reception was beautifully done! Will definitely be back!

reviews.author: Joe McGowan
reviews.text: We had a wonderful 4 nights stay. Martin served as our beach concierge and he was always accommodating. I highly recommend this resort

reviews.author: George Maldonado
reviews.text: Jose and julia and arisleyda the best service in the Palma real and they need to be seen everyday you are here to have the best experience of your life

reviews.author: Laila Rocha
reviews.text:
We loved our stay at this beautiful resort and had a great experience with the concierge services from Mr. Errol Ali’s, who made our stay much more pleasant. It was my aunts 60th birthday and he spoiled her with surprise cake, balloons, room decorations. He also helped us arrange and book any experience and services we needed.
It was awesome!
Thank you!

reviews.author: Julie Hay
reviews.text:
What a beautiful place! The spa was heaven, the pools immaculate, and the rooms very comfortable!
Cristian made sure we had everything we needed through our entire stay and even planned a special celebration for our anniversary.
I only wish we had been able to stay longer.  We'll be back soon!

reviews.author: Eli Barnes
reviews.text:
First night at resort and we meet jose del Rosario at.sports bar, he hooked us up with fantastic food and service. He never left our drinks empty and gave us ideas on the best drinks.
On the Beach Angelo would take care of our drinks and always there to help with finding a spot on the beach.

reviews.author: Dragonball Grigoiran
reviews.text: Amazing service, room was great with the staff being very friendly and nice. The kicks bar had amazing service with me and my cousin going everyday to eat the burgers and Banana  splits. Overall Jose and Luis were very friendly and amazing to us. I would give this place 5 stars.

reviews.author: Stephen Zurek
reviews.text: Julio and Edickson were absolutely amazing and provided exceptional service.  They made sure that we always had we need.   They came by throughout the day and refreshed our drinks!  I highly recommend them thank you for the excellent service

reviews.author: David Gallo
reviews.text:
A Truly Unforgettable Experience!

Paradisos Palma Real is nothing short of spectacular. I visited with my two boys, and from the moment we arrived, everything exceeded expectations. The resort itself is stunning, with incredible facilities, breathtaking views, and one of the most beautiful beaches in the world.

The dining experience here is phenomenal—every meal was amazing, and the variety of cuisine was impressive. The bars are equally outstanding, offering top-shelf liquor without hesitation. Nothing is held back from making your experience first-class all the way.

A special shoutout to Adriana at the Gin Ger Bar—she makes the best espresso martini I’ve ever had, and I’ve tried them all over Manhattan! If you visit, do yourself a favor and stop by to see her. You won’t be disappointed.

This resort delivers on every level, and I highly recommend it to anyone looking for an all-inclusive getaway.

reviews.author: Kristle Hetzler
reviews.text: Wonderful, peaceful and everyone was so nice and helpful. Rosanna was very efficient and helpful. So pleasant to be around.

reviews.author: Chad Dye
reviews.text: We started at the Paradisus Playa Real with my family (wife and 2 infants) and we really enjoyed the updated decor and the recent renovations.  Melvin was great at getting us acclimated into our room. We had to switch rooms a few times and he helped make it right.  Luis was our top server and without a doubt waited on us hand and foot to give us the best service possible.  He made our stay top notch and helped us enjoy our first family vacation in the Caribbean. Juan Carlos was a true gentleman and great to accommodate us during our stay with any issues we had.  Highly recommend staying at this resort.

reviews.author: Michelle Oppong
reviews.text: Ramon Rivas gave us amazing service. He was very attentive and made sure we were always equipped with everything we needed. Very friendly and helpful. Thanks for making our stay welcome! Marta from the activities department was also helpful in keeping us informed

reviews.author: corey mable
reviews.text: Mina was a great restaurant. Junior and Raider were great. Highly recommend

reviews.author: Pamela T.
reviews.text: Eliaania is the absolute best! She has excellent customer service and is extremely personable! She specializes in cocktails, but she does a wonderful in every area that she serves! Check her out at the Kicks Bar + Grill at the resort!

reviews.author: Camille R
reviews.text: The food and drinks were average. Blue Agave was the best place. The alcoholic drinks were very watered down and if you don’t drink alcohol, just stick to the soft drinks. Everyone was very pleasant but if you needed anything it took years for them to follow through with the request. Our personal “concierge” was nonexistent until he wanted us to sit through a timeshare so that he could get $100. When we said no, he disappeared again. Overall the people are pleasant as we’ve been to the DR before and I can communicate with the locals, but this hotel is definitely NOT a 5 star in any category.

reviews.author: F R
reviews.text: This review is about the “Reserve” adults only beach.  It was amazing!  Martin was our go-to guy.  He was awesome! He got our drinks right and right away :) he even had our spots (daybeds) reserved for us.  Excellent service.  The beach is clean and the water is a beautiful green and the drinks keep coming. We will come back!!

reviews.author: Alex Zielsdorf
reviews.text: Resort is very clean, lots of places to relax and enjoy your trip. Staff is very friendly and helpful, with any questions or problems you have. During our stay there were numerous people who helped make it more enjoyable. One being, Arisleida. She was extremely helpful, and knew exactly what drinks we enjoyed. She would always seek to find us and would remember the things we enjoyed. Overall a very good trip, would definitely return.

reviews.author: Shekab L
reviews.text:
Came to Blue Agave and it was a great time with great food and super kind staff (especially Santos). Highly recommend!

Also wanted to acknowledge the amazing service and hospitality from Mr. Juan. An absolute gentleman who from day one treated me and my wife like family and made us both feel welcome everytime we visited the restaurant. Any and all restaurants would all be better off with someone like Juan working on their team. Thank you, Juan!

reviews.author: Jianna Loyola
reviews.text: Mr AYAYAYA was the best, super interactive and respectful, he knows how to make sure you have fun and a good time. Melasa also took very good care of us and both were super sweet. Will be coming back.

reviews.author: Angel D
reviews.text: We stayed at the Paradisus Palma Real this past week and had a wonderful time. The grounds, property and rooms are beautiful and the restaurants had pretty decent food, but I think the buffet could have been a bit better, especially for breakfast. The service, however, was excellent, and it was the staff that really made it a 5-star experience for us. Cristian was our concierge and he was extremely helpful with setting up the hard to get dinner reservations and making sure we had what we needed. Ely was very helpful as well, and was always willing to step in when needed. But my favorite person of the entire stay was my new friend Elidania, who was so kind and sweet and treated us like family. She made excellent mimosas and cocktails, and even let us sample her own special mamajuana recipe! If I could do it again, I would upgrade to the Reserve- adults only area to take advantage of those amenities and exclusive restaurants, but all in all it was a really great time!

reviews.author: Isaac Reyesmejia
reviews.text: Flora is an excellent restaurant. Dismaillin our host and Stefanie our server were outstanding. They were attentive and extremely professional. They made sure our entire food experience was above and beyond our own expectations. 10 out of 10 on everything from presentation, taste to originality. I would come back and try more options of their wonderful menu.

reviews.author: Beverly De La Cruz
reviews.text:
César and Raider at the flora restaurant gave us amazing service❤️
The food at the flora restaurant is delicious. Authentic Dominican food.
We were so in love with the food that we changed our reservation on our last day to come back to Flora❤️❤️.

reviews.author: Danielle Shargorodsky
reviews.text: My kids went to kidsdom everyday and every day the workers were so kind and nice I would like to shout Jesus and Joanna and yesica and yesmeily for always being so nice! All the crafts were so fun and overall they had a great time!  Jesus and the staff are awesome.  My daughter really enjoyed making bracelets and kwychains.

reviews.author: Damien Druce
reviews.text: Marileisy and Teófilo at the Palma Real Reserve Pool were so attentive whilst we were there. All done with a smile on their faces, look for these two beautiful human beings if you visit.

reviews.author: Virginia Spaulding
reviews.text: Juan Castillo is the best concierge person ever and Angelo Richiez was outstanding in service to us, looking out for our every comfort. We have had so many wonderful experiences at Paradisus Palma Real which we thought were greatly because of the amazing staff and customer service. Immaculate grounds, rooms, beach area… We highly recommend!

reviews.author: Jessica Picon
reviews.text: My family and I stayed at the Paradisus Palma Real Golf & Spa Resort in Punta Cana, but our experience was overshadowed by several frustrating issues, particularly with check-in, concierge service, and communication. We were told we could check in early, but our room was not ready upon arrival. Despite being assured it would be ready within an hour with a promised upgrade, we were given a smaller room than what I reserved. This led to a frustrating process of room changes. The second room only had one king bed, unsuitable for our family of four. The third room was spacious and met our needs, but it wasn’t immediately available. After waiting over two hours, I had to escalate to the manager before finally receiving the correct room at 5:00 PM—hours after we arrived, wasting much of our first day. Our assigned concierge, Jose, also caused multiple issues. He failed to secure dinner reservations twice, leaving us embarrassed at the restaurants. Later, Antonio replaced him, and the service improved. Unfortunately, when Jose was reassigned, the quality of service declined again. Daily minibar restocking, which was supposed to be standard, never occurred despite repeated requests. Our room also lacked an iron or ironing board upon arrival, and it took over a day and multiple complaints to receive one. On a positive note, the food was delicious, and the restaurant and beach staff were friendly and welcoming. The grounds were beautiful and well-maintained. However, the poor organization and communication overshadowed these positives. The resort has potential but needs significant improvements in service to provide a more seamless experience.

reviews.author: Kristina khol
reviews.text:
2nd time here unfortunately my last.
Few years back I stayed as a reserve member
This time I had my reservation pre booked for me and was just at the adults only section without any reserve upgrades . Upon checkin we asked what kind of room it was I mentioned I’m here on holiday with my father .
My room was not cleaned daily till 3 pm. On first night I showed the lady the bed came without a blanket to please bring one .
I called and asked for a blanket 3 times and never got one.
The arrangement of the rooms is very unusual. There is a see through curtain with minimal to no privacy to change or while using the shower /bathroom . The see through Curtain  leaves you no privacy to change with another person in the same room accept for the tiny toilet . The shower doors are clear again no privacy . I had to hang a towel off the shower door.the coffee machine did not work.
The light stand beside the mini bar was standing for props the plug didn’t even fit into the wall socket. Strange thing to have knowing it doesn’t fit there .

They used to have a very nice spa maybe it’s on the reserve side not sure . Now the yihi spa is a hut it’s just a space for massage that they up charge $200 .

The food was a bust!
Every restaurant we went to was worse than the the last.  The sushi at Asian was terrible.
Italian was a complete fail. Served us spaghetti with clams minus the clams .
The buffet was very good . We should have stuck to that one for dinner  . We had buffet for breakfast and lunch and everything was pretty good. Not sure why the restaurants were not. The service at the restaurants was good . Same for the buffet . Water plenty of it . And the snack bar was a nice touch in the room .

The night time was weak and boring. 3 nights in a row they had some sort of meticore band playing in the lobby . Put me to sleep that I couldn’t stand to see if anything else was going on past 9:30.
Some entertainment or show would have been good but they had nothing going on.
At the beach we layed out under the umbrella had a nice relaxing time
The second day we walked out a bit and found a much more comfortable bed with mattress padding just 2 feet over from where we were yesterday. I had 3 people come to attack us that my bracelet was not Reserve and I couldn’t be there . I get the reserve privileges but did i really need the attitude to tell me to move off the mattress padded lounge chair because my bracelt was of the different color.  I paid to be on that beach too.
Anyway not sure if I lost out by not getting reserve or they just added on stupid perks for reserve members I certainly didn’t appreciate and would not come back just to get a comfier lounge chair.
Otherwise the place is beautiful has a lot of changes since I’ve been there first time . WiFi works well. Totally lacks evening entertainment.

reviews.author: Justin Pearce
reviews.text: Rooms were very nice and clean! Pool service is excellent and the beach is beautiful. We especially loved stopping by Rum Republic for drinks before and after dinner. All of their drinks are delicious and Miguel does a great job as bartender/mixologist

reviews.author: Puja Joshi
reviews.text: Yafreisy is very helpful and service has been really good. Always attending to us

reviews.author: Lindsey Liese
reviews.text:
Overall would highly recommend this resort. The service overall is outstanding with a couple of call outs- Rosanna and Yanira specifically who helped with breakfast and lunch, and would even get a high chair ready for us when they saw us coming. Just overall really lovely people who provided great service and made our toddler (and us) feel special. We also got to know our pool bartender and the server on the beach, whose name I don't recall but will update if remember.

The food is good, but not excellent, which seems standard for all inclusives. I like that the buffet was changed up everyday for breakfast and lunch, with a few staples that remained each day, but enough for variety. Dinner was nice, though it is a bit of a hassle for reservations, though I understand why we need them. We were eating later than we would have liked with a toddler. The Ginger bar had live music many nights which was really fun, there were always a lot of events going on which I liked.

Overall, amenities and rooms were very nice with some weird logistical things (that did not at all ruin the experience, but could be better): 1) the rooms were nice but only had one trash can. Our room had two separate bathroom type areas with a kitchen, so one trash can was an odd choice. We could have used more than one. 2) not enough shower hooks in the bathroom areas. I am someone who is happy to reuse my towel to help the environment, but it was hard when there aren't enough hooks. 3) the blackout curtains don't trail the ground, so it got light early in the room. We ended up using the "hanger hook" trick to help with that, but it was still brighter than I would have liked early on. As someone light sensitive, I wish I would have brought an eye mask. But overall, I recognize those are nit picky things and overall the rooms are very lovely. Everything is kept very clean.

My only other thing is that the towel stations are spread out and it would be nice if there were more towel stations.

But recognize those are small things that could only make a great resort even greater.

reviews.author: Shainelle LadyNell
reviews.text:
Rafael and Pedro were amazing, they set up our cabanas everyday, remember the drinks we like and even remembered us by name. The service was superb and outstanding!! Rafael went above to and beyond to make us feel catered to and relaxed. Pedro made awesome drinks and they were very friendly and bubbly!! If you stay at this resort, please ask for these people and they will make everything worth your while!

Our staying was nothing short of amazing, Jordania helped us while lounged around the property. She was very friendly and funny  while we relaxed. Would definitely come here again with this friendly staff!

Lewis was our personal concierge and we loved how he made everything seamless for us! He was available 24/7 LITERALLY! He was very prompt responding and catering to our every need. Lewis was polite, patient and sweet. We don’t know what we would have done without him, down to making our dinner reservations, excursions or just answering any questions. Without a doubt when we come back here, we will request for Lewis every time!!

reviews.author: Eunice E. Lee
reviews.text: The resort was great, especially Ramon who took care of us on the beach every day during our one week stay. He helped with chairs, towels, food and drink and kept us well fed and hydrated, always with his friendly manner. Ramon really made our stay extra special!

reviews.author: Stephany Kmeid
reviews.text:
Dismailin, Fransheska and Starling were fantastic! They provided us with amazing service and they were so kind.
Restaurant Flora had great food; i recommend the fish and seafood for their freshness and great seasoning.
We went there twice within a week since we wanted to try different meals.
Would greatly recommend for anyone looking to try authentic dominican food.
Special thank you to Miguel who took care of us all week and made sure we were enjoying our stay - we will miss him the most

reviews.author: Yoko Sharman
reviews.text: My husband and I ate at Mina, the stake restaurant. The meats were well prepared and cooked. They were very tasty and we enjoyed them very much. Our waiter, Olvi, was very nice. You do need a reservation but I highly recommend this place.

reviews.author: Jaime Herveckt
reviews.text: Great Service, The hotel Is Amazing I was here for one week with my family. The people from Dominican Republic make me happy the service at 32°. Excellent Marileisy she es Wonderful

reviews.author: Trina Barua
reviews.text:
We were a family of 17 and stayed in an all inclusive resort with the best experiences. One of the best restaurant was Mescalzone with great service and excellent food. All of the family member got a chance to try almost everything in their menu. Every dish was very tasty combined with their drinks.
Because we were a large group, they have accommodated a private room with private services with prompt service. A huge shout out to Milton, Ricky, Jonathan and Cirilo.
Thank you for making our trip very memorable!!

reviews.author: ari
reviews.text: Wanda Rafael Martín and Cristopher were sooooo amazing . Grateful to have been with such an amazing staff . Such an amazing time . Full of life !! This was a great stay . Beautiful beaches , hotels , and people ! Thank you for such An amazing time

reviews.author: Kristen Moore
reviews.text:
Mascalzone

Milton was absolutely marvelous. He made our overall experience at Paradisus Palma Real Golf and Spa. He made such wonderful efforts for us and very kind. His recommendations were perfect!
The most professional and personable concierge.

Raider was our waiter at the Italian restaurant  and very good also.
The food was excellent! The best restaurant on the property.

reviews.author: Jenny
reviews.text:
Flora restaurant at Palma Real was amazing!
Great high-quality food, good wine selection and adults only.  Our waiter, Ceasar, was professional and attentive.
Couldn’t find a better place to have a fabulous dinner.

reviews.author: S.Bevilacqua
reviews.text:
Excellent Resort! There atmosphere, restaurants and service is top notch!!

The jente of Punta Cana e incredible'!  Nothing they can't accommodate for you here! They service you with your personal guide who assists you with your daily activities and plans. Angelo was the best! He made dinner reservations for us and got anything we requested done within minutes. Can't ask for more.

We'll be back!!!!

reviews.author: Denise Delarosa
reviews.text: Most of the food us just ok but the 3 places that serve latin food are spectacular. Big shout out to Melqui from Blue Agave for keeping the drinks flowing.  Jennifer, Reynoso and Maria from Malva and everyone at Flora (hands down the best restaurant at Palma Real.)

reviews.author: Lauren Benson
reviews.text: Has been an amazing vacation here at the Paradisus Palma Real! The cleanliness, and friendliness of staff is unmatched.  Rosanna, Julie, Yeison at the pool areas were so attentive and kind. Jesus and Charlina at the Kid Zone were fantastic. My kids took right to them which they don’t to everyone. Zenovia our concierge I can’t say enough about. She cares so much and puts lots of work into making sure we’re having a wonderful vacation.  I highly recommend this resort for families. All the food is wonderful. Different restaurants to choose from!

reviews.author: Shani-Li Madore
reviews.text: It’s my third time coming at this resort and it is amazing! We are staying at a swim up room and the service is great! Our concierge Francisco is amazing! Yeison and Teófilo are excellent bartenders. There’s also Miguel who makes amazing drinks at the steakhouse Mina. Also, if you are staying on the reserve you should go to the restaurant Sante. They have amazing servers, especially Juan, and the food is very good. They all have great costumer service! Would recommend!

reviews.author: Stephanie Henry
reviews.text: You will love Rafel for beach side drinks! He's the best! ♥️♥️♥️

reviews.author: Henry Hernandez
reviews.text:
Sante… came to the restaurant expecting something good based that is is prt of the reserve.

What a surprise, food was amazing and the service of Enrique and Misael was top of the experience, Enrique knew exactly what to recommend to us for our meals, wine selection was great, and desert was just perfect.

Highly recommended if you want to have a nice dinner with sea breeze and fantastic food.

Go for the shrimp entree you will thanks me later!!! 😊

reviews.author: Aida Cuevas
reviews.text:
Simply amazing!!! We just had a wonderful time Palm Real; here are just few of the callouts:

1) Henry our Concierge was wonderful.  Made our stay so special.  Everything from ensuring we got reservations for Dinner, assisting us with selecting excursions, and all the little extra special steps he took to make us feel special and taken care of.  Harry is the BEST!!

2) Flora.  Food was so good and service by Cesar first class.  Thanks Cesar for making it a memorable night.  Your recommendations were perfect.

3) Yiri from Kicks bar was always anticipating our needs and had our drinks ready as soon as she saw us.

4) Royal Pool and Beach Services - Yurdiel was simply on top of ensuring we had our Bali beds at beach each morning reach with towels and ensured we were taken care of even when he was at lunch.

5) Luis from Ginger; best Bartender!!!  Made us some great drinks based on what we favored.

The care and hospitality from everyone is top notch.

Will be back soon.

reviews.author: Danney Nunez
reviews.text: The best service overall came from the amazing Jairo. He was always attentive and made sure we were well taken care of at all times. His warm personality and dedication truly made us feel special. Without a doubt, he’s one of the best we’ve encountered. Jairo deserves every recognition and perk you can offer—he absolutely earned it!

reviews.author: Stephanie Mangum
reviews.text: Absolutely wonderful service, Fior was quick, friendly, and always kept the drinks full. Thank you!

reviews.author: Lisa Latirofian
reviews.text: Great poolside service from Rosanna and Jesus!! They always made sure we had a great experience by the pool and somewhere to sit.they were wonderful. Look out for them when you come. And the kidsdom activities with Martha and the rest of the staff were excellent!

reviews.author: Nicole Encarnacion
reviews.text: Paradisus Palma real was a great resort. It is very family friendly. My family & I really enjoyed our time there. Jairo from entertainment made sure we were having a great time during our entire stay.

reviews.author: Nicole Sigurdson
reviews.text: Everything is amazing. Rosanna the server is wonderful! Could not love this place more. Love the Italian restaurant - Milton & Yeensen are amazing! And you have to go see Maria, Denny, Miguel at the rum bar. For the morning, ginger bar is a must-visit for coffee. Ismael lizardo& Anthony make delicious espresso drinks!! And help start your morning off right.

reviews.author: Paige Todd
reviews.text: Currently, on the last day of a 4 night family vacation with children 12 and 6. The location, our room (ocean front suite) and the hotel in general is absolutely gorgeous. The atmosphere is very relaxing and it has not been crowded at all. However, this is not a 5 star resort experience at all. The music tonight for what I assume is some type of event is so loud we can not go to sleep. The vendors on the beach did not bother us too much and were nice,  but you should expect to be approached multiple times throughout your stay. We  stayed in the room that provided a concierge and we were not impressed. We received reservations for dining every night; however it took multiple messages and all the reservations were later than requested. The food at the buffet for breakfast was okay but I would recommend staying away for lunch. If you are not able to obtain dinner reservations, you will be disappointed. The food was mediocre at best at all of the places we went for dinner including the steakhouse, Asian, Mexican and Italian. Other than the food, everything else was okay. I would return again with my husband but likely not for a family vacation as there is not much to do with children. If you are looking for a decent get away with gorgeous beaches, this resort is it! If you want a 5 star experience, this is not the resort!

reviews.author: Laurie Becker
reviews.text:
My stay at Paradisus Palma reserves was wonderful.
The beach was perfect as was the beach service. Every day we were greeted by Angelo. He had our beach beds and chairs ready and waiting. By day two he knew exactly what we wanted to drink and was quick with bringing them to us. Always with a smile and even a song. Looking forward to our next stay and hope that we meet Angelo again.
I can’t say enough about how wonderful he treated us

Let me add that the resort is beautiful. Our room very clean and beds very comfortable.
Beach is like a piece of heaven.

I’d also like to give a shout out to Christian our butler. He was charming and helpful. Also easy to contact and helpful. Arranged our dinner reservations every night and was a pleasure to work with.

Only negative was the food. Most chicken and meat very tough. Service was ok in restaurants. Most food was just fair, though buffet had great number of selections and omelet station very good. The Italian restaurant our favorite to go back to.

Will definitely come back primarily for the beach, Angelo and butler service.

reviews.author: A O
reviews.text: Raul's outstanding customer service was beyond extraordinary experience. His ability to remember each of our drinks without reminders was impressive, and his eagerness to assist us throughout the evening was commendable. We were treated with the utmost care and attention which made our visit unforgettable. Raul truly exemplifies excellence in hospitality. Kudos to him for going above and beyond!

reviews.author: Samantha Araujo
reviews.text:
