I am currently dining at Flora and had an exceptional experience. The service was impeccable, thanks to our wonderful server, Stephania. She was attentive and friendly, ensuring that our dining experience was perfect.

The food was delicious, with every dish reflecting the rich flavors of traditional modern Dominican cuisine. The menu was beautifully designed, making it easy to choose from a variety of enticing options.

The ambiance of the restaurant was inviting and elegantly styled, creating a delightful atmosphere that complemented the fantastic food and service. I highly recommend Flora for anyone looking to enjoy an exquisite meal with outstanding service.

reviews.author: kathy ann
reviews.text: This was a dream vacation. We loved everything. We had a Swim Up room and it was fabulous. We were in Building 8…right by the Beach. I got up every morning to see the sunrise. It was my Birthday. Fernando and my husband got me a cake, ice cream and champagne to celebrate. It was amazing. Pedro on the Beach was the best. He was always available for any of our needs. He got us each a “special” cocktail to celebrate my birthday. He hand delivered and sang Happy Birthday to me. We highly recommend….you will not be disappointed!!!

reviews.author: Ashley Punzalan
reviews.text: Dilania and raysa were the best!! We loved the resort and they provided amazing service!

reviews.author: michael jobber
reviews.text: Julia and Jose at pool bar amazing service, great cocktails, great people!

reviews.author: Adila Khan
reviews.text:
Why do they block the ocean view with a big TV?
First they messed up our booking. Then refused to accommodate. You pay top dollars to get an ocean front juinor suites with a balcony and they bolt a TV right in the middle of the room between the door to the balcony blocking the view! WHY? (See pic)
TV is also bad quality with poor picture.
The staff was nice and polite but that is about it. They will acknowledge the issue but never solve it. I wouldn't recommend this resort!
Blue Agave resturant 7/27/25 :we asked the front for strictly no pork. They reassured us, ok no pork. Ordered food and confirmed no pork. What is the first thing they served us. Cheese with pork! Server start collecting plates while we were eating. He did not understand even when we tried to explain that we are still eating.

reviews.author: Michael House
reviews.text:
We went here for our anniversary.
We loved it!.
The service was excellent.
The staff is really great. Especially Marlina and Starlin..
Make sure you eat at Flora. 👍
Tip: make youra dinner reservations early in the morning just after The reservations open 8:00 a.m. (they fill up quickly)

reviews.author: J Greene (Dani0426)
reviews.text: The location was beautiful but Angelo made our trip the best. He took the best care of us at the pool. Ask for Angelo for any bartender needs. When my daughter got sick he was worried and asked about her, he took the best care of us.

reviews.author: Sarah Slattery
reviews.text: I thoroughly enjoyed my stay at the Paradisus Palma Real. The resort is stunning, and the staff is incredibly friendly. My spouse and I spent a week there, and we had some of the best meals we've ever experienced. Special thanks to Gustavo at Sante Restaurant for being consistently attentive. The pool bartenders were fantastic, always keeping our drinks topped off without needing to ask. Lastly, our concierge, Adriel, was exceptional—always on point, anticipating our needs and delivering promptly. His help truly enhanced our entire trip, and we will miss him.

reviews.author: Gretchen Weston
reviews.text:
We are staying at this resort right now. It's beautiful, but of course very hot in August. We decided to get out of the sun for a few minutes and did the rum tasting in the Rum Republic Bar. Brandon and Joffre and Juan were very informative and enthusiastic about Dominican rum culture.

Editing my review to add a few things:

Today I had the best massage of my life from Gladys at the spa. She has magic hands and worked all the knots out of my neck.

The Mexican buffet for lunch was delicious - the nacho chips were so crispy.

Also, the Dominican cuisine at Flora is very interesting and I really enjoyed the new (to me) flavors of Hispaniola.  Our waiter, Cesar, took great care of us.

reviews.author: Willie Harrington
reviews.text: There were many reasons for my dislike of the resort. First, when trying to upgrade my room online, it kept denying my card despite it being the same card I used for the initial reservations with AND. When I arrived at the resort, I used the very same card, but now additional steps were needed. Additionally, the service was poor. Some staff members were okay, but many made me feel as though I was irritating them. Third, the beach could not be accessed. The brown seaweed and its smell made going to the beach pointless. Lastly, the food was HORRIBLE. Many items, such as fries, hashbrowns, and cooked meats like the breakfast sausage, were reused the next day. They were cold, dry, and clearly old. The charcuterie section had all the proteins and cheeses out in the open, but they were not kept on cold displays or on ice. The meats were hot and sweaty, and the cheeses were melting. The bartenders at certain pools were not welcoming. No poolside food service, which I have never experienced at other resorts, was also a disappointment. Overall, I cannot recommend this resort, and I will never visit again.

reviews.author: D P
reviews.text:
A solid all inclusive resort with great (if not best) strip of beach on the Bávaro strip .(we had done other resorts prior to this)

Food was good (not exceptional) but good to very good at times. A la carte restaurants are good options and have variety. Alexandre at Blue Agave was top notch.

Night entertainment is a bit on the weaker side compared to other resorts.

No comments regarding service. All good and rooms cleaned and service twice a day. Night room prep included which was a nice touch.

Enjoy

reviews.author: Renata Gleyzerov
reviews.text: I would like to leave a review for kids club activities. I must say, they offer a fantastic way for children to have fun, learn, and make new friends! The club provides a great mix of creative, educational, and physical activities that keep kids engaged and entertained. Overall, the Kids Club is a fantastic place for children to learn, play, and grow. Highly recommended for parents looking for a safe and engaging environment for their little ones!

reviews.author: Mario Rascon
reviews.text: This place is amazing! The Mina restaurant is absolutely impressive! The food was delicious. The supervisor Reynaldo Martinez was very attentive. The waiter Manuel was constantly asking us if we needed anything. If you like to eat with plenty of healthy options this is the place to come!

reviews.author: Mike Hsiang
reviews.text: We loved our stay at Paradisus Real Palma! The staff and service were exceptional, the food was great and the swim-out pool room in The Reserve was perfect. Our personal concierge, Irvin, made sure that everything ran smoothly and was always available to book dinner reservations and activities. The rooms were clean, the restaurant/bars were welcoming, and the lobby and layout were perfect for relaxing. The beach and pools were also clean and well-maintained. The staff and service were outstanding from arrival to departure. I highly recommend Paradisus Real Palma and can't wait to return!

reviews.author: Ben Andrea Vidiella
reviews.text: Ron Republic is one of the best bar in the hotel with Miguel and Melvin! Ask for them… they make the best drinks… espresso martini and Sin Nombre w Legenda

reviews.author: Fran Guthrie
reviews.text: Maria got us in to dinner at Mina without a reservation. Such a seeet person. The wait staff is also excellent and the food was very good. Enjoyed everything.

reviews.author: Moses K Tawose
reviews.text: It lives up to its name heaven on earth with all activities fully manned and its security is top notch. It's an awesome place to rejuvenate and comes back fully refreshed with a new energy. Words isn't enough to tells all.

reviews.author: Laura Hasulo
reviews.text:
We just returned from a 10 night stay at the Paradisus Palma Real. We had a great time.
Rooms were great with a very comfortable bed.
The big buffet had something for everyone but we preferred Sante for their quieter breakfast buffet. Juan was our waiter for our breakfasts and he greeted us everyday with his huge smile and had our usual juices, coffees and my Diet Coke on the table before we came back with our food. The whole team there made us feel very welcome.
Sante for lunch and dinner had great menu choices.  The steak there was perfect.
The Mexican restaurant was delicious with outstanding service.
We had Lasagna and pizza at the Italian restaurant and they were very good.
We sat at the regular table at the Japanese and the food was so good.
Juan knew we had reservations at Sante for our last night. He went out of his way to make our last dinner and evening incredible. He, Misael, the chef and the rest of the staff worked together to give us an exceptional experience full of delicious food. After our final breakfast the next morning, we said a sad good bye to Juan with big hugs.
Our concierge, Harry was another standout during our stay. Greeted us everyday with a good morning message and sent us a list of activities and spa offers. He made our reservations, answered all of our many questions, arranged for our catamaran and our spa appointment. If we wanted anything for our room, he took care of it immediately. He took care of us from start to finish. Made sure to find us everyday for a quick chat and laugh and to make sure we were enjoying ourselves. And that smile! He is a gem.
The staff at all the pools and bars were fun but we mostly stayed at the big Reserve pool and the swim up bartenders were excellent and always smiling.
The beach was beautiful and the big beds in the Reserve section were a perfect place to nap every afternoon.
The resort is beautiful but the staff everywhere really made it a better stay.

reviews.author: Paula Grace Asnafi
reviews.text:
We had a wonderful vacation here. The swim up rooms are amazing if travelling with children, as you can enjoy yourself while they’re napping etc.
Our concierge Basilio was extremely helpful with anything we needed. He also prepared a beautiful birthday for our 2 year old during our stay. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Thulile Kavimba
reviews.text: I had a lovely time. The staff were very pleasant. Ramon served us excellently at the beach. Great place!

reviews.author: Yasmin Cruz
reviews.text: Raul who is not only on the beach but at the pool bar serving us was an absolute delight! His customer service was second to none, making us feel valued and cherished throughout our stay. Not only did he remember our drink orders with perfection, but he also continuously checked on our needs, ensuring everything was seamless. Raul's warm hospitality and keen attention to detail made us feel as though we were the most important guests. Highly recommend Raul for an outstanding service experience!

reviews.author: Ray Reid
reviews.text:
Very relaxing, beautiful weather, gorgeous beach!  Everyone has been super friendly and helpful. The Mascalzone restaurant has great food, great service, great ambiance. The manager Milton remembered us from another location and was super welcoming. Our server Yessica was professional, friendly, and accommodating!  All around top notch experience. Highly recommend.

Went to the restaurants Mina and our waiter was the best. prompt, friendly and very accommodating. All around super service

reviews.author: Pete Pascual
reviews.text: Edwin and Raider provided exceptional service during our visit to Mascalzone. They were attentive, personable, and made sure we had everything we needed. The food was exquisite, and the atmosphere was wonderful. The manager was also very friendly, adding to the overall great experience. This is definitely the best restaurant around. We'll be back for sure!

reviews.author: Lisa Souza
reviews.text: We went to Flora and Jean was our server.  Jean was EXCELLENT!!!! The food was excellent - We have been to many different resorts in Punta Cana by far one of the best food and service!!! get the Flora fish outstanding!!! how does this look?

reviews.author: Taylor
reviews.text: We spent our first full day at the beach followed by a lovely dinner at Flora. We got a warm greeting from Jennifer and Thurman at the door & Cesar made the best recommendations and my husband and I both enjoyed our meal and the service!

reviews.author: J J
reviews.text:
We had a great experience in the Italian reataunt, Mascalzone. The manager, Milton and Alexandra and Raider were very attentive and helpful. They made sure we were happy with every course.
Great food, friendly service. 10/10

reviews.author: Howie Shapiro
reviews.text: Virtudes is the very best! Melvin’s super fantastico. Food was excellent!

reviews.author: Ian Gillis
reviews.text: We just spent a week at this resort and it was absolutely fantastic! One of the best people we met was Angelo, he was incredibly helpful and so nice to us the entire stay. This resort does an unbelievable job of finding people who care about what they do, and Angelo is one of the best!!

reviews.author: Shione Donahue
reviews.text: This resprt is gorgeous and has a lot to offer, including wide beachfront, multiple pools, activities, casinos, gym. Service is great too - Rosanna is fantastic!

reviews.author: Kame Spencer
reviews.text: This review is for Ginger Bar. The 24hr bar located near the entrance across from the reception desk. We went literally every morning and sometimes just because. Anthony and Ismael the bartenders and the ladies Nereida and Clari are absolutely amazing!!! They make you feel like family, remember not only your faces but your drink order. Good little pastries and always a clean counter and fresh coffee.. do yourself a favor and go 😉

reviews.author: Kevin Ferguson
reviews.text: Raul on the beach is the best.  He treats us like family every time we come and we’ve been coming for 10 years.  He treats us like royalty by providing great service.  He’s always attentive to our needs with towels, drinks, and buckets of ice.  Can’t say enough good things about our experience.

reviews.author: MLG_ Doge
reviews.text: Raul gave us amazing service. He was the best server and was very attentive. We’ve been coming to this hotel for almost 16 years  and he has been our server for almost every year. The hotel has been a great experience for us year after year.

reviews.author: Tim Patriquin
reviews.text: We are so impressed with the friendliness of the staff, especially at the restaurants.  The Winery and Blue Agave are our favourites so far.  Jose was our waiter at Blue Agave and his recommendations were amazing.  The atmosphere and music are exactly what we were looking for as a dining experience!

reviews.author: Christian Ramos Baez
reviews.text:
✨ 5-Star Experience at Rum Republic and Restaurant! ✨

I want to give a big shoutout to María, an outstanding bartender at the Rum Republic bar. Her energy, charisma, and mixology skills made every drink feel like a personalized experience. She’s truly an artist behind the bar!

And at the restaurant, Reynaldo provided exceptional service. His attention to detail, kindness, and professionalism made us feel right at home. Top-notch hospitality!

We’ll definitely be back. Thank you for making our visit unforgettable! 💯🍸🍽️

reviews.author: Isis Cabrera
reviews.text:
We went to blue agave and had an amazing time.  Santo took care of us.  The service was amazing!  The food was absolutely amazing. Definitely will be returning. The staff was incredible.

Also shout out to Kicks sports bar!  My husband is a huge Licey fan. He watched all the games here and the service was a ten!   Love Yiri!  She is amazing!

reviews.author: Elizabeth Barboni
reviews.text: This resort was phenomenal!! We attended for our honeymoon and can’t wait to come back. The room was cleaned well and stocked all the time. Adriel, our concierge, was SPOT on. If you can request him, do it!! He took care of everything we asked for and some of the things that we didn’t! Once, we got back from an ATV and zip lining trip EXHAUSTED and found chocolate covered strawberries and champagne waiting for us. We felt like royalty and can’t wait to come back.

reviews.author: Mary Ann
reviews.text: Stayed at the Reserve adults only side. Beautiful property. Very clean. Gorgeous beach. Our Concierge Kelvin was so attentive and made sure our stay was top notch! Perfect long weekend get-away! Felt safe. Beautiful pools. Great drinks and variety of food options and restaurants.

reviews.author: Matt Meetsma
reviews.text:
Edickson was an amazing server at the pool. He took care of us the whole week and was the best part of the resort. Julia also helped us out a lot with the drinks. Thank you!
However, I should note the buffet food is way below sub par.

reviews.author: David Turrigiano
reviews.text: Ginger bar. Luis and Miguel were awesome bartenders. Both remembered us from our last trip. We have been five times over the past six days. They are very friendly and make good drinks

reviews.author: Luciano Henriquez
reviews.text:
Yamilet was amazing!!!
The level of service provided at Blue Agave Restaurant was phenomenal to the last detail: the appetizers, meals and dessert were all delicious.  Thank you!!!

reviews.author: MAHANTH M
reviews.text: Location is awesome right next to the beach. Rooms were average. Bar near Mina and Blue Agave is awesome.  bar tenders are great. Specially Laura from service helped us a lot in restaurant reservations and other services.

reviews.author: Christopher Jones
reviews.text:
Our dining experience at Kicks restaurant within the Paradisus Palma Real was absolutely phenomenal, largely thanks to the exceptional staff who truly made our evening memorable. From the moment we arrived, we were greeted with genuine warmth and attentiveness that set the tone for a fantastic meal.

Our server, Jose del Rosario, deserves special recognition. His dedication to providing outstanding service was truly remarkable. He anticipated our needs before we even voiced them, offering helpful suggestions and ensuring every detail of our meal was perfect. Whether it was a specific dietary request or simply a question about the menu, Jose handled everything with grace and efficiency.

His friendly demeanor and genuine care made us feel like valued guests, not just customers. He took the time to engage with us, creating a personal connection that elevated our dining experience far beyond simply enjoying good food. Jose's attention to detail and commitment to our satisfaction were truly commendable and significantly enhanced our time at Kicks.

The bar area was another highlight, thanks to the incredible talents of Leanniand Miguel. These two bartenders are not only skilled mixologists but also fantastic hosts. They crafted delicious and perfectly balanced cocktails with flair and efficiency. What truly stood out was their ability to create a welcoming and enjoyable atmosphere at the bar. They were attentive, ensuring our drinks were always to our liking, and engaging in friendly conversation that made us feel right at home.

Leanni and Miguel clearly take pride in their work and go the extra mile to ensure every guest leaves the bar happy and satisfied. Their positive energy and dedication to customer satisfaction are truly assets to Kicks.

reviews.author: nancy castro
reviews.text: Yamilet  Was a wonderful server she was excellent.

reviews.author: Madison Scott
reviews.text:
We had a fantastic stay at the paradisus palma real!! The lunch box buffet was amazing everyday. All of our dinners were delicious. We stayed in the reserve and our butler Basillio was attentive to our needs and made my husband's birthday extra special with a birthday cake sent to our room!

Martin who works in the reserve section of the beach was incredible and made sure that we always had drinks and dry towels!

I have read reviews that spoke poorly of the food and service and this was not our experience at all!! We loved our stay and will be returning again, hopefully soon!

reviews.author: rachel pflugh
reviews.text: This is an amazing place! Love the staff. The amenities are clean and abundant. We'll be returning. We ate at Mascalzone and Milton the supervisor was wonderful and our waitress Celia was wonderful as well! The pool bar 90 degree staff were amazing and very attentive, Rosanna and Eddie are fast and patient. This is truly a great place place!

reviews.author: Haroon M
reviews.text: Melqui has been phenominal, one of the best waiters I have ever had at any restaraunt.

reviews.author: Brett Smith
reviews.text: This is a review of our reseve pool experience. We have spent the majority of our 14 days here and as our time is nearly over I’d like to give the staff here a glowing review. For the first week we Jojohn ( apologies if the spelling is in correct) and the second we have Marileisy. I can not fault either of these 2 and the rest of the staff here.  They are flawless in catering to our needs, whether it be making our beds up or  bring us drinks before we even know we want one. The attentiveness of these guys is why we choose the reserve or the level when we travel with Melia.  I’ll leave a review of the rest of my experience here at a later date, but for now I just want to give credit where it’s due and these guys will be remembered for a long time.

reviews.author: Jason Mirach
reviews.text: Lovely decor and kind attentive service. The dishes are well proportioned and are flavor forward. Kudos to the chef on the sancocho and bread pudding, which were our favorites. Great cocktails as well.

reviews.author: Jesse Gerstin
reviews.text: Had a great stay at Paradisus and enjoyed hanging at Kicks Bar (one of the inclusive bar options). Yiri is a great host and welcomed us every day with a smile and even learned our favorite drinks and offered new suggestions. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Dave Sills
reviews.text: This was our second time dining at Flora while on vacation here and actually the second time was even better than the first if that can be possible. The food, service and atmosphere were beyond our expectations. Everyone served with a smile and accommodated us and made us feel like family. Highly recommended. Thank you Melina our fabulous server.

reviews.author: Jim Barbato
reviews.text: Tonight at the beautiful Paradisus Palma Real, we enjoyed dinner at Blue Agave, great Mexican fare. Laura was the hostess with the mostess ! It was a perfect meal that felt like a hug 🥰. Filled our belly’s and our hearts. One word, Excellent ⭐️

reviews.author: aman kishore
reviews.text: Such an amazing experience it wouldn’t be amazing without the best staff especially Rosanna, yanira, Maria.

reviews.author: Helen Wint
reviews.text: I am enjoying this place immensely.   The food, the people, the ambience, this hotel is amazing.  Shout out to Fernando so courteous and friendly entertainer.   Michael at the front desk, thanks for such warm hospitality.   Will certainly return.

reviews.author: Kazi Hassan
reviews.text:
My wife, our 17-month-old daughter, and I stayed at Palma Real from June 8–14 in a Junior Suite Swim-Up. I’d like to share an honest review of our experience.

Check-In: Upon arrival, we were warmly greeted by the front desk staff and assisted with our check-in. We had upgraded to a Junior Suite Swim-Up with a king-size bed, but were initially
given a room with two smaller beds. After a long day of travel, we had to request a room change, which was inconvenient but ultimately resolved. For reference, this resort is operated
by Meliá, a Spanish hotel group.

The Room: The room itself was spacious, well-maintained, and well-suited for a family. Housekeeping did a great job keeping it clean. Room service was slower than what we experienced at other resorts (usually 30–45 minutes), but still acceptable. The biggest issue was the air conditioning—it consistently felt warm despite being set to 69°F. It seemed as though the thermostat or AC unit wasn’t functioning properly, and at times the room became uncomfortably hot. The bathroom also had drainage issues; whenever we showered, water would leak into other areas, requiring extra towels to manage the mess. Additionally, although we had mentioned we were celebrating our anniversary, there were no acknowledgments or gestures from the resort, which was disappointing.

The Concierge and Timeshare Experience: Unfortunately, our experience with the concierge was the most upsetting part of our trip. From the beginning, we were persistently approached about attending a Meliá membership presentation. Despite repeatedly declining, we eventually agreed to attend out of courtesy—this turned out to be a major regret. The sales pitch was aggressive and pushy. We made it clear we were not interested in purchasing a $15,000 membership, yet the salespeople continued to pressure us, citing their quotas. During this
presentation, our daughter fell from a chair and injured her forehead, which required attention and has since left a scar. The concierge assured us he would speak with his manager regarding compensation. However, we received no follow-up or support despite repeated communication (we have messages and photos documenting this). After returning home, the concierge reached out, but gave conflicting explanations about the manager’s availability. Ultimately, no compensation or real acknowledgment was provided. We plan to file a formal complaint with Costco, through whom we booked.

The Resort Grounds: The resort itself is beautiful and well-maintained, with plenty of available lounge chairs at the beach and pool, even on busy days. The swim-up suite was a great option for convenience and privacy. That said, there isn’t much catered to young children, and the spa was minimal—more of a massage cabana setup than a full-service spa.

Food and Dining: The dining experience was mixed. The buffet and most restaurants were average—decent, but nothing exceptional. The steakhouse stood out as excellent, and the Japanese à la carte option was also very enjoyable. The coffee shop, Ginger, was fantastic. For contrast, we had an incredible meal off-site at a local Dominican chain, Doña Pula, which we
highly recommend. One frustration was having to make all reservations through the concierge, rather than using an
app or streamlined system.

Wi-Fi: The wi-fi was terrible at this location, if you are planning on using anything please buy your own data.

Summary: While we appreciated some relaxing moments during our stay, there were several shortcomings that left us disappointed. Between the room issues, unfulfilled promises, and especially the negative experience with the sales presentation and lack of follow-up regarding our daughter’s injury, we do not plan to return to this property. We hope our feedback helps future travelers make informed decisions.

reviews.author: Yan Xu
reviews.text: The Italian restaurant Mascalzone was one of the best restaurants we have had in all the all inclusive resorts we have stayed at throughout the Dominican Republic, Jamaica and Cuba. We tried the caprese salad which had the creamiest mozzarella de buffalo I have ever had, and my husband loved the tuna capacio which was also delicious. We also had the T bone steak and lobster papadell. Steak was cooked to a perfect medium rare which was to our surprise because we tend to find meats overcooked in Dominican. The flavour was spot on. The pasta had rich lobster flavour and there was generous amount of lobster meat. The service was great with our waiter Yensen providing excellent service. There was new cutlery after every course and table was wiped clean in between courses and he kept the wine flowing. I highly recommend it in fact we were hoping to try coming back again during our stay.

reviews.author: Nathan Slattery
reviews.text: I had a fantastic experience at Restaurant Mexicano. Alexander Bryan and Santo (the boss) were outstanding. I ordered the enchiladas with Mole sauce, and they were the best I’ve ever had—highly recommend! Later, I stopped by Kicks and was equally impressed with Randi and Luis, who are excellent bartenders. Great vacation overall!

reviews.author: Javier Andrade
reviews.text: Excellent Latin-Dominican gourmet fusion restaurant with a nice ambiance and superb service. It’s an adults-only restaurant but very accommodating—we walked in after leaving the kids at the kids’ club without a reservation, and they made space for us. César, our server, was super attentive and gave us excellent recommendations. The food was delicious; we will definitely come back

reviews.author: Ent
reviews.text: honestly the hotel itself is pretty nice, the food is just ok, but the service here is horrible. i don’t think i’ve ever been treated as bad anywhere else. not all employees are mean but some of them don’t even acknowledge you are there, they don’t say hi or talk to you at all, there’s this one employee who looked at me in a condescending way and overall was really mean. also i was obligated to leave a good review because a girl working here would not leave me alone until she saw i posted a 5 star review so probably all good reviews containing employees names are just fake and forced. she was way too pushy and all over my personal space almost grabbing my phone which i didn’t like. The service here is so bad it honestly kinda ruined my vacation.

reviews.author: Darren St.Bernard
reviews.text: Mascalzone restaurant is an excellent Italian dining spot with a warm, inviting atmosphere. Our server, Jessica, was outstanding attentive, friendly, and made the experience even more enjoyable. Highly recommended, and I’ll absolutely be returning

reviews.author: CharleneO79
reviews.text: Rosanna and Yanira were great at the lunchbox bar and Buffett. We had great service and friendly faces every day. They were warm and welcoming and the food was filling and delicious. Beautiful views, beautiful people. 5 Stars across the board!

reviews.author: Tawny Cross
reviews.text:
Blues grave is excellent. Great service , great drinks and Santo and Melvin were awesome! Santo and Virtudes are amazing ! Chicken burrito yummy!
Kicks sports bar has great food! The smash burger and Mac and cheese ! Our server Jose del Rosario and bar manager made sure my food allergy was taken very serious! Excellent service !

reviews.author: Caitlin
reviews.text: We just spent a week here for our honeymoon and it was nothing short of amazing. We were in the reserve (if you don't have kids, its worth every penny) and our concierge , Yalady was INCREDIBLE. She went above and beyond making sure we had everything we needed from setting up all our dinners, boat rides, special request, etc. My birthday happened to be our last day there and she made it so special, with balloons, cake, champagne, treats. It was something I'll never forget. Pedro was also so exceptional by the beach, always setting us up with towels, drinks and really making us feel welcome. Angelo and Marilesy were also shining stars by the pool and beach checking on us and making sure we had everything we needed. This is one of the few all inclusive resorts with GOOD food. Going to dinner every night to a new place was so fun. Also theres a seaweed boom happening right now where a lot of it washes up on shore and in the water and this resort somehow had none of it, which was amazing. Most resorts are covered in it right now, so beware. Highly recommend this place if you don't want a trashy inclusive experience.

reviews.author: Dalia Restrepo
reviews.text:
Paradisus KANA SNACK  best service! they treated my husband and I like royalty.  I want to give special thanks to:
ERNESTO
FELIX
WANDER
FRANGELIO
They were extraordinary with us, very friendly and always serving us with a great smile! I recommend 200%

I also want to thank Cesar from Flora Restaurant who was exceptional tonight.  His client service skills are great.  We had such a great time there and the food was excellent!   Thank you Cesar

reviews.author: Maria Ross Paths of Light
reviews.text: I really enjoyed the Dominican night. Food and drinks were great. Soranyidid a great job! Room service was great. Delvi Martinez too great care of us

reviews.author: Jodi Dillmon
reviews.text:
Maria and Yafreisy were the best during our lunch at the buffet at the lunch box. They were so kind and helpful and went above and beyond to make our experience helpful.

Luis from the Ginger Bar made the best espresso martini ever! Thank you my friend.

Ismael at the Ginger Bar made us the most delicious strawberry, pineapple, and mint smoothie! He was so friendly and helpful. His co-workers, Quintin, Olga, Clary were equally as amazing! Loved the service here! Thank you.

reviews.author: Teshan Aponso
reviews.text:
Incredible service, delicious food all around and excellent recommendations. The food was beyond our expectations.

Melvin and Maria at Rum Republic were excellent and served some exquisite cocktails. The attention to detail was in point.

reviews.author: Jaclyn Belland
reviews.text: Marileisy at the reserve beach was fabulous! She remembered our names, saved us seats every morning, and was very attentive. And, she’s very nice! I highly recommend her!

reviews.author: Peter Epshteyn
reviews.text:
Great resort! Great service! Wonderful room.
Antonio, one of management person took kind of personal care of us during our stay. Was helping us a lot to accommodate all restaurants reservations,  explaining to us a lot of things we even wouldn't think about.
Doniel and Rafael really took great care of us serving hibachi.  Wonderful service!
Really great resort. Most likely will come back.

reviews.author: Diana L
reviews.text:
Everything was so great from beginning to end. Airport/hotel transfer was easy and check-in was a breeze.
I’ve stayed at multiple Paradisus properties and this is by far the most stunning. This resort is located right on the beach & has multiple restaurants and pools for your choosing. Given that this is an all-inclusive, the food was pretty decent. My favorite was Flora.
Felix was our concierge and he was amazing! He helped us get settled in from our first day to our last day. Checked in with us every day, made sure we had our dinner reservations, and that we had a comfortable stay through our trip. This trip was also for my birthday and he had our room decorated … it was a nice surprise after a day at the beach. Highly recommend him if you’re thinking about going.

reviews.author: Tricia Breedlove
reviews.text: Rosanna is awesome! She made every dining experience top tier!

reviews.author: Emilio Guzman
reviews.text: OMG this place is awesome! Reynaldo helped us pair a bottle of with the perfect Rib Eye Steak, made by chef Rafa. The whole crew that took care of us, was amazing. I couldn’t eat my whole meal but it was amazing. This is the best restaurant I’ve been to so far. Thanks to the whole crew who took the time to come and meet us table side and hear about our experience. I will certainly return soon!

reviews.author: Asiana Freeman
reviews.text: This was my first time in the Dominican Republic and Restaurant Blue Agave among the others were very nice and the food was very delicious. Santo, the boss of Blue Agave and Melvin our server were very nice and welcoming!!! The resort itself was very nice and everyone was friendly and welcoming. I can’t wait to return back!!!

reviews.author: Erin S
reviews.text: Arisleida was the most wonderful beach server imaginable. She made our week here most enjoyable. The Reserve booking is well worth it! We loved every minute it! Arisleida and Pedro made our beach experience amazing!

reviews.author: Jessie Hurst
reviews.text: We ate dinner at Blue Agave tonight and it was excellent. The service was wonderful. Santos was wonderful. The melted cheese appetizer was delicious. The pastor tacos were so flavorful! Loved it!

reviews.author: Tati Garcia
reviews.text: Ismael, Anthony and Luis are the best great people great drink and even better service.  Olga and Quintino at the adult pool are also some of the best people we have meet.  Ask for them on your next visit

reviews.author: Kelly Petersen
reviews.text: Raphael did a great job for us on beach. Very attentive and friendly. Erickson was a perfect mixologist along with his geniune smile. Misael is an excellent good server. His personality shines through. They are all super employees. Hats off to all of them!!

reviews.author: Ayesha McDuffie
reviews.text: Our experience here was by far the best on this resort.  We tried a few restaurants and this was the last one on the list and met every expectation. The food, the waite staff and especially our server Sterling- excellente. For appetizers,I had the Tostin Flowers and for dinner the Flora Fishing.  My mom had the Spicy Short Rib. When I return, I will definitely dine here everyday. Reserve early or miss out.

reviews.author: Scott Suggs
reviews.text: Alquenio, our waiter at the Blue Agave restaurant was amazing, food order was correct the first time. The food came out very fast and was delicious. He always checked in with our table and was patient with us. Our wine glass was always filled. I would recommend eating at this restaurant and staying at this hotel.

reviews.author: Katherine Daniel
reviews.text: Yeimi “Jamie” is an excellent bartender. He has been great to us. The resort is excellent and the food is good as well. Beautiful views.

reviews.author: Christina Luback
reviews.text: We are here now and our stay is great. Rosanna and Jesus at the pool bar make this feel like a real vacation. No matter what you need, they have it covered. We are four families and they made the stay for all of us amazing.

reviews.author: Jaye Kepniss
reviews.text:
We ate tonight at Blus Agave. Alexander Bryant our waiter was amazing and the boss Santo was so lovely! Our host Laura was great too.Our food was delicious and it was such a positive experience- highly recommend!

The second night we ate at the Italian restaurant and it was equally as great as blue  agave! Our waiter Brailyn was phenomenal! The service was great and they were so acommodating to our large party

reviews.author: Nice guy
reviews.text: Reynaldo Martinez is the best educated respectable hardworking beautiful beautiful kinky waiter I have ever met in my life. Outstanding service in Minas Restaurant. He is a nice chocolate man ready to serve anyone that comes into the restaurant. Amazing food but even better view 😉

reviews.author: John Edwards
reviews.text: Raul and Danny at the Circle Beach club are the best bar tenders. They are very professional, accommodating, and personal. I hope these two fine gentleman move up in their careers here at Paradisus very soon as they very much deserve nothing but these best.

reviews.author: Kristen Mease
reviews.text: We had a great time at Paradisus! Francisco, our concierge, was so kind and helpful. Alexander, at Blue Agave, was so fun! The staff were friendly and helpful. It’s so relaxing and the beach is wonderful. Dream vacation. Can’t wait to go back!

reviews.author: Ettevi Narud
reviews.text:
Day 5 update: we ate today at Blue Agave and we were served by Santos, Virtudes and Edison and they were great. Amazing service and the food at Blue Agave was great. I recommend the tortilla soup, the rack of lamb and the tsi Ik as the starter. Again, the service makes the hotel worth the stay.

We just ate at Flora on day 4 of a 7 day stay at the Paradisus Palma Real. Our server Cesar was great, he brought us our food on time and gave us extra portions when requested. The food was actually great— the sancocho and plantain flowers were a great starter, the cocofongo and goat were great… if management sees this, please give Cesar a bonus for providing excellent customer service.

Day 3: we ate at the circle members buffet and our server Carlos (deck of cards tattoo on his neck) was amazing! He made sure we got a table indoors after it started raining and was very attentive… best server hands down!

Day 2: we ate at the ramen hibachi restaurant and our server Fani and cook #7 ( el siete!) were amazing… they really knew how to put on a show and his flavor was excellent.

Day 1: we ate at the buffet… it was OK, nothing to write home about but a the staff were amazing especially our server Mayra and the woman at the pasta station.

All in all, the hotel rooms may need a bit updating to make them a true 5 star hotel but the staff make everything great. The Dominican people are amazing and I thank them for making our stay memorable. Thank you Paradisus staff! Big thank you to our Meliá Circle staff and especially Daniel!

reviews.author: Lilly Esacove
reviews.text: Irvin and Henrry are so good at pool! Pool sharks!

reviews.author: Charles Roland
reviews.text: Jefry Beautiful for you Jeff made my experience here. Wonderful. He was very hospitable and provided great comfort perfect

reviews.author: Joel Nunez
reviews.text: Over achieving service from Laura Batista, Jerry, Erickson. The Chef Kendrick personally came out and asked how our meal was. It feels like you’re at home, with the care and attention to detail. Bring your entire family, you will not be disappointed.

reviews.author: Melisha D Sookhoo
reviews.text: Marileisy derny a Vanessa. Very good service and super friendly. Felt like family. I highly recommend. Best stay ever!!!!!

reviews.author: Adrian Miller
reviews.text:
Reynaldo, Barnelis,and Gustavo,
What a wonderful group of people. Warm, friendly, and genuine. They made my trip memorable, fun, and easy. I would highly recommend this property because if these lovely people on staff here.

reviews.author: Andrea Emilova
reviews.text: Rosanna yanira very good service and very nice,very helpful and lovely hotel and staff.

reviews.author: Anna Krivolenko
reviews.text:
Kanna restaurant was very good, fresh food, very good service
WANDER was the best, very polite and friendly

reviews.author: Sabrina Sollecito
reviews.text:
Can’t express how happy my family and I have been with our entire experience at this hotel. The service has been impeccable, someone is always checking in to make sure we are happy and never missing anything.
Our experience this week was worth every penny. A special shout out to our beach waiter Jesus who took care of our needs the entire week!

reviews.author: Alyssa Neubauer
reviews.text: This resort is great & the grounds are beautiful but a few things to improve on: we kept asking for room service, specifically more towels & water daily & it took them days to provide us with more. Room service cleaning was very limited what they did. The room we had was fantastic but our friends who paid the same for the same type of room ended up with a room with two full beds which was concerning. Restaurants/bars opened very late & were closed during the day which is a minus when you pay for all inclusive. With all inclusive you barely get any options of where to eat/drink & the selection of what you can drink is very limited. Food at the restaurants is pretty good. All in all we had a fun time.

reviews.author: KATERYNA USENKO
reviews.text: Every year we come to Paradisus Palma Real, it’s the best vacation spot in the Dominican Republic. The food is amazing, the beaches are clean and the service is fantastic. Rafael is the best, impeccable service, great attitude, always with a smile and ready to help. Definitely recommend this hotel!

reviews.author: Duarte Lino
reviews.text: Diorgenis is a very good server! Very good friend of mine. Ask for puerta del sol.

reviews.author: maria clay
reviews.text: María was the most attentive helpful waitress that we ever had and I would definitely recommend her for everyone who comes to visit me. I went to the steak restaurant the Mia MINA and if you actually able to get María she’s amazing.

reviews.author: Lauren Spencer
reviews.text: This was a beautiful resort! Went in May so it was very peaceful and our concierge Eriol was AMAZING - very attentive and even helped celebrate our anniversary with a decorated room, champagne and a decorated cake at dinner! Highly recommend this resort and Eriol!! Food was good and room service was quick and easy!

reviews.author: Lucia Molina
reviews.text:
Victor and Jensy at Rum Repulica
Amazing customer service only going back to Ron Republic so they couldn’t make me that amazing cocktails their customer service is A+. I had an amazing time. Thank you so much for having such amazing employees giving excellent customer service.

reviews.author: manny kelly
reviews.text:
Special thanks to Alexander our waiter and Melton the supervisor

I recently had the pleasure of dining at Blue Agave in the Dominican Republic, and I must say, it was an unforgettable experience. From the moment I walked in, I was greeted with warmth and hospitality.

The customer service at this restaurant is truly top-notch. The staff went above and beyond to ensure that my dining experience was exceptional. The waiters were not only attentive but also incredibly knowledgeable about the menu. They provided excellent recommendations and were quick to answer any questions I had. Their promptness in taking orders, serving dishes, and refilling drinks was impressive, making me feel like a valued guest.

The hostess's friendliness added a welcoming touch to the overall ambiance. She greeted us with a warm smile and promptly found us a comfortable table. Her friendly demeanor set the tone for the evening, making us feel right at home.

And now, let's talk about the star of the show – the food. Blue Agave  serves some of the most authentic and delicious Mexican cuisine I've had outside of Mexico itself. The flavors were rich and bold, and every dish was prepared with care. From sizzling fajitas to mouthwatering enchiladas, every bite was a delightful journey through Mexican cuisine.

To sum it up, Blue Agave not only offers excellent Mexican food but also excels in customer service, waiters' promptness, and hostess friendliness. If you're in the Dominican Republic and craving a taste of Mexico, I highly recommend paying them a visit. You won't be disappointed!

reviews.author: Dina Gundecha
reviews.text: We particularly loved the kids club service at the resort. They are very friendly welcoming and took extra effort to make my daughters birthday special.

reviews.author: Lesley Falconer
reviews.text: Flora Restaurant was a wonderful atmosphere with delicious cuisine authentic to DR! Paradisus Palma Real is a beautiful resort with elegance and charm, and great service.  I would have preferred to have known about upgrading to the concierge service before arriving.  This cause us to have issues booking reservations in the restaurants while we were here.

reviews.author: Danica Beudeker
reviews.text: This is my first review as I felt compelled to let prospective tourist know that the service at the pool and beach area was impeccable because we had Romon Rivas. He is charming attentive and passionate about his job.  He wants to make sure we are satisfied.  I never had to ask for anything as our needs were always taken care of.  He made our trip.  We will be returning!

reviews.author: Fraol Abebe
reviews.text:
We had a great experience at this resort. The staff was amazing and attentive especially at the flora restaurant inside the resort. They were very welcoming and friendly. The hostess Ana and the waiter Vladimir were extremely sweet and professional. They are an example of great customer service.

Also, Special thank you to Lennison and Jimmy for their attentive and curious customer service when we arrived and leave. They were very welcoming and happy to assist us. They made us feel very special and treated us with so much love. I love it 🥰 ❤️

reviews.author: J A
reviews.text: Tonight I ate at Flora, a restaurant at Paradisus Palma, and the food was delicious. My server, Cesar, recommended an amazing dish and it did not disappoint! I would definitely come back for the service and the food.

reviews.author: Carla Miller
reviews.text:
I would give this entire vacation experience 10 stars if I could! The resort is dreamy in every way and the staff goes above and beyond to make you feel like you're the most important person there!
The beach & pools are perfection. The room & room service is perfection. The options are endless for food and entertainment. My family came here to see our niece get married and it has been nothing short of amazing...
Even though we came when it's hot as Haitis, we could overlook the extreme heat because everything else has been exceptional!!
We brought our 1.5 year old daughter and the staff has been an absolute delight for a family with a toddler! We would come back in a heart beat. Hands down one of the best all inclusive experiences we have ever had!!
Shout out to Reynaldo & Jean Carlos at Mina who were truly kind and warm towards us all. The steakhouse (Mina) was SO good.
Thank you for the best experience for me and my family!! XO

reviews.author: Jason Cobb
reviews.text: We had an excellent time at the sports bar Kick Start. The best part was our new best friend  Jose del Rosario that not only made sure our food and drinks were awesome but the best part was watching the Final Four NCAA March Madness in Dominican Republic. Unbelievable.

reviews.author: Cristina Hudson
reviews.text: This was my second time visiting this hotel and it has been absolutely amazing!!! My first time was 9 years ago for my wedding. The service is like no other, very inviting and the views are stunning. We stayed on the Reserve side, adult only. There’s a restaurant Sante where the environment is so zen and service is top notch. Alexander and Luz were great and very attentive. Starting our mornings off at the Ginger bar for our morning coffee was amazing, every single staff member from the moment transportation dropped off to the time we departed have been extremely kind, welcoming, warm, and extremely helpful. If I could give more stars I would.

reviews.author: Tarek Uddin
reviews.text:
Blue agave restaurant:

Virtudes - our server was great she. She was outstanding during the service. Very nice.

The restaurant itself is very nice, the atmosphere.

Hector from the Tito stand made a great virgin Martini for my pregnant wife. Very friendly as well.

Rosanna- from the buffet is very friendly and always made sure we were taken care of. Great service.

Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Crystal Salinas
reviews.text: This resort was very peaceful and calming, I definitely enjoyed my 6 nights here. The crew at ginger bar was awesome! Bright smiling faces from early morning coffees to night time cocktails. Shout out to Luis Vilorio, Luis Deza, Andrerina, Lucia, Vianny, Margarel, & Jorge!! Yall were the best! Muchas muchas gracias x todo su servicio asta la próxima!

reviews.author: Arekel Richards
reviews.text: Guillermo my Concierge at Paradisus Palma Real was very polite and helpful. This experience with him was very warming and welcoming. I highly recommend Guillermo when visiting.

reviews.author: Geo Salazar
reviews.text: This review is for Paradisus Palma Real. Great experience for a relaxed family vacation. Service was great as expected, resort was beautiful. Ramon Rivas at the beach and poolside was the best. Always made sure that we had beverages for ourselves and the kids. Ask for him and it’s guaranteed satisfaction. This is our second time to this property. I’m sure it not be the last.

reviews.author: Laura R
reviews.text:
This place is absolutely incredible!!!!  Best resort/rooms we've been in.  Cleanest all inclusive ever (and we've been to several in Mexico).  We stayed in a suite which was perfect for us and our teenager.  Plenty of room.   3 bathroom sinks plus a sink in the kitchenette.  2 doors to balcony.  Perfect shower although short for my 6' 4" husband.  Huge plush bath towels and beach towels.   Tough to get face cloths so you might want to bring your own.   Huge bottles of liquid soap at each sink and lotion so no need to bring your own.

Beach had perfectly powdery sand.  No need for water shoes.... no rocks or shells.  Can't go shelling here if you're looking for that.   Lots of seaweed though although they clean it up daily on the beach... just can't avoid having it in the water,  but you can walk down the beach and find areas with a little less if you want to get into the ocean.

At end of May, this place was practically empty until a convention started and still didn't seem very busy.   No need to reserve beach or pool chairs,  there are plenty!  We even got a Bali bed each day at the pool.... no extra charge and it was the nicest I've been in.  No problem getting as many beach towels as you need.

Lots of pestering of local vendors at the beach.   Little at the hotel,  although Juan from the Ocean club didn't seem to want to leave us alone.   People at the resort are super nice and eager to help although their English here is not as good as in the Riveria Maya.  Large amount of the best looking male workers I've seen at any resort though!  Lol

Brought our own insulated cups,  but they use a lot of paper cups and paper straws here.   Good for sanitary reasons,  but kinda strange drinking out of a paper straw.

Reservations for specialty restaurants were easy to get nightly and the dress was casual which is always nice for my husband.... no need to pack slacks and dress shoes.  Nice shorts were fine.

They play mostly Latin music here which I grew very tired of....only a few English songs sprinkled in here and there.

I wouldn't recommend this place for small children, but fine for teens.  We loved that it wasn't heavily run by kids. Nightly entertainment was lacking... not big productions like other resorts, but again,  that was fine with us.

Resort is smaller than most we've been to,  but we actually loved that as it was big enough,  but not too big.   Didn't have to walk for miles to room or beach.

Loved that we could get to our room and all restaurants under cover in case we had rainy days.....no umbrella needed,  although they provide one in the room.   They had robes and slippers too.

I'm a big soda drinker and they have Coke, Coke Zero, and Sprite (the D.R. versions).  All in bottles instead of fountain so I was especially glad I brought an insulated mug as I would have them fill it with ice because most of the time the soda bottles were warm.

Food was not good here, much better in Mexico, but I found enough I could eat.  As usual,  the specialty restaurants were better than the buffet.   I really missed having an ice cream shop of some sort.  Mini bar was best we've ever had though....had Lays chips, Oreos, and M&Ms along with some local selections of snacks.

Amazing place.   So glad we came and would definitely come back.   If food is a real priority to you,  you will probably be disappointed (although the pineapple is delicious!).

reviews.author: Tommymeats
reviews.text: Ginger bar was amazing. The people working the bar were great. Ismael, Antonio, Dominga, Olga, Clary, and Smaria were the best. I can't wait to come back. The entire resort was absolutely amazing, but they really made it special!!

reviews.author: Morales Esajas-Remak
reviews.text:
I really enjoyed the Dominican night with the fair/market while enjoying the local musical entertainment and dance shows.
The guys (Jairo & Fernando) doing an excellent job entertaining us proactively.

reviews.author: Christine Guarino
reviews.text:
Had a great stay with my girlfriends. The resort is beautiful and so clean, rooms are nice and most meals were excellent. Our favorites were the Mexican, Italian, and Dominican restaurants. We did wish we could get lunch poolside rather than having to go sit at a restaurant, but there is no poolside food service. So that was our only real disappointment.
We loved our concierge Juan Carlos! He took care of our dinner reservations and helped book an excursion for us. He was very responsive and helpful!
We also loved the staff at the swim up bar in the reserve! Nathaniel, Eddie, Rosana, and Mario were the best! Great service and so fun and nice.
Overall a beautiful spot and I would return and recommend to others.

reviews.author: kent vanderheyden
reviews.text: My family and I just returned from our trip to the Paradisus Palma real. The resort is very nice. The food was very good. We had upgraded to the Reserve section that comes with a concierge which is supposed to help you out with your restaurant reservations and other questions. We had 2 because we had 3 rooms. Our were Yaleidi and Christian. From the start it seemed that it was going to be very good as they came and met us and said they would look after everything, "no problem ". Well that definitely wasn't the case.  I had made a dinner reservation for our first evening from home by emailing a week before. They made the next two but the resort was empty. One of the evenings there was only 1 other table in the restaurant.  Christmas day and on was a different story. They didn't get any of our reservations the times we asked for. After complaining to the manager we had a little success but not alot. The resort is nice but I wouldn't suggest upgrading to the Reserve as there aren't much benefits.  We spoke with others and they had similar issues with their concierge. Also if you are going for golf i wouldn't suggest this resort either. The course was in horrible condition. Of the 27 holes only 9 were playable and the golf course conviently changed their prices a week earlier without notifying the hotel bit nothing was done about that either. We still had a good vacation but the extra cost of approx $600 per person was a waste.

reviews.author: Samantha
reviews.text: One of the worst travel experiences I’ve ever had. My family stayed at Paradisus Palma Real, and the resort completely failed to take guest safety or concerns seriously. Housekeeping stole my father’s wallet from our locked room, and management brushed it off, blaming us. Their response to my complaint was careless and full of errors. Persistent beach solicitors made it impossible to relax. This was our first trip to the Dominican Republic and definitely our last. I wouldn’t recommend to anyone ever!

reviews.author: Celia Tiedemann
reviews.text: Kicks sports bar was amazing service and a great atmosphere. The waiters jose dl rosario  and bartender miguel soler , diogene and tairo y la supervisora yiris were very efficient and made fantastic drinks for us!

reviews.author: Jenny Wang
reviews.text: The Kidsdom staff members went above and beyond during our trip. They greeted our 4 year old by name every time they saw her out at the pool and went out of their way to keep her engaged with activities. Alexandra, Lisbeth, Susu are just incredible. We had such an amazing experience!

reviews.author: Adam Tancrede
reviews.text: Amazing resort, entire place is incredibly clean and easy to manage. Able to get a seat at the beach and at the pool at any time of day. Drinks are great. There is a wide variety of food options available and the service is perfect. Yuderqui in the lunchbox is the BEST!

reviews.author: Michelle Phelan
reviews.text: Raider was an excellent waiter at Mascalzone! Very friendly. Our Spanish isn’t the best and he was able to speak Spanish and English to us. Our food came out very quick and was delish! The manager made sure we had an excellent experience as well.

reviews.author: James Williams
reviews.text: We enjoyed our stay and the staff was absolutely amazing! Pamela, Edison and Reilin made our time at the various restaurants great. We wanted to celebrate a friend for their birthday and Pamela went above and beyond to create a great experience with a cake, song, etc. We look forward to our next visit.

reviews.author: victoria vaizburd
reviews.text:
So far having an amazing stay, the hotel is beautiful and well cared for. The beach is powdery soft, the pool bar is on point.
The food - get the RESERVE. The buffet is elevated and you can dine at Flora - authentic Dominican food, it’s beautiful and delicious. Ask for Cesar he will make sure your experience is great !  Felix will also make your experience top notch.

reviews.author: Jennifer DellaCalce
reviews.text:
Had a fantastic time at Kicks at Palmas Real in Punta Cana.

Best and most memorable times which were as a result of people like Yiri who made our stay.

We loved our time with her and always appreciated the care and love she have us.

reviews.author: Lianne Gillis
reviews.text: Our stay at paradisus Palma real was amazing. Angelo at the beach bar was very attentive and friendly with a great attitude and personality. Put concierge Javes was fantastic and so helpful and a great person. The beach was beautiful and the whole resort is the nicest place I’ve been. 10/10 would recommend. Lovely vacation

reviews.author: Dario A
reviews.text:
When we went to dinner and lunch box, we had amazing service from Ricki and Rudy. They were extremely respectful and very helpful, definitely recommend going here!

We had a great workshop with Brandol on how to make mixology cocktails! It was an amazing time!

We had a great time at my Mascalzone! It’s was amazing food and service! The head waiter stopped over and made sure to let us know that the night is about us and anything we need they will help us with! The octopus was amazing! The lasagna was delicious! And I HIGHLY recommend the mamaguana passionfruit with a splash of cranberry (don’t forget the dried lime) cocktail! 10/10

reviews.author: Alexander Barton
reviews.text: Paradisus Palma Real was a great experience. The staff is great, always respectful with a smile on their face. We ate at Mina restaurant, it was phenomenal. Jean Carlos  (Server),  Reynaldo Martinez (Manager), Epifamia Ortiz (Hostess) took great care of us. Definitely try out their steak and cheesecake. Need to plan another trip here again!

reviews.author: Leonardo Cardoso, CFA
reviews.text:
From lobby to room and beach cabana, every moment is fantastic… and if something goes wrong the staff is eager to help.

Shout out to Raul at the beach cabana for his promptness and service. I  highly recommend you to get one and relax during your vacation.

Shout out to the guys at the lobby bar… perfect drinks every time and every day.

reviews.author: Paula Hudak
reviews.text: We ate dinner tonight at Mascalzone Italian restaurant at the Paradisus Palma Real in DR. Food was amazing and the service was excellent.  Our servers were Alexandra and Bernabe.  Great job!  Milton was the supervisor and all were outstanding. Thank you for a great dining experience.

reviews.author: Pedro Cabrera
reviews.text: Restaurant Flora was the best!!! The Chef Jose Morillo was the best of all!! His cooking exceptional but his kindness with our group was the best of all. Andrea the waitress was exceptional with her service..Five Stars.

reviews.author: Mayur Patel
reviews.text:
Excellent dinner at Flora.
Authentic Dominican Cuisine.
Our waitress Andrea Santana was excellent in her recommendations.The fish and Gnocci was very tasty.
Don’t miss out out the rum cake for dessert!
We are Circle members and it’s our 1st trip since we joined just before the pandemic.
Had a good time .
Our concierge Ariel Benzo was excellent .

reviews.author: Luis Ferrero
reviews.text: We stayed for week at PARADISUS and had an amazing time. Our concierge Zenovia was always attentive and took care of all our needs. Angelo and Jeffrey were the best at the pool and beach along with Wanda they kept the drinks flowing and the service was admirable. We can’t wait to come back!

reviews.author: Dylan Elliott
reviews.text: This place was amazing and beautiful. Excellent staff and service. Very clean and comfortable place to stay in. My family I spent a whole week down here and were amazed by the whole experience we had. The food was amazing and excellent.

reviews.author: Bruno Aguillon
reviews.text: Guillermo concierge was amazing! Helped with everything and really attentive!

reviews.author: Brianna Rodriguez
reviews.text:
Ginger Bar has such a lovely wait staff! The best place to get morning coffee and cocktail at night.Thank you
Ismael, Antonio, Dominga, Jenny, and Cris for the wonderful hospitality! I also had a really wonderful experience at Blue Agave. Food was a 10 and staff was very attentive and kind. Definitely my favorite this far! Isais and Martin and Pedro at the Reserve beach provided us excellent service and were always ready for us any time we showed up at the beach. Thank you so much!

reviews.author: Elizabeth Rocha
reviews.text: Yeimi, Lucia, Andreina, Genessis, Fernando - Had an amazing time with my best friend for her birthday and you all contributed to it. Thank you so much for your hospitality and amazing drinks!!!

reviews.author: Ashley Sewdat
reviews.text: Our stay at Paradisus Palma Real was nothing short of amazing. This is my second time coming to this resort and it never disappoints. Every restaurant was absolutely amazing and delicious but I did have a favorite. The Italian restaurant Mascalzone was superb. From appetizers down to the dessert. Service was amazing, our waitress attended our every need. I would absolutely do come back to Paradisus.

reviews.author: Leila Lopez
reviews.text: The view was absolutely amazing, and the rooms were beautiful. Most of the service was excellent and accommodating. I had a great time with my family overall. I did have trouble with a marijuana smell in my room that kept coming back everyday. I do not smoke and it was definitely concerning to me. However, every time I called room service, they did a great job getting the smell out of the room. There was also trouble with making reservations at the restaurants. It was a little troubling because my family spent a lot of money to come to this resort and there were a few times were a simple ‘no’ was given instead of a solution. Luckily, the hostesses at the restaurants were very helpful. It was just a little frustrating seeing that we spent money as club members and were not always a priority. Despite this, most other experiences with the staff were very pleasant. The whole time, we had maybe one rude waiter, but again, the rest of the staff was absolutely amazing.

reviews.author: Zoya Yeprem
reviews.text:
Despite the resort's five-star rating, our recent experience fell far short of expectations.

Firstly, the service was virtually non-existent. We requested extra blankets almost daily during our stay, but they never arrived. Room service was equally disappointing; a simple request for milk for our coffee was ignored. In fact, most requests made from our room were met with indifference or simply ignored.

Secondly, the quality of the food was mediocre. While the a la carte restaurants offered better dining experiences, the buffet was underwhelming.

Finally, the condition of the room was concerning. The furnishings seemed to be held together with glue, with a wobbly sink and an outlet socket that came loose from the wall. The sink drain was clogged, causing water to back up quickly.

Furthermore, while the gift shop offers some over-the-counter medicine for cold or stomach aches, I recommend to check the box before you pay for it. They often sell individual pills out of the box, and you may end up with an empty box if you don't check. The gift shop manager is extremely rude and would out right accuse you of stealing before checking their own records. This is not an acceptable behavior from a five-star resort.

While the resort was immaculately clean and the outdoor pool area was lovely, these positives were overshadowed by the poor service and subpar amenities. Given these significant shortcomings, I can only give this resort two stars. Unfortunately after this bitter experience we won’t be staying at another Paradisus hotel.

reviews.author: Luis Cabrera
reviews.text: Great resort. Really enjoyed our family vacation here. Food was fantastic. Shout out to José for being super attentive throughout our stay, checking in with my mother and ensuring she was always taken cared of.

reviews.author: Christine Crawford
reviews.text:
Paradisus Golf Resort and Spa was amazing for our girls trip! Food was amazing at every restaurant and the staff were friendly and a lot of fun!
The bartender, Miguel, from the rum bar (Rum Republica) was so friendly, personable, fun to chat with and made great drinks! We stopped by every night before dinner to see him!! :)
5 + stars for Miguel!

reviews.author: Isabel Reyes Muñoz
reviews.text: Best thing on this family stay was the staff’ service (shout out to Edison, Ana and Fauri). The beach and the pools were great, the room and restaurant were nearby. The beach bathroom was very clean. The room’s decoration is pretty good, only thing to improve is to provide more waste baskets and soap bars (only found gel). I loved the robes, very comfortable and roomy for bigger people. The food options are good, and could improve (specially in stuff for picky eaters and seafood lovers, lobster is better grilled, for example). The view is amazing too. Looking forward to come back!!

reviews.author: Craig Weil
reviews.text: Maria who serves the most awesome martinis in the Rum Republic Bar, is sensational. She is very friendly and will make you whatever your heart desires and delivers it with a smile. We love her!

reviews.author: Sig B
reviews.text: We had the best time!! My boyfriend and I got engaged here. They made it very special and the photographers and videographers were just amazing, especially Edwin. The rooms are beautiful and cleaned daily. We stayed in the adult - only area with all inclusive -- which includes alcohol! The restaurants are included and have great service. Only thing is you need to book in advance in-person and there’s a line, so that should be the first thing you do when you get there. I have a lot of food allergies, and was able to get gluten free pasta upon request, which is more rare than it sounds when it comes to international travel. Lots of veggie options as well and transparency around what’s in different dishes, I didn’t have any allergic reactions, which is something I’m always concerned about when I travel. All-around amazing, will hopefully come back for an anniversary!

reviews.author: eaviper
reviews.text:
I have to be honest, the food at this resort was not up to par. The buffet was disappointing and the upgraded restaurants were not much better. Making reservations was a hassle and the food quality just didn't meet expectations. One night at the steakhouse was enough for us to walk out.

Unfortunately, there wasn't much in terms of entertainment for the kids either. We were expecting more from an upgraded resort.

In my opinion, if you're looking for a great vacation spot, I would suggest looking elsewhere. This resort just didn't live up to its reputation. Check out the reviews on the Better Business Bureau website when they are trying to sell you the upgraded club membership. this resort has definitely cut back on their quality of Food.

reviews.author: Finne Verstraeten
reviews.text: I had a wonderfull time at this beautifull resort with my friends. We would definitely recommend The Reserve. We would also like to thank Reynaldo aswell for his excellent service. He always welcomed us with a smile and made sure that everything was in order. We will be back very soon!

reviews.author: Erica Whiteside
reviews.text: I came to the Paradisus with my sister for 4 days and we had a great time. The location and view was great.  The hotel was beautiful and well maintained. We enjoyed the food.  For breakfast and lunch we did the buffet. For dinner,  we ate at the restaurant with reservations. The staff was very friendly and attentive.  The breakfast staff Rosanna, Yahira and Deivil were so great that we made sure to sure in their section every morning.  Our Concierge Cristian made our trip easy and pleasant.  Overall it was a great trip!

reviews.author: Wally Contreras
reviews.text:
Kidsdom was great! Our children loved it, they had so many activities and were so lovable. They took great care of our children and they had an amazing time. We barely spent time with our kids because they wanted to hang out in the kids club.

Thank you all! We will definitely come back

reviews.author: April DeReus
reviews.text: We come here every year.  This was our first time dining at Flora, which is Dominican cuisine.  The service was fantastic... Eduardo and Starlin were attentive and totally accommodating.  The food!!!!!  OMG, it was amazing 🤩. Definitely will repeat and try something else.  We had the Boca Chica for appetizer and short ribs and chicken for entrees.  Sooooo good!!!

reviews.author: Sarah & Ryan Davis
reviews.text: We are one night at Blue Agave. The flavors of our pork tacos were excellent and the agua chiles ceviche type dish was delicious. Reynaldo was awesome. My son really wanted tacos with ground beef and that wasn’t on the menu. So he asked the chef specially to make these for him, and they were happy to accommodate us! 🌮 Made his night! Thank you Blue Agave!

reviews.author: Domenica Gordillo
reviews.text: It’s very Good services Diorgenis and Luis are great bartenders, always atento e for my every need at the bar Miguel  soler y lucia

reviews.author: Yaneysi Roque
reviews.text: Jose Ramirez made our stay truly memorable with his exceptional kindness and willingness to assist us in every way possible. His warm smile and genuine demeanor instantly made us feel at home from the moment we arrived. Jose went above and beyond to ensure we had everything we needed and took the time to explain all the details, making our experience seamless and enjoyable. Thank you, Jose, for your outstanding hospitality!

reviews.author: CyNaa Mitchell
reviews.text: If you stay here try The Nina Restaurant, it was amazing from the food to the service. Our server Reynaldo did a great job with our table making sure our food came out on time. Plus we had a big party of 12. They even surprised us with a cake and birthday song making the night extra special for my birthday.

reviews.author: Ashlé Harris
reviews.text: It was our first time on an international trip for fun and we had an exceptional experience. We came to this resort after having a horrible experience at another resort and Brahain and Carlos were INCREDIBLY helpful and patient with us. They went above and beyond with their customer service. Every staff member has been so kind and polite and has great spirits. Everyone just made us feel so welcomed and comfortable. Our room was clean and beautiful. The beach was amazing. The food was good and flavorful and a good variety. The drinks were great. This resort has a great vibe and the perfect place to celebrate any occasion. We are so thankful we came here for our anniversary. We will absolutely be back.

reviews.author: Sharo Jimenez-Santana
reviews.text:
Ricki in the dining hall was the best!!!!!!! Very accommodating!  Super attentive!
Joel (dining hall manager) was also very accommodating and met our needs when organizing our mothers birthday.
Carlos (front desk) was outstanding in providing the best accommodation.
Luis (in the snack area) was great!  Whatever we needed he got for us!!!!!!  Always greeted us with a smile.
That being said, the concierge was horrible.
Our experience could have been so much better.

reviews.author: Amber Morgan
reviews.text: We are at the tail end of our Mother/Daughter birthday trip to the DR. We had a great time. The rooms were trendy and updated and the facility was quite beautiful. Overall we had an excellent time and my 6 year old said it was the best trip ever! I did mark down on the service because we missed our concierge for the first day and were unable to get dinner reservations. The restaurants are delicious and unfortunately the buffet just could not compare.

reviews.author: Riccyn Reyes
reviews.text: We celebrated my husband’s birthday here at Paradisus Palma Real. We chose to book a reservation at Flora and had an amazing service from Eduardo and Ana. Hotel room was nice and clean with all the drinks and toiletries included. We’ll definitely come back here! Thanks to all the staff who made our stay fun and comfortable.

reviews.author: Daniel Marques
reviews.text:
This was our third visit to the Paradisius  Palma  Real, and it was amazing again. !
The resort is immaculate from the rooms to the restaurants the pool and the beach !
Yefry helped us out on the beach and in the pool he always had drinks ready for us and was at our Service. He is amazing with the kids. Also he made our vacation amazing.!!!
We hope Yefry is here the next time we return!

reviews.author: Matt Karkula
reviews.text: I would say the price for this resort is on the upper end and visually it feels great but some issues with service and rooms. Rooms are remodeled and feel new and great however mine had broken hair dryer and it took 3 days to get new one. Jacuzzi also didn't work. Was fixed the next day but broke again another day. Also there was to cockroaches in the room I know they are common in tropical climate and maybe because it was ground floor room. Service in the buffet was decent. Sometimes u had to wait long for your drinks. Service at the kick sports bar is slow  there was a lot of waitresses standing around. Waited one hour for my food. Worst part is making reservations for restaurants. It is a nightmare. U need to see the lady and she tells u system doesn't work or doesn't open until certain hours. Its horrible. They have an app where u can order room amenities but can't do restaurant reservations just plain wrong, for additional $107 a night u will get concierge and be able to just delegate reservation making process. I was able to get to all the restaurants but the process was painful and unpleasant. Especially most of the time restaurants are half empty anyway. They do offer a lot of activities for kids and adults. Highlight of the trip is their kidsdom kids club. My kids had great time there. Staff there is super nice and they always have fun activities for the little ones honestly that place is 5 plus stars. Other than that I probably won't be coming back and if you get a cheap deal on this hotel i would go for it but at regular rate is kind of overpriced.

reviews.author: Hailee Taylor
reviews.text: Beautiful spot. Shows a little wear and tear in some areas, but it’s gorgeous. The service is amazing, especially Cesar and Manuel at the Flora restaurant. My husband mentioned wanting to try some Dominican classics, and even after we ordered, Cesar came back and asked if we would like to try two different soups. I thought this was especially considerate considering this is an all inclusive spot, so it wasn’t an upsell. The food was phenomenal. Highly recommend!!!

reviews.author: Brianna Hickethier
reviews.text:
The Ginger bar is beautiful! The service was excellent. Ismael was a bright spot for us. He
Twas so welcoming and always had a positive attitude every single time we see him. That was very refreshing and always started our day off excellent. The entire staff at Ginger bar was friendly and accomadating. Thank you!!!! The hotel was beautiful and well kept. There was always staff around that were happy to help us.  One of the last nights the hotel hosted a silent disco which was something we really enjoyed.
