reviews.author: Stephanie Goldcamp
reviews.text: The kids club was absolutely wonderful.  There were tons of fun activities for the kids to do like face painting, cookie decorating, arts and crafts, bracelet making and more.  My kids kept asking to go back over and over and it was so nice for my husband and I to get some time to ourselves.  The staff were so friendly and attentive.  We would even see the staff around the resort and they would say hi to the kids which they loved.  Thank you so much!

reviews.author: Orly Balilty
reviews.text: Loved this resort, Johan was outstanding, met him on our last day and wish we met him at the beginning of our trip

reviews.author: Kaylin Reyes
reviews.text: Melani was an amazing server would love to have him again super sweet and on point

reviews.author: Jenifer Chin
reviews.text:
The activities crew of Mr Ayayay , Jairo, Fernando chipa ,Carlos , joulfry Joanna were the best. Ayayay's energy is off the charts. Fernando Jairo and Carlos dance instruction were easy to follow. They were patient
Our servers Rosanna Yadiel and Jasfray  treated us like family. Always greeted us with ohla my familia. Always made sure our glasses were filled and our plates taken away when finished.

reviews.author: Meghan O'Carroll
reviews.text:
If you get the pleasure of being in the presence of Arisleida, Luis, and Roseanna during your stay consider yourself lucky. They are absolutely amazing and made our stay worth it. They make this resort 5 stars. Thank you so much!!! Above and beyond service made us feel like family.

If you book here make sure to book directly through Melia and not a third party like Expedia.

reviews.author: Lucas Fernandes
reviews.text:
The whole resort was amazing! Specially the food and service at the restaurants in the hotel. Milton and Gabriel at the Blueagave mexican restaurant there were also great! Very polite and thoughtful to our needs! They completely improved our experience there at the Blueagave mexican restaurant!

I truly recommend this experience and the resort! Totally amazing (specially the churros, lol)!

reviews.author: Sidney Taylor
reviews.text: I stayed at the Palma Real Golf & Spa Resort on last week February 13 - 15. I was with two fluent Spanish speakers and was treated like an imbecile because I was not a fluent Spanish speaker. I didn't go on vacation to be a laughing stock for all of the workers. There was 0 hospitality for me at the resort, while others were treated with the utmost respect. During check-in, the concierge was connecting with my two friends who are fluent speakers and then I was asked was I too fluent and Dominican. Before I could answer for myself, the lady who checked us in scrunched her face and immediately said no. I am more than capable of speaking for myself and it was very unprofessional for the worker to treat me that way. I would never in a million years just someone for being who they are. I felt judged and ridiculed the entire time and it truly ruined my travel experience. My group paid for one of the highest services therefore I should have been treated with respect. I didn't even have a problem with the workers speaking Spanish and just allowing my friends to translate what I couldn't understand. There were some things I knew how to say in Spanish but didn't feel comfortable trying at all. I thought I would be continuously laughed at if I made a mistake. I never want to come back to this resort again!!! The workers should be ashamed of themselves for how they treated me. I spent money and time from work to enjoy myself, but I couldn't even do that. I couldn't even practice the spanish that I did know.

reviews.author: Darcie Cronn
reviews.text: Jose del Rosario at kicks was excellent service !! My little grandson got hurt and oh my goodness he took care of him so well. Gave him butter , salt, and pepper little guy was running around. Great service. Can’t wait to come back

reviews.author: Kim Erickson
reviews.text: Had an amazing time!! Food and service was excellent! Our air conditioner didn’t work when we got there, within 2 hours maintenance came, troubleshot (motor was shot) and fixed!! Betzi took care of everything we needed and was a great communicator!! Will be back!

reviews.author: Petra Kassis
reviews.text: Mother daughter trip and we are having a wonderful time! The hotel is amazing! The decor and service are on point, lots of restaurant options and so many pools!!! Our room, the deluxe junior suite, is unbelievable! Would definitely be coming back!

reviews.author: Nesma Ansari
reviews.text:
Overall we had a great time at the resort. We were here for 5 nights and the location is perfect. Right on the beach with lots of pools around. Our personal concierge, Luis Cadet was amazing and always at our service. He was very helpful and made sure all our reservations for dinner and anything else we needed was all done!
I would recommend that there are more food options to cater to different people. We ate at Flora which was amazing; however, Mina steakhouse was a disappointment. Also the room service takes a long time to deliver so would recommend to speed that up.

reviews.author: Beth Rosner
reviews.text:
I’ve been going to Melia Paradise Palm Real reserve for nine years and absolutely love it! The design of the property and the buildings is beautiful, this service is excellent, the property the rooms. The restaurants are all very clean. And the staff is wonderfully warm & helpful, always!!
Our concierge Yaladie this year was excellent! Always available and communicated everything we needed! Best of the best! Manager Carolina was super helpful prior to our arrival and then greeted us in person so warmly! We love our beach and bar staff, especially on the Reserve Beach, all of them are fantastic and most especially Pedro.
Can’t wait to return again next year!!

reviews.author: Irene Canas
reviews.text: Great spot for vacation, service is amazing. Angelo in the beach treated us very nicely and was at his service for everything. The only thing is i recome eating at the restaurants. Personally i was not a fan of the buffet.

reviews.author: Ivanrocks1982
reviews.text: This hotel is definitely a 5 star hotel. The hotel itself beautiful and everyone is very nice. Transportation included. Mini bar is re filled daily. They have lots of activities for kids for all age groups. Ladies at the kids club are amazing! Food is great! Italian restaurant was our favorite. Resort is very clean and all updated. When we came to the hotel we asked for upgrade and they gave it to us with no charge. What ever we asked was always a yes or absolutely. We will definitely come back.

reviews.author: Laura Gonzalez
reviews.text: This resort is one of the best in the Dominican Republic. The buffet was delicious and even had fresh sushi!! Our waiter, Franklin Diaz, greeted us with a smile and made us feel like family. I highly recommend coming and checking out the buffet!

reviews.author: Sharline Bryan
reviews.text: I had an amazing experience. The staff was super amazing super helpful. I had the best time of my life. Ramon was amazing. He was one of the best servers I’ve had in years. I would recommend this experience for anyone who’s looking for an amazing getaway.

reviews.author: Isolda Echeverria
reviews.text:
My stay at Paradisus Palma Real by Meliá was amazing. My oceanfront room was the perfect choice, with a spectacular view and a huge balcony where I could relax and enjoy the scenery. The room was spacious, comfortable, and spotless, thanks to the wonderful housekeeping service, which was always available and attentive.

The highlight of my stay was definitely the Kids’ Dome. Alexandra, Susu, and Jesús were incredible—friendly, attentive, and truly engaged with the kids. They didn’t just supervise; they played with them, running in the sand, flying kites, and making every moment fun. My daughters felt happy and safe, and as a parent, that meant everything.

The food experience was great. Blue Agave was our favorite, but we also enjoyed Flora, the Asian restaurant and Kanna  which had delicious options. I didn’t try the Italian restaurant, so I can’t comment on it. The only minor issue was that service at the restaurants was a bit slow, but given that it was Spring Break and the hotel was full, it was understandable.

Evenings at the plaza were fantastic, with live music and entertainment for all ages. Instead of going to bed after dinner like we usually do on vacation, we stayed out dancing and enjoying the beautiful weather until late at night.

This hotel is perfect for families with kids, offering an excellent balance of relaxation and fun. There’s also an adults-only section for those looking for a quieter experience. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Brian Pilkington
reviews.text:
I stayed at the Paradisius Palma Real for 10 days. Just returned on the 20th of July. Cristian was my concierge, he was awesome. He did everything he said he was going to do was always there if we needed anything. Took care of all of our dinner reservations. Checked in with us at least once a day through text and then usually stop by to see us during the course of the day.
We ateed all the a la carte restaurants for dinner because he was able to take care of our reservations and we did not have a bad meal the entire time we were there.

reviews.author: John D'Aversa
reviews.text:
The waiter was phenomenal. Bernarde thank you for the rest service
He was very attentive.
The meals were better than average.
And they came quickly.
Anyone staying at Paridisus in Punta Cana should plan to eat here.
Ginger bar is an excellent place for great coffee in the morning and even better drinks in the evening. The staff was ready to serve and make our drinks very quickly and tasty.
Luis, Antony, Ismael, Dominga, Olga.
I think they are all terrific

reviews.author: Jacob Cevallos
reviews.text:
Hello, I thought I’d share our recent stay here. I would rate it **6 out of 10**. Here are our reasons:

**Food:**
The breakfast and lunch options were limited to a buffet, unless you opted for a $150 nightly upgrade for an additional restaurant choice. Unfortunately, the buffet served low-quality food with little flavor, which was quite disappointing. However, dinner options redeemed the culinary experience; the steakhouse offered a delicious steak, and Flora, the Dominican restaurant, provided a standout meal. These were the highlights of our daily dining.

**Beach and Beach Service:**
If your idea of a perfect vacation involves lounging on pristine beaches, this might not be your best choice. The water quality was compromised by boat pollution, making it less appealing. Additionally, we were approached by vendors every few minutes, which disrupted our relaxation. The beach service itself was minimal; we received barely any attention from hotel staff for drink orders, and the beverages available were subpar in quality.

**Service:**
Service varied during our stay. Many employees seemed overworked or disinterested, which might be attributed to the demanding environment and perhaps unappreciative guests. A tip here and there can make a significant difference, folks! The standout was Melina at Flora, who offered exemplary service, making our dining experience pleasant.

**Pros:**
- The property is beautifully maintained with a spacious, inviting pool area.
- Our room was comfortable, spacious, and equipped with excellent air conditioning.
- Dinner options, as previously mentioned, were the culinary highlight of our stay.

Overall, while the property itself is lovely and the accommodations comfortable, the beach and dining options for most of the day could use significant improvement. I’d probably not return due to the negatives outweighing the pros. We stayed in Cap Cana at another resort and honestly enjoyed the privacy on that side of the island, and would recommended a stay in that area if you are seeking a better beach and more privacy away from the craziness on Punta Cana. Good luck and I hope I provided some good insight!

reviews.author: Mr.
reviews.text: YAnira was excellent! Very sweet and sociable!!

reviews.author: Jesse Jacobsen
reviews.text: Amazing stay! Beautiful beaches, lovely rooms, Rafael took care of us on the beach, Yinesca was there for anything we needed, would recommend!

reviews.author: Melanie Solomon
reviews.text: Just finished dinner at Flora and had a wonderful dining experience. The food & ambience were outstanding as was the service from our server Stephania and Milton the supervisor. Our favourite restaurant at the resort. Going to make sure we eat here again before we go home.

reviews.author: Beth Shephard
reviews.text:
Blue Agave!!!
(Hands down the best dinner we’ve had this week)
Our lovely server Jose was so very hospitable with Jael at the helm seeing the whole experience through.
From the greeting to dessert the entire experience was excellent.

I will dream of the delicious rums, food , and very capable atmosphere.

We were blown away.
Gracias, Amigos!!!

reviews.author: Natonia Armour
reviews.text:
The Ginger bar is delightful! Anthony, Clary Ismael and Olga & Amyee  are  so courteous & always greeting me with a smile and happy to make me happy :-)
Highly recommend the cafe Dominicano & the espresso martini!!

reviews.author: Stephen Dixon
reviews.text: Martin, our waiter on the beach, was very professional and gave us great service.

reviews.author: Heidi Ripka
reviews.text:
Mixed Experience at Paradisus Palma Real

As a repeat guest who’s visited this property multiple times, I was excited for another relaxing getaway. Sadly, this trip left me questioning whether I’ll return.

The Good
The resort remains as stunning as ever, with lush, tropical grounds perfect for morning walks or lounging by the pools. The new coffee bar was a highlight, where an espresso martini paired with a violinist playing pop covers made for an enjoyable evening.

The Disappointing
Check-In & Room Issues
Despite being a loyal guest and noting both my birthday (the day before arrival) and my daughter’s birthday (shortly after departure), there was no acknowledgment. I requested a room closer to the beach but was placed far away, as most prime rooms seemed reserved for Circle members.

On arrival, the bed was made with damp, incorrectly placed sheets. The thermostat wouldn’t cool below 70°F, the safe was broken and never fixed despite requests for have resolved, and snacks in the room were sparingly replenished.

Dining & Shortages
Restaurant reservation system was awful. Upon check-in, we found the system closed, and by the next morning, all options we were told were fully booked, leaving only one late-night slot the day before our departure. While a manager eventually helped, the process was unnecessarily stressful, and the restaurants often appeared half-empty despite the supposed lack of availability.

The food was inconsistent. Mascalzone (Italian) and Blue Agave (Mexican) offered the best meals with attentive service, but others fell short. Tokimeku (Hibachi) was underwhelming, with rubbery chicken and tough steak, and the buffet often had unappetizing options. Worse, staple items like spinach, tomatoes, and grilled chicken breast were at times unavailable.

Shortages extended to basic beverages: I couldn’t get a Dirty Monkey drink because bananas and chocolate syrup were unavailable throughout my stay, same with a Mochachino at the coffee bar (hey, I love chocolate - don't judge ;) ). These recurring issues, coupled with the already limited dining options, significantly detracted from the experience.

Final Thoughts
While Circle members and upgraded guests enjoy a better experience, regular guests are treated as an afterthought. The inconsistent service, dining chaos, and supply shortages made it difficult to fully relax.

The property itself is gorgeous, and I’ve had wonderful experiences here in the past. However, this visit has me considering other options for my next trip to Punta Cana.

Melia, please take action—this beautiful resort deserves better.

reviews.author: Shyla Rivera
reviews.text: I went to La Flora restaurant with my husband. It had a very nice ambiance. If you are looking for a traditional Dominican meal, this is not the place. However, they do put a creative spin on many Dominican dishes, making it seem more high end. The wait staff was lovely and I would recommend giving it a try!

reviews.author: Victoria Crespo
reviews.text:
The staff is amazing, everyone was so friendly . Rosana at the lunch box, who served me daily was amazing. Always helpful and always smiling.
Frank, my other server was always a joy and also very helpful.

Angel Rivera our Bell Boy gave me excellent service. He was so helpful and it made my trip so much nicer. Thank you Angel. Much appreciated. See you again.

reviews.author: Jeeva Seenivasan
reviews.text:
We had a wonderful experience staying at Paradisus Palma Real. The Ocean front Suite was right in front of the beach and yes nothing but the beach sands and the ocean. The room was beautiful, spacious for our family of 4.

The staff all over the resort were predominantly friendly and courteous. We had a bit of communication issues as we cannot speak in Spanish(learning for the next trip). Special mention to Antonio at the front office who went a long way in ensuring a nice birthday treat for my litttle one. Reservations at the restaurants , the team sang birthday wishes and a cake with candles.

Food: Good choices in the buffet. Spice level is low(Get your srirachas if you want it spicy).

The swimming pools were super clean, well maintained, life guards all around.

On the beach: The staff and security guards were professional & friendly. Drinks and food brought to you with a smile.

Special mention: Ramon on the beach side was amazing with his service. He checked on us frequently and always there to help. Including understanding what the local dealers on the beach are saying or asking. The security guards ensured our interactions with the local vendors was safe and without being scammed(yeah watch out for those with the Macaus and lizards).

Excursions: Precimus at the lower lobby booked us on very good excursions -

Overall an amazing trip with great memories. Will not think twice to stay here again. As it goes in Dominica:  Astala Vista Baby!

reviews.author: Brian Herzberg
reviews.text: We stayed at this resort for the week with our extended family including 3 under 5.  Everything was absolutely fantastic. Special shout out to the Flora restaurant which has the best Dominican Cuisine we had at the resort. Cesar (our waiter) made sure everything was perfect and my wife had a special birthday.

reviews.author: Ruth Carrica
reviews.text:
I recently had the pleasure of interacting with Ramon Rivas and Vanessa, and I must say, his customer service and positive attitude were exceptional. From the moment I walked on the beach, they greeted me with a warm smile and genuine enthusiasm, instantly making me feel welcome and valued as a customer.

Throughout our interaction, Ramon and Vanessa went above and beyond to ensure that all of my needs were met.

What truly stood out to me was Ramon's unwavering positivity and can-do attitude. Despite the very hot weather, he constantly served us, had drinks coming. He exceeded my expectations. His enthusiasm was infectious, leaving me feeling satisfied.

In addition to his exceptional customer service skills, Ramon's professionalism and attention to detail were evident in every interaction. He was prompt, organized, and always went the extra mile to ensure that I had a seamless experience from the moment I got to the beach until the moment I left.

Overall, I cannot speak highly enough of Ramon Rivas and the incredible service he provided. He is a true asset to this resort, and I would not hesitate to recommend him to anyone in need of outstanding customer service with a smile. Thank you, Ramon, for your dedication, positivity, and commitment to excellence. You have truly made a lasting impression on me as a customer!

reviews.author: Andy Aymond
reviews.text: Rosanna, y yania y Maria excellent! Very warm and accommodating!

reviews.author: Maria hofbauer
reviews.text:
From gh wedding planning, the wedding team, from Braulia to Stephanie Bellido, who went above and beyond for make our dream come true to all the servers and staff! All staff has been lazing and friendly,  Reynaldo, Guillermo and Barnabys the Reseves hostess they all have been amazing. Reynaldo was super nice who everyone in our wedding party and our families. They all were great always making us feel welcome.

We Weill miss out reserve bat staff calling us “familia”!!   We had and amazing time and will definitely be back!!

Our concierge Basilio was also the best and very attentive!

reviews.author: Kathy Fawcett
reviews.text:
My husband and I have traveled near/far, in and outside of the US.  For several years, our dear friends have showed us some incredible destinations right at our one friend’s birthday.  We have been blown away by our previous adventures together but NONE as spectacular an experience as this getaway!!  From landing in this tropical paradise’s airport to pick up/delivery the resort,  it was a sensational, seamless journey.  Upon our arrival, the greeting & beauty surrounding blew us away!  We stayed in the private Reserve area for adults only.  We had our own private top-shelf tiki bar, private pool, and access to pristine beach right outside our door.  We had our own exclusive restaurant & could (and did) dine everywhere on the premises. I had three different kinds of caviar every day and incredible ceviche that would blow any fish lover away!  The resort is pristine, and the food was like art.  We felt like movie stars sitting on the set of White Lotus!  The nightlife and entertainment was beyond expectation.  It was private and romantic, yet beautiful families enjoyed there together.  We had such a special staff who made our friend’s birthday & entire stay together too-notch!  Yeison was so kind, thought forward, and denied us nothing to ensure an incredible time!  Marcus was a creative, thoughtful, & kind bartender who knew us too (& our fav drinks!)  This will go down as an all time favorite experience & destination.  We will be back!!
We are grateful to our beautiful friends for the spot-on choice to celebrate together.  We are grateful to our travel agent, Jenene, for a seamless vacation.

I cannot stop smiling thinking of our time here!

Getting our next visit on the calendar ASAP!!

reviews.author: Rhonda Staggs
reviews.text: Great resort!  Service was outstanding. Everyone was very friendly and went out of their way to serve you. Make sure to visit Antonio at the coffee bar!  He gave us excellent service every morning. The rooms are nice and comfortable. The property is extremely clean and everything is well run and organized.

reviews.author: Danny McSwiggan
reviews.text:
Garden view suite Reserved section

Check in: super fast efficient and easy. We never touched our bags and they were delivered to our rooms immediately.

Room service: Called at 11 pm and ordered a burger and Chicken nuggets. The burger was amazing and the nuggets were pure white meat but a bit doughy. Fries were warm. Food arrived in about 20 minutes.

This resort is the closest I have come to a 5 star. Everything seemed classier and we felt like royalty.

I contacted Alvaro Manuel at Reserved Guest Services before arriving and he ensured we had rooms on the second floor, that we were close to our friend who was traveling with us and that our first dinner reservation was made at Santé. He also made sure to come and see us during our stay and make sure we were happy.

Our butler, Harry was superb. He was so refined and personable. He noticed every detail and ensured all our reservations were made, delivered a bucket of ice every evening (usually with a bottle of quite good Chilean Merlot). He was constantly in communication  with us and sent us the reservation confirmation and the activity schedule every day. Such a pleasure. We will request him next time we stay at this resort.

Every single staff member at this resort was amazing. So professional and helpful and there was NEVER and expectation for a tip (although we tried to tip for every meal and service). You get what you give.

The resort is not too big and very walkable. Also very quiet and peaceful and well groomed.

Beach: groomed twice a day with a giant net in the ocean keeping the seaweed out. Plenty of super comfortable beach beds with 8 inch mattresses. Servers will usually follow you to the bed you want and clean it off, than place towels down and ask you for your first drink order. No silly towel rules, just go up to the hut and take what you need. NEVER had a trouble finding a nice comfortable beach bed, even after 10am.

Drinks: Bars are everywhere and getting service is never an issue. Ginger bar in the lobby does amazing coffees and specialty drinks. In the evening at the plaza there is a Mojito cart which does hand crafted specialty mojitos. The resorts frozen Pina Coladas are made with real pineapple and coconut.

Food: loved every restaurant but our favorite was Flora. Such a chill vibe and the food was amazing. Japanese was fun but the food is nothing special. Since we were Reserve, we went to Santé many times for breakfast and lunch. Both were excellent (omelettes, cappuccinos, fruit smoothies and much more). Lunch seemed to feature seafood like lobster, scallops, shrimp, etc and frequently and amazing beef tenderloin. Taco bar day was my favourite. The buffet was always great food but too noisy and chaotic for me. My tip is to sit outside at Kanna (great tacos and pulled pork) and get whatever food you like from the buffet. Ice cream at the buffet was really good. Friday is Dominican Day and the entire plaza is buzzing with vendors and food and drink.

We attempted to take the free/included catamaran trip but it was cancelled due to crappy weather. They provide towels and a snack BTW.

Workshops: 2 or more every day. We did several and they were free and fun. Go early since they fill up.

Nightly entertainment: Some sort of show every night. Nothing spectacular but always entertaining. Several nights had staff in costume taking pics with guest. Dance party outside the sports bar every night from 9 to 11pm.

Got some bug bites at night. My fault since I brought spray but didn't use it. If you don't bring enough sunscreen, you may have to sell a kidney to buy some at the resort store.

Shopping tip: We went to the downtown mall (Jumbo is amazing) and shopped at the 2 malls there. Uber to the mall was about $15 with tip. It was a fun rainy day activity.

Weather: rain forecasted everyday but really only rained one day. Umbrella in the room.

Thanks again Harry for making our stay so relaxing. Reserved Section is the way to go, so deluxe.

reviews.author: Andrea Alfaro
reviews.text: I had a really great time at this resort! The room was excellent it was clean with a lot of space and modern furnishing. The restaurants were all very delicious, I can say none were disappointing. Anayely was very kind, helpful, and attentive! She made sure to answer any questions or concerns we had as well as updating us on daily activities and other events. Also, the different daily activities were very fun my personal favorite was painting right by the beach. The service over all was super friendly from all the staff we encountered during our stay, I would definitely come back!

reviews.author: Rosanna Foti
reviews.text: At Restaurante Sante…Enrique, Rosa and Misael We’re absolutely incredible. The service was impeccable. The food was absolutely delicious and he was so entertaining throughout the whole meal. We are so appreciative of this enormous experience and recommend this to anyone coming to Punta Cana.  Visit the Paradisus Palma Real!!!

reviews.author: Rachel Parent
reviews.text: Do not go unless you buy all of the upgrades.  Event then, you can do better at this price point. Resort is practically empty and cannot get a dinner reservation.  Food at the buffet is barely edible and staff cannot be bothered.  Room is in disrepair.  There was a fight outside of my room at 2 AM and nobody answered the phone to come break it up.

reviews.author: Leslie Ruvalcaba
reviews.text:
Muy bien todo! Angleo los estaba manteniendo muy bien con bebidas y comida. El buffet was very good and had so many options for everyone. Everyone was so inviting and felt very safe for the whole family!
Amazing drinks and the sports bar was great to just walk in and grab a quick one!
Primera ves pero no la última🤗🤗

reviews.author: NKS TRANSPORT INC
reviews.text: The ambiance of the gin fee bar was stunning, and the staff’s professionalism added to the overall atmosphere. They went above and beyond to accommodate my requests, and their attention to detail did not go unnoticed thanks to Raysa , Anthony, Ismael , Maria, Domingo y Olga

reviews.author: K B
reviews.text: Had a fantastic week with the family.  Rooms were always clean and well stocked. We spent most of our days by the beach.  Had great service at the restaurants and buffet.  Shout out to Rosanna who was always quick with my tea and my husband’s coffee!!   Entertainment was good for older adults but my sons (M 20 & M 18) were hoping for a more lively nightlife.

reviews.author: Rob Owen
reviews.text: I want to highlight an outstanding dining experience at the Flora restaurant here - the Dominican style food has a lovely gourmet flare, and our server Cesar was a pure delight!

reviews.author: Mike Montemuro
reviews.text: Fantastic service, everyone is very nice and helped us with whatever we needed. Fernando was great and so helpful with getting us reservations at whatever restaurant we wanted to try that evening, and keeping us updated with activities. Would definitely recommend trying out Sante, Eduardo Jose and Amanda gave us excellent service and kept our glasses full! Also try out Flora for delicious Caribbean cuisine.  easily the two best restaurants on the resort. Overall a fantastic stay at this resort.

reviews.author: Ben Smith
reviews.text: We’ve had a lovely first day at Paradiso Palma Real. We swam in the ocean and the pool with a swim-up bar and both were warm and inviting! For dinner we went to Mascalzone. We had an antipasto to start, and a calzone and parpadelle for mains, with tiramisu and espresso and limoncello for dessert, all included. Our server Ana was very attentive and helpful. Looking forward to the rest of our stay!

reviews.author: Jalah Blackmon
reviews.text: Emmanuel and Jose were excellent bellboys! Very professional and nice! The bellhops, registration and food staff were all generally very kind and helpful. Housekeeping was not consistent in cleaning the room/offering new towels and washrags. Additionally the room service food was just okay, and we were unable to get reservations for dinner at the restaurants most night, which I didn’t really understand because it seemed they had the availability. Overall a great stay, but there were multiple instances were overall service quality could have been better.

reviews.author: Danielle Troupe
reviews.text: Manuel was great. Dinner and drinks were excellent

reviews.author: Shakaila Lincoln
reviews.text: This was a great experience from the moment we arrived to the resort to when we departed! During our stay we experienced 5 star service from everyone on the staff. Big thanks to Luis and Harry for being so helpful and making our stay and planning of days simple. Also Milton and his team are fantastic in the restaurants. Every meal was done with perfection. So so happy with this trip. We will definitely be back!!

reviews.author: Danielle Cohen
reviews.text:
We had the most amazing, relaxing, gorgeous vacation. I didn’t expect it to be so good. When arrived we had a problem with our rooms but the receptionists and the guest experience stuff were very kind and helped us with all needed (thank you Karlos and Juan)!!
The room service staff were also amazing- I didn’t expect having the room cleaned twice a day! The cleaning ladies are very kind and with positive energies a pleasure (thank you Liset and Anery we had room 9352 ;) )
The food - we were worried about the food, specially taking my 8 months old with us, but we were surprised and impressed from every single meal we had. The buffet was amazing morning, lunch and dinner. There are also other restaurants to make you feel like going out in the resort which were also a blast.
The amazing waiters that took such a great care of us made our meals even better (thank you Ricky and Rosanna).

** The spa prices are overpriced - personally we enjoyed the local vendors on the beach and had a few times foot massages.

We will definitely be back 😍😍😍😍

reviews.author: Sofia S
reviews.text: The food has been great, my personal favorite restaurant  is the hibachi one. It was great and the attention was as well. My favorite drink so far has been the strawberry daiquiri. The pools are great, their are so many options and it is very calm. The experience has been great and great location. A great worker was Rosanna, and Frank. They were very kind and very helpful. These workers are all very welcoming. It  was nice to have such great people serve us everyday and become friends with us. My family and I appreciated it a lot.

reviews.author: Stephanie Mahr
reviews.text: Ramon Rivas took amazing care of us on the beach. We have come for two vacations and each time Ramon greets us with wonderful hospitality and making sure we are comfortable all day on the beach. We tell him every year we come back because of him! Enjoy!

reviews.author: Don Vo
reviews.text:
FALSE 5/5 Ratings as there was a vendor night and you were to get all 8 stamps on this passport scavenger hunt in order to "win" a 2 night free stay. You locate staff members wearing white polos with red/blue stripes and they will stamp for you. Last one was to take a picture and post and give them 5/5 stars on google reviews. JAIRO took my phone and rated it 5/5 and asked us to put glowing reviews and add his name to it. I didn't do this as I thought it was a LIE and DECEIVING - no wonder google reviews has great reviews which again are BLATANT LIES. People are just doing it to try to win a prize!

Front Desk/Guest Services especially ALDO has an attitude, unfriendly and RUDE. This resort is DEAD so they are just lazy and didn't want to do their jobs.

Kids club is great - they are attentive and sweet with kids. Alexandra and other staff (forget name) were good with kids!

Food was ok - everything is the same every day. There was MOLD in bread and some of the food was cold (definitely leftover food). Some restaurants were closed as again the resort is DEAD. Staff was great especially JUAN. Always had a smile on his face and stopped by to talk when we saw each other.

Not alot of kid activities - more of an adult only resort. Kids were bored after a few days.

We had air conditioner issues due to room being warm and was set lowest to 69 degrees while other parties in our group's room were cold and could go way below 69. Was told several times from front desk that 69 degrees was the lowest or they will send someone up to fix it. NO ONE CAME AND WASN"T Fixed until we had to bicker and front desk told us they will fix thru computer??? If it was that easy to reboot thru computer, why couldn't they do it in the 1st place then give us all the trouble. Front desk seemed bothered with our request to fix the AC and they had such an attitude, rolling their eyes, unfriendly, rude. Again, they were NOT busy -just lack customer service and too lazy to do their job.

I DO NOT recommend this place. This is my honest review and not all the 5/5 ratings due to people trying to win a prize!

reviews.author: Ricardo Bueno
reviews.text: Wellington & Bory were such nice guys!! Very helpful for what we needed, they should be promoted ‘cause they’re very polite and happy employees that every company wish for. Thumbs up 100 times!

reviews.author: Guillermo Calderon
reviews.text: We had a great time at Palma Real. Went to Flora restaurant and Cesar took care of everything for us. He recommended some great dishes that were winners for us. And the service was superb. 100%

reviews.author: Agata Porębska
reviews.text: reservation via booking: no possibility to pay via Booking, price at the reception is higher + taxes.  The service in the main restaurant was so-so, in the Italian restaurant it was great.  Great child care.  Beautiful rooms and good layout.  There was no tasty coffee with milk, and I received the coffee I ordered in a cafe in a paper cup, only after asking for a cup, I poured it myself.  The best coffee in the room.  If we only talked about the rooms, it would be great.  The service is average, although they seem to take care of everything, the result is what it is.  The food is not very tasty, but it looks beautiful.  great first impression.

reviews.author: Monique Lunn
reviews.text: Best place we have been in Dominican. Loved the original Paradisus Punta Cana and this is just a newer slightly bigger version. Rooms are spacious with a great modem layout. Enjoyed the adults only section with pool that we never fought over lounge chairs or waited long at the swim up bar. Everything is close enough it was easy to figure out where to go. 24 hour Ginger Bar is perfect for late arrivals or early departures with lots of various coffee options for whatever ales you. We will be back, maybe even may be our go to for Punta Cana. Flora resturant was wonderful and meal was amazing. Katty at the Ginger Bar was so sweet and one of the best servers at the resort.

reviews.author: Somadina Okam
reviews.text: Loved staying at this hotel! The staff are super friendly and helpful! I recommend you come and ask for Jholfry/Octopus (beach or pool area) if you want some dance lessons!

reviews.author: Paula Aristizabal
reviews.text: Our first time here at the resort. It is spectacular and the service is excellent. Everything is very clean and there are many options for food. Our favorite restaurant was Mina and the waiter Olvi rendered great service. We recommend the Veal Picaña. The beach does get algae in the morning but then clears up. Wonderful vacation time.

reviews.author: Joe Meireles
reviews.text: What a vacation! The place is gorgeous and the experience was perfect. Thanks to Guillermo Joshua, we had professional, prompt, and friendly attention. Highly recommend it!

reviews.author: estephania gonzalez
reviews.text: Jose De Rosario is the best! He went out of his way to bring us a cappuccino and we were so grateful. Kicks Sports Bar has a great ambiance and the service is 10/10!

reviews.author: Elena Favorido
reviews.text:
Beautiful facility overall, pools, beach access, restaurants. The highlight of our vacation was the activities' team and the many activities offered. Big shout out to Soranyi, Carlito, Freilyn, Jholfry and Jairo, great energy! The Dominican night was fun, but prepare to negotiate the prices if you plan to buy any souvenir..
Our room wasn't ready at the time of check-in and when we finally got in, there were still the ladies finishing up the beds. Some details were not on point for a 5 star resort, like a broken toilet seat, reading lamps not working, the safe buttons needed to be pushed super hard, the cleaning could be improved, the door had a gap and you could see the light and hear every noise from outside. We had to call the room service a few times as they missed stuff, like they took the shower mat and didn't replace it, or the tissues box was empty and didn't refill.. The staff would just randomly barge in the room for cleaning without knocking or ringing the bell.
Some of the waiters could use a smile, especially at the buffet, not impressed with the service. The food was good at the restaurants a la cart, but even with the rsvp we had long waiting time and missed a couple of night shows because of that. Lot of variety at the buffet but after sitting at room temperature for a while, some food didn't look safe to eat, like sushi, cheese and even fruit.

reviews.author: stephany ruiz
reviews.text: Raul is the absolute best beach host ! Every morning he would save me my chair so I could have my favorite spot on the beach, constantly made sure my family and i were well during our stay at the beach.  Truly a wonderful person inside and out , always such a pleasure to see him ! Another person who deserves to be mentioned is Starlin Tavarez he is the best concierge if you’re looking for someone who will take care of you and your family during your stay he is the person to go to. He made our reservations for dinner, provided the best room services , always made sure we had nothing but the best. He was so attentive to my family and I,  we are always so happy to be under his care. we couldn’t have asked for better service! Last but certainly not least, Jesus our waiter he’s another person who is an absolute joy to see when we come here. He gave us 10/10 service no matter where we went he would follow to provide the best services. Our lunches were out of this world everyday thanks to him and the birthday dinner he held for us was so wonderful and special. The amount of love and effort that was put into our stay is remarkable, it is our greatest pleasure to have these men apart of our team not only as friends but family. They are the reason why we come here , Thank you for all your hard work ! Until next time

reviews.author: Tyra Warner
reviews.text: Had a wonderful stay at Paradisus Palma Real. Kevin Fernandez, our concierge, was quick to offer assistance regarding anything we needed. He even picked up distilled water for my CPAP machine when there was none available on property. The adults-only pool was relaxing. The beach was beautiful and the water turquoise although rough because of the season. I didn’t enjoy all the people selling things on the beach, although they weren’t persistent and took “no” as an answer very gracefully. Blue Agave was our favorite restaurant. We also tried Flora and the Mediterranean restaurant. I ate breakfast and lunch in the Lunch Box, the buffet. It was okay.  Lots of choices but food and service quality were 4-star, not 5. Hence the rating.  On my last morning, one of the servers accidentally broke a glass and 20 minutes later when I left, it still wasn’t cleaned up. Seemed dangerous. Overall a good, low-key relaxing vacation.

reviews.author: Carlos Freitas
reviews.text: Joanna was the best. She has the best activities. And loved our children while we were there. I would do it again 100%. No doubt.

reviews.author: Jeisy Herrera Ramirez
reviews.text: Super great service. All the team made our dinner awesome. Shoutout to Hansel, Julian , the chef, frank you guys made sure we enjoyed our dinner and our Asian experience! Thank you so much

reviews.author: Matt Crosser
reviews.text: The team at the Ginger bar was great in the morning and evening … Ismael, Jorge, Clari, Olga, Anyi for coffee and Miguil and Ingri for the best cocktails. Our family had a blast!

reviews.author: Rosemary Nunez
reviews.text:
Staff very friendly, attentive and helpful.
Raul by the pool was awesome.  Will highly recommend.  Food options were great and diverse.

reviews.author: Cassi Dow
reviews.text: The service was great, but Raul was by far the best! He set us up with cabanas each day we came to the beach, and was very nice and made sure we never had an empty drink at the beach or pool! Awesome service and hospitality!

reviews.author: Courtney L
reviews.text: At the Flora Bar Juan, Randy and Miguel made us some awesome customized drinks off the whim. Best bar tenders thus far at the resort. Ese es mi chicos!! Lol Thanks fellas for the experience! Keep pumping out the drinks. Fausto at the Italian restaurant was most accommodating. Very professional and attentive. The grilled Octopus was awesome. Loved it all. We will be back..🤗

reviews.author: Gisela Carballido
reviews.text:
We had an extraordinary experience at Paradisus Palma Real.
The whole environment is stunning (garden, rooms). The tranquility was a dream.

Our last breakfast at the buffet was very pleasant thanks to the attention to details by Maria Mercedes and Rosanna Hernandez.

We found here all we look for a vacation and plan to return very soon.

Thank you for making us feel at home away from home.

reviews.author: Simi Rozick
reviews.text: Rosanna Yamuna and Maria were all wonderful for breakfast

reviews.author: Gisselle Montes de Oca
reviews.text: We went to Blueagave, the Mexican Restaurant, and service was great. The ambiance was excellent too. Music volume, lights, everything. Melqui was so nice and attentive too. I recommend it, 100%.

reviews.author: Maria Rago
reviews.text: Had a drink at Ginger bar;  Yiri, and Luis were amazing.   Our entire stay was incredible.  Our concierge, Lewis, was extremely helpful and friendly.   Pedro took such a good care of us by the beach and kept us laughing. What a fantastic guy.  Everyone  was so friendly and accommodating.  It truly was a great, fun, and relaxing vacation.

reviews.author: Sasha Petty
reviews.text: We love it here! It’s our third time here. The activities are the best. Our daughter loves Kidsdom - yesterday they had the best Easter egg hunt and crafts. Martha at Kidsdom is just the sweetest and so welcoming. For adults, the pool classes (dance and fitness), mixology and art classes, and live music are amazing. Food has been really good (especially the restaurants) and the staff is the best. We will be back!!

reviews.author: Victoria Safarian
reviews.text:
Loved our stay, the beach is amazing! Our suite was spotless and spacious!
Best restaurant was Flora! The food is delicious and so fresh! Service was impeccable, our server Ceasar and Adriana were excellent!
Kidsdom was awesome! Team does a stellar job taking care and entertaining kids! We are so grateful for their hard work!!!!

reviews.author: Diane Kowal
reviews.text: This is a great resort. Everything is in close proximity and very easy to navigate. The staff have been wonderful, especially Brandol, one of the entertainment team. As a solo traveller he always was there to make sure that I was looked after. The room was lovely. I was in the Reserve section and could see both sunrise and sunset, as well as overlooking the adults only pools. I would highly recommend this resort. I’m looking forward to my next visit.

reviews.author: Megan Sears
reviews.text: Amazing trip! Third stay at Paradisus Palma Real and each is better than the last! Angelo kept us hydrated all day at the pool with a smile. Yuderi picked us the best loungers at the beach. Dorca provided super relaxing services at the spa! Splurge for the swim up suite at the reserve! Yalheidi was the best concierge booking us all our dinner reservations and spa appointments and taking such good care of us the whole time! 10/10

reviews.author: Davin Lawton-Bryce
reviews.text: Hotel was really nice. Swim up room worked really well, and the pool connected to the main pool. Would say the rooms were a little dated. Staff were lovely but could have been a little more attentive at times. Stuff for the kids to do, but wouldn't say it a main focus for the hotel. But nothing to detract from the experience. Would recommend

reviews.author: Lavondra Ransom
reviews.text: Yaleidi was awesome. Very attentive even after her hours. She went over and beyond to make sure we enjoyed. Very nice and customer service oriented. Ask for her personally. She will not disappoint.

reviews.author: zahira mella
reviews.text: My husband and I got here on Wednesday. We have had a wonderful experience so far. The service and the food are good. Our best service so far has been in the adults pool. Our favorite bartenders, Carolin and Rosanna, are the BEST. They have made our trip amazing so far.

reviews.author: Armi Bernier
reviews.text: The bartenders at the Kicks are the best. Professionals and respectful...

reviews.author: Carlos Jimenez
reviews.text:
This was probably the worst experience I’ve had at an all-inclusive. I’ve stayed at Melia hotels in Spain and Italy and always received amazing service and hospitality however this was not the case with their Punta Cana resort.

I booked an oceanfront suite that would lead us right into the beach for our anniversary. They put us in the wrong room, a junior suite instead of the regular suite. When I told our “VIP concierge” he said he would look into it and after I followed up with him twice he had no answer for me.

We couldn’t get reservations for any of the restaurants even though we had our “VIP concierge” since we booked at the reserve.

The service was horrible. I had to get up and get water for ourselves when we were seated at a table for over 30 minutes. Then on another occasion we had been sitting and no one brought us utensils and I had to take them from another empty table. The buffet was bland and the food looked like it had been sitting there for hours.

It is the absolute last time I will ever visit this resort or any of the Melia Punta Cana resorts. Horrible experience.

reviews.author: Roger Geng
reviews.text:
Overall a great experience here definitely recommended. The beach and swimming pool were literally a 2 min walk from our room that made it absolutely amazing. The staff here were very friendly especially Ernesto that made an extra effort to welcome us here. The food at flora was very good, however I found the other restaurants and especially room service to have very bland food.
Room service was a little disappointing given that they were constantly out of any beverage on the menu. The drinks at the bar were a little light on the liquors. We were very satisfied with the room, it was very spacious and comfortable, with the exception that the hot water was not there 100% of the time.

Overall would recommend, but lower your standards for the food!

reviews.author: Deepa Shankar
reviews.text: During our stay at the Paradisus Palma, we chose to dine at the Blue Agave Mexican restaurant on our first night. The welcoming atmosphere and warm ambiance set the tone for a wonderful evening. Jael, the manager, went above and beyond to accommodate our complex drink order with patience and care, ensuring we felt truly valued. Our waiter, Jose, was incredibly attentive, taking the time to explain the menu in detail to our group of seven. The dining experience, along with the delicious food, made our first evening of vacation unforgettable. Thank you!

reviews.author: Jeanne McDougall
reviews.text: We had a great time. Your grounds are beautiful! We loved Luis  at the main swim up bar. He was so friendly and fun. Ruby at the Italian restaurant bar was so sweet. She went out of her way to find me the wine of my preference. Alvaro was a great concierge. He helped us with reservations and car pick up. So helpful and so nice.

reviews.author: Chas Whisner
reviews.text: Kicks sport bar very good service and friendly staff, great food and drink. Luis and staff do very good job👍👍

reviews.author: Wayne Bleich
reviews.text: We had the Best Service Ever! Our people Ariel my concierge and Aristide pool beach concierge  Luis bartender were so on point we couldn’t have ever been more Proud and Pleased with all of them. I will recommend anyone to come to this Resort. Beyond Fun and so Beautiful.

reviews.author: jim mayer
reviews.text: Angelo was the best! We never ran out of beer or drinks!

reviews.author: Deanique Gajo
reviews.text: We went to Palma Real on our honeymoon and had an amazing time! The food was good and the staff was so kind. The beach and everything around the resort was beautiful!! We will be back!

reviews.author: Isabel Lopes
reviews.text: This an amazing resort and we were here last 2 years ago. The upgrades to the resort are amazing and more family friendly. We stayed at the Reserve this time and Hector was our great concierge who quickly resolved a room leak issue and had us moved. He provided the best service overall and for a great NYE experience. The resort was super energetic and staff accommodating during a fully booked timing.

reviews.author: Richa Dutta
reviews.text: We had a pleasant experience here. The beach views are gorgeous, the pools are well maintained but all services come for a price. Be ready to tip a lot to get your drinks, any food or even towels.

reviews.author: Ashley Lassis
reviews.text: Had the BEST meals at Flora restaurant. AUTHENTIC Dominican food, exactly what I was looking for. Lived every single meal. Cesar(our server) was great with recommendations and offered us multiple meals to try all they had to offer. LOVED IT!

reviews.author: Renee Daniel
reviews.text:
Wonderful service and delicious Mexican food at the Blue Agave! Delvin made sure we had an amazing time and took time to make the birthday girl feel special. Best food at the resort!!

Ruby at the Between Lounge Bar makes the BEST Moscow Mule!!

reviews.author: Abdulaziz Ozden
reviews.text:
A disappointing start to our honeymoon

We checked in today for our honeymoon stay. During the booking process, I clearly mentioned that this trip was for our honeymoon, and I even called the hotel to confirm. They told me that as long as we informed the front desk upon arrival, they would take care of everything.

However, the first thing we were met with at check-in was an aggressive attempt to upsell us to a more expensive room for $2,900 USD. When we declined, they kept lowering the price little by little, which felt pushy and insincere.

To be honest, this whole experience drained our energy from the very start. Instead of feeling welcomed and excited, we began our honeymoon with zero morale. Very disappointing treatment from a hotel we expected so much more from on such a special occasion.

Note: I truly hope you will be able to change this perception. I will sincerely update my review after I leave the hotel, based on the overall experience.

reviews.author: Supreme Paving
reviews.text: Good hotel. Beautiful property. Didn’t like that the rooms actually have full size beds versus queen as advertised. Customer service was exceptional specially from my new lovely friend Arisleida at the pool. She made our stay way better with her attention and kindness

reviews.author: Joe Rath
reviews.text: All of the food is excellent, especially at the Lunchbox daily buffet where you can eat with a gorgeous beach view. Extensive variety and always fresh. The service is phenomenal. Yeffry, Yuderqui, Yessica and Yorgelis are very friendly and attentive. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Shelly Sharma
reviews.text:
Beautiful hotel! Views are amazing, hotel staff was equally amazing. Everyone was very attentive and provided great customer service. Our concierge Juan Carlos was amazing- he helped us out so much! Bartender Luis was the best! Jordania was amazing!

Cons- everything closes at 10pm.. we came here on a friends trip and this hotel isn’t a party hotel. We spent a lot of time off the resort doing excursions.

reviews.author: Kermen Bembeeva
reviews.text: I wouldn't recommend book a room on the first floor.  I saw bugs crawling all the time. They didn't prepare our room, there was water all over the bathroom and it was really humid in the room. AC didn't work properly, but they fixed it. Another thing is that we were told by concierge that we don't need to make a reservation to a restaurant, turns out that you have to. Food was okay but service is good

reviews.author: Laurie
reviews.text: My sister and I just  left here after  spending five days here it was amazing. The resort is beautiful And very big. Beautiful pools our room was beautiful. We didn’t have a swim up room, but our room was just as nice and had a hot tub outside. We didn’t use it though.. my sister and I did quite a few of excursions. I booked an excursion on my own. Thinking it would be OK. The resort did give us a hard time leaving and didn’t want to shuttle us down to the gate. So just be aware of that if you book things on your own. I didn’t feel like there was a lot of Entertainment at night as well . I didn’t like the food very well, so I ended up not eating a lot. The Japanese restaurant I think was my favorite out of all of them. The food was very freshly made right in front of you. I felt like the other food was well overcooked and sat there for too long. The staff is amazing. Everybody was so kind . You can tell they’re very hard workers..  The spotlight for me goes out to Eriol  Alix . Our concierge. He was amazing. He went above and beyond to help My Sister and I whatever we needed. He got us water wine whatever we needed kept us well stocked. He would send me an itinerary every day . And message me good morning every day and how our night was. Upon checking out, we couldn’t find one of our bags and he stopped what he was doing and went and found our bag and took a picture and sent it to me . He is very good at his job and I heard good things from my other friends about him as well. Everybody adored him in our group. If anybody goes to this resort, ask for Eriol Alix , he will hook you up with everything or assist you .  I do give this resort a five star rating because it was beautiful and clean and the service was awesome! Thank you

reviews.author: kiara edmunds
reviews.text: my amigo alberto is the best. he is the bartender at the pool bar celsio and he brings the best drinks and energy!!!! he has a great smile and is lots of fun!!! try and get him if you can as a tender! everyone at the bar celsius is amazing! also victor was great and deserves a shout out too

reviews.author: Maria Amelia Machin
reviews.text:
As a travel advisor with over 30 years of experience curating luxury stays for discerning travelers, I’ve learned to recognize the true gems in hospitality — those that go far beyond expectations. Paradisus Palma Real is one of those rare finds.

From the moment you arrive, the experience is elevated. The rooms are spacious, spotless, and thoughtfully designed for maximum comfort. I pay close attention to beds and pillows (a detail my clients know I never overlook), and here, the bedding is simply perfect — soft, supportive, and luxurious.

The layout of the resort makes all common areas easily accessible, inviting guests to relax and move about effortlessly. Whether you’re heading to the pool, spa, beach, or a restaurant, it all feels seamless and serene.

Now, when it comes to all-inclusive properties, people often imagine large quantities of average food — but not here. At Paradisus Palma Real, each restaurant is a fine dining experience. Every dish is beautifully crafted, and best of all, personalized service is at the heart of the culinary journey. The chefs and staff take the time to understand each guest’s preferences, including dietary needs and special touches, delivering meals that feel tailored and memorable.

What truly sets this property apart is the attentive and enthusiastic team. Each guest is cared for by a dedicated staff member who brings genuine warmth, empathy, and joy to their service. Whether you’re traveling solo or with a large family, the staff makes it their mission to ensure everyone feels seen and celebrated.

And the activities? Simply fantastic. They’re diverse, creative, and fun — from relaxing moments to energizing adventures. I was truly impressed by the balance of luxury and playfulness.

✨ In short, Paradisus Palma Real redefines what it means to be all-inclusive. It’s an experience of personalized luxury, heartfelt hospitality, and thoughtful details that make all the difference. Highly recommended.
@viajesprincipal.usa

reviews.author: Anthony Chaloner
reviews.text:
I will start by saying that the property is beautiful, modern and high end feeling. The staff are very nice and helpful and when we arrived, Antonio made us feel welcome and appreciated and he did everything he could to get us the best room possible and we were very grateful to him.

That being said, there seems to be a major issue with staff communication at the resort between departments and the Melia call centre employees. We were told ahead of time when we called that there were no microwaves in any rooms, and when we arrived there was one in our room, which was quite frustrating as that would have changed how we packed with a newborn baby. We also only had one tiny garbage in our bathroom for the whole room and when we asked for a larger bin for the kitchenette we were told there were no other bins available. We also had to call multiple times every time we needed something because hours would go by and they would clearly forget about us. Their housekeeping was pretty bad and inconsistent with restocking water and drinks in the fridge and ignored our requests for extra garbage bags etc.

I thought the quality of the property and amenities was good value, but the issues we had this week were quite frustrating and would make it tough to want to come back.

reviews.author: Jaidy Lopez
reviews.text: My family and I had the best experience at Paradisus Palma Real Punta Cana! Management and staff were so helpful, sweet, professional and fun! Carlos and Rodolfo in the front desk were so helpful and accommodating. Absolutely fantastic customer service.  Make sure to visit the lobby bar Ginger Bar and say hi to Maria S and Anthony for the yummiest drinks.  Make sure to ask Anthony for his morning pick me up, the Anthony special! Delicious espresso slushie drink :) Luis at the pool bar, Celsius, was so friendly and fun and Jorge too! The adults only pool bar also had the sweetest waitress and so attentive! I wish I could remember her name but she was wonderful. Rosaniris and her team member did a beautiful job with the room service and I loved catching up with them in the morning on our way out for breakfast!  Marileisy was fantastic! So was Pedro and Rafael at the reserve beach. The beach services were wonderful and attentive! Ricardo, Edgardo, Francesca, Gustavo and Olvi from the restaurant services were a pleasure during our dining experiences! There were so many wonderful staff members that I wish I could recall all their names! The whole team made my mom's 70th birthday so special. It is a beautiful, clean resort with great customer service, good food and wonderful ambiance. We will definitely be visiting again :) Thank you for a wonderful experience!

reviews.author: Bilha Garcia
reviews.text:
The experience at Paradisus Palma Real has been surreal. Our room was beautiful and clean with new sheets and towels everyday. Another of our favorite spot was the ginger bar. It has a great atmosphere and has been an amazing experience. Our bartender Antonio was such a great person to talk to he joked around and knows how to make a great Mocaccino 👍.  The crew, Olga, Domingo, Maria, and Clari were also so amazing and welcoming. The welcoming staff and our personal concierge Rosemary was top notch. She answered our questions in a timely manner and went above and beyond to make sure our accommodation and requests were met. Our favorite restaurant was Flora and our now friend Andrea was also amazing, we had great laughs and conversation. So far this place has been amazing to my husband and myself and created an amazing experience on our first ever resort trip. 10/10 I recommend.

My only suggestion is to have someone update the activities board on the days some of the activities are canceled or changed due to wheather reasons. Also, during the activities, a person to get the crowd and the vibes going would be awsome.

reviews.author: Point and Balance Acupuncture
reviews.text: This hotel was wonderful! We couldn’t have had a better experience. Adults were happy, kids were happy. We will definitely be back. Rooms are clean, entertainment is great. Alexander was wonderful in the Mexican Restaurant, George was great. Wiley, Our concierge was quick to take care of any needs we had. The guy around the pool checking in if we needed anything, got me everything we needed.

reviews.author: Zarif Hanif
reviews.text:
This island is truly beautiful, and the people are incredibly friendly. I wish I had only positive things to say, but unfortunately, our experience at the resort was quite challenging. We arrived around 5 PM on Tuesday to celebrate my niece’s birthday, choosing this location because it was advertised as a preferred Jet Blue luxury vacation.

Arrival and Room Issues
Upon arriving at 5 PM, it took us over an hour to check into our room in Building 4, Room 15, on the first floor. From the moment we walked in, the room smelled musty and moldy, and the air conditioning wasn’t working. The outside temperature was 79°F, but inside the room, it was an uncomfortable 85°F, making it hotter inside than outdoors.

After five hours of frustrating back-and-forth calls to the front desk, I finally went there in person. At around 10 PM, they agreed to move us to a different room, but by that time, my two children, ages 2 and 6, had been baking in the overheated, musty room for hours. We were relocated to Building 1, Room 15, where the AC worked, and it smelled much better. However, the room was missing basic amenities such as robes, toothpaste, and an iron. At that point, I was just relieved to have a functioning AC and let the other issues go.

Room Conditions
The rooms are equipped with twin beds, which are extremely small, similar to dorm room beds. There’s also a full-size pull-out bed, but it’s uncomfortable and springy. When we checked in, we were told that our room options were limited because we had children under 18, leaving us with no choice but to accept this room type.

Problems Encountered
No Hot Water: Hot water was a rare occurrence during our stay. For a resort marketed as a luxury destination, this was unacceptable.

Broken Bathroom Fixtures: The bathroom fixtures were poorly maintained. The faucet was loose and barely attached to the wall, which added to the frustration of dealing with an already malfunctioning room.

Odor: Our initial room had a strong musty odor that made it uncomfortable to stay in.

Unresponsive Front Desk: I requested several items from the front desk, including an iron, shampoo, body wash, and a robe. Although the shampoo and body wash were eventually provided, I never received the iron, forcing me to borrow one from a family member staying two buildings over.

Outdoor Bathtub and Cabana Issues: The outdoor bathtub, which lacked a proper cover, was filled with leaves and dirt, rendering it completely unusable. The outdoor garden cabana was in a similar condition, neglected and dirty, making it impossible to enjoy.

Staff and Language Barrier
Despite these issues, I must commend the housekeeping, waitstaff, and chefs. They were incredibly friendly, helpful, and did their best to accommodate us. However, there was a significant language barrier for English-speaking guests. While the staff was somewhat familiar with basic English phrases, many things were lost in translation. Although this is understandable, given that this is a Spanish-speaking island, it still posed some challenges for us. It’s not the staff’s fault, but it's something to be aware of when visiting.

Overall Experience
Overall, I love the island and the friendly people, but this resort is definitely not a well-maintained facility. Having traveled to multiple destinations and stayed at many resorts, I can confidently say that we will not be visiting this resort again, nor any resort managed by this holding group. It has not been a good experience. We still have a few more days here and will try to make the most of it, but that’s as far as it goes.

reviews.author: christine cullen
reviews.text: What a fantastic vacation! The service was top-notch. The employees cannot do enough to help you. The rooms are so pretty. I stayed in the adult only area and it was so peaceful and relaxing. Make sure you eat at Flora and Blue Agave. They are both delicious. The food at Buffet has great options. Flora has an amazing wait staff and the food is beyond delicious. The same goes for Blue Agave. Overall this has been a wonderful vacation. Jose Ramirez our bellhop was so helpful.  He took care of everything for me. From checking in to making sure I had transportation to take me to the casino. Everyone just goes out of their way to assist you.  The beach had plenty of chairs and umbrellas as did the pools. Highly recommend. I am definitely going back!!!!

reviews.author: Aditya Hublikar
reviews.text: Italian restaurant - amazing food and service! Our waitress Yuleni was so attentive with special attention from the supervisor Milton. My wife is gluten free and they went above and beyond to accommodate her dietary restrictions. Would recommend anyone to come here to have a great time

reviews.author: Charla Pritchett
reviews.text: Having a great time with Angelo great service and he takes care of his people

reviews.author: Mark Tofan
reviews.text: Our family had an absolutely amazing experience. The staff was extremely friendly and always willing to help. Special mentions to Antonio, Franklin and William from guest services who were very helpful to address any questions we had. Would definitely come back to this resort.

reviews.author: Jessica Warren
reviews.text:
Beautiful resort. Clean, comfortable, and in a great location. Only about 20 minute shuttle ride from Punta Cana airport. Felt very safe and secure everywhere on the resort property.

The staff was extremely kind and attentive throughout our visit. Luis at the main pool bar, Milton in the Mascalzone dining room, and the entire staff at Blue Agave were particularly good.

While families are clearly welcomed, there didn’t seem to be a ton of children’s activities or play areas. I was happy with this - I’m a parent, but this was a couple’s trip.

Food was better than expected for an all-inclusive and we were happy with the variety and freshness of both buffet and table service restaurants. Only watch-out is that compared to our preferences at home in the USA, the food had very little spice and was consistently very mild. We both drink and found the included options to be totally solid - if you can’t find something on their menu to enjoy on the beach or with dinner, then all-inclusives probably aren’t your speed.

We chose to stay at the resort for nearly all of our trip. The activities were high-quality, but the schedule was light - likely due to visiting during the low season when the resort was clearly well below capacity. We saw the pools cleaned daily and all common areas were clean and very well maintained. Everything in our room was clean, stocked, in proper working order, and the housekeeping team was very responsive

Beach was very clean and despite being public in DR, not too many pushy vendors. My only complaint was small - the resort has Bali beds for rent that are set in front of all the beach seating areas. I didn’t see a single one occupied all week (they’re extremely overpriced in my opinion) and they blocked the views from all other beach loungers.

Would definitely return again for a couple’s trip or with older (teen) children.

reviews.author: Katie Hennessey
reviews.text:
The Ginger bar is fantastic.  Best service.  Especially Ismael!  My kids were welcomed and were able to order smoothies in Spanish.  Incredibly welcoming and best coffee on the resort!

We also truly loved going to the Mascalzones restaurant.  In particular Fausto went above and beyond in making sure my wife and two young sons had an exceptional time at the restaurant. Not only did he provide excellent service, but he engaged with our kids and our interactions with him was one of the bright spots of our entire vacation. We were also extremely well taken care of by Ana, Maximo, and the restaurant manager Milton.

reviews.author: Jeff S
reviews.text:
Completed a stay with my daughter a couple weeks ago and had such a wonderful time at this resort. From the moment we checked in and met Felix our concierge, we were treated extremely well and our every need was taken care of by Felix and his team.
The dining and service were both excellent. Our favorite two restaurants were Sante and Flora.
While we were there, the resort was experiencing an unusually quiet time, so I’d like to give extreme thanks and appreciation for how hard Danyelo worked with us and the other guests to keep everyone involved and having a great time. Brandol also provided amazing guest interactions.
Looking forward to returning.

reviews.author: Camin Cohen
reviews.text:
Came here to celebrate my boyfriend’s birthday.

Overall, it was a beautiful hotel. The rooms were clean and nice. The resorts is really big
There is a separate area for adults, only which was really nice
The staff are nice, welcoming, but I expected a little bit more nicer service .
Food and the drinks are all inclusive indeed, but we didn’t really eat there because the food was not so good
so we ended up going to a different restaurant outside of the hotel, but the food is decent .

The location of the hotel was good, but a little bit further away from the main beaches, but you can go for a walk throughout the beach and enjoy.

Recommend

reviews.author: Joanne Gaccione
reviews.text: Rosanna, the waitress near the pool, was excellent! She made sure we had everything we needed and brought a big smile everyday. Her warmth and attention made our vacation especially memorable!

reviews.author: M Bungert
reviews.text: The service on the beach was top notch,Yuderi took care of our drinks, reserved our spots, made sure we had what we needed, made the best aleros soritz, and they have most comfortable beach beds ever. The adult side is where it’s at! Also, Walquiria in the lobby bar makes the best espresso martinis and they have fresh juices at the bar, which doubles as a coffee and juice bar all day! We loved the fresh ginger juice!

reviews.author: Philippe J
reviews.text:
Lovely and aesthetic place! Great time at the buffet, shoutout to our server Andrea at night! She was terrific at all times. Will definitely recommend this place to friends and family. It has activities for all types of families, couples, and individuals.

Check out was very seamless! Jose handled our bags and transport very professional and fast. The whole staff is amazing!

reviews.author: Iris Lo
reviews.text:
A very nice getaway! It was our first time at any resort, and we really enjoyed the pools and beach access, especially being so close since we booked the reserve. Our concierge was Juan Carlos, and he was very kind and patient and answered all our questions promptly.

Other highlights were Malcazones, the Italian restaurant (which Juan Carlos helped us get reservations to twice). Our server was Raider, who was very sweet, as was the manager Milton.

We also had daily stops at Ginger, managed by Ismael. We got iced coffee every day, and it was delicious!

reviews.author: Gail Crowley
reviews.text: Absolutely, beautiful wonderful people place and food The best  print your name stormin we had the buffet for breakfast we’ve come for lunch. We absolutely love this resort this food and the service. we also ate at Santa tonight an adults only restaurant which was phenomenal  it was an four star restaurant by far wonderful drinks, delicious upgrade food, and the best service you could want. reviews.author: Daniel Jung
reviews.text:
Paradisus Palma Real Golf & Spa Resort has been one of my favorite all-inclusive resorts in the world, and this was my second time staying here. My first trip was during the pandemic, and despite the restrictions, I had an absolutely amazing experience. The resort is beautiful, the food is top-notch, and the service is generally fantastic.

However, I have to say that my most recent experience was marred by one major issue: the resort's strict policy on outside excursions. For over a decade, I’ve been using Viator and booking excursions all around the world without issue. I arrived in the Dominican Republic with a list of pre-booked activities, only to find out that the resort doesn’t allow any outside companies to pick up guests for excursions. This was incredibly frustrating, especially since I had already paid for the excursions in advance.

To make matters worse, when I asked about arranging a car service to the airport (since outside services aren't allowed), I was quoted an outrageous $300 for a simple transfer. Meanwhile, my group's airport transportation to the resort in a suburban was only $70. This felt like a blatant attempt to funnel guests into the resort's own overpriced excursions and transportation services, which seemed like a monopoly and left a very bad taste in my mouth.

It’s disappointing to see a resort with such a strong reputation engage in practices like this that feel exploitative. While the resort itself is still beautiful and offers a great all-inclusive experience, I really hope they reconsider their policies to allow outside excursion services. It’s a shame that such a wonderful place is tarnished by this unnecessary and frustrating issue.

reviews.author: Renée Mianowski
reviews.text: The ginger bar was an amazing experience. They have all sorts of drinks like smoothies, coffee, juices and alcohol which are delicious. The service at the bar was also excellent. Antonio, Dominga, Altagracia, Olga, Nereida, and Clari were super friendly and made the experience exceedingly enjoyable! They made sure we were well taken care of and even made drinks especially for us, which were Dominican staples. I loved this trip and me and my family hope to come back soon!!

reviews.author: Monica Niculcea
reviews.text: Dinner as Mescalzone was delicious the food was just amazing especially when you finish off with an expresso. The atmosphere was welcoming and kind. Next time you don't know where to eat come here.

reviews.author: Darya Berger
reviews.text: I just had an amazing stay in Paradisus Palma Real! The hotel is beautiful, located right on the beach, with excellent food, beverages, and entertainment. The staff is very helpful and go above and beyond to ensure your perfect stay there. My concierge Eriol was great and took care of any questions or requests that I had. I will definitely be back again!

reviews.author: Tonia Edwards
reviews.text: SHOUT.OUT.TO.GINGER.BAR! the staff was incredible,  especially my girl Andreina for making this solo travel feel safe and loved.  You were all so incredible.  Canada love is being sent your way, thank you for your incredible professional and kindness.  See you next time!

reviews.author: Dee DeGrushe
reviews.text: Had a wonderful time at this resort.  Juan Carlos and Nathanael our concierges were excellent. They helped with anything we needed or wanted.    The concierge VIP service was outstanding.      The beach staff on the reserve side were top notch.  Pedro, Rafael and Gilbert were just amazing.   They knew how to take care of us at the beach. They made us feel special.    Highly recommend!!

reviews.author: Karen Bastian
reviews.text: Mina restaurant was phenomenal!  Great staff and fantastic food and service

reviews.author: Jamila Austin
reviews.text: The service was great. Vianny (waitress) and Jose  del Rosario (manager) at Kicks bar were amazing. Would definately visit again. Enjoyed the setup, tvs and pool table..drinks were also really good..

reviews.author: Leandro Luna
