reviews.text: You gotta go to Flora Restaurant and meet Cesar. He is amazingly great at service and knows the menu back and forward. He and Wolfan (concierge) helped with a surprise for my wife's Bday! Great cake and great surprised. She loved it! THANK YOU!

reviews.author: Raymond Sue
reviews.text:
Bittersweet Review

Beautiful weather . Beautiful resort.
Great place to be at if you’re coming from a colder country.
However, my overall experience was a let down.
Checked in first day. Missing 2nd balcony chair. Requested many, many times for additional chair as all units have 2 accessible for their stay. Staff followed up with a phone call but did not bring the second chair the whole visit.

Food was good. Buffet was tasty, and al la carte was entertaining. Housekeeping kept room tidy and replenished towels daily. Staff were friendly. Day time activities were fun and entertaining.

Beach vendors were an annoyance to our stay. Constant rude behaviour of trying to get our attention and wanting us to buy something or show us something to purchase. One of them threw a sandball at us because we did not respond.

Some of the Circle Club and Reserve resort staff were likewise an annoyance and disturbance to our stay within the hotel. Continuously trying to sell us packages/upgrades to our stay (circle membership, etc) and approaching us when we were just trying to relax and enjoy our vacation.

Health and safety hazards at the pool. Management needs to keep the pool safe to all guests by doing their due diligence in the maintenance of the tiles inside the pool.
Had a freak accident. Cut my right ankle inside the pool with a sharp broken tile.
First aid was provided by lifeguard, followed by standard paper work to fill out an accident report. Then was transferred to the medical clinic located inside the resort. The doctor was great and provided medical treatment. Was then told I need to go to the local private hospital to get 6 stitches.
I have medical travel insurance, but hotel opted to pay for all medical fees. However did not compensate the transportation fee of getting there and back.
Guest service staff was very sympathetic and tried his best to accommodate me for the remainder of my stay.

Hotel wanted me to sign a nondisclosure agreement about this accident, right as I was about to check out, which I thought was absolutely ridiculous.  Felt as if it was an intimidation tactic to sign or else you can’t leave. After bantering back and forth, I refused to sign the document as I do not feel comfortable signing anything without legal counsel present.

P.S: the pool was likely not closed or cleaned after I bled in it, and I’m sure the tile was not fixed either.

Enjoy your stay, folks.

reviews.author: Scott Thompson
reviews.text: Our experience was an unparalleled experience from every restaurant we tried to the staff all around the facility.In particular I would like to recognize our concierge Ariel we did not want for anything. I would also like to point out Pedro one of the many beach bartender's,a giant smile greeted us every day and last but certainly not least Fausto our waiter at two of the restaurants we frequented what a pleasure he was. We will definitely be back soon !

reviews.author: Robert Sadlier
reviews.text: Roseanna & Yanira always made my daughter feel welcome and special at the breakfast buffet. They always had a table ready for us and kept our coffee and drinks topped up. Very nice resort with good variety for an all inclusive.

reviews.author: Barbara Soogrim-Raghunandan
reviews.text: What can I say other than Rafael, our guy at the beach was the best experience here at the beach!!! Rafael is attentive and caring and always on point each and every day - he always gave the best service with a smile and great energy!!! If you’re here, ask for Rafael!!! His service is impeccable!

reviews.author: Snowhite
reviews.text:
Just came back from a 8 night stay at this resort. Everything was good but at times there was too much pressure to write a review. I had to complain to the management when a employee typed up a review on my 23 year old son's phone and posted on his behalf.
They can definitely ask you to write a review but this is was a little too much and made us uncomfortable.
Everything else was good. Service to food and environment.
Anthony at the Ginger Bar always was very welcoming and made us feel extra special.
Katherine at the Spa was really nice.
Most of the staff speaks Spanish so it a big plus if you know the language.

reviews.author: Andy Jimenez
reviews.text: Ricki and Georgi at the Buffett gave us excellent service. They were very attentive and accommodated us with our needs. The only negative about the resort is that the concierge kept promising us a reservation for my moms birthday at one of their restaurants, but they never came through. I know we where a big group, but they kept giving us false hope. Other than that, the place is very beautiful and the beach and pool were clean and nice.

reviews.author: Santiago Reta
reviews.text:
Nice hotel, but not worth the price (not value for money).

Based on service quality, it felt more like a 3-star hotel. It shouldn’t be rated as 5-star by today’s standards.

The hotel is beautiful and the beach is great, but they need major improvements—especially in service. We arrived at 10 a.m., checked in, but didn’t get our room until after 4 p.m. (even though check-in was at 3). It felt like if we didn’t insist multiple times, the room wouldn’t have been ready at all.

The rooms were nice and looked fairly new, but cleanliness was a major issue. There were grapes under the bed when we arrived. One day they didn’t clean at all, and the rest of the days we had to call to make sure they came. We asked them to come before 1 p.m. since we were traveling with two babies who nap around that time—only 2 days they followed through. They wouldn’t replace shampoo unless you asked, and only left a tiny trash bag. We requested room service trays to be picked up, and despite saying yes, no one came—so we spent nights with leftover food in the room.

In-room dining and all restaurants/bars (we tried them all) required repeating orders multiple times. In many cases, we gave up waiting. Most staff weren’t rude, but they didn’t seem interested in helping either. Very few asked if we needed anything, and some had a bad attitude. The general rule seemed to be: no big tip up front, no good service.

Hotel rules (zones, included services, etc.) were unclear and changed depending on the staff member—and whether they were hoping for a good tip. At check-in, they barely spoke to us, let alone explained how the hotel worked, what was included, or where to go. Everything was trial and error.

Food-wise, it was mostly average. The Asian restaurant was just bad—bland rice and chicken (think hospital food), and a very awkward show (a “chef” threw plates and glasses on a guest). In general, waiters made it feel like you were asking for a favor—not what you expect from an “all inclusive” or “premium” hotel. The steakhouse and Mexican restaurants were the best, followed by the Italian (we had to ask them to reheat the food though). Nothing was really memorable. The pre-dinner bar made great drinks though. The buffet was the most consistent, although service was also poor there. We had a great dinner at Brisas, a members-only restaurant they invited us to due to the check-in issues—but it’s not part of the usual guest experience.

Between 3–6 p.m. (when the buffet closes and restaurants open), only one snack bar is available, and with a very limited menu. Room service options were narrow. The minibar was restocked quickly, though.

Facilities and activities were below par. A yoga/stretching class lasted just 27 minutes and was led by someone scrolling on their phone. The gym had old, basic machines and no nice view—just a hallway. Activity offerings were limited and poorly communicated. The spa charged more than a walk-in at any local spa.

The hotel seems focused on events or members. During our stay, there were 3 weddings, a fashion show, and several corporate events. Nothing wrong with that, except these groups clearly had priority over regular guests. If you’re not a Meliá Circle member, I wouldn’t recommend staying here. They’ll treat you like you’re staying at a discounted 3-star hotel.

Some individual staff were kind and made an effort to improve our stay, but overall service was poor—hard to highlight the exceptions.

Lastly, third-party tour companies working with the hotel were unreliable. We booked a boat trip that turned out to be totally different from what was promised. They picked us up an hour late and didn’t allow our 6-month-old onboard (despite saying it would be fine). No refund offered.

In short: we had a very nice time because the place is beautiful, but unless you’re paying for the highest-tier experience, tipping at least $100 USD a day, and/or are a Meliá member, I wouldn’t recommend it.

reviews.author: Karin Ajmani
reviews.text: I just ate at Blue Agave and it is excellent!!! Truly, very good Mexican and wonderful service.  They have a mole-type spicy brown hot sauce which they serve with their chips that is the best I have ever had!!! Santo and Delvin were especially wonderful to me and made me feel at home, as I was dining alone.

reviews.author: Declan Rybacki
reviews.text:
Excellent resort all around, the staff is fantastic and make sure your taken care of at all times. I highly recommend!

Antonio, Rafael, Soranyi, Dominga, Clari, Olga, and Lucia are the best out there!

From the beginning of our stay until the end (7 nights), Felix was our concierge. He always tended on our needs and surprised us with wine and fruit platters in our room almost every day. He made sure we had everything we needed, made all of our reservations, and helped us find the best excursions in the DR. He is very kind and the next time we come here we will definitely be requesting him! Thank you Felix!

reviews.author: Francesca
reviews.text: Ismael, Antonio, Dominga, Yenni, and Cris at the lobby bar are so wonderful! They know how to greet every guest that walks in. Drinks are always a 10/10 (especially the iced coffees and espresso martinis). They are some of the reasons why my friends and I return to this resort time and time again. Truly great staff!

reviews.author: Damian Kottisch
reviews.text:
Great thanks for the whole Beach Bar Team on The Reserve side, Gilberto, Martin, loco Rafael and Pedro, super kind tall gentleman who always helps us in the morning! Great thanks to the Sante Team! Beautiful place, kind service! For piece and good food it’s worth taking the „The Reserve“ option. Great thanks to Basilio for beeing a great help and organising everything for us! 💪

We came back and the stay was even better than the first one The food in Sante and Flora is amazing (not only for an all-inclusive but in general) The stuff is super kind, friendly and professional, Great thanks to Basilio and Adriel. To Gilberto, Rafael, Pedro, Martin and Yudery from the Beach Team and to all the Sante stuff: Santo, Juan, Gustavo, Franklin, Barnelis, Miranda, Norjandro all all the people that made our stay an unforgettable experience. Big thanks to Kayanna for her help. Gracias, Familia!

reviews.author: Katie Poling
reviews.text: John was so helpful with our bags and helping us get a car to the airport and letting us know where we need to go for things at the resort. HES AMAZING. The Mexican restaurant was amazing we decided to come back twice - Bryan and Edito had great service! Wonderful experience and food! Everything was so clean. Staff was so, so friendly. Including Jordana and John. Pools are big and beautiful. Beach has a lot of room for everyone to enjoy. We will be coming back at any chance we get.

reviews.author: Julie Crofts
reviews.text: We were married here 10 years ago and came back to celebrate- it has only gotten better! The restaurant and bar staff are so nice and helpful, especially Olga and Ismael at Ginger Bar. The rooms are beautiful and clean, comfortable and well appointed. We love it here! Our concierge Fernando is a rockstar- he made all of our dinner reservations for the week after only one conversation, he was spot on in his service and made our trip beyond special. He was always available, attentive, and brought us many many bags of yucca chips which made my kids so happy. There was plenty to do for the kids each day and night, as well as the adults. Couldn’t recommend the Paradisus more!

reviews.author: snsr sa
reviews.text:
We recently stayed at this resort and were left disappointed by various aspects of the experience. The corridors were dark, and smelled like mold. Even the
Top of the line room had issues. While the rooms have been updated recently, many features were either broken or run-down. The bathroom and walk-in closet doors wouldn't close properly, and the patio door didn't work, which limited our access to the outdoor space we were looking forward to. The steam iron did not work.  The AC system was also a problem—it wasn’t adjustable, maintaining a chilly 18°C at all times, which made the room uncomfortably cold, especially for families with kids.

Housekeeping was subpar, particularly at night. We requested that the sofa bed be made up for our child every night, but each time, we had to call repeatedly, and no one would show up for an hour or more. This lack of attention was frustrating and left us feeling neglected by the staff. Furthermore, the concierge service, which initially came across as helpful, turned out to be more focused on selling a timeshare-like membership than addressing any of our actual needs. It was clear that their friendliness was more about getting us into a presentation than providing genuine assistance.

Dining options were also limited and disappointing. More than half of the restaurants were closed most nights, restricting us to only a few places. The hostess at Flore restaurant was especially rude—she even skipped over us in line to serve people who arrived after us. This level of poor service is unacceptable, especially given the resort’s premium pricing. The buffet lacked variety, with the same vegetarian options repeated daily, and while the desserts were visually appealing, they all tasted the same. If you’re seeking flavorful cuisine, particularly Indian or Thai options, I’d recommend looking elsewhere.

A few positive notes: Miguel, a bartender at the restaurant, was fantastic. He was attentive and welcoming, standing out from the otherwise lackluster service. However, restaurant reservations were another hassle; they had to be made in advance, and though some restaurants appeared empty, they still wouldn’t take walk-ins. The main buffet was closed for dinner every night, which limited our options further.

Overall, this resort has declined significantly since our last visit. Unfortunately, with such deterioration in service, food quality, and room conditions, we wouldn’t choose to stay here again.

reviews.author: Christina Jerome
reviews.text:
This is our 2nd time at this resort and it was absolutely perfect! Our Reserved Adults Only Concierge Nathanael was attentive, thoughtful and delivered on everything we asked. We celebrated an anniversary and he set up our room really nice with balloons, chocolate, sparkling wine and a bubble bath with rose petals! When we had difficulty getting I touch with our transport home he personally reached out to the company to ensure they arranged our trip to the airport. The renovated rooms were clean and modern and our ocean view was beautiful!

Last time we came there were not as many families. I’m glad to see with the renovations that the Adults only section has more pools and service. It was nice to see the families and kids have fun but we were glad to retreat to the quiet adults only section.

Hands down our favorite resort! Thank you to all the staff that made this experience unforgettable! Shout out to Rafael at the reserved adults only beach! Also top notch service!!!!!

reviews.author: Brittney Hendelson
reviews.text: Antonio who works at the Ginger bar is absolutely amazing along with the other staff at that bar!!! His energy and big smile really made our mornings every time we came for coffee or juice! He made our trip very special and we loved our interactions every day!!!

reviews.author: Tammy Burr
reviews.text: Rosanna and Yaniva were amazing at the Lunch Box.

reviews.author: Edwin Alicea
reviews.text: Sportbar … best group of service thanks to Luis y Felix the best bartender

reviews.author: Jackie Orris
reviews.text: Blue agave was an amazing restaurant at the Paradisus Palma Real resort!! The food was absolutely wonderful and the staff and service was outstanding!  Delvin took care of us from the minute we walked in until the end and was so amazing in making our experience!  Santo the manager was also super helpful and inviting! Wish we were here more nights to come back again for the food and experience!  Really appreciate them!

reviews.author: Michael M
reviews.text:
We arrived and waited several hours for our room to be ready. When we arrived in the room the couch was stained orange with an unknown orange substance.

On our second day of the stay we received 3 calls within 45 minutes asking us to confirm our last name and when we checked in. I went to the front desk to ask them to stop calling my room and when I went back they had deactivated all of the wristbands of my party and would not tell me why. They reactivated the wristbands, but would not explain what happened, why we kept being called or why they deactivated our access. No apologies, restitution or comps were offered.

The service was otherwise good and aside from the weird stain on the couch the rooms were nice, but the entire experience has been bizarre.

reviews.author: Francois Desormiers
reviews.text:
We came with a big group Wedotransformation and the experiment was amazing on every level.

The staff are friendly, the food is good with a lot of option!

The place is so beautiful!

Alexander at the Mexican restaurant was amazing! We have the best experience!

Everyone should come here!

reviews.author: Jen (Jen)
reviews.text: Amazing service by Chef Joselo, our waiter Celia, and Franklin. They were all very attentive and we enjoyed the Tomahawk presentation by the chef. The best meal we’ve had at Paradisus! I highly suggest dining at Mina, they have a variety of options on their menu.

reviews.author: Gina Bracetty
reviews.text: I went on a couples trip to Paradisus Palma real this past week. We had an amazing time! The people there are so nice, helpful, appreciative, and hard working. Our concierge Jose Simeon was absolutely PHENOMENAL. He took amazing care of us and went above and beyond to meet every request we had and made sure our time there was nothing short of amazing. He took care of our dinner reservations, excursions, helped make sure we were able to switch rooms/upgrade, as well as went to the lengths to decorate our room romantically. We were craving authentic Dominican food, so he made sure to make a special request for us to the chef and served us. I can’t say enough great things about him. The one thing I will say is that the hotel lacks a night life and for a younger crowd may be boring. Other than that we had an amazing week.

reviews.author: Ivan Lemus
reviews.text: I had an absolutely amazing experience at the hotel, thanks to Starlin, our exceptional counselor! From the moment we arrived until our departure, Starlin went above and beyond to make our stay memorable. Their warm and friendly demeanor instantly put us at ease, and they were incredibly attentive to our needs throughout our stay. Starlin provided us with excellent recommendations for local attractions and dining options, making our trip even more enjoyable. Their dedication to ensuring our comfort and satisfaction was truly remarkable. I can't thank Starlin enough for their outstanding service and genuine care. I would highly recommend Starlin to anyone visiting the hotel. Five stars all the way! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

reviews.author: J. Alexander Diaz II
reviews.text:
Unbelievable customer service. All the staff at all the restaurants and shops went above and beyond taking care of us and anticipating our needs. Some I’ve met by name and have blown me away are:
Jose at the entrance with the bags
Rosanna and Jessica with the kidsdome
Jaime Alonzo
Raysa, Dominga, Anyi, and EVERYONE at ginger bar. I can’t stress it enough. Book here.

reviews.author: Chelsey Hendrickson
reviews.text: We have enjoyed our stay at Paradisus Palma Real. We had an issue with our room due to an issue with the timeshare exchange, but Carlos at the front desk was able to help us get it worked out. We have been a bit confused with the family buffet being closed a few nights, but our concierge has been helpful getting reservations at the restaurants. Wellington was super friendly as he refilled our wet bar and gave our kids their favorite juice boxes. Overall very friendly staff! Love the small pools near the rooms, which have been great for our kids. The staff at Kidsdom is phenomenal. Especially Marsiel, Susu, and Alexandria!

reviews.author: Sherri Greene
reviews.text:
We LOVED Luis Desa, Luis Vilario, and Walkiiria!!
They served the absolute best drinks! We returned to the Ginger Bar every night just to experience their excellent customer service and awesome drinks! Thank you!

reviews.author: Jordan Rusher
reviews.text:
I enjoyed my time at the Flora restaurant. The ambience was beautiful especially if you like nature.
Daiana Rodriguez was sweet and very welcoming.

Another night I had dinner at the Winery. The waiters Maximo and Jonathan were our waiters and helped me celebrate my birthday. They were very informative, classy, and helpful. They made my experience very enjoyable.

reviews.author: Karina Goldstein
reviews.text: Soranyi was very kind and helped us with a lot of activities in the hotel. She helped us book reservations to the restaurant and was very entertaining. The other staff were also very nice and helped us with all our needs. I will definitely come back to Paradisus Palma Real!

reviews.author: sylviane cohen
reviews.text:
Mascalzole Italian restaurant was excellent.
The food quality, choices and service was superb!

reviews.author: Andrew Vahil
reviews.text:
The restaurant you must visit in this hotel.
I think it was the best one there. Less words. Just come and try. Milton was a nice guy taking care of everything. Love the calm atmosphere and delicious food.

reviews.author: robyn deal
reviews.text: We had the absolute best time at this resort! From Irvin our concierge and trip guide, to Juan and Maria our bartenders, we were treated like royalty the entire time! The nicest people, the best food  and the best hospitality the entire time! The manager at Mina even found us 2 nights after our dinner there to bring us delicious crime brûlée! Best service possible!

reviews.author: Richard Tejeda
reviews.text: Rosanna absolutely the best treatment  in the pool area the  number one attendant

reviews.author: Robin
reviews.text: Jose and all of his staff are super friendly and helpful. The omelets and pastry are delicious. They always get our order right. It’s nice to come for breakfast where they remember how to fix your coffee! They make you feel welcome and comfortable.

reviews.author: Coleen Johns
reviews.text: Rafael made our week perfect! Every morning was set up so we had not a care in the world. Towels, drinks, water and laughs. Best service ever. Can’t recommend enough!

reviews.author: Laura Gutierrez
reviews.text: This is the first time I staying at Paradisus. I absolutely loved it. Great resort, family, friendly for sure. I enjoyed the clean pools. The beach was nice and clean as well. The service was amazing. My concierge was Basilio Jimenez He was great. He made sure everything was perfect. When I asked for anything he made it happen always with a smile. I highly recommend him, I will definitely be coming back to this resort.

reviews.author: Tina Hillier
reviews.text: Kick Bar service is great, Luis provides a wonderful service and friendliness like family

reviews.author: Sasha Miranda
reviews.text: The food at Kicks was so goodwe ordered 1 of everything it felt like. Our waiter Jose.de.Rosario was very attentive and friendly. 10 outta 10 would recommend.

reviews.author: Jennifer Hanna
reviews.text: Excellent service and Seuleidy was so sweet and kind. Will definitely be back again

reviews.author: Nerine Small
reviews.text: The Italian Restaurant at Paradisus was really very good. The food tasted great and was very well presented. The service was excellent!  Thank you Jessica!

reviews.author: Sarah Kuter
reviews.text: Great vacation spot!  We had a blasts at the pool and beach was beautiful!  White sand and turquoise blue water!  Francis was the best server at the pool bar, and always made sure we had what we needed from water to cocktails!!  The steakhouse, The Mexican and Italian restaurants are excellent!

reviews.author: Kristin Wax
reviews.text: We absolutely loved the 90 degrees pool bar at the Reserve. Rosana was so special to us. Eddy is so much fun and Carolina was so sweet. We had the best time with them. They love their jobs and are the best people.

reviews.author: Pat Fan
reviews.text: We had a great time on vacation. Basilio was great as our concierge service, he met with us everyday and made sure all our bookings were made every night for dinner. He was also very helpful with booking outside activities.

reviews.author: Tina
reviews.text: This place was great! The The Mascalzone staff was on point especially our waiter Yenseen was attentive and knowledgeable, always ready to recommend the perfect wine to complement my meal. To top it all off, the dessert selection was irresistible; the tiramisu was light and decadent, a perfect ending to a wonderful meal.

reviews.author: Lauren
reviews.text: The experience at Paradisus Palma Real could not have been any better. Our concierge Francisco went above and beyond our expectations. We went to Blue Agave (Mexican food) for dinner twice while we were here because the first time was amazing. The second time around exceeded expectations. Alexander B was amazing, so accommodating, great scene of humor and all around phenomenal server. Jose Ramos at Brisas could not have been any better. He went above and beyond for us. Anytime we came here for breakfast and lunch, he made sure everything was perfect. His service was impeccable. He set the bar very high. I can’t wait to come back for my next vacation!

reviews.author: Chelsea Olortegui
reviews.text:
I recently had the pleasure of staying at the Paradisus, and I must say, it was an unforgettable experience. From the moment we arrived, the beauty of the place took our breath away. The surroundings were stunning, with meticulously maintained gardens and breathtaking views.

The highlight of our stay, however, was the exceptional service we received from the staff. Adriel, in particular, went above and beyond to ensure our comfort. He was incredibly attentive, always there when we needed something, yet never intrusive. His warm and welcoming demeanor made us feel right at home, and he truly elevated our experience.

We also participated in a pizza-making class, which turned out to be one of the most fun activities we did during our stay. Brandol, who led the class, was not only an excellent instructor but also incredibly funny. He had us laughing throughout the entire session, and his easygoing nature made the class enjoyable for everyone. Plus, the pizzas we made were delicious! 10/10 recommend to do the activities around the hotel!!

reviews.author: A S
reviews.text:
Stayed for a week in the regular Paradisus Palma Real. As experienced Paradisus/Melia PC guests we almost  upgraded to the Reserve (as we always have in the past) but last minute decided not to. Based on recent reviews we were extremely surprised at the good service and food quality.
Our room was new, beautiful and clean with a view of the ocean in the adults only section. Daily housekeeping was excellent. The adults only (non reserve) pool was amazing (60yd lap for swimmers out there) and the beach clean. The bars and services were plentiful.
Yes, getting dinner reservations was a pain. You have to get in line early at 8:45am daily (opens at 9am) to get anything  around 7pm for the next day, but the restaurants were all really good and worth the wait.
The sushi bar was first come first serve for dinner and was also actually really good.
We loved the Ginger bar and the sports bar and the nightly performances in the plaza were great too.
Shout out to John, Georgina and Judy at the Lunchbox buffet who took care of us for breakfast and lunch daily.
We will return!

reviews.author: Alana Borden
reviews.text: I wish I could remember everyone’s name to shout out as each server and bartender deserves recognition for the hard work they are doing to keep the guest happy. I was here for 5 nights with a party of 10. I myself stayed in the reserves and had the pleasure of having Kelvin as my concierge. If I return I will ask for him again. He made sure my family had the best vacation. He made all of our dinner reservations for us and ensured my mom who was celebrating her birthday was well taken care of. He was very professional at all times. Idk how but he seemed to find me wherever I was at the moment I was just about to text him! It was freakishly pleasant. The highlight of the trip was breakfast at  Sante’ with Juan and Mysael they are like family now. They were so attentive to all our needs. Juan needs a promotion he is the best server on the resort. I got the opportunity to meet the famous bartender Wanda at the adults only bar and she did not disappoint. She was hands down the best bartender at the resort. The guys at the ginger bar are very nice, fun, and a great time.  Luis was awesome and very knowledgeable. Everyone made me feel safe and treated me like family and looked out for me. The reviews said Blue Agave was the best restaurant but to my family it was the worst. The best was hands down Flora for dinner. The only improvement I could ask for is more entertainment at night and please bring back the water circuit at the spa you’re advertising hydrotherapy and you don’t have it. I almost forgot when we first arrived Angelo in guest services was awesome! Now that I experienced The Reserves I don’t want any other way. We had the swim up room it was lovely. I could go on and on. The staff deserved every tip we gave! What a beautiful resort and beautiful people, great food and drinks.

reviews.author: Ralphy D.
reviews.text: The room was really nice. The staff was very friendly and helpful but at a price. Bring tip money. The food at the buffet was terrible. They over cook everything. The steak, the pork, and the chicken were all cooked to death. The only restaurant that was remotely palatable was the Italian pizza place. The guy walking around the pool selling excursions (last name Smith) was terrible. He was very pushy and intrusive. He had zero regard for personal space and was very insistent. I ended up buying a dune buggy excursion for my 10 year old son and I and I learned from the other people on the excursion that I overpaid. The transportation to and from the excursion was atrocious. I will not be back. I was ambushed and pressured by three female servers at the buffet to post a positive review on Google. That was very unprofessional and a very uncomfortable experience. My family and I will not be back.

reviews.author: Autry Tysinger Jr
reviews.text:
This was our first trip to the Dominican Republic and our first (and last) stay at a Melia Resort.
First off, the property and beach were beautiful, however that beauty was overshadowed by issue after issue.
Good experiences...Gustavo in Sante is wonderful. Wanda at the Fahrenheit pool bar is fabulous! The 80-minute couples massage that we paid for was excellent. Out therapists Alba and Maria gave us great deep tissue massages.
Issues that occurred during our stay:
•	We had no concierge on Day 1 and part of Day 2. We were told upon check-in that Adriel would be our concierge, and that our luggage would be delivered within the hour.  I had to call the front desk after 2 hours to have them find our luggage. This caused us to miss dinner on Day 1 . The room service food was terrible. How do you mess up a cheeseburger? Melia can do it! Adriel finally contacted us at 9:30pm via WhatsApp on Day 1. We found out he had left at 5:00pm, so there was no way we would have gotten our luggage without me calling and complaining.
•	On Day 1, The shower was not draining.  I messaged Adrial and also called the front desk. This issue was fixed on Day 4. The water flowed out of the shower into our room and into the water closet.  We had to make a dam out of towels when we used the shower.
•	Called the front desk and messaged Adrial about air conditioning on Day 1 not cooling enough. This issue was fixed late on Day 2.
•	Our Minibar was not stocked upon arrival.
•	Had to visit the Reserve lounge on Day 2 to ask for an on-site concierge, because our concierge, Adrial, was not going to be onsite again on Day 2. We got Alam, our 2nd concierge, that gave us a tour that we should have received on Day 1. He said he would make our dinner reservations. My wife had to send Alam a WhatsApp message to remind him about dinner reservations EVERYDAY or else we would have not gotten dinner reservations. We requested dinner reservations be between 6pm-8pm. Only 1 dinner was scheduled between 6pm-8pm. The rest was after 8pm.
•	We received one message about activities the entire stay from our concierges. This was on Day 1 and we did not receive any more. We were supposed to receive a message every morning about the day's activities.
•	On Day 5, Alum told us he was off for the rest of our stay. We were then assigned to Gustavo our 3rd concierge. I didn't think things could have been worse well Gustavo proved that they could.
•	On Day 5 We were told by Gustavo to wait in our room because the manager was coming by to talk to us. We waited over 2 hours and had to get to our 8:30pm dinner reservation. The manager never showed up.
•	On Day 5 the room was not serviced. Green ('Make up room') light was on since breakfast. Had to complain to Gustavo after coming back from our 8:30pm (turned into 9pm) dinner. The room was finally serviced late. The Minibar was not serviced.
•	On Day 6 the concierge manager and the resort manager, Alvaro Fernandez, met with me and my wife on our room's patio. I told them everything. They both agreed that we did not receive the Reserve service that we had paid for and they agreed to talk to upper management about refunding us the Reserve rate minus the regular resort room rate (wo/ concierge service). We thought everything was going to be settled after that, but NO!
•	Day 7: We were checking out and I had not heard from Alvaro. I messaged him on WhatsApp (see attachment). Since we booked through Costco Travel they are basically not honoring the agreement from Day 6. Melia owns the resort, not Costco!
After we returned, we contacted Costco Travel. They reached out to the resort and the resort is now saying that they are not honoring anything talked about with concierge manager and the resort manager, Alvaro Fernandez on Day 6.
My suggestion…if you go to this resort do not upgrade to the concierge or reserve service. I wish we had had concierges like the other guests had. If you get Adriel, Alam, or (God forbid) Gustavo, you need to request someone else.

reviews.author: Igor Yushchenko
reviews.text:
Came on Friday, today is Monday. We had to go to Lobby 5 times, as our keys do not work. They could not fix the issue so the best way is to stop by lobby and ask for the “door guy” to open our rooms. No one seems really care, except us that we could not enter into the room. Also, we have two kids and our room is on the third floor and there is no elevator. We asked to change, but no luck.
Beach is good. Food is good. But because the door issue, we could not relax.

reviews.author: Raina Beraud
reviews.text:
Restaurant blue agave was amazing. Santo is the best we come back and visit him every year.

Kidsdom is the best. My kids are 2 & 4 and they make sure to speak both English and Spanish so our kids understand. They are so friendly and have great activities for the kids. It’s also nice that year after year we return and the women are the same and they remember my kids.

reviews.author: Kristen Maurer
reviews.text:
Not the luxury arrival you would expect no towel no drink and then to make matters work we were  not given or told about resort just given incorrect information about the restaurant situation.
We were told restaurants were open or available to us when they were not open.we complained to the concierge regarding the amount of time and inconvenience we had making reservations.  The concierge told us that he would look into it and get back to us.  We never received further communication from him.
If you have a food allergy stay away I have a lactose allergy.  This was on the reservations card and was told to the staff when we arrived at the restaurant.  When questioned about the food, staff did not know what foods had lactose and at Flora I was given butter in her main dish.  I do want to point out that at Mascalzone the staff did pay attention to my food allergy.

At 11:00 am we were lying out by the adult pool.  However, our peaceful morning was interrupted by staff doing yard maintenance including using a very loud chainsaw.
Children were always in the adult area and pool. This is not enforced at all. Screaming babies and children jumping in the pool.

Every morning when we would go out to lay by the pool at 10:00 am we could not find beach towels.  We always had to wait for them.
We would ask Staff how and where to make reservations, get towels, or how to make our airport transfer. We were provided with different answers or staff didn’t know. This was frustrating because we did not know what was going on.
Staff did not explain what they were doing with our luggage during the checkout process. ie where to go, cutting wrist band, room charges.

I asked when they can cut off the wrist band she stated upon departure no one ever cut anything off of us. Another stupid thing but they all start to add up.

WiFi password was not given to us nor was there information in the room. I called and was given the information to use a certain network that didn’t work and so they said “ooo you have an apple phone, you need to to use this other network and the password was like 1000 characters and numbers. Again no information shared and when it was shared it was complicated for no reason.

reviews.author: Cassandra B
reviews.text:
The visit to the Paradisus Palma Real
was a real treat. But, a real highlight was dining at Flora. The food and staff was marvelous and so patient as I ordered in spanish as an American.
Andrea was the best waitress that I could have asked for. She’s a gem and great at her job. She offered me the best wine with dinner! Bravo to all at Flora.

reviews.author: Monique Brinson
reviews.text: My experience is absolutely amazing. Yuderi and Angelo and marcos and jhojan were my favorite. They treated me like royalty, the usual the professional were our go to words for service. I will definitely remember this experience. And return just for them. Thanks yall.

reviews.author: emily laurence
reviews.text: Malva is great. We came for seafood night and it was great. Lobster, salmon and all the shell fish. Francisco, our server, was amazing and made us feel like family. Santo, the manager, offered anything we wanted. Overall a great experience.

reviews.author: Mark Benjamin
reviews.text: We are dinner tonight at Flora Caribbean/Dominican at the Palma Real. What amazing flavors and presentations of the food! The creative menu is unique for a resort restaurant. We particular enjoyed being pampered by the always perfect Cesar. He ensured we were stuffed with the finest choices and personally wanted is to have the happiest night ever. Thanks Cesar.

reviews.author: Terrell
reviews.text: The Mascalzone, Food was delicious. Servers were phenomenal at tending to our needs. Very fast and efficient. Couldn’t ask for a better experience. The Dominican Republic experience was great. They taught us the history of the the Dominican Republic. Hairon, Jensy, and Michael were great host. Definitely made the experience wonderful and fun.

reviews.author: Annie Kay
reviews.text:
This was our first time at an all-inclusive resort in the Dominican Republic with a child, but our travel companion was a very seasoned traveller who's stated at more than a dozen different DR hotels over the years. Our overall experience was on the positive side.

Kids club / Kidsdom 5 stars
The entire team was extremely kind, nurturing and attentive. Our daughter loved going in and asked to attend even more activities once she got a taste of the kids club. There are about half a dozen activities each day in addition to the free-play in the playroom. Thank you to Janilda, Jessica, Jesus, Joanna, Lizbet and Sujeiny - we look forward to seeing you again!

Rooms 5 stars
The hotel and rooms looked recently renovated and they were kept to an immaculate standard. Bed and bedding were comfortable, but not the sofa bed.

Beach / Pool 5 stars
Well Bavaro beach is breathless and the pools immaculate. We're glad we stayed here for the quick access to both throughout the day.

Restaurants 4 stars
Main buffet was excellent, especially since we're not "buffet people", as were the Dominican and Asian restaurants. Other restaurants were just about alright. Booking process every day for a meal out 2 days in advance was annoying.

Service 3 stars
On checkout, no one asked me how my stay was -- this is a real miss for a 5 star hotel. There were some smiley workers who made sure we were doing well throughout though; I'm very grateful for those.
Here's an example of the service: One night the cleaner attempted to deliver unsolicited towels at 10pm... we were all asleep from jetlag, had plenty of towels already, but nevertheless the doorbell rang, and after a moment the door opened. I was told to put on the do-not-disturb sign for future nights even though no one should be disturbing guests at that time of night anyway.

Entertainment 2 stars
Activities during the day were hit and miss, and evening entertainment often consisted of a solo musician with spectators scattered around the hotel. I'm told that most other hotels in the area have a proper and engaging shows.

reviews.author: Charlene Ben
reviews.text: Stormin (manager) at the Kanna bar was the hostest with the mostest. He was attentive to our every request. The food was delicious, and the drinks kept on coming. What better way to enjoy the company of new-found friends while enjoying the warm breeze at the beach.

reviews.author: Rosa Pugliese
reviews.text:
Our stay was absolutely fantastic!
The rooms were clean and spacious, and the snacks and drinks were refreshed daily.
Frank and Santo at the Japanese restaurant were wonderful and very attentive. Jose at the coffee bar was awesome, as well. Irvin was attentive and responded quickly to our family’s every need.
The pools and beaches were well kept and we enjoyed spending the majority of our day at them.
The entertainment was really great. We got to play lots of beach volleyball with the staff, and the night events and music were great.
We are so excited to return next year!!

reviews.author: Jordan Sharpe
reviews.text: I cannot say enough about how incredible my experience was at this resort. The views were immaculate, the room was beautiful, and the staff really made the trip all the better. I have to give my biggest thanks to our personal concierge, A. Eriol, for great communication, excellent service, and thoughtfulness throughout our stay. He even set up romantic surprises in our room at the end of the day! Also, special shout out to Wanda and Pedro for great bar service at our reserve pool. Thank you again, Paradisus, for one of the best trips I’ve ever had!

reviews.author: Edgar Acuna
reviews.text: We had a wonderful meal at Flora, the signature restaurant. Ana Michel was a delight and treated us like vips from the moment we arrived. Great food. Exceptional service. Don’t miss this experience.

reviews.author: Gabe Stanfield
reviews.text: This resort is absolutely fantastic! I came with my grandparents, parents and brother and we all think it's the best we have been to in a long time. Everybody at the resort was kind and helpful, especially Maria at the Kanna restaurant. Our trip was one to remember!

reviews.author: Arlo Hernandez
reviews.text: Resort is great, clean. Not crowded and having an Adult section certainly helps. Unfortunately, the fine-print when making a reservation at the restaurant onsite - max allowed time is 90min. The host will not sit you until your entire party arrives and are not flexible with any modifications- adding people to the reservation, knowing the establishment has plenty of empty tables. Bartenders are respectful, however the staff at the restaurants are not to par.

reviews.author: Adriana Nunez
reviews.text: We attended a birthday dinner at Malva restaurant and all I can say is wow. The servers made everyone feel welcome and they prepared a special dinner served family style. Our waiter Misael was so attentive. We had Rib eye steak, fish, and lamb chops. Everything was delicious.

reviews.author: Antony Savvas
reviews.text: Four days at a conference that booked the whole place out. I was room 7211. Nothing wrong with the room and good amenities. Set to privacy for the entire time, but I'm sure the maids would have done a good job. Never tried any of the different restaurants, just used the buffet service set across two locations near to each other. Kept off the salads and cold stuff as I didn't want to risk any illness, and just ate grilled and roasted meat and rice and vegetables, which were good overall - at least as good or better than you will get at an all-inclusive in mainland Spain or the Canaries, for instance. I did try some cheese from the 'cool units', but I thought it was a bit warm, so I left it. Plenty of staff to bring you what you want, but you have to ask sometimes to make sure you get it. Where appropriate, they deserve the odd tip of a few dollars.

reviews.author: Orthoroks Orthodontics
reviews.text:
Fantastic experience at blue agave! Gorgi found us while eating our breakfast and asked us if we would like to eat at his restaurant that night. There were 9 of us and he not only got us the table but he made the entire experience simply amazing. His manager Santo made sure we received our food in time but Gorgi went out of his way to get us great food and drinks, incredibly kid friendly along with delicious food!!
Would recommend everyone come here

reviews.author: Joe Podnar
reviews.text:
Server Jean at Flora was incredible!! Very nice and genuine. Would hire ASAP.
Julia at the side bar/towels "hut" was fantastic, very sweet lady. Took care of us all week.
All Otium staff were very kind and caring.

reviews.author: Chona B
reviews.text:
Amazing resort! The ginger cafe made amazing lattes. The customer service is remarkable!!! Ismael,Antonio,Domingo,Victor, Jose and Crisieida were all amazing! So nice and very friendly!!
Relaxing vacation. We recommend.

reviews.author: Denise Sturtevant
reviews.text:
Restaurant Mina steak was amazing, ,Kelvin our server was the best, very attentive.  Highly recommend.
Breakfast had superior service from Rosanna Hernandez Marta,  we have had her in the past and her service is always top quality.  She is the Best!!!

reviews.author: Erin Hancher
reviews.text: Tonight we dined at Mascalzone. Our servers, Raider and Celia, provided excellent service. They were exceptionally friendly and accommodating.  Drinks were refilled and dirty plates cleared away immediately.  The food was great as well!  Martin, the manager, came to check on us and make sure we had everything we needed. I highly recommend this restaurant for anyone dining in Punta Cana!

reviews.author: Carmen Figueroa
reviews.text: My friends and me had a great experience at 90 Degrees yesterday and today with Leticia and Raysha. They are excellent hostesses. We really enjoyed our time there thanks to them.

reviews.author: Maria Cara
reviews.text:
Resort stay has been incredible in every way.

Special shout out and thank you to the staff at the lobby ginger signature bar. They were so incredible at what they do. Andrea, walguivia, Miguel, sailis, caronin, jesyey. Such amazing service !! :)

reviews.author: Evelin R.
reviews.text:
Upon arrival, we checked in and were greeted by Felix, our concierge. He was very sweet & made sure we were comfortable and helped us with any question and bookings throughout our stay.

Yeison and Georgina were wonderful and very attentive. Making sure we needed everything and going above and beyond! Great service.

The night life was fun too. Danyelo De Jesus made sure we were having a good time. Had lots of energy, life of the party! Made sure each customer had a personal experience.

They truly made our experience feel like we were on Paradise. Not one worry throughout our trip. Thanks everyone.

reviews.author: Baxter Stephenson
reviews.text: Great Resort! Awesome and welcoming staff. Shout out to Ana Michelle at Flora, Georgi and Felix at Mascalzone and our concierge Harry and Eriol for making our experience remarkable.  10/10 recommend visiting!

reviews.author: Pooja Patel
reviews.text: Mascalzone was AMAZING! Our server Fausto was quick, efficient, and beyond friendly. The food was the best we had at the resort. We enjoyed everything. The pizza was made fresh and melted in our mouths. Milton, the manager, came over multiple times to check on us and make sure we were satisfied with everything. The service was unbeatable as was the food. We may make another reservation here during our stay!

reviews.author: Erica Williams
reviews.text: Concierge Harry and Rafael at beach are the absolute best year after year.. if you are at the hotel, ask for both. They will make your expensive soooo much better!!

reviews.author: Renata Aghazarm
reviews.text: Paradisus Palma Réal was a great experience for a honeymoon. The best place for us was definitely the Adult Pool. The service at their bar 90 Degrees was absolutely amazing, Leticia and Olga were super nice and caring with us, they brought us great drinks regularly 😆😆😆

reviews.author: Amy Parrish
reviews.text:
We recently got back from spending 10 nights at this hotel. This was our second visit, and our first visit with our child (18 months).

We had a swim up suite which was very spacious and well stocked, well decorated. The beach access was great, always a lot of space. The last time we were here, the beach was heavily impacted by the sargassum, so it was great to see this time they have taken more attention to prevent the build up.

The majority of the staff is just outstanding, and there were some key players that made our stay exceptional. Firstly, our conceirge, Yaleidi, catered to our every need. She really went above and beyond, and we would have been completely lost on many things without her. Antonio (Anthony?) and the rest of the team in the Ginger bar were the kindest, nicest people. They were so lovely with our daughter, Paloma, and on top of that made the best coffee/drinks. In the breakfast/lunch buffet, Yafreizy (I am probably butchering the spelling) was a delight. Everyday with such a great attitude. The last day of our trip, the hotel was totally overbooked with a conference, and Yafreizy helped us find plates/food as we were rushing to get our child fed, etc.
And how could we forget the amazing ladies at the kidsclub! Firstly, the kidsclub was pretty much our child's dream room so it was such an asset to have this for the hot afternoons for a little AC play break with baby and parents. In addition, we left our child for a few hours with the staff and they were so sweet with her. We used the babysitting service a few times in the evenings and they were very professional.

We only did a few of the evening activities and it was all very fun and well organized. We were massively impressed with the quality of the food in both the buffet and in the restaurants, which is not usely the case in all inclusives. We never had any issues getting reservations (but we also had an amazing concierge).

The only problem we had in this hotel was with the housekeeping department. It started with our first night at the hotel, waiting 2+ hours for someone to bring a crib to our room, which was requested at the time of booking, and confirmed the week before with the hotel. Additionally, we had some issues with mosquitos and asked repeatedly every day for them to come spray our room, which never happened until our last night. In a few instances, we had the issue that they never came to clean (or at least take out the trash), which ended up with my husband running around asking someone to contact housekeeping. There is clearly a communication/organization issue within this team that we hope can be resolved.

All in all, it was a great stay, with many cherished family memories. We will really miss the kind people we met during our stay.

reviews.author: George Morales
reviews.text: The hotel was 10/10 for our family. The rooms were clean, modern, and spacious. The layout of the rooms was perfect. The hotel was great overall and the service was one of the best. Would definitely recommend to anyone.

reviews.author: Cantal Bakker
reviews.text:
What a beautiful location, what a fantastic experience.
I'm very touched by the great attention of the team in the hotel to their customers. They are taking amazingly good care of you in a very professional matter. Eriol was taking special care of any of my requests, reservations and transport. Very polite and with sincerity.
The hotelroom is great and spacious. Direct acces to the beach and great facilities that makes you wish the holidays will never end ;)

reviews.author: Gabriela Burgos
reviews.text: Paradisus Palma Real was a slice of heaven. Did not want to leave! So many choices to make! They have so many good options for food, pools, bars, and whatever vibe you’re looking for. The staff has been great especially Rosanna! Definitely coming back

reviews.author: Ofelia Palma
reviews.text:
Wonderful week at the resort. Many of the employees are wonderful and they go above expectations to please the guests!
Raul Jimenez at the beach - always attentive and ready to do whatever he can to make your vacation more pleasant.
Franchesca at the breakfast and lunch buffet - always anticipating whatever we needed. Ricki at the dinner buffet - wonderful!
These are wonderful people that help us create wonderful memories of our vacations. We will look for them next year when our family group of 7 adults come back.

reviews.author: OND 13
reviews.text: Such a beautiful location! Everything about it was amazing. Our favorite restaurant was Mascalzone, the pizza was delicious. We had so much fun at the ginger bar with Luis and Luis our favorite bartenders. Our favorite place to be was on the beach where Ramon Rivas took such good care of us. He was the biggest influence in our 5 star review.

reviews.author: Florida AutoService
reviews.text:
The service across the hotel is amazing. The bartenders were the best making wonderful drinks.
The bar had great drinks ,coffees and a lot of Amazing things . the best part of it was the wonderful service from my concierge FRANSISCO VILORIO, he knows what he's doing. we had no issues communicating each other in my native language.
I highly recommend him, he is the best. Thank you very much. I hope you never quits.
and the staff behind the bar are the best!
At  the lobby.
Thank you all for everything.

reviews.author: Kelly Ramirez
reviews.text: Always a great experience here at the resort. The employees like Arisleida and Victor at the bar are super welcoming and helpful! Will be back again!

reviews.author: Julia Summey
reviews.text:
Our concierge, Zenovia was wonderful!  She helped us with making our reservations, coordinating activities, and helped in making our stay here at Paradisus Palma Real so relaxing and enjoyable.  Zenovia always went above and beyond with outstanding hospitality.
Gilberto at The Reserve beach bar was also great!  He had such an amazing personality and always greeted us with a smile.
Everyone at the Paradisus Palma Real Resort truly helped make this our best vacation yet and we are so grateful. We are looking forward to returning soon!

reviews.author: ANNE Marie LANGLOIS
reviews.text: Sharing our experience at Flora. Excellent from start to finish. Our server Cesar was knowledgeable , warm and helped us with our food choices. The flavours, presentation, portion sizes and specialized drink menu were second to none! If you are staying at Paradisus Palma Real don’t miss eating at Flora!

reviews.author: D T G
reviews.text:
We just returned from our family of four vacation and I can honestly say it was absolutely wonderful. Eduardo our pool waiter was hardworking and attentive. Sandy our cleaning lady was always meticulous at everything and even made cute designs for the kiddos with their blankets. All the ladies at the kidsdom were an extreme delight (I am unsure of all of their names but I believe Jessica, Susu, Tania and another friendly face). They made it constantly entertaining for my kids (ages 7.5 and 11 year old). A few times they didn't even want to come out of their activities they were having so much fun. Christian was our concierge and he worked hard on making our reservations and ensuring we always had a place to eat at night (that is key btw... having that person of contact was worth it).

A few people wrote some negative reviews and some of them are facts (ie the room service menu is limited, and when we did call the front desk for an extra towel it took a while but to be honest it's all minor things). We have been to 6 other 5 star resorts and this buffet was probably the best buffet we have ever had.

As for the restaurants, Flora and Malva were my favourite. The Italian restaurant was my least (the wait for everything was not worth it). The lobby bar was my husbands fave. They had delicious coffee! Iced and Hot.

Would I go back to this resort? Yes. I liked it that much. Esp loved the room with the pool in our backyard with our very own Cabana.

reviews.author: Lynnann Fox
reviews.text: Our stay has been exceptional.  The service has been fabulous.  We are sad to leave. Fifteen days is not enough!  Rosanna, Maria and Yonara have been attentative and doting at the buffet (for breakfast and lunch).  They have made sure our stay was nothing more than spectacular.  All of the entertainment and food has been top tier.  Irvin and Fernando who support the activities have also been fabulous.  The wait staff in the restaurants make sure you enjoy your time.  They all take pride in the food they serve.  Overall this resort is my favorite and I will continue to come here.

reviews.author: Etienne Petit
reviews.text: Great food at the italian restaurant, and amazing service from Jensen.  Gracias!

reviews.author: roxi hahn
reviews.text: Paradisus Palma Resort in Punta Cana exceeded all expectations! From the moment we arrived, the service was impeccable. Maximo and Jhonathan from the winery provided insightful  tastings, and recommendations, enhancing our stay with their expertise and thoughtful service. Julia and Rosanna at the 90 Degrees Pool Bar went above and beyond to make us feel welcome and like family. The facilities were top-notch and the atmosphere was pure bliss. A huge thank you to the entire staff for making our stay unforgettable. We can't wait to return!

reviews.author: Nancy Sciglitano
reviews.text: We are always greeted by Raul at the beach with a smile and wonderful service. Drinks and towels and anything you could possibly need during your stay. I give it 5 star service all the way! We  can’t wait to come back next year.

reviews.author: Jennifer Lackey
reviews.text: Perfect trip! Most amazing time. Couldn’t ask for better. Eriol was the best butler we could ask for and the coffee bar near the lobby had the most amazing service where they make any drink you’d like including smoothies and alcoholic drinks. Will be back!!!

reviews.author: Jackie Lee
reviews.text:
Luis & Rafael at the Asian Experience restaurant are amazing. Very energetic, friendly and helpful.

Restaurante Blue Agave was amazing. Jose was a great server even recommended a drinkat dinner. Santo the owner was attentive and ensured we were well taken care of.

Mascalzone Restaurant was great. The pesto shrimp linguini is amazing. Pizza tasted authentic and food was fresh and tasty.

The room we booked was the Master Suite Deluxe; it was big and spacious and very nice. The only thing missing was a hair dryer which it doesn't seem they offer. The downside was the room we stayed at was quite far from the main plaza but overall a very nice space.

We happened to be assigned a concierge which was very helpful at the beginning but seemed to be a little less responsive after we sat through their Melia program promotional talk and did not sign up as a member. We missed out on restaurant bookings as we relied on our concierge and by the time I went to schedule them myself, they were fully booked.

All in all it was a great experience. Tho kid friendly, it didn't have as many free activities for younger kids compared to other hotels. A nice spot for adults only.

reviews.author: Fotini Gertsios
reviews.text:
We went and ate at the Sante restaurant and had the best waiters! Franklin and Franklin Miguel were the best and very accommodating! The chef Rafael was amazing as well!

I also have to comment on how wonderful Martin was! Everyday he would greet us and remembered our names and had a drink waiting for us every time we went to the beach!
We loved this resort and all of the staff!
Highly recommend

reviews.author: Angelo Ochoa
reviews.text:
Rafael and  Yuderi are the BEST!!
Took excellent care of us the entire time we were on the beach and at the pool! They made our trip 10 times better!!

reviews.author: Young Banshee god
reviews.text: Impeccable customer service can’t complain they always made sure my needs were met always. Salute to them great people the bar was always clean and on point shout out to ginger bar and team Luis great hotel will recommend to anyone you will have a great time. . 🙌🏼

reviews.author: Rio U
reviews.text: Fior wasp awesome. She provided great service. She was amazing. We love her. Will come back any day for her to take care of us. Epic kiss bar all day every day

reviews.author: Ruslan Cebotari
reviews.text: Great and knowledgeable staff. Great selection of wine. Johnathan, maximum and Fransisco are the best. Great food and best restaurant in the resort

reviews.author: Tauland Hoxholli
reviews.text: This place is amazing! Restaurant Kanna is amazing. Louis did a great job serving is. The entire staff was very good. Louis you are a rockstar

reviews.author: Cameron Lease
reviews.text: Yamilet and Sugey were great at Blue Agave Restaurant!

reviews.author: Yolanda Perez
reviews.text:
Paradisus Palma Resort in Punta Cana exceeded all expectations! From the moment we arrived, the service was impeccable.  Beautiful hotel with, an excellent location, and the food was great.

We stayed and the Reserved, Basilio was our concierge and he was amazing! He helped us get settled in from our first day to our last day. Checked in with us every day, made sure we had our dinner reservations, and that we had a comfortable stay through our trip. I will request Basilio next time I visit.

I want to recognize the following staff for their outstanding service.

Virtude & Sandra- Blue Agave
Pedro, Rafael  & Gilberto- 96-degree beach bar by the Reserved area.
Cesar- Flora
Frank- Tokimeku & The lunch box (buffet)
I can't remember the male staff member name at Santé who assisted us on 5.27 for breakfast and dinner. Such a great personality and service.
Basilio- guest concierge who made our stay easy.

The facilities were top-notch and the atmosphere was pure bliss. A huge thanks to the entire staff for outstanding service. We can't wait to return!

Johanna P.

reviews.author: Joan Woodward
reviews.text: Stormin, the manager,  and waiters at kannada bar, next to the beach were attentive and very efficient in waiting our tables. Food, especially the grill. were excellent. Sande restaurant was beautiful  with very good food. Henry, the manager, was most helpful and gracious.

reviews.author: Dave Bickford
reviews.text: Spent a week here.   One of the most amazing resorts my wife and I have been to.  Right on the beach, great amenities and restaurants.   Delvin was amazing.  He was with us at the Lunch Box for lunch and at the Blue Agave for dinner.  He was amazing,  made us feel incredibly welcomed and was extremely attentive.  Blue Agave was our favorite restaurant on the property.

reviews.author: jerry taylor
reviews.text: Excellent friendly service everyday. We felt like family, sad to leave this place.  This is the same way we felt last year and the years before. We will always come back. Terrill and Gilberto were extremely accommodating as was the majority of the staff.

reviews.author: Jessica Akshar
reviews.text:
We had an amazing time at this resort. It was quiet and seemed much less crowded than the other resorts even during spring break.

We spent our time mostly at the beach. Martin greeted us every morning with a smile. He had the towels and chairs ready each morning and would check in on us throughout the day.

The food was ok like what is expected at all inclusive resorts.

We will be back.

reviews.author: Heath
reviews.text: Raul at Paradisus Palma is the best, took care of us all day, awesome dude

reviews.author: Alejandro Sabogal
reviews.text: Full relaxation and quiet time. Just one issue: some links on the hotel’s intranet don’t always work.

reviews.author: Tori Dittmann
reviews.text:
Currently sitting at the Italian restaurant, Mascalzone The food and service was great! Willamena, Bernabe and the supervisor Milton were very kind and accommodating!  The bread is really really wonderful 😂

Now for the rest of the trip:
Hotel rooms are nice, fridge stocked and snacks plentiful! Everything was super comfy and we liked the walk out garden patio. The walls are SO thin though. You can hear every word of the conversation happening next door. It’s really strange and every time they close the door, the adjoining door rattles so that’s a bummer.

Service everywhere is hit or miss. Loved the staff at the Ginger coffee bar and Kicks Sports Bar. Super nice and friendly. Victor, and the Miguels are the bartenders that stand out the most from Kicks - very attentive and nice! All the staff at Ginger Bar are fantastic and make great cups of coffee!

Service at Blue Agave was absolutely terrible and food was pretty mediocre. Flora was probably our favorite dinner, I dont remember her name, but our server was so sweet. Great atmosphere and service! Tokimeyku (Japanese food) was super fun and yummy as well, Kelvin and Raphael were hilarious! The Lunch Box for breakfast and lunch was good but lots of room for improvement. Yogurt and milk were never quite cold which was weird. Lots of food options but many dishes needed salt. Ice cream was super melty almost all the time.

Activities were… meh. Participated in a few things here and there but learned quickly they weren’t really worth it. Our concierge was very kind but difficult to get a hold of (used WhatsApp) and I had to ask almost every evening where our reservation was for the night. 2 nights our reservation was 9 or later which we had asked for early dinner on our first day here. The language barrier can also be a bit of a hindrance between all the bars, restaurants, housekeeping staff, etc because their English all varied.

We went to Bavaro Adventure Park for an excursion one day which was a blast! We booked it through the guys who sit in the lobby.

All in all, it was a great vacation but if I had to do it again, I’d probably try another resort just to see if there’s a difference. You also need to bring things to do (cards, books, water raft/activities, things like that) to occupy your time and plenty of sunscreen!

reviews.author: Layla Letizi
reviews.text:
Our stay at Paradisus Palma Real was truly remarkable, thanks to the outstanding service we received throughout our visit. From the moment we arrived, the staff's dedication to ensuring our comfort and satisfaction was evident.

Yanira provided impeccable service, consistently attending to our needs with a warm and genuine smile. Her attention to detail and commitment to guest satisfaction truly stood out, making us feel welcome and valued throughout our stay.

Our mornings began on a high note, thanks to Gerado Esubio at the breakfast buffet. While the food selection was fine, it was Gerado’s perfectly crafted omelettes and friendly demeanor that made breakfast memorable. He took the time to tailor each omelette to our preferences, adding a personal touch that we greatly appreciated.

Alex, a server who went above and beyond to ensure we had everything we needed, made our dining experiences exceptional. His dedication and friendly demeanor were highlights of our trip, making us feel well cared for during every meal.

Dining at Minu Steakhouse and Blue Agave was enjoyable, with Alexander providing exceptional service that enhanced our experience. His attentiveness and professionalism ensured that every meal was pleasant and relaxing.

Paradisus Palma Real exceeded our expectations, not just with its beautiful surroundings and comfortable accommodations, but primarily due to the exceptional service provided by its staff. We highly recommend this resort to anyone seeking a luxurious and memorable vacation. Thank you to the entire team for making our stay so special!

reviews.author: Michael Andrew Lawrence
reviews.text: Great food and very nice service! :) Maira was our server

reviews.author: Hcar61
reviews.text: I want to personally thank Arisleida from the beach bar. She is constantly going out of her way to make us feel welcomed. Her dedication and endless energy is unmatched. We feel very fortunate to have been met Arisleida. We wish her the very best!!

reviews.author: Kevin Lewis
reviews.text:
The food and service were major letdowns here.

The facility is beautiful with pools and gardens woven through with walkways. There are curves that join restaurants with the pool.

They could have used more ceiling fans throughout. The lobby area had some but would still get stifling hot in some areas. The reserve restaurant, Sante, had some in the circular area but none in the area closer to the buffet.

The rooms in the reserve were nice. The minibar was stocked every day with drinks and snacks. The "bathroom" area was large due to the use of a curtain instead of walls. The water closet was pretty small.

The food in the Flora restaurant was quite good. Everyone in our party enjoyed it.

Blue Agave was hit or miss, but once we found the right dishes, we were happy with it.

All the other restaurants were very disappointing. The worst being Mina, the steak house. The steaks were of poor quality and poorly prepared. But the sides were a disaster. The potatoes were closer to hockey pucks than anything edible. I am not joking.

The sports bar has beer on tap but the staff didn't know how much it cost and were confused if it was included in our reserve stay (it was). But even then they were out of most of the beers listed. It was truly a pitiful experience in the sports bar.

Throughout our stay the service was very poor. In the restaurants would disappear after seating us and never come back until they were waved down.

The reserve restaurant, Sante, was always painful. At breakfast, the servers are uninterested in anyone wanting to order of the menu. They want everyone to go to the buffet. And the buffet was not good.

The adults-only area continuously had a lot of children in the pool, at the bar, on the beach. And there are plenty of pools. There was no reason I could see that the children needed to be in the adult pool.

Overall, our stay was very disappointing. We would not go back.

reviews.author: P Lay
reviews.text:
I’m going to just start with a short description for those who don’t want to read the whole thing. I wouldn’t book again only because I know there are better resorts for the same price. Food and service was terrible but beach was great! If you want more details on why continue on reading.

Going to start with the pros: the room was nice and spacious, very beautiful. Got the king size bed so it was nice. The double room didn’t look as good. We stayed at the all adults sections. It was a little further walk to the main buffet, but not bad. The beach was nice and they did a good job of cleaning the seaweed in the am, so that the beach front was nice and enjoyable for the guest. The adult pool was good. Not too far from the airport, about a 25 min ride with a little bit of traffic, so not bad. They had a wrist band so you can get into your room with it, so no need to carry an extra key card, which was really convenient. The towels were abundant and didn’t need a towel card, bonus for that.

Cons: food was terrible, not many choices and the same thing was served at the buffet for most of the night. There was minimal things that was hard to get like mustard or dressing specifically ranch or Caesar and if you asked the staff did not know. Food was always overcooked on the grill, just dry hamburger, hotdogs, chicken, you name it… just dry all the time. We tried to make reservations for restaurant but it was hard to get into any as many were booked all the time. You can only make reservations in advance for the next day as well. So we would wake up early in the am to make reservation for the next day, but it was always “booked” not sure how??… when we were at the desk around 7:30am. We did get into the Italian and Mexican restaurant. Food was not that good except for the grilled octopus at the Italian. The Mexican blue agave was nothing special except for the lamb chops. The meat ball was terrible! The service everywhere was always so slow. Waiter and staff were not attentive. Except when they notice you were tipping. We tipped since the beginning but there was no consistent staff. So we just felt ignored most of the time. Also when I say we tipped, we tipped well. Tipping shouldn’t be factor of level of service received since this is all inclusive, you should receive good service with or without tipping. Also, check in was terrible, we stood there for at least 30 min waiting on service. Multiple people working the desk, but no acknowledgment of the guest at all. Once again lack of service. Also there were very few spaces that were ac gathering area, so it was really hot most nights. Most resort has a rec room or multiple lounges with ac so the gust can relax this place did not. Just the sports bar. Which gets really loud with club music after a certain time. Which if that is what you are looking for then fine, but def not a place to just sit and talk and be able to hear a conversation.

reviews.author: jillian petroglia
reviews.text:
Rosanna is amazing! Always taking care of all our needs at the buffet!
Natanael at kicks is awesome! So welcoming and always keeping my drink filled
Jonathan at the main pool bar is the best! He is so personable! He is funny and caring! Best experience here ever! Definitely coming back!
If I could give more than 5 stars i would! 100% the best vacation spot

reviews.author: Karen Baltzer
reviews.text:
Maria and Miguel at Rum Republic were amazing. Friendly and professional. They introduced us to a few new cocktails which were amazing.

Yeison and Teofilo were amazing bartenders at the pool. They are very friendly and attentive. They also make great drinks. I recommend you visit them is you are at the Paradisus Reesort.

reviews.author: Feroz Khan
reviews.text:
Beautiful Resort!
Amazing Beaches!
Great Staff!
Excellent Room!
Clean!

Food was subpar and my main complaint...  Reservations for dinner is the way to go.  It took a few days to figure out where had decent food.  I ordered popcorn chicken, got chicken nuggets?! sadly, it was better than a lot of the other food I ate during my visit.

reviews.author: Kaila Magill
reviews.text: I am astounded by the cleanliness! The hotel has been absolutely wonderful! Tonight my husband and I ate at the blue agave. We had exceptional service with Junior (our waiter). Had great conversations and service with him! Highly recommend grandmas meatballs if you love chipotle❤️

reviews.author: Monica Montero
reviews.text:
Gin Ger bar review. Olga, Ismael, Clary, Dominga y Olga provided excellent service! Very friendly staff, excellent coffee and drinks. A must have experienced that is often missed (people pass  by easily without noticing it).
Winery review. Maximo has been more than accommodating. We enjoyed our selected wine and food so much. Service provided by Jonathan Acosta was very pleasant and food qas delicious. Overall a welcoming and pleasant environment. Recommended during your stay.

Totally recommended!
M

reviews.author: Mark Furman
reviews.text: The resort has some great staff. We loved the local dishes at Flora, which was our favourite of the restaurants.   Nice clean, well maintained beach. There were lots of shaded spots available even during march break.  Lobby bar is opened late and well staffed with good vibes.

reviews.author: Selene Alcocer
reviews.text:
We had really good time in this Hotel, food was good, amenities were nice and clean everytime. The staff also were very gentile and kind. The names of the most friendly were Yeison (beach), Milton (supervisor of Italian restaurant), Teofilo (Pool area) and Maids (room 9252). Also all the hostess were really kind (specially from Agave)

Food was really good, but sometimes we noticed that some ingredients were missing from the menu. Besides that we enjoyed everything.

We definitely come back again 🙌✨

reviews.author: Nikki C.
reviews.text: Andreina (she is a waitress in the Kicks sport bar) did a really good job. She was very attentive and provided wonderful service. We created a nice bond with her and even came up with a nickname for her. She was amazing!

reviews.author: Rajashekhar Thota
reviews.text: Kids loved it.  Somethings can be improved. Employees are amazing.

reviews.author: Siena Almonte
reviews.text:
Updated review 08/24/2023
Today we checked out and are on our way home.
We had the greatest time! Our concierge Francisco was the most helpful, attentive and professional concierge we’ve had in the 10 years that we have visited Punta Cana. He made us feel like family for our whole stay. Because of him we will rebook to stay at Paradisus again.
The bellhop hat carried our luggage to the front Jose Ramirez was also very attentive.
The food was amazing! Must get the pizza.
Dayhani was so sweet and made sure that we had everything we needed while our server was getting our stuff. Their supervisor Milton came mid dinner to make sure that everything was up to part which was very sweet.

reviews.author: Mark Mikhail
reviews.text:
