Restaurant Blue Agave is the best!!! Food is delicious and very clean. Ask for Santo, Alexander and Delvin, they will hook you up there.

We had an amazing time at Paradisus Palma Real!

For breakfast go to the buffet. Rosanna and Yanira were AMAZING 😍 and they were always there everyday at the buffet and gave us an amazing experience. They are your girls there ask for them and they will help you out.

reviews.author: Giovanna Monçores
reviews.text: Book it! Book it! BOOK IT!!! Service is amazing, rooms are pristine and so are all of the facilities. Must make reservations for dinner at the restaurants (inclusive) ahead of time but it is SO worth it. Best restaurant by far is Mina!!! The steakhouse. Appetizers will make you want to order one of each! Ask for Olvi for your service. BEST WAITER we had the entire trip. Didn’t even need to ask for more drinks he just kept them coming, gave great recommendations for food, was always attentive and super engaging with the conversation. We didn’t want to leave the table because the entire esthetic, vibe and more was divine!!  The hotel is right on the beach and you can see pool and beach views at the breakfast buffet. Pool is also very large and not too cold!

reviews.author: Vu Pham
reviews.text: Nice size room with access to pool. The buffet is top-notch with a variety of cuisines. Staff was friendly and helpful. I would definitely come back to Paradisus.

reviews.author: Andrew Plunkett
reviews.text:
Between Bar experience was great!
Miguel, Maria and Jose were excellent!
Drinks were well-made and tasty with a very welcoming atmosphere.

Also, Maria at Rum Republic was very personable and made great drinks!
Highly recommend the smoky Rum Fashioned!

reviews.author: Lauren Tarver
reviews.text:
I stayed at The Paradisus Palma Real in the Reserve Section. I’m used to Florida beaches but this resort in the DR pails in comparison! The service is outstanding,l and the food amazing. The main reason I came was for a quick, relaxing getaway with my mother. I fully believe the experience wouldn’t be the same without my concierge Edgar who has been very helpful and attentive so far! I’ve only been here for 1 night and I’m already obsessed! June is the perfect time to stay at Paradisus because it’s not crowded and the weather is perfect! No rain just sunshine and good vibes!

Miguel, our baggage handler, was very sweet!

reviews.author: Gwen Perri
reviews.text: The Flora, Andrea the waitress gave excellent service and the food was five star. We were on vacation with two other couples and they made us feel special and right at home! Highly recomended!

reviews.author: Blue Angel0
reviews.text:
One of the best choices we've ever made Was to spend two weeks here with the whole Family. We had a great time and our children talked about it for weeks after. I can't think of one thing that I do not like or anything Negative about our experience. Our first day there when we checked in We were assisted by a young lady named Katherine. We had many questions,

She was very patient with us. Her attitude while she interacted with us was so joyful and natural. My Wife gave her a tip, And she turned around and gave the money to my daughter. The smile she put on my child's face was amazing.  These are the type of people We look forward to being in the presence of when we travel. Our first day there was A blessing especially to my daughter. When a person like Katherin leaves a memory in a child's life Like that, it's amazing. We are already planning our next vacation, And of course we will definitely be back here. Thanks Katherine for you're kindness.

reviews.author: Cale Carmichael
reviews.text: Do not come here. Just had the worst meal of my life after a series of very poor meals.  The food is just inedible.  That may sound like hyperbole but it is not.  I had a very fair review of this resort written before this experience.  The concierge was not helpful and lied to me several times about what just happened to me and my family.  I gave him several opportunities to make this right, but he refused.  Tried to escalate this, but was told I needed to wait.  This is not an option as we leave in the morning.  It is not possible to rate this resort lower, but they deserve it.  One of the biggest problems is no one is in charge.  A meal or 10 is bad, but no body cares.  Things go missing from your room, no body cares.  If you have 30 or 40 screaming 18 year olds, please come here.  They will love it, especially if you are paying for it.

reviews.author: Jessica Alexis
reviews.text: Beautiful resort and premises! Food is delicious! Shoutout to Melina at Flora, she was amazing! Food was delicious. They really accommodate everyone’s preferences and food needs! We had the beef ribs, steak and rainbow trout.

reviews.author: Lauren Piroli
reviews.text: Our waiters Raider and Milton were exceptional at the Italian Restaurant, Mascalzone. They were very attentive and our glasses were always full. Because of their efforts, this was easily the best meal we had during our stay.

reviews.author: Jenna MacPherson
reviews.text:
Our family had a fantastic stay at Paradisus Palma Real in Punta Cana, with just a few minor drawbacks that, if improved, would make the experience even better.

The resort itself is stunning, set right on a beautiful, well-maintained beach. The main pool is massive, and each hotel building has its own quieter pool, which we appreciated for a more relaxing experience. However, the main pool is shared between the family-friendly and adults-only sections of the resort, and by late afternoon, it was overrun with spring break revelers. This led us to retreat to the quieter pools, which thankfully were excellent alternatives.

One issue with the main pool was the lack of shaded areas and umbrellas, which made it difficult to stay outside comfortably during the hottest parts of the day. More shade options would be a great addition.

The spa was excellent, and the adult activities throughout the day were well-organized and fun. The evening entertainment was also a highlight, with a great mix of performances and events.

The absolute standout of our trip was Kidsdom, the resort’s kids’ club. It was well-organized, engaging, and a true highlight for our children. They spent a few hours there each day, coming back thrilled about the crafts they had made and the friends they had met. The staff was incredibly welcoming—engaging our kids the moment they walked in—and even greeted them by name around the resort.

A couple of small notes for families considering this resort:

The pools are quite deep (most are nearly 5 feet), which was challenging for our younger kids and even for me as a shorter adult. This led to congestion around the pool stairs, as they were one of the few shallow spots.

Providing plastic cups and plates for kids at meals would be helpful, as the condensation on glassware made them slippery, and the ceramic plates were quite heavy for little ones.

Despite the minor inconveniences, our stay was wonderful, thanks to the beautiful resort, delicious food, and—above all—the exceptional staff. Huge thanks to Johlfrey (activities coordinator), Alexandra, Stefanie, and Sujeidi at Kidsdom, and Jamie and Alba at the spa for making our experience so special. A special recognition is also due for Maria at Rum Republic who is a fantastic bartender—kind, welcoming, and truly excellent at what she does.

We would recommend Paradisus Palma Real to families looking for a beautiful, relaxing getaway with top-notch service.

reviews.author: Claritza Morel
reviews.text: We had breakfast with the lovely Rosanna y Yanira

reviews.author: Breagh Mckeough
reviews.text: We had a a amazing time! Thank you to all the staff, especially Vanessa who provided exceptional service every single day on the beach! And to Ricki in the Lunch Box. We're grateful, it was a lovely vacation. We'll be back!

reviews.author: marylou fernandes
reviews.text: Beautiful resort! The rooms better than the pictures. They have events happening throughout the day that you can join. The restaurant Flora on the premises had delicious food. My server was Cesar and he was great. Highly recommend this place.

reviews.author: Fei Long
reviews.text: Nice environment. Very friendly and competent staff. Our concierge Cristian took good care of us. Thank you, Crus! Juan,  Amanda , Rafael from the restaurant Santè provided us with great service. The food there is very tasty. It was an unforgettable dining experience.

reviews.author: Tyler Stemen
reviews.text: Our stay here has been absolutely perfect! The food, people, service, and rooms have been amazing! And Alberto at the 90 degrees bar has made the experience even better! We will definitely come back!

reviews.author: Alicia
reviews.text: Rosanna at The Lunch Box is fantastic!  Always great service with a smile.😊

reviews.author: Michael Johnson
reviews.text:
We came for a week vacation to Paradisus Palma Real. The hotel was quite empty this time of year, so we enjoyed that but it might not be for everyone. So restaurants were closed each night which was fine as we were able to get to them all over the week. The room was lovely and the amenities excellent. We spent most of our days at the club members pool and bar. We had excellent care and service by the staff at the pool. Shout out to Joel and Marlileisy. Our concierge was Lewis, and he was attentive and friendly as well as helpful. I recommend his services to any member!

All in all an excellent stay.

reviews.author: R K
reviews.text: Mascalzone rest. We have just completed the most amazing meal  . The menu has the most astounding selections, my choice, lasagna far exceeded my expectations. The wait staff was most attentive to our every needs. This is a culinary memory I will not forget. Thank you for providing an exceptional dining experience. Waiters  Reynaldo y el supervisor Milton

reviews.author: Hope McLean Anderson
reviews.text:
Our stay was Great! This is such a Beautiful resort!! The staff have done such a Wonderful job making this an Awesome vacation!! Everyday our room was found spotless and the minibar stocked with all kinds of goodies. Flora was Awesome!! GREAT food and service! Francesca and all of the staff were Amazing!! The Lunchbox was Great! Good food and Excellent service!! Franklin helped with ant information that we needed at the concierge
desk, was so helpful! Can't wait to come back!!

reviews.author: yekenis alb
reviews.text: The Italian restaurant was absolutely amazing! Milton passed by our table and personally greeted us, which made the night even more special. Wilminia, our waiter, was incredible—so attentive and kind. The food was delicious, and the service was top-notch. Truly a 10/10 experience!

reviews.author: Hiba D
reviews.text:
Unfortunately, I could only give this resort that’s disclosed as a “5 star resort”, 2 stars. This is because the food was absolutely atrocious, to the point where it was inedible. On 2+ occasions my significant other received raw steak, I mean only pan seared not cooked on his plate. This could seriously make someone very I’ll. On top of this the chips were stale at the buffet, omelettes were so over cooked that they didn’t even taste like eggs anymore. Just a horrendous experience. Even the restaurants were pretty awful. The best experience we had was at Flora, where we were actually able to finish our meals.

Besides the terrible food we loved absolutely everything else about the resort. Bar tenders and staff were lovely & attentive, the resort was spotless. However one thing to note is to be careful on your balcony. You may get locked out and stuck there like we did. The vendors walking up to your beach chairs were consistent and that was extremely annoying and not so relaxing. I had to pretend I was sleeping every time they came by.

The pools were essentially empty, we didn’t stay at the reserve but had access to the adults pool & the resort was empty regardless probably because of the time we went. Barely any kids, which was nice.

Because the culinary experience was appalling, I would not recommend this resort to anyone or come back again.

reviews.author: Naks S
reviews.text:
Me and my partner spent our honeymoon here. The food was amazing, as was the service. My favourite restaurant was Sante. The staff were lovely including Nelson, Santo, and Juan :)

A huge massive thank you to Miseal and Norjandro, they provided 5* service every meal, and always with a smile!

Eriol was our concierge and was absolutely lovely, he made our honeymoon experience extra special.

reviews.author: Amy Pessis
reviews.text:
Our multigenerational family of 27 had an awesome time at the Paradisus. Rooms, views, beach all excellent. Our first time at all inclusive resort and we were pleased- the ease of buffet eating was great with kids. The buffet also can become tedious, so I recommend reservations at conventional restaurants. (Particularly the Japanese one- extremely fun for everyone)
You may need to ask questions more than once if you are not a Spanish speaker, and follow up is necessary with large group plans. Our concierge was extremely friendly and helpful- which enhanced the trip. We were content with the resort pools and beaches but if we come back (which is likely) we would go to neighboring resorts for more variety. An extremely relaxing and happy vacation

reviews.author: Raquel Olivero
reviews.text: This was the 2nd group trip I set up at this property. By far an amazing resort. We had some issues during the check in process that took up 5 hours of our day, and got absolutely no resolution from the very dismissive manager Lisandro. But aside from that I would definitely return back and continue booking my vacations with the Melia Brand. We encountered some very AMAZING staff that went above and beyond to make this birthday trip amazing and i would like to thank Fiora (Kick's Adult Club), Olvi and Stormin (from Kanna Restaurant), Wellington, and Carlos (entertainment staff).

reviews.author: Ruthshel Telus
reviews.text:
We were pleasantly surprised to find out that the Palma Real has a kids zone that you can drop off your kids. My daughter spent a couple ours everyday of our stay with the staff at Kidsdome and she had soo much fun. They did activities, took them to the beach, pool, made slime to take home. The staff was always enthusiastic to see her every morning and she formed a close bond with some of them. Wagner, Tania, Alexandra and Joanna and Susu were amazing! My daughter is already asking when we will come back here. Thank you for loving my daughter!!

This morning is sadly our last day at Palma Real. We had the pleasure of having Rosanna Castillo Felix as our server this morning. She was sweet and kind, and very quick to attend to our needs. One thing I can say about Palma real is that the staff is excellent, and professional and fun to be around!

For our last night we ate at the Italian place mescalzone.  The service was excellent. The manager Milton made sure all our needs were met, and that we were satisfied with our meals. It was a pleasure to have Briley and Reynaldo at our service. They had such a pleasant demeanor and overall welcoming attitude. It was a great way to end our trip

Maria Mercedes (with the braces) , Betty and Yafreisi were such a joy to see at the lunch box in the mornings for breakfast and lunch. They always had a smile, they were ready to meet our every needs weather it be getting a drink for my daughter, getting my coffee or extra utensils and making recommendations on foods they believed I would like like. Seeing them daily definitely made me enjoy my stay more!

Alqueno and Roberto were amazing!! They gave us amazing service at tokimeku, and put on a really amazing show. They were attentive to our needs, engaging and so much fun. My 6 year old daughter had a blast and of course the food was great!! Thanks so much for a great experience

reviews.author: Miguel Cotto
reviews.text: At our finale night at Paradisus Palma Real we had dinner where we started, at the Mascalzone  restaurant. We returned for our final meal here because the staff are all very attentive and personable. Our favorite staff is Milton. Every time he would see us he would always say hello and ask us how our stay is. He has made our stay here very enjoyable.

reviews.author: Meghan Schroeder
reviews.text: The service is exceptional here. At the beach, we had Rafael cater to us all week. He saved our spot, set us up, and brought us water and drinks as needed. Fior was exceptional at Kick’s. We also had an amazing concierge in Basilio. He took great care of us, always setting us up with anything we needed throughout our trip. We had a great trip and these three assisted in making it special.

reviews.author: Danny Perez
reviews.text:
I enjoyed our time on the beach especially with the excellent service provided by Marileisy. She provided us with excellent service and made our experience on the beach very enjoyable.

Our dinner at the wine club was excellent and our servers Johnathan and Juan provided excellent service. I will definitely have dinner there again.

reviews.author: Terri
reviews.text:
A fabulous resort!!! Beautiful rooms, clean and spacious.
Service is impeccable.
Always someone there to tend to your needs.
Thank you to all staff, especially at the restaurants.
Rosanna Castillo served us … she’s a very friendly hostess and ready to make your eating experience a pleasant one!
Great job everyone!!!

reviews.author: Anivette Garcia-Soldevila
reviews.text:
Flora Restaurant at Paradisus Resort was amazing.
After all we have gone through during our stay…no pick up from the airport to the hotel, no cold AC in our room, room refrigerator doesn’t work, bad bad bad customer service.
We came for dinner at Flora and starting with the ambiance, decoration plus Stephanie’s, recommendations and service; the food was outstanding.
5 Stars for this restaurant!

reviews.author: Anselma Ellingwood
reviews.text: The Dominican night was amazing. The food was good and the atmosphere was lively and welcoming. Shout out to the staff who made it possible (Soranyi and Jairo!)

reviews.author: Adam Ali
reviews.text: Basilio our concierge made our vacation experience the best one we had in Punta Cana. He was very accommodating to our group. He was efficient in booking our daily dinners. He's very courteous, extremely pleasant and funny. We were very fortunate to have him as our concierge. He made our 50th birthday experience memorable with cake, balloons and rose petals all around the room.

reviews.author: Stephen Severino
reviews.text:
Loved our dinner at the Italian restaurant  (Mascalzone) - delicious and top rate service (thanks Milton, Rider, and Celia).

The resort as a whole is in a beautiful location, there are numerous pools (not overcrowded), and our room was spacious with a great view. Very pleased.

reviews.author: Jennifer Fitzsimmons
reviews.text: Amazing service and delicious food. The servers are very attentive and kind. Thank you so much !!!

reviews.author: Luciana Domingues
reviews.text:
My family of 4 stayed for five days at this beautiful resort, we loved the accommodation and hospitality. The food could definitely use some improvement, especially in main area  ( buffet) . More air ventilation around the Buffett also would’ve been awesome as well.
Our room was absolutely beautiful and everything remained cleaned and well maintained, the weather and everything about DR is beautiful!
Starlin was our guide and he was absolutely awesome. We appreciated his kindness, attention, and time. We hope to see him again :)

reviews.author: Abhirami Raghavan
reviews.text:
We had a wonderful time at Paradisus Palma Real… the service, food, location, and specifically our concierge Felix Garcia were all amazing. Also, special thanks to Ivelecce for helping us with a smooth check in and check out process.

We are a family of 5, 4 vegetarians and 1 with nut allergies; and we were very well taken care of with multiple options being offered at each of the restaurants as well as the buffet.

Would definitely recommend!!!

reviews.author: Sarah Iskali
reviews.text: The family had an amazing experience at this resort. A big shoutout to Rafael, Martin, and kelvin for making our experience better. The service was great and these people went out of their way to make our vacation experience better. An even bigger shoutout to our concierge who made our vacation seamless where we didn’t have to worry about a thing, we highly recommend Eriol.

reviews.author: Cassandra Pelletier
reviews.text: Overall, we enjoyed our stay. Ginger was a great bar for higher quality drinks (alcohol and coffee/smoothies) and Kicks Sports bar was a fun time! Great service, all sports available to watch on the TVs and the other activities (pool table, dj, etc.) were great!

reviews.author: Alex F
reviews.text:
We booked three different hotels on our trip and this one was the best. This hotel is quite high level. Good design and maintenance.

Great reception bar. Friendly staff.

Room is clean, modern, comfortable bed, quiet, good design.

The beach is big with a large number of umbrellas and sunbeds. Good towels without a card - you can leave them anywhere.

There was only one minus - the food in the steakhouse is not very good, and a long wait time.

So we rated the hotel at 9/10. If we went again to Bavaro, we would choose this hotel.

reviews.author: P R
reviews.text:
Ramon at the beach provided excellent service.  He knew exactly when we needed something and brought it before we even asked.   He is the best!

Jonathan at the swim up pool bar was also amazing!  He anticipated our favorite drink!  Leyenda brugal on the rocks with lime, delicious!

Enjoyed the entertainment by the activities director Jhoffrey (?spelling).  Danced many nights away.  Also learned poolside dance moves and had a fun rum tasting.

Our snack attendant in building 4 was so welcoming with his kind smile.  He made sure we had all our snacks and sparkling waters daily.

For therapeutic massages Gladys (she has magic hands) and Dorka (also wonderful masseuse)  at the spa.  Have the herbal tea and select a complimentary aromatherapy. You won’t regret it.

Juan Castillo was an attentive and caring concierge.  He took extra steps to ensure everyone was aware of our allergies- made the stay so much more enjoyable and relaxing from the start.  We love and appreciate him so much!

Make restaurant reservations- superior dining compared to the buffet for sure.  Kicks sports bar also has great food- try the shrimp!

reviews.author: Gladys Negron
reviews.text: This trip was amazing. The restaurants did a great job with the food. Our food was cooked perfectly. We really enjoyed our stay and our Concierge Juan Carlos Sierra did an amazing job. He was so helpful and attentive. All the staff from the restaurants, pool and beach areas were great. We can’t wait to come back.

reviews.author: Louise Mather
reviews.text: Ramon on the beach and by the pool - great service with a smile, always keeping drinks topped up.  Thank you for looking after myself and my daughter so well.  Louise.

reviews.author: Prall
reviews.text: We had such a great time for our honeymoon. We stayed in the reserve swim up suite and it was amazing. The service from our concierge, pool waiter and bartender, all restaurant hosts/waiters were fantastic. It was usually always pretty quiet on the adults only side which was nice and contributed to the relaxing atmosphere.

reviews.author: Ubiel
reviews.text: We had dinner at Flora restaurant At Paradisus Palma Real and Ana was awesome, she made us feel special and gave us great food recommendations. The food was delicious and nicely presented. So far our best meal during the week! We will be back!

reviews.author: Anna Buba
reviews.text: The resort itself is beautiful, with lots of activities to participate in. As soon as you arrive there is the Ginger Bar right across the check in desk. In the morning, if you get the chance talk to Ismael and he will make sure you get exactly what you want ( if you’re not sure ask for his special). At night, Robert is the same way - overall, they are very kind and the drinks here are my favorite out of ALL the bars in the resort! What really made my trip, was the service. Especially, Yenseen at the Italian restaurant. He was very attentive and consistently checked on us, refilling our beverages, and being patient especially with the partial language barrier. Not to mention, his supervisor Milton was very welcoming and cracked a few jokes here and there. Tokimeko, the Japanese restaurant was also amazing. My chef Kendy and server Fanni did an exceptional job. Kendy was joking around with my family and the food was so filling and seasoned perfect. It was like a performance - amazing! Make sure to visit these restaurants your first night and you will not be disappointed!!!!

reviews.author: ana gonzalez
reviews.text: Went to Restaurant Flora and our waiter, Cesar, was very attentive. I had the Mofongo which was very delicious. What great food and service.

reviews.author: Rudy Gibbs
reviews.text: Absolutely loved the place and the people.  The staff made our visit one of the best vacations that we've ever had.  Looking forward to returning!

reviews.author: Mary C
reviews.text: This is the first time at the Paradisus Palma.  We are beach people and Rafael, Pedro and Gilberto would greet us every morning with smile and have our chairs and drinks ready for us.  All three of them were wonderful for that I would come back to this resort.  Also our Concierge Juan was also amazing he took care of our dinner reservations and all of our needs.  Thank you Juan your the best.  Also I can't forget the cook at the Sante omelet station, he was amazing made the best eggs ever and so friendly.

reviews.author: Kristin Duffek
reviews.text: Rosanna, Rocio and Delvin were great each morning. Santos from Blue Agave also truly stood out.  He was very kind and accommodating.

reviews.author: Sandy Terry
reviews.text: Paradisus Palma Real is meeting and exceeding all of our vacation expectations. The property is stunning; the staff is warm and genuine and eager to please; the beach is gorgeous; the Adult only Reserve is a treat with extra benefits of comfort and luxury; the overall ambiance is splendid; the entertainment is very good and the food is delightful. We would highly recommend this experience and plan to come back with family.

reviews.author: Mike Wierzbicki
reviews.text:
I had the pleasure of staying at the hotel with my wife and 2 and 4 year old daughter in November of 2024.  The resort was absolutely beautiful, the kids loved the vacation. Martha & Stephanie from kidsdom the children’s day care were amazing. I have nothing but good things to say and we felt so comfortable leaving them as they always had so many fun activities with the kids. Very caring and attentive.
The food was great, the atmosphere was wonderful and there was always a new experience to be had each day.

5 stars all the way.

reviews.author: Khedra Joseph
reviews.text: Five stars all across the board! Thank you so much for such an amazing welcome it really enhanced the experience from start to finish, and sooo thankful to Franklin for going all out to make all our restaurant experiences superb, we really appreciate you!! Thank you to our favoute waiter Roberto ♥︎♥︎.  Also, Lisandro & Yaniel!! Thank you so much

reviews.author: Lee
reviews.text: Manuel’s service was outstanding at the Steakhouse.  The steak was outstanding!  I am not even a steak person but that steak was flavorful, juicy, and cooked perfectly.  Also the manager snd the servers are extremely attentive to your needs.  Outstanding all around.

reviews.author: Tar Far
reviews.text: Amazing service by Ramon by the beach. Best part of the trip

reviews.author: Tony Perez
reviews.text: Kicks crew and staff was great along with food and drinks

reviews.author: Dr. Leslyn B. Uribe
reviews.text: I had an exceptional stay celebrating my birthday. Ely was my concierge and he was an amazing host, meeting all of my needs. The property is nice and all of the staff I encountered provided great service. 10/10 I recommend.

reviews.author: Gregory Gatteny
reviews.text:
We would like to tell you how much we appreciate your time and efforts to get us on vacation. Thank you for Juan, the upgrade to the Reserve was the way to go, especially when it came to the food, the beach & the other pools.

Just a few of our thoughts: In our opinion, Definitely not a 4-5 star resort. We called down for ice and towels the first 2 days we were there, we received them without issue, after that we called down multiple times for towels didn't get them, we called multiple time for ice didn't get it. When it comes to Language and communication a 4-5 star resort should be able to assist and communicate with all there guests. Some staff spoke a little English but not enough to feel like we were understood.

When it came to the buffet at the Lunch Box, some of the items were labeled and some were not. Tourists with food allergies need to be careful, my wife has a gluten & shellfish allergy, when we asked about some of the food items at the buffet, I don't think the cook/chef tending the buffet understood us. There were so many people at the morning buffet that the 2 omelet/egg stations had 5-7 people deep in line.

The lounge chairs and tables at the main pool were broken, cracked and rusty. The main pool is in need of repairs. Every morning there was always trash around the pool deck, my wife stepped on a piece of plastic that would of cut her foot if she didn't have water shoes on.

We loss electrical power once and we loss the air conditioner twice. The second time the air condition went down was the day before we were leaving, the blowing of warm air soaked our floor with condensation, my wife slipped and twisted her hip. I called down to let them know, they said OK we will send someone up. I sat there for 2.5 hours while my wife & daughter were at the pool. I called multiple times and was told OK they are on it. This is were communication comes in, they should of said to me that they are having a problem with the main unit  so I didn't have to wait in the room.

The Resort had great views, but having to be shuttled to the beach, because the direct access was for Circle or Reserve members, pools closing at 7 PM and not opening until 10:00 am, all this information should be in the Resort Description so vacationers can make a better decision.

Again we appreciate Juan, we also met Leonela she is a concierge who we engaged with on our 3rd day there. I guess we were suppose to meet our concierge and have welcome drinks when we arrived, we didn't have any of that.

This was our experience, our thoughts and opinions. Thanks again for all that you did for us.

Jhonathan at the Winery made our last nite in Punta Cana Relaxing and pleasurable. After losing the air conditioner in our room, we headed down to the Winery for our last meal. Great meal great service. Thank you.

reviews.author: Steven Wherrey
reviews.text: My final review for Paradisus Palma Real before we return home tomorrow. After a week long stay at this resort and in celebrating my 23rd anniversary at Blue Agave with my wife and daughter….I can honestly say that we will miss this resort. The service tonight at dinner was impeccable as our servers were Virtudes and Edisson, who never left us with a dry glass. They provided great service and very attentive. Thank you to the entire staff of Blue Agave and to the manager Santos who took care of us after missing our timed reservation. We will be back.

reviews.author: Nadine
reviews.text:
All-in-all an outstanding hotel!

We enjoyed our holiday to the fullest.

The rooms are spacious and nicely designed.

There are really a lot of pools!
My favorite one is the largest including the swim-up bar. Always nice music and people in very good mood. ;)
There is also a very long pool, I guess around 100 meters, where you can perfectly train your swimming skills.

The food in every restaurant  - even the buffet - is excellent on a very high level.

The white sandy beach is beautiful with turquoise water. The visibility is not so good, so snorkeling/ the underwater world is not good to observe but that doesn’t matter. You can stay in the beautiful water for hours.

The most fabulous part are the people working here: everyone is focused on giving us the best holiday experience ever. I think of a lot of names, who are exceptional, but it would be unfair to mention just a few because everyone is doing an incredible job;
The maids make our room so clean you could literary eat from the floor. The gardeners take care of the whole outside area and so do the pool boys early in the morning so that everything looks stunning.
Then the service at all restaurants, bars, pools, the beach, the kidsdom, the singer in the evening, the cook at the “breakfast-egg-station” … really nearly everyone is awesome!
Not to forget all the people working in the kitchen to create this exceptional food experience!

Special thanks to Jonathan, Laura ❤️ and Gustavo, Gerarado Elvis, Reynaldo, Melinda, Rocio, Hilda, Betty and Maria and Francesco and many more I am sorry that I don’t know their names. Santo always remembers every name ;)

reviews.author: Alexis Lanier
reviews.text: love the service! very nice & clean. Rosanna was so sweet and helpful during the service we needed.

reviews.author: mayra rojas
reviews.text: The resort was beautiful, clean and has a relaxing atmosphere. The restaurants for dinner were all nice and the food was great. The buffet was alright nothing crazy but I feel like that’s how all buffets are. Our concierge Adriel made our vacation even more relaxing and enjoyable! He took care of everything from restaurant reservations to booking the taxi back to the airport and making sure everyday that we had what we needed in our room! Will definitely request to have Adriel as our concierge again!

reviews.author: julie coulas
reviews.text:
Flora staff and service were top notch, Andrea, Stormie kept us entertained and our cups full!!  This group of employees are all professional and so friendly we became family!  Everyone must try the food you can not miss this restaurant!!

Yuderi was the BEST Server on the beach!!  He made our trip even more special and he is so accommodating with the cold beverages making sure we never went thirsty

reviews.author: Nervin Lawendy
reviews.text: We had an awesome stay here. The place was rather empty. We had a surprise dinner for my husband’s birthday at the Winery and our servers Maximo and Jonathon were awesome and made our evening special. Food was delicious!! Our concierge Starlin was the best. Super kind and caring. Made every day a pleasure!

reviews.author: Jenny Akridge
reviews.text: Blue agave was awesome! Our server Melvin was great, and also Felix. The food and atmosphere are wonderful.  Would love to come back again soon!

reviews.author: Joseph Peden
reviews.text:
I was very pleased with the service that was rendered to me at the Kanna restaurant at Paradisus Palma Real in Punta Cana.
The service team were very attentive to customer service and anticipated the need of the clients. The view was spectacular viewing the playa Kanna,
I am planning to come back soon.
Hopefully the supervisor Mr. Storming will be working so that his team can supervise my Family Reunion .

Sincerely,
Joseph Peden

reviews.author: Miriam Carminio
reviews.text:
Arisleida was so good and attentive
while at the beach. She made sure that we felt comfortable. We didn’t have to way for anything. Had so many conversations with her in both in English and Spanish.

reviews.author: Clyde Poloska
reviews.text: Rosanna at the pool deserves all starts. She is passionate and friendly.

reviews.author: Jose G Jimenez
reviews.text: Italian restaurant, wilminia had a great service. Supervisor gave us great food services/ advices.  Experienced with the mamá Juana testing 10/10. Brandol treated us great with great guidance. Flora has the best Dominican culture food themes. Cesar has great services, very respectful.

reviews.author: Vanessa Ruiz
reviews.text: Paradisus is an excellent hotel, everyone was very friendly, the service was superb and the hotel itself is beautiful. The food was amazing at Mina and Jean Carlos and Reynaldo were truly attentive and took great care of us. 100% recommend.

reviews.author: Michelle Kristofik
reviews.text:
While the location was beautiful, and restaurant staff were wonderful, the management and customer service was the worst I’ve ever experienced from an all-inclusive resort. We noticed they trick you into leaving 5 star reviews by asking you to review specific places after some drinks, but the link actually leads you to the whole resort, not for individual bars or experiences (Ismael at Ginger Cafe, I would leave YOU a 5 star review, but not the resort).

Upon arrival, they took my passports and payment, and left us standing around for about 15 minutes. The rooms were not ready until 2 hours after “check-in”. They kept offering to take our bags, but it was clear others were waiting around for hours without their bags and unable to enjoy the pool and beach. I’m used to being handed a drink at check in, given an introduction of the place, and ALWAYS a map to our room. Not here. We traveled with another family, and they also had a similarly poor check in experience.

When we left, they tried to double charge us. Despite me showing the charge from my bank with the hotel’s details, we were held 25 minutes past our departure time. It felt as if they were trying to hold us responsible for their ineptitude. We even asked our transport guy to just take us since we clearly paid and the front desk started to argue with him.

Otium, their primary transportation service, also failed to have our info at the airport upon arrival, nor did they have the confirmed time for the ride back when I was told to expect it.

I was also left confused by their food and if any of their chefs have even tried to look up videos of how to make international dishes.

With that said, the restaurant staff and activities team was always wonderful and a pleasure to interact with. The place was beautiful and the pools and beach were always clean.

But if they want to provide a 5 star experience, they need to figure out how to make check in and check out a more relaxing and welcoming experience— not the most confusing and stressful aspect of the trip.

reviews.author: Andrew Dempster
reviews.text: Great experience. Staff is eager to help and provide whatever you need. Very relaxed environment at the adults only side of the resort, and the family side is also very calm for such a big resort. I would definitely recommend and come back.

reviews.author: Cristina Mirabal
reviews.text: The best waitress Rosanna is at the pool. She is extremely serviceable and nice. She is the best person at the hotel. Look for her if you want great service.

reviews.author: S W
reviews.text: Rosanna yaniva  Maria was wonderful. Very nice and helpful. Great service

reviews.author: Dema L
reviews.text:
Our experience at this hotel was very good! The family-friendly atmosphere and attentive staff made our vacation memorable. The spacious rooms accommodated our family with three kids comfortably. The kids club was a great addition and they kept our kids happy and engaged. It was perfect for older kids, offering a range of engaging activities. While it's great, we suggest adding more scheduled activities and adding kids areas to enhance the experience further. Nonetheless, the overall stay was fantastic, earning this hotel a well-deserved five stars. Highly recommended for families seeking both relaxation and entertainment!
We also had an issue with the concierge service, however, after a brief meeting with the supervisor our issues were addressed and everything was great. So if you have any issues - please, talk to the supervisor and your issues should be resolved.
A true big thanks to señor Jimenez who helped us at the steak house restaurant and hosted our huge party of 9 at the time when our booking got lost!
I would also like to express a personal and special gratitude to Mrs Loyda who took care of us at the beach and served all our families with cold refreshing drinks and made our stay a remarkable experience!

reviews.author: Kaitlyn Johnson
reviews.text:
Our stay at Paradisus Palma Real was nothing short of spectacular! From the moment we arrived, we were surrounded by luxury, relaxation, and top-notch service.

The beach was absolutely breathtaking—soft white sand, crystal-blue water, and plenty of loungers to unwind under the sun. The pools were beautifully maintained, offering the perfect oasis for both relaxation and fun. And, of course, the drinks were fantastic—refreshing cocktails by the pool and beachside, always perfectly made.

A special shoutout to Jendry, our incredible concierge, who went above and beyond to make our stay perfect. He ensured our clothes were always laundered on time, secured all our reservations, and even surprised us with prosecco in our room—a thoughtful touch that made our experience extra special.

At the beach, Pedro was amazing! He took care of everything, from reserving our favorite chairs to keeping us stocked with fresh drinks and afternoon snacks—his attentiveness truly made our beach days unforgettable. Pedro made our vacation so special and memorable, and we are already talking about coming back and hoping to see Pedro again.

We also indulged in the spa, where the massages were simply divine—pure relaxation in a serene setting.

Overall, Paradisus Palma Real exceeded all expectations. If you’re looking for a luxurious, relaxing, and beautifully maintained resort with exceptional service, this is the place to be. We can’t wait to return!

reviews.author: Christianne Takeda
reviews.text:
Excellent service and exquisite food. Not to mention the wonderful service by Daniel and Jose at the Japanese restaurant, Johnathan and Elvis in the Winery, Ismael, Olga, neeryda, Clary at the Ginger Bar, Quintino at the pool bar, Juan nd Frank at the breakfast buffet. All the dtaff are “ personas muy atenciosas y amables”.
To Rosimery our dearest concierge, thank you very much for the attention. We loved your terrific work! Always taking care of everything so that we could have  the best experience during all stay.

reviews.author: Michael Page
reviews.text:
My wife and I just returned from 4 nights at the Paradisus with our 15 month old son. It was really a terrific trip.

We had a swim up suite, and the room was super spacious. Tons of space for us, and a crib that the hotel supplied. A new-ish, clean room. Being able to use the pool while the baby slept was clutch--and not many hotels in Punta Cana would let us book such a room with a toddler.

We went in with low expectations for the food based on some reviews, but honestly it was all at least good to very good. I wouldn't expect a true culinary experience when you go--if that's what you want go elsewhere--but we never had bad food, and found plenty of variety.  The best food we had was the fish, which was always very fresh and some of the better meals we had, as well as the hibachi at the Japanese restaurant.

We were able to get dinner reservations each night with the help of our concierge, Franklin. He communicated with us each day via WhatsApp to get us into a restaurant we requested.

The pools were chilly, but never overly busy. Tons of space. We were able to get cabanas each day, which was great for the baby. Arisleida was particularly helpful getting this set up each day.

Being here with our son, this felt like the perfect spot for us. Easy, a great beach, beautiful weather, and low stress. If my wife and I had been traveling alone we likely would've liked a more elevated experience, if that's what you're looking for, but again--that's not what this trip was meat to be for us so we had a terrific time.

reviews.author: Kat L
reviews.text: This resort is amazing. The staff, the food, the drinks and the location are breathtaking. My best friend and I went for three nights, and every night we were there was phenomenal. Our concierge Eriol was hands-down, the best person that could’ve helped us on our trip. He was super helpful to the and answered all of our questions. He made sure we were hydrated and very comfortable. The resort is a 10 out of 10. The only regret I have is not staying for longer.

reviews.author: HeatherLenore B
reviews.text: The food and service is phenomenal at Blue Agave! Our server, Delvin, was amazing! So fun and funny! Made sure we were taken care of at every meal he served us. Even had a table ready for us right when we arrived. Great service, great people, great food, love love love it!

reviews.author: Laurie Putnam
reviews.text: The check in process was a breeze. We were given a tour of the property and shown to our room. Kelvin was our concierge and he was amazing! He made our dining reservations, answered our questions and checked on us daily. The swim out room is worth it! The rooms are nice, very updated. The only downside is the air conditioning can only go so low so I’d bring a fan. Housekeeping was on top of it. The food was excellent even though the resort was low occupancy, we were still able to eat at all of the restaurants. Overall, this spot is great to visit the DR.

reviews.author: Brandon Sands
reviews.text: Rafael and Martin made me and my wife’s stay very enjoyable! They were friendly, super attentive and very helpful in every manner. Our beach area was set up and ready for us every single morning. Whenever our drinks were empty, we had another one in hand within minutes. I highly recommend service from these two great guys!

reviews.author: Dana Dorr
reviews.text: Dior at Kicks Sports Bar was amazing!! Great service all around the resort but he was our favorite made us feel welcome and comfortable! Definitely coming back!

reviews.author: real deal
reviews.text: Rosanna, Delvin, Santo and Yanira and truly amazing people!! They're service is impeccable, the way they greet you and treat you makes you feel like family and THEY ARE ALWAYS SMILING!! The Lunch Box Cafe is such a great place with great food, but I can not speak highly enough about this staff! We love you guys.

reviews.author: Ron Gee
reviews.text: Ramon Rivas from the pool and beach area was so amazing. He was so attentive and such a nice person and hands down made our trip absolutely awesome. He was so kind and very helpful. If you come to this resort request Ramon Rivas!!!!!!! You will not be disappointed. Thank you Ramon for everything you made our trip and we are so grateful for you. See u again !

reviews.author: dawn R
reviews.text: We ate at Sante for lunch several times and we ate there for dinner also. The food was absolutely amazing. There were four of us and we almost had everything on the menu. Service was great. We had the lobster raviolis, the octopus excellent lamb chops the fish and the list goes on. The service was amazing, Franklin, Mercedes Amanda, Wilson, Lydia, and Misael took care of  us for our dinner.

reviews.author: Paul Stone
reviews.text: We had dinner at Flora restaurant. We wanted to try Dominican food. The food was excellent. Our server, Francesca, was fabulous. We took her recommendations and were not disappointed.  Service atmosphere and food were top notch.

reviews.author: Walk the Talk SLT
reviews.text: Excellent service at Flora restaurant. Great massages by Estrella. Wonderful teppanyaki chefs and Mexican restaurant. Place is lovely. I would highly recommend it. Facilities are excellent clean and service is great at breakfast. Staff are friendly and make us want to come back yearly.

reviews.author: Chris English
reviews.text: Ramon on the beach was fantastic!!  He kept our champagne glasses full all day as we enjoyed the beach in a cabana!   Excellent service!

reviews.author: Liz C
reviews.text:
The hotel's services have been satisfactory.

The buffet staff, particularly Yorgelys and Lucianna, demonstrated exceptional efficiency and attentiveness during my dining experiences.

However, it was inconvenient that reservations were required for each of the six restaurants on a daily basis, and most preferred time slots were often unavailable despite our early attempts to reserve. As a result, we had to venture into the downtown area for dinner on two occasions, which, while enjoyable, was not the expectation for an all-inclusive resort.

The pools were consistently clean and well-maintained.

Overall, I am pleased with my stay and would consider returning in the future.

reviews.author: James Park
reviews.text:
The resort was top and I would gladly stay again!!

Fernando Chipa was an excellent fitness instructor. His classes were both fun and a great energy boost.

reviews.author: Krishna Patel
reviews.text: Beautiful resort, amazing service and food. Great location! Loved it! Sante is an amazing restaurant in the resort. They prepared a wonderful meal especially for us after we told them we are vegetarian and the service was great!

reviews.author: Carla Burden
reviews.text: Alberto and Antonia are the best!!!!  The adult pool is great!

reviews.author: Amanda O'Neil
reviews.text: This is one of the nicest all-inclusives I’ve been to.  It is absolutely beautiful and I’ve travelled most of the Caribbean.  The cleanliness, the esthetic, the grounds , the facilities, the beach.  The restaurants are very nicely decorated and the food was overall good.  Shoutout to Arisleida, Pedro and Rafael at the beach bar for their excellent service.  The VIP status is very worthwhile.  The beach is walkable.

reviews.author: Kathy Allen
reviews.text: It was a wonderful experience!!!  Absolutely beautiful location with ocean views and plenty of pools.  Service was excellent all around but our concierge Wily Mercado was the best!  He made dinner reservations for us every night and made sure room service was taken care of.  He made sure that we were well taken care of!  It was a great vacation!  We would highly recommend it!

reviews.author: Jennifer Mackay
reviews.text: The ladies at the child daycare, Marta, Alexandra, Susu, Joanna and Lisbet were amazing! Our son was well taken care of and kept asking to go back. They are the gem of the resort. Thankyou ladies.

reviews.author: C DeBenedictis
reviews.text: The whole trip was tremendous!!  Our concierge Fernando was so accommodating and helpful for the entire trip.  We were greeted with a welcome bottle of wine in our room.  The room had a beautiful view of the ocean and pool.  Fernando scheduled wonderful dinners to each of the restaurants.  He was also able to schedule a relaxing catamaran trip to an island spot for yoga and a swim.  Fernando also arranged some surprises in our room throughout the week.  Can’t say enough about him as well as Pedro and Raphael, who also made sure our favorite spot was saved for us on the beach each day.

reviews.author: Melissa Smith
reviews.text: We have just returned from a fantastic stay at the Paradisus Palma Real. The resort is stunning and well looked after. We stayed in the Reserve and had a great experience and were well looked after by Zenovia. The breakfast at Sante was excellent and the staff were friendly and efficient.  We ate at all the restaurants and generally the food quality and service was excellent. We had a few issues including our room not being cleaned one day which was eventually sorted and an issue with vouchers we were provided with as we were unaware we had to present them at the restaurant, not on check out and they refused to honour the voucher. All in all I would recommend staying at this hotel.

reviews.author: Dariusz P.
reviews.text: Great place to eat and have great food,  the service is awesome.  Some of the most friendly and accommodating staff. Definitely would recommend it while staying at the resort. Our waiter Ceasar was one of the most friendly and accommodating waiters that I've met. Definitely recommend him while staying at resort.

reviews.author: Diana Lita
reviews.text: Ginger bar was a great addition to the rest of the hotel the staff Ismael was great with smoothies for the kids and the coffee bar. Along with his team Antonio dominga Olga and clavy made our trip to ginger bar very pleasant !

reviews.author: William Carroll
reviews.text: We had an incredible stay at the Paradisus Palma Real. Cristopher with the concierge staff took care of us throughout our stay. Rafael at the Reserve beachfront was incredible and made sure that we had everything we needed! We’re so sad to leave, but can’t recommend this resort enough and the service is top notch!

reviews.author: Larissa Scandura
reviews.text:
Two years later we love this place. Our Concierge Franklin annd Fernando Chispa has been awesome making the resort sooooo fun!!! AND LENNISON!!! He’s been the best!
Amazing!!!! Restaurant tokineku was so good Santo the Box. We loved having G.C.  Starlin as our concierge this trip! He made our trip amazing and we can’t wait to come back!

reviews.author: Bola G
reviews.text: Excellent service. We had a great time at this Resturant. We were met by Mr. Manuel Torres and everything he recommended was amazing. This was our first time at the Aqua at the Reserve and we were amazed. Excellent food and service. Our waiter Katy was also very pleasant and on top of it. We would come here again. Thank you for all you do Katy and Mr. Manuel Torres. You both deserve a raise.

reviews.author: Elaine Bohme
reviews.text: We were at the resort at the end of November 2024 and had such a wonderful time. The resort is beautiful and well kept. The food at the Blue Agave was definitely our favourite. 2nd place was Flora the Dominican restaurant.  The Lunch Box had an endless supply of very good food. The BBQ and Paella at Kanna were spectacular!Countless bars to get your drinks from but our favourite  was the main bar by the big pool. Best bartender at the resort was Louis! He would spot us from a distance and our drinks would be on the bar when we got there.  One lady in particular made our trip extra special. Her name is Yafreisy and she works at the Lunch Box. She was so warm and welcoming and so much fun! Familia!! We are looking forward to going back there!

reviews.author: Susana Sohail
reviews.text: please read my review in its entirety. The only reason I am rating all 5 stars was literally for my last dinner at the hotel. Idelka was my server for my 6 o clock reservation ant the blue agave  and she was absolutely a pleasure to have. The food and experience at this particular restaurant was so memorable. I’d love to come back just to see and have her again. So sweet and friendly. Thank you Laura for accommodating my niece and her picky food options.

reviews.author: Mike Rashkovsky
reviews.text: Loved the staff at the kids center. Beautiful resort. The Mexican restaurant was my favorite. If you have a large group and don’t have butler service, line up for restaurant reservations at 8:30am and you‘ll be first in line. Bring cash and small bills for tips. Housekeeping staff really took care of us, make sure to tip them daily.

reviews.author: Sakurapsychopath
reviews.text: The service is amazing here especially the people who work at the pool, Jhojan is one of the best servers at the pool, he’s very kind, will take care of your family the whole time, and is efficient. 10/10 Recommend coming here.

reviews.author: Jennifer Mak
reviews.text:
We had a wonderful stay at the Paradisus Palma Real. The grounds are beautiful and so green. Everyone is so friendly, welcoming and helpful. Martin and Pedro at the Reserve beach were wonderful - they had our beach beds ready for us before we arrived to the beach in the morning.

Our concierge Juan was so attentive and nice. He checked up on us every morning to see if we needed everything.

I was pleasantly surprised by the quality of the food. Everything was tasty.

Lloelis was also great - very friendly and helpful!

All in all, we had a wonderful time and will definitely be back.

reviews.author: Carter Wrigley
reviews.text: Place was insanely good. Jarlin and Ismael were top notch. Always a smile on their face and simply wanted to give you the best experience possible. And don’t even get me started with Dino in the gift shop, she was so kind. Very pleased

reviews.author: Jessica Russell
reviews.text: Our stay was absolutely incredible. Our guest concierge Fernando took care of us and scheduled little treats for us pretty much every night in our room for our honeymoon. The food was immaculate. The views were amazing. It was truly the best honeymoon. Antonio at Gingerbar made sure to make us the best drinks. 1000/10 experience!

reviews.author: Big Mac
reviews.text: To start with, it was an amazing entrance to a direct view of the atrium and ocean. Paradisus Palma Real is an exquisite resort. Our concierge Senrowny Sosa was amazing. He did everything to make our trip as memorable as possible. His service to those assigned to him benefit from his charm and great smile. I know that is his responsibility, yet he treats you like you are family. Something I remember from when we got here, “Welcome Home” was said numerous times to make us feel welcome. He made my wife’s 60th birthday special. Thank you, Senrowny!!

reviews.author: Nick Griffin
reviews.text: Amazing experience here. Our concierge Eriol was an amazing guy. He was a bunch of help and really made our stay here that much better. He helped us out as much as he could and made sure we were having the most fun. The staff here was also very nice and helpful. Only good experiences here. It’s very clean and put together and the food here is great. Service has been amazing and I would recommend this resort for anyone choosing to come to the Dominican Republic.

reviews.author: zeycan Tutal
reviews.text: I loved this resort, the people are so friendly and helpful. The breakfast, lunch, and dinner were awesome. The food is good. The pools are very nice and clean. The bar workers are really friendly and they engage in conversation even though their english is limited. Overall a great experience.

reviews.author: Debb Leticia
reviews.text: We planned a last minute trip here and it was worth it. The resort itself is beautiful and very large, has lots of different dining options and the food was really good. Even the buffet was really good! Nathanael and Rosanna at the pool bar were great! They always had high energy and gave exceptional service every time. Definitely would return to this resort.

reviews.author: Hilka Corona
reviews.text: We are having a great time at the property. All of the employees have been great and their service is excellent, from the people who take orders to the servants. They all have positive attitude and are very pleasant.  I would like to give special thanks to Pedro who takes great care of us by the beach, Luis at buffet and Luis  who attend the bar by the main pool. My family appreciates their services.

reviews.author: Maria Di Fino
reviews.text: We ate at the Japanese restaurant. The food was amazing. Our waitress Maria was amazing and the chef Raffaele cooked us a delicious meal. Highly recommend eating here. Thank you for a memorable supper.

reviews.author: Dana Hayward
reviews.text: Juan Castillo was amazing. He made our stay and our anniversary wonderful. He was attentive , personable friendly and professional. He went above and beyond to make our day and evening memorable. We will come back and stay longer due to his excellent customer service skills. We also tell all of our friends how amazing g he and this resort was. I will also look to book company incentive trips based on the way he treated us. His customer service skills are an asset to Meliá and this resort.

reviews.author: Jane Hatzikonstantis
reviews.text: This resort is next level! Most notably we went to Flora for dinner which is elevated Dominican food and we loved it. Melina was our server and she was awesome. Would come again

reviews.author: Kayla Moné
reviews.text: I went here to celebrate my mom and cousin’s birthday with 9 other relatives. Some of our family stayed in the Reserve, adults only, and family/kids area. Each and every one of us enjoyed our stay! I will say the Reserve is definitely worth the upgrade, but my family who didn’t stay in the Reserve still had just as good of a time! Juan and Misael at Sante were AMAZING servers and ensured we were satisfied with every meal! Their hospitality made our stay in the Reserve all the more top notch. Kelvin, our concierge was AMAZING as well. He set up all of our dinner reservations, excursions, and massages. He even stopped by to check on me while my family was gone for a day on the yacht and I was left alone in the room due to not feeling well. Kelvin also surprised my mom and cousin (the birthday girls) by setting up their rooms with a hot bubble bath, birthday decor, and delicious cake! We enjoyed the activities the resort offered such as beach volleyball, live concerts, and the silent party with headphones. Everything was clean and well kept throughout the resort. We all felt safe. Every moment we spent there was truly a breath of fresh air and picture perfect! My advice would be to make sure you keep enough cash on you wherever you go for the purpose of tipping. The only thing I wish would’ve been better was my experience with housekeeping. It seemed as if there was a shortage of wash cloths at the resort. Me, my sister, and my mom shared a room in the Reserve and we never had enough. I also experienced an attitude with 1 of the housekeeping staff after asking for more clean face towels. Other than that, our experience was 10/10. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Charlene D
reviews.text: This resort came highly recommended to us. Raul, our concierge was beyond accommodating and always at our service! Our room was beautiful with a balcony and a gorgeous ocean view! The ginger bar was our favorite go to place for smoothies , coffee, and martinis! Lucia and Louis smiles were always welcoming at the bar! The bellman, Lloelis Alvarez, was wonderful and very friendly! This resort is a breathtaking place to relax and take in the beauty of the area.

reviews.author: Sam Peters
reviews.text:
This was my second visit to this resort. The experience in both the visits was vastly different. Which this one not being the best.

It’s a decent resort and has great views and good activities in the resort and nearby

To experience their dinner specialties. You need to make reservations

All these restaurants were a disaster.  With Italian taking the crown to being disgusting.
I am not the only person who had a bad experience. Even a different table too was disappointed. They simply walked away. Which prompted me too to call it a day in this restaurant. Olive Garden has better Italian food and i give it 2 out of 5 stars

Not sure if anyone from the resort will read this review. The point is my holiday was not what I expected

Rooms - staff did a great job. Keeping the rooms neat and tidy. 5 stars here

The swimming pools were clean

Someone who architected this place didn’t know what he was doing.
Check out the stall in the men’s washroom next to lunchbox. It’s practically impossible for you to open the door without hitting something

Had to change my room due to a problem in the middle of my stay. The staff who helped me move was hanging around expecting a tip. And didn’t leave till I tipped him.
Its not that I don’t tip. But expecting a tip is not appreciative

Kudos to the staff in Ginger and Lunchbox. They really do a great job.

reviews.author: Katie Simione
reviews.text:
Thank goodness for the amazing service here! Our concierge Nathanael has been spot on taking care of us  step of the way, going above and beyond! Our guys on the beach Martin and Rafael made our days on the beach perfect. They were ahead of our needs every day, set us up with the best spot, kept the drinks coming steady and cold, excellent service, go find them on the beach they will make your trip immensely better!
Things to improve - the food is just not good. Overcooked, flavorless just needs so much work to be good. All the buffets all the speciality restaurants were just NOT good.

reviews.author: Kristin W.
reviews.text:
Perfect Resort! From the beginning to the end! So many nice people.

Specially Juan from the Santé restaurant is one of the best! Friendly, funny and he is doing such a hard work. We are so thankful that he made our time at the resort so special! He is such a good human! Thank you very much!

reviews.author: Jandy Naruto
reviews.text: The whole place is great with super nice rooms and extravagant customer service. The employees are super kind and will do your best to have a good experience. Frank and Felix at Tokimeku were amazing with the show and service. Would for sure come back for them and the experience.

reviews.author: Vay Vay Hao
reviews.text:
Rosanna and Yanira are very welcoming.
We really enjoyed our stay!

Have Leonela as your host is the best! She got everything under control and ready to help!

reviews.author: Fernando Portal
reviews.text: Spent seven days at the resort and our chef Juan Cabrera was wonderful. All of the meals he made for us were delicious and the service impecable. Our waitress, Maria Ortiz had our table ready for us every day and provided excellent service.  All were very friendly and made us feel very much at home.

reviews.author: Ken Parks
reviews.text:
Want to thank all at the Ginger coffee bar for an outstanding experience every morning. Excellent service always pleasant and friendly. Antonio was especially attentive and would surprise us with different drinks. I am not a big coffee drinker but he has expanded my taste for coffee. They also make excellent smoothies! So thanks again to Antonio, Clari, Soranyi, Magda, Domingo and Olag!,
Salute!

reviews.author: Griffin Lompra
reviews.text: Super fun time, enjoyed all the entertainment, great food, plenty of options. Staff was all extremely nice. Rooms were very nice along with all of the accommodations. Especial ledixon!

reviews.author: James Skelton
reviews.text:
Overall a nice hotel. The rooms have recently been refurbished and although the finish is a little scruffy (chipped floors, paint on skirting, wonky handles) they're nice and spacious. Our favourite part was the cafe stroke bar area where various musicians played in the evening. The sports bar is also very nice (however they were not showing any English Premier League matches). Also, for runners, there is a track around the complex which you can squeeze around 6km from. Saves being on a treadmill indoors whilst on holiday!

One major drawback is that they don't appear to monitor or control sales people on beaches like other hotels we have stayed in in the Dominican. This means you will be pestered constantly to buy things which meant we never once used the beach sunbeds. The beach, though, is amazing and you can swim in the sea. You can also walk for long distances in both directions so you don't feel trapped in the hotel.

The staff are all friendly but quite laid back so expect customer service levels to vary. For example, some of our drinks never arrived at breakfast. But overall we were satisfied by the service. We really appreciated the chocolate and crisp deliveries in the afternoons to our room!

The food is restaurant standard and really impressed us. The buffet is what you'd expect from a large hotel - Overall decent with a few exceptions. The restaurants however were superb and would highly recommend the Italian, Brazilian and Mexican. Unfortunately, we had a terrible meal at the Steakhouse. I'd go as far as saying the steak was inedible due to the amount of fat and how tough it was. Ironically it's the most popular but my advice would be to avoid and enjoy the others.

For those with allergies, beware of the online menu which isn't accurate. Some food, such as the brownies, arrived with walnuts however the online menu had indicated it was safe. The staff are not reassuring at all when it comes to allergies, and my wife has a severe nut allergy and carries an EpiPen. We're very cautious anyway when traveling but some may be easily caught out.

Beware also that this is a large commercial hotel, which contradicts all of the Melia advertisements and social media. I was expecting a quiet hotel however it's enormous, quite rowdy and also hosts many business conferences and events. Something to be aware of when booking as this is quite misleading. The overall finish and style of the hotel is very nice, however, just much larger than we envisaged.

reviews.author: Will Gaughan
reviews.text: Kicks bar, phenomenal. The service from Luis and his team was wonderful.

reviews.author: Kimberly Chapman
reviews.text: My husband and I visited for our honeymoon and we’ve had the most wonderful time. The service has been exceptional and the staff are extremely nice. Lewis, our concierge, was very attentive, personable and helpful. Our dinner at Malscazone stood out because of the incredible service we received from everyone. Overall our time at this resort has been excellent and a trip we will always remember!

reviews.author: Ken Cross
reviews.text: My wife and I are on resort now. We are staying 14 nights this time. Stayed at several Melia resorts. The food is always good and the service staff at the restaurants and bars are always amazing. The staff in general are very nice and typically say Hi or Hola ro you as you walk by them. My issue is why is there no adult beach. We booked an adult only room. The adult only buffet is closed I am assuming because not enough guest here this week or time of year. There is an adults only pool which is nice. But I do not want to have sand kicked in my face with uncontrolled kids running. I love kids. I have 4 adult kids but I raised mine and want to relax and not have to worry about someone else's little ones. Now I am not on the Reserve side but the adults only part. I was told to go to the Reserve front desk and speak to them. So I did and even spoke to their supervisor to of course be told the only thing we can do is charge you $150 more per night for the Reserve. So he took me over to the guest service concierge who just kept telling me about the Reserve restaurant which I do not care about. I just wanted to know if there was an adults only beach since I paid more for that. Was told no you would have to pay more to stay at the Reserve.  So very frustrated I left the guest service area with no clear answer except pay more money. I have no issues with the resort as a whole bit I paid more for certain things like adults only restaurants and beach. I have also been trying for 2 days to change a reservation from one restaurant to another and have been given the run around. Went to where you book the dining reservations and they said since guest service booked them you have to go through them. I said I sent a massage to him 2 days ago and nothing they said still have to go there. So we did and was told he did message them and waiting on an answer from the dining reservation people. Omg should not be this complicated to get something done. I feel like they just pass you around until you give up. We have been to Melia resorts like 6 times bought a5 year program to their Circle. Should not be this hard to get answers. So feeling very frustrated. I will post again at the end of my trip.

reviews.author: Green Genie
reviews.text: The hotel itself is beautiful. The room was nice. I enjoyed the adults only pools. The water seemed clean. Flora was the best restaurant on property, It was the first restaurant I actually was able to eat at on my vacation, but overall, the food was terrible. The food is the reason I would never go back. I felt like I had to survive on fresh fruit and dinner rolls my entire stay.

reviews.author: Trevor Dials
reviews.text:
Great sevice!! Julio was excellent and very kind!! Definitely recommend staying here.
Flora was an amazing place to eat!!!  The salmon and jerk chicken was a big hit!!!  Eduardo and the staff made it possible for our whole party (12) to eat together!!  Felix was a wonderful waiter!!!  So kind an d love the smiles!!! And the plantains…. Yummy!!!!
90 degrees pool bar was awesome!!!  We spent 3 afternoons with our group of 12 and Eddy, Rosanna, and Mario were amazing bartenders!!!! ♥️🥰♥️. Thank you for a wonderful time!!

reviews.author: Mike Krekic
reviews.text:
Rosanna
Yanira  son unas chicas  exelente un buen cervicio muy amable y rapida le recomiendo este hotel a mas persona
Restaurant MINA excellent food, service, atmosphere, servant Wandor was wonderful- great service.
We will definitely come back again:)
GINGER coffee house- BEST coffee with a smile.- kindest group of people- we definitely made some new friends- Thank you Clare, Olga and Ismail:)
Italian restaurant- great food, great service. Staff here are very respectful and hard working. We are very thankful for a great experience!!

reviews.author: Jody Dixon
reviews.text: Rosanna, Yanira, and Maria provide good service.  A beautiful resort.

reviews.author: Karla Loyola
reviews.text: Had a blast at this resort the service was amazing and super relaxing. Mr. Ay yay yay made the time a blast

reviews.author: D. Griifin
reviews.text: I had an amazing experience with Angelo & Jeffery provided the best pooll service.  Fast friendly service.  These guys are super amazing and the resort is luck to have these to guys providing expectional service.

reviews.author: Jacqueline Rivera
reviews.text: Mascalzone Restaurant is a great restaurant… the Linguini & shrimps is my favorite. It doesn’t exist at the menu anymore but the chef prepared it anyway . The black spaghetti was also great.Our waiter Fausto and all the team were great. Definitely we will come again.

reviews.author: Tara Illiano
reviews.text: The restaurant Blue Agave at the Paradisus Palma Real Golf and Spa Resort had excellent food and service! The hostess Laura was so friendly and accommodating and our waiter Alexander Gonzales was very friendly, attentive and on top of things. I would definitely recommend adding this restaurant to your trip itinerary when visiting this all inclusive resort.

reviews.author: Maribel Torres
reviews.text: Restaurant Flora is one of the best restaurants.  The food is great.  Paradisus is a beautiful resort and all the people are so friendly and helpful.  The servers at Flora are amazing.  The whole experience at the resort was wonderful.  Melina was our server at Flora and she was so wonderful.  Great service.

reviews.author: Chris Tavares
reviews.text: Arisleida and Rosanna at the pool, by the swim up bar are the very best! Their service and attentiveness is best in the resort! So awesome! We will be back because of them!

reviews.author: Annie Ellenberger
reviews.text: The location of this resort is amazing - the beach is kept so clean, we had plenty of space to relax everywhere we went, you can walk for several kilometres in either direction along the water. The food was good, the drinks were even better, and the staff was the best! Especially Gustavo at Santé for breakfast. I speak some Spanish but my husband does not and we always felt very comfortable communicating. Highly recommend for a peaceful vacation 🙌

reviews.author: genesis gonzalez
reviews.text: José was our server and he was excellent. He was very fast and made us feel at home. Very attentive and just over all made our stay a 100% better. We were very lucky to have crossed paths with him.

reviews.author: Courtney Bond
reviews.text:
Alvaro was our butler for the week and he happily tended to every need!  He made us feel like we were his only guest. Very thankful for his services!

Derickson at 36 degree pool bar made me my morning mimosas as I started the day pool side outside of our room.

Loved and highly recommend Kona for breakfast and lunch. Best lunch place and the resort!!

reviews.author: Giuseppe Morisi
reviews.text: We stayed one week at the Paradisus Palma Real. We come here every year since 2016. Super happy with the hotel accommodation, activities and especially restaurants. The staff is very professional, friendly and recognize us from the previous  year. This year our concierge was Yaleidi Sims. I have no words to describe how good she was. She went above and beyond to make our stay memorable!

reviews.author: Kathleen Monroe
reviews.text:
Radhames/Luis/Warkiria at the Ginger Bar   made our stay exciting and fun. Stopped by every night to enjoy their company. Highly recommended.
We also had a wonderful concierge named Felix that was very attentive and always made sure what we needed we had.
As far as dining we had a wonderful waitress named Judy that did morning at the Lunchbox and nights at Mina.  Service was excellent and  overall she gave us a great experience. Lastly I enjoyed our lunches at Santos exclusive restaurant with our friends. Service was always good and you never left hungry.
Overall I would definitely recommend this resort for your traveling pleasure.

reviews.author: David J. Chammas
reviews.text: We had a great experience at Palma Real. Beautiful resort, nice amenities, nice staff. Only complaint is service - we were supposed to have a welcome bottle upon check in and we did not get it until our last evening despite calling the resort multiple times. Breakfasts were also a bit chaotic but other than that we had a great experience and definitely recommend the resort!

reviews.author: Christine R
reviews.text: Great service! Beautiful experience! Teofilo was awesome, met all our needs at the beach and beyond. Definitely ask for him when at the beach. He’s amazing! If you’re looking for a dance partner, Dayelo was amazing, great dancer got everyone going and out to dance. Great spirit and energy! Overall from check in to check out everyone was helpful and kind

reviews.author: Justin McCann
reviews.text:
Rosanna yanira Hilda was amazing!  Excellent service at every breakfast and lunch
Francesca and Francis at flora served an excellent dinner!  And Angelo was one of the best concierge we have had!  Very attentive!

reviews.author: Dipal Patel
reviews.text: It is a very loving place for families. Best part of our trip was having Felix Garcia help us step by step. He had answers for everything, he did all the restaurant reservations so we didn't have to remember to do it every day. Trust me that was very helpful, so that we can enjoy our trip and not worry about things. If u get him u will be stress free.

reviews.author: Nick Walker
reviews.text: 5/5 would recommend. Great food, great service, great amenities. Staff is so friendly and accommodating. Jordania is just the greatest! She helped us arrange our romantic dinner on the beach. John and Miguel were so helpful with the check in process and taking us to and from our rooms!

reviews.author: Devin Smith
reviews.text:
Olvi was incredibly friendly and helpful during our late lunch at the buffet - Kanna. Great time!

Had dinner at Flora- Dominican Cuisine, Cesar was really great and had amazing customer service. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: kristine sahakyan
reviews.text: We celebrated my birthday at Mina restaurant and we had magical experience. Jesus our waiter was very attentive and gave the best service. Food was very delicious. They also surprised me with the birthday cake and singing. Highly recommend the restaurant!

reviews.author: Jason Beke
