reviews.text: Excellent experience. I am allergic to shellfish and Alexander Bryan and Santo made sure to accommodate me.  We had a large group and they were prompt with drinks, appetizers, meals.

reviews.author: Emily Roberts
reviews.text: Blue Agave was delicious and Sandra was so kind and attentive! The manager Mardin was so helpful! We enjoyed it (4 stars only because it was a hassle to make food reservations) Yenifer A. delivered our room service for breakfast each morning and it was great!

reviews.author: Mike Castain
reviews.text: My wife and I are Club Melia members and stayed at this resort for the past week. This is a very nice resort with good food and high quality service. The amenities are very good. In particular we received great service and friendship from Raul Jimenez who served us during our daily visits to the beach.

reviews.author: Arturo Santos
reviews.text:
Amazing Stay! Fully recommend The Reserve at Paradisus Palma Real. The perks, attention to detail, service is really good.

The service of Virtudes in the Blue Agave restaurant was stunning, thank you for being amazing!!!

reviews.author: Deuel Gomez
reviews.text: This hotel is top notch, we actually stayed at the neighbors hotel but made a dinner reservation at the restaurant Mascalzone, food and service was exceptional, the treatment received since arriving was superb, our waited Brailyn not only took the time to make sure we understood the whole menu but they were genuinely concerned with our needs and wants when it came to dinner. The experience at this restaurant was amazing! Thanks for the treatment.

reviews.author: Daniel Rodriguez
reviews.text: Rosanna Yanira Maria services were always excellent at the Buffet in the Paradisus Palma Real.

reviews.author: courtney niven
reviews.text: The Italian restaurant Mesacalzone was amazing. The red snapper special was to die for and the lobster pasta was incredible. We also had the octopus and mussels which were some of the best we’ve ever had. Our waiter Yeensen was so attentive and nice, he made sure that everything came out right. we couldn’t have asked for a better server. The supervisor Milton was also great and checked in with us. I would recommend eating here to everyone

reviews.author: Larry
reviews.text: Julia & Jose #1 Great service, great drinks!! The BEST!!!

reviews.author: Rebbecca
reviews.text: Ismael, Gorge, olga, clari, anyi, maria were very excellent on our vacation. They were very kind and welcoming and we loved our time here - we will definitely  be back!

reviews.author: Greg Weeder
reviews.text: Nice hotel, my concierge Yaleidi Sims it was amazing! So much fun!!! Great experience at Kicks bar. The second we walked into the bar the ambience & music was fantastic!  The bartenders were having fun, dancing & mixing fantastic drinks. The overall crowd was welcoming and have a great time. So glad we came in tonight. Can’t wait to come back!

reviews.author: Michelle Uvaydov
reviews.text:
We were blessed to be served by Abraham Torres in this restaurant, who was also our morning buffet waiter throughout the entire duration of our stay. He always ensured that my lactose intolerant mother had almond milk at the table, without even asking after the second day! We will never forget him and his kind service. When he told us Sal was worth the visit, he did not lie! We ordered the French Onion Soup, Flank Steak, Salad with nuts, and delicious Apple Pie for dessert. Not one bad word about the food. The steak was cooked perfectly, with the most delicious sauces. Sal will not disappoint, and the service adds on to the amazing environment.
Epifania and Andrea from Mina were exceptionally helpful with accommodating my big family for my Grandma’s birthday, and made sure our glasses were never empty.

reviews.author: Michael Davis
reviews.text:
We are on day two of our trip and so far the hotel has caused nothing but chaos. However one particular person who made it better, a feeling top tier was Juan. Juan was our server at the Santa restaurant. We ate there for breakfast and diner. He was really accommodating and doing above and beyond to make sure we enjoyed. All the way down to teaching us his home ritual during shot o clock. I would definitely come back just to see Juan.  This vacation was set to celebrate my husband an I 10th year wedding anniversary.

Thanks Juan for
All you do here.

reviews.author: George Powell
reviews.text:
Miguel the concierge was great and patience. He did he best to resolve all issues. He was pleasant and had a great smile.  Easy to deal with.

Riña was great she brought us a large group all our drinks. She was friendly and made sure we were all taken care of.  When your out and about Rina will take care of you.

Erwin was a great concierge he made sure we had a cake for our sons birthday.  He checked on us to ensure we were good.

reviews.author: Geniese Theagene
reviews.text: This hotel is beautiful heaven on earth. The staff is great the food is delicious. Hemeregildo services was excellent he dress professionally every day and gave us 1st class services the all time. One of his worker Rosanna assist us the all time and she was very helpful. reviews.author: Jordan Alarcon
reviews.text: The lunchbox restaurant was really good! Servers Rocio and Yuleni were very helpful! Me and my wife had a great time and enjoyed the food. Supervisor Milton spoke with us and made the experience even better! We want to come back!

reviews.author: Linda Profeta
reviews.text: Our second time staying with them.  Faculties very clean. Food is good. Staff tries their best. Best part of trip was the quality of activities they offer for adults and children alike. Special shout-out to Martha Russell at activities and Zulieca Rodriguez our server at the restaurant who provided exceptional service and made every single one of the members of our party feel special and well taken care of every single breakfast and lunch of our stay.

reviews.author: Fouad Salib
reviews.text: I have been here for a few days the best atmosphere. The foundation of the rooms so clean sparks service they're doing their best to help. The quality time by the beach is beautiful and amazing. The artwork of the food has been a delightful experience. The Consure service galanda great job

reviews.author: Philip Bradley
reviews.text:
We had a special request to celebrate a birthday at Tokimeku restaurant. The wait staff were fantastic and went out of their way to bake a special cake and sung happy birthday for our mom's birthday. Shout out to Maria, Reynaldo, and Fransisco.

We also had a very good experience at Kicks with Jose de Rosario and Bieni, Para. We appreciated the extra care I'm ensuring the food was dairy free and the service was excellente!

reviews.author: Chantal Diaz
reviews.text: Excellent experience! The staff was absolutely incredible. Shout out to Rosanna at the Lunch box. Got an amazing massage with Irolenis at the spa. Highly recommend! I feel like everyone went above and beyond. Thanks to Alexander and the Manager of Blue Agave for being very accommodating! The location and rooms were great. Safe for a solo traveler. Will visit again!!

reviews.author: Lisa Stewart
reviews.text: All things considered, the hotel should charge less or step up their game in terms of professionalism at the check in area and improve their food and drinks. My family did have fun, and there are many wonderfully polite and pleasant workers on the resort. The pool has really fun activities that change out each day and the architecture/view on the property is gorgeous. The beach was lovely, and it was a fun vacation with kids. We  came here for my husband’s business trip and I tagged along with young kids for vacation, so it’s definitely better than winter in New York, but some improvements could be made for sure.

reviews.author: amanda medina
reviews.text: Service was wonderful. Yaleidi, our concierge, was very helpful, punctual, and accommodating. Our room was very nice with an ocean view but there was an interesting smell in the toilet area that did not go away even after asking housekeeping to clean it. Location was awesome, we were right off the beach with an amazing view and super easy access to the beach. There was plenty of space on the beach to sit as we were there during slow season. One thing I would warn is that if you go during May there tends to be a lot of seaweed on the beach due to the season we heard.Food was a downer for us, but found that the best restaurant was the steak house as well as Sante on the adult section. Aside from food being very underwhelming, I can say we had a good experience and the service was wonderful. Please ask for Yaleidi if you can, she was truly a pleasure to work with.

reviews.author: Caitlynn Smith
reviews.text:
Everything was good but there was a conference there and it became too busy, with all the restaurants being completely full. Need to accommodate for this. Also, there needs to be more signs for the adult only side because people ignore the signs and bring their kids over.
Other than this, everything was good. If on the adult only beach, I would recommend Rafael, as well as Jwan as your butler. Both were amazing, as were everyone else!

reviews.author: Allie Wyman
reviews.text:
Raider was an excellent server on our Italian night out at mascalzone!

Overall, wait staff was very attentive to every need that we had.

Our concierge, Harry, was amazing & delightful to have for our stay here!

reviews.author: Adiel Cruz-avalos
reviews.text: The ginger bar was the best bar on the resort. Ismael, Antonio, Dominga, Olga, Nereyda, and Clary were all the best mixologist. Every drink we had was perfect with the right taste and plenty of alcohol. They were very fast and attentive. The best bar on the resort.

reviews.author: Marky Picard
reviews.text:
Our SUPERB host Jose recommended The Miascalzone as our first dinner reservation and it did not disappoint. The restaurant’s service was phenomenal! Our servers were Yuleni Bernabe & Wander. They were all professional and very attentive. They were also patient with my 2 children.

The supervisor for the evening was Milton. He was charming and accommodating.

The food was fresh and had good flavors. The chefs behind the glass looked like they cared about each meal that they made. And while they made it, everyone in the kitchen watched with admiration and concern. You could tell they had great teamwork.

I would definitely recommend this place!

reviews.author: Tears Hayes
reviews.text:
SSSOOO....THE ROOMS ARE BEAUTIFUL 😍!!! The only issue was they ran out of washcloths 🤦🏾‍♀️.. no biggie .. bring your own.
ROSANNA at the buffet SHE'S SUCH A DOLL!!! So kind and warm.  Greeted us with a hug and made our stay very pleasant ☺️.
Activities in the pool were SUPER FUN! AYYAYA IS SOO FUN AND INTERACTIVE! HE'S A SWEETHEART! HE WILL MAKE SURE YOU PARTICIPATE!! I LOVE THAT!
JEFFREY (POLE ) was very attentive and patient! It was sooo fun..I would definitely do it again!!!
Angelo - OMGEEEE.... HE'S SUCH A DOLL!! GREAT CUSTOMER SERVICE.  HE GOES ABOVE AND BEYOND! MY Mother had him running around when we were at the pool lol... but he was so sweet about it!!!
Great experience!!!

reviews.author: Paul S
reviews.text:
When you book a 5-star resort, you expect a 5-star experience. However, after staying here, this is not a 5-star — it’s 3 stars at best.

While the rooms and facilities are nice and clean, the food and service are sub par. At a 5-star resort, the expectation is 5-star service, food, and facilities across the board. That is clearly not the case here.

From the start of our week-long vacation, we encountered numerous issues with our room. First, our bracelets, which serve as the room key, did not work. Once in the room, the air conditioning and TV remote did not work. We were also left in the dark with no functioning lights for an hour. It took three phone calls to resolve each of these issues. And to make matters worse, no one spoke English so it was nearly impossible to communicate our displeasure.

You also expect the food and service to be high end at a “5-star” — it was not. The food at all the restaurants was inconsistent while the service resembled your local Chili’s. Plus, even getting a reservation is a difficult process.

The perfect example happened on our last night. First, we had to wait 45 minutes to be seated at a table that was empty for those 45 minutes. Once seated, we ordered 12 total items (apps, soup, main, dessert), but the waitress said in Spanish that we were ordering too much. The manager then said to her in Spanish, they can order whatever they want. Neither knew that I could understand what they were saying, but as this is an all-inclusive hotel, you’d expect that conversation to never happened.

Beyond this, the language barrier was a huge issue as it almost killed my girlfriend. She has a soy allergy and when she asked for almond milk for her coffee, they brought out soy milk. If she had not verified before drinking, it would have been Cafe de Muerto (the coffee of death). When we brought this to the attention of the front desk staff, they essentially changed the subject and didn’t acknowledge that their waitstaff almost killed my girlfriend.

Also, it’s clear that the only reason this “5-star resort” gets such good reviews is because the waitstaff at some of the restaurants will stand over you with a QR code and ask you to write a 5-star review as they peer over your shoulder to see what you’re doing. No true 5-star resort would even consider this as a tactic. I’ve never felt more uncomfortable during an interaction at a resort in my life, so I politely declined.

On top of all of this, the casino isn’t on site and felt like I was gambling in my friend’s basement. With 12 slot machines, 2 blackjack tables, and 1 roulette table, the casino was more like a party room at a bowling alley instead of that of a 5-star resort.

My expectation at a 5-star resort is that everything is five stars. That’s clearly not the case here, but there are some positives. The rooms are clean and hotel is beautiful. There are also a few staff members who are diamonds in the rough. We found Rodolfo, a member of the concierge staff, to be extremely helpful. He was able to get us a reservation for 12 while our friends, who had a personal concierge, had no luck. Jose at the In Between bar, was kind and personable. After ordering with him once, every time we went back he asked if we wanted that same drink. That is the type of hospitality that you expect from everyone at a 5-star resort. The bartenders at the main pool bar and Ginger bar met our expectations.

All in all, the Paradisus Palma Real is a 3-star resort disguised as a 5-star. I wish there were more positives, as overall our vacation was saved by the beautiful beaches and perfect weather. I hope the Paradisus takes these real reviews into account and makes some changes in the future.

reviews.author: Hope Ingram
reviews.text: We had such a wonderful trip! The drinks were good, the bed was comfortable, the hotel was very clean. We had a great experience with the help of our butler Fernando. Fernando went above and beyond to give us a wonderful vacation. After a surprising proposal from my now fiancé, Fernando went all out decorating our room! Bartenders Victor and Luis are phenomenal at their job!! The best drinks and such fun guys! Jesus was delivering us drinks while we were hanging by the pool and on the beach and he was so great always checking if we needed something. The ginger bar is such a cool hangout spot. Lots of good entertainment! Kelvin at the steak restaurant was a wonderful waiter and was so quick to getting us anything we needed! The Italian restaurant was my favorite, the shrimp basil pasta was incredible! The buffets for breakfast and lunch did have tons of options, but the food was cold a lot of the time and quality not the greatest. The beach was not crowded at all and the ocean water felt wonderful! The gentlemen that were working in the towel area by the pool we so fun and spunky. They were always having a great time with the guests! The pool was a bit chilly, but after jumping in it didn’t take long to get used to. It was a nice, relaxing trip! Cant wait to return!!

reviews.author: Jessica Robitaille
reviews.text: We had a blast at the Paradisus Palma Real! Great classy resort and greek style architecture. Employees are happy and nice. The concierge service is awesome! We were assigned Alejandro Gomez and he satisfied all of our requests. Gerri and Luis at the pool bar also deserves 2 thumbs up!

reviews.author: bgsoccerr9
reviews.text: We had a great experience at Paradisus Palma Real. The service was great from the moment we arrived until we left. Our concierge Eriol was very helpful and he always took care of dinner reservations and all other requests. The food was great at all of the restaurants we visited. Teofilo was very nice and he always accommodated us with drinks while we were at the pool.

reviews.author: Adrian Posteraro
reviews.text: Excellent resort with amazing architecture and location on the beach. Our concierge Antonia was very helpful and accommodating! Large selection of tasty foods at the Buffets and dinner at Flora restaurant was delicious with exceptional service from Jean and Stormin Norman. This place will not dissapoint!

reviews.author: Jamie Saunders
reviews.text:
We just returned from a trip to Punta Cana, Dominican Republic. We used Best punta cana tours for our transportation to and from the airport. They were great. No issues.

We stayed at the Paradisius Palma Real - Reserve, the adult section. We booked the presidential suite that had two bedrooms and was right on the beach. We had a concierge, Alvaro, that helped us with everything from restaurant bookings, excursions, room stock customizations, even seats at the beach. He was always available and very quick to respond.

When we arrived, we went to the Reserve only reception area. While there, we received a bracelet that served as our room key. As for the room, the suite had 2 bedrooms, one with 2 full beds and one with a king. There was also a living room in between the rooms with an additional bathroom with a stand up shower. In the king sized room, the bathroom and closet were very spacious. There was also a living room type setup with a tv in there, which is where we spent the late nights watching football and playing games. The second room with the 2 beds was definitely smaller in the bathroom and the closet wasn't in the room, which was odd. You had to go out in the shared space to access the closet. The rooms were great but the bedding could be way better. The mattresses and pillows were hard. The balcony was huge. It had rocking chairs, lounge chairs and a shallow hot tub. The room was stocked with vodka, rum, whiskey, wine, beer, sodas, water and some snacks daily. The concierge made sure we had just what we wanted. We received a beach bag, robes and house shoes in our room which we all loved! The WiFi in our room was good. It worked in many areas of the resort as well. So, that was a plus. Also, I feel like the map is a bit deceiving. We were worried everything wasn’t within walking distance from the reserve but it is. We didn’t venture past the plaza where all of the restaurants are though. Beach, pools, restaurants, coffee, bars, towels are all relatively close.

We were able to have a palapa at the beach with the very comfy layout beds. The crew did a wonderful job at cleaning the seaweed at the resort. The swim area in the ocean was really big compared to other resorts I saw. The beach is definitely a huge win for this resort!
The pool is really big and has a swim up bar on one side. There is also a pool in the Reserve section. We didn't spend a lot of time at the pools though because the water was freezing!!!

If you want to shop, beware! The sales people at the markets are very aggressive. They will approach you on the beach and offer you cheapie cheapie. If you aren't a negotiator, expect to pay more. Likely more than the item is worth. I personally suck at this so I'd almost rather shop at the airport to avoid this.

Overall, it was a great vacation that went by way too fast. I'd book again at the Paradisius Palma Real Reserve. You can't go wrong with Alvaro. He was wonderful!

reviews.author: Justin Baxley
reviews.text: This place is absurdly beautiful and the pools and beach are amazing. Supermajority of staff was great and polite. The problem is that the food was so bad the only explanation I have is malice. Hot food is not held hot and cold food is not held cold which probably explains the number of people from our company  who had to leave with food poisoning or suffered in their rooms most of the week.  A close colleague still hasn't eaten in days. Despite the very clear absence of basic food safety, other things were just inedible, even if you tried. The number of times I finally gave up on a stew because I couldn't even cut it with a knife finally made me give up. I had to cut cooked fish with a steak knife. The unanimously agreed exception seems to be the omelet bar and the cheese selection. The final night we were there, most of us ate bread, cooked vegetables, and rice trying to avoid anything that could be risky. The rice tasted like cleaner. I don't need my food to be amazing. I'm pretty low maintenance in that regard as long as I'm not hungry. But I need to be able to chew the food and I don't like gambling with foodborne pathogens.

reviews.author: Chris
reviews.text: We had an incredible time at lunch box breakfast buffet. The server staff Maria Mercedes, Jessica Carlos, and Heidi was so friendly and accommodating. The orange juice,coffee and overall service was 10 out of 10 and we all appreciate them VERY MUCH!

reviews.author: Rhazel Gregory
reviews.text: I highly recommend this resort! It’s a beautiful, the rooms are spacious and clean. The staff were super friendly and always helpful. Special thanks to Hector, my personal concierge, who was excellent at answering any questions we had and planned all our dinner reservations. Had dinner at the Sante restaurant and Misale was a great server! He was warm, friendly, and attentive! Ask for him! The food was tasty and came out quickly! Also the hibachi chef at the Japanese restaurant was great! Very entertaining and friendly. Overall great experience. My only issue is I wish the pools were a little warmer.

reviews.author: Luis Miguel Hidalgo
reviews.text: Excellent service and friendly staff. Ana Michel, from the restaurant Flora, did amazing. Teofilo, from the bar near the beach, treated us graciously - even pouring us drinks after the bar was closed. Overall, a great experience.

reviews.author: Delphine Dussault
reviews.text: I went on vacation with my family, it was an amazing trip, good service, beautiful hôtel, good food! I big thank you to Rafael (server on the beach) and Jendry our concierge!

reviews.author: peyton futchko
reviews.text: Cirilo, maria, rafael were the most amazing servers tonight. They were extremely welcoming and helpful throughout our dinner tonight. They were efficient and kind to my family and I. Their smiles were contagious and made us laugh throughout our experience here. I highly recommend coming to check out tokimeku at Paradisus!

reviews.author: Jamal Rogers
reviews.text: tokimeku was excellent, frank and felix were amazing.  loved our swim up room and Milagros was amazing providing exceptional customer service.  my only complaint was the buffet quality being so so and the two hr wait i had for room service the Thursday i was here.  had to call to check and it seemed like they forgot my order.

reviews.author: Kelly Weekly
reviews.text: This review is for  Blue Agave restaurant.  My server  Alexander was amazing...I ate alone and he made it very fun.   His recommendations were perfect!! Dessert was so yummy!!  Thank you for a great experience ❤️🥰

reviews.author: Diana Corral
reviews.text:
Kendo and  Jose del Rosario we great at the hibachi. They took into account our families allergies and put on a great show. Food was typical hibachi but they made it fun.
On the beach Vanessa was the best beach service person. She took care of me every day. The housekeeping ladies and staff were all kind and helpful and with great attitudes.

reviews.author: Faye
reviews.text:
I love the place and the staff are superb the food is also good. But the actual hotels needs much work done. From small details to some major health and safety works in the rooms.
I am more than happy to provide an extensive details if required as I feel the place has so much potential to be even better than what it is.
Our concierge Wily was super and worked well with us and made our stay even more enjoyable sorting all things for us.
Jorge Rafael our dance instructor was fantastic full of spirit and kind and patient,

reviews.author: Jim Starman
reviews.text:
A great resort!  Restaurants are all close to your room and choices are all very good!  Pools are spacious and everything is clean.  Our concierges Héctor and Edgar were awesome!  They took excellent care of us. When we were at the pool, Wanda made sure we had the drinks we wanted and Pedro took very good care of us and always made us laugh.  Franklin, the waiter at Sante, was exceptional.  We also enjoyed the time spent at Ginger!
All the staff made us feel like family

reviews.author: Amanda Schumacher
reviews.text:
Excellent service and great food! We will be back! Maira took great care of us!
Alexander y rocio. Ginger Bar is the best bar!! Ismael, Antonio, Dominga, Victor, Jose and Crisieida took great care of us and make the best drinks!!

reviews.author: Pawan K
reviews.text:
Overall, great service at the front desk and by the service staff throughout our stay. Room was clean and well maintained. Housekeeping staff was courteous and respectful. Dinner at the restaurants was tasty (though limited vegetarian options). Lunch at the buffet place was ok though lacked good vegetarian options. Really loved the private beach area.

The only negative (and this has nothing to do with the hotel itself) was their sales pitch (at Falcon hotel, which was in the same resort) regarding joining their circle club. THE SALES PERSON WASTED OUR WHOLE MORNING ON THAT. !! I WOULD NOT RECOMMEND SIGNING A CONTRACT IN A FOREIGN COUNTRY!!

reviews.author: Erick Feliz
reviews.text: Flora Restaurant: Excellent service,which was provided by our tonight's waiter Cesar. Great environment, as well as phenomenal food. I really devour the food selection and this is definitely a must visit spot at the Paradisus Palma Real Golf & Spa Resort.

reviews.author: Leilanie Diaz
reviews.text: Had an excellent experience at the Italian restaurant. Our servers Wilminia, Reynaldo and our supervisor Milton. From beginning to end the service was amazing,  ambience fantastic amd the cuisine was to die for. By far the best restaurant we've had dinner at and the service was extremely accommodating . Will be coming back for dinner before we leave

reviews.author: Janelle Mejia
reviews.text:
I simply do not recommend this hotel.

I originally had a review praising the hotel because I was forced to upload something at the beginning of my experience. But after sitting down and analyzing the entire trip - I have to be completely honest:

First - the staff (you know who you are) lie to you about giving free services to you by forcing you to sit and listen to “Melia” membership presentation where they try to swindle you off $4-5k a year with a $300 monthly fee on a contract that last 5 YEARS. absolutely ridiculous. They falsely advertise that if you listen to it then you’ll either get free golf or spa/facial/massage session. My group of friends had to fight the front desk after sitting for an HOUR LONG PRESENTATION to then be told “you can’t book the golf session it’s too late”. It caused unnecessary stress for everyone. To then be forced to get up early the next day and fight for it again. I was also lied to about a massage. I told my “concierge” my availability and he said he would send a confirmation but never did. He proceeded to avoid the group and me on our last day. THANKS FOR WASTING MY TIME s.o.s.a.

Food - Mediocre at best. The only restaurant that was good was FLORA. Other than that the food at the buffet was cold and the “popular” Italian restaurant got FOUR of us sick. Unreal.

They have large pools and I did like one bartender there. He was very nice. But they have vendors trying to sell you something every 2 seconds. One optium vendor I specifically said “sorry we are leaving tomorrow” and he said “I hope so”. Extremely rude.

The beach was really dirty. They don’t clean it enough and you have vendors with parrots and iguanas coming at you all the time even if you say no to them. We couldn’t relax because they even yell at you when you’re sleeping.

They have one “night life” bar which was small and they repeated the same music. And they close pretty much everything by 10pm. The bar by the lobby stays open later but they don’t allow you to take your drinks to your room. Which is crazy.

⚠️ Casual Racism⚠️ it’s a bit disappointing when we are hit with colorism or stereotypes. I will not go into details but it is important to be mindful of all nationalities and races staying at the hotel. The staff should be trained on how to be hospitable to everyone and not make weird jokes or comments that come off wildly ignorant and offensive.

reviews.author: James Griffey
reviews.text: This resort is amazing, we've been coming here for years and love it. The steak restaurant Mina is such great quality and Jesus was by far our fave waiter. And Diana Rodriguez was so friendly with greeting our family. Olga, Wanda and Laticia made every moment we spent on the pools an enjoyable one. I didn't get the lady's name that cleaned our room each day, but she did an outstanding job. Every evening when we'd walk into our room it was as nice as when we walked in on the first day. Just the staff in general were amazing.

reviews.author: Denise Vitale
reviews.text: Wouldn’t come anywhere else in DR. My home away from home. Staff, grounds, amenities, rooms far exceed anywhere else I’ve been. Be sure to visit my super talented bartender and friend Ismael at the Ginger bar!! Happy travels to you all!

reviews.author: Kimberly Bieniek
reviews.text: Thank you for everything, we had a very relaxing time at your resort. We would like say a special thank you to Antonio, he was wonderful, he called us and checked on us everyday and made sure we had everything we needed. The only problem we had was trying to get change at your resort for tips and such.

reviews.author: M E G
reviews.text: Bernabe our waiter was very professional and he gave us great service. The restaurant Mascalzone is very friendly and classy with a high quality menu. The pizza is like a slice from Italy, the dough is spectacular and I can eat it every day 😁! We will definitely recommend this restaurant if you’re in Paradisus Palma Real.

reviews.author: Elizabeth Khym
reviews.text: This place was amazing for my family! Being an only child stuck with her family there were great opportunities to meet others my age and the virgin drinks are amazing! The service is amazing and everyone is so incredibly!! There is family friendly night life with lots of dancing and there are some amazing dancers and entertainment! I recommend this place for a relaxing but adventurous vacation!!

reviews.author: Nadia D'Alessio
reviews.text: I loved my stay at the Paradisus. Felix and Melvin were great and took good care of us. The food and service was so good especially compared to other all-inclusive resorts i’ve been to. We will definitely be back soon!

reviews.author: D O
reviews.text:
Problems started at check-in: We were a group of five people and I have two rooms under my reservation: 1 room for two people and 1 room for three. I requested that the room for two guests be one single bed a couple days before arrival as I was told this was an option when I booked only and that the other room have a cot brought in or the pull-out couch made into a bed. At check-in, they confirmed that they were able to secure a room with one bed for the two guests and that they had a rollaway bed brought into the other to accommodate the room with three guests.

The rooms were not ready until about 4PM, which was fine, but once we got into the rooms we saw that both rooms had two small beds and the rollaway bed was put into the wrong room. The three guests who were rooming together only had access to the room with two beds through their badges, so I called concierge to request that they move the bed over to the correct room and mentioned that we were told one room would have one large bed. The response I got: “Is that a problem?” I decided to drop is and the concierge agent I spoke to said they would sent someone to move over the rollaways bed. Hours passed, they never came. We moved the bed ourselves and as we were dragging it over to the other room, a worker walked by and said/did nothing.

Then we had a 9:30 PM dinner reservation at the Japanese restaurant on the property: Our server was COMPLETELY DRUNK. Spilling water on the table, delayed to bring our requested drinks, some came some never did, and got all our orders wrong for appetizers and desserts. Any time he came to take an order, he could barely stand as he wrote them down. He would forget repeatedly what was ordered and come back to take our order over and over again as he swayed from side to side. The cook knew he was drunk and kept looking at us shaking his head over the situation. This was quite a shock for our first night on vacation but decided not to say anything because we knew it could cause the man his job.

We got back to our room at the end of the day and we phoned concierge to request fresh towels be brought to us so we could use them on an excursion we were going on the next day. They never came. We woke up the next morning, left for our excursion with towels we went to go grab ourselves and come back to find our room was never cleaned. We requested the room to be cleaned and for fresh towels to be brought to the room a second time. We left for the beach for a couple hours, come back and still nothing. I called concierge a second time to request fresh towels at the least. They never came.

That night, we stopped by the concierge desk in-person to file a complaint about the towels/cleaning service/drunk server because at this point we were quite annoyed. No compensation was offered but he promised to have the rooms cleaned and fresh towels brought to the room. This is now our THIRD time requesting fresh towels over the course of two days.

We go to dinner, come back to the room 2 1/2 hours later and find that the room is not clean and no towels have been brought to the room. I walk over to the concierge counter to speak to them in-person. I let them know that I really don’t care if they clean the room at this point but that I’d like the towels I asked for three times already. He doesn’t apologize about the room not being cleaned/towels not being brought, but calls to request that the towels are delivered to my room.

To no surprise, they never arrived.

The only reason I’m giving two stars instead of one is because of the positive experiences we had with other staff members at the hotel, including bartenders and our amazing waiter at Flora. There are some great people working at this hotel, but there are others that have absolutely soured our experience.

This is our second time here and I see a dramatic difference in the service we received compared to our last visit. After spending over $5000 dollars for a four-night stay at a 5-Star hotel, you would expect much better too.

We will not be returning.

reviews.author: Wanda Messer
reviews.text:
Flora restaurant was delicious.  The tsunami was excellent...fresh seafood.  The sliders that my husband had were very good.  The main course we both had dumplings/ gnochi and shrimp.
Delicious...the sauce was Exquisite.My husband loved the bread pudding.

Melina and Edwardo were Great and attentive to all of our needs and wants.

reviews.author: Jackie Landry
reviews.text:
Ricki at Lunch Box was very nice and helpful.
Osvaldo was our concierge. Was always available for questions. Very nice people.
Food could have been better.
3 star because of food… even 2 star
Beach was nice but not many waiters passing for drinks. Had to wait or go get our own.
Not enough towel locations.

reviews.author: Kim Peyser
reviews.text: We had an incredible trip to this resort. The facilities were gorgeous and well taken care of, the pools were huge with lots of seating, the beach was well kept and the water was gorgeous, the food was really good too. A highlight though was that our suite came with concierge service dedicated to us. Our concierge, Eriol, made the trip extra relaxing because we never had to worry about a thing! He took care of meals, housekeeping, activities for our kid and went above and beyond in coordination of a special birthday dinner for my Dad’s birthday! We were so grateful for Eriol’s help which made everything even more perfect.

reviews.author: S W
reviews.text: Emmanuel was very helpful. Has taken care of our luggage, mad us feeling welcome and safe :).

reviews.author: Austin Holmes
reviews.text: We had a fabulous stay here, especially at the beach with a special shout-out to Rafael, Martin, and Wanda! The service was excellent, they took very good care of us during our stay. We stayed in the presidential suite and I cannot recommend it enough. The room came with our own personal concierge Miguelito and he was phenomenal. He made all our dinner reservations at Flora, Santé, Blue Agave, and the sushi restaurant (I forget the name). All the restaurants were very accommodating for our group of vegans and vegetarians. An amazing first time in Punta Cana!

reviews.author: Lyudmila Matayeva
reviews.text:
This Hotel is amazing  and so beautiful.
Very clean and organized.
People make you feel so welcome.
The food is fresh and delicious.
Their was 2 waiters who were very nice and professional.
Their names was Frank and Ricki.
They are so polite. The best service  I got from this guys.
There is also a manager  who was very helpful  and   professional.
He helped  me with anything  I needed. His name was  Miguel .
But in general  all the waiters are great.
I had an amazing time.
I recommend this Resort  Hotel to everyone.
You"ll have a great  and awesome  experience.
The beach  is so beautiful.
I can't Wait to go back there again.
See it for yourself.

reviews.author: Jennifer Seabrook-Scott
reviews.text: I ate at Malva in Punta Cana on the Melia resort, and it was excellent. Andrea and Alendri  waited on us and gave service with a smile and gave attention to our every need. I am a vegetarian and they had great options for me.  We would highly recommend this place. Tonight was the first time we had dinner here, we had lunch here yesterday and it was good, but dinner was a step up. Everything was cooked perfect and seasoned well. Everyone was friendly. The desserts were great!

reviews.author: James Druitt
reviews.text: Had a fantastic week at the Palma Real. The hotel exceeded our expectations and the staff were amazing - shout out to Martin on the beach, Emmanuel our concierge and Riley in the restaurant who were all superb. The facilities were great and the all inclusive very generous, can't really fault it.

reviews.author: Humberto Balbuena
reviews.text: Luis from Kicks sports and fun bar gave friendly service each and everytime

reviews.author: Jay Greenbaum
reviews.text: We had an excellent dinner at Blue Agave. The staff was all great and the food was delicious. They were great with our kids and had a nice kids menu. We stayed at the Circle but came to Paradisus for this meal and will definitely come back.

reviews.author: C R
reviews.text:
The most amazing, beautiful, and pristine place!!! Adriel was our concierge and took the absolute best care of us on our vacation! Everything was perfect and the service was top notch! He was so helpful with every question we have had!

Shoutout to Maria and Danny (the bartender) at mamajauna tasting event! So knowledgeable and had an excellent experience!!! Highly recommend doing this one!!!!

Rafael was our beach currier, was INCREDIBLE! Always getting us drinks, remembering our orders, and always having a beautiful lounge area set up for us every morning right in front of the ocean. Made the beach experience incredible. Rafael has an excellent caring personality and makes sure everything is always perfect. Truly an asset here!

Santo was our restaurant manager and he has went above and beyond every single time we were eating at a restaurant. Came over to us to check in on us and make sure everything was perfect. You truly don’t go without your drink filled up here!!! Excellent service.

The food has been incredible and some of the best I have ever had. If you have a chance to do the ceviche tasting, altagracia is in incredible chef and such a kind human! Came out to sing happy birthday to me at dinner even and presented a delicious cake!!!!

This was the best getaway ever and I cannot recommend this resort high enough.

reviews.author: Jamie McInnes
reviews.text: Pablo & Jose were both AMAZING, very kind, they never left me dry and always were 2 steps ahead of my needs. Please come, and support these boys. KICKS

reviews.author: Nat J.
reviews.text: Our room was amazing and clean, Our concierge was very helpful and attentive. One thing i have to say was that a day before you checked out they will have the presentation for you( trying to make you join the membership and it last about 3-4 hours!) so if you already knew your answer then… and you know why they want to have a presentation on the last day you stay? Because if you signed up..they will change your bracelets and  you only have 1 day to enjoy the “lobster” and “RibeyeSteak” and “unlimited wine lists” again no hard feelings but people know why. So if you want to become a member go ahead when you reached, JOIN then you have more time to enjoy the perks!

reviews.author: Gh S
reviews.text: Ate at Mascalzone. Service was fantastic. Our server was Ryder. Very attentive and took great care of us. The manager, Milton, also came by several times to ensure everything was to our satisfaction. Lasagna was good and the pizza was very good.

reviews.author: Carlos N. Melo
reviews.text: Words can’t express how amazing the staff, atmosphere, food quality, and overall experience we had here. Milton was exceptional. He helped us get a reservation upon walk in, and made us feel welcome. We’ve been to Dominican a ton of times, and have yet to experience such attentiveness and hospitality. Wish I could input 1,000 stars !!!

reviews.author: Mubarak Ahmed
reviews.text: The Italian restaurant Mascalzone was great! Brought my 11 year old who is an Italian connoisseur, and she loved it! It was our first night and were looking for a place to eat without reservations, and Reynaldo was gracious enough to accommodate us on such short notice. He made my daughter’s experience one she’ll never forget. Thank you!

reviews.author: Crystal Gonzalez
reviews.text: This review is strictly for the restaurant, Mascalzone!  We had not had a great culinary or service experience until we walked into this restaurant on 4/12/24.  We were not able to get reservations, and the supervisor, Milton, was so helpful, kind and worked us in fairly quickly.  The food and service was TRULY exceptional!  This was the first meal I ate every single bite of since we arrived and I wished I had ordered double servings!  Milton is a true gem. So courteous and friendly… we truly appreciated his exceptional service.  Our waitress was Yessica and she was also perfectly friendly and attentive!  Definitely the BEST we experienced during our stay.  Thank you so much for redeeming our initial impression of the resort! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

reviews.author: Lauren Thomas
reviews.text: My stay at this 5-star resort was sadly somewhat disappointing for a first time all-inclusive experience. It's evident that the positive reviews here are likely coerced, as the staff relentlessly hounded guests for good reviews right after serving them. Housekeeping also stole our tip for our personal concierge while we briefly left the room (for not even 2 minutes) and lied when confronted about it! (Luckily, our concierge got it back.)The location was beautiful regardless. Food and drinks were actually pretty good- so no complaints there! Lastly, our personal concierge was pretty helpful so that was a huge plus.

reviews.author: Justin Robbins
reviews.text: My wife and I stayed with 2 other couples at the Paradisus Palma for 1 week. We had an oceanfront suite (Nikte). Overall it was a great experience. The hotel itself is beautiful and newly renovated. Our first room faced the lobby which was loud at night so we asked to switch to a different room without any problems. The pools are all very nice, accessible, and close to the beach which is right off of the resort. The service overall was somewhat lackluster with nobody coming around to fill up your water and some mildly unfriendly staff (more the exception than the norm). The daily activities were somewhat lacking (likely because we went at a quieter time of year) but the nightly live music was wonderful. Of note, the food overall was quite good, better than expected for an all inconclusive. Overall would definitely recommend this to anyone looking for a great experience at an all inclusive in Punta Cana.

reviews.author: diane zalewski
reviews.text: Julia was awesome! Always had excellent service. Ericson was always available when needed to provide great service as well. Good drinks!

reviews.author: Niysh Fuvk
reviews.text:
Had dinner tonight at Mina Steakhouse on the resort …the food was amazing;) The service was excellent and Dionys Ramirez went above and beyond to ensure we were pleased with the service! Very exceptional

And concierge Jose Ramirez was excellent ! He ensured our belongings were safe during our wait and completed transportation services for us to the airport ! So nice and welcoming.

reviews.author: Angelica Rodriguez
reviews.text: Resort was nice, very clean, and well maintained. It was quiet and not crowded. Osvaldo was great! 5 stars for Osvaldo. He was always available, answered our questions, and made our dinner reservations. Overall the service was good, but there were some servers near the buffet area that were not as nice. If you're looking for a quiet relaxing getaway, I would recommend this place. It is also very family friendly with lots of activities for kids. If you do not have kids and are  looking for a more active resort with more day and evening activities/shows, this place may not be for you. For the days we were there it was quiet and started to pick up the last few days before we left because there was a conference taking place. Maybe we went during the wrong week, but I was looking for more day activities by the beach and pool and it didn't feel like much was going on compared to other resorts I have stayed in. Aside from this, it was a relaxing few days.

reviews.author: Nelson Gouveia
reviews.text: Paradisus Palma Real is one of the best places away from home. We came here a family of 4 and we well looked after from the second we were picked up at the airport to the resort. My kids had a blast on the beach which is like taking a warm bath and super clean. The pools are fantastic, and always serving you drinks. The even have a kids place that have the most wonderful staff looking after your kids. My kids really enjoyed their time there esp with Marta one of the employees who was so kind and joyous to be around. Thank you for a wonder time.

reviews.author: Paula Wims
reviews.text:
We absolutely loved our trip to the Paradius Palma Real. The beaches were beautiful, rooms were perfect. The best was our service from Nathanael, he took excellent care of my family for the week. Anything we needed he was there to accommodate.
He even arranged for a private dinner for my family. The chef cooked the fish that my husband and sons had caught earlier in the day on a fishing boat. It was the freshest fish we had ever eaten. Overall the trip exceeded our expectations. We can’t wait to return!!

reviews.author: Sydney O’Shea
reviews.text: I have nothing but great things to say about this resort! The food & drinks was delicious, the pools were peaceful and the beach is gorgeous! Our attendant, Diana was very sweet and made our stay very enjoyable! My husband and I also enjoyed getting to know the general manager, Juan. He made our vacation special and his warm personality exceeds past customer service -he really makes you feel welcomed! I would absolutely recommend staying here!

reviews.author: Reesey Ellis
reviews.text:
What an experience!  Can’t rave enough about the beauty and maintenance of this resort.  I’ve travelled a lot and will have to say the Paradisus Palma Real Dominican Republic is top of my list for overall beauty, 5 star level quality of service.  All inclusive far exceeds my expectations.
We stayed in the ocean view junior suite - which we highly recommend.  For the balcony gorgeous view - the location and proximity to all pathways to food lol.
Attached some sunset pics.  From your early morning rise to closing out the evening - just gorgeous.  Maintenance teams are always out just making everything perfect.  Want to sit at the beach in your covered cabana - you will see a bartender come around to take care of your needs.

Everyone is so friendly, particularly our concierge  EROIL !!! 💕💕 talk about making our stay even more top notched and tailored than we can imagine.  He booked our reservations at the daily sold out restaurants.  He booked every single thing.  He took care of champagne in the room.  If you think of a need on your vacation, he is there from the start to finish to cater to your family.  It’s all very exclusive.  Thank you thank you thank Eroil.  Great attitude and smile - he made our vacation magical.  And we travelled with our toddler.  We even forgot something in our room and he sent a note telling us how he can help.

Looking objectively, we were not thrilled with the meals although a wide variety of culinary experiences were available.  Food overall should be investigated and revamped.  There are a ton of people helping to make absolute best to make everything as enjoyable as possible.  Recommend not exchanging your USD at the (not resort related) Punta Cana airport we got hosed.  Rate was really 58, we only got 48.  Make certain to bring a lot of smaller bills with you.  If they direct you at the airport to the right and they will try to sell you an experience before you get to your hotel.  It sounds like a good deal, it’s not worth the time spent on your vacation.  Will talk more about the resort’s Melia Circle Club experience at a different time, overall be very aware and 1 hour is not the time it will take.

reviews.author: Luz Frazier
reviews.text:
What a beautiful place to stay in the Dominican Republic. Decor is amazing, service impeccable and location couldn’t be better.
Katherine our concierge was simply amazing!!!
She took care of us making all restaurants reservations and even made our anniversary very special (she made sure we had some wine and fruits in our room at check in).
We fall in love with the place. It is in a word a PARADISE!!
Big thanks to our waiters Juan, Nathaniel and Hemeregildo at the Buffet, Kelvin at the Steak Restaurant and Eddy at the pool bar. This is a place I can recommend to anyone.

reviews.author: Anant “Ashu” Somalwar
reviews.text:
We had excellent stay at Paradisus Palm Real for 5 nights. It was a wonderful experience overall.

We had the concierge service. Our concierge was Mr. Wiley. He was very nice gentleman and very helpful and very friendly. He was always available to us and answered all our questions.

He helped us with Hotel Reservations for all nights. He helped us with arranging photographer so we could capture lovely memories. Time to time he worked with other staff members to ensure all things are in place.

I highly recommend working with Wiley

reviews.author: Peter Adorno
reviews.text: My wife and I just stayed here for a week for our honeymoon and had an amazing stay at the Reserve. Every morning Martin, Pedro and Gilberto were extremely kind and attentive while we relaxed at the beach! Pedro made sure we had a perfect spot set up with towels, and Martin and Gilberto never had us waiting for a drink. They were awesome. Back at the reserve pool, Yuderi made every afternoon an awesome time with excellent service, drinks and kindness. At the main pool bar, Jonathan served up smiles and some of the best drinks we’ve ever had! Luis and the rest of the bar staff were also excellent. Throughout our stay we had so many meals with extremely kind waitstaff like Misael at Sante, Luis at Lunchbox and everywhere else. Lastly our concierge Fernando was extremely kind, helpful and made sure we had an amazing stay! Overall the location and the staff throughout the resort made our honeymoon everything we could have wanted. We can’t wait to come back!

reviews.author: Henry Garzon
reviews.text:
It’s been a wonderful experience with my wife.

When you come, you have to reserve a table for dinner. But even if you don’t get a reservation, you can go to the restaurant and they would likely said you down.

My wife and I went to a free spa  activity, and it was great. We got free facials and products at the end. Huge thanks to Alva it was and Jairo.

Overall, it has been a worth of experience for us. Would definitely recommend the hotel.

reviews.author: Lois Lee
reviews.text:
Our vacations was amazing, we have such a great time with our family and everything was nice. We liked our room the beach and the pool was very nice and well maintained, the staff was very friendly and food was delicious, our Concierge Harry Milor was amazing and friendly and has effectively communicate with us when ever possible. He was extremely responsive to all our requests.
He made our daughter’s birthday celebration special with a cake to celebrate.  We would definitely recommend the hotel and the staff are doing an excellent job. Lot of activities for kids and water park as well.
We definitely will be back soon.

reviews.author: Steven maloney
reviews.text:
Review of Mascalone Italian restaurant
Food was amazing, Raider our waiter was brilliant.
Definitely recommend if you are staying at the hotel.
And  a sambuca to finish topped it off

reviews.author: Juan Hernandez
reviews.text: Randy is more than an outstanding bar tender he makes your whole experience feel as if ur VIP all night. The amount of favors, the personality and everything about him makes you feel as if your best friend is serving you. I had a FANTASTIC time I promise you don’t be scared to ask for anything when you’re staying at the great Palma Real.

reviews.author: William Gene
reviews.text: Needed a break. Spent a week at Paradisus Palma Real, and it was fabulous. We chose the Reserve option, and it was worth the extra cost. Our concierge, Nicolas, took care of all our wants and needs flawlessly. In general, service was very good throughout the resort. The resort was recently renovated, and our room had all the modern amenities, always clean and minibar restocked daily. We tried almost all the restaurants, and Sante was the best for me. The bars made very strong drinks. We were in the adults only area, which was very quiet since it was June, not high season. We thoroughly enjoyed ourselves and didn't want to leave.

reviews.author: Rparks 73
reviews.text: Johnathan and Julia provide outstanding service!! Outstanding drinks!

reviews.author: Ana Tanase
reviews.text:
The service at the restaurant Kanna is great! The waiters are very polite, always smiling and ready to serve and bring us really good food in a timely manner. The service is great. Our waiter Alex has been so amazing: always coming by asking us if we want anything else.

The beach is also nice, very quiet. The service is nice: we have a bar on the beach always ready to serve drinks, and they always bring fresh towels and serve us with a smile.

Our concierge Zenovia was amazing always looking out for us and making a lot of accommodations for us like dinner reservations and sending us the activities to do. She was very welcoming.

Stephanie our Expedia liaison was also very kind and generous, making sure we were taken care of and she was always ready to help us and reach out to us when we needed.

reviews.author: Eli Pawlowski
reviews.text: Antonio, samari, anyi, and clary at the ginger bar were great. Coffee and smoothies were amazing. Great stay. Rooms were good enough and food was good enough but drinks and pool were amazing.

reviews.author: Yvette Graser
reviews.text: The resort is awesome and beautiful and absolutely relaxing 😎. There are a variety of restaurants and eating areas that are top quality.  The staff is attentive and will accommodate for dietary needs.  The Kanna grill is right near the beach with great food and a spectacular view!  Jose Emilio Batista is a senior food and beverage manager and went out of his way to take care of us!! Luis Rodriguez was a great waiter!!!

reviews.author: Phil Knapton
reviews.text:
Restaurant Sante, food was excellent again at this restaurant, second time we have visited and food and service has been top notch. Eduardo, Manuel and Willis served us and were really great and attentive. They have a nice manner and helped with our Spanish with a smile.

The service at the beach from Yuderi was excellent, after day 1 he knew our drinks and kept us supplied all day. A lovely guy and well worth a mention.

Another big shout to Martin on the Reserve beach, got our beds sorted, constant supply of drinks, very nice manner and friendly. We are are the beach everyday and this makes a big difference

reviews.author: Chris Scarff
reviews.text: Staff was very friendly and helpful. Food was excellante.

reviews.author: Keshi Handapangoda
reviews.text: We have had an amazing time here so far  at Paradisus with amazing sun and service from the staff. The servers and bartenders is the restaurants are exceptionally sweet and care about making ur experience a full all inclusive. Shout out to Ruby and Randy at the between bar for amazing drinks and commentary , Eduardo and Starling at Flora for amazing reccomendations and service , Juan and Gustavo  at Sante for making our mornings memorable with great service, and to our conceriege Gustavo for planning out our evenings amazingly. Would definetly reccomend to others!!!!

reviews.author: Steve Holmes
reviews.text: Adriel our concierge made our stay fabulous!! He looked after our dinner reservations for 2 weeks, answered all our questions and is a very valuable employee for the resort!! Keep us the good work and thanks Adriel!!

reviews.author: Hana Alali
reviews.text: Flora restaurant was delicious, the gnocchi dish was creamy and satiating and the coconut taste was just noticeable enough to enjoy but not overpowering. The service was very good, the waiters were all very attentive and kind.

reviews.author: T Y
reviews.text:
Rafael the server really came through for us.  He always friendly greeted us as we walked by since we met the 1st day. Where he really shined is on our last day, we were late departing for the airport and have not had lunch yet. We dropped by the only restaurant open at the time at Kanna and he rushed out our lunch so we able to fit out lunch in prior to leaving.  Top notch service Rafael!

Felix the sushi chef at the Asian restaurant was awesome! He did a sushi workshop for us and was so patient teaching us how to make sushi rolls. The portion of fresh sushi was quite generous. We were allowed to make our own roll of any kind with ingredients there.

Flora has terrific authentic Dominican dishes.  As soon as we walked in, we were greeted with a very warm smile from Dismailin. The food was prepared in a gourmet fashion.  Service was excellent.  Everyone was so friendly. The staff were very accommodating as we did not have reservations but they somehow managed to fit us in.  We has the whole fish, steak and gnocchi.  They were all prepared to perfectionist. Our waitress Estafania was so attentive.

we attended the pizza making experience. It was really nice.we got to make our own pizza and the dough was so soft wnd and pizza was delicious. our host Brandon was so nice and accommodating.  It felt like a private lunch.

reviews.author: Scott Brachmann
reviews.text: Fantastic place to stay with great hospitality.  Martin at the beach for Reserve customers was simply outstanding every day!!

reviews.author: Daniela Silva
reviews.text: Our first night at diner, we went to a Habachi place and it was truly amazing! Not only was the food amazing but the service was even better! They were so kind and included us so well into the service. The service throughout the hotel has been amazing. The pools are also very amazing! They are so gorgeous and there is space for everyone. Some great workers here is HAIRON AND SAMUEL from activities! Other great workers who work at The Lunch box buffet is Roxana and Frank!! They are very kind and very attentive.

reviews.author: Furkan Kahraman
reviews.text: Everything was a dream come true. When we landed Kelvin greeted us and showed us everything. He was our concierge and he was top notch amazing. I highly recommend this resort and Kelvin as your concierge. We will be back very very soon.

reviews.author: Leland galley
reviews.text: ginger bar is the best bar on the whole vacation their service is great ismael,antonio, raisa,clary, olga,raysa are awesome they are very good to you and always happy to talk also mr wonderful is wicked awesome good dancer and great to have around

reviews.author: David Clermont
reviews.text: Delvin is outstanding!! This is the second year he’s waited in us.  He truly goes above and beyond for his clients, he is definitely management material!!! My husband and I highly recommend him and this restaurant!!

reviews.author: Niseet Patel
reviews.text:
Therm service across the hotel is amazing.  The bartenders are all helpful and make wonderful drinks.

Ginger bar has great drinks and coffees.  Amazing pastries as well.  Ismael and the staff behind the bar are the best!

It is by the lobby but worth the stop.

reviews.author: Etty Amsel
reviews.text: We had the most amazing stay in Paradisus Palma Real! Everything was beyond our expectations! We could not have asked for better! The resort is stunning, and everything is very clean and comfortable. The pools and beach are well kept and really nice! The staff is incredible here and super accommodating! Big shout out to our concierge’s Alvero and Felix who both helped us out so much and made sure we have everything we need! We had a wonderful stay and will definitely be coming back!

reviews.author: michael perez
reviews.text: It won’t be fair to not review and recognize the amazing service by the great staff, the attention to detail,’ location, grounds, pools has been fantastic. From the beginning with Jose Ramirez, our luggage guy with the best greetings and service we knew it was going to be a great time. Food was all around good, however. The best food and service was at Sante restaurant, starting with Jose our server, Amanda y Eduardo. I SWEAR EVERYTHING WAS SUPER  DELICIOUS ! we enjoy fine dining at home at least 2 times a week. And definitely they serve meals fit for a king and Queen ! My compliments to Chef Rafael. Came to our table and had to let him know that he should influence the other kitchens on the seasoning, presentation and overall service. Thank you to Miguelito for being an awesome butler and concierge. A truly Respectful gentleman with great customer service. We had a few inconveniences with our room and they resolved as best they can and made up in extra service. Best sport bar service at Kicks was always a good time with the best drinks from Andreina & Mr. Luis. Great vibe and always makes sure everyone is taken care of. I will definitely recommend and I will definitely be back here. God bless you guys and your hard work to make us feel super special. 100% 5 stars

reviews.author: Lisa O'Connor
reviews.text: Fantastic experience. Great Room. Pedro at the beach in the Reserve section made our trip. Dinner at Mazcalzones on our final night was great, especially the service. Fausto, Yanzee and Milton were very attentive and efficient. Drinks were always full and they kept everything spotless. Recommend this restaurant if you stay here.

reviews.author: Maya Tataj
reviews.text:
Family vacation with little kids 7 and 3 yr old. Amazing stay, location is great! Irvin is amazing at what he does he was there every step of the way. He even gave my kids sand toys hats and coloring book!
The buffet - they remembered our drinks, where we sat, they were so kind to our kids. been to Punta Cana 5 times to different hotels each time- and I can definitely see ourselves coming back here. We had the master swim up room and i highly recommend it.

reviews.author: Christine Mortimer
reviews.text:
Jhonatan at the winery was wonderful. There was another gentleman waiting on us but I can’t remember his name. He was also very helpful.
Patricia helped us make reservations at Mina for Surf and Turf dinner. She was fabulous! All of the staff were friendly and helpful. I would recommend this place to all of my friends and family.

reviews.author: Shahan Syed
reviews.text: We came in September 2023 with my wife and 2 kids. The service was exceptional. There was great attention to detail and the resort is very well maintained. Their child care really was a game changer and actively engaged my children. The beach was pristine and their was ample pool space. We did have a few mishaps with room service but nevertheless the experience was overwhelmingly positive.

reviews.author: Jess Brown
reviews.text:
This was a wonderful hotel, better than expected as it was a first time in Dominican. We did the reserve adults only and it was amazing. Fantastic pools and oceanfront. We always found a seat! Pedro our beach/pool friend was so nice and happy. Our main Stars for our days out were Wanda and Yeisen at the beachfront adults only pool. They were fun, amazing service, great drinks and made this trip! Our concierge Hector J was impeccable. Everything was done and organized before I even went to ask! From ice in our room to our dinner reservations, he even called our flight agency to ensure our rep was sending someone for our pick up. We went golfing on this trip and he handled all of our bookings, as well as a beautiful yoga day retreat and catamaran trip. Hector J. Made this seamless and stress free which was really needed- can’t say anymore, he was amazing. Last shout out was to our breakfast omelette chef Alexandra - she was amazing, thank you for making our breakfasts delicious!
The rooms were beautiful! The hairdryer isn’t easy use bring your own! Some of the restaurants were closed during our stay which was unfortunate. The music playing around the resort was dated and needs an upgrade, was a bit repetitive. The Italian and Mexican were our favourites. Cocktails at Kicks were delicious and playing pool was fun.
Thanks for a great stay!

reviews.author: Lucas Couture
reviews.text:
Miguel is the epitome of what makes Rum Republic a standout destination. As a skilled bartender, he combines technical expertise with an engaging personality that draws customers in. Miguel’s mastery of mixology is evident in every drink he crafts. Whether it’s a classic mojito, a bold rum punch, or one of his creative signature cocktails, each sip reveals his precision and passion.

Beyond his technical skills, Miguel shines through his ability to connect with people. He has an uncanny knack for remembering regulars’ favorite drinks and personalizing recommendations for newcomers, making everyone feel welcome. His warm smile and easy-going demeanor set the tone for an enjoyable evening, whether you’re there for a quiet drink or a lively night out.

What truly sets Miguel apart is his dedication to the craft. He’s always exploring new flavor combinations, attending workshops, and staying up-to-date with the latest trends in mixology. This passion translates into an ever-evolving menu that keeps customers excited and coming back for more.

At Rum Republic, Miguel isn’t just a bartender; he’s an ambassador of good times, great drinks, and unforgettable experiences. His presence behind the bar is a big reason why this venue is a favorite among locals and visitors alike.

reviews.author: Alexander Hook
reviews.text: Rosanna is best! Exceptional service. So fun!

reviews.author: Citlali Espinosa
reviews.text:
Thank you so much for the experience!!
Our favorite things to do was visit BlueAgave , their Mexican restaurant. The ginger bar was also awesome. Other than the food was okay. The lunch box, their cafeteria style service, was our least favorite place with subpar quality.

We met with a concierge at the beginning of the trip and towards the end couldn’t get a hold of them.

The rooms were nice and comfy.

The room service was subpar.

The pools were clean and peaceful.

The activities they offered were okay. Not a lot of engagement from the crowd.

reviews.author: federico villafane
reviews.text:
We had a great dinner experience. Franklin was an awesome host which made the experience memorable. Thank you

Breakfast was delicious and amazing with the wonderful help of Maira, Jessica and Broxni.

reviews.author: Eloise Pranger
reviews.text:
Our daughter got married at the resort with 60 guests present for the wedding
We are so happy with how everything went and the resort is beautiful!
Having the help of Kelvin , Ariel and Francisco our 3 concierges for the wedding group, who we could contact any time for any questions, reservations, and anything at all was extremely helpful and made our trip seamless
Thank you our friends!!

reviews.author: Yazmin Ramirez
reviews.text: Our stay has been nothing but amazing here! Jose Ramirez was great at providing great customer service, explaining the fun things punta Cana and the resort has to offer, and overall just an amazing personality. 100/10 definitely recommend!

reviews.author: Margaret Frasher
reviews.text: Our stay, here was amazing. Dalmis, our butler took excellent care of us. Rafael our beach boy was over the top accommodating, and was always happy to serve. Wanda at the pool bar always had a smile to greet us and kept us hydrated, wink… wink. Overall the service was amazing. Will definitely be back. Very attentive.

reviews.author: kayla rivera
reviews.text: All AROUND 5 stars !!! If I could give this place 1000 stars I would. Everything included literally means everything freaking included here. Everyone has their own experience, if you come with great vibes and ready to have a great time, this is the place to be. Milton and Luis are your guys at the buffet ! The best of the best . Also those who like bringing their kids everywhere have a different spot so don’t worry about hearing kids running around! Mina restaurant also Manuel and reynaldo was fantastic service over all 1000/10

reviews.author: David Morrow
reviews.text: Food was excellent. Bernabe was our waiter and was very accommodating. Smaller size portions but you can order multiple meals as it is all inclusive dining. We had a late reservation due to the amount of reservations however,we went at dinner time and they seated us anyway. Well deserved recognition 👏

reviews.author: Jenny Torres
reviews.text: Blueagave- Santos was a great server . I really recommend coming to this restaurant. He took good care of us . We were a party of 10. And he made sure we all had enough food and drinks . I give him a 10-10 🌸👌

reviews.author: Eve Weber
reviews.text: Betty, ebony, Brailenny, Mary gave the best service ever. Thanks girls so much.

reviews.author: Jovan Bennett
reviews.text: An amazing resort with equally amazing staff! A big thank you to the staff at the Gin Ger Bar Ismael, Dominga, Mereyda, Olga, Carary, Samaria and Anthony! They were all super friendly and made phenomenal drinks.

reviews.author: romant bhattarai
reviews.text: Wellington was very helpful. He was in charge of my mini bar. Very little did we have to call for it to be filled. We informed him of what we wanted the very first day and never did we have to worry about running out of its contents.

reviews.author: Jessie Santos
reviews.text:
Excellent time at the resort!  Everyone was very, very hospitable and accommodating. Jordania at Guest Service was extremely helpful in arranging our transportation to the airport.  If I could give 10 stars I would!! We had an excellent stay at Paradisus. Palma Real!
Also, huge shoutouts to Victor, Miguel and Miguel and the two waitresses (sorry, I forgot their names) at Kicks Sports Bar, and Jonathan, Jose and Rina at Celsius Pool Bar.  They served the guests with a smile kept the drinks flowing for everyone to keep the fun going all day and all night. Top notch, 10-Star service from this crew!  Had an awesome time at the Pool and Sports bar!  It was truly a party atmosphere all day and night!
Also Richard the bellboy who helped with our luggage was awesome!  He was punctual with helping us with our luggage and he clearly explained the checkout process to make sure we got to the airport on time! Thank you Richard!

reviews.author: Nelson A. Diaz
reviews.text: We had a great time at Paradisus. The activities group was always fun to be with. Jairo and his team were great and we enjoyed spending almost every evening with them. We also enjoyed their classes and learned a lot about the Dominican culture. Also the service was superb, thank you to Brandol, Jholfry, Johanna, Yesmely, and Soranyi.

reviews.author: Sam Kordes
reviews.text: I had such an amazing experience at Ginger Bar in Paradisus! The drinks are incredible and service is phenomenal! I was helped by Ismael, Dominga, Clari- they were all amazing and always ready to help. My favorite drink was the mudslide. Highly recommend visiting!

reviews.author: Jack Scharf
reviews.text: The Celsius pool bar was by far my favorite spot, not only because of the drinks but the excellent bartenders Jonathan and Jorge who where the best bartenders who you can tell really love there job. Both Jonathan and Jorge got to know us really well throughout our stay and where always knowledgeable and fantastic at there job. I would definitely recommend this spot as the heart of the resort.

reviews.author: kristi morrison
reviews.text: We will be back because of her kindness and attentiveness to our group!

reviews.author: Wynter
reviews.text:
Jensen and Milton were phenomenal at the mascalzone restaurant ! Food was excellent and service was perfect. Definitely recommend other residents to dine in this restaurant while on their stay. It was such great traditional experience.

The Dominican Republic experience with Hairon, Michael, and Jensy was fantastic! Learning the history was a great experience!

reviews.author: Laney T
reviews.text: The hotel was extremely beautiful. Everyone in the guest service staff was very helpful and accommodating. We have no complaints and would recommend to stay to anyone! Family and kid friendly as well. Makes for a great vacation! Jordania in guest services was so kind and helped us with all our travel inquiries!

reviews.author: N Erri
reviews.text:
We are on a family vacation here now and after our check in day we met Katherine in guest services who helped navigate a few challenges and set us up with Luis our concierge. He has been a pleasure to have helping us. He had arranged some really nice touches to help celebrate our daughters birthday. His smal is contagious and our kid have loved getting to know him!. He really is a gem!

The rooms are lovely and food has been great so far. Definitely some challenges with the language and hoping that the kitchen staff truly understand our daughter being celiac - some options are a bit limited.

We have greatly appreciated having Luis help us to navigate things and her restrictions. He has done an excellent job so far and we can’t wait to have him the remainder of the week - we so appreciate you adjusting your time off to stay with us for the week!

reviews.author: Rachel and Walter
reviews.text:
We had a lovely experience at Paradisus!
We booked a Reserve room which meant that we had a private concierge to help us book activities and dinner. Cris was ours and he took excellent care of us. He went above and beyond in every way. Got us into each restaurant we wanted to try and addressed a couple minor concerns we had about our room when we first arrived. He was great!

We had breakfast at Sante every morning and Franklin took amazing care of us. He was attentive to our needs - kept our coffees and mimosas full and took our orders promptly. He also had the help of Gustavo, Sunirda, and Kelvin who were attentive and helpful as well. Our leisurely breakfasts were one of our favorite parts of the trip!

After breakfast we would make our way to the beach for ocean views and refreshing drinks. Rafael was our server and always had our favorite loungers ready and kept our drinks full. The friendly service was amazing!

reviews.author: Roma Diarra
reviews.text: The hotel is beautiful, right on the beach with everything that you need at least as a family. Everyone wins from babies to older kiddos. The bluffer is nice, have a variety from very healthy to “I am on vacation” menu. People extremely friendly . Coming back here for the 4 th time and won’t be the last. Away from everything but that is what we need

reviews.author: Lucas Smith
reviews.text: It was my family’s first time staying at Paradisus Palma Real, and we had an amazing experience! Stephanie from the wedding department was extremely helpful in making my dream proposal to my girlfriend come true — I cannot thank her enough for everything she did to make it a perfect night. The suite we stayed in was very clean and the service was impeccable. Our bellmen, Luciano and Juanlly, were the best as well! Not only did they make sure our bags were taken care of, but they welcomed us with open arms and answered all of our questions we had about the resort when we first arrived. Will definitely be coming back!

reviews.author: Paula Yory
reviews.text: Amazing time at the resort! Went to a sushi workshop where Chef Roberto and Soledad made the experience pleasant and fun! Everyone has been very professional and nice. They accommodated to my grandmas needs and have tons of activities for all age groups. The resort is well taken care of, visually appealing, comfortable and clean.

reviews.author: Leigh Davis
reviews.text:
My stay at the resort was amazing! Our concierge, Hector, was very professional and answered questions promptly through Whatsapp messaging. He took the time to introduce himself in person and even organize a birthday surprise for us.
There are many activities and beautiful sights on the resort. The lounge areas and restaurants are beautifully decorated. The food and drinks had its ups and downs, but was overall tasty.
