We spent some time off of the resort to take part in excursions. The hotel offers packages for excursions at a fair price. Although, we purchased our packages at the airport for a seemingly better price.
The resort is also near other resorts, popular nightclubs and an amusement park. We were able to do so many things during our stay and created great memories!

reviews.author: Tiffany Fuentes
reviews.text: We are a few days into our vacation and we couldn’t be any happier! We were greeted with delicious drinks and check in was seamless. The restaurants are all so beautiful and the food has been delicious. Ingrid has been extremely helpful in making our stay here perfect. Chris, our concierge, has been great at communicating and attending our needs. They have been so friendly and welcoming!

reviews.author: Karen Edwards
reviews.text: We had the best experience at the hotel. We were in the reserve section and the service was impressive. Dalmis took amazing care of us as our concierge. He was always one step ahead of us!! The food was amazing, the beach was amazing and the staff is very friendly. Shout out to Wanda at the poolside bar, she was the bomb! Highly recommend!!

reviews.author: Ervin Gilmore
reviews.text: Victor Felix and John Marte at Tokineku was amazing. His showmanship was great and his people skills are very welcoming. He's a peoples person and he engages with the customers perfectly. I will definitely return to this restaurant and to this resort. John takes great care of the service and the drinks are great. He's friendly and you don't have to wait or ask for anything.  I love this place and the service.

reviews.author: Kristen Brown
reviews.text: My aunt and I came for a relaxing getaway and had the best time! The pool bar bartenders Terfilo, Yeison and Marcos for extremely attentive, pleasant and could not have been nicer.  Beautiful resort with beautiful people!

reviews.author: Jim Kunz
reviews.text: Beautiful property and everyone was very friendly and accomodating. In-Room food service had a hiccup and housekeeping was short on certain towels at times. Basilio, our personal concierge was fantastic, day or night. The personal touch he added was fantastic.

reviews.author: Scott Lynch
reviews.text: During our stay at Paradisus Palma Real, Brisas was our preferred breakfast spot.  Food was good in terms of quality and presentation. Our hostess, Fidelina, was warm and friendly.  Our servers, Jose and Rosanny, were excellent. Besides being polite and friendly, they were efficient and remembered our preferred drinks and food.  Will definitely be back during future stays.

reviews.author: Michael Osgood
reviews.text: Visited here on a company trip. Location was great. Pools were nice. Drinks were good. We tried the steakhouse and the Italian restaurant (twice) for dinner and the Mediterranean restaurant for breakfast. Other meals we did the buffet. Overall, food was alright but it was a little difficult to get reservations.

reviews.author: Laura Bigelow
reviews.text: I give this 3 stars, and the food doesn’t quite reach the same caliber as the service & rooms. Mediocre at best, whether eating at the buffet or in one of the many restaurants. Best restaurant was the hibachi, which I’d rather at a solid 7. Nothing blew us away as far as food went. And all inclusive drinks seemed WEAK, at best. Little to no booze, so stick to beer & wine if you want to make sure you get what you’re paying for.

reviews.author: Nancy Street
reviews.text:
An update to this review from a couple of years ago. Unfortunately, not a good one. This is not a 5 star resort. Not even close. It’s important to note that we are members and are supposed to get a higher level of experience. There are significant maintenance issues- the property is neglected- broken tiles in the pool, banged up trash cans everywhere, work is needed on the exterior of the buildings, the beach huts are shabby  and the cushions need replacing. The staff does not pick up bottles and glasses left around the property. The food is worse than when we are here last. There is not much for healthy eaters or people who don’t eat beef or pork. The staff  is nice but they are understaffed and not well trained. Last night our food was served cold and the bottle of wine we ordered never came. Our bed and pillows were uncomfortable. The lovely Melia scent was nowhere to be found. People were noisy and there are smokers everywhere. I can’t imagine we would come back. Our experience at the Mexican properties has been better and we will try Spain. I’m already having second thoughts about our membership.

The Paradisus is a wonderful property. Incredible service, great pools, beach and activities. The staff is uniformly kind, friendly and service oriented. The buffet food is great. The restaurants are mixed- some good, some not good. I would hope management would work on improving them. A highlight of our trip was our concierge, Yaleidi Sims. She is such a lovely person and so efficient and helpful. She made our trip incredibly special. Ask for her!!

reviews.author: Iuliia Ishkova
reviews.text: Our stay was overall great. We were a big group of 9 with 5 kids. The swim up room was excellent. Everything was clean and mini fridge stocked as needed. Special thanks to our concierge Jose Simeon that sent us activities every morning, set up all restaurants everyday and arranged a jogs tour that we really enjoyed. Special thanks to Ms.loud a with the beach services. She was always there with cold drinks, setting up our place , bringing towels.

reviews.author: Zeke Trezevant
reviews.text:
Unfortunately, this was not the dream vacation I planned.  The resort is absolutely stunning.   The food was less than average.   My hot water was off for at least one of our four days there.  We asked the resort to arrange transportation to the airport, which accepted credit cards.  The driver they sent me had to stop at a gas station, and they charged my credit card.

Spoke to hotel management to no avail.

Don't think we will be back.  :(

reviews.author: BFRM De Maria Valdovinos
reviews.text: Edwin and Raider made our dining experience unforgettable at Mascalzone. Their attention to detail and friendly service were top-notch. The food was delicious, and the ambiance was perfect. Management is on top of thing! This is by far the best restaurant in the area. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Liz & Geoff Muller
reviews.text: Blue Agave restaurant is top notch. Attentive service from Delvin and Milton the suave and debonair maitre’d. Fantastic drinks beforehand with Ruby at the bar. Enjoyed our stay. Tacos and flautas were some of the best we have ever had

reviews.author: Laura Lavoie
reviews.text:
There is our 5 stars of the week…for a 5 stars service of all time.

Juan at the Sante 🤩😎

Our friends at the between bar : Tequilata & Co 😘🤘

Yaleidi, our butler ❤️❤️❤️

Fausto, our handy man, the waiter who never sleeps and taking care of us 😘🫶

Dominico, the cooker at the sante 👌👌

reviews.author: Sandra Crowley-Le
reviews.text:
Juan at Sante was amazing!! Service was spectacular attention to detail was spot on. He was very kind, fun, attentive. He made a wonderful evening for all of my family as we celebrate my parents 60th wedding anniversary. Thank you Juan and all your team!!  We will be back

We also had a beyond amazing dinner twice at the Winery. Jonathan and Maximo made two nights absolutely incredible. They were beyond attentive and we could not have been happier with our experience there. Our first meal there exceeded our expectations. Two days later our dinner reservations at the Mexican restaurant got messed up and we ended up at the Winery and they accommodated us completely and served us the Mexican menu in a  location that does not normally do that. We appreciate everything they did for us! They are beyond amazing people. Thank you, Jonathan and Maximo! Te amo!!

reviews.author: Darcy Walker
reviews.text:
Best Food and Margaritas in Paradisus!
Yamilet and team are Amazing!

reviews.author: Ama Ross-Aikins
reviews.text:
Stayed before and flight was cancelled so went back for a night. Flight was cancelled again so stayed for four nights this time. Again lovely service. Eriol was our concierge this time and he was great. Rosa German was lovely again. It felt like being home when given the room I had stayed in a couple of nights ago.

Staff at the Santé restaurant were great as before. Gustavo was lively. He had a calming presence about him.

reviews.author: Jennifer Evans
reviews.text:
We have had a great experience on vacation here. Overall the food exceeded our expectations and service was stellar. At some of the restaurants the main courses took a while to come but we had read this beforehand; we scheduled earlier dinners because of our kids so it wasn’t an issue. The grounds are beautiful and the staff has a great attention to detail. Housekeeping was great. The beach was very nice and you could tell that this resort takes better care than some of the others that we walked by. Our room was more spacious and updated than we expected. Every person we interacted with was friendly and helpful.

Eriol was our concierge and was very helpful in making our trip worry-free and enjoyable. He arranged for us to go to the water park where our kids had a great time, and took care of any minor room issues very  quickly. Eriol also made all of our dinner reservations and was able to get our large group to eat together several times which I was not expecting.

Julie solano and edickson at the poolside bar were amazing and went out of her way to make and bring us our favorite drinks. Our niece and nephew had a great time at kids club and each of the staff were very engaging and attentive to all the kids. They planned a lot of fun activities and the kids looked forward to going.

reviews.author: Joanny Cedeño
reviews.text: The hotel by itself is glorious; awesome view, delicious food, comfortable rooms, and don't even get me started on guest services!! ❤️ I just had dinner at Blue Agabe, what an experience! If you find yourself looking for good Mexican food and want to have a good time, go there and ask for Alexander.

reviews.author: Tim Herlan
reviews.text: We had a great time at the hotel so far. The check in experience was very good and we are very happy with the overall service as well as our room. We had dinner at Cape Now restaurant tonight. Every aspect of our dinner experience was great. We received amazing service from Calvin and Jose during our dinner. The food was excellent and the vibe is very nice. We would definitely come back again.

reviews.author: Jeremy Hageman
reviews.text: Had an amazing week! All the people are fantastic. I want to give a special shout out to the best bartender in the Dominican, Hector at the Tito’s bar. So friendly and made great drinks! There is no shortage of bars but I would search out Hector! Find him and you will have a great time!!!

reviews.author: rocksand hernandez
reviews.text:
The service and food at Sante were absolutely delicious! I recommend the lamb chops, they are a must!! Marian, Eduardo, Jose, and Pamela were all very helpful and inviting! They made us feel as if we’re were joining them at their family table. This resort is absolutely stunning, very pristine! Can’t wait to see what else is in store for us during our stay! I can assure you though that Nicolas will ensure that we have absolutely everything we need and desire! From dinner reservations, stocked fridge, and overall enjoyment, he’s taking care of every detail!

The beach view and service was amazing.  Rafael was our server and was very helpful and friendly each day.  He always made sure we had everything we needed!!

The bar outside of our room next to the pool was very convenient.  Grey and Teofilo were our servers for several days and made sure we had what we needed!  The “Coco Loco’s were amazing!!

reviews.author: Jerry Gumpel
reviews.text: Our butlers Alvaro and Kelvin were great. They were attentive to our needs and procured reservations for us every day at the time and place that we wanted. The food and beverage operation is below par and it’s a pity as the resort is beautiful, as is the beach.

reviews.author: diego homes
reviews.text: Just Had dinner at Flora, most amazing food I have had in such a long time. I ordered the Salmon and it was beyond my expectations, I will be coming back for more. Francesca & Eduardo offered super incredible service as well, made sure my water was never empty and that my cocktails kept coming as if she was reading my mind. Overall 10/10 experience.

reviews.author: Jordan Anderson
reviews.text: Jose Ramirez was phenomenal with our luggage and service to and from the room. Harry Milor, our concierge, took care of us the entire time without issue and ensured our stay was as pleasant as possible and met all of our needs. The propriety is beautiful and is everything pictured. Be mindful in the off-season, only 2 restaurants are open at a time. There are daily activities for adults and kids alike. Overall the stay met all of our expectations and exceeded them in many instances. The friendliness of the staff and upkeep of the property truly sets Palma Real apart.

reviews.author: Mehdi Belkhedim
reviews.text: I would like to give a huge shout-out to Juan, our awesome waitress at Sante restaurant! He really made our vacation so special with his top-notch service. Juan was so friendly, helpful, and just super professional. Thanks a ton to him and the whole crew for making our vacation so memorable! Best hotel, best restaurants and best staff ever

reviews.author: Umair Chachar
reviews.text: Amazing resort with great options to do alot of things, and they focus on relaxation which is great. Alberto was our favorite bartender, absolute gem.

reviews.author: Sam Migdal
reviews.text: Beautiful hotel.  Restaurants are pretty good.  Good luck getting a reservation at any restaurant.  They make it impossible to get any time at all then the next move to reservation available at 9:30pm.  Front desk is challenging.  That’s all I have time to say because there is no way to describe the ineptitude.  If you are lucky enough to check in and check out without issue, you may be ok.  Unless your keys don’t work for no reason.

reviews.author: aaron smoot
reviews.text: Melvin and Miguel were great bartenders. They gave us knowledgeable advice! They made our favorite drinks quickly and with care.

reviews.author: Leah Johnson
reviews.text: Jairo and the mixologist Edgar conducted an amazing Mamajuana class.  The hotel is beautiful, food is amazing and had a great time! Maria, Yanira, Rosanna were our servers for breakfast each morning and greeted us each day making us feel very welcome. Service was excellent and helped us celebrate our friends birthday the last day! Highly recommend this resort!

reviews.author: Chirag Shah
reviews.text:
My wife & I had a wonderful time at this resort for a family wedding!  The staff was great and so very pleasant.

Great, clean, safe & fun for the whole family!

Lunchbox was great as a buffet, with diverse & delisioso food!

Shout out to Arleny, Lenny, Yorgelys, Ismael, Edmuanny, Antonio for making our stay a blast and making is feel like familia!

reviews.author: Tracey
reviews.text: We really enjoyed our stay. Everyone was so kind and helpful! Jose was a fantastic server at breakfast. Rosanny did a fabulous job also. Our butler Lewis was beyond amazing. I would highly recommend a vacation here!

reviews.author: Rajat Arora
reviews.text: Beautiful location and very well kept, but food was not really good at the buffet. Main buffet was closed 7 nights we were there, malwa buffet was cold and not many choices. Going to the beach was ruined by hawkers trying to sell stuff. You need to know Spanish because most staff don't speak English at all, but they were all nice and accommodating. Our host, Alejandro, was brilliant. Swim out room was the best part, pool was very clean and warm at all times.

reviews.author: Summer C
reviews.text:
We really enjoyed the mixology experience.
Juan and Brando were great!
Each restaurant was fantastic as well. Our family favorite server and manager was Jael and Juan. Great food and great service! We loved our stay.

reviews.author: sev toross
reviews.text:
Ate at Mina Restaurant.
Very good food and amazing service, thank you Wander.

reviews.author: Patricia Pelayo
reviews.text: If I could give it 10 stars I would ! The staff is so welcoming and attentive ! The rooms are luxurious and very clean ! The cleaning ladies come in everyday ! The food … to die for ! The fruit was amazing they had a very wide selection ! There are so many different restaurant to choose from  … That i couldn’t they were all so good ! the customer service is on point ! if you need absolutely any thing they got your back ! AND VIEWS FOR DAYS ! I would definitely plan to stay here again! love the beach love the food , the people , the bar and I know you would too. Two thumbs up !!👍👍

reviews.author: Jason Engermann
reviews.text:
Yeison and yafreisy are a great team . Great personality and very friendly. And in the evening, Ana was really on top of things . All of them we out of their way to make our dining experience as wonderful as it could be . Shots out to the Lunch Box! Can't wait to come back to see them!
And here we are on our last day. The excellent service never stops. Maria Mercedes, Yessica and Frank, always smiling and will stop to help no matter what they are doing.  I don't know how they keep up with it all . Truly a great team!

reviews.author: Amel B
reviews.text:
We had a very pleasant stay at the Paradisus Palma Real hotel. The staff is friendly, the room and pools are very clean. Swimming in the sea is also pleasant since the seaweed is picked up and doesn't accumulate on the sand. The room is cleaned twice a day.
The downside of the stay is that the air conditioner in the room made an intermittent noise, which woke us up during the night. The technician came to repair it several times, but the noise persisted until the end of our stay. We had a concierge at our disposal, but we saw no big advantage in it.
The buffet menu is very varied and the croissants are delicious. The quality of the food in the restaurants is equivalent to that of the buffet.
Special mention and a big thank you to Juan Torres and Dayhani who always welcomed us very well when we ate at the buffet, they are kind, accommodating, and cheerful.
All in all, we are delighted with our stay at this hotel.

reviews.author: Rachel Percell
reviews.text: Everything at Paradisus Palma Real was wonderful. They were more than able to accommodate our family of 7. Rooms very clean. The Kidsdom Kids care was perfect! We only used it 2 days but the kids loved it. There was fun activities both indoor and out. My kids felt very loved even in the short time they were there. Food was good and all were able to eat well, even with food allergies. The beach was beautiful. The resort had everything you could need while vacationing. Fun nightly entertainment. Live music. Lots of spaces to hang out.

reviews.author: Grace Giarmoleo
reviews.text:
So happy we changed our reservation to this resort. If you have doubts about where to stay no worries anymore. This resort is excellent.

Sante restaurant: Franco and Raphael are the best. Great service!
Mascalzone: Milton the manager was so great to us.  Love the service and the food!

Flora: Great service from Andrea Sanfora!  Thank you for a great evening.

reviews.author: Bryan Lefebvre
reviews.text:
We came for an event and it happen to be over Valentine's day.
Great place, great food and, entertainment

reviews.author: Allison Ogle
reviews.text: Top tier! The service is fabulous and each and every person is so kind! They go above and beyond to create the best experience possible. They truly thought through guest experience. Food- fabulous! Drinks- delicious! The resort is newly renovated and just beautiful. Highly recommend!! Martin, Rafael, Gilberto, and Pedro were so attentive and made our stay so special. Make sure to say hello to them!

reviews.author: Blake Bergstrom
reviews.text: Rafael, Pedro, Martin, and the rest of the team of beach staff in the Reserve section are absolutely wonderful! They are constantly working hard to make sure that everyone has everything they could possibly want and keeping the section ready for the guests to enjoy! The team does everything from helping you set up a comfortable spot in the morning to making sure you have a cool and yummy drink to enjoy! My family and I have been coming here for years, and we are always so excited to see Rafael, Pedro, and Martin and each year they always remember us and welcome us with open arms and a big smile! Rafael, Pedro, and Martin are truly some of the best parts of the Reserve at Paradisus Palma Real!

reviews.author: LuAnn Myles
reviews.text: We had never had such amazing service from everyone at this resort!  If I could give 10 stars I would.   Yuderi and Pedro made the beach experience amazing and made us feel like we belong.   Yuderi himself out  the experience 5 star.  Irvin our concierge was the best we ever had and We travel a lot.  He is incredibly attentive and is there for us no matter the request.   Love this hotel, love the service but mostly love the people!!!  Highly recommend a we will be back for sure!!

reviews.author: Francisco Ramirez
reviews.text: We have been in Paradisus Palma real this year 4 times, it’s an amazing place the staff is amazing. The guys at the Celsius pool bar specialty Victor, Luis, Jorge and Jonathan makes the best margaritas:) and arisleida by the pool bar us the best she is amazing she works by the pool bar. I will be here again in June with my girls I can’t wait. :) I really hope that you be able to control the room AC , the best concierge is Francisco his amazing.

reviews.author: annika lynch
reviews.text:
Lovely Resort! Very clean, friendly staff, nice amenities, and great restaurants! Jorge is very friendly and helpful!
The Ginger bar is wonderful! Great coffee and friendly service.
The Italian was very good, Very yummy and the service was very good. The staff was very attentive. Milton, attended to all needs and was wonderful!

reviews.author: Genevieve Goelz
reviews.text: We LOVED the coconut oil class and the cocoa class!

reviews.author: Emily Wymore
reviews.text: Ramon Rivas was the best and most helpful person to us! He greats us each day with a huge smile, has towels waiting for us, our favorite drinks and many laughs! He made our trip better than imaginable! If you come here, make sure to find him!

reviews.author: Christy F
reviews.text: What a beautiful resort with exceptional staff.  The rooms were spacious, clean and newly renovated.  We had a wonderful swim up pool right outside the doors of our 2 bedroom suite.  The staff was so friendly and Kelvis Sano took great care of us everyday asking what we needed and giving us lists of activities for each day.  The pools and beach were beautiful.  We look forward to returning next year!

reviews.author: Janet Amin
reviews.text:
Yefry and angelo both servers are excellent, the best experience along with our concierge, jensica
She was amazing making things possible beyond
Our expectation

reviews.author: Gabriela Sehinkman
reviews.text:
We attended a wedding at the resort. The resort is beautiful, the beach had easy access, amenities and food all excellent, staff always attentive and polite.

I happened to forget a set of keys at the resort. I realized this once I was back home. I decided to reach out to our dedicated concierge, Franklyn Pierret. He went above and beyond searching and leaving no stone unturned. He found the lost keys!!

I wanted to give a shout out to Franklyn’s dedication and whole heartedly recommend the resort. Gracias!!!

reviews.author: Dylan Schlundt
reviews.text:
The room service was great! Fast service, and Dalvin Valdez made my experience great, and he was very kind and friendly. The mini bar was great, especially those M&Ms!

Mina Steakhouse was amazing! The service was incredible, and Rony was the best server we have had! He was so quick, respectful, and fun! Definitely deserves a raise and some paid days off!

reviews.author: shauna fah
reviews.text: What a great couple of days we had on the property. Everyone was so wonderful to work with.  We stayed in The Reserve and had an amazing personal concierge Eriol! He kept me informed and provided the ultimate 5 star service with dinner and spa reservations along with keeping me to to date on activities happening every day.  Thanks again for a fabulous time. We will be coming back in April.

reviews.author: Sonora Coronado
reviews.text: Palma Real has been a beautiful and relaxing experience! Our favorite restaurant was Mas Calzones, the Italian restaurant within the resort. The supervisor Milton and our server Wilmina was very kind and quick, and even helped me with my Spanish. Delicious food!

reviews.author: Vitor Trindade
reviews.text: Luís and Diogenes is a very good atendence in Kicks Sport Bar, I loved this place, I recommended

reviews.author: jake sciarrotta
reviews.text:
Beautiful place, great food and drinks, especially the service from Rosanna, Hilda, and Yorgeli.

Jonathan Rodriquez was amazing at the main pool bar. He was very personable and caring. He always made sure our drinks were full and always remembered us. He made the pool experience very memorable!!

reviews.author: Luz Frazier
reviews.text:
Rosanna Hernandez, Janira Sosa and Francisco were great and provided an outstanding service at the lunch box for breakfast and lunch.  Luis at Ginger spoiled us with the Paradisus  cocktail. He was always so friendly and willing to please us.  Big thanks to Sujeidy, Alexandra, Jesus and the rest of the staff at the Kids club, they all treated our son with so much care and kindness . He just wanted to be there all the time. Bartolo helped us to move our luggage from place to place with genuine care. He was always available and on time, he was awesome!!
Eddie at the pool bar remained the best in what he does.  Fior at the Spa gave us a great massage, we were so grateful for that. Antonio and Jose were our concierges who always made sure we were happy. Jose turned around a bad start into a beautiful  vacation time.  He went out of his way to accommodate us in a very personal way. He was the best concierge you could ever have. In general we love Paradisus Palma Real and its staff. They made us feel like family. It was a pleasure seeing everyone there.
Thank you 🙏🏼
Natalia

reviews.author: Bianca Villar
reviews.text: Had dinner at Mina with the family and the service was impeccable. Olvi was our waiter and he was very attentive. I had the traditional Caesar salad, New York steak, and ended my meal with a slice of cheesecake. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Arianne JOHNSON
reviews.text: MALVA resturant had the most wonderful food! Our waitress, SandraJones went above and beyond. Maria was so quick to be sure all our needs were attended too and Jose Pierre handled keeping our table ready for each next course as well and keeping our food out in a timely manner. The menu was limited. But that was a huge blessing as typically I wouldn't have chosen the food they selected for me and it was superb! I would easily come back time after time! Wonderful service and incredible food!!

reviews.author: Liz Lizzie
reviews.text:
"Exceptional Service!"
"We had the pleasure of being served by 🥰 Marileisy 🥰all week long at paradisus Palma real golf and spa beach She was consistently friendly,  and always had a smile on her face. What truly impressed us was her proactive approach – she would often save chairs for us before we even asked, going above and beyond to ensure our comfort and enjoyment. 🥰 Marileisy 🥰 made our beach experience truly special with her outstanding service.
She was incredibly attentive to our needs, always making sure our drinks were refilled.
She went out of her way to make sure we had everything we needed to relax and enjoy our time on the beach.

reviews.author: Andrea Blanco
reviews.text: Great service, they are kind, and very professional. The food was very good. It's Dominican style dishes and thus anew experience. Ana our waitress provided a great service and was very kind. Restaurant: Flora

reviews.author: Larry Graber
reviews.text: Rum tasting was great jholfry was fantastic. Juan the bartender at rum bar is the best!  Ariel are butler was the best. Always ask for him every time we come down! He is amazing! wanda at the adults bar always the best!

reviews.author: Bonnie Mai
reviews.text:
*WARNING* This resort fell short of expectations in every regard - extremely disappointed with my stay. Will avoid Melia hotel chains altogether from now on.

1. The staff went through my belongings and stole $300. I had an envelope of cash that I needed to pay a tour operator and realized when I got to my next destination that I was missing money. I stayed in room 3316 and there was a security camera right outside my room - I doubt hotel management will open an investigation (given the lack of care throughout my stay, which I will describe later) but if they do, it would be quite straightforward to figure out. I welcome them to do so with no expectation that they actually will.
2. All inclusive resorts are meant to entice you with a variety of restaurant options. Paradisus only has one buffet open for breakfast and lunch, with the exact same  offerings each day. On their website, they claim that other restaurants are open for lunch, for example, but nope - that is misleading and your only option is, you guessed it, buffet.
3. The unprofessionalism of the staff was evident since the second I stepped foot into the resort. It's a really uncoordinated environment that results in negative guest experience. I waited close to two hours beyond when the front desk claimed the room would be ready. Then when I got to my room, I realized they gave me the wrong one. Several minutes later, I am undressing to change out of my plane clothes and a male staff barges in with the master key, without knocking, and claims to be stocking the mini fridge (it was already stocked). Throughout all the buffet meals, the staff only ever fills your small cup of water once and ignores you the rest of the meal. There is also no place to readily get drinking water throughout the resort - not providing water for guests in a place where you can't really drink the tap water is the perfect metaphor for how Paradisus treats its guests - they just want your money (in fact, they will be happy to steal some extra too) and couldn't care less about their guests.

reviews.author: Patricia Joyce
reviews.text: Delmis was a wonderful concierge! The facility was wonderful. Great beach, pools, great service from all the staff. All so friendly. Sante wonderful for breakfast and lunch with their buffet.met some wonderful people. I thoroughly enjoyed daily stretching and yoga on the beach. Totally relaxed Namaste 🙏

reviews.author: Sean Parker
reviews.text: Our family recently stayed in the Palma Real, and we had an excellent time. The resort was extremely clean and well maintained. There was a wide array of restaurants that were excellent. The ocean was…. Fantastic! And our concierge’s name was Ralphy and he was a tremendous help. He was always there for us and made sure we had an excellent stay. Reynaldo was also full of life and super friendly. 10/10 would recommend, great atmosphere.

reviews.author: Morten Ris Hansen
reviews.text: We had a great stay here. Rooms were nice, activies fun and food was as expected. Lots of different options. We had the best experience at the italian restaurant with Brailyn as our waiter. Thanks again!

reviews.author: Dennis Davis
reviews.text: Everything was fabulous. Our concierge Simeon provided outstanding service. Dinner at Sante was super. It was impressive to watch Milton manage his team to ensure us and all the other guest was well served. It was a pleasure to meet Chef Rafael who prepared a fabulous meal. Additionally, Jose and the other staff provided us excellent service.

reviews.author: Teresa Z
reviews.text: Yuderi was amazing!  He took care of us on the beach and made our vacation exceptional!  I highly recommend!!! Malcazone the Italian restaurant was delicious!  We were well cared for and even remembered when we went in to eat a second time this week! Exceptional service.

reviews.author: Lisa Flieger
reviews.text: Great survice and very nice with Julia and Jose out by our pool at 3011

reviews.author: DiscoRegina
reviews.text:
Excellent food ! Highly recommend this restaurant. Excellent service and Milton, brailin, Arquenio very welcoming. I recommend the Italian and steak house restaurants. All the bars at the hotel are great including the pool bars.
Our room was the Nikki ocean front room and it was huge and wonderful!!
The Paradisus resort I highly recommend. Our concierge Ariel was excellent and very attentive. He helped us with everything we needed help, advice, reservations, booking tours etc.He was wonderful. All staff was very friendly and helpful. Jimmy our bell boy was on time and very nice. I have no complaints! I will be visiting again.

reviews.author: Salvatore Cairone
reviews.text:
Ismael, Antonio, Olga, Dominga and Criseida were great at the ginger bar. Dinner at blueagave was great thanks to our server Alexander and the food as well.

Special thanks to Maximo and Jonathan for an incredible winery experience, they stood out.

reviews.author: Shandrea Stallworth
reviews.text:
We absolutely loved our stay! From the moment we arrived, our personal concierge (Juan Carlos Sierra) had dinner booked and provided us with a resort tour. Throughout our stay, Juan Carlos stayed in contact with us and promptly answered any questions we had.

The resort itself was beautiful and quiet. Our swim up room offered amazing privacy with access to servers for food and drinks. The nighttime parties were entertaining and the staff was great.

reviews.author: Julianne Gaspard
reviews.text:
I had the pleasure of experiencing exceptional service from beach attendant Rafael and our concierge Cristian at the Paradisus Palma Real beach resort. From the moment I arrived, Rafael and Cristian’s attentiveness and care truly stood out. They went above and beyond to ensure that I had a comfortable and enjoyable time by the ocean. Cristians friendly demeanor, prompt assistance, and genuine interest in making my stay memorable were truly commendable. Rafael’s attention to detail and willingness to accommodate any request made my beach experience truly exceptional. I highly recommend them both to anyone seeking top-notch service and a truly delightful beach experience at Paradisus Palma Real.

The rest of the resort was wonderful, but Rafael and Cristian really stood out!

reviews.author: Jake Algor
reviews.text: At my stay at here, we were helped by one of the most amazing people named Juan Castillo. He gave us 20/10 service and made myself and my girlfriend feel beyond welcomed. I would highly recommend him to anybody as a server. Also, in the reserve section, the bartender Wanda and Pedro not only made some of the best drinks but also made the days so much fun! They all have such great hearts and personalities. We are absolutely going to be coming here again plenty of times in the future not even for the resort itself but to see the same great people who made this trip so special. Thank you to again to Juan, Wanda, and Pedro for making our trip super special!

reviews.author: Ryan Ossinger
reviews.text:
Our recent stay at Melia Paradisus Palma Real was fantastic. The amenities and service were absolute top notch. Ismael Antonio Dominga and Fior were amazing, as were Luis, Elvis, Felix, and Giorgi at the various a la cartes and Lunch Box restaurant.  Would highly recommend this resort.

Addendum:
My last night was absolutely fantastic. The announcement of my last night resulted in an unexpected support from the servers at the Ginger bar to send me off. Special thanks to Andreinta, Waliquia, Luis, and the support staff - unreal service. Thank you and I can’t wait to return.

reviews.author: Aj Mckoy
reviews.text: The kicks bar was super fun. Yiri was awesome and attentive of my needs. The food was hot and to my liking. They are all great and I would recommend 100%.

reviews.author: Ariana Munoz
reviews.text:
I recently dined at the hibachi restaurant at Paradisus, and it was an unforgettable experience! The atmosphere was vibrant and welcoming, perfect for a delightful evening out. The highlight of our visit was undoubtedly the exceptional service provided by our servers, Kendy and Jose de Rosario. They were incredibly attentive and made sure every detail of our meal was perfect.

Kendy and Jose de Rosario went above and beyond to ensure we had a fantastic time. They were friendly, professional, and their knowledge of the menu was impressive. They made excellent recommendations and were always ready to assist with a smile. Their warm hospitality truly enhanced our dining experience.

The food was absolutely delicious, with fresh ingredients and expertly prepared dishes. The chefs put on an entertaining show, making the entire meal a fun and interactive experience. From the appetizers to the main course and dessert, every bite was a delight.

Overall, the combination of mouth-watering food and outstanding service from Kendy and Jose de Rosario made our visit to the hibachi restaurant at Paradisus a memorable one. I highly recommend this restaurant to anyone looking for an exceptional dining experience.

For our last day we dined at Blue Agave with our server Alquenio. Service was the best and  the food was superb!

Our time at paradisus has been the best! We are looking forward to our next day!

reviews.author: Ralph Kassin
reviews.text:
Hi.
I brought my family to the Paradisus Palma Real in Punta Cana on 1/15/25-1/23/25.  I brought 12 people with me and we had 4 suites
I have stayed at Melia resorts 8 times.
I have gone to Punta Cana 15 times.

Unfortunately, this was the worst vacation of my life.
From the minute I landed all we had were issues.
For example first day and second day no air conditioning.
No wifi for 6 days.
They broke into my safe and stole money.  They stole money from my sons wallet in his back pack.
My wife burned her arm in the buffet.  She spent 3 days in  the doctors office. Her arm got infected.
We could not get reservations in most of the restaurants.
I can go on and on.
Although problems can occur on vacation, it is how management addresses these issues is what is important.
Unfortunately, I met with management every day and nothing was done to help us or accommodate us.  I met with Lizandro (assistant manager) as well as Luisa ( manager). Neither did a thing for us.

I have flown over 4 million miles in my career. I am a million mile flyer on 3 different airlines, and have stayed at several hundred hotels worldwide.  I have never been treated by any hotel in the world this way.

I recommend you stay at any other location than this.

Best regards.
Ralph

reviews.author: Temeka Johnson
reviews.text:
Concierge and room has surprisingly exceeded our expectations!  Resort is not  overcrowded.  Resort is clean, well maintained.  Good is good and prices are good especially on this economy.
Reservations rep can improve on confirming inclusive services.
Overall, great resort.
Will definitely plan to revisit!

reviews.author: Sami Abrahim
reviews.text:
Sushi restaurant was amazing staff is great just ate here today wow so hype

Chefs service and liquids were high level.

Wanted to add that Lewis the person that was assigned to us was amazing and helped with everything that he could do! He set our friends up with facials and made our time here amazing!

reviews.author: Farah Souguir
reviews.text:
Had a great time at Paradisus Palma Real. The hotel is amazing with various pools, a great beach and multiple restaurants to choose from! Eriol was a fantastic concierge during the stay and was very helpful and available day and night.
I would highly recommend this hotel and his service particularly for a relaxing and enjoyable trip.

reviews.author: Bobby Glidwell
reviews.text: Service here is amazing. Pedro at the beach welcomed me and my wife by name every morning and made sure we had fresh towels and drinks right away. They set us up with a concierge who was very quick to address our questions. Rooms were newly remodeled, but the matresses were a little stiff for my taste and the pillows lacking. Massages were great at the Yhi spa. They have bracelets as the room key which is nice, one less thing to remember.

reviews.author: Dan
reviews.text:
Fior and kicks great service. The sports bar (kicks) are very friendly and very welcoming. My group went there to watch the hockey game and it felt like they were there with us.
Very satisfied with the service

reviews.author: Mitchell Prorwicz
reviews.text: Yensen and Milton at the Mascalzone restaurant were awesome! Great service from all the staff members. The tiramisu was amazing, and so was the pasta. Great wine list as well!

reviews.author: Claudia Rodriguez
reviews.text:
We loved our week long stay. The property was very well kept, the rooms and location are wonderful. We did the reserve experience that made a big difference in terms of access to restaurants, etc. Definitely recommend Santé restaurant. Our server Juan went the extra mile to make our experience great.

We will definitely back!

reviews.author: Tomas Fernandez
reviews.text: IN KICKS SPORT AND FUN BAR THE ATENTION PROVIDED BY ULESES EL CAPITÁN, JOSE DEL ROSARIO, Mr.  SANTOS AVILA AND THE CHEFF USTAQIU WAS FIVE STAR AND EXCEPTIONAL.

reviews.author: Jami Hunt
reviews.text: We stayed here with a whole group, and it was amazing! They let us at the airport with cold water and cool towels to clean up.  So many different pools, plus the beach. We had a junior garden suite with a refrigerator that was kept full of cold beverages. The buffet was wonderful, and all the staff are so polite. The resort is very walkable, even for me.  It might be helpful to learn a couple of phrases in Spanish…but those who didn’t speak it didn’t seem to struggle too much.  One day they even gave us free 5 minute massages by the pool. Both Jorge and Dorkas were fabulous. Stephanie was very helpful.

reviews.author: Ariel McClure
reviews.text: I love this resort!! Osvaldo was THE best concierge. Always available and friendly. All of the staff members were courteous. Bars open late. Views are amazing of course. They were very helpful in planning excursions. Food was top notch. I cannot wait to come back!!

reviews.author: Shara Greenberg
reviews.text: Our stay at Palma Real was absolutely fantastic! We had a great week and Starlin made sure to attend to whatever we needed. We have known Starlin for a few years and he always welcomes us and makes sure our stay at Palma Real is perfect. From dinner reservations to answering our questions he is always available. Thank you Starlin and Palma Real for making our week away so great! We can’t wait to come back!

reviews.author: Kelly D'Andrea
reviews.text: The Rum Republic is an amazing experience!  The cocktails are top notch. Don’t miss trying the “Horchata Painkiller,” a delicious craft cocktail.  It was great chatting with bartender Maria at the end of the day.

reviews.author: Delisa Maney
reviews.text: Mr wonderful was fabulous. I loved how he got everyone moving, including me!! Thank you so so much for having him here. ❤️❤️❤️ our stay has been fabulous.

reviews.author: Alicia Diaz
reviews.text: This is my husband and I fourth time in this resort and it does not disappoint.  We always stay on the adult side and book through Expedia. Our checkin process was a little rocky but Stephanie at the consierge made it right.  The staff at the Celsius bar especially Rosana are amazing always going above and beyond for the guest. Rafael providing service for us at the beach was amazing. Last but not least the food and service at Cana always amazing and fresh.  I will continue to come back not just for the obvious spectacular view but for the service.

reviews.author: Pier Cas
reviews.text: Angelo was an absolutely awesome with making us feel at home here in Melia Palma Real. Top notch service, great quality products!

reviews.author: Osvaldo Rufino
reviews.text:
We had an awesome experience at many of the restaurants, specifically the adult only restaurant, Flora! Felix, Eduardo and Elvis went above and beyond to make us feel comfortable and recommend the best dishes!

We loved that the hotel was right on the beach!

Starlin, our concierge, was great. Was able to book our group of 17 for dinner together every night! He took care of all of our needs!

My kids loved Jenny , Yasnelly and Joanne at the Kids Club! They were all awesome there!

The bell boy, Emmanuel, was awesome and always willing to serve us with anything we needed.

Although we loved it here, we prefer Meliá Falcon’s Resort because it has more kid friendly activities.

We would definitely be back!

reviews.author: Mary Anne McCarrick
reviews.text: The beach is beautiful but what makes it perfect is the service - especially Raul who would greet us each day with a big smile, towels and a cold drink.  A bucket of beers on ice as we got out of the water.  Raul made our trip even better than we expected!! 🏖️🍹

reviews.author: Alanna Pereyra
reviews.text: This resort was great! The staff, food, drinks, and location. The staff was very accommodating and made you feel welcomed and comfortable. We had Eriol as our concierge and I’m very grateful. We were here for a bachelorette party and he made sure we had everything we needed. He let us know the daily activities and helped with reservations and excursions. I would recommend this resort to anyone.

reviews.author: Arefin Wadud
reviews.text: 10/10 service by Luis. At the ginger bar. Gave me the best mojito ever. Every day

reviews.author: Roselyn Jimenez
reviews.text:
Ricki was amazing.  He was very attentive and catering to our needs.  Joel Polanco also assisted us with a special birthday event for my mother.
Carlos at check in was also very helpful he assisted with getting a room on the first floor and closer to the amenities for my mom.

They were all great!  Thank you!

reviews.author: SKT Isaiah
reviews.text: I loved this place, Luis from the ginger bar, gave me a really good service,5 stars I would recommend to get your first drink from Luis so u can have a good start on your day!! loved this resort I would definitely recommend it

reviews.author: Esteban Ramos
reviews.text: We had a great time at the resort and lived the fact we could leave our kids at the kidsdome. They had a great staff and the kids loved it. We were able to truly relax on the vacation because of this service

reviews.author: Chantall Redd
reviews.text:
Gorgeously built, cleanliness great, food royally disappointing, room temperature very uncomfortable when ac working well, ac froze up 2 out of 4 nights, room was soaked with condensation, was hard to get room serviced with service light on, so had to ask for toilet paper and towels several times, mini bar (water) stocked 1x in 5days so had to bother room service unnecessarily for drinking water. All this would have been mostly ignored if we weren’t forced to pay a second time when checking out and DOUBLE THE ORIGINAL PRICE!!! We would have missed our flight if we didn’t just concede and pay as transportation cannot leave premises without authorization. Regardless it would not be a place we would pay to stay again, mostly because of the food and the difficulty just getting a reservation for the better dining options and solidified by the very frustrating and expensive checkout.
If you do stay here make all your dining reservations ASAP for however many days you are there. If you made reservations through their website BEWARE!!!

reviews.author: connor o'brien
reviews.text: My wife and I came to the Paradise Hotel for our honeymoon and had a wonderful time. Our concierge, Luis Cadet, took care of our asks and even went. Above and beyond. He made dinner reservations every night, ensured our room was always serviced, and even surprised us with some honeymoon activities. 10/10 would recommend this trip, and we plan on coming back. Thank you paradises hotel and Luis for the fantastic stay!

reviews.author: david cruz
reviews.text:
Excellent place to go, food was marvelous.
Maira got us covered.

reviews.author: Rebecca Meyer
reviews.text: Recommend the Blue Agave and having Georgi as your server. The food was great, and he provides amazing customer service and even brings our extras without asking. If need recommendations-Georgi is your guy. Blue Agave has the best desserts at the hotel too.

reviews.author: Joline Epple
reviews.text:
We had the most wonderful stay at Paradisus Palma Real! It is truly a five star experience.

We were automatically upgraded to the adults only side of the resort and given Irvin as our concierge. He went so far above and beyond to make everything SO EASY for us that it really made our trip wonderful!

Yuderi and Pedro on the beach treated us like royalty and made us feel like treasured regulars. Thanks for the best and most relaxing vacation I’ve ever had!!

reviews.author: Denise HILL
reviews.text:
Yeimi was very attentive and made the most amazing drinks. His customer service is spectacular! Kicks Bar is the place to go!

Yay Yeimi!

reviews.author: Kingdom Focused
reviews.text: Resort is amazing!! Staff is very friendly! Brush up on your Spanish as the English is broken.food is so so earning it 4 stars instead of 5 but the grilled pineapple is Amazing! Ismael at the ginger bar is amazing making Oreo shakes and coffee drinks. Come enjoy the sun, beach, and relaxation in the Dominican.

reviews.author: Anel Ibarra
reviews.text: This is our 2nd time this week enjoying dinner at Blue Agave. I love the vibe! The aguachiles are delicious. The customer service is exceptional. Delvin and Reynaldo exceeded my expectations. They both went above and beyond. They treated me like family. I will definitely be back!

reviews.author: sarah Bassitt
reviews.text: Luis Rodriguez is the best server! He took care of our every need and want with a fantastic attitude! He even set up a special Dominican meal that chef prepared. Delicious! Louis enjoys his work and is very fun and friendly!

reviews.author: Moraima Barber
reviews.text:
The waiters and waitresses in the breakfast buffet are courteous and very accommodating,  but four that took care of us need to be mentioned. They went above and beyond to make us feel special. They were Olvi Almontes, Reynaldo Martínez at
Mina Restauran and Dayanis and  Yudelkis at the morning Buffet. This resort is not too big but it’s spacious enough to make you feel comfortable and have a special circle club in the premises which, based on our wonderful experience, we became a member of today. All the  restaurants are wonderful and the food delicious! We are Looking forward to many more vacations with the Meliá Family of Hotels! Thank you for making our 43 anniversary very Special!

reviews.author: Rebecca Juliano
reviews.text: The media! Wow! So wonderful! Best espresso martinis I’ve ever had in my entire life. The staff was so enthusiastic! Luis dress, Luis Rosario, Luis nilorio were wonderful!

reviews.author: Demetrius Richards
reviews.text:
We had a wonderful time.  Luis Cadet was the bomb concierge.  He tended to my wife and I every needs and was top of everything.  I highly recommend for any future endeavors that the resort have for him in the future.  I definitely would recommend this resort and willing to come back.  I want Luis as my concierge if and when I come back

Also Jose Ramirez provided excellent service with our bags and making sure we got t our transfer safe and fast

reviews.author: Ocean 2 Sky
reviews.text: Great service. Jimbert Jessica Betty. Thank you

reviews.author: Tristen Bellows
reviews.text: The property is beautiful, truly gorgeous and the staff was attentive and kind. I loved the options for food for dinner although there wasnt much variety for breakfast the buffet is varied enough. The room we had was clearly worn as some of the doors had chipped paint and smelled a little off. I recommend to book excursions at the airport or online in advance. Otherwise everything else was great about Paradisus I would come back and maybe stay in the adults only section next time. Juanlly and Deysi were amazing and attentive. They always helped out immediately and with a great attitude.

reviews.author: Spiro Kasimis
reviews.text: The property itself is beautiful. The many pools and the beach are beautiful their service though is subpar. 9 PM reservations at one of the many restaurants to get you seated at 10:45 PM. Unacceptable. The food is subpar as well. Bottom shelf liquor not ideal first time we did all inclusive probably last time we ever do it. We ended up leaving the resort three times to get decent food.

reviews.author: Betsy Hernandez
reviews.text: First,  as a traveler to wait 3 hours for a room you reserved  is ridiculous, the food wasn’t that good , the laundry service was a nightmare, the shower in my room was clogged and every time I wanted to shower I had to call so they could turn the hot water on , just a horrible stay for the price paid it’s definitely NOT WORTH IT!! Go somewhere else!!!!

reviews.author: Sophia Alvarez
reviews.text: Came and vacationed with my family and had the most amazing experience! The resort is beautiful and the service and staff are phenomenal! Our concierge, Alejandro Gomez, was exceptional and went out of his way each and every day to ensure that we had a five-star experience and stay! Will definitely be coming back soon!

reviews.author: Estela Carmona
reviews.text: We stayed for 8 days and had a fantastic time. Mina restaurant was super. Food was very good and service was great. The service at the  buffet was outstanding, Ulises and Yudy were great. Night life was a little limited since it was done by midnight or so but then again after a day in the sun, midnight was a good time to go to bed. Over all we highly recommend this resort. We will definitely come back.

reviews.author: Alexander Martinez
reviews.text:
My recent dining experience at Blue Agave Restaurant in Palma Real Resort was nothing short of exceptional. From the moment we walked in, the atmosphere was warm and inviting, setting the stage for a memorable evening.

Special praise goes to our outstanding waitstaff, Ventura, and Renaldo Martinez. Ventura's attentiveness and warm demeanor made us feel truly welcome. Renaldo's knowledge of the menu and his impeccable service added to our delightful experience. Both went above and beyond to ensure every detail was perfect.

A heartfelt thank you to Ventura and Renaldo for the unforgettable birthday chant for my girlfriend. Their enthusiasm and genuine happiness made the celebration extra special and left a lasting impression on us.

Blue Agave Restaurant, with its delicious food and extraordinary staff, is a gem at Palma Real Resort. I highly recommend it to anyone seeking a fantastic dining experience. Thank you once again, Ventura and Renaldo, for making our evening so remarkable!

reviews.author: Elisa Sena Santana
reviews.text: Muuuuuuuy rico! Good drink and good services in kicks!

reviews.author: Austin Jimeno
reviews.text: Restaurant Sante. We went here for dinner and had an amazing view of the beach. The staff was awesome! Pamela, Eduardo and Jose were very attentive!! The food was nothing but the best, we ordered the lobster ravioli which was very fresh and the ribs which had the meat falling off the bones. Definitely a 10 out of 10. Highly recommend!!!

reviews.author: Anthony Rapp
reviews.text:
Third year in a row and still a great place. We have eaten at Brisas many times this week. Jose is excellent and makes you feel very welcome, and the food is excellent! Juan Castillo, our concierge has been wonderful arranging for our dinners and other matters. Even moved a special dinner for my daughter when she got sick.

Back again a year later and still love it! Just ate at the lunch box and Franklin was our waiter and he did a great job!

Best vacation we have ever had. It was a wonderful place to stay and we had a great time! Our concierge Harry Milor did a great job! He had reservations lined up for dinner every day and got back to us with any questions immediately. Can’t wait to go back!

reviews.author: Gur Amrit
reviews.text: Amazing service and food for a romantic dinner by the beach at Paradisus Palma real. We were well looked after by our waiter Arismendis Negueis Jean who was attentive and did an amazing job for the night. Thank you

reviews.author: Marko Jugovic
reviews.text: The beach at this resort is amazing! The staff are very welcoming and friendly. Yuderi in the Reserve section is the best there is! Always making sure we have what we need and is on top of drink service. Highly recommend a stay as this resort.

reviews.author: Charlie Zielsdorf
reviews.text: Service everywhere was amazing. All workers were incredibly outgoing and made sure every guest felt comfortable and welcome with their stay. Arisleida at the pool was outstanding and constantly made sure we had everything we needed. The rooms were always clean and all requests were met.

reviews.author: Marcel Boisvenue
reviews.text: Jose at 34 degrees is awesome! He is very polite, professional, funny and good with the kids. He is also very fast on getting drinks. He definitely made our stay more enjoyable! Thanks Jose!

reviews.author: Lena Heinberg
reviews.text:
Amazing Experience at Mascalzone!

We had a fantastic dining experience at Mascalzone in Paradisus Palma Real. The food was delicious, beautifully presented, and full of flavor.

What truly stood out was the exceptional service from Yuleni. She was attentive, friendly, and made sure everything was perfect. Her warm personality made our meal even more enjoyable.

Everything was flawless—great food, impeccable service, and a wonderful atmosphere. Highly recommend dining here and asking for Yuleni!

reviews.author: Hasan Misiri
reviews.text: Ruined my first vacation day, I paid extra for the Reserve and was put in a room with no air conditioning, minibar/frig not working, safe deposit box not working. Took us 4 hours going back and forth from concierge to "managers" complaining and finally they decided to change the room. What a start of vacation, could have received much better treatment in resorts next door with half of price. Nobody is taking responsibility here, up to now horrible experience, hope next days will be better.

reviews.author: Andres Flow
reviews.text: Great service by Luis Desa, Miguel Rodriguez, walkiria brito and lucia Díaz at the Ginger Bar at Paridisus Palma real. The service was always on point very attentive and caring of our needs.

reviews.author: Glenn Brown
reviews.text: This place looks nice but good luck trying to find a place to eat. You cannot make dinner reservations until you arrive but when you get here the and try the registrants have no availability. All that’s left is the hot, horrible and stuffy buffet. There are better resort options on the island. We are considering ending our trip and going home early.

reviews.author: Brian B
reviews.text: The resort was amazing but the people there were even better. Our concierge, Ariel, was always there for us and he went above and beyond for us. We brought our little one with us and he got sick half way through our trip. The staff helped take us and our son to the doctor right away and got us everything we needed. They all constantly checked in on us and would always stop us to chat when they saw us around the resort. Once our kiddo felt better Ariel came to our room and set up a small pool party for him on the balcony tub. Overall it was a great experience! The food could be better but the people there made up for it.

reviews.author: Donghyun Lee
reviews.text: Ramon Gil and Alexandra in Muoi restaurant were very kind and happy! It was such a wonderful experience!

reviews.author: Michelle Ferrara
reviews.text:
The resort was beautiful, staff is very friendly and very accommodating. Buffet wasn't great but the cafe latte made up for it 😉.
We had the 2 bedroom master suite for our family of 5 and was the largest we've ever stayed in. Our only complaint is that you need to make a reservation for dinner. We arrived late Monday, Tuesday morning I tried to make reservations and most restaurants were full for the week. This was finally rectified Wednesday and the meals we had were very good. I highly recommend the steakhouse and the hibachi. But overall great vacation 🌴

reviews.author: David Fiumaro
reviews.text: Had Franklin, Barnelis, Gustavo, Juan, Kelvin, and Supervisor Franklin for 3 days now. They are the best!  Such nice people. Service always professional and top notch. So nice to see them for breakfast with a smile. The best people and best service I ever had at any resort!!!!! Love them !  Nancy and David

reviews.author: Michelle
reviews.text: We had dinner at Flora tonight & it was amazing!! The server & entire team including Edouardo were so attentive & provided service with a smile. The food was incredible, one of the best meals we’ve had since we arrived. We had the lobster banana croquettes, tropical salad, chicken dumplings, shrimp soup, dumplings, veal & mofongo with shrimp. Each dish was excellent, ingredients super fresh & seasoned perfectly! Between the high level service & delicious food it was a 10+!!

reviews.author: Mercedes Jimenez
reviews.text: Francheska and Eduardo in Flor restaurant were amazing and the food was spectacular! Service was actually good! Quiet and private ,Spa girls Liannete/Yaemi were great

reviews.author: Amanda Strong
reviews.text: Our experience with Mary and Felix our servers was awesome. They were attentive to our needs for additional - tea, pepper, salt, etc.  making sure we are comfortable.  They served us with a smile.  THANK YOU MARY & Felix !!!  We need more Servers like you guys.

reviews.author: Ana O
reviews.text: We are so happy and please to have spent seven nights in this Resort. The service was very good .  The service personnel were all very attentive and friendly . Ariel our Consier was always eager to complete our requirements and to answer our questions. Wanda in the bar by the pool very kind . Martin the cabana boy also always ready to help. Taura,  our made keep our room fresh and cleans everyday. We are leaving this place feeling so great . We must come back in a near future.

reviews.author: Peter Gleason
reviews.text: Dinner at Mascalzone was exceptional. The food was top notch and the service by Raider and Yeensen was the best; second to none. Milton, the host, did a great job following up and making sure our meal exceeded expectations. Which it did.

reviews.author: Danny Murrilland
reviews.text: Ismael at the Ginger was awesome. Antonio, Dominga, Chris, Yeri, was very pleasant and served us very well. The coffee was great. The service was fast. the attention to detail was fantastic. they were friendly. see you again.

reviews.author: valentin gorelik
reviews.text: Visiting with the family and by far, Starling Fernandez and Broxni and yalgeny have provided exceptional service at the buffet Malva at the Paradisus Palma real! Service is everything and these days it is hard to find.  It has been a real pleasure being taken care of by these individuals.  They are amazing and we look forward to visiting them again!

reviews.author: Kristen Smith
reviews.text: This is our seventh time staying here and we absolutely love it! The resort recently updated the main hotel building and the adults only section and it is very lush. Definitely make sure you hang out with Wanda at the adults only bar and Martin and Pedro on the beach! They’re the best and will take care of you. Also, Jorge Rafael did a great job of planning fun activities and keeping us informed of what was going on each day during our stay! Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Juan Mercado
reviews.text: Emmanuel B. At the front was amazing. He was quick to task, always very nice, and informative. This resort is amazing defiantly give the service 5 stars all around. And Elvin Mercedes had the best personality of customer service I have ever experienced. He made me feel like family and went above and beyond for us.

reviews.author: christian villa
reviews.text: This resort was amazing and our concierge “Juan Castillo ” made it even better. The grounds were simply amazing. Dining was also awesome and food was delicious. Pool bar tenders are awesome people also… I highly recommend nanny if you have kids there all high quality people.

reviews.author: Margie Williams
reviews.text: Flora restaurant was spectacular! The waiter offered wonderful suggestions for our meal choices . Both the salmon and local fish were cooked perfectly and tasted delicious. The salads and appetizers were unique and very tasty.

reviews.author: Lena Mendoza
reviews.text:
Olvi and Laura are very nice and friendly.We have a good experience staying and have some snacks and drinks at Kenna Restaurant . Good job to both Olvi and Laura.
Fortunately because of Olvi, we managed to experience to have a fine dining at the Italian , Flora and Steak House which is suppose to be the responsibility of our concierge .Thank you Olvi. You did a great job! Kudos to you!

reviews.author: Isabella Livingston
reviews.text: The mascalzone was amazing. We got all the vegetarian options and the linguini and had zero complaints. It is so much food, incredible service and Milton (the supervisor) was so incredibly kind. Everyone was very attentive to us and The service was incredibly quick. Will be going back!

reviews.author: Andrew Hjorth
reviews.text:
Very disappointed with our experience at this resort. The staff was very nice but very little English spoken, sometimes it was very hard to communicate when ordering food and drinks.

The beach area was very nice and beautiful, the rooms were clean and comfortable.

Now the really bad part. The food is awful. I’m not joking when I say this, a couple people in our party lost weight the four days we were here, not just a little bit. We skipped meals because we knew we wouldn’t want to eat bad food again.

reviews.author: Kimberly Greenberg
reviews.text: We came for 5 days, fabulous time!! Great food, the friendliness of the staff is top notch!! The drinks were yummy, the rooms are clean. Very safe!! The activities were perfect, the bartender Wanda was on it everyday we were there!!

reviews.author: Todd
reviews.text: We had an awesome time at the resort!!  The food and resort staff were exceptional.  Our Beach attendant Rafael was the best!!  I recommend people to ask for him at the beach for a great service experience !!

reviews.author: Mandy Fernandes
reviews.text: We aren’t the type to leave our children on vacation but my 3yr old daughter was asking to go to the kids club! They were so friendly and welcoming! Always something fun to do and remembered my daughter’s name throughout our stay. Joanna was exceptionally kind with us and reassuring. I highly recommend!

reviews.author: Morgan Zang
reviews.text: 10/10 experience at this all inclusive resort. Nothing but great things to say about the staff, food, and activities! My family and I will definitely be back next year! A special thank you to Brandol, Kelvin, and Wander for making our experience perfect. Staff was very entertaining, prompt, and fun! Thank you :-)

reviews.author: Valerie Bolduc
reviews.text:
We had a nice trip overall. Service was not great everywhere on the resort especially at front desk. However, we had a really good service on the beach with Arisleida. She was really helpful and always caring for us. She was exceptionnal! Look for her when you go to the Beach.

On another matter, the food was disappointing at the buffet, but the restaurants were good in general.

The beach is good and you always have plenty of chairs. No need to rush in the morning.

reviews.author: Melissa Reitz
reviews.text: Overall I think this is a beautiful resort but misses the mark on customer service. However, the highlight of our trip was our dinner at Flora. Melina was a delight and the food was fantastic - the best of our trip!

reviews.author: Darwin Baird
reviews.text: So many great people here providing excellent service. My wife and I felt like celebrities being pampered and attended to the whole time. From Yanira and Ricki making breakfast special at the lunch box, to Felix walking around at the superbowl party making sure our glasses were never empty. We looked forward to going to the pool bar with Luis singing and dancing as he mixed us delicious beverages. Their joyful spirit is infectious. We will always smile when we think of Paradisus Palma.

reviews.author: Cody Duffek
reviews.text:
Kicks has great service.

Here’s how to make a sandwich:

1. Gather all the ingredients you need for your sandwich. Lay them out on a clean surface such as your kitchen counter or island.
2. Take two slices of bread. You can use white, whole wheat, multi-grain, or any type you prefer.
3. On one or both slices of bread, spread your desired condiments. Common choices include mayonnaise, mustard, butter, or ketchup. You can also get creative with other spreads.
4. Add vegetables of your choice on one of the bread slices.
5. Add your chosen meat if you want to have a non-vegetarian bite. You can use 2-4 slices, depending on your preference. Overlapping them evenly on the bread works well.
6. To add creaminess and extra flavour, you can add your preferred type of cheese.
7. If you like, you can cut your sandwich in half diagonally for a classic presentation. Or use an electric sandwich maker or grill to make it more delicious.

reviews.author: Cheryl Collett
reviews.text:
We visited Flora restaurant and Melina was our waitress. She was attentive and friendly. We had a terrific meal of local cuisine that we all 4 enjoyed. Definitely worth trying.
At the Lunch Box buffet, Maira and Rocio waited on us and were very attentive and friendly. We thoroughly enjoyed our breakfast.
We ate at Mascalzone tonight. Milton greeted us with a welcome drink and Raider was a terrific waiter. He was attentive and friendly and made our meal a delight.

reviews.author: David Westfall
reviews.text: This was probably the best vacation e we have ever had. The staff was very accommodating. Clean clean clean. Amazing. Spend the extra and come here. Food was excellent. Drinks impeccable. Felix at the Hibachi restaurant was a true entertainer. Can’t say enough about this place. We will be back.

reviews.author: Arshi M.
reviews.text: Loved the experience! Service was amazing, as was the view and overall hotel experience. There’s a good array of food, especially at the Flora and the Japanese hibachi place. There’s a bunch of activities to do too! Everyone here is super friendly (shout out to Glenys) and really helpful. 10/10 great vacation destination!

reviews.author: Edwin Rodriguez
reviews.text:
First time staying a Paradisus Palma Real. We are a family of four, two little girls,4 &1. The hotel is more for adults but they still accommodate for families. We stayed in the villas, one downside is there is no elevator in the villa, so going up and down with tired kids was hard.

The location is perfect, beach front property and huge pools. Our kids enjoyed Kidsdom and the staff were wonderful. We were hoping for more kid friendly activities but our kids had the time of their lives regardless.

Felix, Elvis and Eduardo were wonderful staff at the adults- only restaurant Flora. Mina Restaurant was our top favorite restaurant!

reviews.author: cheryl young
reviews.text:
Our stay at the hotel was very memorable.  Our concierges Irvin and Luis Cadet went above and beyond to make sure our stay and everything in between was perfect.  Highly recommend the hotel and our concierges.

To all the hard workers in ALL departments throughout the entire hotel. You ALL went above and beyond. You are all hard workers that I respect tremendously!  Keep up the great work. The place ran smoothly, looked absolutely beautiful and there were many smiling faces! Will be returning!

reviews.author: Amanda Renaud
reviews.text: Highly recommend. We came here with our extended family and our rooms were all close together. Great clean beach, food and drinks. The variety of restaurants and amenities is impressive. The adults enjoyed tennis and learning paddle tennis. The swim up rooms were well worth it.All the kidsdom workers were so kind and engaging and remembered our kids names, and kids activities were fun and creative. It was a huge hit and the kids did not want to leave. Our concierge Eriol took great care of us. Julia’s poolside service was amazing. We are ruined for any other vacation after this!

reviews.author: David Garcia-Rosen
reviews.text: We loved the kids club. They were so kind and caring to our 3 year old son for our entire stay. We were worried that he would not want to go, but he was constantly asking to go to kids club. Fun activities and attentive staff meant we were never worried about him during adult time.

reviews.author: Camillus Patel
reviews.text:
The property is beautiful…one of the best lobbies and common area, clean open rooms. I really appreciated that most of the common areas were open air with a view of the ocean. The pool was great although wish it had some more shallow parts that would make the pool bar more accessible for those of us who don’t like getting our hair wet in the pool every day.  The beach access was amazing.
My biggest frustration was the lack of clear information around upgrade to the reserve. I wish this information was more clearly available during the time of booking so that me and the rest of the group I was with (3 rooms total), could have made a better decision. The biggest challenge was trying to get any reservations for the restaurants. The system was that on Sunday morning reservations for the entire week opened up. So if you checked in on a Thursday you pretty much had no shot of getting a reservation at any of the restaurants, unless you had reserve upgrade. Most of the restaurants were half empty when we would walk by yet we were repeatedly told there was no availability. When Sunday came we were one of the first groups in line to try to make reservations for the rest of the trip including Sunday night. We were immediately told there was no availability for Sunday night or Monday night even if we split into two gyros of 4—-how can this be when we were literally the third group in line??? My sister patiently worked with the service rep to ultimately find us availability But it was like they were doing us a favor. We made it work but the amount of time and disappointment really took away from the overall experience.

The staff was really nice and helped if you asked a question; However, there was a element of personalized service that was missing. I think you got this if you upgraded to the reserve. For example if we were at the beach we hardly saw any service being offered. I needed help to book a return car service back to the airport and they had no information available and said they only thing they could do is book me a taxi…? Really?. So it was the small things that could’ve been better for a getaway that wasn’t exactly cheap.

That being said the property is beautiful the meals that we did get at the restaurants were great. The bartenders were always super friendly. I would probably come back but only if I can afford upgrade to the reserve (since I don’t know how much the upgrade is).

reviews.author: Kim T
reviews.text:
We are here now and will provide a full review when we return but this is definitely NOT a luxury or 5 star resort. If you don't have their upgrade level, your wrist band shows what you're worth and how much service you'll get. Which is valid in the aspect of "getting what you pay for". But for those just checking out the resort without knowing the level of service, thinking you'll get treated equally, I would probably avoid. Yes, we've been tipping everyone.

Their restaurant reservations process is outdated IMO. You'll have to be in line, BEFORE the reservation desk opens and line up. Which takes away from your "relaxation in paradise". If you're traveling with your family, someone will have to take time out in the morning to line up. Once you get to the front, you may not even have a reservation. It may be "all booked" for the day and next day because the higher level rooms have priority and can book their reservation for their ENTIRE STAY!

reviews.author: PERPETUA VIEGAS
reviews.text:
Our concierge Juan Castillo is the best, he took care of our concerns right away.  We didn’t have to worry about our dinner reservations, he was at each restaurant to greet us every night. Juan is very caring.

Olvi is and excellent server!  Olvi was at a few of the restaurants where we had our meals.  He was always attentive, friendly and professional, he cares about the clients.

Josias is guest services liaison. Always on top of things.  Always professional and very, very helpful.

The restaurant the service is excellent the variety of food is pretty good too Rosanna,, Edito, yuderqui, George gave us great service. They made our breakfast time very pleasant, and it was fun too!

Last but not least the bell boy service was great, they were on time to pick up our bags.  We’ve travel all over the world, waiting for someone to come and get your luggage is irritating.  This was a pleasant experience.

reviews.author: Anjali Sharma
reviews.text: The Palma Real is a beautiful property and well maintained. There are lots of activities and restaurants to choose from.  Harry, our concierge, was helpful and responsive, and did a wonderful job helping to coordinate reservations, trip excursions, and general inquiries. He was very persistent for the presentation and while we opted out, he did a great job trying to convince us.  We struggled a little with the language barrier, but the staff was overall helpful.  The master swim up room was amazing, and plenty of space for a family of 4.  We enjoyed our stay at the Palma Real and would recommend it for anyone wanting to enjoy a beach vacation in DR.

reviews.author: LaMancha
reviews.text:
Luis and Quintino are the best and friendly bartenders at the pool bar. They were attentive, courteous and very friendly. They also pay good attention to all details, our drinks were
Never empty and both of them were just amazing.
I will come back many towns just for them.

reviews.author: Debra Freire
reviews.text:
The activities workshops were very enjoyable and convenient. They offered painting (on canvas and figurines), candle making, a gem workshop, etc., administered by artists and professionals. The staff were very helpful and positive. Shout out to Brandol and Jennifer!
Our dining highlights:
- the buffet is varied and well-stocked with many delicious, fresh options. Hirlenne is an attentive, personable and professional hostess. Our serving staff, Rosanna, Yanira, Maria, Ibelka and Luis (names I recall) were excellent. They served with a smile, remembered our preferences and made us feel welcome and cared for.
