- Mina, the steakhouse, is amazing. The food is high quality and cooked to perfection - from steak to fish to vegetables, appetizers, dessert and more. The service matches the high standards. Dionys, Jesus and Kelvin provided excellent recommendations and delivered a first class dining experience that matches the best steakhouses.
Our appreciation also goes out to Vanessa (and Yuderi) who efficiently and energetically managed the beach (and pool) area and delivered wonderful tropical cocktails, always with a great attitude.  Muchas gracias!

reviews.author: Fidelia Perez
reviews.text:
We had such an amazing time at this hotel. First time visiting with this chain and will definitely be back. Some of our favorite staff were:

Olga, Antonio, Clari, Domingo, Lindbergh, Madelin, Sonranyi

Jose Ramirez Amazing bell boy.

Osvaldo our concierge.

All at the lobby bar! ginger.

Don’t forget to get your coffee here too they are open 24/7.

reviews.author: Dan Caine
reviews.text:
Amazing hotel.
Great service from all the staff, special shout out to Rosanna Castillo and supervisor Milton at the Lunch box who were amazing during my lunch.
Fantastic location and all food and drink was great.
Visited on a work trip but would come here with family in a heart beat!

reviews.author: Ryan Whitham
reviews.text:
We had a great time! Our family booked a Nikté Master Swim out room which was great since we have 2 young kids. The room was big and nicely designed. This allowed us to swim whenever we want and have fun if the kids were sleeping. This room was well worth the premium.

The food was very good and were were able to visit most of the restaurants over the week. The buffet had lots of great options, even though my 3 year old just got waffles each morning for breakfast. Best meal was the 24 hour slow cooked beef at the Japanese restaurant. Favourite server was Wander at Kanna were we ate a few lunches. Ginger serves a great morning coffee with a smile.

Service was excellent starting with our concierge Jose Simeon. We stayed in touch via WhatsApp and saw him most days. He made sure we had restaurant reservations, answered any questions, and made sure our room essentials - milk for the kids, and wine for the parents, were always stocked. Jose stayed with us right to the last minute, ensuring we got off ok to the airport.

Rooms were cleaned thoroughly each time we pushed the button. We spent a lot of time lounging in the pool outside our room and the drinks were brought right to us.

The beach was excellent and well kept with very little seaweed. A welcome surprise was the service. Beach attendants were happy to bring you towels and a bucket of water, beer or anything else you could need.

Some helpful feedback: "Circle" exclusive venues were almost always completely empty. Consider opening them up to higher room categories or rewards status members.

Pro tips: bring lots of USD tip money, it can be hard to get change once you are there.

Book an airport transfer through Melia, they know the good companies as the one we booked through the internet was late both times.

reviews.author: Sheila Hunt
reviews.text: The restaurants Flora was excellent, service and food was awesome. My server Naomi paid attention to detail and was very attentive. Eduardo was excellent as well. Don’t miss the opportunity to spend time at this wonderful resort and restaurant. You will  not be disappointed

reviews.author: CT 7567
reviews.text: Only roughly 20 minutes from the airport and a 3 hour flight from Atlanta it’s an awesome resort with great people always asking how they can make your stay as best as it can be. I was extremely happy with the trip.  In the interest of honesty my only complaints are the paid beds blocking the beach views of the included beds, the number of vendors on the beach and “beach view” rooms mean you can see the beach from the edge of your balcony. Aside from those things the employees are all kind and wonderful.

reviews.author: Mindy
reviews.text: Yamilet was wonderful at Blue Agave ….wonderful food and service

reviews.author: FBD Marketing
reviews.text: We ate at Flora and Melina was the GOAT - Awesome service, her recommendations on point. Loved it. SUIIII

reviews.author: Daniel Blake
reviews.text:
The hotel itself has a fantastic ambience and scenery definitely displaying what a 5* hotel should look like. The service of the staff everywhere was great, not a single person let it down. We had a private concierge Eriol who looked after us throughout our stay. He went completely above and beyond and as we were here for our honeymoon he made so much effort to add romance and a personal touch throughout the stay.

The only issue I found with the hotel was the quality of the food in the other restaurants, other than Santé, and room service, with the use of salt being far too much. We unfortunately did order room service a couple of times and did receive raw chicken both times which put us off ordering from that point on.

Santé was definitely the highlight restaurant in the hotel. The food, service and ambience were definitely number 1.
Shout-out to their staff members, Misael and Norjandro.

The rooms are very comfortable and cleaned to a very high standard. With the shower being nice, powerful and hot.

reviews.author: Marybeth
reviews.text: The kidsdom staff is superior. They are so caring. My daughter loved every minute and wanted to go back each day just to spend time with them. So many activities, pool time, karaoke and dance parties. Amazing staff!!!

reviews.author: lulu Perez
reviews.text: Felix was very pleasant and attentive with us. Such a gentleman.  He  make sure that everything we needed was at our table.   An excellent employee..

reviews.author: Azra Kadric
reviews.text: We came here with the kids during spring break and it was phenomenal! Lots of activities for the kids, staff is super attentive and accommodating. Everyone is willing to help and make our stay great. The beach was clean, water crystal clear. Could not recommend the place more. We came back alone a month later to enjoy their adults only section. Did not disappoint.

reviews.author: Lori Stinson
reviews.text:
Haley in the sports bar was amazing as was her passion fruit drink.  She has an infectious smile and is very friendly!

Richard s was grea helping with luggage!

Cocolini in the adult pool was wonderful and very accommodating.

Luis at our end of the event banquet was very attentive and helpful with getting beverages at the dinner.

Rooms were wonderful as were the pools

Will definitely recommend and be back!

reviews.author: KA KTUS
reviews.text:
Don't book this hotel - you don't get any value for your money

especially, if you book an oceanfront room, because all the services surrounding it have been taken away from the Palma Real and are reserved either to Circle Members, the adults only or the Zel, so what you get is an old, run down room with limited sea view + smells and noises from the services/ bars you are not allowed to use!

We were staying in the Oceanfront Suite No. 9354 with my wife and teen aged daughter from December the 26th to January the 4th 2025. I booked the room through the hotels official website. Rooms were promoted with a seasonal discount of -30% and a free transfer for a stay for more than 4 nights, but we didn't get neither the discount nor did someone pick us up from the airport!

Originally I looked up the neighboring Zel a new brand Melia, but the Zel is very far away from the beach and does not provide the proximity to the sea we were looking for.

Of course we assumed, that an oceanfront suite in this proximity of the beach, which comes along with an exclusive price tag, would also include the essential services and infrastructure of the hotel right in front of it. Furthermore not one of the pictures on the hotels webpage, nor the google reviews or google maps did, not even the map they gave us when we checked in, did indicate something else - on the contrary the pictures of the pool bar have been photo-shopped so you can not see the plate indicating, that it serves only to members of the "circle".

Waiting for a transfer in vane, we got to the hotel late in the evening and had to realize only the very next morning trying to enter the beach bar in front of our room in order to have breakfast, that we were refrained from entering it, with the explanation, that they were only serving “socios”, as they called the members of "The Circle".

We learned that very moment, that we are not allowed to use  the facilities below our room and our daughter not allowed to use the pool we had a look at from our balcony, not any other close.

First I thought this surely must be some kind of very big misunderstanding, having talked to Luisa from Guest Services 12/27/24 I realized, that this was all part of an outright scandalous scam the management of the Melia is carrying out here!

Would we have known, that this was only the start of things we would have pulled out of this building renovation case immediately (pls. look @ pics), instead of spending 5 afternoons waiting for the maintenance team (the app did not help, tickets were ticked of as „solved“ immediately, but nobody came):

1. fridge did not work (had to throw away medicine)
2. safe  did not work
3. shower hose burst
4. drain of the hand-washbasin leaked
5. drain of the shower started leaking
6. TV's had no channels any more after we got a missing remote for our 2nd TV

When I mentioned all those issues to Luisa she told me, I quote “esta buscando pedos…”, that is you are looking for farts (= problems). She finished our conversation telling me in front of witnesses, that she would contact my embassy and get me kicked out of the country…!

So this is exactly the kind of reaction you would expect to be delivered by the guest service manager of a five star resort, isn't it?

I send an email complaining about this to her colleague Juan Pena and it took me two more of those and him more than four days to contact me.

They never offered us another room though, but an upgrade for our "next stay"...But there was a catch to this too: They tried to make me sign a NDA - stripping my of all my rights incl. indemnification - yeah that was the cherry on the cake (pls. see the scan..)!

As to New Years Eve, would you be surprised to hear that the F&B team actually blocked the access to the dinner buffet between 8 and 8.30 p.m. in order to "refill" the full buffet (see pics) that wasn't so lavish after the refill anymore 🤣needless to say, that they had their own party with the best bits of it a couple of days later…

Mano en el corazon turned here to:
Una mano en tu bolsillo y otra te tapa la boca...

reviews.author: Lucy Abernathy
reviews.text: This was such an amazing vacation. The service was excellent. The staff goes above and beyong to make your stay as pleasant as it can be. Our concierge Jose Simeon was so amazing. He always made sure we had everything thing we needed for the day. He helped us set up all of our family events / activities during our stay. We celebrated a couple of birthdays and Jose and staff made everything go so smooth and enjoyable. The resort's restaurants, the Spa, the beach, the pools and everything else were just great. I will definitely come back!!

reviews.author: Kelly Bauer
reviews.text: Would like to rank this at 4.5 stars if that was an option. The resort grounds are beautiful, well-maintained and clean. The beach was by far the best beach in the area. Buffet food was as expected and sometimes really good. All of the restaurants with reservations needed were very good and accommodating for a party of 2. We had some issues with our room and had to change, but Eduardo at the front desk was very helpful. We had the pleasure of having Adriel the butler assist us in our room issues and making reservation. He went above and beyond to make sure we had a great stay and my friend had a special birthday. The facial at the spa was heavenly and I wish I remembered the name of the woman who did it- she had amazing hands. We appreciated the adults only pool and the music played there every day. Pro tip- pack sunscreen or wander offsite to buy some. It is $30+ at the resort.

reviews.author: Tammy Wiggins
reviews.text: We had a marvelous time at Paradisus Palma Real. The staff is top-notch! Our Butler, ERIEL was amazing and attended to our Every need. Check out the ginger bar for the caramel iced latte and friendly faces. The baristas are the best!

reviews.author: Lynn Christine
reviews.text: Beautiful property, nice staff always friendly well maintained. Great swimming pools, good food and an exceptional concierge named Yaleidi Sims. She did a fine job for us. It was a fun time.

reviews.author: Holly
reviews.text:
Great setup for older couples without kids (no wildlife or anything to swim with).

Bar service is great, find Arisleida at the adult side of the beach. She will take care of you.

reviews.author: Chelsey Thornburg
reviews.text: We have loved everything about our stay here at Paradisus Palma Real! The food and service included. Rosanna Yorgelis Betti has been one of our servers this week and she’s been incredible! Thank you Rosanna for your care and attention during our stay, and for the excellent service!

reviews.author: Aria Rose
reviews.text: We love staying at Paradisus Palma Real! Brisas is our favorite restaurant - the menu is great and the servers (Jose Ramos and Yuleni - we appreciate you!!) are amazing. Everything on the menu looked and tasted great. We looked forward to our lunch every day because of the great service. Thank you for making our stay amazing!!

reviews.author: shannon mclaughlin
reviews.text: Edito has been our server all week and has been beyond amazing ! He greets us every morning with coffee ,  serves us wine with dinner . He is extremely positive and has made our trip! His service has been excellent! Felix has been amazing as well!

reviews.author: Brittney Sharp
reviews.text:
Marileisy was a wonderful sever throughout our entire stay. She was ready with drinks and remembered our orders all week long. She was bright, cheerful, and so helpful while we had a large group of 14 (including 5 kids, 5 and under!) Her service was a highlight of our stay!

Our main complaints were as follows: it was nearly impossible to get change. We were refused a purchase at the store due to lack of change (while they were counting change). It made it extremely hard to tip the valued employees. Second, the grounds music played constantly, all night long, and could be heard clearly in my room in the middle of the night. Restaurant service was generally good, as was the food, but we had a negative eating experience on the final night. Finally, we felt that the overall communication of the resort was confusing. The areas, restaurants, bars, activities, and that were available to our level of stay was unclear.

We appreciated the guest services manager’s assistance throughout our stay and Dalmis and Wily were very helpful.

reviews.author: Candace Benson
reviews.text:
Celebrated my 50th birthday at Paradisus Palma Real Resort.  Had an amazing time. Basilio was on point 100% of the time.  I love him, I'm coming back and I want him again.  Martin was also very attentive on the beach.
Thank you,
Candace B.

reviews.author: Andy Layman
reviews.text: Our first night at this resort was incredible and set the tone for us for the whole week we were here. We went to Blue Agave on our first evening and Edito was our server. He was sincere and kind, and made our night super lighthearted and enjoyable. Thank you, Edito! Overall a wonderful experience

reviews.author: Deana Seuferling
reviews.text: The service with Delvin was amazing!  Took care of us the entire dinner and was very creative with our dinner.   Francis the chef was fabulous and came out to greet us at the end. We had the lobster and Tomahawk steak.  To die for!   If you go to Blue Agave then please ask for Devlin and enjoy the beat service ever!!!

reviews.author: robert nolan
reviews.text: Maria from the bar made fantastic drinks and provided excellent service. Frank, the waiter at multiple locations, was enthusiastic and kind and remembered our family every time he saw us.

reviews.author: Peggy McDaniel
reviews.text: We were very pleased with our stay The aura was very relaxing. The architecture and design and decor were interesting and the food was amazing , The beach is clean, the room is gorgeous and the whole place is a joy to walk around and enjoy. Love to come again.

reviews.author: Trevor Shaw
reviews.text: We came here on our honeymoon and it’s been fantastic! Dinner at Mascalzones was phenomenal. The food was vibrant and the service was wonderful! Was not expecting Italian food in the Dominican to be this tasteful! The service from the bellhops were fantastic as well! Fernando and Juanilly were exceptional! Our concierge Juan Carlos was wonderful and took care of every need we had,  not that there were many!

reviews.author: Paula Slipp
reviews.text: My vacation was fabulous withDana from animation. She was friendly and full of fun. She engaged the people and did a great job teaching. A lovely person.

reviews.author: Faith Schultz
reviews.text: Ebony yedy likes to give her own review of 5 stars after taking your phone under the assumption of using a translating app. Cant say that she earned it, she came to our table and asked if we needed something to drink. We didn’t receive the mimosas and the water had a fishy smell??! But Joan and kelvin were amazing!  We didn’t care for the scheduling of dinners at restaurants at the last hours. SCUBA is not worth the time or money as well as chartered fishing  The free catamaran was very enjoyable! The main pool bar was by far the best of the outdoor bars. Steak house and Mexican were the best food options  entertainment was marginal, except for the young Spanish singer at the Mexican restaurant and the 4 person band with a female lead singer and female lead guitarist. Overall this was a good vacation. ( ps. Wouldn’t buy into the Circle ownership)

reviews.author: Lucy Birch
reviews.text: Fantastic evening! Music and entertainment were outstanding!!! Highly recommend. Jairo was the best !!!!

reviews.author: Abylash Chacko
reviews.text: Kids club was great. My almost 6 year old loved all the people working there especially Martha and all the activities. Food at the buffet was great. Wish there was food available at the pool. You have to go to the buffet for food or snacks during the day. Otherwise no complaints. Perfect relaxing vacation.

reviews.author: Melanie Tran
reviews.text: We had such a great time at Palma real! A couple of hiccups with check in but over all the grounds are beautiful, the people are incredibly kind and accommodating. A couple of folks who stand out, Wander at Kanna for lunch, all the staff at breakfast, Rosanna at the main pool was the sweetest! She went above and beyond. Sugey at Blue agave and all the staff. Jaime our concierge. Def recommend coming here! Thank you for a beautiful stay

reviews.author: Carolina Rosa da Silva de Oliveira
reviews.text:
Mixed experience. If we hadn't upgraded to The Reserve, I wouldn't have recommended the hotel. With the upgrade, we had an improvement in beach and pool service, and we also started eating at Santé. Our concierge refused to help us because he only wanted to sell the circle experience.

The staff did not solve basic problems such as: TV without Netflix, minibar that didn't work, among others.

Great beach service with Pedro and Yuderi! They were very Nice with us and prepared a lot of drinks without alcohol for me! In Santé, Barnelli and Luz were awesome.

reviews.author: Karen Tesoriero
reviews.text: We came here for my 50th birthday as just a couple and we are having the best time.  The food at Restaurant Flora was sooooo good!  The resort was so nice we love our room.  The service is incredible…. We are here in the office season of Early October and there are so many service people here.  we will be coming back again and highly recommend to others!

reviews.author: Adrienne Sicard
reviews.text: It was such an amazing experience!!! I didn’t want to leave. The people/waiters in the buffet were so nice and attentive. The pools were so big and many to pick!! I already am trying to plan my next vacation and have high standards because of the great things this resort had to offer. I’ve been comparing and won’t settle 🥹😅

reviews.author: Cassie Hancock
reviews.text: Perfect in every way! Bleagave maria y Alexander son super atentos.

reviews.author: Matthew Granger
reviews.text: Great resort. Lovely private properties.  We loved our services from Jose and Julia. Our concierge, Dileydis, was helpful and attentive. Thank you!

reviews.author: Gabrielle Lopez
reviews.text:
We absolutely love this resort, we
continue to come back each year because of the people! One of our favorite restaurants Brisa’s that always takes care of us including Jose & Rosanny and has incredible food! The circle bar by the pool has amazing staff that always checks on us including Joel and Marilessy, at the beach staff members such as ivan and odeybi who always make sure our drinks are full!

reviews.author: bety jay
reviews.text: Everything is good about this hotel. But... except for daily activities and pool entertainment.  There is nothing= zero. And also there is an indian wedding. The wedding guests turned the pool into a private one. They play Indian music all the time. My advice is that have your own speaker. I have to be honest: staff are polite, room service is excellent, food is good. But the wedding really ruined everything.  I hope the hotel manager reads it and do something about it. I'm here right now if you have any questions ask me please.

reviews.author: Ermina Radoncic
reviews.text: My husband and I went to eat at the Italian restaurant in Paradisus Palma resort called Mascalzone. We we serviced by Yuleni who was so nice and attentive. Milton the manager came by to make sure everything was going well. Beautiful resort with beautiful staff. Would come back again and again.

reviews.author: Michael Coscia
reviews.text:
We stayed at the Reserve section of the Paradisus. This is my 3rd time staying here. Every time I come back I am so surprised with how many updates and improvements they make. We were assigned a concierge (Adriel) for our stay. Adriel was truly amazing. He made sure to take care of all of our needs. He checked in with us every morning and numerous times throughout the day. He went further and had birthday balloons set up in our room for my partner and even had a cake brought out during dinner. I felt very relaxed and comfortable knowing Adriel had us taken care of. I highly recommend staying at the Reserve section for its top of the line amenities, premier access, and concierge service.

We ate at the Italian restaurant (Mezcalzone) tonight. We were greeted by the lovely hostess Daniela. Rayden our waiter and Santo (manager) took great care of us. Our glasses were never empty. The food was excellent. It was prepared right in front of us via the open kitchen. We had a great experience overall. Highly recommend making a reservation here for dinner.

The beach staff was excellent. We had Rafael as our courier. Rafael was very friendly and helpful. Every morning he had our cabana bed ready for us with towels. He checked on us constantly throughout the day to make sure we were comfortable and quickly fulfilled any requests we had. Our experience on the beach was enhanced by his presence.

reviews.author: S. Cheng
reviews.text: Kidsdom: Our kid (7 years old) loves the kids club (Kidsdom). The activities/theme of the day, the flexibility and variety in games, the cleanliness of the place are all things we appreciated.  The staff is caring, attentive, friendly, and there's always a few staff members around. Thank you for making our kid's stay a fun and memorable one!

reviews.author: Aaron Branham
reviews.text: The hotel is nice and clean. The food was average at best. There are almost no activities provided by the hotel, and if you do participate in an activity they get you to fill out a Google review while standing over your shoulder and making sure you say their names. The swim up pool rooms are actually just a shared pool that is 10 feet outside your room.

reviews.author: Alper Logan Kaya
reviews.text:
Our stay at The Paradisus resort overall was average. The staff is pleasant but not on top of things. It is a huge complex and thus I understand organizational aspects can be complicated, but thats not an excuse. The open buffet was below mediocre except for the few items we were able to find. However,  The beach, and its location are phenomenal  and even with rainy weather we were able to enjoy it. The rooms were clean, and the beds were very comfy. And the kids play room, programs and staff were wonderful.

BlueAgave - the Mexican restaurant  was the best restaurant option available from the 3 other Child friendly restaurants (Asian - avoid if possible, steakhouse and Italian). The first time our meals were good, but during our  second visit every single item we ordered was amazing. And our waiter Edicto was attentive, efficient who overall made this a lovely experience for me and my family.

reviews.author: Erika Neal
reviews.text:
We had such a great vacation here!  Our butler Kelvin was so helpful and always attentive to anything we needed.  Every member of the staff was so friendly… from bartenders to waitstaff to housekeeping.. they were so kind and always had a smile!  Our favorite restaurants were Flora and Mascalsone- they were delicious!!  Lunch at Sante was also amazing!

We will definitely be back in the future!!

reviews.author: Carlos E. Wiegering, M.D.
reviews.text: Italian Restaurant with the best service I have ever had. Milton made the difference in this wonderful resort. A the staff under his supervision was very pleasant.

reviews.author: Ralph Salinas
reviews.text:
This restaurant crew is amazing, hard work, attention to our table, providing a great experience for our trip. They assured we were not without.
Props to
Juan Torres, Edison, Rocio, Mayra

reviews.author: Stephen Bennett
reviews.text:
Our service at Blue Agave Mexican Restaurant was extraordinary. Gregori made our dinner experience so special, and the Service Manager Milton was there to make sure everything went perfectly! What a great dinner!

We had an excellent time at the sushi workshop with Jorge and Ayda!

Loved the service at Ginger lobby bar. Antonio went above and beyond, with great drinks from Dominsa, Clari, Olsa, and Soranyi!

We enjoyed the rum tasting with Anthony and all the staff at Rum Republic!

The swim up bar is where it's at! Eddy, Olga, Jose, and all the bartenders there took great care of us. Thanks!!

reviews.author: Megan Logan
reviews.text: We had a wonderful time celebrating our friends’ 40th birthdays here. The resort was beautiful and very clean. The food was good, the drinks were strong and the WiFi worked very well through the whole resort. Service overall was very good but was slow at times although I suspect this is more of a cultural difference of opinion in what good service entails. Regardless, our concierge Kelvin Fernandez Arias was amazing and took care of all our needs. We will be back in the future for sure.

reviews.author: Kimpenny McQueen
reviews.text: The bartenders by our swim up suite were wonderful as well as the ones at Kicks Bar. Loyda Tejeda was a great server. She took great care of us while relaxing on the beach. The property was beautiful & very clean. The first day there we never saw or heard from our concierge. We were informed at check in that he would book our dinner reservations. This made it difficult to eat at the restaurants we wanted, because they booked up quick. The lunch buffet was not good to me at The Lunch Box. Flies were on alot of the food. The breakfast buffet was better. I would not come back to this property.

reviews.author: Penny Sorrick
reviews.text: Ismael, Antonio, Dominga, Olga, Nereuda, and Clary at the gin bar were super friendly. Coffee was great! Enjoy my conversation with him and the service was great.

reviews.author: Mary Caldwell
reviews.text: I stayed at the paradisus for a corporate work function and it was lovely. The reserve suites have complimentary concierge services that make it so easy to get questions answered and services provided. My butler was Kelvis, a professional young man who was very attentive and kind. Good job to the guest services team for making all the requests from our group happen! 👏 Bravo!

reviews.author: James Scott
reviews.text: We stayed for 9 nights - lovely, large hotel and beach location. Service from staff very friendly and happy to help. Great hotel for families with small children. Room overlooking the beach was great, a few minor issues were resolved in a day or two, such as broken furniture. Restaurants were nice, but we struggled to book tables at the times we wanted even though the hotel was not that busy.

reviews.author: George Dugdale Jr
reviews.text: Alexander and virtudes , the restaurant blue agave good food the service good

reviews.author: Lora McKeown
reviews.text: We loved blue agave. Food was amazing and service was exceptional. Jose was such a treat to get to know. Felix made sure everything was perfect.

reviews.author: Debbie Biernacki
reviews.text: Five stars for the excellent food and service!!  I had the steak cooked exactly how I asked for it, and Sergio was my server who took great care of me.  He was very attentive and had 5 stars high-end service. And the molten chocolate cake and home made ice cream was out of this world! I’m definitely going back a couple of times before my trip ends!

reviews.author: Ellis Poling
reviews.text: We had an EXCELLENT couple of meals at Blue Agave in the Paradisus! The hospitality, food, drinks, pools and beaches were all top notch. Everything was very clean and professional and incredibly relaxing. Jordania was a huge help throughout the week, she helped us with reservations, transportation and any questions we had. We will definitely plan on being back for another stay!

reviews.author: Hannah Payne
reviews.text:
Love it here! Ginger bar service was amazing! Ismael makes the best coffee!

Edit: Review #2 (11/26/23)

I stayed there with my family for the first time about 2ish weeks ago. We had a wonderful time! We will definitely go back! Please see my pro/con list below.

Pros -
- Our concierge Starlin was amazing! He was so easy going and helped us make dinner reservations, book spa days and even brought us a volleyball when we asked! He was great and would definitely recommended him to anyone staying there!

- Gorgeous Resort. It is absolutely stunning and quiet! Plenty of room even though they were pretty booked. I appreciated the pools right out side our rooms so we could take a quick dip if we wanted too! Such a nice touch.

- The Service. We had great waiters and waitresses and all the restaurants! A few servers that gave exceptional service were Ezekiel (Beach dinner), Yanira (Buffet), Gustavo (Sante), Eduardo (Sante) and Louis. Another way we saw good service was at check-in. Josiah at the circle checkin counter was very kind and friendly when checking us in. He also provided us with refreshments and made sure our bags got to our rooms accordingly.
One other area we got great service was on the beach! An attendant named Martin got our beach beds ready for the day and always asked if we needed anything. He was very kind. At the beach bar a server named Wanda made us fantastic drinks and was very fast!

The staff were just amazing, and will definitely remember them next time we go!

Cons -
Unfortunately the food was not as good as we had hoped. The resort definitely raises the bar for a clean, friendly resort, but the food was a total bust. I wish it could have been better because I would give at 10/10….
Even though they have plenty of restaurants I saw a lot of similar items of the menus… the buffet was not better either. The food just felt like cafeteria food and tasted so bland. I hoped they makes some changes or at least get better quality because I might have to bring my own snacks next time… Seriously…

Over all I would give our stay a 7/10. Like I said, the resort is wonderful and staff are more than exceptional! If the food could just be upgraded I would have given a better rating. Also, this is just my opinion and my experience. Feel free to do your own research. 🙂

reviews.author: Anita McGee
reviews.text: One of the best vacations ever. The resort was absolutely fabulous.  Nothing bad to say, from the moment we stepped onto the resort until we drove away, it was fantastic.

reviews.author: Stephanie Jones
reviews.text:
Service was great all week long!  Maria Ortiz in the buffet had a table and smile ready for us each morning…what a great way to start the day!  Edickson Morales served us all day long at the pool!  Top notch service wherever we went.

Restaurants were accessible, once we figured out how to make reservations.  Loved Blue Agave…get the churros with chocolate sauce there!  The restaurants were all highly vigilant about allergies.  The buffet could do better at this… at least have one area with no seafood, because cross contamination was a worry all week.

Resort system was a bit confusing with where we were and were not allowed access.  Several different “levels” at this resort and we were never really clear because what we were provided with during checkin seemed to change throughout the week or was dependent on the individuals working that day.

Rooms were spacious and beautiful.  Our room specifically seemed like maybe it was supposed to be under construction….some dry wall patching that wasn’t finished off, shower missing a piece to prevent water from running out, AC went out twice (fixed before we knew it once and the other within 60 minutes.). Housekeeping didn’t come reliably…sometimes morning, sometimes evening, sometimes not at all.  It was still comfortable and very nice, just not what we expect to see at a Melia resort.

reviews.author: RS
reviews.text: I especially enjoyed my meal at la Flora the diminican restaurant. My host Ceasar was very attentive and was very informative about the wonderful meals. He treated us with first class service.  He was a wonderful host. I recommend this restaurant very much!! 5 stars. Try the platano flower it's to die for!

reviews.author: Hoa Nguyen
reviews.text:
We have been enjoyed the resort a lot for the last 3 days. Food, service were excellent. The resort was a little bit quiet in low season hence we’ve got all the attention during our vacation. Highly recommended

All services are excellent. Concierge Franscico, bell service from Luciano, Jose were very good.  Service for Circle members are top notch!

reviews.author: Rylie Cranmer
reviews.text: I really enjoyed the service all over the resort! I cant believe how empty the gin ger bar was because the service was great! Ismael served us and our drinks were amazing. I would totally recommend coming here for your morning coffee.

reviews.author: Ryan Walsh
reviews.text:
I wanted to keep this brief, but it’s challenging given our experience. We stayed at the Paradisus Palma resort last week, hoping for a perfect BabyMoon, but encountered issues from the moment we booked the trip, including difficulties contacting the hotel, arranging airport transportation, and securing the correct room.

1. Calling the Hotel

Hotel employees hung up on me 5-6 times over two days. Despite being polite and calm, I couldn’t get clear information about the free airport transport promised through Expedia. They vaguely confirmed the transportation but couldn’t provide any details. Ultimately, there was no free shuttle, and I had to pay $40 to get there.

2. Anniversary Package Inquiry

When I inquired about purchasing a package to add flowers or drinks to our room for our anniversary, I was hung up on again. While I understand there may have been a language barrier, this was frustrating.

3.Arrival Experience

Upon arrival, our bags were dropped off at our room, but we received no tour, no concierge service, and no information on how to reserve dinner or where we could eat. The only person who offered help was trying to sell us a vacation plan in their circle lounge.

4.The Beaches

Tour sales guides were relentless, bothering us at our chairs, following us to the water, and even to the edge of the resort. While I understand the resort cannot fully prevent this, they could at least keep them out of the resort’s chairs. The salespeople called us rude for not buying their products, making my wife feel unsafe.

5.The Food

As Expedia VIPs, we were entitled to access two additional dining options. However, with no concierge to inform us, we only discovered this after two days of eating at the regular buffet. The food was mediocre at best (3/10), with multiple instances of finding hair in the food, and essential items (bacon, steaks, pizza) often not replenished.

6. Staffing

We had multiple staff barge in our room after only knocking once, (not enough time for me to get up off the bed to answer) and then would say sorry and continue on in my room to clean. I very much understand they are doing their job, but a bit of privacy would be nice.

6.Overall Experience

Despite the beautiful resort and fantastic rooms, the customer service fell short. Most employees were caring, and we spent over $300 in tips to show our appreciation. With a better customer experience program, this resort could significantly improve. Lastly, we  called the concierge line multiple times (no one picked up).

P.S. Special thanks to Jose, a customer experience manager, who found us on our last day. He was the nicest and most professional person we met, truly making us feel like VIPs. Thank you, Jose!

reviews.author: Bill Pepey
reviews.text: We had breakfast today at the Main buffet are at Paradisus Palma Real and it was amazing! Our waiters  were Ricky and Yineri. Great team! Their service was above  and beyond our expectations! Great team of workers!

reviews.author: Amanda Howe
reviews.text: I had the BEST time here! My friend joined me on a business trip and we hadn’t seen each other in 10 years! Alejandro at the hotel was incredible! He helped us find local restaurants- shopping- dinner reservations at the hotel and so much more! Alejandro helped us daily with anything we needed or had questions on. He was so patient, friendly, and a friend for life! Thank you Alejandro for making our stay 6 stars!

reviews.author: Tiana Key
reviews.text: Kicks Sports Bar!!! What an amazing staff!! From karaoke to dancing they provided an amazing experience.  The drinks came before we could ask and they all treated our group of 12 like.rock stars each and every night. Definitely spend some time here, get to know the staff because they love what they do!!

reviews.author: Sarah Chirico
reviews.text: Luis and Victor at the pool bar are the most amazing bartenders so friendly and fun we love them! Drinks were excellent!!!made our trip even better than it could have been at this beautiful place

reviews.author: Gabrijela Basic
reviews.text: Fior from Kicks sports bar made our vacation unforgettable! She is very sweet and makes the best Moscow Mules! My family will miss her!

reviews.author: A
reviews.text: Ate at the Blueagave twice during my trip. Food was absolutely amazing. Great service from Alexander B very helpful with the menu and great suggestions. Highly recommend coming here for dinner and asking him to be you waiter. Also as a melia club member we ate the Brisa’s member for lunch and breakfast. Food was amazing along with our waiter Jose Ramos. Such a nice person to talk to everyday!

reviews.author: Wendy Fierro
reviews.text: This review is for great customer service specially for Anthony who works at the coffee bar by the lobby. Anthony was super friendly and attentive. He offered us a delicious drink with Ginger. We told Anthony that we went on a tour the day before and we learned that Dominican Republic has a various kinds of mangoes season. He went and found us a delicious mango to eat in the same moment. Thanks Anthony for being so kind and fyi the Dominican Coffee is delicious!

reviews.author: Dan Lipson
reviews.text:
This was our second stay at a Paradisus resort (first was Cancún) and both were excellent. We didn't stay at the Reserve this time, and the only issue with that was that markings for what was "Reserve only" were unclear, and one of the restaurants that was listed as "adults only" was only for the Reserve. Not a big inconvenience, but being told to move your seating area or change lunch/dinner plans wasn't quite what I expected from a resort like this.

The staff was very friendly and the food was delicious

Samuel and Freddy led a wonderful ceviche making class with delicious margaritas!

Great activities and a lovely pool to enjoy after :)

reviews.author: Rafelina Collado
reviews.text:
I had an amazing time at Royal Service Paradisus Palm Real. The hotel was the perfect size. Not too big or small and you can see the beach all the way from the entrance. It is absolutely stunning! They greeted us upon arrival and walked us to a bar where we were served mimosas and a very nice lady explained the amenities. We were then introduced rob Kelvin our butler and this gentleman was our life saver during our stay. He secured dinning reservations and was very informative. He pretty much did everything for us during our stay. He was amazing. The butler idea is a great one.

The food was great! I enjoyed the Mediterranean restaurant and Peruvian Rest the most. The adults only section is nice to have for quiet time. This hotel has it all.

Cons: the only con I can find is that the room smelled a bit moist. But it was tolerable.  I will definitely return.

reviews.author: Luke Moczydlowski
reviews.text:
The resort looks like it was remodeled recently so we really enjoyed it. Our room and all common areas were beautiful. The staff at the buffet could use a smile and some hospitality training. However, Luis, Walquiria, and Jose at Ginger Bar were excellent and made up for the lack of positive energy from the staff at the buffet.
Our 4 and 6 year olds loved the kids club which gave us a lot of needed adult time to unwind. Overall we really enjoyed our stay.

reviews.author: Kelly Moore
reviews.text: Paradisus was truly paradise. We had a wonderful time here. Service was incredible and all the staff were so nice professional and helpful. Grounds and rooms were immaculate and the food was great! We cannot say enough good things about Gilberto and Arisleida at the 90 Degrees bar. They were both so nice and we came everyday just to see the both of them. We were so sad to leave the resort because we were leaving them too, they felt like family by the end of the trip. Both Gilberto and Arisleida went out of their way to make our stay special. Gilberto made specialty drinks with fresh passion fruit and we didn’t even have to ask for new drinks he was on top of everything. We loved Paradisus!

reviews.author: Christine McKinney
reviews.text: We could not have received better service! Antonio and the staff in the lobby bar were terrific. We were greeted enthusiastically upon arrival and taken care of throughout our trip. Great drinks and friendly smiles made for a great experience at the resort. Also the lobby bar is the best place to get your morning cappuccino. :)

reviews.author: Angela Walters
reviews.text: Raphael was phenomenal! He reserved the best beach chairs for us every day, and made sure we always had a drink in our hand. He was attentive, polite, and very personable. We really enjoyed getting to know him during our 5 days. Highly recommend if you're at The Paradisus Palma Real to look for Rapheal, you won't be sorry!  10 stars!

reviews.author: Grayson Higgins
reviews.text:
Incredible resort! My wife and I came here for our honeymoon and we highly recommend it! True paradise especially if you upgrade to reserve status. All of the staff is incredibly polite and friendly!

I would definitely do the mixology class at Flora’s bar with Jensy. He crafts custom cocktails and they are incredible and you learn how to make them yourself!

reviews.author: M G
reviews.text: The resort was very quiet, rooms were clean with upgraded finishes. Swim up rooms with concierge service are worth the upgrade. Felix (our concierge) pre-booked our restaurant reservations (highly recommended vs buffet, food is miles better) and kept on top of our needs. We travelled here with our baby and he was able to arrange extra water (5gallons actually) and followed up every morning/evening. Outside of the concierge, overall service was good at the resort.

reviews.author: Kyle Mauch
reviews.text: Maximo and Jhonathan were incredible at the winery. Easily the best service and food we had. My only regret is not going multiple times during our trip. Highly recommend reserving an experience here as soon as you check in.

reviews.author: Janet Fleitas
reviews.text: The Blue Agave was an Excellent restaurant, the food was amazing. Gorgy the waiter was extremely attentive always making sure if it was anything else we needed. They got what the kids wanted. Milton the supervisor was also making sure that we were satisfied with the service. I will definitely recommend it !

reviews.author: Courtney Rickard
reviews.text: The service was amazing! So friendly and welcoming. We went every single night to talk to the Luis and Violorio the bartenders! Made the whole trip!!

reviews.author: Shaun Milmore
reviews.text: Buffet had great selections every day. Not sure if the ice or tap water was making us a little sick. Resort was gorgeous, staff was super friendly and spoke English really well. I could spend weeks there with the night life and activities they had at the resort. I would highly recommend if you want to eat at specific restaurants to book early. They are all delicious but book up really quick. If your going to do excursions, the better experience is with the top end attractions. Over all experience was excellent!!

reviews.author: VFM
reviews.text:
My daughter and I went to The Paradisus Palma Real Golf & Spa Resort from 1/8 to 1/12. What a wonderful stay we had. The property is beautiful! We stayed in a ocean front Nikte Junior Suite, a great room with amazing  views. We did have an AC issue where the vent was dripping but we were quickly moved to a new room where the view was even better!
We appreciated our Concierge Irvin Nolasco! He was very attentive with exceptional customer service. He made all our dinner reservations, checked in with us every morning and the provided activity schedule daily. I could not get through to our transfer service for our return flight but Irvin was able to contact them and verify our pickup time. He made our stay that much more enjoyable. Thank you Irvin!
The food was very good. The only restaurant we didn't care for too much was Tokimeku, we weren't too impressed with the quality. The Hibachi side of the restaurant was great so I would suggest that side versus the ala carte side. We really enjoyed the daily buffet for breakfast and lunch, the food was fresh with a lot of variety. Our favorite wait person was Yanira Sosa Santo. She was always cheerful and full of smiles!.
I would highly recommend The Paradisus Palma Golf & Spa Resort. Beautiful and great customer service!

reviews.author: Darla Manguerra
reviews.text:
We had a very swiftly check-in process at The Reserve. Christopher gave us a very warm welcome and discussed all the details we needed to start our vacation. We met our concierge, Dalmis, as well and he showed us around the resort then to our room. We were very fortunate to have Dalmis only a text away when we needed help with something - from restaurant reservations to plaster for my wound. We highly commend Dalmis for his professionalism, thoughtfulness, and attentiveness to details. He is amazing and will always be one of the reasons why we would come back to Paradisus.

Ginger bar has been our favourite place to go to from breakfast smoothies after a gym session to mid afternoon coffee pick me ups to cocktails all throughout the day. Ismael, Maria, and Antonio have curated us (and I say this with full confidence) the top 10 drinks we've ever had. Marc and I travel a lot and we've met quite a few bartenders, and they definitely are exceptional. Together with the rest of the personable staff of Ginger Bar - Dominga, Clary, Olga (always smiling and greeting us throughout the day), and Criselda (who interestingly have a few cocktail recipes up her sleeve). We highly commend all of them, and we will always go back to Ginger Bar. Such an amazing atmosphere and incredible staff.

reviews.author: Tiffany Korb
reviews.text: Had the most delicious and wonderful experience tonight. The service is spot on spectacular and this is coming from someone who grew up in the restaurant industry. Wish I lived here cause I would spend all my money on the roasted octopus cause it’s that delicious

reviews.author: M M
reviews.text: Ricki, Lydia, Pierre,  and yineiri at the Lunch Box were extremely attentive to our needs. Always serving delicious food with a smile. There was another gentleman that was deaf. That was always looking after us with the smile, and offering to do whatever he could with whatever he understood from us. Special people  like makes you want to tell the entire world Authenic superior service displayed by the staff. Love this place 🫶🏽

reviews.author: Dan Smith
reviews.text: Such a wonderful place! The atmosphere was exactly what you need for a romantic night. The food was awesome, but the staff was even better. Marian, Eduardo, Jose, and Pamela were amazing. Our glasses were never empty. If you come to Paradisus Palma Real definitely go to Sante for a dinner!

reviews.author: Brianna Jones
reviews.text: We had an excellent time here! The concierge service was splendid. We were privileged to have Starlin Tavarez as our  concierge, and he did an amazing job ensuring any minor problems were sorted out. He even had a surprise cake made for my Mom’s birthday and surprised her at the restaurant! Overall an amazing trip!

reviews.author: Keith Lowhorne
reviews.text: Fantastic dinner at Blue Agave. Jose took great care of our family. Daughter in law wanted some mango. None at Blue Agave. Staff went and found her a plate of fruit. Definitely recommend.

reviews.author: Megan Ford
reviews.text: So helpful! And best service!!!! Luis, Fior, Altagracia, and Rosario the boss at kicks is the best!

reviews.author: Susan Daughtridge
reviews.text: Alexander Bryan and Fausto were my servers at Mascalzone and Blue Agave and they paid great attention to detail. They even called me by name remembering me the next day I returned. Eduardo assisted me at Flora and was very attentive and kind. At the pool, Teofilo, the bartenders, and beach attendants were amazing as well! Franklin from Guest Services and Patricia from Premium Moments were super sweet and offered me a discount on the spa. Overall I enjoyed my stay at Paradisus Palma Royal and had a relaxing trip. They offer top notch service and hospitality!

reviews.author: Devin Lee
reviews.text: This is an amazing place to enjoy DR hospitality! My wife and I celebrated our anniversary here and every restaurant was great, but the staff at the Ginger bar was the best! From coffee in the morning to cocktails in the evening…fantastic!! Ismial and the morning team makes the best cafe’ con leche! If you love a great Tito’s and Club Soda or an ice cold shaken lemon drop this is your spot!!

reviews.author: Jens Benneker
reviews.text:
Dinner at the Restaurant "Mascalzone":
We had a great dinner with a delicious dessert as the special final. Our colleagues Fausto and supervisor Milton were very nice and could explain us everything about the food and drinks.
All in all a great evening in the Restaurant Mascalzone 😃

reviews.author: Susan Gitman
reviews.text:
Yafreisi soler y jeison was an excellent server providing great professional service always with a smile and readiness to help. We really enjoyed her helping us!

Teofilo pool bar service person has been excellent in serving us with beverages throughout our stay. He kept checking in with us througout the day at the pool every day of our stay. A very professional and friendly person

reviews.author: Christina Botelho
reviews.text: We had the best 4 days ever! The service was exceptional, and the resort itself was beyond beautiful. The grounds were spectacular and so clean. The room was one of the best we have ever had. Lastly, the service was phenomenal. Such amazing people. Can't wait to come back with our kids!

reviews.author: Maryam Ahmad
reviews.text: The service was great. Alejandro (happy boy) provides great service and entertainment. Robert the bartender and Ivelisse the bartender were great, always happy with smiling faces and around to help always. The restaurants had bad food, not all of them were open and the quality of food was not good. The rooms are not cleaned regularly, we had to ask to clean them constantly. We arrived and had booked the reserve but got moved to a different hotel despite emailing and calling to confirm the hotel prior to arrival.

reviews.author: Elvin Rosario
reviews.text:
Flora restaurant is outstanding. Ceasar is an outstanding server. Goes above and beyond to make you fell special as a client. Five star service.
Sports bar kicks. Andrina and fiol. Did a great job. The service was excellent. Always had a drink in my hand. Give these ladies a raise for outstanding service.

reviews.author: Giselle Hinojosa
reviews.text: This hotel is so wonderful. It is beautiful all around, and there are so many great activities to keep you entertained. A favorite of ours is the pool areas, all of which have a bar that is easily accessible whether you’re taking a dip or just relaxing in the area. The staff are all really friendly. Special shout out to Jorge Rafael, who helped us find the activities, such as wine tasting and cocktails class, and to Ariseida Perez and everyone at the 90 Degrees bar at the pool! Would highly recommend to anyone planning a stay in the beautiful Punta Cana.

reviews.author: Maureen Coleman
reviews.text:
Stunning resort! Incredible service - BIG THANK YOU to Kelvin for taking such good care of everything.  Also, shoutout to Pedro and Rafael at the Reserve beach for a beautiful beach experience.  You guys rock!
Flora restaurant was truly delicious - but all the food was good.  Thank you to all the Reserve staff!

reviews.author: P C
reviews.text:
We stayed at this location, October 23 to the 28th for a family wedding. Although the property is nice, the customer service and maintenance department are absolutely terrible. Our family wedding was Thursday the 24th and our section of the hotel lost power. One hour before the wedding . A lot of the ladies in the wedding party arrived late because they could not properly get ready. No power. Eventually power is restored around 5 PM as a result of the power loss. Conditioner also started to malfunction .
They reprogrammed the air conditioner and we thought OK. The next day we went on an excursion. Came back the AC was broken and our entire hotel room Water all over the floors due to the ac issue.  We went to front desk and asked for additional towels to be dropped off to our room while at dinner so We could mop up the floor and prevent Any issues from falling which the wet floor Produce.  When we got back from dinner there were no towels provided.The next morning, we went to the hotel front desk and asked To have our changed Due to broken AC and flooding. They told us to come back at 8:30 which We did, however Have any solution to offer us? We asked to speak to supervisor and they said they had already spoken to him And that he was working on it. The supervisor never came to greet us and show any empathy towards our issue. We were told to go back to our room pack our things within 10 They would take us to a new room.
We eventually got our room and hopeful, we can Day of vacation with family. I highly advise you to avoid this property their customer service and management. Are a joke.  The front desk staff on Saturday, October 27 Carlos and Nathaniel were completely incapable to provide any solution or empathy, additionally the supervisor on duty, Carlos, but we never met Should also be reprimanded For a terrible lack of customer service. Do not choose this location as you’ll be very disappointed by
The lack of quality service and value you’d receive.  zero stars To the individuals listed above, shame on you!

reviews.author: Doug Lind
reviews.text: Walking into an Italian joint on the beach in Punta Cana may not be the normal expectation, but the food was good, and the tiramisu most excellent!  To top it off, the service by Milton and Yessica was superb. They went over the top to ensure this guest had a great experience!

reviews.author: Brody Young
reviews.text: Saylis is a very personable and friendly server at the Ginger Bar.   She made us feel welcome and shared about her hometown and the Dominican culture.  Truly made us feel like family.  Thank you.

reviews.author: John Fitzgerald
reviews.text: Have had an amazing time!! Ricki has been very attentive and made sure all of our needs were met. Went out of his way to get my wife almond milk since she can’t have dairy. Lennison was extremely helpful when we needed to move rooms and helped with our bags. Katherine helped us move rooms when we had a disruptive neighbor. Flora restaurant was our  Favorite experience for dinner, Nahomi and Franklin were very attentive and we never had any time without the things we needed. The salmon and the jerk chicken were delicious. The Japanese restaurant was a fun experience with delicious food! This resort has not disappointed. My wife was well accommodated with her allergies and everyone took great caution in what she could and couldn’t have!!

reviews.author: Richard Abramowitz
reviews.text:
Just had dinner at Mas Calzone restaurant at the Paradisus resort. Excellent service by all the staff and especially Yenseen our waiter.  Great entrees and apps. Very nice ambiance
Sitting at the ginger bar with Antonio and Ismael having Cappucinos and pastries.  Great place for a snack and drinks. Service is fantastic.
Had dinner at the Winery tonight 2/6.  Jonathan was our server.  Great wine. Great dinner and service.

reviews.author: Kevin Frazier
reviews.text: Rosanna Hernandez and Yanira Sosa were serving our tables at the Paradisus in Punta Cana DR, and they were excellent and very attentive to our needs. We never had to chase them.  They were always there ensuring that we had what we wanted or needed. With their service, they made dining a pleasure and enjoyable At the a Paradisus.

reviews.author: Milane Huguet
reviews.text: Jordania was an amazing host of the hotel. She offered great services when booking our reservations for dining, connections with excursions and any help we needed during our stay with anything related to the hotel and their services. Always had a smile and ready to serve.

reviews.author: Christian
reviews.text: We had a wonderful time at Paradisus Palma Real. We spent the most time at the Ginger Bar, which offers great coffee and drinks. The service was especially great.    Olga, Antonio, Ismael, Clari and Magda were amazing servers, we appreciated their hospitality.

reviews.author: 박시은
reviews.text: Best service ever! Especially Italian restaurant. Service was so perfect. Waiter and the chef were so caring and kind. Food was really nice. I recommend the white pasta and octopus. Special thanks to the supervisor Milton!! Thank you for making our night wonderful :D

reviews.author: K Kandyba
reviews.text: This is the third time we stay at the Paradisus Palma Real.  We stayed at many resorts, and we absolutely love this one.  Our concierge Yinesca was so kind, attentive and available. One of our favourite places to have coffee in the morning and a cocktail before dinner is the Ginger Bar.  The coffee is delicious and made to perfection.  The staff are so courteous, kind and always smiling and willing to help. Antonio and Ismael were amazing. They start making your coffee when they see you walking in!  Whether you want your coffee with soy or lactose free, there are many possibilities.  In the evening, Luis prepares your drinks at the bar while maintaining a huge smile, despite the number of people waiting!   There is different live music in the ginger bar every night.  We stayed at the adults only reserve section, which was amazing and there you have access to Sante, its own wonderful restaurant.  I was so impressed with Juan.   He remembered from day 1 my lactose intolerance and was concerned after seeing that I had ordered some pasta with cream.    All other waiters at this restaurant are fantastic including Misael. Rooms are clean and beaches are impeccable.  The three 9 hole golf course is a nice and not very challenging one but a bit pricey for what you get.   You can bring your tennis rackets (and pickle ball paddles) because there are tennis courts available.

reviews.author: Jean-Simon Côté
reviews.text:
Restaurant Mascallzone (our first dinner)
Waiter Raider was awesome and polite!
Supervisor Milton was polite and friendly!
Food was excellent! Service was great!
Second night was another thing.. food was cold, asked for champagne two times, because we were celebrating the 40th anniversary of my parents and nothing, no one came to have this request filled .. what an experience..

Staff is nice on site! Available and polite and very funny with children! Our concierge Harry was just ok.. Best advise I could give is always follow up your request or you should get a surprise..

Room are great BUT you can perfectly hear what’s happening in the other room, which sucks for a 5 stars hotel… Should not be tolerated..

Food is good but never hot at the buffet :(

reviews.author: Lyndi Hawn
reviews.text:
My husband and I took a sushi making class with Jovani & Brandol. It was so fun and we learned a lot. We each got a turn to make our own roll. They were very patient and friendly. I would highly recommend it!

We also did a pizza making class. The staff was very helpful and engaging. The pizza was delicious. Brandol, Danyelo, and Chef Miguel were awesome!

Our week stay at Palma Real was absolutely amazing! By far this hotel has the best beach and location. My husband and I walked up and down the beach and this location was our favorite. The beach was beautiful. The hotel grounds were kept clean and tidy and the staff was incredible. Our concierge, Starlin, was the best! He booked all of our dinner reservations and made sure we always had what we needed. It made us feel very special and taken care of. Our room attendant was wonderful too and kept our room very tidy. We loved the Plaza area and the live music and entertainment each night. The food and variety of restaurants was great. Try the cake in the buffet. Our favorite dessert! We would definitely recommend this resort.

reviews.author: lydia meneses
reviews.text: Yamilet at Blue Agave,  was amazing very quick knows everything very well, friendly with kids, brought the dinner out. one of the best restraunts in the hotel.

reviews.author: Brian S
reviews.text:
I had the pleasure of working with Luis Cadet as my vacation concierge while visiting Punta Cana, and I must say that he truly exceeded all my expectations.

What sets Luis apart is his unwavering commitment to ensuring his clients have a seamless and unforgettable vacation. He was always accessible, responding promptly to any queries or concerns. Moreover, Luis's warm and friendly demeanor made the entire trip enjoyable.

Thanks to Luis Cadet, I had a vacation that exceeded my wildest dreams. I wholeheartedly recommend his services to anyone seeking a top-notch vacation concierge. Luis's expertise, dedication, and personalized approach make him a true gem in the world of vacation concierge’s.

reviews.author: Gretchen Turner
reviews.text: We were taken care of from the time we got off the bus. The staff was wonderful, the accommodations far exceeded my expectations, and Samuel was an awesome concierge.  He took excellent care of us. The only issue was the wait staff at the Gabi restaurant. The were not as attentive as the other restaurant staff. Overall, I would highly recommend this resort to anyone vacationing with a large group or individually.

reviews.author: Barb Zola
reviews.text:
The staff at Between is absolutely amazing. Friendly, knowledgeable, and smiles at the ready! Our pool barman is the best!

UPDATE 13MAR

As my initial review was a bit rushed and incomplete, I am now taking the time to provide a more comprehensive review.

I initially spoke of the staff at Between, I was specifically referring to Miguel and Ruby. They made our evenings enjoyable by providing a ready smile, quick conversation, and well-poured drinks.

I am confident that Miguel will complete his English studies and be a bigger asset to the Milea family. He is friendly, has already made use of his skills, and has that flash when preparing a drink.
Ruby is already a major asset to the Milea team. Quick to stand up for her customers when glassware supplies are low (the restaurants were borrowing glasses even though Between’s supply was perilously low) yet ready to offer a smile and drink suggestion at the drop of a hat.

Our ten-day stay was in building 50 and while we started the week at the main pool with Milagros and Julia, we usually spent our afternoons with Edikson and Julia at the building pool. Edikson introduced me to the CocoLoco and it quickly became my go-to choice while T.H. gravitated toward the dark rum, pineapple and lime juice. Julia delivered quickly and returned often to make certain that we were well hydrated!

Speaking of hydrated…we appreciated Edikson’s provision of water when housekeeping was unable to fulfill our 4:30 pm and 9:00 pm requests (on the same day) to fill the mini bar.  Guest services did bring us a handful of water and beer that evening which was much appreciated.

Delvin was a joy at Blue Agave as were Melvin, Junior, and our drink server (for the life of me, I can see her but never jotted down her name).

At the Ginger Bar, Ismael and Daniel stood out. Probably because we were there at quieter times and could chat with them a little longer. This was our second most favorite place to visit for drinks as they were consistently delicious.

Many times the “pop-up” bars were over poured and undrinkable or we could not explain exactly what we wanted because of the language barrier.

Because we arrived mid-week, we were greeted by an alternative concierge, Juan, as Alejandro had taken time off to be home. Juan was gracious and checked in with us Thursday and Friday to make sure things were going well and that Alejandro would be in on Saturday.

We did meet with Alejandro Saturday and understood that he had other patrons as well and was typically busy; however there were key items such as reservation requirements, general availability (WhatsApp is not as good as face to face), and his lack of follow through on catching up with us after the first introduction that was frustrating.

Otim provided great options for excursions and we took the opportunity to go off-site for a partial day snorkel, swim, and party! Transfers were also an option we took and it was Great!!

We ate daily breakfast at the buffet and we were rarely disappointed. Again, the majority of the staff were competent in basic English; however, there were times that the language barrier was difficult to penetrate, but everyone was super friendly and most generally a smile and ‘gracias’ did the trick.

Overall, we had a great experience and will return to say hello to our new friends.

reviews.author: Cassandra Howard, MD
reviews.text: Dinner tonight at Mina was amazing. The wait staff was prompt, professional and met our needs. The food was fresh, hot, and very well seasoned. This has been our best meal this week at the Paradisus Resort. Many thanks to Jose, Olvi, and Kevin for giving such excellent service.

reviews.author: Ricky Fernandez
reviews.text: We were blessed enough to be able to come here with my girlfriend’s company. Once we made it here the experience began and let me tell you, AMAZING! The staff in incredible and the rooms are well stocked and tended to. I highly recommend anyone come here be transported to paradise.

reviews.author: Angie Osinkosky
reviews.text: What an amazing resort! The staff is attentive, friendly, and extremely efficient! The resort is beautifully designed, tastefully decorated, and kept clean and well maintained. I highly recommend the Paradisus, and don’t miss the coffee bar as well as the Tokimeku restaurant with Victor as your chef!!

reviews.author: tristen rodela
reviews.text: Everyone here was wonderful! Very helpful and were always on hand when I needed something. The sports bar KICKS was super lively and the manager Luis gave outstanding service making my trip very memorable 10/10 - definitely will be coming back!!

reviews.author: Wanda Harris
reviews.text:
Milton was exceptional!
He was our waiter last evening at Mina.  His service was impeccable.  Today, he directed us to a other restaurant where we were privileged enough to have him again at Kanna with Francisco!   I was impressed once more!  Superb!! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

My concierge Alejandro Gomez was awesome!!   He was our personal genie!!!   He so very accommodating and seamlessly, made everything possible! He was full of surprises!!!  We were very fortunate to have this experience here, with him!⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

reviews.author: Avi Patel
reviews.text: I had an amazing experience at this resort.  I especially enjoyed talking and getting to know the workers as they were very good and treated us well with hospitality.  If you come you need to visit the ginger bar where you will meet Luis, Jose, Lucia, and Altagracia.  They offer too quality services.  Overall this was a fantastic resort and experience!

reviews.author: Duanne Render
reviews.text: Staying at Paradisus Palma Real as a  Reserve guest was a fantastic experience. The biggest benefit was being able to dine at the exclusive Reserve restaurant, Sante, where the food was consistently great and the service by the best waiter at the resort, Juan was unparalleled. We WILL be back!

reviews.author: Ron Oakes
reviews.text: Our last dinner for this trip and we experienced Flora.  Excellent food with a new and exciting menu. Attention to detail by the staff was very attentive with every course. We have vacationed here with Melia for many years. This is our third trip this year and will surely be another of many more. Thank you Paradisus & Falcon.

reviews.author: Laura Casper
reviews.text:
Ramon was the best!!! He took care of us every time we went to the beach and helped us out of a sticky situation with one of the many vendors.
Some staff were friendly,  but others just looked at you like you were inconvenience them and said "no". Very few spoke any amount of English, so when you tried to get help or ask a question you couldn't get help. I understand that we are in a different country, but when it takes 15 minutes and 3 people at the front desk to understand you are locked out of your room, that is a problem.
The food was not good, or hot. Everything was mediocre to be generous, and cold to warm, except the steak house. One of the hostesses harassed me to review, then grabbed my phone and was hittingv5 star on everything.  I grabbed my phone back and told her I would review later.
You are constantly harassed on the beach by vendors.
Our shower didn't drain and flooded into the room. They said they fixed it, but didn't.
We had a huge pool of water from the bathroom to beyond the bed. They were in no rush to fix anything.  They finally did and i had them fix the shower again. We still had a puddle the next day, but just used towels instead of trying to deal with them.
Definitely not coming back.

reviews.author: Jonathan Sacco
reviews.text: This review is for the hydro grill only and my experience there.  The restaurant was nice, very good service and the portions were generous. The servers Ulisis and Kelvin were great and attentive through out the meal. They took care of the food restrictions our dining party had and went out of their way to ensure everything was correct. You could tell they enjoyed their job and interacting with the guests.

reviews.author: Regina Banovaya
reviews.text: The most amazing experience at kids club Paradissus Palm Real! Real gold hearted professional staff. They took the best care of my 6 year old daughter. They were always hands on, busy entertaining children (indoor and outdoor in the pool/beach. They will always take social place in my memories! THANK YOU ALL SO MUCH! Our special THANK YOU to Joanna🥰

reviews.author: Franzi Lestorti
reviews.text:
Check-in:
Check in at the reserve front desk was quick and efficient. We were then brought to our room (swim up reserve), which was beautiful, but instead of the king bed that was shown on the Meliá website, our room had 2 full beds. Not really what we wanted for the price! However, we were told that no king rooms were available.

Room:
Besides the mentioned bed configuration, the room was nice, however the AC couldn’t really keep up which led to the room having a damp feeling and slightly musty smell. The design is gorgeous and the patio very large.

Resort:
The resort itself is beautifully designed, but overall it feels like they need to prioritize maintenance a bit more (chipped paint, old grouting in the pool, cushions on beach chairs being very worn, etc).
The beach is absolutely wonderful and what was nice that despite the resort being booked, you could still always get beach chairs and beds.

Service:
Service was really hit or miss. Let me start with the concierge. When we arrived, we were told the concierge was gone for the day (late afternoon) and that he would reach out to us the next day. We never heard from him. After 2 days, our friends who were staying at the same resort, spoke to their concierge and he added us to his clients. He helped us with dinner reservations. One word of caution: the concierge will try to convince you to join a membership program, you will have to sit through a sales pitch to get a “free gift“. We politely declined but heard from other guests that the sessions take quite a long time and people are very pushy for you to sign up. Avoid.
Service in the restaurants was mixed. We had phenomenal service at Blue Agave and Mina, but service at Sante varied very much, but most times we were not even asked if we wanted coffee for breakfast. Beach and swim up bar service was good. We made sure to bring tip money and took care of our waiters.

Food:
The quality of food was not as high as I would’ve expected with such a high rating on Google. The food at Blue Agave was very good, Mina and the Italian place were alright. We were disappointed by Sante and the beach grill. Generally, we were surprised that there were no snacks being served at the beach or pool.

Conclusion:
Overall, I think that Paradisus is a good resort, but I would try a different hotel next time. For the price you pay, I would expect more attention to detail and better level of service. What surprised me were the many high reviews on Google, but we were asked multiple times by waiters to please leave a 5-star review on Google and mention them by name, because their bosses “were monitoring”, so I’m sure many people are trying to do them a favor

reviews.author: Alex Khodorov
reviews.text: The ginger bar service was excellent. Ismael, Olga, Nereyda, and Clary took great care of everybody and were very attentive. They were very pleasant and always smiling. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Scarlett Flaz
reviews.text:
Excellent place to vacation! Came here for just a weekend and wanted to stay longer. Food has room for improvement can but overall good experience. The place is very clean, rooms are very comfortable and there are many things to do during your stay.
The ginger bar was amazing! Fresh fruit juices and smoothies, great drinks and very nice staff. Special thanks to Antonio, Dominga, Nereida, Clari, Marino and Rosa for the great service.
Also thanks to Estafania, waitress from Flora; Miguel, Jimmy and Andri the concierges; Odelina the receptionist, who checked us in and out, very nice and informative.
There’s one of the waiters at the Lunch Box whom should be applaud for his costumer service, Jose if I’m not mistaking. He was very attentive and extremely nice!
Suzuki the chef at the Hibachi place and Darling, the waiter, made our Saturday night memorable. The DJ was very good, great playlist and a very nice person!
For the rest of the wonderful people there, thank you!

reviews.author: Kaitlyn Bryant
reviews.text: Brandol was the best activities host ever! He was very nice and welcoming to all guests. I enjoyed the pizza making class and the aperol spritz was amazing! Paradisus Palma Real is an exquisite resort.

reviews.author: Scott Meyer
reviews.text: We ate tonight at Blue Agave and had the  most wonderful service and meal! Virtudes took such great care of us, and we ended the meal with a delicious cappuccino. Just our first night and we cannot wait to experience more.

reviews.author: Mr. Nobody8020
reviews.text: Restaurant Flora is awesome, really made my girlfriend's birthday one to remember. Ernesto as our concierge has been wonderful for our whole trip. Rosie H. gave a fantastic overview of what "Melia" has to offer worldwide. We are so grateful to have had such a beautiful experience. 10 out of 10. The other restaurants on sote were delicious and accommodating as well. The excursions on site gave us a lot of choices for fun off the resort as well.

reviews.author: Melissa Sassack
reviews.text: The resort is very nice and newly renovated. The restaurants are very good and the buffet is good for all inclusive. Our room was cleaned everyday and restocked with plenty of water. The pools and beach were clean. I’ve been to Punta Cana 3 times now, and the guests/staff at this resort (compared to previous) spoke mostly Spanish, but we did fine without knowing much of the language.

reviews.author: Tony Leandro
reviews.text:
I had the pleasure of visiting paradisus palma real
We visited Flora and the waiters Stefanía was amazing she knew exactly everything on the menu and knew what to recommend us to eat . The manager Eduardo went above and beyond to meet our expectations . 100% recommend

reviews.author: Anthony Pardo
reviews.text: Very amazing hotel the staff are great especially the ginger bar amazing service from Miguel Luis V and Luis R great talks and drinks will definitely be visiting again

reviews.author: Brian Richards
reviews.text: This was our second trip to the DR, first to the Paradisus Palma Real resort. The experience here has been fantastic. Beaches are clean and facilities are all well maintained. Food is top notch!! Service is amazing!! Brandol Perez did a fantastic job leading the ceviche and margarita class with Engel doing the food prep. Wily Mercado from Guest Services has been simply amazing with getting things scheduled such as dinner reservations and spa days. All around extremely impressed.
