Every single staff member has been pleasant and extremely willing to help in any way they can. 100% would recommend coming here for your next vacation!!

reviews.author: David Duarte
reviews.text:
This is our second stay at Palma Real. We stayed for two weeks between November 26, 2023 and December 9, 2023. We really like the resort for its cleanliness hospitality, good food, spacious rooms and great customer service.
Both of our vacations at Palma Real were The Reserve upgrade. We like the personalized service given to us by the concierge. The concierge we had on this trip, Zenovia, was the best we have encountered. She was extremely friendly, hard-working, courteous and attentive. She knew what we needed and took care of what we wanted. Zenovia is in our opinion, the hardest working concierge at Palma Real, our hope is she will be our concierge on our next stay.
I would also like to extend our gratitude to all the staff at the restaurants who do a great job serving lot of people. We especially enjoyed getting our coffee every morning from the Ginger Bar and all of the staff there. The Ginger bar has the best coffee in the Dominican and the staff keep it very clean. Shout out to Ishmael, Natanael, Clari, Olga, Maria and Grey, many blessings to you.
Mina Steak House is our favorite dinner restaurant and Sante is our favorite overall restaurant. At Sante, Misael is a pleasant and thoughtful server, he makes sure that all your needs are met and greets everyone with a smile.
At Kicks Sports Bar, there is an happy, enthusiastic server who loves her job, Rina made my wife the best passion fruit and rum drink.
The cleaning staff of building eight especially the young lady who cleaned 8254, She kept our room fresh every day. It was so nice to come back to freshly mopped floors and and fresh sheets like a new beginning every day.
We were lucky to have two great concierge, when Zenovia had to leave Lewis De La Cruz took over and did a great job. He is very friendly and knowledgeable, he helped to complete our fantastic vacation.

reviews.author: Leroy Robinson
reviews.text: Everything here was great. We stayed on the Reserve side. The best vacation we’ve had thus far and we plan to return in January. Juan at the Sante’ restaurant was the very best and provided great customer service. I hope everyone gets to enjoy his professionalism. The food is great here too.

reviews.author: Kelli Huser
reviews.text: The staff at Ginger are the best. Ismael introduced us to our new favorite drink with lime, cucumber, and champagne. Other wonderful staff included Antonio, Dominga, Yeni, Clary, and Olga. They made us feel so welcomed, and the staff was very efficient.

reviews.author: A. Grimes
reviews.text: Rosanna and Marleisy where extremely professional and took care of all of our needs. They went above and beyond to make sure we was happy. I am very pleased with their service and I recommend them to all!

reviews.author: Edgard Rodriguez
reviews.text: Mascalzone restaurant was really good. Service was impeccable. Felix did an amazing job serving our table and making sure our experience was the best. Try the penne bolognese and the lobster papardelle.

reviews.author: Leanne Pereira
reviews.text:
The Winery at Paradisus Palma Real—
Juan, Maximo and Jonathan provided great service. They were attentive to our needs through dinner. The meal was delicious. It was the best dining experience we had this trip.

reviews.author: Atrin Khodadadi Fard
reviews.text:
We stayed about 12 nights at this resort! The food was good! Room was clean! The resort assigned a gentleman, Osvaldo Veloz, to us who answered all of our questions during our stay and helped us with any requests we had! He was awesome and did a wonderful job! He surprised me with a cake and champagne on my birthday, which was not expected and was really appreciated! We enjoyed their great service! The 24 hr food service was of a high quality! We had enjoyed service of two great waitresses at Kicks Bar, Andreana, and 90 Degree Bar, Aristolada Perez. Overall, we had a great experience and will definitely go back!
PS the only suggestion that would improve their great service would be more familiarity and fluency with English language as it was a little hard to communicate with some resort staff for non-Spanish speakers!

reviews.author: Stephanie Wilkerson
reviews.text: Vivianny was our waitress today and she was excellent!  Fast, friendly and a pleasure to have wait on us!  Everyone at the resort has been amazing to say the least!  Our bartender Anna was great too!

reviews.author: Hugo
reviews.text:
Without any doubt you should choose Paradisus if thinking to stay at Melia Resorts. Nothing comparable with the others, where i stayed in the past too! We stayed at The reserve area and is amazing, the service is fantastic! The beach area needs some maintenance as some sunbeds are damaged and does not represent the hotel itself. Martin has been our guy at the beach area! Always serving us with a smile and going an extra mile being a fantastic host at the beach!
Our concierge Osvaldo, really supportive from the beginning and proactive, attending all of our needs and keeping us updated with activities and making our reservations.
The food at Sante restaurant and the service there has been amazing, but food in specialty restaurants was really good as well.
We had dinner at Blueagave restaurant and from the moment we arrived and Laura welcomed us it was a nice experience! Our waiter Georgi was amazing as well!

reviews.author: Jacqueline Hagans
reviews.text: Great coffee and friendly service at the Ginger Bar at Meliá paradises Palma Real.  Antonio was always friendly and took great pride in the taste and presentation of his products.  The staff always kept the bar really clean.  We had Juan the previous day.  He made me the best macchiato I had before.  I love the chill vibe.

reviews.author: Apryl Donato
reviews.text: Beautiful resort with stunningly clean pools.  Staff was incredibly helpful and friendly especially Hector.  He greeted with a smile every time he saw us and many times with our favorite drink in hand.   Our stay was very enjoyable!

reviews.author: Alex White
reviews.text: Everything has been fantastic! The resort is beautiful. We so much enjoyed our stay!! The water aerobics were super fun. The instructor’s name was Jorge Rafael. Can’t speak more highly of him! Only good things to say!

reviews.author: Sadhia Santos
reviews.text: We had a blast! The hotel is beautiful and everything was perfect! Alejandro Gomez made it even more special, he always had a smile on his face and was also always willing to assist us! we felt as if we were home! Everything was clean at all times, food was delicious, it was the best vacation ive ever had, im looking forward to come back as soon as possible! Loved it!

reviews.author: LaQuanda Gilmore
reviews.text: Service was excellent! Victor Felix aka Kamasaki the chef was very engaging and provided excellent service. John Marte the waiter was on top of everything. Never had to ask for drinks and made the time here welcoming. Would highly recommend visiting the restaurant Tokimeku if ever traveling to Punta Cana in Dominican Republic and stay at the Paradisus Palma Real Resort. Nathaniel the concierge was phenomenal and attentive as well. 10 out of 10 recommended. Will definitely visit again.

reviews.author: Michele Owens
reviews.text: Rosanna our server at breakfast was wonderful. So very attentive. Friendly. Super accommodating. She was a pleasure to see each morning.  The team of Edito, Yesica, Nelson and Melvin were all terrific. They worked so well together and were always willing to please. Lo lunch box.

reviews.author: Thiago Rodrigues
reviews.text:
Concierge: Excellent, good job Gustavo! Very polite and kind. Always tilted to help us anytime. Score = 100 for you!

Customer Service (Restaurants/Bars - on the beach) - Takes around 1 hour to get 1 drink on the beach, if they remember I gave up lot of times when they started to forget my drinks. Also the restaurant on the beach the food was served cold, I wouldn't recommend.

Customer Service (Restaurants - Close to the main pool) - They are good, the food is good. The plus I would say would go for the Sushi Place. Also The pool restaurant sometimes I had misunderstanding with my orders but nothing bad, the food there was good as well.

Customer Service (Bars - Main Area, Pool) - In general, very good. Premium drinks, bartenders very kind. Extra points for that!

Towels (Pool Area) - Very difficult to get a towel, I think you guys should improve this point.

In General: In general I was a good stay but could be better. I would recommend!

reviews.author: Deborah Engle
reviews.text:
The Ginger Bar at the Paradisus Palma Real serves the best Dominican coffee at the resort! If you like fresh ginger, their coffee with ginger is a spicy & fresh antioxidant kick to your day! The coffee, smoothies, milkshakes, and bar drinks are fabulous. It’s across from the reception area & many don’t think to come upstairs to find it.
Spacious, beautiful decor, & friendly servers. A hidden gem in the property!

reviews.author: Claire Funnell
reviews.text:
Reserve Level - adults only.  This is great and quiet, both the beach and pool have excellent beds.
Resort very clean.
Most of the staff are helpful, English can be an issue but the staff we have found go and get others who speak English so it hasn't been a problem.
Sante restaurant food is fabulous and definitely the best.

reviews.author: Victoria Elkin
reviews.text: This review is about the service we got as soon as we got to the hotel on the first day. We came with a toddler and were told we can’t get the guarantee upgrade we paid for because we had a toddler, got a room in the last building all the way at the end, on the second floor with no elevator. Then after arguing with the supervisor we got a different room at 8pm on the third floor with no elevator. You can’t do restaurant reservations even if you go to reserve as soon as you get to hotel because they keep telling you there is no seat available. The buffet stuff don’t clean the tables on time and we were looking for available clean table for long time every day for dinner or breakfast, even cleaned ourselves few times. Over all would never go again, this is definitely not a 5 star hotel , not a 5 star service ! The reception personnel were very rude and talked Spanish btw each other and I found understand they talk about us.

reviews.author: Dennis Benigno
reviews.text: Alexander and Francis at Blue Agave are awesome and were fantastic to us! Food was great and we really enjoyed it! Rosana and Yonita at the buffet were amazing.

reviews.author: Nicole Cartee
reviews.text: Location is amazing. The beach is absolutely beautiful. The pools are well taken care of as well. The service is dependent on the situation and person. The food isn’t THAT amazing. If they could work on the food it would be a 4-5 star. Rina the bartender was great.

reviews.author: Sara Sule
reviews.text: Alexander Bryan was a standout server during our week. Very friendly and helpful and made our week much more memorable. Francis Javier is a great chef and made us come back for 3 nights for dinner. Marbin Luzon was outstanding as well. Our concierge Yaleidi Sims was very helpful throughout the whole trip and went above and beyond to make sure we had everything we needed and more

reviews.author: Ulrike McCray
reviews.text:
We came through RCi to Palma Real and are very positively surprised about the property, particularly its location, cleanliness of the suites and the whole property.
Most impressive though were the people and their service. Anybody from the maids cleaning the rooms to the people tending the bar, people like Maria, Virginia and Yensi made our stay very special to us thank you

reviews.author: Flo Rizzi
reviews.text:
I stayed with my husband and 6 year old son for a week. Such a beautiful and clean resort.

Beach days were made so enjoyable with the help of Raul. He had our seats ready every morning with towels. He took care of us throughout our entire stay. He is such a kind and attentive man, truly number one.

The kids club was incredible! I was so impressed by the facility and the variety of activities they did with the kids. My son begged me to go there everyday. Truly recommend families with kids, and to be able to have some well deserved adult time. Joshua and Joanna were so kind and patient. All the staff in the kids club are great with the kids, we always felt comfortable leaving our son there with them all.

Omar the bell man was so great, we had to switch rooms and he went above and beyond to help us get a new one. A man of his word. He is always on the go assisting guests with any of their needs.

The buffet is okay, food  needs some salt but the steak house, Mexican and Italian restaurant were amazing. Our servers Georgie and Fausto from the restaurants were always accommodating us and our needs.

The resort wasn't busy which we really loved. Truly a gem of a resort. We will definitely return!

reviews.author: Andy Lingle
reviews.text: Attended a make your own pizza and event and it was great. Pizza taste delicious too. Definitely recommend the resort and its restaurant. Danyelo and yency were great too us. Everyone was friendly. The sports bar, kicks, was great too. Yiri and staff was all helpful kind snd attentive. Franklin Yael santana in maintenance was great, he fixed our broken jacuzzi very quickly and great.

reviews.author: Lauren Bohac
reviews.text: We love staying at Paradisus. This is my third time here and the service and amenities are above and beyond. The pool and beach are the best quality. We LOVED our dinner at Mina, the steakhouse. We also loved seeing Joel all over the resort because he was so friendly and helpful. I will continue to come back to Paradisus

reviews.author: Ricky Ahuja
reviews.text: We went to the Italian restaurant and everything was exemplary. Food, drinks and service was amazing. Milton was an amazing host and Daniela was a great server who looked after us. Special shout out to Reynaldo

reviews.author: Darren Banks
reviews.text:
Awesome place. Probably the best value of an all inclusive resort you’re going to get. The views are unreal and the rooms are amazing. They have 8 different restaurants to eat at the property. I ate at 3 in which all 3 were great.

The ginger bar is at the lobby and they greet you the moment you walk in with wonderful drinks.

Hands down 5 stars. Also Osvaldo was my personal concierge. He’s undefeated in service lol.

reviews.author: Chirag Patel
reviews.text: Service at Kick’s sports bar with Luis and his team are great. Their attention to the detail is great. They are genuinely dedicated to making your vacation great. They don’t know the word no. Anything you want they are looking to make it work. Awesome..

reviews.author: Tanya G. Latcha
reviews.text:
I had a great time here!
The Kids Club was great. We love Joanna Santana...
We just upgraded  and will be back in August! Jorge Rafael was great in the hat workshop!
Also Luis Rodriguez was a great waiter at the buffet!!! Our concierge was great--we will be back!

reviews.author: Andrea Tambalotti
reviews.text:
Our recently renovated room was excellent. Very spacious, new and quite luxurious with a big living room. The food is very low quality, especially in the buffet, but also in the restaurants that require a reservation. And the system for those reservations is chaotic and badly organized (one evening we had to wait for 45 minutes for our table…). The beach is great, nice sand, nice see, ideal climate, but it could use being cleaned a bit more in the hotel section. The whole tiering system (Circle and Reserve, with some areas and restaurants exclusive to one or the other tier) is confusing and frankly seems like a misfire, as most of the exclusive areas appear empty.

Rosanna, Edito, Yorgelis at breakfast are very friendly and helpful. Thank you!

reviews.author: Jamie Pyron
reviews.text: We brought a conference with 200+ attendees here and it was challenging. The concierge service was not consistent for every attendee, there was a huge language  barrier with staff, our wristbands didn't work for our rooms on more than one occasion, it was very challenging  to reserve a restaurant on your own, the beach was uncomfortable with locals constantly hustling you for $$ with exotic animal pictures, excursions, jewelry, etc. Several attendees struggled with the balcony doors. If you close the balcony doors hard, they auto lock behind you. Four to five attendees were locked outside on their balconies and had to wave down staff to assist. Multiple attendees were double charged upon check-in, and have yet to receive a refund. Attendees complained constantly about the food, the menu never changed and the food was considered glorified cafeteria food. Melia app is unusable; it would be much better if it were redesigned to assist us without having to us staff for everything. When traveling, you don't want to have to interact with someone over everything. The biggest challenge was probably the language barrier. It was impossible to make it better with everything that went wrong because of the language barrier. The resort is absolutely beautiful, pools are amazing, nightly entertainment was great, but the challenges made the Beauty & food hard to enjoy.  Overall, I am consider myself highly dissatisfied.

reviews.author: Erin P
reviews.text: Had a great.time here, rooms were cozy, great views, restaurants were nice eve. Tho we didn't eat much, this property is huge and they have things going on every night for your entertainment, if you need someone to assist you get with Edgar he took on all of our needs and went over and beyond for us. He made sure our stay was very comfortable and easy going with his quick response time and he way around the property we couldn't thank him enough

reviews.author: Emma Lennon
reviews.text: This resort is beautiful, all of the staff has been accommodating and helpful. Special shoutout to the Italian restaurant. Milton, Braylin and the rest of the staff were informed on the menu, quick to serve and kind. My Mom and I had such a nice dining experience and we would highly recommend!

reviews.author: Sheila Douek
reviews.text: This place is an amazing vacation place! The beach, pool, coffe bar and restaurants were all outstanding. We had an exceptional experience at the Tokemeku restaurant, Santos the manager made sure the night went smooth with all our dietary needs, Frank was a great waiter and Jose the chef met all our expectations. We also celebrated a birthday and they really turned it into a festive night!! This is our second time at the Paradisus and we highly recommend it😃!!

reviews.author: Taylor Gorske
reviews.text: My family and I went to Sante for dinner the other night. It was our favorite restaurant in the resort. I had the lobster ravioli which was absolutely gorgeous, highly recommend that as a main. The ambiance was lovely and quiet. Perfect for a romantic dinner. Eduardo, Jose and Amanda took really great care of us and made sure everything was perfect. Definitely recommend stopping by here before leaving. X

reviews.author: Nicole Turrin
reviews.text:
Book this resort!!! After reading several reviews before leaving for the week,I was worried about how my boyfriend and I would enjoy our vacation. This resort exceeded our expectations, so much so we are  planning our return next year.
We had a Nikte Master suite swim up room - it was HUGE and newly renovated. Our room faced north east which meant we only got sun in the late afternoon. That being said our section of the resort was super quiet therefore there were plenty of sun beds in the opposite side of the semi private pool. This room came with an amazing concierge named Yaleidi Sims.   She was incredible in checking in with us, making reservations for restaurants (benefits to Nikte) and providing for any additional requests like bottles of wine and a lovely surprise cheese plate yesterday afternoon to make our last day extra special.
The food was great as well.  Both buffets offered enough variety that it would be hard to get bored. That being said, please do not expect high end dining at the restaurants. Mexican restaurants was excellent but the others ( we did not get to Flora) were just okay. Other reviews have had great things to say about the restaurants so it might be personal preference and who is in the kitchen that night.
The live music every night was entertaining and a great way to spend a few hours in the evening. There are a lot of activities during the day. Not my thing but they seem to have been well attended.
Because people all mention this there is little to no seaweed on the beach at the moment.
Staff are all terrific. Friendly and clearly working their butts off whether it was the housekeeping staff or the bar staff (visit the gin and tonic bar cart in the main square - really good cocktails)
Once again don’t hesitate to book the resort and if you can the swim up rooms are beautiful and a wonderful way to truly relax on your vacation.

reviews.author: Jessica Haynes
reviews.text: Rosanna was perfect! We never went without and she made us feel so welcome! She was the absolute best!

reviews.author: Julian Recio
reviews.text: My wife and I had dinner at The Winery. It was an amazing experience. Jhonathan and Maximo were extremely helpful and knowledgeable. They made good recommendations and made sure our experience was exceptional. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Riley Duyser
reviews.text: The staff is super friendly, food is delicious, most staff is bilingual so is gringos can get around super easy. Fernando is super helpful

reviews.author: Moreno
reviews.text:
We went (Myself and my family) to this Amazing resort to attend the wedding our friend's daughter and although we could have chosen a cheaper place to stay, we decided on the Paradisus as most of our friends stayed there too.
What a good decision that was.
We have traveled quite a lot and been in many 5 star resorts before around the globe but this one tops them all by miles.
We didn't find a single negative thing in our stay, none.
The organization of all of the events we attended was as precise as a Swiss watch. That included New Year's Eve, The Wedding, Night barbecue and the giant boat party to mention few.
Food was excellent and always available. The alcohol provided in the All Inclusive package was top shelf too.
Obviously, all of the above could have not have happened if not for the excellent service of the local people who where always ready to help with anything with a happy smile.
Because we stayed in the exclusive Royal Service area of the resort, we also had some extra service and facilities to use like private reception area with food and snacks always available, private pool, and fresh fruit in the room every day just to name a few.
The cherry on the cake it was definitely ARMANDO, our personal butler who made sure that every single day our stay was simply excellent. My wife enjoyed immensely the Jacuzzis he prepared after a long day out and before evenings dinners and events.
Thank you very much Armando because you made our stay an unforgettable one and we will definitely come back again.

reviews.author: Tiffany Hayes
reviews.text: I had a great experience coming to the DR for the first time. Felix Garcia was wonderful and made sure I was taken care of from anything I needed for my room to the surprise cake for my birthday. Liset was also wonderful coming and making sure I was set for the night and always gave me some chocolate. I highly recommend Palma Real to stay at. I will be back soon…

reviews.author: Sergio Perez Muniz
reviews.text:
Excellent hotel, excellent service.
Great for families.
Although the hotel is all inclusive, the food needs work in the buffet area and in the restaurants with the exception of the mexican restaurant which was up to the standards.
The server Sandra Lombo gave us the right choices but after I ate the barbacoa tacos I ask her if I can order more food and she said what would you like? I ask for the tacos Al pastor just because the tacos de barbacoa were so good, I wanted to try something else to see if the other were good as well. And they were as good as the first one.
After trying the Italian, japanese, steak house and the main buffet, the Mexican was the closest to the authentic Mexican cuisine.
Thank you Sandra Lombo for your service

reviews.author: Atilla James Ford
reviews.text: Paradisus resorts are a brand that I will always use because of their standards of high quality. I have stayed at Paradisus resorts in different countries and have always been extremely satisfied with my stay. Once again Paradisus Palma Real Punta Cana met my great expectations with the quality of the resort and the excellent service.  My concierge Claritzel was very friendly, helpful and extremely knowledgeable. Unlike most concierge who try to push the time shares on you, she made a great sales pitch but didn't over do it with unwanted aggressiveness which would have made it very uncomfortable. And by the end, I actually wanted to listen to the information because of her. She definitely is a very positive imagine of the hotel that I will definitely not forget. And when I come again, I will asked specifically for her.

reviews.author: Larissa P. Inacio
reviews.text: I stayed at Paradisus Palma Real within The Reserve services for 1 week. My concierge was Basilio and he was great during the week, being helpful and available whenever needed. Stay was great with minor issues/difficulties but so minor that it's not even worth commenting. Hotel activities are amazing, a lot of yoga, volleyball, artisan classes that make you feel relaxed. But here is a warning about THE RESERVE services: the concierge Basilio was the only good part of it. He was really great. However, the Reserve is supposed to be an exclusive service but it is not exclusive at all. The worst part is their restaurant SANTÉ which is supposed to be an exclusive restaurant for The Reserve guests but it is a chaotic restaurant with terrible food and service. This was the first time I stayed in a resort that the exclusive service was worst than the not exclusive one. The other restaurant (not exclusive to The Reserve guests, called The Lunchbox) was way better than Santé, in both food quality and services. Important to say that in one of the days I tried to had lunch at Sante, they didn't let me in saying my clothes were wet. I showed that it wasn't, that they were already dry and it was just an impression, but they still wouldn't let me have lunch. I wore the same clothes to go to the Lunchbox and I was treated really well. There is no exclusive services at the beach as well, you won’t be served or well treated unless you pay extra tips to the hotel staff. But didn’t I pay extra to The Reserve services already? I mean, it is a good hotel but I would never choose The Reserve services again. It’s unnecessary since other guests are treated same way or even better. Once again, this has nothing to do with the concierge, he was pretty incredible, I just don’t believe that The Reserve it's worth the price.

reviews.author: Rebecca Jessie
reviews.text: Our favorite restaurant at the resort was Blue Agave, the Mexican restaurant. The food was so delicious that we ate there three times in our week long trip. Our favorite plates were the pastor tacos and the mole enchiladas! As for Edito and he will make it an enjoyable experience.

reviews.author: Melina Gonzalez
reviews.text: I have had the best experience in this resort! The food is great, the staff is excellent and the restore itself is a dream. Kevin and Jael from the Italian restaurant were very nice. I would recommend and come back here many times!

reviews.author: Leilani Lagac
reviews.text: This place is gorgeous. Service is spot on. Staff is SO friendly. Jose Simeon our concierge is amazing. Immaculate cleaning. Food is phenomenal. Drinks are yummy. I couldn't be more pleased with our experience here. Definitely recommend and cannot wait to come back myself!

reviews.author: Christine Ortega
reviews.text: From the minute, we got there we had first class service. From being greeted in our bags taken to our rooms, to the checking in experience, to the food and restaurants. One thing I loved, was every buddy you encountered, had a smile on their face, was there to help you, not just there to help you, but happy to help you in the most genuine way. Our destination concierge, Aerol took care of every need, request, question, and reservations we needed. I can honestly say we had the best destination concierge ever. And if we ever go back to this hotel, I will request this particular gentleman has a concierge.

reviews.author: Sandra Lovric
reviews.text:
We have had an amazing time so far.
This is our first time to this resort and have already recommended it to our friends and family. Very clean, great service and food has been great!!
Thank you!
Definitely visit the Restaurant Flora. Dominican tradicional meals. Fantastic!
Ana-the hostess and Minerva our serve a pleasure to be acquainted with!!!

reviews.author: Charie Reyes Krieger
reviews.text:
The name speaks for itself, the resort really felt like paradise! My husband and I are so happy we chose to stay at Paradisus Palma Real for my birthday week vacation, specifically in the Reserve, adults only area.

Booking this gave us the pleasure of working with our personal concierge, Zenovia — she guaranteed we had dinner reservations every night at different restaurants (which is a must), readily answered any of our questions, helped us with all our transportation needs, and made my birthday extra special with all the surprises she had up her sleeve. We can’t thank her enough for the amazing and most stress-free stay! ❤️

Additionally, the room we booked was beautiful and cleaned everyday. Most of the restaurants were exceptional especially considering that this is an all-inclusive resort, our favorites being Sante (only for Reserve), Mina, Flora, and the Winery. All the staff we had a pleasure of meeting were all great. The services we got at Blue Agave on 03/20 (I believe our server’s name was Jorge) and at the Winery on 03/22 were amazing — shoutout to our servers! Shoutout also to Adrian in the swim up bar for making my delicious drinks and giving great service.

All in all, the stay was super worth it and we’re hoping to come back again in the future. In the meantime, we highly recommend this place 1000%.

reviews.author: kingsley edwards
reviews.text: Dalmis was our concierge and was amazing.  He made sure we had everything we needed and wanted!  Wanda at the poolside bar was so helpful and made the best drinks.  This was a dream trip and this hotel’s food and service was top notch.  I would come back here in a heartbeat!

reviews.author: Eric Johnson
reviews.text: Just ate at Mascalzone, very delicious and the service was even better. Our waiter was on top of filling our wine and we even added items to our order a couple times with no problems. Management was great too and checked on us several times during dinner. The food came out hot and above expectations!

reviews.author: Joyce R
reviews.text: Both my husband and I felt that the facility is beautiful and the staff are friendly and accommodating. Our room was large and comfortable, and kept clean daily. Our concierge Kevin was helpful and attentive. He got us into all our desired restaurants. Unfortunately, the food left a lot to be desired. We would have happily given a higher rating if the food had been on point. We will return and bring some friends, hopefully Kevin can oversee our next stay. We bought excursions from vendors on property. However, on our excursion to Saona island the bathrooms were in scarce supply and in bad condition. Since it was a 12-hour trip, we cannot recommend that one unless you have limitless bladder control. Further, don’t assume all the water on the excursion is filtered. We recommend the dolphin excursion, not too long and very fun!

reviews.author: Erin Thomas
reviews.text: Ralphy, our concierge, was absolutely amazing from the time we arrived to the moment we left. He took care of every detail as well as some surprises along the way for one of our daughter’s graduation and our other daughter’s birthday. The staff at Paradisus, Palma Real was the best ever. We enjoyed a once in a lifetime vacation. Rooms were clean, food was good, service was excellent. Wanda, our poolside bartender is the best of the best! Martin and Pedro gave daily excellent poolside service. We hope to return again next year!

reviews.author: Rainer Wellige
reviews.text: Andralina at the team at the Ginger Bar are amazing and go out of their way for the guests. Each evening she made us feel special.

reviews.author: Michael
reviews.text: Amazing time and experience. Everyone was very friendly! We were celebrating my mother in laws birthday and Milton and Fausto at the Italian restaurant  really made it special :)

reviews.author: Anh Nguyen
reviews.text: Flora and Sante restaurants are fantastic. We are pleased with people and their service. Everyone is very friendly and helpful. Had some confusion with the room but it was all sorted out. We feel super safe where we at. Will come back for sure.

reviews.author: Miguel Raya
reviews.text:
The resort was beautiful, massive and stunning. There was plenty of pools and beach options to relax in. What ruined the experience was the bad service,
harassment and food. We were being misdirected and told different things by the staff members when it came to making a reservation. We were told  at check in that all restaurants were available except the reserve restaurant. We came back later to talk to someone about making a reservation at the front desk. We were told only a few restaurants were available to us. If we “hooked up” this person, she would get us in the exclusive restaurants. This turned out to be bogus information for this individual to scam us for money. The resort will limit you to 1 reservation per day. In the meantime, you’re stuck eating atrocious food from their buffet, in room dining and bar section. Sometimes when you ordered a drink, it would be watered down. Expect to be harassed and bothered by their salesmen. I was insulted and harassed by Abraham because I declined to sit for 45 minutes to his presentation. What an unprofessional clown!  I came there to relax and be unbothered. The complete opposite occurred. No idea what he was selling me. Refused to provide any paperwork to verify any details. Others will walk by constantly trying to get you to say yes to their excursions. Along the beach, you’ll be bothered by street vendors. It is a beautiful resort that is severely flawed by the people who run the place.

reviews.author: Tracie G.
reviews.text: Fantastic location for a large group of friends or family to celebrate a special location. We visited with a group of 16 adults & stayed on the adults only area. The beach was beautiful & the views were amazing. Our concierge Zenovia was wonderful and helped us with every little detail. She made sure we had a very special experience.

reviews.author: Natalia Yaport
reviews.text: The restaurant Flora was amazing, Cesar was soo sweet and helpful. Franklin was so friendly and helpful as well. Hector was unbelievable friendly, very nice people love them all !!

reviews.author: Mark Evans
reviews.text:
We spend a week here in March with our family including 5 grandkids.   The location and beach are great.  (They did a good job of keeping the beach clean unlike some other nearby properties.).  The place is really beautiful and very well maintained (some renovations had been done last year).  The staff provided excellent service.  In particular Eriol Axil our concierge in the Nikte area was great and got reservations for our group of 13 at the restaurants as well as proving help with many other things.  Ask for him - he does an excellent job.
We had Nikte swimup rooms which were amazing.  They were very spacious and very well appointed.   The resort pictures are true to the reality!
Staff at the buffet were great.  The omelet station chef did a very nice job and we had great service at the Nikte pool bar from Julie Solano (such a pleasant and hard worker!) and Edickson
The location here is really superior since it’s right on the beach
Workers at the kids club were also outstanding.  So much energy and making it fun for our grandkids!

reviews.author: Joyce Hallisey
reviews.text: Could not have been  better.  Resort is beautiful with clean spacious rooms.  The food and beverages outstanding!  I cannot say enough about the staff.  Erol was our concierge and he went out of his way to accommodate our every wish.  Always greeted us with a big smile and warm welcome.  From Fabiola, housekeeping, Andy and Estefani all were wonderful!  Enjoyed Laura the hostess at the Italian restaurant.  Her smile and personality lit up the room.

reviews.author: Monica Andreu
reviews.text: We stayed as a family in the Nikte swim up. The room, amenities, service was excellent. But our vacation highlight was the service at the Ginger Bar. Antonio is above what customer service should be. If you visit this hotel, you must go to Ginger Bar and ask Antonio for a coffee or a cocktail. All the employees Dominga, Clari, Olga, Soranyi and Lisbeth were excellent too!!! Pretty amazing staff. The food at the restaurants is very good too…..

reviews.author: Jenn O
reviews.text: Blue agave restaurant was fantastic. Devlin was our server and he was superb! He made recommendations for our meals and they didn’t disappoint. This resort is beautiful and the staff are wonderful.

reviews.author: jay radia
reviews.text: Alberto and Leticia were fantastic by the adults pool section. Always active, dancing and singing and kept every glass full. Really appreciated the service.

reviews.author: Christian Solomon
reviews.text: Mr Whitmore was great, Ms Anna in room service,was excellent, and Mr John , and  Miquel took very good care of me and my family. The hotel is beautiful. I hope that you can update your handicap situation better.

reviews.author: Bobbie Frazier
reviews.text: Dinner at Mascalzone was great. We enjoyed the view of the open kitchen. The pizza was fantastic. My wife ordered the Antonia LaFaulsa tasting menu and enjoyed it, however her Snapper was slightly overcooked. I ordered the premium Lobster and while it was enjoyable and taster and a very fulfilling portion, it too was somewhat overcooked.  Service was excellent. Fausto was our server and was very attentive. Overall a very enjoyable evening.

reviews.author: lorena alcoba
reviews.text:
Great service! I had the best frappes and lemon drop martinis made my Olga at the lobby bar , and Luis made the best lemon drops Martinis ever. super amazing staff, they were very attentive, caring, and friendly. Definitely favorite place to get my drinks and coffee in the hotel.
Yiri from the kicks sports bar was amazing and super attentive !

The staff from the sante restaurant was awesome as well

reviews.author: Regina Gama
reviews.text:
Rooms were beautiful and spacious, and very, very, clean. The resort is beautiful!! Incredible views all around. Fabulous beach, comfortable loungers and never had a problem getting a palapa.
The water was so warm, both in the pools and the sea.
I was in the Reserve, but never received access to a concierge. We had face cloths on the first day only and never again. It took 2 days to get extra hangers. We only received turn down service twice in 7 days.
Restaurant service was hit and miss, depending on who your server was. Food was average at all restaurants except at Sante.
We liked the breakfast buffet and got the best service there.
Overall, the breads were terrible, but that's a good thing for carb-conscious people.
For an all-inclusive, it was acceptable.
We attended a wedding, and they had all the food outside, in the heat, 4+ hours before we sat to eat (not good for salads with mayo), and the white wine was warm. By the time we ate, the food was cold because the wind blow out all the candles heating the warm dishes. The good news is that the food was very tasty albeit on the cool side.

reviews.author: Shannon Parker
reviews.text: This resort was great! The service was phenomenal and it really felt like they cared about their customers. Ralphy was our concierge and he was BEYOND awesome! He made our experience so much better. Also, the food tasted amazing. Will be back!

reviews.author: Jean Luis Marrero González
reviews.text: The best bar and cocktails with a really great attention to detail and Dominican nights, the people is really great and welcoming. Specifically in customer service thanks to Jairo (el animal)

reviews.author: Selene S
reviews.text:
Restaurant Mina.   Great ambiance and exceptional service.   Food was delicious!!!! The presentation was exceptional!   The best meal we had all Week.  .  We had the potato and beef bomb and the cheese provoleta were outstanding.  For main dishes we had the Josper chicken flavorful, juicy and with a crispy skin!   Family ordered the baby back ribs and New York steak also raved about the dinner.  Thanks to Santo, the manager for paying attention to every detail to make
Our Time at Mina a memorable one.    A shout out to Alex, our very attentive server, who never let out drinks run out and even got rice from a different restaurant for us!

reviews.author: Dan Simone
reviews.text:
Chef Roberto at the Japanese restaurant was phenomenal. His skills and vibrant energy made our experience at the restaurant unforgettable!!

Bell boy service was one of  the best experiences travelling. Miguel, Luciano, and Richard went above and beyond to make our stay and logistics world class.

reviews.author: Pam Casaceli
reviews.text: We have never been to Punta Cana and so far we are very pleased with our stay! We got an upgraded room which we love. Our friends at the Ginger Bar. Have given us excellent service! We thank Antonio Domingo Olga Yenny Clari and Marino.

reviews.author: ivan j
reviews.text: Rosanna, Maria, Laicha offered great customer service. Great attention during our breakfast experience after our flight was canceled we were taken to this Hotel where we were awed with its beauty and cleanliness. Staff was awesome and attentive!

reviews.author: Inolia Notice
reviews.text: This place is excellent, my children and I had a great time. The kids zone was the best, the children enjoyed every programs  that they had for them.  The staff was amazing ( kelvin, Darlin, Emmanuel, Axel) and everyone else were awesome. The service was great. The rooms were beautiful cleaned every day, their bathrooms smelled so good and the food were delicious. My concierge made sure everything went well for my family. I would recommend  this place 100 percent for family good vacation time. We will definitely be back .

reviews.author: ajay san
reviews.text: The hotel is very good. The service is one of the best that i have ever experienced. I would recommend for anyone and everyone visiting Punta Cana to stay at Paradisus palm resort. My favourite place within the resort is the Kicks bar. They keep the drinks flowing. Stay in touch with the best waitress in kicks, Andreina.

reviews.author: Praxis Weston
reviews.text:
Juan Vicente, Brandol, and Jholfry Michael ran a very informative and delicious Rum Tasting at the beautiful Rum Republic Bar.

We had wonderful service at Flora served by Cesar, the food was wonderful and be sure to ask for the Mamajuana before your food for a lovely spicy local cocktail.

reviews.author: Yves Durivage
reviews.text:
Olvi served us a wonderful meal at Mina, the Paradisus steak house. The lasagna at Mascalzone was... so good. Thank you.
The employees at Paradisus are awesome. Let me highlight Anyela at the front desk and everyone at Santé.

reviews.author: Stephanie Hannar
reviews.text:
Our forth time to this resort.

The menus have been updated. We very much enjoyed our dinner at Flora tonight.  Felt like local authentic cuisine from the DR. A special experience vs. the usual restaurant offerings at an all inclusive resort.

reviews.author: mariela guadarrama
reviews.text:
The service at a Paradisus is excellent. The pools and the beach view is beautiful! Highly recommend for a family vacation or couple getaway!
The 90 degrees bar was so much fun! Excellent drinks and good music, they allowed us to make song requests. It was an amazing time

reviews.author: Amber Heim
reviews.text: We were originally scheduled to stay at the garden suites but when we arrived they put us at the Palma Real resort, which was newly renovated. We had a 2 bedroom swim up suite that was very nice. Property was well kept. Our concierge Raul Moya did a wonderful job by meeting with us; keeping us updated on daily activities (mainly kids stuff); making dinner reservations and attending to whatever else we needed. He was always checking in on us to make sure our stay was going well. Downside of the resort; not a lot of activities or things for teens (ages16 & 18) to do. There were no water sports included.  We thought we had access to the other properties on the resort which wasn’t the case. Food wasn’t horrible, but we’ve had better at other all-inclusive resorts. Overall, we had a great stay with very little complaints.

reviews.author: Marsha Alcoser
reviews.text:
Tokimeku great service with Santos and their team. Had a great time and great food. 10/10 recommend.
The spa services are amazing and the hotel staff makes sure to deliver a world class experience. You won’t regret your stay here.

reviews.author: Liam Sachs
reviews.text: Flora was the best restaurant out of all of them. The food was perfect and  service was amazing Bladimir was the best server along with glenny. John the chef cook the food perfect both times i went. Also the manager Ezekiel was very helpful and nice. The atmosphere was perfect and looks amazing.

reviews.author: Diana Munoz
reviews.text: The beach bar service was nothing short of exceptional, with Martin, Gilberto, and Frank offering a level of hospitality and attention to detail that went above and beyond. My mayordomo, Adrian Cabrera, truly elevated the experience, ensuring that every aspect of my stay was flawless and personalized. At the Sante restaurant, the service was flawless—Juan, Nelson, Lydia, Reynaldo Martínez, and Elvis created a seamless dining experience, delivering warmth and professionalism with every interaction. Their commitment to excellence made my visit truly unforgettable. Brandol from the catamaran tour was outstanding, and Jason from the entertainment team was incredible—his energy was contagious, and his talent behind the camera captured memories that will last a lifetime.

reviews.author: Angela Miller
reviews.text: The resort itself and the property it is on is beautiful. The rooms are nice and fairly clean. The service is not great. Most of the staff is not friendly. Simple requests can’t be met. Simple drinks that you get at resorts are unknown to the bartenders. The food is terrible. It’s either cold, not what is described on the menu, or just lacking in flavor. It seems the staff has not been trained properly. For such a beautiful location this resort could be so much more with better training and better food.

reviews.author: Nat Geissel
reviews.text:
Maria is great at Rum Republic. She makes the best Rum Old Fashioneds. Make sure to ask for her when you're there.

Dined at the Winery twice during our stay. Service from Maximo, Jonahtan and Juan was exceptional. Food was well-prepared and delicious. Great selection of wines. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Gretchen
reviews.text: Roberto was a great waiter. Great hospitality and great food.

reviews.author: Anthony Tran
reviews.text: We spent 5 days at the Paradisus Palma Real. Our room, Nitke Junior ocean front suite was amazing and in a great location. Our concierge, Luis Cadet provided exceptional service, showing genuine care and attentiveness throughout our stay. His warm and friendly demeanor made us feel welcome and valued as guests. He went above and beyond to ensure our needs were met and even offered helpful recommendations for activities in the area. Thanks to Luis's professionalism and dedication, our stay at the resort was truly memorable and enjoyable. We highly recommend him to anyone visiting Paradisus Palma Real.

reviews.author: lauren soto
reviews.text: The resort was beautiful and clean. All of the workers were friendly. A special shout out to our personal concierge, Dalmis Rodriguez who was beyond phenomenal and went above and beyond in every way to make our stay stress and worry free. Also, shout out to our swim up bartender Erickson who provided top notch service the second he seen us step outside our room to our pool.

reviews.author: Isaac Resek
reviews.text:
Rafael González the Restaurant General manager
And Jael made our trip absolutely spectacular
Their service Rafael and Jael gave me an my family was way above expectations he was always
There to make our visit to all Restaurants in the resort.
Thank you for your excellent service
We stayed in an Ocean Biew Suite and the view was spectacular

reviews.author: Jon Jones
reviews.text: I just had to reach out and let you know that Arismendi Jean absolutely shined! My wife and I came to your resort for the first time and this gentleman made the whole trip the most amazing experience ever for us. He went out of his way to make every dining experience or business meeting the very best and highest level of excellence you can achieve. He remembered us each night and every detail about what we enjoyed. This young man sets the bar high for every other employee you have. The resort was beautiful, your staff was superb and we especially are grateful for Arismendi Jean’s hospitality and professionalism. Thank you!

reviews.author: Monique Stevens
reviews.text: Yaleiidi made our experience amazing 10/10 I looking forward to visiting again soon! The special room decor for my friend 40th birthday was beautiful and thoughtful! Thank you thank you thank ♥️

reviews.author: Marlon Vergara
reviews.text: I had a great time at this resort. Francesca at Flora was extremely helpful and the food was delicious! To add, the hibachi at Tokimeku was the best experience accompanied by delicious food thanks to Felix and Jose.

reviews.author: DaVon Clack
reviews.text: Amazing trip for work! The resort is top notch. The food was great and the service was even greater! Dalmis Rodriguez took great care of me. He made sure I had the activities each morning and bath salts each evening 😀. I can’t wait to come back!

reviews.author: Dario Cintron
reviews.text: Ginger bar has the best cocktails!! Expressos martinis, coffees, smothies and ambience 🤩 Ismael, Olga, Antonio y Gladys are just wonderful employees, excellent customer service!!  Thank you this is our second time here and definitely will come back every year

reviews.author: Nick Costanzo
reviews.text: Dalmis was the best! He went above and beyond to ensure our complete enjoyment everyday. He made our trip to DR even more memorable. We love Dalmis!!!! Thank you so much DR and the Paradisus Palma Real!

reviews.author: Varun Rambhala
reviews.text: Amazing dinner experience at Mascalzone!  They took care of everything we needed. They took special care of our 2 daughters. The food was amazing!  Highly recommended and Milton, the supervisoe, and Fausto, the waiter went above and beyond for us.

reviews.author: Tom Mackenroth
reviews.text: We had Eriol as our concierge and he took care of all our dinner reservations and guided us towards the best tours. He was amazing to work with and made the stay super easy. Luis the best server ever, highly recommend him at the Kanna beach restaurant.

reviews.author: Ksenia D
reviews.text:
Pluses:
1. The hotel offers a fantastic kids activity room and attentive staff, making it an ideal destination for families with children.

2. There are ample day activities available for both adults and kids, ranging from engaging pizza making sessions to fun mixology classes. The boat competition for kids adds an extra element of excitement.

3. The restaurant and buffet crew deliver exceptional service, providing a diverse selection of dishes and ensuring a delightful dining experience for guests.

Minuses:
1. Unfortunately, restaurant reservations leave much to be desired. It appears that priority is given to certain guests, leaving others feeling neglected or overlooked.

2. On a concerning note, our initial experience with the baby crib provided was disappointing, as it was dangerously broken with screws popping out. This safety issue should be addressed promptly to ensure the well-being of guests, particularly families with infants.

Overall, while the hotel offers many enjoyable amenities and activities, there are areas that require improvement, particularly in terms of restaurant reservation procedures and ensuring the safety of provided amenities like baby cribs.

reviews.author: Maris Torres-Soto
reviews.text:
Beautiful place, with great service. I did the painting with Yovanny Rodriguez and it was a very nice experience. The food is amazing and I highly recommend this place for a nice relaxing vacation.

I also went to the Ginger Bar where the lobby is. Amazing environment, a great selection of drinks, and amazing service especially Ishmael, Antonio, Dominga, Olga, and Cri.

reviews.author: Lauri LaChance
reviews.text: Of all the restaurants Floras our favorite. Had dinner a couple times. Felix and Eduardo were fabulous. So attentive, warm and very fun to talk to.   Service was excellent and food outstanding!!  Try it, you will be glad you did.

reviews.author: Lauren Stark
reviews.text:
Franklin is the best at Sante restaurant and everything was delicious. This hotel is incredible. Misael was also absolutely amazing!

The pizza class at Mascalzone was amazing and Brandol & Danyelo were great! They are so welcoming and made our time so much fun. Chef Miguel rocks too!

Blue agave has some amazing traditional Mexican food. Laura the hostess went above and beyond for us.

It is worth it to go to the winery and spend a little extra money. Maximo and Jhonatan were incredible. We had the best wine and meats and they went to a bakery to find me an eggless dessert (I’m allergic to eggs). Amazing amazing amazing

reviews.author: Chris Stretton
reviews.text: We enjoyed all the restraunts at the reort which had incredible food. Our concierge, Yaleidi Sims, was so incredible the whole time. She made sure we had everything we needed and made my wifes birthday amazing!! She also made sure we were able to get reservations we wanted each night. Had an incredible time at our Bali Bed experience on the beach with Wilmer!! The service was excellent and we had a blast!! Thank you so much!!! Luis Garces was also incredible, thank you so much!!

reviews.author: Halle Absi
reviews.text: This hotel is amazing! Their service and employees are top tier! Arisleida, Jael and Sandra are the best! Blue Agave is the best restaurant with the best tequila. Arisleida was amazing our entire trip and accomodated all of our needs while at the pool. She is the sweetest employee we met! I will definitely be coming back to see her ❤️

reviews.author: Margaret Ricci
reviews.text: From the moment we arrived Anyela De Jesus was amazing and helped us with our check in.  She was so informative and really went way and beyond to help us.  She definitely is a hard worker and an asset to the hotel.  They are very lucky to have a great employee like her, hard workers are hard to come by these days. She was AMAZING!!!!! 💖

reviews.author: James George
reviews.text:
We recently had the pleasure of staying at the Paradisus Palma Real, and it was truly an exceptional experience from start to finish. The rooms were nothing short of amazing—spacious, elegantly designed, and meticulously maintained. Every detail was thoughtfully curated to provide the utmost comfort and luxury.

A standout aspect of our stay was the Activities team, particularly Brando and Jholfry. They went above and beyond to organize fun and engaging events that catered to all ages and interests. Their enthusiasm and dedication ensured that there was never a dull moment. One of the highlights of our trip was the painting session with Carlos. It was not only enjoyable but also a wonderful way to unwind and unleash our creativity.

The resort's beautiful surroundings, excellent amenities, and the warmth of the staff made our stay unforgettable. We highly recommend Paradisus Palma Real to anyone looking for a perfect blend of relaxation, entertainment, and luxury. Thank you for making our vacation so memorable!

reviews.author: Vinnie Posteraro
reviews.text:
The resort, beach, pools, and activities were fantastic! It’s a beautiful venue and beach. The customer service throughout the entire resort is world class. Mascalzones is an Italian restaurant that you have to visit and see Jael and Raider who will provide excellent dining experience.

Did a pizza making class with Danyelo and Franklin. They make the process seamless and fun!

reviews.author: Heather Sampson
reviews.text: We had an amazing trip at Paradisus Palma Real in the adult only Reserve section. They assign you a Consierge during your stay. We aren’t the type of travelers who would request a Consierge. But, at this resort, the Consierge can make or break your trip. We listened to other travelers complain about their Consierge as we checked in. We felt so lucky to be paired with Gustavo! He scheduled our dinner reservations each night, left wine in our room for us one day and had our room decorated for our anniversary and left another bottle of wine. We were very pretty low maintenance, but he was always available to answer any questions and reminded us to let him know if we needed anything. He even checked in with us while off of work! If you go to Paradisus, make sure to request Gustavo!

reviews.author: Daniel Picerni
reviews.text: We were lucky to get Fernando as our concierge. He took amazing care of us. This trip was for my wife’s birthday. Fernando helped me to book the best restaurant and make the day very romantic. “The best birthday ever!” Will recommend Paradisus and specifically Fernando to my friends and family.

reviews.author: maria pinheiro
reviews.text:
Breakfast and lunch service was excellent our waitstaff lead by Yanira was always friendly and accommodating for our party of 8.
Second time at this resort. Getting seating at night for a party of 8 together was challenging. Our concierge tried his best but we never got into the steakhouse Mina. First trip to this resort two years ago there were 6 in the party same problem with night seating at certain restaurants. The concierge that was assigned to us first day never contacted us we wound up with our friends concierge . Which he did try his best.
First day no hot water and TV wasn’t working. That was addressed and we don’t know who had been in the room to repair these items.
This trip my luggage was broken into nothing was taken but lock on suitcase was tampered with, reported it to the manager and security never got a response to what happened with investigation.
Room was suppose to be an upgrade slider broke glass came loose from frame needed maintenance to repair, which my husband and another friend helped the guy repair.
Very disappointed with resort this time around
Probably won’t go back I will miss our waitstaff for breakfast and lunch.

reviews.author: Wendy Sa-onoy
reviews.text: Basilio was amazing.  He took care of me ans my family upon arrival and departure.  He coordinated my daughter's birthday with a beautiful cake during dinner and balloons in our room.  He went over and beyond and our stay a memorable one.

reviews.author: George Schmidt
reviews.text: My families happy place.  We ate at Flora and Starlin was an amazing waiter.  Very helpful and food was delicious.

reviews.author: James Louveteau
reviews.text: I had a good time in the D R.  The wait staff was amazing.  Especially, Maria Santos, Rosanna Hernandez, Yineiry Albuquerque and Anileidy Guzman. Always a smile on their faces.  A credit to your organization.  The housekeeper also kept the room spotless.

reviews.author: Aman Patel
reviews.text: Great hotel and the staff are very friendly! If you come you have to visit the ginger bar upstairs where Luis, Lucia, Jose, and Altagracia will make you the best drinks and give you an amazing Dominican experience!! Made great memories and can’t wait to come back!

reviews.author: Kayla Morales
reviews.text: I stayed the weekend after memorial day, and we received beyond incredible service. My butler, Juan was fantastic, he really made sure our whole group had a blast. Our bartender duo Wanda and Luis were also fabulous. Drinks remained full, and there were always plenty of dry towels whenever needed. Not to mention the multiple restaurants, which such large variety. Our group had a fantastic time, and definitely plan on returning in the near future.

reviews.author: James Tripi
reviews.text: This place is paradise. Check-in was fast and simple. The room was amazing, it had a swim-up pool directly outside the backdoor. Multiple restaurants on location. Adult only and family areas are available at the resort. The beach was clean and set up with plenty of chairs and private cabanas. My concierge Raul helped with everything I needed. He made reservations at any restaurant I requested. He messaged daily to make sure my stay was perfect. He provided daily lists of activities and things to do around the venue. He went above and beyond to make my stay a pleasure. Stephanie, the guest service manager, also made sure my stay was as perfect as possible. Paradisus has an excellent team and I recommend this resort.

reviews.author: Andrew Chan
reviews.text:
Milton (The manager) and Yessica (servicer) were very polite and provided excellent services to my family and I.
Foods were great at the Italian restaurant. Especially, the margarita!! Excellent
Thank you very much for the excellent service and we had a great time for our dinner!

reviews.author: Caroline Ternes
reviews.text: We had a lovely stay here at Palma Real. The hotel is a twenty minute drive from the airport and has a lot of activities for kids and adults of all ages. Fernando our concierge was outstanding. Very friendly and responsive to all our needs any time of the day! The spa treatments were amazing and we would definitely return in the future!

reviews.author: Dee Moring
reviews.text:
We thoroughly enjoyed our stay!  The resort is absolutely beautiful, the staff is extremely friendly, beautiful beaches. Our concierge, Harry Milor, was amazing!  He went over and beyond to help us our entire stay and to make sure we were comfortable and had everything we needed. We can’t thank him enough for all that he did. Sante was the best restaurant in the resort. Most definitely 5 stars. Wonderful food, friendly staff and an amazing view for dinner. We would definitely recommend.
The room was perfect for us! Wonderful view of the resort.

reviews.author: Holly DiCostanzo
reviews.text: Had a lot of fun attending the sushi 🍣 workshop with Chef Manuel, Jorge, and Hairon!  Also recommend Juan at the Between Bar and the grapefruit spritz!  Visit Flora restaurant and ask for Melina.  She is so cheerful and helpful!  And of course we were so well taken care of by our concierge, Lewis!

reviews.author: Ida Castain
reviews.text:
I had the pleasure of coming back to Palm Real.
Yanira & Maria at buffet services were amazing!
They went above and beyond every time they saw us! We love getting to know them, they work hard!
Excellent experience!

reviews.author: Rob Scott
reviews.text: Maria, yudy y yanira in the buffet were excellent and provided amazing service. Always prompt with coffee, waters, and a welcoming smile. They all remember us each day and greet us with happy salutations. They respond accordingly to our requests and spend time talking with our kids. They are a valuable part of the buffet experience.

reviews.author: Antonio DiBerardino
reviews.text: My family and I went to Flora and our waiters were Bladimir, Francisco, and Melina. They went over the top for us while serving us food and they were extremely friendly. They explained to us that one of the dishes we ordered traditionally comes with extra food that they did not have at the restaurant because they usually do not serve it with it. They proceeded to go out of their way to go to the buffet to get it. Some of the most kind hearted people we have met here. Absolutely recommend to anyone who visits!

reviews.author: Karina M
reviews.text: What a hidden gem this hotel! The property is gorgeous, the front beach hotel and location just 20 minutes away from the airport are convenient, but the best thing is the top notch service… Virginia and Rosanna at the general buffet are very friendly and provide exceptional customer service… Hostel at the pasta station creates delicious dishes and is so friendly… Julia in the bar outside of the 50 room complex is so detailed oriented… we had a wonderful stay and hope to be back soon!

reviews.author: Jamie Lopez
reviews.text: Miguel was our bartender at the kicks sports bar. He made us some unique drinks that were absolutely fantastic. We loved him!

reviews.author: Marissa Yessis Prough
reviews.text:
We're currently 3/4 thru our trip and having a great time.  This is our first time at an all inclusive and wasn't sure what to expect,  but we've been pleasantly surprised.

Dinners..you have to reserve ahead of time which is sometimes tricky if you're off on excursions,  but we easily went to all 4 family friendly restaurants.  Asian, hibachi style was tasty and fun. Blue agave Mexican...delicious food and excellent service from Edito. And coming from southern CA, we were exceptionally surprised at good Mexican.  Italian,  delicious dinner for all. Had excellent service from Reynaldo and manager Milton.  Steak house...would not go again. Food tasty but service for family lacking.

Buffet for breakfast and lunch..very good with lots of variety of food.

Room kept up very well and very comfortable for us. Great wifi everywhere.  Great concierge service ans great excursions that were recommended.

Suggestions...if you've never been to an all inclusive,  it's a bit overwhelming for the first day or so. And the tipping was more than expected...but gets extra service.  Bring lots of US small bills. They go further than DR pesos.

reviews.author: Paule Savary
reviews.text:
Fabulous vacation !
Our best experience was the fantastic service with Martin, the beach supervisor,who was more than helpful, always aheadof our wishes and needs.
Adriel, our concierge, also did a pretty good job. Excellent service, everyone was nice and smiley. Also, the Santé restaurant is fabulous. Îm coming back in december.

reviews.author: Jack Vanderhorst
reviews.text: We really enjoyed this trip. If you are staying in the reserve, I highly recommend Martin on the reserve beach. He is very friendly, helpful, and always makes sure you have the best seat. In addition, I reccomend the catamaran trip that is included with the reserve. If possible, use Basilio as your concierge, he is also incredibly helpful, nice, and always gets you the best dinner reservation.

reviews.author: Jamie McElroy
reviews.text: Rosanna, Yuderqui, Georgi, Raul were amazing! They all went out of their way to make us feel welcome and accommodated all our needs. They were eager to assist and super friendly. This was an amazing vacation and their service was a large part of why it was great! I would highly recommend coming here for vacation! The beds were so comfy also!!!

reviews.author: laura hernandez
reviews.text:
Our experience dinning at Blue Agave was a true delight 😋 my kudos to the chef 🧑‍🍳.
Also this fallow by the attentive service from supervisor Edito and Edison, put the final touch on our dinning experience at Paradisus Punta Cana.

reviews.author: Jessica Duffy
reviews.text: Overall the resort was beautiful!  The service was great!  The staff at The Kicks Bar was top notch!  The shrimp was amazing!  The adult pool was so relaxing and enjoyable!

reviews.author: Lexi Jones
reviews.text: Arismendi Jean, Luis and Yeison seriously made this the best trip ever! We have never been here before and wasn’t sure what to expect but those 3 went above and beyond in every way! They helped us with the language and took the best care of us. They absolutely are the top ones at the resort. Thank you so much for such a wonderful and memorable trip!

reviews.author: Ronald Chiaratti
reviews.text:
Really liked the Paradisus!
Had some problems with room service either not showing up or not bringing what we asked for or at the time stated.
House keeping wouldn’t bring us wash clothes, or hand towels for some reason.
The one thing that we enjoyed the least is the loud thumping repetitive music everywhere! At the pools especially and in the restaurants.
Food options were great, the beach is great, our concierge was great too! When we lost hot water he got Maintenence to get it fixed within a few hours.
The lobby bar with pleasant live music was a favorite hang out for us!

reviews.author: James Bruce
reviews.text: At Paradisus Palma Real for 11 days with friends.  We love it by the Reserve pool close to ocean.  Fantastic service from Jeison, Pedro and Martin.  Very helpful with everything we ask for.  They are keepers.

reviews.author: Cristal Lopez
reviews.text: Paradisus palma royal is the most luxurious resort there is. The staff is great and the ambiance is so relaxing. Francisco is the best concierge I’ve ever encountered, ever. He goes above and beyond for anything you need. Flora is a must-go when it comes to dining experiences. Melina and Eduardo were exceptional and the food was the most authentic Dominican food I had on the property. I had to personally give my compliments to Jerand, the chef because the food is truly delicious. If I could eat here every night I would.  Will definitely be coming back for more fun in paradise!

reviews.author: Dawn N. Powell
reviews.text:
Top notch service from:
Ismael
Dominga
Olga # 1
Olga # 2
Clari
Hopefully I did not forget anyone, but these were our servers at the ginger bar, and they were phenomenal. Amazing service. Wonderful welcoming, warm, attitude and they were always ready to serve us with a smile. If you’re ever at Paradisus Palma, Real, visit the ginger bar. You won’t be disappointed!

reviews.author: Della Arriaga
reviews.text: The bar ginger is a great place for a cocktail.  Saylis, Miguel , Luis, AND Lucia will take great care of you

reviews.author: Tom Crist
reviews.text:
Would like to say  Thank you to Carmen
( supervisor ) , Patry as they exceeded the expectations, they  go beyond and made our New years’ trip so special . There is 19 of us and we are well accommodated , welcomed . All the staff is super nice , espc .Wanda ( nest bar)  she makes the best Mochachino’s for Maria ,  also Johana and Yesenia , they are very friendly and welcoming… again thank  y’all
For the hard work .(room 3111) Happy new year!

reviews.author: I. Manuel Guzman
reviews.text: The best resort in Punta Cana, for its excellent service, quality of food and the pleasant kindness of its employees. Its a la carte restaurants are excellent. The Blue Agave, its waiter Alexander and its Captain Milton. Like Junior (AKA "El Fuerte"), they felt us to be special. Our concierge  Nathanael and at the Front Desk The Reserve, Melisa, all with very good attention. Kicks Sport Bar It is an excellent bar, with a dance atmosphere, cocktails and watching sports on its screens. Andreina gave us her kind attention. Every day that we see each other, he did not stop offering us the drink service.

reviews.author: Rodney Sanchez
reviews.text:
**Exceptional Service at Paradisus Palma Real**

During our recent stay at Paradisus Palma Real in Punta Cana, we had the absolute pleasure of being assisted by Eriol, the concierge. From the moment we arrived, Eriol went above and beyond to ensure our experience was nothing short of perfect. His attention to detail, warm personality, and genuine desire to make our stay memorable made all the difference.

Eriol was always available to answer our questions, offer recommendations, and assist with any special requests we had. He managed everything with such grace and professionalism, making us feel like valued guests throughout our entire stay. Thanks to his efforts, our vacation was seamless, relaxing, and truly unforgettable.

We are incredibly pleased with the service we received and would highly recommend Paradisus Palma Real, especially with Eriol as your concierge. We can't wait to return!

reviews.author: Susanne Roewer
reviews.text:
Today we had lunch at the restaurant Sante. The lobster made by Chef John was outstanding! Santo, the manager and the entire staff, especially our waiters Norjandro and Maria, made sure we enjoyed our lunch and time at Sante. Thank you for taking such good care of us.
.

reviews.author: Royal Davis
reviews.text: We dined at Mena restaurant tonight at the Paradis Real hotel and it was a wonderful experience. Manuel was our waiter and he was incredible. We truly appreciated his humor and he attended to our needs immediately. We had a wonderful meal. We are so happy tonight. Gracias to the staff and Manuel!

reviews.author: Augustus Valerius
reviews.text: We received an amazing service from Idelka at the restaurant Mina. We loved the food, the service and the restaurant. Also, I would like to mention the service of Rafael at the snack bar who went beyond our expectations. The hotel is beautiful, it needs some small maintenance here and there but we liked our stay. We got a room with a front ocean view that gave us an amazing view of the beach and ocean. The room was very spacious, nicely decorated and confortable. Air conditioning kept us cool and to recover from the heat of the day. The water at the beach and pool was really warmed. There was almost algae compared to other beach resorts we visited before in Central America. The waves were calmed and relaxing. We decided to take a luxury room with ocean view, close to the beach with concierge service and we loved it, Irvin took good care of us. We highly recommend it. The only subject where I was disappointed was the refill of the snacks and mini bar where I had to request multiple times to refill it. Overall we really like our stay at the resort.

reviews.author: greg santos
reviews.text: Have been to this hotel line for more than 13 years. Was better before Covid. I actually got married here. This last trip I found Rooms were nice enough. Food was ok but not great. Grounds were well kept and staff was very accommodating for the most part. House keeping can use some work. Had to call many times to get toilet paper and towels. The snack bar was always empty or with damaged candy lol but whatever. Entertainment was lacking. In the past, there were two dancing clubs, one on the second level and one on the lower level (where there now is an office where they try really hard to convince you to buy some package of I really don’t know what), there was some fitness group visiting the hotel and they got a private white dress party in the beach that seemed to be the party of the year, mean while the rest of hotel guests where given head phones to quietly dance around like looney tunes, something out of a Seinfeld episode. I had a good time in general. But believe me when I tell you this hotel used to be a dream but not anymore, it’s average now. For the first time since I’ve traveled to punta cana I was ok with leaving and felt no nostalgia whatsoever. This trip my wife and I were celebrating our anniversary, asked for a better room and closer to the pool, they gave us a room In the back where our view was towards another hotel where a chuchu  train full of kids would pass every 5 minutes, yet this resort was supposed to be and feel adult only… was really awkward every time I smoked a cigar on my underwear with families passing by on the train.. Christopher said he would do his best to get us a more luxurious room, lol well I guess he was just sharing his sense of humor and adventure. Our “butler” Nathanael was very nice. A true gentleman. The one thing that cannot be denied is that the environment is relaxing, Thus don’t expect any thrills. But ok overall.

reviews.author: Lisa Bzowski
reviews.text:
Resort was fantastic and lived up to the expectations I had after being recommended to stay here by a friend. We even booked while we were there for the same week next year.

Pros
-We stayed in a nikte oceanview suite, Irvin n was our concierge and greeted us as soon as we stepped foot off the taxi. He ensured a smooth check in, gave us a tour and had our belongings brought to the room. Was responsive entire week- answered every question, set up our reservations for dinner, and routed a few requests for us.
- kids club (especially Tania) was fantastic. Activities every day, lots of crafts, magic show and big holiday party were spot on! Cool stuff in the pool too
- room was very clean and set up for our child to sleep in the sofa bed, fully stocked fridge and snack shelf, even spare toothbrush sets.
- pool and beach were clean
- pool bar great service and friendly people
- the meals were great. I liked the Italian place the best, but all the food was awesome and accommodating.
-room service was always right in their estimated time. Chicken nuggets for kids were a lifesaver.

Cons
- the shade around the main pool is extremely limited in the family area. Complaints about people creeping into the adult area with kids - which I 100% did cross the line because the shade is a necessity when you are poolside all day! Add umbrellas or more roof thingies :)
-room service was.. confusing. It took 3x on average to actually get what I was requesting. My daughter was sick the entire trip and day 1 we ran out of tissues and it took 6+ hours to actually get a box of tissues, I requested blankets and was brought towels, etc
-room temperature- our ac was stuck on freezing, couldn’t control the temperature and it ran, air blowing, the entire 6 days, called in multiple times and it was never addressed. So cold so I stayed wrapped in a robe and we doubled up blankets all week.

All that said - I think the resort was fantastic. Very clean, everyone was friendly and helpful. Food options were great. Plenty of beach seating!

reviews.author: Erika Villalobos
reviews.text: Beautiful hotel located in a large resort property. The food has been delicious. We had the hibachi on our first night. Chef Kendy and our server José del Rosario were both magnificent. They made the dinner fun and provided great service.

reviews.author: joel brincefield
reviews.text: Had an incredible dinner experience at Tokimeku tonight!!!!  Miguel, our chef was not only excellent at the Hibachi, but super entertaining too! Santo, the manager, was one of the most gracious and attentive hosts we’ve had on our trip.   John also provided superb service as our server.  Without a doubt, our favorite dining experience while at Paradisos Palma Real.

reviews.author: BELINDA GONZALES
reviews.text: Exceptional service since arrival , rooms were beautiful relaxing and always stocked at the minibar .
