We received a cheese platter on arrival with a bottle of wine and turndown service daily . Food was excellent everywhere and entertainment was classy . Top notch service especially from our private Concierge person Eriol outstanding customer service from him. We were celebrating my boyfriend's birthday and he went over and beyond with everything he setup for us and surprised us every time .

reviews.author: Justin Lowtan
reviews.text: My family and I’s trip was a dream as usual, but the real highlight would have to be our concierge - Kelvin Fernandez Arias. He was very hospitable and patient with us. He was there whenever we needed him and regularly checked up on us. He tended to our every need and went above and beyond to make sure that we were satisfied with everything from our rooms to our reservations to our transportation to and from the resort. Anyone who stays here would be lucky to have him as a concierge. Thank you again, Kelvin! :)

reviews.author: Sean Carr
reviews.text: Rooms were really nice. Good location relative to the airport. Very good food for the most part. Buffet was a little hit or miss. A few restaurants were adult only so my family was limited to the same 4 dinner places. Wander at the steakhouse is so nice and works so hard, always made sure my table was ok and helped if we needed anything.

reviews.author: Arezoo Sharp
reviews.text:
The Paradisus Palma Real is a beautiful property! All of the food options have been great, especially the Asian restaurant. The Ginger Bar is the best bar with the most drink options (so far the only bar that we have found that has a blender to make kids smoothies). Ismael Lizardo from Ginger bar has been great and even introduced us to the Dominican specialty cocktail of mamajuana.
The staff at the lunchbox is very friendly and attentive to the guests. Rosanna was very kind and a pleasure to have as our host.

reviews.author: Shinobi CMX
reviews.text:
CM
5/5

Stayed at the Palma Real. From start to finish we were treated quickly & respectfully. The entire place was very clean and well maintained. The Brisas was excellent.. Jose our waiter was nice and attentive. Highly recommend this place, beautiful resort.

reviews.author: Johanna Kuber
reviews.text: We just had the most MAGNIFICENT stay at Paradisus Palma Real! The staff, room, pools and beach were beautiful! Jose Simeon was an absolutely FABULOUS concierge! Please ask for him on your stay! He handled all our reservations and requests with such generosity and kindness! He was a joy and delight!

reviews.author: Lyle Rohan
reviews.text: The service & atmosphere at Ginger bar was outstanding!!! Ismael is the best bartender in the DR hands down. Please visit him. Great service with a personal touch.

reviews.author: Vane M
reviews.text: The experience was wonderful . This hotel is 100% recommendable

reviews.author: Revati Pawar
reviews.text: Its the best Resort in Punta Cana. The staff is very helpful always ready with smiling face. Love the ambience and the various activities the resort conducted on daily basis. All the restaurants with different cuisine is just awesome. Live music, unlimited food and drinks is speechless. Loved the pool area. Best for family as well as couples. Over all 10 out of 10. Must visit place in Punta Cana. Special thanks to Andreina and the team from sports and fun bar and Karina from front desk for helping us. I will definitely visit this resort if I plan to come again to Punta Cana.

reviews.author: Salim Nour
reviews.text: We’re leaving Paradise on earth today! Big thank you for Miguel at the buffet for all his hospitality and his help in making our stay memorable. Milton at the Italian, thank you also to you for your hospitality and amazing service.    Dioni, the steak house manager, you are one of a kind. Sharp, hospitable and Extremely helpful when it came time to facilitate some issues.  Would like to especially thank the kids club.  They made our kids experience amazing. All the employees are enthusiastic, caring and Dynamic. Big Mention to Sujeidi.  You’re on fire girl. You’re an amazing entertainer.  Jesus, The kids club, thank you.  My son appreciate all of your help during his workshops you’re so attentive and dynamic . Thank you all for your kindness, and all your playtime great ideas. Our kids loved their experience at Kidsdome.  We hope to come back very soon. So far this is the best resort in the DR.

reviews.author: John Joseph
reviews.text: Raul is the man! Go to the beach and find him. His service is unmatched on the island. Took care of our party of almost 30 people all week long. Best spring break for the group. Thanks Raul! We will be back to see you.

reviews.author: Marah Qumsieh
reviews.text:
We are very happy and pleased with the resort!
Makati was AWESOME! He was so kind and attentive. He didn’t let us need anything and always checked on us and made we have everything we needed. If you ever come here, ask for makati because he will treat you THE BEST.

reviews.author: Olga Camero
reviews.text:
Restaurant Flora was spectacular. Our waitress was Andrea Santana, she was amazing!!!!!!!
The Best food in the resort and the best service from Andrea! Will definitely come back on this stay. This was the food to beat

reviews.author: Edgar Zavala
reviews.text:
Amazing experience, I highly recommend this to anyone that’s comes by Resort Paridisus @ the 90 DEGREESE BAR is fantastic. Excellent service and quality by Leticia & Greivin

Thank you for the birthday surprise

reviews.author: David Gue
reviews.text:
Absolutely Amazing vacation. Visited resort 5/16 to 5/22,  Not one disappointment.  Rooms were very clean and spacious. Daily service was fantastic. Restaurants very nice and friendly staff at each we visited.  Pools everywhere and very well maintainshrubbery. Area was great. Meticulous shrubbery. Front desk personnel was friendly and helpful. Special shout out to a very special lady at the pool bar Arisleida. The best service anywhere. Always servicing us the entire day, never had to wait for refreshments. Always on top of it. She is one that stood out and will always stand out to us. Best wishes Arisleida
David and Donna (Poppy and Mama)
We will look for you again.

reviews.author: Ivette Lucchetti
reviews.text: SANTE Restaurant ... WOW, what great food. The seafood rice dish was to die for; the ceviche .. holy cow, that was tasty and delicious! We also sampled the taco bar, which was mouthwatering. The setup of food in the buffet was plentiful and a very good variety to choose from. Now, to the staff .. hospitable and super caring, VERY respectful of our needs .. what an asset of a team!  Norjandro fue un encanto; Manuel muy servicial; Miranda, qué personalidad bella. We'll be back for sure.

reviews.author: Gloria Banunguna
reviews.text: My boyfriend and I stayed at Paradisus Palma Real in the reserve section of the resort for 7 days and we absolutely loved it. What made the experience even better was our personal concierge Juan Carlos. Because of him we got to experience more of the resort and what it had to offer such as the activities and restaurants. Every night he made us a dinner reservation at a different restaurant and sent us the activities sheet for the day. He did everything for us which made the trip even better and hassle free and more relaxing. The food was great the staff is friendly and the restaurant is beautiful. 10/10 highly recommend definitely going back soon

reviews.author: Caitlin Milbury
reviews.text:
This resort is very nice and I was glad I splurged on the swim up as it was quiet and relaxing.
The food is mediocre at best and it was inexplicably hard to get a reservation.
We had a great concierge, Ariel, who went above and beyond, our friend’s had one who didn’t ever meet them let alone help.
The best part of this resort is the KIDS CLUB. The women working there are fantastic. They made my kids feel comfortable and they kept them busy and engaged both indoors and outdoors. Sujeidy, Alexandra, Martha, Tania, Joana, Jesica, Sandila all had my kids dancing and laughing. They even made a cake and gave my daughter a Barbie for her birthday! I almost gave 3 stars for service, but went with 4 because these ladies were exceptional!

reviews.author: Jenn Martin Benware
reviews.text: Julia and Jose-fast, friendly, great service.  Gracias!

reviews.author: Aditya Shukla
reviews.text: Great vacation with my family. Made some excellent friends, like Jorge Rafael. He and some other guys (like Julio) helped me improve my Spanish a lot. They are great teachers. They are very nice people, and they make the place as good as it is. I would recommend everyone to come here.

reviews.author: Hayley Cohen
reviews.text: The food was great and service was also! Yuderqui was our server for breakfast each morning and she was fantastic. Very warm and attentive.

reviews.author: Chelsea P
reviews.text:
Overall, this is a 3.75 star resort in my opinion. It’s fabulously gorgeous and you’ll feel like a Kardashian walking around the manicured gardens and public areas. You’ll get the best sleep you’ve ever had in the quiet and spacious luxury rooms. The long stretch of beach is one of the most beautiful in the Caribbean. However, I will not return due to the poor quality of food. I’m not a food snob and will eat almost anything but many dishes were simply inedible. Not fresh and not kept at safe temperatures. If you can survive off water, amazing cocktails, and just the mashed potatoes you’ll be fine. Tables in eating areas are on top of each other and not romantic at all.
Best suited for ages 55+ due to little entertainment and not much for children to do.

reviews.author: Luke Wright
reviews.text: Martin on the beach is amazing!  Paradisis is the prefect place.

reviews.author: Eric West
reviews.text:
Very nice resort.  Modern, updated, clean.  The grounds and pools are well maintained.  The restaurants and Ginger Bar are very nice - you feel like you're at an upscale resort.  There was always some form of entertainment each night.  Kids loved the Kids Club.

Our concierge was Eriol, and he was very eager to help with whatever we needed.

The only downside was the buffet food.  It's ok.  Food at the restaurants and room service was much better.

Overall, we loved our stay.  Going back next year.

reviews.author: Charly Ba
reviews.text: Had the best experience at Paradisus Palma real with our very helpful concierge  Zenovia, and staff, Jose. They made sure we were taken care of and had our meals and activities prepared. She also decorated our room so nicely for our anniversary, great experience!

reviews.author: Cris Berwick
reviews.text: Amazing staff, beautiful beach, pool, rooms. Food was mediocre at best

reviews.author: jamie horn
reviews.text: The best service in a country I have never travelled to. The bartenders are very friendly, and respectful. They treat you like family here.Louis, Alexa, Salomon, Rosa, walquidia y Lucia

reviews.author: Omar Avalos
reviews.text:
We absolutely loved this hotel, the climate was pretty, a little cloudy but couldn’t have asked for better weather. It was our first time ever in the Dominican and will definitely not be the last. Food is incredible which we are big foodies!
We met workers along the way that have been also great.
Jordania was great asking about our trip.

reviews.author: TV
reviews.text: The hospitality of the staff was second to none! I highly recommend you opt to do the VIP experience if you're looking for more of an "adult" vacation. Our personal concierge Eriol went ABOVE AND BEYOND to make sure our stay was as great as it could be. The staff were incredible, always asking if they could get us something or help us in anyway. Hard to remember all the names, but Fausto, Luis and Luis at Ginger Bar, Gladys and her staff at the Spa...the list goes on! My wife and I were here to celebrate the 60th birthday with a friend. EVERYONE at Paradisus made sure she had the best birthday ever! Highly recommend going here! We will be back for sure!

reviews.author: Yuriy Podoshev
reviews.text:
Hotel has gorgeous grounds, beautiful lobby, beach and pool areas. It's generally well maintained outside. This is  where good things end.

Every night / morning there is strong smell of burning/smoke in the air. Apparently a known issue with garbage being burned in the nearby area since 2022. Google it. The more inland you room is the more you can smell it.

Housekeeping - we had to call numerous times within first 24 hours of arrival to replace damp and smelly pillows and to get our room cleaned. We were ignored. Even multiple escalations to the Guest Services didn't work, until we spoke to the most senior manager. Ended up sleeping on self-created pillows, made from our own clothing the first night.

Food - we didn't expect a gourmet experience, however we were mostly disappointed. We ate in most restaurants, Flora being on top of the list and Mexican pretty decent. Italian and Steak restaurants were mediocre. Lunch buffet was just ok. Breakfast was below average, as an example they only serve instant coffee. Food had nice presentation, but was mostly tasteless.

Restaurant reservation - don't waste your time with the "lunch box" reservation desk. Guest services are far more efficient and flexible.

Lastly, we booked our room directly with Melia. The representative booked our 14 year old child as a 12 yo and when I called back to point out the discrepancy, he assured me that it will not be a problem due to a "known system issue" and that the reservation is noted. Fast forward to our checkout from the resort - the hotel had demanded large sum of money, holding us hostage a few hours before our flight home.

reviews.author: Donellia
reviews.text:
I had mixed feelings about this resort during my stay!

Here is My Overall Experience: Disappointing and Far from Luxurious

I was really looking forward to this trip, having planned for this trip to the best of my ability for what I hoped would be a luxurious experience. Unfortunately, my stay at this resort fell short in many ways.

Cleanliness Issues and Poor Response
From the moment we arrived, cleanliness was a major concern. On day one, we found blood on the floor and the comforter in our room. When I called housekeeping to report it, the person who answered had an attitude and seemed unwilling to help. When I asked how long it would take to address the issue, he rudely responded, “I don’t know, I can’t tell you.” Blood on the bed should have been treated as a priority, but it felt like they didn’t care.

Now, they did fix the issue & tried to make it better. I just felt like why even give this room to people and you can clearly see blood in the room.
Even though housekeeping eventually cleaned and tried to manage the situation, the blood stains remained on the floor for our entire stay (throughout the room). It was unsettling, and I couldn’t shake the feeling of discomfort throughout the trip.

We did tell staff about this issue - however it seems much wouldn’t change so we just dealt with it. It was my partner’s birthday and we just wanted to make the best out of the trip!

Lack of Luxurious Experience
One of the main reasons we chose this resort was the promise of a luxurious experience, especially since we paid extra for the reserve. However, from the start, it felt more like a DIY vacation than a luxury getaway.

For example, when we checked in, the person at the front desk was nice, but we were left to wander around aimlessly when we should have been escorted to the reserve area. This was the experience we were sold, but instead, we had to find our own way, which diminished the luxury we expected.

The reserve building itself seemed old and in desperate need of updates, particularly the pools on the reserve side. If you’re paying extra for a premium experience, it should feel like one. Unfortunately, it didn’t. The pool towels had major stains (like blood), and the pool looked like it was growing algae—far from the pristine luxury I had envisioned. My boyfriend even almost cut his foot on a crack in the pool, which speaks to the lack of proper maintenance.

Staff and Guest Interactions
While some staff members were wonderful—especially at the reserve restaurant, sports bar, Asian restaurant, and Italian restaurant—special thanks to Lenny, Antonio, Asante, and Yaleidi for making our trip special with their kindness and exceptional service. However, a few other staff members made us feel unwelcome. Unfortunately, not all staff were as friendly, particularly when it came to interacting with Black guests. To be direct, it seemed like we were the only Black guests at the resort, particularly from America. Though nothing was said directly, the difference in energy and treatment was noticeable, especially when white guests were around.

By the fourth day, it started to feel like we weren’t as welcome anymore. When we dined at Blue Agave, we felt watched—the lady and man were staring at us while we ate, making us very uncomfortable. The treatment we received was noticeably different compared to that of other guests. Sadly, the other guests also didn’t make us feel welcome, which only added to the discomfort of our stay.

Final Thoughts
In summary, this trip had its bright moments, thanks to a few kind staff members, but overall, it was disappointing. The cleanliness issues, lack of luxury, outdated facilities, and uncomfortable interactions with some staff and guests left a sour taste in my mouth. I want to stay somewhere where I feel pampered, valued, and truly welcomed. Unfortunately, this resort did not provide that experience, and I’m not sure I would stay here again.

I can say that the best part about this resort is the food—it’s good!

reviews.author: Paulo Nascimento
reviews.text: Our first time to Punta Cana and everything was perfect! Service was fantastic especially at Sante, our server Edwin was especially personable and outgoing making the experience even better! We will definitely return with our family!

reviews.author: Lee Perrin
reviews.text: Activities are great. We made sushi with Brandol and Yisleni and Roberto and Chef Kelvin. Great fun and unlike on a cruise ship-no extra charge. Sake was good too. Great beach location. Rooms are beautiful. Staff try hard, but lots of mistakes. Dinner reservations for our group of 10 were very hard to get even though the restaurants were half empty.

reviews.author: nathalie fonseca
reviews.text: The hotel was perfect! Nothing to complain, rooms, restaurants, food, service all perfect. Jose de Rosario from the Kicks sports bar is very nice and simpatico!

reviews.author: Meg Gould
reviews.text: The resort is beautiful and the food was pretty good for an all-inclusive experience which can be hit or miss. The Mina Steakhouse for dinner and Sante for lunch were our standout meals. We also had a 50 min massages which were excellent. However, service was a disaster at the beginning. We paid for the upgraded service in the Reserve suite. We were directed to the lounge which was lovely but once there the service was sub par. There was only 1 staff member working and those going in and out completely ignored us. We arrived at 3pm. We were told our room would be ready in 30 mins and to go enjoy lunch and then come back. It took over 2 hours to get our room, with no one giving us updates. Finally I ran into the bellman, Jimmy (who was excellent) who was able to get us into our room and settled. Also, we were told we would have a personal concierge who would help with our stay. After complaining to guest services, we were finally introduced to Harry who made the rest of the stay incredible. He went above and beyond to make sure our friend’s birthday celebration was fun. Despite a rocky start, we had a very good time. But in the future, I’d urge hotel management to have to better arrival process. Concierge’s should be introduced at check in and communication should be far better during the check in process. Also there needs to be more than 1 person staffing the Reserve Lounge experience. Although I am glad the rest of the stay was good, I was very disappointed by first impressions.

reviews.author: Emily Hanton
reviews.text:
We had such a great time! The service here is top notch. We did a lot of the activities- the coordinators were amazing, especially Reynaldo. All the entertainers were also amazing.
Edit: returned in 2024. Another wonderful year with amazing service! Rosanna Edito Yorgelis at breakfast was fantastic with great service!!

reviews.author: Olivia Paulsen
reviews.text:
We just finished our stay at the Paradisus Palma Real - The Reserve section and we were grateful to have Zenovia as our concierge. She was very helpful from the moment we stepped onto the property and was easy to communicate with for anything we needed whether it was for reservations, excursions, or any general questions. We would definitely request her in the future because she has great knowledge of the resort and could help us better understand how things work on the property.
We just went to Blue Agave tonight for supper and the service was amazing. The boss Santo helped us along with server Alexander and they were very attentive and helpful explaining menu options.
My husband and I have now tried Sante for breakfast two times and supper once and we loved all of the options. The staff is willing to help you with anything you would need whether the item is on the menu or not. The breakfast is buffet style and we had the option to choose things on the menu as well. The juices are always fresh and they give you the option of customizing juices. Also, they are bordering the pool and can see and hear the ocean as you eat!

reviews.author: Julie Constantine
reviews.text: Luis at the pool bar is THE BEST!! He always went out of his way to make sure we were taken care of, and truly made us feel like family! Also, a little shout out to his side kick Jonathan! Their kindness really makes this place shine!! ♥️

reviews.author: Stephen Kaye
reviews.text: We had a great stay at the Reserve at the Paradisus Palma Real. I had stayed at the Paradisus Grand Cana in January and as nice as that hotel was (and the rooms are fantastic!) and as good as the shuttle service to the beach is (and it really is on demand without a wait), it isn't "on the beach". So we stayed at the Palma Real this time which delivered - the rooms aren't as modern as the Grand Cana but they are big and clean but being so close to the beach, the dedicated pools for the Reserve, and most of the restaurants is great. Staff at the hotel are very friendly (both hotels to be fair so compliments to the management because this isn't always the case) and while English isn't always brilliant just bear with them as they are really trying to help. If you want the nicest rooms then Grand Cana and if you want to be on the beach Palma Real. Can't go wrong. We will be back I'm sure. Doing "The Reserve" is well worth it if you can do it reasonably. There's extra space at the pools and beaches and we never found it "busy" - and it was Spring Break with two very large school parties - and dedicated restaurants. And you get a concierge to help with things. Kelvin Fernandez was a help to us with getting a different restaurant each day as we had asked and connecting us to someone for excursions. Bottom line - very friendly staff, good holiday good, nice beach and pools, rooms good enough and overall very enjoyable

reviews.author: Alberto Corral
reviews.text: Favorite part of the hotel were the rooms.  New and modern.  Beach was ok.  Pools very nice.  Food hit and miss with some high points like the steak house and the tepamyaki.  Especial mention to Jose de Rosario and Kendrick Suzuki who really took care of us at dinner.

reviews.author: Sogol ght
reviews.text:
Overall the customer service was great. Antonio Rameiz was such a great staff . He made our stay very very special with his great attitude towards his job and all the guest. I’m Staff were friendly and polite and did their best to make us feel welcomed. Olga, Criceida and Lucia were highly friendly and professional. Lucia was a great host at the front bar and made me want to come back to this hotel again. There were few staff next to the bar next to the big pool that I didn’t manage to catch their name but they were all awesome.
Many thanks to flora restaurant staff
Frankline and Diana

reviews.author: Stephanie DeFilippi-Soares
reviews.text: This was my first time at an all inclusive resort and I have to say it was a wonderful experience. The resort is clean, the staff is friendly, and the drinks are delicious. We dined at most of the restaurants at the resort. Abraham took care of us in two of the restaurants. He was always considerate,  friendly and attentive. Wonda at the adults only pool was lively and kept us laughing as we drank the day away. We were fortunate enough to have a butler throughout our stay. Kelvin responded to all of our needs quickly and surprised us throughout the trip with little amenities. He was always a text or a phone call away and made us feel very comfortable.

reviews.author: Sergiu malii
reviews.text: The best kids club ever, kids love it, staff are great and care about what they doing . Professional people. Thank you for everything.

reviews.author: Sue Mattson
reviews.text: This is our second year in a row coming to this same resort. We love it! Ginger bar is one of our favorite places for morning coffee and an intimate evening nightcap. All of the staff, especially Ismael and Dominga, provided excellent service with kindness. We cannot wait to come back again next year!

reviews.author: Matthew Rapp
reviews.text: Everyday we’ve had coffee at Ginger the hotel coffee bar. The service was been excellent! By the second or third day they knew us and knew what we wanted. Antonio and the entire staff Sorangi, Olga Martini and Clari have been great. We will miss our morning coffee for sure when we go back home!

reviews.author: Joanne Streutker
reviews.text:
Rafael was amazing at the beach !!! Never have we had this kind of beach service!  He saved us our sun beds, got us our drinks and towels which never had at any resort at all before.
Our conciege Iwin was also awesome, reserved all of our al lacartes daily and they were delicious

reviews.author: ernan deleon
reviews.text: One of the nicest experience at a all inclusive hotel. The service is top notch and everyone is nice and curtious. Ismael lizardo at the ginger bar was one of the highlights of my trip. Really nice person to talk to and really eager to help. But i can't forget others that went above and beyond in order to make our stay a delight. Dominga, Clari and Antonio. at the ginger bar.

reviews.author: Nicole Staci Fridas
reviews.text: Excellent experience at Macalzome restaurant,  Milton the supervisor assisted us immediately as we are from the Falcon hotel. The waitress Jessica was absolutely delightful, kind and professional with a smile. The pizza was our favorite. You need to try it! We had a great time!

reviews.author: Jenni Bilang
reviews.text: The mexican restaurant was very, very good. Especially Melvin' service, just great, funny guy, never too much never too less, understood our preferences without saying anything - congrats! :-) Santo' food very good, mexican taste, fine herbs

reviews.author: Gary Madison
reviews.text:
Angelo was a fantastic waiter very attentive, happy and pleasant
Yuderki & Eduardo at the flora restaurant was absolutely amazing. Great food, great service!

reviews.author: Dennis Wagner
reviews.text:
My wife and I spend six days at the Melia Paradisus Palma Real in February 2024. We booked an Oceanfront room at The Reserve, which is the adults only section of the Paradisus. It’s a great resort with well maintained gardens and countless different pools.

We generally enjoyed ourselves and frankly didn’t do much other than enjoy the beautiful beach and got some much needed rest. The room was great and the beds very comfortable. WiFi was working rather well in the rooms and even on the beach and pool area.

Overall this is a great resort. The Dominican/Latino staff is unbelievable friendly. But don’t forget, you are in the Caribbean and things tend to be a bit slower and occasionally unorganized. And if you at least try to speak a little Spanish with the staff you will put a nice smile on their faces.

Especially the beach attendees Roberto and Martin at the 96 degrees beach bar were very friendly and courteous. Our Spanish isn’t great, but they enjoyed speaking with us and helped finding the best sun loungers. Sadly, some guests have taken over the habit of getting up early and putting their towels on the prime loungers close to the sea and then only showing up late in the morning. So, it was nice by Roberto and Martin to keep an eye out for non occupied loungers.

This is - like so many other resorts in Punta Cana - an all inclusive resort. There are plenty of restaurants to choose from. Yet the first nights were disappointing and the food was mediocre at best . In general, you need to make reservations for the restaurants in the morning (except Flora and Lunchbox) and after you arrive your personal concierge will arrange these for you. But when you arrive to the resort later during the day you need to take what’s available on your first night and may even have to wait for a table. Our concierge Nathanael arranged the reservations from night two on and after he learned that we didn’t like the first two restaurants he made the right recommendations.

We ended up at the Asian restaurant which we really don’t recommend. The sashimi didn’t look good and tasted stale. The rolls were more rice and veggie than fish. The Udon noodles were drowning in some sauce. Not qualified to be called “Japanese”.

The second night we went to the Italian restaurant since our primary choice (Flora) was closed. Likewise very disappointing. No flavor, no salt, just not good. Neither the pasta (totally overcooked noodles and drowned in cream sauce) nor the pizza (small, mostly dough and very little topping).

Then Nathaneal recommended Sante, their Mediterranean restaurant in the adult area. Their food was excellent. Albeit, I ordered soup twice and returned it both times since it was cold. When it returned it was at least warm and tasted well.

The other restaurant Nathaneal recommended and we really, really enjoyed was Flora and they serve Dominican and Caribbean food.

Probably not a big surprise that in this part of the world the Italian and Asian restaurant weren’t great. We did not go to their steak and their Mexican restaurant but again highly recommend Sante and Flora.

The first couple of days we had lunch at the mega buffet restaurant Lunchbox. Great selection of food from all over the world. Sadly, many items that were not prepared fresh, were cold. But it’s a great concept, especially for families.

Another down side was the amount of corporate events that they seemed to have booked. One day the took away our sun loungers because they were setting up for a corporate dinner at the beach. The set up, especially the never ending sound check, were rather annoying throughout the entire afternoon but there was no escape since we wanted to stay in the adults only section.

The review may sound negative, but over all we really enjoyed our time here and may even come back again.

reviews.author: Gonzalo Arotzarena
reviews.text:
Food (service and quality) is deplorable.
Breakfast is fine.
Lunch and dinner are bad.
There are many restaurants, and then there is the buffet. Overall, the food is really bad. Except for the Mediterranean restaurant (Santé), my family and I have really disliked the rest of the food (dominican restaurant, buffet, italian…). So far, I cannot speak about the other restaurants (japanese, steak house) because despite having been here for more than 5 days, being able to get a reservation (through our concierge) is a real hustle (despite the apparent good predisposition of the staff, effectiveness is difficult to achieve).

We stay in the Only Adults part of the hotel aka The Reserve.
It is quiet (pool, and beach area).
Rooms are perfect.
Hotel is beautiful and blends in with environment.
Staff is always friendly.

reviews.author: Aaron Coplan
reviews.text: Amazing resort! Dalmis went above and beyond to ensure our experience was unforgettable. From sending a delightful dessert plate to our room for our last night to securing a late checkout, e was attentive to every detail. He also arranged our dinner reservations and helped us book a fantastic parasailing adventure. His dedication and personal touch truly enhanced our vacation. Thank you, Dalmis, for making our stay so special!

reviews.author: Damian Douglas
reviews.text: Restaurant was awesome!! Flora Fishing was amazing and the Cesar was the best server!! 5-star experience!

reviews.author: Rainelly Abreu
reviews.text: Our first stay here at this resort! It was a great stay. From the moment we arrived everyone was very friendly. We were greeted by  Ernesto who helped us throughout our whole trip he is the BEST!! He helped my boyfriend do a birthday surprise and it was beautiful and I definitely recommend coming!

reviews.author: Gail Cappelli
reviews.text: We just had a wonderful dinner at Flora Restaurant. The Manager and the waitress gave us AAA service. Thank you so much Melina and Franklin!

reviews.author: Alexis Molinari
reviews.text:
Amazing time! I got to mix a drink and it was great! Very delicious. Thanks to Jorge Rafael and Antony Ortiz

I also went to the macrame workshop with Jeury and Gilda. I had a great time and Gilda was a great teacher! She was so nice and helpful, and was great at explaining in 2 languages!

We went to the pizza workshop with Hairon, and chef Juan. They were so nice and very skilled. The workshop was so fun and we also made aperol spritz. 10/10 recommend!

reviews.author: taylor whalen
reviews.text:
Amazing hospitality and service at Mascalzone ! Reynaldo knows what he is doing in managing the team here - guest experience is top of mind !
Was greeted by Reynaldo and when I let him know my party of 4 was now just a party of 1,  he made sure my solo dinner would still be enjoyable .
Fauto , my server ,  was very professional but very warm - always making sure I had what I needed and wanted ! Perfect timing on service .
The most enjoyable meal since I’ve arrived ! Great hospitality and service !

reviews.author: Bella Douek
reviews.text:
Ginger Bar is great! Ismael, Antonio, Dominga, Clary, and Jenifer make excellent coffee

I also had an amazing experience at the Tokimeku restaurant. Santo, Jose, Frank, and Jeff were accommodating and served only the best sushi!

reviews.author: Jae Cho
reviews.text: Jose Del Rosario and Chef Rafael Martes were excellent at the Tokemeku restaurant!   Also enjoyed the buffet (great service by Arismendis) and dinner at MANI with incredible service by Olvi and Reynaldo!  Our family had great company and had a wonderful experience at the Paradisus Palma Real.   Good food, clean, comfortable, amazing views.....we will be sure to return!

reviews.author: Nick Restuccia
reviews.text: Great experience. Beautiful spots on property for photos and relaxing. Many bars for drinks and pools for different environments and activities. Nathanael was our concierge, he was helpful and friendly. There were so many great employees/servers/bartenders such as Miguel, Miguel, Bladimir, Raul, Andreina. Short trip from the airport. Highly recommend for a DR vacation.

reviews.author: Bambi Tran
reviews.text: Spent our honeymoon here, very beautiful hotel and location. The architecture is beautiful and very well curated, each restaurant has their own style and flair yet you still know it all belongs to the same hotel. I very much appreciate the design and work/attention put into each detail. Most of the staff was very attentive and sweet, many of them remembered our drink orders for breakfast, said hello and were very genuine. I appreciated their charisma and kindness! Our housekeeping always kept our rooms fresh and clean and room service was always great. Our concierge could’ve been more helpful (messed up a few of our reservations and lots of miscommunication, but surprised us with a cake and champagne for our honeymoon), but overall a great stay! Drinks here are on point and food is pretty good! Some staff I’d like to highlight as stars: Omar who helped us with our luggage, Bladimir from Flora, Frank from the buffet and Tokimekku, Maria from the buffet, bartenders at the Celsius bar, Jordania from the lobby.

reviews.author: Ella Smith
reviews.text: Flora is a delicious restaurant with many options. We tried a variety of dishes and all were amazing. The gnocchi dish was by far our favorite. Very pleasant place and great service by Cesar, highly recommend.

reviews.author: C Brian
reviews.text:
First of all, what an amazing facility!  We recently went with some friends and had a wonderful time at this place.  We had the Nikte Master Suite swim up.  The room was perfect but a bit too large for just the 2 of us.  Scroll to the bottom for our biggest complaint and the main reason for 3-stars, not 5! :)

Ginger Bar - awesome staff and lots of options for drinks, smoothies, milkshakes, coffee's and more.

Italian Restaurant - server was great but the first person to the table was cold and seem annoyed that we were there.

Lunch Box buffet - 50/50 on service.  Some were great but we had several that seemed irritated (and took their time sometimes) when they had to get us coffee or water.  Food was slightly above average with lots of options.

Steakhouse - nothing great.  Server was really good but the steak was below average.

Japanese - one of the better meals we had.  Staff was awesome and lively.

Mexican - service was great and the food was fine.

Caribbean - Marina (I think?), was a great server and the food was delicious.

Kicks Sports bar - great service, good music and entertainment.  This is a bustling place in the evenings and they sure keep up with the service no matter how many people are in there..great job!

Room service - burgers and quesadillas are just okay.  Chicken nuggets really need an upgrade, they're not good...simple fix I think.

Housekeeping/bar fridge - amazing staff who work hard to keep the rooms clean, towels changed and bar fridge/snacks stocked.

Service/drinks on our patio/pool - Julia was on top of it, very polite, good sense of humour and checked on us frequently during our stay...great work Julia!

Our concierge Harry - awesome guy, very helpful, communicated through WhatsApp to reserver dinners, transportation and answer any questions we had.   Just an all around great guy!

Our most annoying part of the stay?  The concierge teams seem to be trained by their management to consistently push you into attending a sales presentation.  Once or twice asking throughout the week, I have no issues.  When you're on a 7-day holiday and each day you have to decline and say no to the sales presentation, it really does take away from your enjoyment of this amazing place.  This must be fixed!  If someone says no once or twice, that should be the end.  Don't require your staff to constantly ask them each day, its annoying!

We would definitely rate it a 5-star if not for this frustrating tactic.

reviews.author: Marianna Rosario
reviews.text:
Thank you very much to the superior Eduardo and the waitress Melina! ❤️they were amazing and always with the same smile 😊 every time i come
To the Flora Restaurant they gave us the best service ever !! We love this place ! Paradisus is a dreams come true ! Lovey and peaceful place 🥰 the food was amazing and we love the special service of the chef Hostess the food ♥️♥️♥️♥️😋😋

reviews.author: Jason Marquardt
reviews.text: The kids club was fantastic for our two year old. The coffee bar, Ginger, Ismael, was always a great bartender. The drinks are consistently great for coffee and cocktails throughout each day.

reviews.author: Cali Redd
reviews.text:
Lewis was our concierge and was absolutely amazing. He catered to our every need including things we didn't know we needed. He made our birthday trip very special. Thank you!

This is a review for the Reserve Adults Only Beach. Rafael and Pedro were amazing! They got accomodated my cousin and I for our bday Trip. Very professional and attentive. Will come back again just for them. Thanks guys!

I also ate at Flora where Stormin and Malena waited on me. They provided my cousin and I with great service! Gracias.

This place is amazing! I’ve loved every aspect of it. It’s giving luxe and I love it. Jordania was amazing and very friendly and knowledgeable. I can’t wait to come back and visit everyone I’ve met while here.

reviews.author: Jay Yang
reviews.text:
We booked a suite at the Reserve and the moment we arrived, we knew it was going to be an amazing R&R vacation. We checked in at the Reserve section of the lobby. The Lobby was spacious and quiet. We arrived early and had to wait until the room was ready. It did take a while for us to successfully get into the room.

The room we had was an ocean front view. It was perfect. The balcony was huge and the rooms were very comfortable.

Zenovia took care of us for the week we were there. She did a fantastic job. She helped us with everything we needed. We mostly had questions, and she would respond back within 5 mins. She helped us book all of our dinner restaurants. But surprisingly, out of all the restaurants they had, we just kept going back to the Buffet. The buffet had the Dominican food we were looking food. It was amazing.

Because we stayed at the Reserve, we had a few "exclusive" pools to jump into. The reserve section of the beach was great as well because there were always beach chairs. Just walk and take one.

The week that we were there, there were less people. Perfect for some peace and quiet time. No one bothered us, we just simply relaxed.

We took a trip on the (included) catamaran to do a early morning yoga session at this private beach about 20 minutes out in the water. It was a great time.

There were bars all around the resort, people were always helpful, room service/housekeeping staff were all great! we will have to definitely come back soon!

Big shout-out to Zenovia and all the staff that helped us. Thank you!

reviews.author: Chloe Erazua
reviews.text:
Review of Kidsdom
I was pleasantly surprised by the high-quality childcare center available at this resort for kids over 1 year old. The caregivers at Kidsdom were incredibly friendly and attentive—they never took their eyes off my child and ensured they had a wonderful time. This allowed us to relax and enjoy the adults-only activities with complete peace of mind.

We felt so comfortable and are deeply grateful for the exceptional service provided. Bonus: Kidsdom is open from 10 AM to 10 PM, so you can drop off your child at your convenience—how amazing is that?

Big kudos and heartfelt thanks to the team at Kidsdom!

reviews.author: Brian Daniel
reviews.text: On our third night, we celebrated an important birthday at the Blue Agave restaurant. Santo y Delvin were fantastic, along with the food!  Also, come early to catch Ruby, just outside at the Between Lounge Bar.

reviews.author: adara ezekwe
reviews.text: Yiri is the best person I have ever met! She was so sweet and very personable! She made me feel welcome and I will miss her!

reviews.author: Quiana Davis
reviews.text: Paradisus trip in DR was absolutely amazing. We went for my daughter’s 7th birthday and Irvin (our concierge) did a fabulous job of setting her birthday dinner on the beach. Our stay at the pool we had Melvin who was on top of things for us and made our stay super awesome! We would come back here again as the people are nice and friendly! The hotel is simply gorgeous!

reviews.author: Jack MacDonald
reviews.text: Ginger Bar is the best. Ismael is the best. Antonio, Nereida, Dominga, Olga, and Clary were amazing and helped us so much. If you need drinks, stop at the ginger bar at the lobby, they make the best margaritas.

reviews.author: Meena Prasad
reviews.text:
Our boys loved sand soccer at the beach!
Jorge Rafael and John Springer are awesome at keeping the kids entertained!

Ana and the staff at the Asian restaurant did a wonderful job on both the sushi and Hibachi sides. The Mexican restaurant also did a great job accommodating vegetarians - George and Alexander were wonderful and attentive.

reviews.author: Brent Swanson
reviews.text:
DO NOT BOOK AT THIS RESORT!
Areas where the resort failed to deliver basic standards of service:
Room Reservations:
•	Unable to confirm room bed, given twins not king
•	Long, unorganized, and delayed check-in process
Resort Layout & Infostructure:
•	Resort is challenging to navigate, little to no signage
•	Room door had gap against the door jamb when closed allowing bugs into our room
•	Air conditioning in the rooms was subpar with no humidity control
Food:
•	The main buffet was awful. The food was mediocre, it was very understaffed resulting in long lines and food stations running out of food
•	The fruit was mostly all unripe, tortilla chips were stale, cheese was sweating, and the pizza was undercooked to highlight a few
•	Food signage was unclear, missing, or mislabeled which made navigating with dietary restrictions very challenging.
•	The restaurants are only open for dinner! Tried to make a dinner reservation at 10:45AM and was told that every single restaurant was booked solid.
•	Limited snacks, sit down service only
•	My room service chicken quesadilla came with a hidden 2-inch-long chicken bone which was disgusting to bite into.
•	You are not able to order any food at the pools.
Bars & Beverages:
•	Adults only pool bar selection was incredibly limited and was bottom shelf package only.
•	The pool bar also closed at 6pm
Beach & Pool:
•	Hands down the most disgusting Caribbean beach I have ever visited. The water was brown and smelled worse than our beaches back home in NJ
•	No attempt to clean up the washed-up seaweed and it lined the water edge
•	The number of hecklers allowed to wander around the beach chairs is outrageous.
•	The pools closed at 7PM!
Customer Service:
•	This was the most unfriendly, unaccommodating, unhelpful staff I have ever encountered in all my years of traveling and working in the hospitality industry.
•	Calls for support from the hotel room often times resulted in calls going unanswered
•	I was shocked by the lack of English spoken and understood by the staff, most understood zero English.
•	The house keepers were not properly trained and entered room multiple times unannounced.
•	I physically went to the customer service desk at 11am, 1pm and 3pm to try to speak with the manager, Stephanie, and was dismissed each time. I still have not heard from anyone at the resort regarding my experience.
Avoid the Paradisus Palma Real and any other Melia resort while visiting the Dominican Republic.

reviews.author: Peyton
reviews.text: This place is amazing! Willy is great and helped make the trip smoother! He was great with answering questions and making dinner reservations! Food is very very good and fancy here! Pools are private and you have your own space! Wonderful stay! Beach is private and has many things to do!

reviews.author: brian patterson
reviews.text: We had a wonderful time at this resort.  Sante was our favorite place for all our meals.  Randi was the best bartender and made the best drinks.  He had so much pride in his job.

reviews.author: Nate Dockswell
reviews.text: My family and i stayed here for the week and my god! The service was fantastic. All of the bartenders, specifically Lucia, luis, jonathon, and quintino, were incredible. Jorge also led an activity for pizza making, which was fantastic and super fun. They all took so much care into knowing us and what we liked, and provided fantastic service. The facilities were spotless, the service was incomparable, and would not hesitate to come back. Must go!

reviews.author: The Postpartum Closet
reviews.text: Maria Santa, Franklin Acevedo, and the host Laura were very nice. Service was great. Our server went out of his way to get us a special dessert. Lunch was very pleasant.

reviews.author: Amy Pineda
reviews.text: Food at restaurant Flora was amazing. Server Anna Michelle was great and really nice! Would totally recommend!

reviews.author: Sheriean
reviews.text: I got my full 9hrs of sleep both nights I was there. The tub was amazing. Very luxury in the room and the complimentary supplies in the room were much appreciated. Check in for Amex platinum took longer than expected. Did a body scrub at the spa and the service was good. Pools were great. Beach was meh. Make sure you find and reserve your restaurants asap because the buffet food was just okay with limited options and got tired quick. More elaborate decorations than practical tasty food which caused the bread to be stale. I feel like the plate was the hottest item at the buffet. Everything was warm or lukewarm but I didn’t get food poisoning. The beef tripe, fruit, and virgin mojitos were the highlight of the food after you get tired of the charcuterie. The Asian hibachi was bland but the chef was entertaining. I would do another 2day stay here again but the walk from your room to anywhere is quite far if you like chilling in the really nice room often.

reviews.author: Luis Vasquez
reviews.text: Angelo and Jeffrey has  being one of the.best server so far they where very respectful and the relationship was great from the first day his service was spectacular in the future hopefully we run in to them again.

reviews.author: Victoria Lopez
reviews.text:
We had an amazing dinner at the restaurant Mascalzone, big shout out to Bernabé, very attending during our dinner , made our choices very easy , recommend some amazing dishes! Would definitely eat here again!
We also had a great time at the 90° pool bar, Eddy, Carolin y Rossana were amazing hosts, thank you for all the delicious drinks and the great service, you made our stay a great experience

reviews.author: Keith Weaver
reviews.text: Great stay for sure. Just careful when you go on the beach as it is public there. Many people want to sell all kinds of things, but they do accept no as an answer. Wife got her hair done and got some nice figurines. Nice all inclusive restaurants. They were very busy when we went, our group had 700+ people but they did their best and we had a great stay.

reviews.author: Angelyna Alice
reviews.text: the buffet was wonderful, i really enjoy this resort and the many offerings! i love the room and how close it is to the ocean. everyone is so hospitable. thank you Maira, Juan and Anileidy for being so kind during our lunch!

reviews.author: Dar el Mehdi
reviews.text: We especially recommend the 32 degrees bar at the pool of the circle palma real with the fantastic team : Vanessa , Hansel , yeison , raul y deni . They made us pass beautifull holidays in punta cana

reviews.author: Emily Bodrug
reviews.text:
Dear Paradisus & Red Tag Vacations,
First of all, I do not even know where to begin!? I just wanted to write a review to thank you so much for the most amazing trip. Thank you so much for randomly selecting me as one of the winners of the 12 days of Christmas giveaways! The trip to Dominican Republic, Punta Cana- Paradisus Palma Real was by far the best trip I have ever been on in my entire life.
I will never forget the moment I found out I was selected as one of the winners of this outstanding trip. I was busy nursing at the hospital and on break I finally got a chance to look at my phone and I saw the notification that I won a trip! It seemed too good to be true at first, however I was absolutely speechless when I found out it was totally real!!
From the second I won, Red Tag went above and beyond to help arrange and make sure I was all set up for this trip. Everything was so organized and I appreciate the help from your VIP support specialist, Liliana R, so much. She made sure that our availability worked with the hotel and even helped arrange our resort confirmation number, our transfers, and our parking at the airport.
The second we got to the resort, we were in such good hands. The resort went above and beyond to make us comfortable. The resort was extremely clean and breathtakingly beautiful! We got greeted right away, had a very easy check in, and had someone guide us right to our room. When we got to the room, I could not believe my eyes in regards to how clean and beautiful the room was. We had a king sized bed, walk in shower, a large tub, a mini fridge, and a stunning balcony with incredible views. The staff at the resort were so helpful and so friendly, always checking in to see if we needed anything else.
The resort itself had amazing restaurants. Everything was newly renovated and extremely clean. The resort had restaurants such as Italian, Mexican, local, Japanese, a steak house, and a large buffet. The food was so fresh and so delicious. The pools were also the highlight of the trip as they were literally everywhere! There was multiple swim up bars with the friendliest bartenders. I would like to thank the bartenders Mario and Victor for making our trip so memorable. The pools were clean and the perfect temperature. It was very easy to find beach chairs, as well as sun beds to tan on. The beach was just a few steps from our room and was great/warm for swimming! We enjoyed walking the beach each night at sunset. We also made great use of the gym every day. It had all new equipment and had everything we needed. The grounds were also beautiful to run and walk around. Fresh flowers everywhere with beautiful gardens!
The Paradisus Palma Real was definitely a 5 star resort in Dominican Republic. Again, I cannot thank Red Tag enough for the best trip. It was a trip of a lifetime and I will never forget it. We also made so many amazing friends at the resort that we will always stay in touch with! I am already dreaming of going back. I wish there was words and a review I could write to express my gratitude and my appreciation for this outstanding trip. From now on, I will only be booking with Red Tag as everything went so smoothly. Being a nurse and firefighter, it is very hard to get the time off and to find time relax. This was a trip I will never ever forget and everything I needed and more. I was treated so exceptional. Thank you from the bottom of my heart! I am SO excited to return one day! Emily & Travis

reviews.author: Moh Guerrero
reviews.text:
Vanessa was a great help on the beach daily. She set up our beds and made sure we were comfortable. Thanks Vanessa for all of your help!!!

Melissa was also great at the plaza!!! Great times🙌🏼🙌🏼

The Kidsdom was amazing!!!  Alexandra the guys and gals are very attentive. My daughter did not want to leave their side.  The activities are fun, educational and the kids love it!!!!

Last but DEFINITELY not least was the BEST concierge Zenovia. Her dedication and attention to detail is unmatched. She took our vacation experience into her own hands and transformed it into the best yet; even though this was our fifth time here. Thank you so much for all of your hard work. We are now family.

reviews.author: Aaron Davis
reviews.text: The Ginger Bar was THE BEST service I received while I stayed at the Paradisus. 100% recommend you spend time here , the bartender(s) give excellent service. Luis and Luis  and miquel  y walquidia good service

reviews.author: Aleecia
reviews.text: Overall giving this wonderful place a 5 star because of the ginger bar staff. Ismael, Yeni, Antonio, clary and dominga were all super friendly and more excited to see me in the morning than I was to get my food and drinks! It’s this kind of staff that makes a hotel experience tremendously better. Thank you so much for a beautiful stay!

reviews.author: Christopher Charalambous
reviews.text: The hotel deserves every one of its stars. Paradisus has exceeded my expectations, the staff have been very caring and the butler service is extraordinary. Alvaro, our personal butler, has booked all of our dinners and activities as we requested them and always had a plan B for us in case we decided otherwise. Whilst also sending fresh fruit and juices to the room. The royal service is excellent if you're looking for a more quiet, soothening experience and the staff of the royal service, Jose especially, make you feel the experience even more. In my opinion, we definitely chose the best resort and would love to visit again.

reviews.author: Dean Salminen
reviews.text: Yeison and Teofilo at the Fahrenheit Bar are very friendly, excellent bartenders. Their specialty local cocktails made our trip even more special. Our third trip to same resort and we have already booked next year’s trip.

reviews.author: Vanessa Romero
reviews.text: Wow all I can say is I will always have great memories staying here!! The amazing staff are my ultimate favourite especially Juan Castillo ,  Andreina , And Luis ! Super y espectacular friendly and very helpful always making us feel special ! kicks sports bar soooo fun love it 😍 thank you so much for making me feel like a princess on my very special day my birthday 🥳  you guys went all out for me 🎂🥂🦩  I will definitely return 😘 love to you all ! Ginger Bar  is also amazing awesome staff attentive  and delicious drinks . Everyone is super amazing !! 5 stars all around 🤩🤩🤩🤩🤩 I’m in love with this resort and everyone working here I will definitely let all my loved ones know about this hot beautiful place !!! Oh ya the food yum 🤤 oh my the best ever ! Thank you all 🩷😻 🩵

reviews.author: Rick Stratton
reviews.text:
Booked 6 months in advance and paid for their Nikté upgrade class. First day here and so far a nightmare; hopefully it improves.

Arrived at 12:30 and was checked in (understand the room won’t be ready until 3pm). At 3pm was told to come back in 10 minutes and so it went on until 4:30.

When we arrived at 12:30 we tried to get a reservation for dinner and were told they were no reservations at any restaurant available and we’d need to book through our concierge.

We were finally showed to our room by the bellboy whom told us our concierge would be there in 5-10 minutes. After 30 minutes and unanswered phones calls to the operator, front desk, manager (every call was transferred to a line that was never answered) I finally again went to the front desk.

After another 15 minutes I was introduced to our concierge Wily (whom seems like a great guy). He promised to make things right……TBD

Change my review rating but can’t give them a five. Overall very nice property and good service. Besides the check in issues, I tried to use an upgrade voucher I received. It states very specifically for “premium food or beverage”. The restaurant would not accept it saying it was for room service only; when trying to confirm what it was for, the front desk said it was a room upgrade and not tied to food at all. UGH!!

reviews.author: Kim Fornier
reviews.text:
Luis Cadet was our Concierge during our stay here at Palma real and it was a good experience. We enjoyed our stay here and he helped us with everything we needed and wanted! We can’t wait to come back and will recommend this resort to our friends and family!

Emmanuel and Fernando helped us as well and it made our trip worry free! Didn’t have to worry about anything especially our luggages. Emmanuel even brought up to the other resorts a few time! Will definitely be coming back!

reviews.author: Shelly Billingsley
reviews.text:
Our server by the pool was a delight and attentive.

.

reviews.author: Mary Pravdin
reviews.text: Beautiful hotel, amazing service, super friendly people, BEST dancing and DJs. Great drinks. Great restaurant choices and delicious food.  Alejandro the dancing boss made sure everyone had fun, and Osvaldo our concierge mage sure we had a great experience. Relax by day and have fun by night every day! The rooms were very spacious,  although some fixtures are a little old, but that did not take away from our fabulous experience.

reviews.author: Justin Chappell
reviews.text: Raul provided the best beach experience i had. Super attentive and always available.

reviews.author: David Villa
reviews.text:
Very nice resort but will not recommend coming here. Service is not what you’re hoping for in an all inclusive. Eduardo Pujols which is the supervisor wasn’t not helpful at all.

Big issues:

1. Bed room reservations aren’t guaranteed. So for our honeymoon we have to sleep in two separate full beds instead of the king bedroom suite we booked.

2. Our Suite Room comes with a personal concierge and it’s a scam. They don’t reach out to you and to use their service they request additional money for their services. If Fernando Ducoudray is assigned to you ask for a different person.

3. We submitted a complain because everything is driven by their app that doesn’t work. We can’t call them to order anything because the phone doesn’t work.

4. We have one of the most expensive rooms, and the essentials are not working. Phone to call out doesn’t work, lobby is far from the premium suites and you have to walk there every time you want something.

5. We requested to become members but it’s impossible to get one to show you around. Doesn’t make sense a resort not interested in making money.

6. The spa is impossible to make a reservation.

reviews.author: Karen Ryan
reviews.text: Julia and Josewere great with making great with making sure we had enough drinks and we were well taken care of

reviews.author: Ernesto Reguan
reviews.text: Great stay at this hotel. Superb customer service at all the a la carte restaurants specially at Flora with Daiana  and Glenny and at Kanna with Luis Rodriguez y el chef Wander. We dined at Sante and Jose the waiter was awesome as well. We had an outstanding concierge named Irvin Nolasco that went above and beyond to make our stay unforgettable. Our housekeeper too, Ernestina, she was excellent and always kept our room spotless. I think everyone was excellent but definitely the buffet staff could use some training on customer service.

reviews.author: Malaysia Wiley
reviews.text: This place was so beautiful! The staff was very accommodating and attentive! We had absolutely no worries thanks to Luciano, Melvin, and Irvin. They ensured we were taking care of from rides, excursions, and even securing reservations on our behalf. 10/10! Will be back for sure!

reviews.author: DANZ HANDZ
reviews.text:
Rosanna went above and beyond for hd for breakfast and Lunch please gove het a raise she is one in a million
Thank you again for everything

reviews.author: Welder Gomez
reviews.text:
We had the most wonderful at the Long Boat Buffet. Yanira, Rosanna and Judith did a wonderful job! They were so nice and professional!!!
The food was great, so organized and clean. And again, service was the best!!
Thanks so much girls!!!

reviews.author: Angela Garcia
reviews.text:
Best resort ever!
My favorite bar is Ginger and Ismael is the best bartender! Antonio, Dominga, Olga and Clari are the best servers.
Rooms & service and restaurants are amazing. Can’t wait to come back.

reviews.author: Sylvain Montminy
reviews.text: This resort is a solid 8 with the potential to easily be a 9. Although sometime inconsistent, the service is generally excellent with a few standout stars like our concierges Luis and Harry and Santo, Marie, Edito and Frank at the restaurants. The grounds and rooms are fantastic with some elements showing a bit of wear and tear! They accommodated our group of 16 very well and we had a fabulous time. Would definitely recommend!

reviews.author: Allyson Schroeder
reviews.text: The resort was great! I especially liked the Bri Sas restaurant, our waiters Jose Ramos and Rosani were very sweet and attentive. They took care of everything we needed and went above and beyond what we needed. Lewis was also great, he took care of us throughout the week and got us everything that we needed. He was very kind and very attentive to us and made us very happy!

reviews.author: Karene Wint
reviews.text: Big shout-out to yaleida for making my vacation so fantastic and memorable. She when above and beyond to ensure that our room was cleaned each day. We were celebrating our anniversary and my husband birthday. She decorated our room for both our anniversary and my hubby birthday. My reservations for dinner was also booked thank you for providing such a quality service see you next time 👌🏾🏝️

reviews.author: Richard Shefteshy
reviews.text:
Flora

Delicious food. Wonderful experience overall, service was perfect. We had Edouardo and Carlo Aponte take care of us the 3 nights we were there and it was super great. Our waiters were Cesar, Jonathan and Stephania - they were all great.

Best restaurant we tried during our stay :)

reviews.author: Brittanee Weimer
reviews.text: Fior at the bar kicks is the best person on this resort! She makes the best expresso martinis you've ever had!!!!

reviews.author: Max Sherwood
reviews.text: Absolutely amazing resort. Have been to many resorts in Punta Cana but nothing compares. Premium alcohol included, (corona, heineken, cours light, black label, don julio 1942, Hennessy, and more). The pools and beach are beautiful with a swim up bar to keep you in you in the pool all hours of the day. Don’t forget to hit up the best bar tender and towel man in the business, Pedro and Gilberto. It is amazing to see staff like Pedro and Gilberto in such high spirits, both made my experience one to remember. The food was absolutely wonderful and especially at the Mina restaurant. Wander and Reynoldo provided my wife a beautiful cake for her birthday with a surprise Mariachi band. I do not have one complaint about the resort and will be returning in years to come. See you soon, Pedro and Gilberto.

reviews.author: Farrah Jaber
reviews.text: This was an absolutely amazing holiday at a stunning hotel complex. The rooms and facilities at the Reserve are incredible, and since Palma Real is under construction, we were given access to Paradisus Grand Cana. Grand Cana is equally as beautiful and has an additional few restaurants that we had access to, as well as a beautiful pool area with a great swim up bar. The food at the restaurants was better than expected, with Mina Steakhouse being especially great. All of the staff are so friendly and made the experience even better. Our concierge Nathanael was also amazing and reserved a new restaurant for us each night, and made sure to send us the activity list each day for both the Reserve and Grand Cana, which was super helpful. Highly highly recommend!

reviews.author: JOANNE STREUTKER
reviews.text: Our stay at Pardisus Palma Real was amazing!..great  swimup room with awesome location and the beach was right there. Rafael gave us awesome service and so did Gilberto and Wanda were all awesome bartenders. Irvin was an awesome concierge.. thanks all of you for the awesome service 😎👍

reviews.author: Shrimmie 21
reviews.text:
Update:

It’s been almost a week since we got back from PUNTA CANA!  My family and I can’t stop talking about how much fun we had and how much we miss it!  We stayed at the Reserve and had the best butler!  Juan Carlos was our butler. He was so amazing. He took care of all of our dinner reservations.  Each restaurant was 10/10.  He sent us a daily schedule of all the activities. Any question I had he answered immediately.  Thank you Juan Carlos for your amazing attention to detail.  Also there is Ruby she’s a bartender where the Mexican and Italian restaurant are at. You must go visit her. The drinks are insanely good. She’s amazing. We were sad to say goodbye to her. Over all don’t think twice about booking at the Paradisus!  Rooms were amazing. Very clean the entire resort is 5 star. Can’t wait to be back.

We had the best time at the local sport bar here!  Luis and staff were amazing. The DJ and show is hard to beat. Can’t wait to be back

reviews.author: Haydee Uwantege
reviews.text: We had the best service at Paradisus Palma Real Punta Can. The first contact we had was Daniel Rivera who really treated us so good. A big thank you to him, he welcomed us with a warm welcome, an Jose Ramirez, Miguel and Maria from the buffet 😊

reviews.author: David Houseward
reviews.text:
Very nice hotel and amenities.  Our room was not ready when we arrived and the food quality in the family concierge area was not as good as the beach front so we were constantly golf carting to the front.  That being said the food was incredible.   A few rolling power outages occurred but that didn't last too long.

Overall the beach was nice, weather fabulous, food excellent, and service was personal.  At other resorts we have been to the staff were more "scripted" so you get a more varied experience here.

There are golfing benefits but didn't take my clubs. Also the spa was very nice.  I think I went three times.

reviews.author: Steven Williams
reviews.text:
The service at Tokimeko was great. The food and chef (Roberto) was the best. The others supporting the service were great, too.  I would come back again.

The beach area at the Reserve was great. Marten was great he made sure I had a great location and my towel were out andready everyday. I would co.e back and ask for he again.

reviews.author: Phillip Wassner
reviews.text: We stayed at the reserve at Paradisus for a week. It’s a very peaceful and relaxing resort. The beaches are beautiful and staff is very friendly. If you stay here, you have to eat breakfast and lunch at Sante. We had Franklin as our waiter most days and he was by far the best employee at the resort, always smiling, friendly, and attentive. Five star service!!

reviews.author: Laura Lopez
reviews.text: We’re very happy to return to Paradisus Palma Real where we got married five years ago (with our infant daughter). It’s been so nice to see Alvaro and Wanda again (and Irvin who has been really helpful). Maria at the Lunch Box has been remarkable and so caring. Milton, Raider and Ana over at Mascalzone and his team provides exceptional service (the food was delicious!) and Juan over at Rum Republic was incredible. It’s nice to be back at our home away from home.

reviews.author: Aga Scott
reviews.text:
The hotel is nice but not everything is accessible for standard guests. Some parts are for Circle members some for reserved members so you can’t go everywhere.
Rooms are slightly outdated and need maintenance (which was actioned quickly).
Drinks are lovely and Mina restaurant was our favourite. Room service was quick but not the best.
Some members of staff are really nice, Arisleida was lovely at the beach and spoke superb English.

reviews.author: Tanja Mirazic
reviews.text: Just finished having a fantastic dinner at Mina steakhouse, celebrating our parents 50th anniversary.  Celia, and her Team were phenomenal.  Thank-you for the anniversary cake, and show!

reviews.author: Jillian S
reviews.text: What a special resort! It is beautiful, immaculately clean, and the staff could not work harder to make you happy and feel special. The food is excellent. Happy boy and Reynaldo on the entertainment staff were especially warm, fun and encouraged my mom and I to take part in lots of dancing and fun activities. We especially loved making dolls, Aqua trampoline and dancing at night at Gabi beach. Thank you for everything, we can’t wait to come back.

reviews.author: Emmanuel Morin
reviews.text: Great food and service by Jose at Brisas.  We enjoyed grilled lobster quite a number of times. Jose is such a nice guy,  helpful and always of good advises.

reviews.author: Aja
reviews.text: Visited this resort with my partner and another couple. We had a great experience. The property itself was beautiful and the rooms were nice, clean, and updated. This is a good choice if you are looking for a more chill vibe. Our concierges Ralphy and Deysi made sure we have everything we needed. They booked our dinner reservations each night. At the first restaurant (the steakhouse) we waited an hour for our food to come out and when it did it was not hot. The 2nd night, Milton at the italian restaurant (Mas Calzones) was great, him and our waitress took care of us. Overall, the food was subpar to me, I basically ate pizza and chicken the whole time. That was really my only complaint. They have multiple pools, some with swim up bars. Overall we had a good experience and would visit again.

reviews.author: Joe
reviews.text: I have had a great experience at the hotel and all the activities such as volleyball! I also enjoyed the dancing and football the food is great as well. Special thanks to John Springer and Jorge Rafael for the help! The were great at teaching volleyball, would love to come back again.

reviews.author: shena wheaton
reviews.text: Me and my spouse stayed at Paradisus Palma Real Punta Cana. During our stay we had three fantastic waiters that stood out Melina Etien, José Pierre and Raider. They were very attentive to our needs and surprised my spouse with a birthday song and cake. They were very nice and provided and great hospitality. This made our stay and experience 5 stars and I will definitely come back.

reviews.author: Steve Greenwald
reviews.text: This is a few months overdue, but...We had a such a great time at The Reserve! Our concierge, Sam was incredible! Really, the entire staff was unbelieveably hospitable and kind. Sam took the guess work out of everything. Anything we wanted to do and anything we had questions on, he had the answers. He also made all of our reservations for all dinners. I would highly recommend this resort to anyone, especially for families and small children. When you're there, make sure to take care of the staff because they'll definitely take care of you!

reviews.author: Sara Zuluaga Munoz
reviews.text: This has been the best place we have stayed at. Above the atmosphere, the food, and the rooms, the service has been the best of it all. It has truly been what makes this place the most amazing resort to ever stay at. Omar has been the number one best that had made us feel the most welcome and accommodated us with everything, he’s made sure we have been safe when going anywhere out of the resort and also been the one we can count on in the resort for anything. Lenninson has also been one of the people to be so attentive and caring and patient. Every server has been so nice and have always made sure to make the impossible happen but as i mentioned before above all omar.

reviews.author: Javier
reviews.text: This was our first time visiting Punta Cana and the Paradisus Palma Real was a great choice. The location was excellent and the food really good, which is always a concern at an all inclusive as we are picky eaters but the food really was superb. The staff was extremely attentive and we felt very welcome. We stayed in the Royal Service part of the hotel and our butler Armando made the overall experience seamless and effortless. He was very attentive of our dining requests and every detail of our stay, great service and hospitality on his part. We enjoyed the trip and hope to come back soon!

reviews.author: Ashley Martin
reviews.text: This hotel offered an experience like no other!it truly was the perfect vacation. From the moment we stepped out of the car Melvin and Jose greeted us and their warm welcome set the bar high for the remainder of the trip. Love this resort and the staff!!

reviews.author: Weldesemayat Bi
reviews.text: This place was awesome from the beginning to the end not only it’s a beautiful place but the people that work very hard to make it the most welcoming and restful place to come to. Let’s start with Ralphy our concierge who was excellent and extremy professional who took care of me and my family throughout the trip you are the best brother thank you for going above and beyond. You are a true asset to the company and I hope management sees how hard you work and make people happy. Hansel, Trefeno, Jonathan, Jose and Quainto the best bartenders, servers that took care of us like we are family thank you for all your smiles and positivity and above all your professionality. The staff at the lunch box who made sure we have a table every morning since we were a family of eight which is very hard to do but they made sure to do that every day starting with Vivianny who made sure we were taken care of every day. Thank you to Yudelquis, Franklin, Alexandra and Maria and all the other staff for their extreme professionalism. The staff at the grill and all others that I forgot their name I just want to say we really had an excellent time and until next time.

reviews.author: Damaris Almanzar
reviews.text: Very nice staff. Beautiful and spacious rooms. The food is really good. Amazing drinks at Rum Republic. Maria is the best and sweetest. We had the Passion Mamajuana infused with spice smoke. It was a treat.

reviews.author: Alicia Macom
reviews.text:
Lewis made our stay care free.  He is professional,  kind, and knowledgeable about the resort as well as the outside activities.     He attended to all our requests in a timely and efficient manor and made
Our stay from NYC better than we expected.    Absolutely amazing.

reviews.author: Susie Kovass
reviews.text: The bar at the InBetween (between the Italian and Mexican restaurants) was a great bar. They really hussle w drink service.  They we super friendly and gave us service with a smile. Miguel is a sweet guy too ☺️ Ramon at the pool was spectaular server. He came over to check on us a lot and even made sure we had fresh drinks while we were in the pool. And saved us seats the following day. Maximo and Juan were the best at the wine bar. Very informational about wine. And super helpful when it came to dinner service. They really hustled on their service too. The rooms are very clean and the housekeeping service was amazing. The food in general is just “ok” the drinks are “ok” too. It is what it is but service was good all around

reviews.author: Celina Virjee
reviews.text:
We have been at Paradisus Palma Real for 3 days and are highly disappointed that we wasted our money and long awaited vacation on this resort. From the moment we arrived it has been disappointing and subpar. LThe biggest issues have been poor service and terrible quality food/food preparation and handling. Here is a list of specific examples from the last 72 hours:

1. As soon as we arrived, we were told they did not have our name listed on their guest reservation list. The individual who met us at the shuttle said we didn’t have a reservation and that we have come to the wrong place. As you can imagine, we were totally stressed and panic stricken as we scrambled to find our email confirmations for this expensive trip we had paid for. When we showed them our email confirmation they shrugged it off and took us to the check in counter where we were told the room would not be ready for half an hour. We were taken to the buffet to pass the time, but the food options were very limited. We saw another person with a plate of fries, we asked for the same thing for our toddler
and were sent from one staff person to the next only to be eventually told they didn’t have any. Yet we saw them with our own eyes. Then we were served raw burgers and I am pregnant - this is unsafe and unacceptable. This was the start of our food troubles. We took our time for an hour and then went back to the front desk and our room was still not ready. Highly frustrating with a baby.
