2. We have yet to encounter any staff member who can clearly communicate in English. Most staff start speaking to us in Spanish and we are really struggling with communication. We have had room service orders that are wrong because of the language barrier, leaking fridge that was not repaired properly the first time with some communication challenges and very frustrating experience trying to ask for anything in the buffet. Also the servers in the buffet aggressively take away our full plates when we are still eating and frantically saying no we are not finished - this is wasteful and frustrating since it has happened at every meal. Tonight we were told we needed to go to the other side of the buffet since half of it was closing as not enough patrons. It was 8 PM. Tough to relocate with a hungry baby who is eating.

3. The food quality and preparation/handling is very poor. As mentioned above, we were served raw pink burgers. I am a physician and pregnant - this was very alarming to me as it does not meet basic food safety standards. The next morning we ordered omelettes, the eggs were completely raw inside and I had to take them back. There was a large amount of salt thrown into them and not mixed so the eggs were inedible. The bread and cereal are stale. The milk for our baby has been consistently warm ?sitting out. We called room service asking for chicken fingers, which is on the menu - we were told they don’t have any. We asked for fresh juice - they did not have any. At the coffee bar I have asked for 3 different types of smoothies written on the menu in the last 2 days - they first didn’t have chocolate then no banana then no mango. I’m not sure what they do have. The buffet food is always cold.

4. We have seen multiple cockroaches outside our room.

We have stayed at many resorts in the Caribbean and Mexico over the years and this has truly been our worst experience. I have never written a negative Google review but I am upset that our vacation has been a nightmare and we threw away so much money at this place. We initially had a reservation at Finest Punta Cana, which was recommended by multiple friends/colleagues. However we had a great experience at Paradisus Los Cabos two years ago so we thought we were making the right choice by switching to here. We were sorely mistaken. For families, I urge you not to spend your hard earned money and precious family time at this resort. It is a truly regrettable experience. I tried to reach out to Guest Services about our experience but the email bounced back and nobody seems to be able to help me speak with a manager.

reviews.author: Ryan Chamberlain
reviews.text: We just wanted to compliment Luis and Eriol on the top notch service. Despite some issues with our room (and management), they have both been going above and beyond to help us and sort out the issues to help our vacation experience. Our family is very grateful. The location of the hotel is beautiful, and it has so much potential, but the lack of care on the management side gets in the way of what could be amazing.

reviews.author: Dr. Susan Johnson, DBH
reviews.text: Marileisy and Joel were amazing!!! They provided exceptional customer service during our entire trip. They ensured we had cold water and our favorite drinks. On my birthday, they made my day extra special by bringing champagne and additional snacks. Make sure and ask for Joel and Marileisy while at the pool bar. They will take great care of you.

reviews.author: Jack Arnold
reviews.text: A fantastic place for a honeymoon, especially after many days of hiking, it's so nice to relax here. The staff is phenomenal, the food is tasty and the location can't be beat!

reviews.author: Elizabeth Ledbetter
reviews.text:
We had a great experience at Palma Real.our concierge Anayely was very attentive and took care of all our needs promptly and always had a smile for us that made us feel like part of the Melia family. Marilisi was  a superb server at the pool bringing us drinks before we knew we needed them. Yaniri was very attentive at breakfast bringing whatever we needed.  These people worked so hard to make sure we had a great
vacation.  The beach and the pools are beautiful. The rooms are clean and comfortable.  There are plenty of restaurants and bars to choose from. We will definitely go again.

reviews.author: Theo Cameron
reviews.text: Great resort, great staff in particular Fernando, Emmanuel, and Lenninsa at the bellman station, Olvi waiter, and Daisy was an absolute amazing Concierge.  Highly recommend!!! Food was slightly average, Japanese restaurant was best of all restaurants.  Dominican was not good. Mr Room service needs better evening selections...

reviews.author: Nawel
reviews.text: I just had dinner with my family if 8 at Mascalzones, one of the many restaurants at Paradisus Palma Real and we are very pleased. The staff was so accomodating and attentive. The food was great and the service outstanding. Special thanks to our waiters Raynaldo and Riley for a great evening.

reviews.author: Pat G
reviews.text:
Love this hotel and the people who worrk there!
Dayhani B was awesome and helped us with everything we need. Great service, super nice and caring, every day! The people make a big difference and it is what will make us come back.

Luis at the bar is amazing, knows all guests, is the life of the party, makes amazing drinks plus has great input about the area... people make you feel very welcome here!

Big thank you!

reviews.author: Lizette Fernandez
reviews.text: This is the worst resort I have ever visited, please do not be fooled this place looks nice but, looks are deceiving. I booked for 8 days and I REGRET it!!! This place is trash, garbage and, I honestly DO NOT RECOMMEND anyone to spend their money to come here. I booked for my family and myself, total of 4, and each of us feels the same. I am going to write in order. Almost every where you enter has a STRONG smell of scented aromas, if you’re an asthmatic ,suffer from migraines, or are aware that these scented aromas are hazardous and harmful, I felt so sick! Don’t even let me get started on the cigarettes and cigars that are allowed in every section of this resort, which is absolutely ridiculous! The food is horrible, in 2 separate occasions I found hair in my food and my son as well. The only soda they have here is Coca Cola and sprite, which tastes like they kept it in the sun for months before serving it, either it has no flavor or tastes like sugar. The very little activities they have did not do it for us. Bar’s… ginger bar is ok if no one smoking, kicks sports bar is so small, it’s crowded all the time because there is nothing else to do! So disappointed NEVER again. I am not writing all this for my health please believe me. THIS PLACE IS DEFINITELY NOT WORTH SPENDING YOUR MONEY!!!

reviews.author: Jillian Korwek
reviews.text: BEWARE! Only putting 5 stars because my review keeps getting deleted.. I stayed at the Paradisus for 4 days with friends for my bachelorette and everyday was a HUGE nightmare. The resort is beautiful but the service is insanely disappointing. Day 1 we were told to make reservations for dinner at a service desk and when we did, the woman told us that all the restaurants were booked for the next week and we would only be able to eat at the buffet for EVERY meal. When we expressed our concerns to management, they basically said that they did not care and that the buffet was a fine choice. All of the staff was incredibly rude and acted bothered that we were there. They could not understand that we did not want to eat at the buffet and we were paying to have sit down dinners. At one point, we were even told to go to another resort. After wasting the entire first day of our trip arguing with staff about the food options, we were able to make reservations at a few spots (one of which we had to pay extra for) and when we went to dinner, the restaurants were EMPTY. The rude service continued all throughout the week and the “guest service” members, especially Leandra, were so horrible to us. Never have I ever stayed at an all inclusive that treated their guests so poorly. STAY AWAY

reviews.author: RaNyah Crawford
reviews.text:
Anthony Ortiz and Jorge Rafael at the Tequila tasting at Blue Agave were both great! It was nice to make our own Margarita and to get the history on how Margarita’s were developed. Enjoy the experience if you try it.

7/3/23 new post
The activities crew was great our entire stay
Jorge
Jairo
Were wonderful
Soap making, candle making, rum tasting all a great experience

reviews.author: David Peraza
reviews.text: Great hotel at a prime location. I very much enjoyed dining at all the restaurants especially at blue agave where our server Alexander Bryan went above and beyond to make matters work for us especially since my child is only a year and a half. Alexander was very kind, attentive, and professional.

reviews.author: Ethan Guerry
reviews.text:
Our first experience at Paradisus Palma Real. Hector, our concierge, was top notch. Friendly, attentive, and always helpful. He was always eager to make sure we had what we needed and he did it with a smile. Excellent.

Were upgraded to a beach-facing room.

Used spa services twice and found them easy and delightful.

Plenty to do if we chose to, but also easy to relax and do nothing.

reviews.author: Aleida Sanabria-Gil
reviews.text: We had a wonderful time at Paradisus Palma Real. Everyone here is very welcoming and professional. Our concierge Sosa made us feel very welcome as well and helped us with making dinner reservations. One of our servers at the Paradisous was Rosanna. She worked at the Lunch Box.

reviews.author: Tara FALLA
reviews.text:
Me and my friend stayed 1 week in this beautiful resort, we were welcome by Starlin and he took care of us the whole time!

Everyone working here were really nice with us too !

Can’t wait to come back next year !

Great activity with Jorge, Nay and Javier, I recommend 10/10

reviews.author: Eric Rey
reviews.text: Paradisus Palma Real is a beautiful place, but you will know that by just looking at the pictures online. What left us really impressed was the superb and incredibly nice staff and service all-around. The staff was so incredible that I even remember the names of the ones that provided us with the best service we have ever seen. Thank you very much Edisson, Broxni, Yanira, Rosanna, Yafreisy and Santos. You all truly made it an amazing experience. We will be back soon!!

reviews.author: Santino
reviews.text: From the moment I arrived the little Olga greeted us with some drinks, just from arriving we got refreshed and started our trip really good. At the GIN GER Bar we met Antonio, Ismael and another Olga which made our experience even BETTER. We talked a lot with them and made jokes and everything. It was PERFECT.

reviews.author: Christine Stirling
reviews.text:
Super friendly staff.  Was here during a conference and there was plenty of beach and pools spots
Rooms were spacious and very clean !!!
Beautiful resorts 5 stars for sure.

Martin at the beach adults section was so lovely.

reviews.author: Alejandra Evans
reviews.text: Kelvin Fernandez was an amazing concierge during our time at the Reserve at Paradisus. He helped us with everything including helping us fix my daughter’s phone when it stopped working! He was always very kind to all of us and made reservations for us every day.. the place was beautiful the food was excellent and he made our experience even better!!

reviews.author: will davis
reviews.text:
This resort is over the top amazing!!!

We had the Honeymoon our dreams recently!!

The resort is absolutely gorgeous, magazine worthy!!

Food absolutely incredible, best quality buffet we have ever experienced and the restaurants were fabulous!! Best dining we have ever had a resort, incredible.

What I think really makes this place though are the employees, they are fabulous.

We wanted to recognize a few people below that made out trip unbelievable.

•	Concierge: Manuel, he was absolutely spectacular, took amazing care of us in everyway possible. Anything we needed he was all over it! Very responsive, got us the best reservations, made out room up for a honeymoon surprise, etc. He was AMAZING
•	Beach Captain: Rafael Guerrero, did everything to make sure our day on the beach was perfect and relaxing. He is a great leader and we really enjoyed spending time on the beach
•	Beach Bartender: Gilberto, makes the best drinks and was extremely nice and fun to be around
•	Reserve pool bartender 1:Rosanna, was such a great bartender and host of her pool!!! these two really made the experience great for us!!
•	Reserve pool bartender 2: Ariseledia, was such a great bartender and host of her pool!!! these two really made the experience great for us!!
•	Rum Republic bartender, was so great and made amazing drinks
•	Ginger staff, made awesome drinks and coffee
•	Sante staff, this staff did an amazing job 3 meals a day!
•	Reserve Pool bartender: Jonathan Rodriguez, went out of his way too make sure we had everything we needed by the pool! Awesome guy
•	General buffet staff - awesome people that worked very hard to make such a great experience!!

reviews.author: Dreamma Mendoza
reviews.text: This stay has been wonderful all around. But the best part was our dinner at Mascalzone. The hostess Daniela helped to make sure my daughter had a great birthday and the servers were amazing. We had Bernabel and Wilmina who were very attentive. Special thanks to Milton for running such a wonderful restaurant and thanks again for helping to make my daughters birthday extra special!

reviews.author: K Tunca
reviews.text: We went to celebrate our honeymoon and we loved our stay. The service is amazing, lovely, helpful personal. Food was ok, I recommend doing a new a la carte restaurant everyday for dinner. The restaurants are better than the open buffet for sure. They suprised us with some fruit and red wine upon arrival which was very kind. Big thanks to Arisleida for being so positive, Wily for being so kind and helpful, Ismael for the best drinks & keeping us hydrated and Jorge for good entertainment.

reviews.author: Eileen Tirado
reviews.text: My favorite bar is Ginger. I received the best coffee and attention I could ever ask for. Ismael, Antonio, Dominga, Olga, Yeni, and Clary were incredibly attentive, and their drink crafting skills are amazing. I will definitely come back.

reviews.author: W K
reviews.text: Malina was our server and was cheerful and very sweet.  She went above and beyond to make our evening perfect.  The food was one of the best meals during our stay.  We will be sure to be back again soon!

reviews.author: Peter Doukas
reviews.text:
Amazing resort, Martin, Isaias, Wanda, and Roberto were wonderful and made every aspect of the reserve incredible and relaxing. Very great pool/beach service.
Cristian was our concierge and he would bend over backwards to make sure we had everything we needed.
10/10 recommend

reviews.author: Debbie FieldService
reviews.text: I had a wonderful time at Paradisus!!  The resort is beautiful and really clean, and the food was great. I had a Concierge, Kelvin Fernandez, who assisted with my dinner reservations, sent me the daily activities, and was always there to see that everything was going well!  I had a great time!

reviews.author: Alexandra Valencia
reviews.text: Great location, and great service. We are frequent travelers, and this is one of the better family vacations we’ve experienced They have fun for all ages at the resort. Five stars to Hector, our Concierge that helped us by booking great dinners, excursions, and overall made us feel very welcomed.

reviews.author: smita patadia
reviews.text: We had great Experience , great staff, great service, everyone was accommodating. Being Indian vegetarian they made special Vegetarian food for us. We were group of 8 people and they made vegetarian lunch and dinner for us. I want to thank Santo Avila he took care of our Lunch and Dinner with his team chef Fernando and Joselo, Hojaro,  Juan, Sente and manager Carlos he took care of our Italian dinner, and Luis from Lunch Box took care of for Indian lunch and dinner with chef Vanktesh. I want to thank our Concierge Chis to make reservations for us. I also want to thank waitresses Rosanna, Yanita and Ramon  for their service

reviews.author: Pedro Grande Quintanilla
reviews.text:
Sport Bar Kiks is the best place in the hotel.
José del Rosario is a great man, atento y servicial .
Yiris the chief is a great boss

reviews.author: Enmanuel Iacono Vizcaino
reviews.text: We had a wonderful time at Ginger Bar, thanks to the amazing service of Ismael, Nereida, Quintín and the rest of the team. They were friendly, attentive and professional, making sure we had everything we needed during our Synlawn conference. They also gave us some great recommendations for drinks and food, We felt welcomed and pampered by their hospitality, and we can't wait to come back again. Ginger Bar is definitely one of our favorite places to hang out and have fun.

reviews.author: Raquel Rubalcaba
reviews.text:
Great experience overall.
Some things to improve:
- Smelly room (constant sewage odor)
- Some basic things took forever (for example, we never had our last lunch after waiting for more than one hour to eat)
- A lot of plastics on the wonderful beach.

reviews.author: Justin Stone
reviews.text: Flora restaurant was excellente. We had Caesar as a waiter and he crushed it. Well done

reviews.author: Alex Shparber
reviews.text:
Supper attentive staff throughout the hotel. All of the workers at the kids club are supper friendly and great with children.  Our 2 girls were very hesitant to be dropped off at a place they've never been to, but after their first time at Kidsdom, they were happy to leave us and spend time with the counselors.

The food is pretty decent at most of the a la cart restaurants, but we all preferred the selection at the buffet.

We all enjoyed our stay, and will certainly be back soon.

reviews.author: Shannon Anger
reviews.text:
There is a lady working at The Lunch Box her name is Yuderqui she is by far the best person we have met here.
Ginger Bar is the best! Ismael Domingo Olga Clari is an excellent barista. He made me the best Oreo frappuccino! The Flora restaurant is amazing! The food the atmosphere is wonderful!

reviews.author: John Cabal
reviews.text: Cana restaurant is by far one of my favorite places to eat at this resort. The staff is very attentive and didn’t hesitate to make us comfortable and give us what we needed. Luis, Orbis, Virginia, Alex Wander y John were amazing!

reviews.author: Jessi Grant
reviews.text: We loved the staff at 90°. They were all amazing! Rosanna, Eddy, and Arisleida were all incredible. Best service we had the entire stay! They were fun and nice. Made great drinks, danced and made our stay incredible!!! We love them!!!

reviews.author: Michelle Tisonczyk
reviews.text:
I had to change my review.
They had us post a review the second day or so. My review has changed since then.
We were having a great time, but our room didn’t have any warm water. Bathroom sink, shower, bath, and we politely asked everyday and let people know. The service desk also wrote down our complaints. We didn’t get help at all. And we remained without warm water our ENTIRE trip.
The manager said, “it’s only service” as if service doesn’t matter. It’s the most important thing actually.

reviews.author: John Cardea
reviews.text:
Concierge Jose Simon was fantastic. He helped us have a fantastic honeymoon, upgraded our room, and handling scheduling activities for us. Can’t say enough great things about him. We throughly enjoyed the pool and all the service we got while relaxing, especially from Wanda at the pool bar by the Reserve.

Staff at Sante (Yieauri, Eduardo, Saudys, Pamela) all provided great service too, and Franklin was great every morning for breakfast.

The only downside would be the food. We did get raw chicken one day and the food was just ok, but that is ok considering it’s all inclusive. The steakhouse, Italian, and hibachi were the best options.

Our trip ended with and east checkout process with Darianna Felix.

reviews.author: Jeanette Evans
reviews.text: This was a top flight resort. The staff was very friendly and pleasant. I had an ocean view suite, which was awesome. In my room, I was greeted with a cheese plate and 2 bottles of different types of Dominican Rum plus a wine bottle of Merlot and a fully stock mini bar. There was a personal concierge assigned to me. This guy's name was Felix, and you talk about a person's dedication to their job, then Felix was excellent. Felix came to greet me at my room on my first night stay to introduce himself and to let me know he would be of assistance to me during my stay. He provided his personal contact number to me via WhatsApp.  You talking about awesome service Felix delivered a 1000%  every morning  I received a text from him to see if there was anything I needed to make my stay enjoyable. He booked restaurants for me and kept me on top of everything. He even took me around the resort, which was very beautiful to show me where the various restaurants were located and how to get around the resort using shortcuts to the various activities. Felix checked in on me every night by text to make sure my day went well and that I had made it safely back to the resort on the days I went on excursions. There were certain staff members in the restaurants that provided great service. The young lady Ana which I saw everyday for breakfast at the Lunch Box restaurant was sweet as pie, The porter Manuel who made sure my bags were delivered and picked up from my room promptly for return home.   The young lady Anna at the lobby bar made excellent drinks and always served with the biggest smile one could ask for. Our waiter at the Mexican Restaurant Devan gave great service as Felix had arranged for us to celebrate my girlfriend birthday while we were there. Felix even had our table decorations in her favorite color of orange and had the restaurant bring a beautiful cake out while the restaurant staff sang Happy Birthday to her. I highly recommend this all-inclusive resort and the concierge Felix. You won't be dissatisfied.   Felix even texted me just to check to see if I arrived back home safely the next morning. Now tell me, that's not great service. I will be returning to this resort again definitely for vacation, and I will definitely be asking that Felix be assigned to me. He was awesome, fantastic, caring, and just the best person to work with. Thank you, Felix, for your great care and service

reviews.author: Alex Lopez
reviews.text:
The experience at Brisas was amazing, I loved every dish from breakfast to morning. Wonderful staff and a most beautiful time. Very punctual and personal, I couldn't ask for more

Thank you to Jose and Rosa for a delightful time!

reviews.author: Charles Pressner
reviews.text: Luis Rodriguez, Kanna restaurant, is an excellent server! He is exceptional and I totally recommend you ask for him only! He personally had this dish made for us when it was offered at time we wanted it. I recommend him for a higher position .

reviews.author: Michelle Lynch
reviews.text:
Definitely do the pillones painting! We had a great time and made a souvenir to take home! Brandol and Giovani were so friendly and made the experience so much fun!

The buffet staff are amazing! The food is scrumptious! Maria and Yafreisy are two of the best staff!!

reviews.author: Jeiry Batista
reviews.text: this insane really good. the rooms are beautiful and spacious. very clean. the food is good quality, especially at the dominican restaurant named Flora. i was served by Cesar who was extremely kind and welcoming to us. excellent service!

reviews.author: Jessica Delossantos
reviews.text: A beautiful resort. The food was great and the service was top notch for a family with kids or just adults. Jose Ramirez was great with following up with us to ensure we didn’t need anything and to help with our luggage. I would definitely recommend this resort to anyone.

reviews.author: Ruth Perez
reviews.text:
I went with my daughters 19 and 13 and we had best vacations ever!!! We had a blast, too much to do, excellent food, great confortable, clean beautiful rooms, amazing entertainment, very diverse and fresh food either at the buffet or the restaurants, and the best staff and service I ever experienced. They took care of us the whole stay, the concierge department is fenomenal. Having Alejandro has been one of the highlights of this trip, he is a great professional who knows how to treat the guests, respectful, into details, caring, a good listener, even when you don’t say anything, seems like he is a mind reader and he has outdone our expectations. Is gonna be hard not having him back home 😊.
If we come back to DR we will repeat, no doubt at all, hopefully soon.
And I’ll recommend this hotel always because a destination can be good but it will turn into AMAZING if you stay in the right place , and nothing better than Paradisus Palma Real family, they make you feel like home ❤️

reviews.author: Shraddha Walker
reviews.text: The activities were a great diversion! We had such fun making soap with Brandol - he was so accommodating, even when I got distracted by the great conversation and messed up my soap! A thoroughly enjoyable experience and a lovely little keepsake! And making pizzas was a fun mid-afternoon activity.

reviews.author: Marcela J.Bendana
reviews.text: Alexandra and Saylis were amazing in the coffee shop!

reviews.author: Liz Hernandez
reviews.text: The bartenders from 90 degrees Rossana and Jose are so so nice and pleasant to be around. Also the waitresses Lenny, Nelson and Yorgelys were so great. Very attentive. Sweetest staff.

reviews.author: Javier Carbonell
reviews.text: Loved my stay. Employees attention to detail and service to its guests made our stay memorable. A special call out to Yahira, Rosanna, and Maria who made every one of my meal experiences extra special.

reviews.author: Michelle DeStefano
reviews.text: The Ginger Bar staff; Ismael, Antonio, Dominga, Olga & Clari are Fantastic!! They are so warm and welcoming and serve up amazing drinks! Love visiting them everyday on vacation!

reviews.author: Michelle Stein
reviews.text: Jose Del Rosario was our server and service was excellent. Food very tasty. Highly recommend! Yiri supervisora also provided great service.

reviews.author: Christinne Jeffs
reviews.text: Exelent luxury resort, the attention is awesome and the cuality of the facilities and the food is prime. I love to come here, the beautiful beach and how peaceful it is. You can disconnect from the world and enjoy your vacation here.  Nice activities for the family . Maria from the spa gave us marvelous service . The rooms are super comfortable and have beautiful views.  I recommend this a hundred percent 👌.

reviews.author: Ryan Deschamps
reviews.text:
I recently had the pleasure of staying at Paradisus Palma Real in the Dominican Republic, and I cannot say enough about the exceptional service provided by the staff at the adults-only "Reserve" area. Yuderi, Raphael, Gilberto, Yelson and Fernando truly went above and beyond to make my stay unforgettable.

From the moment I arrived at the beach, I was greeted with warm smiles and a genuine eagerness to assist.  I had the perfect spot on the beach each and every day! They also seemed to know exactly when to come by to offer a refreshing drink.

Our concierge (Fernando) worked tirelessly to ensure that we had everything we needed, from dinner reservations to helping coordinate a private Bachata lesson and a birthday cake for my Girlfriend! I truly felt that he strove to make our experience exceptionally memorable!

The staff at Paradisus Palma Real are a testament to the exceptional service standards of this resort. Their dedication, warmth, and professionalism made my stay extraordinary, and I can't wait to return for another unforgettable experience. Thank you for making my vacation truly special!

reviews.author: Jaimie Miller
reviews.text: The resort is beautiful! The massage was one of the best I’ve had. Hector was the best concierge and surprised me with a cake for my 35th birthday. Grey and Antonio made the best drinks! Will definitely be back.

reviews.author: Mia Workman
reviews.text: Food is good and fresh, Jimbert and Milton are the best!

reviews.author: John Berendsen
reviews.text: The resort was the best resort we have ever been too!! Everything was stunning, our room close to the beach, use of hut cabanas everyday, the beach and water was clean and clear, the grounds were stunning!! We loved the food and had great variety, very tasty.  Our butler JUAN Castillo was so helpful, kind and guided us every day with what was going on!! He helped us check out the day before which was so helpful. He is the best of the best!! We absolutely live this resort and will highly recommend it to all when we return to Canada!! Pedro at the beach helping us has been a gem too, so positive and fun!! Thank you so much Junior from Air Transat for such professional service!! So pleased and happy with Palma Real Resorts!!❤

reviews.author: Laurie Kreisberg
reviews.text:
Enjoyed the pizza 🍕 class with Brandol,, candle and soap making activity.

The hotel grounds are beautiful and immaculate. Our ocean view room
In the reserve is great

Food is just ok!  Lots of seaweed at beach.

Maria at the rum bar is so kind and makes amazing drinks.  For her it is an art that she takes quite seriously!  Outstanding barista

reviews.author: David Jacobson
reviews.text:
Fantastic stay at Palma Real. The renovations made over the last year are quite amazing (last visit April 2022). Definitely our best experience yet.

The staff is fantastic, helpful and friendly.

Special shout out to Santo at Tokimeku (hibachi restaurant), Felix at Flora (Dominican restaurant) and Joel, Hansel and Raul at the pool/beach bar (those guys are the best!

Last but not least - Francesco and Lewis are amazing concierge/butlers. They do anything to make sure you have a great stay!

reviews.author: Liz Graham
reviews.text:
We visited the Paradisis for a brief wedding site inspection last week for two nights.  It has been 10 years since I visited this property last and I was pleasantly surprised with the accommodation and restaurant upgrades but I missed the Flamingoes!

We stayed in a pool-front suite in the Reserve Section (Adults only) which was beautiful with great access to the rest of the property and the Sante Restaurant.

Felix Garcia was our Concierge and he was outstanding!   He made our brief stay so easy and seamless.  He provided property info, made our reservations for dinner both evenings, booked us a return transfer at the airport, had our safe reopened promptly after we locked ourselves out, brought our luggage back to the Lobby when we were departing and was basically at our service, with prompt, friendly and efficient service every minute of our stay.  Thank you Felix!

reviews.author: Jaime Phillips
reviews.text: The dinner at Flora was fabulous. Our waiter Caesar was great. He was helpful with the menu. The ambience was perfect. The interior was decorated so nice. It was a pleasurable dinner.

reviews.author: AVA
reviews.text:
A total disappointment! I spent 6 days at the Paradisus Palma Real with my partner, everything was a disaster from the moment we arrived. During the check-in process they made a mistake with our room, after that it took them 2 hours to give us the correct one, and even then they did not have the details requested in the reservation for our special occasion.

These mistakes often happen in hotels, but what surprised us was that the hotel staff seemed neither to care nor to be surprised by the situation.

To every question we had about the hotel they told us that the butler would be in charge of informing us. What a surprise, the butler was of no use, he did not respond to messages in a reasonable time, nor did he solve our problems. Additionally, on two occasions he mentioned having booked our dinner, only to arrive at the restaurant and find out that it was not the case.

The hotel has a big problem with the service and communication between its departments, the hair dryer in our room did not work, we insisted three days in a row that they change it, in the end we gave up, the same thing happened with the bathrobes, they They took them and never replaced them.

The staff does not do their job well, no one serves you at the pool or beach, and they always have a bad face. As for the food and drink, a constant disappointment, the quality is really not up to par with a 5-star hotel. After all these events we decided to talk to the manager, it was of no use, the example of disorganization. In short, he would never recommend a stay at this hotel to anyone.

PS. Don't be fooled by the good reviews. Employees who serve you acceptably harass you to leave good reviews through a QR that leads you to create a review of the hotel. They insist that you mention their name, but the review is for the hotel. In short, they want to maintain the image that the hotel is a 5-star experience, while not making the adjustments required to significantly improve. Very unfortunate.

reviews.author: Gian Carlos Barrera Miranda
reviews.text: Amazing hotel with great food and drinks! The kicks sports bar is awesome, great live music most nights, different games, dj, and a pool table. Luis Rosario and his team are the nicest and most attentive people I’ve met ! Keep up the great work ! Will definitely be vacationing at this hotel again.

reviews.author: Cheri Huber
reviews.text:
We had a great time at this resort - awesome view from our room, and delicious food.  Sometimes the buffet food wasn’t real hot, but it still tasted good. Angelo was a great butler - he was always accessible & eager to please.
There’s plenty of beach to walk - which is nice. There was a lot of ‘salesmen’ along the beach but they’re very good about not pushing after you tell them you’re not interested- most of them were very friendly, in fact.
Overall beautiful resort, friendly staff & great food.
We really have no complaints...

reviews.author: Erika Dawn
reviews.text:
Luciano del Rosario & LLOELIS ALVAREZ & Pedro
Greeting service and Luggage  service was excellent, checking in was difficult as we had to wait 5 hours to get a room and when we were taken to our room, the plumbing was torn apart in the floor being worked on, we waited another hour to get into our room.
All the bartenders and beach servers and room service and housekeeping were excellent. The lunch box buffet wasn't the best quality it was when we visited here 4 years ago & it disappointed us, but the restaurants were delicious with fantastic service.
The beach sand pools were kept very clean and all in all it was a fabulous vacation!

reviews.author: Mike Byrnes Investing Journey
reviews.text: We had a tremendous stay, back for a second time. We returned for our anniversary at the same resort in which we were married. It has only improved and we really enjoyed our stay. The food, the ambiance, everything was spectacular. We had the best concierge in Eriol. He went above and beyond in making our stay special. Jonathan at the pool bar was tremendous. Manuel, Pedro, Pedro and José were amazing at the checkout. All in all it was a great experience and we will be back again.

reviews.author: Antanina Petroglia
reviews.text:
Very beautiful place!! Great food, and service especially Rosanna y Hilda y Yorgeli in the buffet.

Amazing sports bar Kicks, the drinks and atmosphere are great. Bartenders are very good especially Natanael. He was very kind, and always made sure everyone’s glass was full.

The main pool bar in the water is also amazing!! What a great thing to have when I first arrived here I thought it was so cool. But what’s even cooler are the bartenders especially Johnathon Rodriguez!! He’s so amazing, kind, and a great bartender. His experience clearly shows in his drinks, and he is just so amazing. Can’t wait to come back and visit the pool bar for him again!!!

reviews.author: Mary Bond
reviews.text: Incredible experience and service. Alexandra is fabulous!

reviews.author: Jurabek Menglibaev
reviews.text: If you’re used to the level of customer service and attention to detail of Cancun, Mexico, do not even consider visiting this resort. It’s evident that most workers simply don’t care about your needs and will try to avoid any initial requests you may have by saying it’s impossible. The food at any restaurant is quite sub-par and the food is terribly under seasoned. No matter where you go in the resort there is an issue with the food. It’s always either terribly chewy, undercooked, or charred to a crisp. Food options are extremely limited, especially for kids who are often forced to consume nothing but terribly bland chicken nuggets that have been sitting under a heat lamp for hours. There are also security concerns with peddlers on the beach constantly harassing guests to buy parasailing tickets or go snorkeling. These people are not only very persistent and don’t let you rest, they also try to extort unknowing guests for money and in some cases steal belongings when nobody is around. Hotel staff and management lured me into a timeshare presentation with the promises of a “special lunch” as well as “room and service” upgrades. Upon listening to these people try to lock me into a contract for several decades and politely declining, they provided no services that were initially promised by just listening to their presentation. Essentially, I was robbed of several hours of my time. The grills at the buffet are questionably dirty just like everything else in the buffet. The food at the snack by the beach, the only place to eat lunch if you’re not a special circle member, has some of the least appetizing and dry food ever. For the thousands that were paid up-front, it was expected that the management would not block advertised foods and services behind several pay-walls and tier-based memberships. When complaining to management, I couldn’t even get to talk to someone for 3 hours. I wouldn’t ever consider returning here considering that the food, location, services, and overall resort are much better in Cancun for an even cheaper price! Even if you tip the workers, which I had done, the level of service or food doesn’t improve. Terrible experience, ruined vacation and such a waste of time and money!

reviews.author: Lauren Wurdeman
reviews.text: Jose Ramos and Rosanny were fantastic! They did an amazing job at Brisas where we had lunch every day. He was very attentive, kind to the baby and knew what we wanted every time. He kept our drinks full and was timely and kind. He was very conversational and personal. Rosanny was so kind and was very sweet and attentive. Each lunch and breakfast we were well cared for!

reviews.author: Nicollette Meyer
reviews.text: Luis Diaz is the BEST bartender! We have been coming here for years and look forward to seeing him. He provides beyond 5 star service. And also makes SUPER drinks! Can’t wait to see him soon! We also love Maximo Cedono. He was fantastic during our stay. We love it here!!!!

reviews.author: Joshua Hernandez
reviews.text:
Emmanuel at the front of the lobby was very helpful. He helped with taking care of of us with our excursion. Calling us when our ride showed up. Him and Pedro Reyes were awesome! Thank you!!

Magda has been an amazing person! She welcomed us with opened armes. From day one, she has been awesome! Luis, her supervisor has been a delight as well. This resort has been a dream! Thank you for your great service.

reviews.author: Leslie Samuels
reviews.text: As this is my first time visiting this beautiful resort. And I will definitely return. I came with my best friend for a big birthday. A big thank you to Fernando( personal concierge )for making her birthday amazing. He definitely went above and beyond. From having our beach area decorated our room was surprisingly decorated as well, and our table for dinner. The staffcame out to sing happy birthday with a birthday cake. Fernando is a true asset to this company and you are  lucky to have him on your staff. Also a big shout out to Olga (ginger bar)Wanda, and Jose’ at (adult side bars )also Rafael and Martin( adult beach area )and Gladys( spa). She has magical hands lol .Everyone honestly that we have had contact with are truly amazing people and I can’t wait to visit again soon. 😁

reviews.author: Chris Jones
reviews.text:
Blue agave had amazing food & Edito was hands down the best waiter. Would highly recommend.
Jael poured wonderful drinks as well.

Tokimeku hibachi was a wonderful experience because of Daniel & Fanni was a phenomenal server.

reviews.author: Camilla Kuhl
reviews.text: Cesar , olivi , and welinto at Melia the steak restaurant were great servers and gave us great service. Was definitely the best restaurant at the resort! Also Nicholas our concierge he was amazing! he helped us a lot to make our reservations, helped us really with any need. 10/10 for the service with Nicholas. Definitely deserves a raise!

reviews.author: Liliana Jurado
reviews.text: Great stay at Paradisus Palma Real! I’m wowed! Beautiful room, excellent service, delicious food and gorgeous beach. I cant say enough about Maria and Yanina at the Lunch Box. They were always attentive with us, even preparing a table for us ahead of time knowing we were coming for breakfast and lunch. A few other shout outs! Shout out to John at the front for always checking on us, making sure we were comfortable and transporting us. Also, shout out to Maria Teresa who took great care in cleaning and prepping our room every day. And last shout out to Yosmaira at the Maia Spa for treating us like royalty. Thank you so much Yosmaira 😃 we are leaving relaxed, happy and with wonderful memories. Will be back! Until next time!

reviews.author: Tee K
reviews.text: Amazing service! Luciana was absolutely amazing, anything we needed she made sure to help us. Definitely will be coming back! Cirilo and Ebony at Tokimeku were amazing! The service was great, will come again!

reviews.author: Vero S
reviews.text: The service at the Blueagave restaurant at Paradisus Palma Real hotel was excellent!! Marbin, the restaurant manager was awesome, very kind and helpful, he made sure we had everything we needed and then some. Also,  I want to mention Stefannie, the customer service manager was AWESOME!!!!! she was on top of every detail to guarantee a great culinary experience and a great stay. Thanks to these two wonderful and hard workers!!

reviews.author: Cheryl Biron
reviews.text:
Just had a wonderful margarita lesson from Miguel the bartender and ceviche lesson by Angel. They were both very friendly and knowledgeable! The Activities Coordinator Hairon did a great job explaining and translating when needed. All in all a fun experience I recommend very much!

Santé Restaurant, delicious food and attentive service. Captain Eduardo and Eziquel are so welcoming and helpful. Hostess Estebanni greets us with a beautiful smile and invites us choose our table, a nice, shady, breezy table with a beautiful view.

The waitstaff is very friendly and attentive, helping us learn more Spanish and accommodating special requests. Sunirda , Gustavo, Franklin, Luz and Juan watch to see if we need anything and often ask as well. Much better service than typical US restaurants.

This morning Cristal, the bartender made me the most delicious jugo verde (green juice) full of vegetables, just like I love it!

Wanda made me delicious drinks and Grael also at reserve pool bar very attentive!
Ruby bartender in Between made delicious cosmos. So sweet and fri
Laura hostess at Blue Agave always smiling and very warm and friendly!

We highly recommend Santé Restaurant!

reviews.author: Emmie Victoria
reviews.text: Really happy with the service we have received during our stay at this wonderful hotel. Maria at the rum republic bar made us some delicious cocktails. Would highly recommend

reviews.author: Amara G.
reviews.text: Julio has very good service and the restaurants are to die for. Plus we enjoyed the vibe and drinks at the sports bar. Everything was a vibe. Appreciate everything and everyone who helped our experience in Dominican be the best it could be.

reviews.author: B Chan
reviews.text: Shoutout to Ismael, Antonio, Dominga, Yeni, and Clary at the gingerbar. Loved this resort and loved this bar. Everyone was so lovely, always welcoming with a nice warm smile. Great variety of coffee available. Top notch service.

reviews.author: Ausim Chaaban
reviews.text: Everyone was lit and all the staff are very nice Espically freilyn that guy is the goat and he’s also very nice I met him everyday and had a blast would recommend but the one restaurant that is whatever is the Mexican one bland n no flavour as I would’ve expected but overall it was a blast shout out too my goat freilyn tho he deserves a raise

reviews.author: Olga L
reviews.text: Loved dinner at Flora's. The food was delicious with big portions. Our waitress, Estefanía provided excellent service and made us feel right at home. Best meal at hotel.

reviews.author: James Tarver
reviews.text: Re: Restaurant Flora. We dined at Flora our 1st night at the resort. The food was based on Dominican fare and was overall excellent. Our server Ceasar was attentive,  and efficient and made the meal a fantastic experience. Would dine here again.

reviews.author: Crystal Fingerlin
reviews.text: I had the most relaxing vacation here ,  my concierge Yaleidi Sim.  Was an absolute gem.   She was there for every single thing we needed.  Made my stay the best stay ever. Every day she had our dinner reservations.   And was such a pleasure to work with. Bell boy Jose Ramirez was so pleasant and helped so much

reviews.author: Hailey Gibson
reviews.text: Maira, Francesca, and Laicha are wonderful! Great service! Great place ◡̈ Tokimeku was so fun!! Santo is amazing!!!  Delicious food. Ismael, Antonio, Dominga, Nereida, Clary at the Ginger Bar were fantasti!

reviews.author: Natalie Korsik
reviews.text:
This is my second time coming back to Paradisus. The first time I came a few years back, I had an incredible experience. I raved about this resort to my husband and we decided to come here for our vacation and to celebrate his birthday. This time around the experience was average at best.

The rooms are renovated and spacious, the staff is friendly and helpful, always willing to help. The beach is beautiful and the overall resort is clean and nice.
Those are the good parts, but like with everything, there is a caveat with not so good parts. The restaurant experience was a complete nightmare. Let me elaborate further.

As soon as you arrive, you are required to make reservations for the restaurants on the property- without the reservation they won't seat you. No such thing as you will walk in anywhere you want and be seated. It sounds great, exclusive and helpful until they tell you they don't have any reservations available and their system is not working. So to put it simply, can't go to a restaurant without a reservation but also you can't get a reservation for no explained reasons. Either they don't have anything available or the system is not working. There are plenty of restaurants but we were only able to try 3 because 6 others were closed or would not seat us (no reservation). The safe bet is the buffet, the rest, good luck, won't be seated or the resultant won't be opened. After many attempts of calling and practically begging for a reservation, they would let us know they don't have any available. Finally, we were able to make one the day of for only one restaurant that was opened. The advertisement for 9 restaurants is false and deceiving.

We came here to celebrate my husbands birthday. We were planning to enjoy all the restaurants the resort has to offer only to end up at the buffet for lunch, breakfast and dinner. I am not sure if the resort is facing labor shortage, inadequate management, or possibly will be going out of business soon but it's evident it's on the verge of possibly being shut down. The resort was halfway busy, if that.

I will have to say, the whole reservation fiasco put a bad taste in my mouth. I am not sure we will be coming back and brining our family here. Second time coming here was disappointing.

The staff is caring and has to pick up the slack of frustrated customers  but also forces you to write a review on Google and asks you to take a picture afterwards. Felt very forced and insincere.

To end my honest review with a positive note. The staff is wonderful, hard working, helpful, and works very, very hard to pick up the issues that management need to resolve and not trickle down to their workers to deal with.

All the praise and shout out goes to the wait staff in the ginger bar to Olga, Dominga, Clari, Elisabeth, Antonio. All the attentive staff in the Lunch Box buffet. The management gets none, as they are no where to be found to speak to customers even though we asked numerous times to speak to them.

Cheers

reviews.author: Teresa Fernandez
reviews.text:
Rest The Lunchbox:
Rosanna was the best and was so attentive with our group.  She made us look forward to breakfast!
Concierge Luis Cadet:
Our concierge was very attentive and cooordinated the dinner reservations we wanted.  He also surprised us arranging to decorate our room for my birthday and arranging to send a chocolate cake to our dinner reservation for my birthday.  He was very diligent with us

reviews.author: Kristi Maines
reviews.text: Rosanna Aquino y Carolyn Castillo are the very best bartenders who took care of our every need on this trip. They made our experience amazing. 90*

reviews.author: Sese R.
reviews.text:
I stayed at the Garden Suitws by Mélia, All Inclusive and did the Sushi Workshop with Chef Julian, Jorge, Ayda, and Wilkins as hosts. There were 5 of us and they made it feel like an intimate party! The sushi Chef was very nice and helped us all be successful. The hosts were friendly and courteous too.
The property is well kept, there are lot of things to do.
The location is beautiful.
Only with are the people on the beach that are trying to get you to buy hair styles, cigars, and other things.
Would highly recommend.

reviews.author: Scott Day
reviews.text: The most beautiful resort I have ever been to!  Truly paradise!  Rachel Ortega and Daysi Gonzalez were very helpful!  Luis Cadet was our concierge and he was very professional and very attentive to our needs. Luis made all of our dinner reservations and our activities. Luis could not have been more helpful!

reviews.author: Vito Cairone
reviews.text: Antonio, Domingo, Criceida at the Paradisus Palma Real Golf & Spa Ginger Bar are absolutely wonderful and helpful. In the morning they made sure my coffee craving was always satisfied, and our conversations make waking up so much easier. Thank you.

reviews.author: Albina Kurayeva
reviews.text: Having breakfast at Luis Cafe daily. Our waiters knew what we like after the first day. On the third day we alrrady had our table set up and fresh juices ready and our coffees. They are so sweet and caring. Thank you to Fran Felix, Maria Fernandes, Betty Corporan.

reviews.author: Bridget Nunez
reviews.text:
My family and I dined at Mascalzone. Bernabe took care of us. He was so lovely, personable and professional. The food and service was excellent. We will be dining there again upon our return.

Rosanna Yanira at the buffet restaurant is wonderful and so accomadating!

reviews.author: Melissa Detrick
reviews.text: Great location and a fun trip. Went to the Ginger bar every morning for coffe and it was great! Ismael, Antonio, Domingo, Olga, Clary, and Magna were amazing! Spent the afternoons in the pool with the swim up bar, 90 degrees, bartenders Israel and Derny were fantastic 👌. Highly recommend and we will be back

reviews.author: Ellyssa Kubicki
reviews.text:
We had a nice stay at this resort. Eriol was wonderful and really went above and beyond to make our stay great. Thank you!

The beach was beautiful. Plenty of space to sit. our room was really nice with a picture perfect beachfront view.

reviews.author: Megan Plosila
reviews.text: Felix and Starling at Malva were amazing, they were very accommodating! They got us in after our reservation time.Best food on the resort so far. ! Thank you!

reviews.author: Karan Sood
reviews.text: Wonderful experience!! The dinner at Mas Calzone was the highlight of the trip for us. Amazing ambiance, excellent food, and a wonderful staff sealed the deal for us. I especially want to call out our server, Bernabe for a great hospitality. Wilminia was also wonderful along with Fausto for serving us drinks and food. The supervisor, Milton, was a great host and made us all feel very welcome. Great people!!

reviews.author: Margarita Cha cha
reviews.text: This vacation was much needed for some overdue rest & relaxation. I have stayed at many Meliá properties but this one has to be top of my list. The property is beautiful and just big enough..not like some gigantic resorts. They cater to superior customer service and there’s an elegance to this hotel. We decided to stay on the Reserve side..adults only..private beach area with butler service and a specialty restaurant catered to reserve guests (which was fabulous). The check in was private, quick and painless. We met our concierge there..Zenovia..this angel made our whole week. The kindest most hard working woman I’ve ever seen. From morning to evening running around checking with us and others if we required any assistance or needed anything. We saw her everywhere with her warm smile and gracious presence. All our a La carte restaurant reservations were made through her and special requests. She genuinely loves her job and you could tell. She needs to run the Reserve side. Then there was Pedro & Raphael at the beach. I can’t say enough about these two. Pedro had our Sun beds ready with towels and drinks everyday and Raphael kept the drinking coming all day. Pedro you are one of a kind! Outstanding service gentleman! I treated myself to a massage and had Gladys as my masseur. Wow! Hands from God..best massage ever! She is one talented lady..beautiful on the inside and out! Then there was Jorge from activities/entertainment. He kept us entertained & engaged with all activities and dancing up a storm in the evenings. Thank you for your smiles & kindness. All the servers & bartenders were attentive and provided excellent service. I come from a hospitality background and the professionalism from the staff was incredible. I never had to ask for a drink refill they were so on top of watching and refilling my drinks. Overall, an excellent vacation already planning to return in January! Hasta Luego! ❤️😘

reviews.author: Diana Wind
reviews.text:
Came for a company rewards trip, had ‘Reserve’ access.

Our room was beautiful, clean, and cold. Well appointed with multiple shower heads in shower, tub, and separate toilet room with its own sink. We were two women in the room so two sinks for getting ready was very convenient.

Loved the property, many beautiful sitting areas amongst the majestic courtyard lined with columns, upstairs in the Ginger bar area and really anywhere on the resort.

Because we had reserve access, we opted to eat at Sante for breakfast and lunch, they also have a small buffet inside the restaurant which we absolutely preferred over the Lunch Box options and environment. Sante also overlooks the main pool bar and you can see the beach and ocean while You dine. 10/10.

Some specific shout outs-Loved the bartenders at Mina - specifically Juan B and Maria. They made us a special smoking vodka cocktail that tasted like a sour patch kid-DELICIOUS! 10/10
Luis outside also made an incredible espresso martini very meticulously adorned.
Swim up bartenders made delicious Dirty Monkey frozen drinks.

reviews.author: Elissa Mikos
reviews.text: Beautiful resort. We stayed in the reserve and got top tier service from our butler Lewis. The food at all the restaurants we tried was very good and there was a lot of variety. The beach was BEAUTIFUL. Our room was also very nice. I would highly recommend booking at this resort!!!!

reviews.author: Anthony Blanc
reviews.text:
Arieleida gave the most excellent service on th ebeach and by the pool!!!   More than 5 stars!!!!

The team at the ginger bar were anlso excellent.  Ismael, Antonio, Dominga, Grey, Clary and Leanni… great job!!!  You know the bar gives good service when they know your drink by your second night!

Hotel was excellent!!

Restaurant reservation was lengthy, and same day reservation was not possible after a long line.

reviews.author: Mary Lorraine Matiling
reviews.text: Joel Valdez and Hansel has been amazing! All 7 days we’ve been here they were so accommodating, kind, courteous. Excellent service at the pool, bar and the beach. 10/10 recommend these two! Thank you Joel and Hansel for an excellent time

reviews.author: Carmen Rodriguez
reviews.text: Sante Restaurant, this is one of the reviews where we can yell to the world, where it's food ( which is one of my most favorable) and the quality of Service, combine to make a powerful statement of perfection. The staff, is unbelievable, accommodating to your unique wants and desires, giving you the impression that you are in paradise. I can only say I love this Restaurant.

reviews.author: Amy
reviews.text: Basilio was amazing. He was our point of staff and took care of all our needs. He went above and beyond to get us balloons and cake for two seperate birthday events and decorated the room. Sweet and always available. 10 out of 10.

reviews.author: Danielle Goetz
reviews.text:
The service and atmosphere was outstanding.  At Kicks sports bar, Victor, Miguel, Adreina and Luis were amazing!  Very attentive and amazing group of people!  Thank you!  You are appreciated!

Blue Agave restaurant was delicious.  Came back to have dinner twice.  Georgi and Edito were fabulous servers and took very good care of us.

Ralphy was an amazing host our whole trip.  He took care of scheduling everything we needed including dinners and excursions.  He made sure the room was in perfect working order and checked in with us multiple times a day.

I cannot say enough wonderful things about our stay here.  The staff were wonderful and welcoming.  You truly feel like family here!

Muchos gracias mi familia!!

reviews.author: Michaela Halbach
reviews.text:
Fransicisco, Milton, Jessica, and Fauto were awesome! we enjoyed our meal and the food was great! I highly recommend coming to Mascalzones if you are staying at paradisus Palma real! The service was quick and we  enjoyed time with friends! Can’t wait to come back next time!

Raul took care of us at the beach. The service was great! He bought us drinks and took care of us! Thank you Raul!

reviews.author: Andrea Montemarano
reviews.text: Milton is the best of the best! He has gone numerous times above and beyond for us! After a hiccup with our dinner reservations, we were able to dine at Mascalzone, the Italian Restaurant at Paradisus Palma Real. The service was outstanding! Milton and his staff were all attentive, hospitable… and the food was delicious! The chef even came around to greet us. So far the best meal experience of our trip! Since meeting Milton that evening, he has helped us around the hotel. Thank you Milton for your service!

reviews.author: Chris Evans
reviews.text: This was our first time at an all inclusive resort and we were so pleased with our choice. We would definitely return in the future. It was particularly helpful having a concierge as they allow you to have fun and relax while they do all the work of making reservations and answering your questions! Eriol did a particularly good job for us and we would request him in the future.

reviews.author: David Alberico
reviews.text: Awesome experience!  Will come here again!

reviews.author: Fernando Salinas
reviews.text:
I spent five days with the family, and everything was just right. Lewis, the concierge, was always there for us, helping us in every need. The food was amazing. We had the chance to enjoy a romantic dinner on the beach; that’s a must!

All the Melia team, from the receptionist Josias to the bellboy Jose Ramirez, the food runners at the beach Hansel and Leudys, the bartenders Erickson and Julia, and the lady in charge of the kids zone (I can’t remember her name), everyone was really kind, always with a smile on their face and willing to be there to ensure you’re enjoying your time off.

The hotel is great, and I highly recommend it for a vacation.

reviews.author: Mary Beth Gaulin
reviews.text: Dinner was excellent and the service was outstanding!  Highly recommend! Server was Misael Enrique esmerlin Rosa in sante was amazing

reviews.author: Phil Leboudec
reviews.text:
We had a fantastic experience. The staff were very friendly, helpful and professional.
Many thanks to the staff at the Ginger Bar...Ismael, Dominga,Maria, Franchesca, Olga, Mereida, Clary

reviews.author: Carlos Gutierrez
reviews.text:
Service here at 90 Degrees has been fantastic! They were very attentive to our needs and very friendly.
The staff (Roxana, Eddy, Caroline) here made us feel so welcomed that we spent most of our time at that pool. I definitely would recommend it to anyone staying here. I give these people at the pool 5 Stars.

We stayed in the Adults side VIP level.
However this was not the case for other areas of the resort. First we arrived and had reserved 2 rooms on the adult side of the resort and as you all know they expect you to make a deposit and then pay the remainder 1 week before you arrive. Well the problem was that when we arrived they did not have the room we reserved available. (Swim up room) They offered us a less expensive room (Garden View). We asked to speak to a manager and got the run around for about an hour and half. Finally we got a supervisor and nothing happened since they were not a manager. The hotel was not even at 50% occupancy so there were rooms that they could have provided us with instead of inconveniencing us. Then they did not want to reimburse us for the difference of the room cost for that day. They told us they would be reimbursing us and we still have not seen the reimbursement. It has almost been 1 month since we were there. Estenia Perez (Yield Executive) was who sent the e-mail stating that we would be reimbursed for not having the room we reserved available .

We also had a concierge. The concierge was not that accommodating. We had to call everyday to make reservations for dinner and he would never be able to accommodate our request to have dinner where we wanted. I asked to make reservations for the whole week the day we arrived and he told me they can't do that. However we met some people that were there on vacation as well and they were able to reserve the restaurants that they wanted to eat at for the whole week on the first day.
The concierge (Wolfen) never even walked my kids to the room to explain to them how things worked or explain to them that if they needed anything that all they would have to do is contact the concierge. I also shared a picture with (Wolfen) that there was a cockroach in there room.

Everyone made excuses about everything. I even had an racist experience by one of the employeesthat I will not talk about this here. If Melia is interested in hearing about my experience they can reach out to me to discuss it.
Ivelisse Hernandez - (Sub Director for Paradisus Palma Real) knows about the situation that occurred.

This service does not reflect on the people that did there jobs and did everything possible give us a nice experience.

reviews.author: William Kim
reviews.text: The bartenders, especially at the swim up bar, Jonathon, Jorge, and Louis, made fantastic drinks and gave very good service. Would definitely recommend!

reviews.author: Olivia Zarik
reviews.text:
The Paradisus Palma Real was absolutely spectacular! Some of the best service I have ever received! And the reserve made it an even better experience.
Our room came with a Butler; Miguelito. Who was absolutely exceptional, and paid great attention to our requests. He truly made our stay exceptional. Went above and beyond expectation for us. When we come back we will request him. I can’t possibly thank him enough for a job well done.
The stretch of beach was impeccable and super clean. Truly well maintained sands that marry beautifully with truly clean turquoise waters.

reviews.author: Stylianos Kutob
reviews.text: What a wonderful experience. I enjoyed everything about this vacation. The rooms, drinks, food, and sights were all equally amazing. I’d definitely recommend. Shout outs to Ebony and Maria for their exceptional hospitality.

reviews.author: Adam G
reviews.text:
This resort is overall very nice. The service from the folks that work here is great and they are always helpful. The food and drinks are delicious and there is plenty to do during the day - meaning activity options. The rooms are nice enough but our room has a smoked glass door for the toilet and a curtain instead of a door, for example. Just a little odd. They have some sort of entertainment until about 10 or 11 which is nice but no late night dance or nightclubs for adults only.

Couple other thoughts - there are so many resorts connected with Melia on site and some amenities are available to some people and others to members and other amenities that are even more exclusive and some adult only. It’s kind of a confusing mess when there are whole restaurants that are exclusive yet no guests are there. Just staff standing around and. I good explanation or map/guide to make it more clear. Lots of wasted space and pools due to the caste system they’ve set up.

reviews.author: Son Goku
reviews.text: The hotel was amazing and Luis Gabriel was an awesome concierge. He helped us with setting up our reservations each day so we had something to do later and gave us his whatsapp so if we had questions or issues he was there to help! All the staff at the hotel were very nice and helpful in making our experience truly a wonderful one!

reviews.author: Steven The Batman Hurst
reviews.text: Ate at the Blue Agave. Fantastic food, amazing atmosphere and Georgie, our server was the best, he knew suggested things he thought we would like and hit the nail on the head! So so good!

reviews.author: Anna Keller
reviews.text: We had a wonderful time here, everything was just perfect. The hotel has beautiful amenities and rooms. The food was very delicious with a great variety of different restaurants.  We enjoyed every moment here. The service was all the time very welcoming and helpful, especially the staff from the gin ger bar&cafe (Ismael, Criceida and Antonio). A big thanks to our concierge Stephanie and Marielisa who make our stay unforgettable and were always happy to help with everything we needed! We will for sure come back to this hotel and warmly recommend to choose this place!

reviews.author: Kyuyeon Hwang
reviews.text:
Stayed 5 nights at Nikte Ocean Front room. Fully renovated hotel and well managed - everyone is friendly and someone is always cleaning all day long.
Our conceierge Luis is very professional and super responsive via WhatsApp. He always tried his best to book dinner restaurants at our desired time. Highly recommend him!
Overall, it's really nice resort and we had great time during holiday.

Only gave 4/5 star about room. Room itself is very clean, modernize, spacious with good view but have some soundproofing issue.

Additional thing is a waitress, Glennlye, who works in Snack Box, is professional and super friendly.

reviews.author: Lorell Gonzalez
reviews.text: We had dinner at the Flora Restaurant and our waitress Ana Michelle and our bartender Randy were amazing! Great food and service! Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Jonathan Almodovar
reviews.text: Beautiful resort with nice amenities. We particularly enjoyed the wine dinner where you can order from any restaurant and buy a perfectly paired bottle of wine. Johnatan gave us great service and has a knack for making one feel well taken care of.

reviews.author: Deonna Melton
reviews.text: Pleasantly surprised upon arrival. This was overall a great experience. I was a bit skeptical at first as the website doesn't offer a lot of pictures or information on what to expect which makes it hard to plan for your experience especially if yu are deciding on bringing children. I am here to tell yu, this resort is 100% kid friendly. The kids activities, clubs and attitude of staff are all top notch. They give the kids attention throughout the day with free trinkets, candy, and specialty drinks. We throughly enjoyed our experience. The views were breathtaking. The room layouts are designed well. The food unfortunately wasn't great but plenty of options to choose from. I have no other Dominican Republic resorts to compare this one to; however, I will say if yu opt for this place, it won't disappoint.

reviews.author: Marshyneschkav Paradas
reviews.text: It has been a great experience. Melvin is un amor quien nos dio la bienvenida!. Fuimos a cenar a Blue Agave y nuestro camarero Georgi fue sumamente amable al igual que su supervisor Milton. La atencion es extrodinaria. It was a plasure going to the Kicks Sports & Fun Bar Luis and his team were amazing! Our third night dinner was amazing. The chef Keandy Suzuki was amazing. He made us laugh and was very charismatic. Alquenio was also great. He did not wait for us to ask for another beer, he was on top of it! Best dinner so far!

reviews.author: Doug Lynch
reviews.text: Our concierge was great, food was OK, resort was pretty and drinks were decent but the resort is very poorly run.  My 18 year old had an adult wrist band but got hassled every time she went for a drink. Many of the bars wouldn't serve her unless she showed her id so she ended up having to carry her license around with her, fortunately she didn't misplace it! She was even denied a drink once after showing her license. We had a food credit with our room so we upgraded our steak at dinner, when we went to check out, they wouldn't let us use the credit as supposedly we had to tell them at the restaurant. Every day at lunch, it took forever to get our drinks and food and the food order was never right. The room number they had for us in the system was different than our actual room number which they couldn't fix and caused issues during the trip. The restaurants required you to scan a code for your menu and it only worked about half the time. I could go on but I'll leave it here.  We won't be going back.

reviews.author: Lou Mira
reviews.text: An excellent experience at Blue Agave. The service was superb and dinner was exceptional. Do not miss the pescado de caribe. Thank you Georgi and Felix for a wonderful evening.

reviews.author: Denis Haxhija
reviews.text:
Perfect is the only word to describe my stay here... 9 days at this haven in heaven!
All the staff here are absolutely phenomenal, so kind & helpful!
Alejandro (Happy Boy) & Geraldo are amazing - they oversaw so many activities & made sure to keep my family & me busy laughing & having fun. Andy & the other entertainment & activities staff are equally as awesome.
Paola, Jeanne & all the other hostesses & reservations staff went above & beyond all the time!!!
The waiters, waitresses, busboys/girls, housekeepers, security, reception, concierge (Felipe), guest services, bartenders all helped make our stay so enjoyable!
Beautiful resort with so many great activities & events. I loved it so much.
Will definitely be back soon!

reviews.author: Denise Lawson
reviews.text: Johnathan and Jorge are the best swim up pool bartenders.  Very in tentative and make you feel really good and make really good drinks.

reviews.author: Daneisha Jones
reviews.text: Excellent service and food. Rooms were very clean and modern. Quick 15 minute drive from the airport. I will definitely be returning. Ask for Francisco and Broxni when you come!

reviews.author: Gisele Soto
reviews.text:
Everything is beautiful as always.  The service is top notch!

Love Luis from Canna very very welcoming and Frank,Yorgely, Maria and Betty and lunchbox really took care of us at breakfast.

I have to say, I'm not crazy about the food.  The stay would be pure paradise If the food was better.

reviews.author: T Tran
reviews.text: Celia soliver was our server at Mina restaurant tonight. She provided an excellent service that was beyond our expectation. Also the manager, Reynaldo martinez was dedicated and welcoming us at the restaurant. We are so impressed with the services here tonight!.

reviews.author: Eftjola Glozheni
reviews.text:
We highly recommend the Mascalzone pizza more restaurant!  This is the best meal that we have had so far. The food was delicious and the staff was very professional and friendly, especially Diana Rodriguez, Franklin Botista, Raider and Wilmina! We can't wait to come back here again!
The family beach was clean and not crowded. We  had great server, Raul was the best!  He was always polite, friendly and funny!
My family loves him!!

reviews.author: Oleg
reviews.text:
Beautiful property and great service!

Special thank you to Stephanie, she was very attentive and beyond helpful! She made our stay memorable!

Also, Luis and Maria at The Lunch Box, Karina and Yvette at the front desk, and the guys at the gym, big thank you for your service!

¡Salud!

reviews.author: Andrea Herschberger
reviews.text: Very nice grounds. Edgar was an attentive concierge. Even though we tried immediately upon our arrival, we were unable to get reservations at the restaurants which was very disappointing. The food at the buffets was good. The language barrier with much of the staff was frustrating. Our spa services were excellent.

reviews.author: Anup Warrier
reviews.text: Amazing place to stay. Great room service. Restaurants are amazing especially Blue Agave and Georgi who works there is the best employee. Thanks so much for making it a memorable vacation.

reviews.author: Steven Weisenburger
reviews.text: Overall, our trip was great! Our personal concierge, Lewis, made sure our trip was ease free and painless, always fulfilling every request! A few servers stood out: Johnathon at the pool bar makes amazing drinks as well as Antonio and Olga at Ginger! Sonayti at ginger too! However, what really made our stay was the kids club taking amazing care of our two year old and 7 month old while we had some alone time! Alexandra, Sujyedi, Yesmeily, Marta, Jenny as well at the managers there were so friendly and sweet! Made me feel relaxed and I could enjoy vacation! They sent photos of my kids while we were at the beach and just made our trip! Great stay!

reviews.author: Camila Correia
reviews.text:
Franklin from Asante restaurant is amazing! So kind, has the sweetest smile that will make your day.
The food was amazing and the service was incredible. This was also the best coffee I’ve had - no sugar needed :)

reviews.author: Mailee Layman
reviews.text: Stayed here for a week.  Absolutely incredible experience! Would definitely go back! We upgraded to the reserve and the restaurant Sante was 10/10. Wonderful service and food was so good!! Juan, Franklin + Bronxni were incredible waiters🙌🏽

reviews.author: Mikey Dao
reviews.text:
Elvin Mercedes at Flora is amazing
Jose Montero is good boss.
Bladmir was a great server as well. This place is excellent and we highly recommend it to everyone. Everything was super clean and everyone was so friendly. And the water is amazing. All the restaurants were so delicious.

reviews.author: Johanna Pinsker
reviews.text: We have been coming here for the last 16 years and so far things have exceeded the expectations. We love coming here with our kids they make so many friends and we have made long lasting ones also. It’s why we continue to come back year after year. Victor, Luis, Rosana, Ari, George, Johnathan, Alberto, Eddie. All of these guys are the heart of Celsius Bar.

reviews.author: Chloe M
reviews.text: Dinner at Sante was excellent! The service was very attentive, the food was freshly made and the ambience was lovely. Our meal and drinks came to our table very quickly and all correctly - we were served by manager José, Amanda, Misael and Nilza. Plan to come here again during our trip for breakfast and dinner.

reviews.author: Jeffrey Yi
reviews.text: The Kick sports bar was a highlight with incredible service and atmosphere. The bartenders are skillful and very joyful to be around and willing to have a good time while making your drinks. Victor was very energetic and made fantastic cocktails.

reviews.author: Steven L
reviews.text: This was the 2nd group trip I set up at this property. By far an amazing resort. We had some issues during the check in process that took up 5 hours of our day, and got absolutely no resolution from the very dismissive manager Lisandro. But aside from that I would definitely return back and continue booking my vacations with the Melia Brand. We encountered some very AMAZING staff that went above and beyond to make this birthday trip amazing and i would like to thank Fiora (Kick's Adult Club), Olvi and Stormin (from Kanna Restaurant), Wellington, and Carlos (entertainment staff).

reviews.author: Yolanda Caraway
reviews.text: I came here for my Birthday and it was absolutely spectacular! My concierge,  Starlin,       has been amazing - really treated me like a Queen. And Raphael, at the beach, took exceptional care of me. I will definitely be back and recommend to friends.

reviews.author: Piotrek Szkaradek
reviews.text: Very good food and service was wonderful. Staff is very attentive and cares about your opinion. The food at the Mexican restaurant with Milton supervising was exceptional and Jose E makes sure everything is the best.

reviews.author: Ray Richards
reviews.text: The food at Flora restaurant at Paradisus Palma Real was the best food at the resort, particularly the beef short rib which is delicious. The service from Melina and Edwardo was excellent. We will be back!

reviews.author: Elva Samantha Molinar
reviews.text:
Mascalzone Italian restaurant was amazing
Delicious lasagna, pizza and delicious appetizers. The house Merlot was great too.
We tried all three desserts on the menu and they did not disappoint.
Willminias service was outstanding!

reviews.author: Sherry Hayes
reviews.text:
We had an amazing stay at Paradisus Palma Real Golf & Spa resort!  Everyone was so helpful.  Gladys is amazing at the spa! Arisleida and Marino were the most amazing servers! Karina and Anyela at the front desk are so helpful! They go above and beyond to help their guests. Marcos and Wladimir handle any problems that may arise! Franklin helps with all of your concierge needs!! Blue Agave was our favorite restaurant while we were there.  Get the Pastor Tacos and Tres Leche!  Viltudes and Alexander are both great servers.

The resort is gorgeous and the beds are so comfortable.

reviews.author: Fatalstar08
reviews.text: The weather was amazing. We had around 500 guests for a conference. Found the service to unfortunately be slow and at times completely unavailable.  Much of the staff are not very friendly and some were surprisingly rude, with one or two exceptions.  Won't be returning,  unfortunately.

reviews.author: Eye On Creative
