reviews.text: We had a great time at Palma Real -Meliá the best part was the kid zone (everyone including Joanna was such an pleasure and gave our daughter so much love) we were able to hire a caregiver for after hours 10p-12a for our four-year-old daughter. Martha R was so attentive to our daughter and made our getaway so enjoyable. My husband and I had an opportunity to enjoy some much needed time. She was excellent with children! We had a great time!

reviews.author: Devin Joseph
reviews.text: Oscar and Yeimy  gave us excellent service. They were so kind, friendly and accommodating. Kick the Sports Bar is a go to spot!

reviews.author: Heather Cox
reviews.text:
Enrique, Christian,Yelderi, and Adriel
were all amazing!  Our experience at Paradisus Palma Real was second to none!  We will
Definitely be back!  Gracias!

reviews.author: Jonathan Ordon
reviews.text: The Paradisis is absolutely gorgeous. The rooms are beautiful, the amenities are superb and the staff is very friendly. Shout out to Cirilio who has helped us and been very friendly! Would recommend this resort.

reviews.author: Ady Miriello
reviews.text:
First: the hotel is stunning and impeccably kept.  You don’t get a room, you get an apartment! Our room is so spacious: living room, kitchen and huge bathroom with a shower and a gorgeous tub and 3 sinks! The bed is soooo comfy and the pillows are also incredibly comfortable and you know how a bad bed and pillows can ruin a vacation!
The staff is so helpful and friendly without being obnoxious; they are incredibly professional and always make sure you get everything you need.
Lunchbox staff Edito went out of his way to help us when a member of our family wasn’t feeling well.
Also Edickson the bar attendant at the pool on building 60 also great and so respectful and professional.
Thank you so much! Highly recommended!

reviews.author: James digby
reviews.text: Jose Eusebio,  at the Mexican was wonderful nothing was to much stress ! Honestly really lovely guy I wish I could take him home with me he is so attentive and happy to serve anyone. Made my kids feel at home. Mexican restaurant was lovely

reviews.author: Maricarmen Milan
reviews.text:
Excelente hotel. Magnificent staff. Great pool. Great service by chef Roberto and John at Tokimeku. Also by Melvin at the lobby 😊
Overall 9/10, but some thing I did not like: no drinks at the pool until 10am when the bar opens; no food at the pool area until 12pm when the snack bar opens, otherwise I would have to walk to the restaurant that closes at 11am, or the other restaurant for some hotdogs/hamburgers (not that great). Need more activities for the guests and more nights with life music
I was told at the counter I would get a room upgrade and that was a lie, ended up with the same room I paid for and the a/c stops working after midnight!!

reviews.author: Lucas Guerra
reviews.text:
Ginger bar is one of the best places to visit here. Ismael, Dominga, Clari and Olga are very nice and receptive

We had a great dinner and experience with Dionys and his crew. I can't be thankful enough for all the experience we had during this amazing week in Palma Real. Thank you again!

reviews.author: Marlena Campopiano
reviews.text:
Emmanuel was there to take our luggage with a smile on his face ❤️

Irvin our concierge was amazing.  Always checking up on us & handling anything we needed.

Rosanna in the lunch area was AMAZING.  She’s always has a smile & was very helpful.

reviews.author: Pete London
reviews.text:
Look at all the 1-3 posting reviewers!! We booked this based on the high ratings scores more than the reviews - big mistake. Here is a log of our at Meliã Paradisus in Punta Cana, Dominican Republic.  We give this a moderate rating as there are many staff who do seem to try and the groups were very nice.  However the overall service and food was not great.  Trust the balanced reviews, not the ratings which can easily be staged.

Day 1 - we arrived early and had to wait for our room.  It wasn’t ready until almost 4pm, and then after delivering luggage we discovered it wasn’t what we requested and we had to go back to the main desk. This was resolved by about 4:30pm.

Day 2 we started to notice that the entire room smelled like mold.. this seemed to be in the A/C unit and we were told that no other rooms with our paid-for amenities were available so we lived with it for the rest of the week.

Day 3 the ability to make a request to housekeeping or maintenance services through app was taken away completely and the guest services like wasn’t answered after 20+ rings.  There is no way to get ice but via room service and we tried for 2 days but the requests through the app were ignored.

Day 4 - Room service stopped being functional through the app.

Day 4, it became extremely crowded on weekend - there were times we couldn’t find a single place to sit for breakfast or lunch, and most of the food was picked over or gone completely at the buffet.  There was no way to get a chair at the pool.

Day 5, had to call to get minibar service at 6pm.  They asked what we wanted and delivered completely different items.

Day 5, had to call to get housekeeping service at 5pm while we were getting ready for dinner.  We were taking showers (there is only a thin see-through curtain for the bathroom door) while they cleaned our room.

Jackhammering of the flooring also started outside of our room on day 5, lasting all day.

Day 6, again no housekeeping service or minibar service.  Had to call and minibar showed up but not room service.  Since it was past 5pm we asked that they skip us for the day.

Other notes:

Food at Italian place very bad, like they took from the buffet line.  There was a giant poster of an American top chef stating that they had a special menu. The fish was so bad - over cooked and rubbery.

Much of the food at the sit down restaurants was very mushy, worse than a carnival cruise ship.  The exception was the fish at the Dominican restaurant and the flank steak Minas.

Grounds were nice, and swim up pool was very nice.

Drinks were acceptable, the won’t blend anything and everything is pre-made and very sweet.

Several areas and one of the main restaurants were shut down for days due to an Indian wedding.  It was difficult not to eat in the buffet, most restaurants had no reservations on most days but were visibly half-full if that!

The resort is geared towards finding ways to get you to spend more (than the $500-800 per night you already out down for an all-inclusive). Some staff helpful, others wouldn’t go out of their way unless there was something to sell.  Example, they advertise a $120 beachside dinner.  However when you inquire about it they say the $120 is for one plate to food to share!  How misleading is that?!?

There was a “Beer mixology” event one day.  Tastings included Budweiser rather than the local beer (which cost extra, and as we discovered wasn’t worth paying for).

Suggest staying in the adult section to avoid loud neighbors due to adjoining room doors which let a lot of noise through.  Unfortunately some of the best room configurations are on the family side.

reviews.author: Leslie Currin
reviews.text: Service was very efficient and everyone was so friendly! Eduardo, Hilenne, Saudus, Jose, and Felix were great at Restaurant Sante!  They went above and beyond to make sure everything was good and made special drinks for us. All of the entrees that we ordered were delicious, as well as the appetizers. Great flavors. The Dominican restaurant (Flora) at the resort was great too! Raul, Luis, and Jonathan did a wonderful job serving drinks and attending to us this week! We will definitely be back!! Lewis was our concierge and he went above and beyond.  Very responsive when we needed something, made dinner reservations for us, and was very family oriented and all around amazing! Go Paradisus team!! We love you, familia!

reviews.author: Anes Mehmeti
reviews.text:
Wow, how to begin. Location, rooms, cleanliness are all amazing. This is a luxury hotel and it lives up to it in terms of that.

First impression 0/5 stars. Bell boys were amazing! HOWEVER, Front desk people didn’t even greet me… No respect, they don’t smile. I had to check in 3 different times since my family arrived after me and every time the experience was THE worst I’ve ever had at a hotel.

The service is HORRIBLE. It’s not even worthy of a 3 star hotel. Waiters constantly forget your order, are slow, or better yet don’t even bother to ask if you want a drink. 2 out of 7 mornings, I wasn’t even asked if I wanted coffee… On the last day, a waitress even rolled her eyes at me.

There are good servers, Maria Ortiz is amazing! Luis pool bar, Victor sports bar, and Ysmerin from the gin bar were also top notch. Everyone in the steakhouse and Japanese restaurants were great. There are good people as well but these stood out the most. Also shout out to the entertainment team especially Danyelo.

Food… Average at best. Once again not worth the price. It is clear that they use leftovers for days. Same seafood that was given out during Christmas Dinner was used for 3 days for lunch and dinner (maybe longer but I left).

As I mentioned to one of the managers and the guest experience manager, they need supervisors everywhere. They need people that are good at their jobs, like the above mentioned to oversee the operations and make sure that guests have great experiences. There are toooo many inconsistencies and a lack of communication at this place. If you don’t pay to be proffered or the Circle, you will be a nobody here.

Unfortunately as a seasoned traveler, I know this is not nearly good enough for the price.

I am currently at the Riu Palace Punta Cana since i decided enough was enough. Let me tell you not only did I save A LOT of money, but it’s a 5/5. It obviously isn’t as luxurious, but the service is a million times better. As soon as you sit people come and ask how you are and if you need anything. It’s the polar opposite of what I experienced.

Paradisus Palma Real is worth 2.5/5 stars, gave it 3 because of the cleanliness and location.

I will not recommend this hotel to my customers.

reviews.author: Mayra Linares
reviews.text: Wonderful experience making traditional dolls with Brandol and team. I was able to show my children these traditional dolls I saw as a child. What a great touch. Painted bags with Yesmeily, Jairo and Brandol who were great. We had a great time as a family. Thank you, Franklin Diaz for your attention at Lunch, great service.

reviews.author: Monica Brusaterra
reviews.text:
Kidsdom was absolutely amazing! We have a nine year old boy and a four year old girl and they both had a great time at the camp! Staff keeps the kids busy and entertained at all time, very kind and friendly. The kids love them! On Wednesday and Friday they are open 10 am to 10 pm, so me and hubby could enjoy a couple of date nights ( that was so convenient!).
One of the reason we chose this resort is for the kids camp and it didn’t disappoint!!!! Amazing staff, great atmosphere, and the kids had the best time!!!!

reviews.author: Ilda Velez
reviews.text: Luis Cadet was an excellent concierge. This review is based on his service,  he went above and beyond to make sure our family and friends were taken care of.  The steakhouse service sticks and he had to fill in to accommodate our family.  The buffet food is repetitive, every day the same exact foods, meats dried out and burgers were burnt every time.

reviews.author: David Carsley
reviews.text:
My wife, 11-month old daughter and I just spent a week at the Paradisus Palma Real. We stayed in a Nikte-Master Suite Swim-Up.

PROS:
1. The staff. Contrary to some of the other reviews, we were treated so well by everyone at this resort. They made our little one feel like royalty from the minute we arrived. A special shoutout to the following individuals who went above and beyond:

*Yamira, Yafreisy and Maria (Buffet staff): thank you for always bringing warm smiles to our table and for sneaking strawberries for the baby! She loves her fresas.
*Edito (Blue Agave Restaurant) was the best waiter we had during our stay. He went out of his way to suggest food options to accommodate the baby's needs.
*Mackenson (Concierge): for organizing our dinner reservations, massage and more. The Nikte upgrade was worth it because of you.
*Karina (massage therapist) was excellent.
*Antonio (Ginger Bar) made some great drinks for us everyday. He also was warm and friendly each time we saw him.

2. The grounds and room were beautiful. You can tell they put a lot of care in keeping the resort up. The Nikte suite was totally worth it. It was so nice having the pool just outside our balcony, along with the three minute walk to the beach.

CON
The area keeping this resort from a solid five is the food. It wasn't terrible but it wasn't anything special. Unfortunately, I got quite sick one day after eating at the buffet and Mexican restaurant. I don't know exactly what caused it, but I can't give a resort a full five star when I had food poisoning. Fortunately, there was a doctor at the resort who saw me right away, gave me a prescription and I started to feel better. Note: the doctor visit isn't free so you will need travel insurance.

reviews.author: Sheyla Paez
reviews.text:
Virtudes at Blue Agave was the most wonderful hosted, very attentive to my grandkids, very pleasant.
Also Manuela at the bar is very nice and pleasant. Wanted to make sure you were pleased with your drinks.

reviews.author: Monicka Mann
reviews.text:
Brandol and Carlos were fantastic! So much fun at the soap making workshop! Look forward to many more workshops with them during our stay!

Gilda and Brandol were fantastic at macrame! Such a great workshop! And then another super fun sushi and sake workshop! The staff and chefs were fantastic too and enjoyed having the sushi after!

reviews.author: Dave Singh
reviews.text: No this hotel sucks! I expect better for the price we paid. No fun entertainment at night. After dinner we had to go to our room because that’s how boring it was. We were there in February 2023 for a few days for a wedding. Over 90 people from the family and no one was entertained. Usually we stay at the dream and they always had music, dancing or a fun entertainment to watch. The food was alright. The wait at the lobby for our room was tiring. We waited for a few hours. Was not greeted with any excitement. I do not recommend this hotel if you have kids.

reviews.author: Yoryet Perez
reviews.text: We are at Mina punta Cana! Amazing food and Diana Rodriguez was great! And Roberto , Jesus and Junior were amazing! Good great  Also Juan Sierra our concierge was amazing!!! He was courteous, professional and super nice! I highly recommend him.

reviews.author: Lindsay Austin
reviews.text: I highly recommend the steakhouse, Mina! Exceptional service, food, and especially the hostess, Daiana Rodriguez. She was a complete gem in helping us secure the reservation. Wander was the best server. Do not eat at the sushi restaurant. It was sad.

reviews.author: JM Hay (John and Marilyn Hay)
reviews.text: Amazing. Staff were friendly and attentive to ensure you have everything you need and more. Raul was great and went above and beyond. Beach is wonderful. Martin took very good care of us always. Facilities clean and spacious. Never felt crowded or rushed. Food was delicious and plentiful with lots of choices. Alvin at 6' 5" was gracious and funny. Made dinner entertaining and enjoyable. Our 25th is one to remember. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Yvonne Secreto
reviews.text: Very friendly and helpful.Antonia gave excellent service

reviews.author: Morgan Lang
reviews.text:
A quick trip down to the DR. We stayed for 3 nights and went with friends. A lot of daily activities for adults and kids, beautiful pools and beaches. The facilities are VERY clean, fresh and new feeling. The food is surprisingly delicious for an all-inclusive place. Fresh fruit, yummy flavors, good drink options, lots of restaurant options too.  The staff are eager to help and are very friendly. We were able to play golf at the nearby course and enjoyed that as well. The only frustration is the entire dinner reservation experience. It feels a little like a hoax and they push you where they want you. Not a deal breaker, but a bit annoying if actually care or trying to go with a group that’s under another reservation.

The staff gets 5 stars! A few shout outs to Kicks and Jorge, Floir, Miguel and Victor. We also ADORED Laura who was the hostess at Fior one night. So bubbly and fun.

reviews.author: Liz Hoscheid
reviews.text: I’m editing my review now that I’m home. The staff at this resort pressures you constantly to leave reviews and stands there next to you while you do it. And they make you add their name. It is so uncomfortable. In general the resort is beautiful. However, the service and food are not what you’d expect from a so called “five star” resort. Not in the slightest. The staff is grumpy and never happy or helpful. I also have never felt so pressured to spend MORE money at an all inclusive. That defeats the whole purpose. Weird experience.

reviews.author: Thomas Irvine
reviews.text: We’ve had a good time at the resort.  Our oceanfront nikte room was a great size for our family of four. Our concierge, Héctor, has been really helpful and attentive during our stay. He helped with reservations and setting up excursions. The food was excellent at Mazcalone.  We were with our two kids and they loved the pizza and calzone. Raider provided great service and the supervisor Milton made us feel very welcome. We will be back for another night during our stay.

reviews.author: tjn914
reviews.text:
Our time at paradisus was amazing from the very start. We were welcomed by friendly hosts with refreshing drinks and were guided to our beautiful swim up suite by our amazing concierge, Raul Mota. Raul catered to our every request, providing plenty of recommendations,  making dinner reservations, and treating us like family.

Raul recommended the tomahawk steak and wine pairing by the beach, both of which were delicious. Our server Jorge Rafael was great, and chef Jonas Jimenez made one of the best steaks we've tasted!! Excellent!

The pools are amazing and the service could not be better! Edickson Morales is the best bartender and server! Every time we sat at the pool and turned around, he was there to take our order and promptly returned with delicious drinks! Very friendly, attentive, and courteous. We could not be happier!

This was one of the better vacations we've taken, and we would love to come back in the future!

reviews.author: Dave Hunt
reviews.text:
The people!  The staff at this place was absolutely incredible!  Guys like Reynaldo Monegro were constantly there with a smile on their face, and were truly happy to assist you with whatever it was you asked for.  The bar tenders were Johnny on the spot with the drinks! The rooms were spotless. The wait staff was on the ball. Even the grounds keeping crew was great.  All were incredibly friendly and happy to help!  If you go, get a young fellow named Joel Valdez to make you a whiskey sour.  He'll keep them flowing and he does them right!

Only 4 stars due to the food.  Most of which is served buffet style and room temp.  In the 7 days we spent there I had only one good meal!  They need to step up their game in this dept.

reviews.author: Alexandra Donnenwirth
reviews.text: I have to thank our concierge Kelvin Fernandez Arias. He made our family trip truly amazing! He was always there to answer questions (no matter the hour!), make us reservations, and generally took care of us. People like him make this an amazing resort. Would absolutely recommend!

reviews.author: Elizabeth Persaud
reviews.text: Sante restaurant- amazing!!!! Visited multiple times for lunch and dinner. Staff exceeded expectations and went above and beyond to make sure we were satisfied. Hats off to the chef. Special recognition to Pamela, Eduardo and Jose! Made our last dinner in DR a great one! Thank you! Def check it out if you’re looking for great food and service every single time.

reviews.author: Amber Mauk
reviews.text: Raphael gave us great service on the beach! We rented a cabana for two days and he was attentive and provided us with everything we needed! Muy excellente!  Today was our daughter’s birthday and he went above and beyond! Thank you Raphael!

reviews.author: Bailey Brizzard
reviews.text: Angelo was so kind and gave us the best beach service ever! He was wonderful!

reviews.author: Laney Leonard
reviews.text: Went to Mina for dinner tonight, so so yummy! My family loved all of our steaks and our deserts. Beautifully cooked steak and great service from Manuel!!!

reviews.author: chancellor byrd
reviews.text:
The bar tender were very hospitable and far exceeded my expectations.

My guy Luís Desa  at "Ginger Bar" was extremely helpful and even helped me practice my Spanish along the way.

reviews.author: Natalia Papierz
reviews.text: Every time we were waiting about 20 minutes for high chair for the baby at the buffet. Waiters don't see you. You have to call them for something to drink and it takes a long time to get anything. This situation is only on the buffet. Restaurants have very good service. Water in the swimming pool is very cold. It is so hard to get used to it. Jose, Melvin very good service.

reviews.author: Rob Levy
reviews.text: Jose at Bri Sas was most professional and generous in his serving. He took care of us each morning for breakfast and his attentive kindness was very appreciated. Thank you Jose and we look forward to seeing you next year!

reviews.author: Vladimir Morales (VM)
reviews.text:
We traveled to Paradisus Palma Real for our 40 Anniversary and it was spectacular! The hotel has been updated and is luxurious and well tended to. Our concierge Anayely from the moment we met took charge and made all of the arrangements from decorating our room, scheduling a romantic dinner at the Winery and making sure our 40th was both special and memorable. She pulled all the stops to make it happen!
The staff at the beach was very attentive especially our friend Pedro in ensuring our Bali bed was setup daily and our beverages were constantly refilled.

At the Brisas restaurant were we had excellent breakfasts and lunches, Jose Ramos  and his team provided excellent service tending to our every need. Because of Jose and Rosanny constant attention to our dietary needs and excellent service as well as the food being spectacular, we ate there all week. We would definitely return to Palma Real without a doubt!

reviews.author: Bailey Parks
reviews.text: The ginger bar at the resort was the highlight of my trip! Antonio, Ciara, Sorany, Magda, Dominga, & Olga were phenomenal! Best drinks in the entire resort, whether it’s a coffee, a smoothie, or something a little stronger the ginger bar has it & it’s the best! José & Melvin we’re also amazing, service was 10/10 !

reviews.author: corrine cw
reviews.text: Jean the waiter at Cana was 10/10 super respectful and kind. Make sure he’s your server throughout your entire stay here ! Treat him with love he’s super kind !

reviews.author: Joseph Zagorodny
reviews.text: Tokimeko was the best experience for a fun and eventful night. Food was delicious. Victor the chef was amazing and entertaining. John joined us for some dancing. Santo joined us for the party. I have never felt more welcomed on vacation. I will do this 10/10 times again. Best night ever

reviews.author: Madelline Sanchez
reviews.text:
I initially had posted a review on our first night as requested by a nice and friendly staff which I regretted because my review was only meant for the dinner we had that night, it had nothing to do with the treatment or experience we had up to that point. As I said that was our first night, I would advise anyone that would like to post reviews to do it mid of their stay or when you get back home so that you can articulate your experience to help the future travelers to make decisions.

As for our stay at Paradisus, so far, our experience from this place is nothing but the best. My husband and I are celebrating our wedding anniversary, the staff at this Resort really treated us so well that they made our anniversary special. From the moment we checked in up to now (our third day), the quality of service, their demeanor, and hospitality hasn’t change, in fact, it has gotten better as they get to know you. Our Butler, Miguelito is awesome, he’s by far the best butler we’ve ever had in comparison from all of the resorts we’ve ever stay. He’s always on point, thoughtful, knowledgeable, humble, friendly and courteous. We’ve met so many kind and wonderful staff here that I really feel bad for not being able to name them all.

Thank you all for your wonderful hospitality:
Sussy -  Front desk
Miguelito - Butler/Concierge
Andino - Manager @ Sante
Juan - Breakfast Station Cook  @ Sante
Gustavo - Sante staff
Pamela -  Sante staff
Felix - Sante staff
Glenis - Sante staff
Daniela - Hostess @ Sante
Wanda - Fahrenheit Bar

And last but not the least, Ricki from Lunch Box, very nice kid. He always make sure we are taken care of and make it a point to say hello every time he sees us. We met him on our first day and told him that we are here to celebrate our anniversary. He asked what day, so we told him, little did we know this young man actually remember it, and he was the first one to congratulate us on that day, when none of our kids even remembered. What a sweetheart! Thank you again.

reviews.author: Joel Olivares
reviews.text: Went to flor and mascalzone, great service and great time. From flor andrea was amazing. Was always available and brought more drinks just awesome time, the food was great . At mascalzone we were served by a couple gentlemen. Milton and brailyn were amazing were attentive and the food was amazing. Worth the stay

reviews.author: Jennifer Reycroft
reviews.text: What’s not to love? Seriously, everything about this resort is amazing. It absolutely exceeded our expectations. The grounds are beautiful and clean, the service exceptional, food is consistently good and the nightly entertainment is fun! Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Adam Kubsh
reviews.text:
The kids club and overall ambiance is amazing, but that’s about where it ends.  You get a buffet for most of the day, so you only get a plated meal for dinner.  However, dinner is an absolute nightmare with a ridiculous gatekeeper system.  You need to go in-person to a desk, wait in line, and ask for available restaurants and times EACH day.  So be prepared spending half of your morning trying to figure out a plan for eating dinner somewhere.  You also will probably either have a 9pm or later time slot, or literally turned away and told to eat at the buffet because all the restaurants are full.  Yes you read that correctly, they can’t seat everyone for a plated dinner, so you can eat the same buffet 3 times a day if that’s your thing.

There is a nice beach, but you will be hassled relentlessly by people trying to sell you something.  We just hung out in our hotel room for peace which was frustrating.

Overall, I’d say spend your money elsewhere because $500+/night for an open buffet is what you’re getting.

reviews.author: Lisa Minuta
reviews.text:
The service is amazing! We love Joel the bartender at 32 Degrees. First, he makes the best drinks. He offers the amazing hospitality, is so welcoming and selflessly ensures the other staff are taken care of.

Go see Joel!

reviews.author: Sarah Felix
reviews.text:
Luis Cadet is a gem 💚
We have been blessed to have him for our children’s events and our daily schedules. He has gone above and beyond and for that we are forever grateful. Every meeting and/or passing has been so pleasant and  made our day. Thank you Luis!!

Miguel & Jhon are too sweet. They took such good care of my husband and babies. We are grateful!

reviews.author: Mariana Martinez
reviews.text: Alexander Santos and Milton Perez were amazing during our visit to Melia in the steak Mina restaurant, they were able to accommodate our XL group. The food was great, but the service made a huge difference. During the day, Raul in the family beach made our day really great, amazing service!!!

reviews.author: Leanne Ajbuszyc
reviews.text: Staff was fantastic!  Olga, Jonathan, Jose Luis at Celsius bar!! Awesome service! Always smiling , friendly and accommodating!! Will definitely come back!!! I would like to add Anayely was a wonderful concierge - she was most helpful and pleasant to interact with!

reviews.author: jose ocasio
reviews.text: Jholfry, Fernando and the bartender jefri are the best. Courteous, fun and attentive. They made our vacation such fun.

reviews.author: Veronica
reviews.text: I stayed at this resort and had an amazing experience. The buffet style food at Kanna was delicious, a lot better than I expected it to be. The staff was very welcoming and amicable especially Laicha and Virginia. Juanlly and Hector were very helpful in the lobby and always made sure to give me directions and tips on where to go. I definitely recommend this resort and will also be coming back.

reviews.author: Lilly G.
reviews.text: This is by far the best all inclusive experience I ever had. I booked an ocean front room and upgraded to Reserve. From Ingrid at check in to Adreanena at the steak house, each staff member provided top notch service. Our concierge Alvaro made sure we were well taken care of throughout our stay. He checked in daily and always was one step ahead of us anticipating needs and making adjustments as needed. Rafael at the beach club gave us the best Bali bed experience. He brought us piña coladas, fruit, food and of course a bottle of champagne, he really went out of his way for us. Wanda and Juan at the poolside bar in the Reserve section were so fun to talk to and made us the best drinks. Jesus at the steakhouse was great, so was Olvi. Gladys at the Reserve spa really was God sent. I cannot rave how much each one of these staff members represented their brand’s core values by providing world class service. I will for sure be back! P.S. the turkey on Thanksgiving was amazing! Best food at an all inclusive hands down.

reviews.author: Aidita Rosado
reviews.text: We were staying at Paradissus Punta Cana.. the buffet called Lunch box was amazing .. the food was really good and the staff was out of this world. Yafreisy Soler and Maria Ortiz were our servers .. always on point very friendly and the day we left they had a beautiful table decorated for us.  Gregory Arias the supervisor was always helping out

reviews.author: Zep B
reviews.text: Gorgeous place!! Looks like paradise! Clean grounds, friendly staff! My concierge was Héctor, he went above and beyond being available for any questions I have , he booked restaurants for us every night , made our spa reservations,  as well as sent us an agenda for activities daily! Couldn’t be happier, so much so that we plan to return with more family members :)

reviews.author: Lazaro Cabezas
reviews.text: Kelvin and Fanni were absolutely amazing! The service was great, and the vibes were immaculate. Highly recommend. We also did the Sushi Class with Jairo, Brandol and Kelvin, it was an amazing experience. I learned how to make sushi and it will be a skill I use in the future. It was a very fun and interactive experience.

reviews.author: Jumoke Sands
reviews.text: Amazing resort! It’s so beautiful. We stayed in the Reserve, adults-only section. Everything was perfection. Our concierge Nicholas was very helpful with booking our dinner reservations and excursions. We had great meals at the buffet, Kana, and Sante. The Japanese restaurant and hibachi experience were also great. The Ginger bar is great for morning coffee and late night cocktails. The sports bar had nightly DJs and entertainment. We had a great trip and will definitely be back.

reviews.author: Andres Menendez
reviews.text: Great hotel staff is very friendly, rooms are clean, beds are comfortable, pools and restaurants are high quality. Cant recommend paradisus and all of the Melia hotels enough, always a great experience

reviews.author: Maggie Guadamuz
reviews.text:
Had the best week! Our favorite night place was Kicks. The staff was amazing, very friendly and attentive. Fior was especially friendly and gave us great service. Andreina and Yiri were amazing as well,they came around constantly to make sure we were ok,,refill our drinks and make sure we were good. Would definitely recommend and come back here to vacation!

Also Ralphy our concierge was outstanding! The most kind and helpful person,we couldn’t have had the vacation we did without him. He set up dinner plans every night, outings and was available 24/7.  All the employees super friendly and helpful. Would definitely return.

reviews.author: Dallas Vaughn
reviews.text:
Great resort! Rooms were beautiful and clean, food was delicious, everyone here is very friendly,
funny, and accommodating!

reviews.author: Dad Foster
reviews.text: This resort is phenomenal. super clean, very manicured, and staff is top notch. everyone is always helpful seems to love what they do. Frankie and  rosanna in the lunch box dining  were always extra nice and went above and beyond to take care of me and my family.

reviews.author: martha palma
reviews.text: Blue agave was really good. Santo and Alexander were really good with my table. They were able to accommodate my order perfectly. I definitely recommend coming to this restaurant. All the music was amazing, old school Spanish music 🩷🩷

reviews.author: Laila Falk
reviews.text:
Location is beautiful. Rooms are amazing with nice balconies.
Maria Santana was a server who was extremely professional, kind, and welcoming. She made our mealtimes easy and enjoyable.

reviews.author: Those Holmes
reviews.text: We had a lovely stay here! The food was exceptional at all the restaurants. If you are staying at the reserve then you have to eat at Santé, the whole staff was very friendly and attentive to us. We are vegan and vegetarian and they made sure we were well taken care of. They made an off menu authentic Dominican dish called Mofongo mangú and it was just delicious. All of the employees at Santé were amazing! A big thank you to Eduardo, Yieauri, Amanda, Pamela, Felix, and everyone else who made our dinners and breakfasts here amazing.

reviews.author: Afolabi Kukoyi
reviews.text: Family had a wonderful dinner at Aqua and Chef Manuel Torres did a great job with the meals. The Mediterranean meals  were exquisite and our waiter Kathy was fantastic. It’s a  5 star restaurant that everyone that visits the Reserves at Punta Cana needs to explore.

reviews.author: Eudad Gonzalez
reviews.text: Ana Michel and Randy Santana giving us excellent service at Flora restaurant. Very friendly people and great food. I love it here!!! You need to come and check them out.

reviews.author: Corazon Deecher
reviews.text: Blue agave restaurant , hostess Laura and waitstaff Melvin were excellent. Great experience and food was great.  Also the rum Republic was excellent. Maria the bartender was the best. She fixed John a fabulous drink.

reviews.author: L Schott
reviews.text: Enjoying my stay at Paradise. A relaxed breakfast poolside at Sante each morning. Excellent service from Gustavo, Alexandel, and Felix. Wonderful food to fill the body and soul. You need to get a coffee at the Ginger bar. Ismael and Luis were always there to give service with a smile.

reviews.author: Vanessa Little
reviews.text: while visiting Punta Cana, I had the occasion to visit the Kicks Sport Bar, the food was phoenimal,  but the service from Jamie and the other staff was above and beyond.  If I ever visit here again at the Paridesius Palma Real Golf Resort, I will be sure to visit here again..

reviews.author: Donna Lowrey
reviews.text: The Ginger Bar was our favorite coffee spot in the morning. The service was excellent. Our favorite people Ismael Francesca Maria Olga and Clary

reviews.author: Raina Kenigsberg
reviews.text: Great experience. The activities in particular are very engaging and fun and break up the day of otherwise relaxing. Would definitely recommend this resort to others looking for a great value all inclusive! Brandol with the activities was excellent and really contributed to our experience being fabulous and fun. Jholfry rijo was excellent with the activities as well. Jensy as well was incredible with the rum informational

reviews.author: Dorothy Jatzen
reviews.text:
A wonderful experience eating at Blue Agave with the best server Virtudes who went above and beyond. The food was amazing by Chef Francy. Make sure you get the churros for dessert!!!

We were at the beach every day! Martin had our beach chairs ready for us each morning!! We had both shade and sun! He was always around when a drink was needed even if it was only cold water! The water had a small amount of seaweed which didn’t bother you. It was a wonderful vacation!!

reviews.author: Amy Land
reviews.text: Eriol our concierge was amazing and helped our big group get reservations each night.  Place is clean and views are amazing.  Pools are so big and they have several.   Had a great trip - wish we could have stayed longer.

reviews.author: Louise Kao
reviews.text: Beautiful resort with spacious room ( we had a two bedroom suite). Right on the beach. Many beautiful pools. Fun activities including pizza making and mixology and shows most nights. A shuttle to the neighboring resort casino. Drinks are included and are always super tasty. We had a fantastic time!

reviews.author: Karely Madrid
reviews.text:
The ginger bar is the best! Ismael, Antonio, Dominga, Olga , Nereyda, and clary treated so well!
Beat drinks And chat!
The resort was beautiful and so clean! Loved it here!

reviews.author: shelbi shaw
reviews.text: Ginger bar has the best coffee. Ismael, Jose, Olga, Walquiry, and Cryseloa were so helpful and made the best drinks. I would highly recommend this resort and plan to come back.

reviews.author: Sawyer Skraitz
reviews.text: We just finished our stay at this wonderful island and resort! I am sad to leave. Starlin our concierge was awesome and helpful throughout this trip. He always had our reservations ready for dinner and had great recommendations. I loved this stay and hope to be back soon.

reviews.author: djbuka72
reviews.text: This place is just like Paradise foreal. Very very nice. Rooms are great food is good and the bartenders are A-1 especially Antonio and his crew at the Ginger bar. Had a few issues with the temperature in our room being too hot but they rectified it asap. This resort and the people are awesome. Even had a fantastic butler in Zenovia. All in all an even 4.6.

reviews.author: Jennifer McGehee
reviews.text: This resort is wonderful! The views are unbeatable and the staff go above and beyond. We dined tonight at the Mascalzone. Our waiter Yeensen and the manager Milton made sure our dining experience was exquisite. Everything here has exceeded expectations.

reviews.author: Sonia Tontodonati
reviews.text:
A truly stunning beautiful resort that was apparently just recently renovated. So many pools (lively or quiet, children's or adults-only). There is always someone nearby to help - they have a lot of staff and all of them are friendly and helpful.  We especially loved the beach area - wide sandy beach for as far as the eye can see with swaying palm trees.  This resort goes above and beyond to make all guests feel welcome and ensure they have a great time!

Our personal concierge  Eriol deserves a special mention: he was  superb in providing personalized service on a daily basis - sometimes even meeting up with us just to ensure everything was going OK.  He reached out to arrange our a-la-carte dinner reservations every morning while also providing us with the resort's daily activities, and responded to all our enquiries quickly and efficiently.
Also...
Soleda , and Jairo and Antony gave a wonderful experience at the pizza making afternoon activity! Loved it!

Santo at Tokimeko was amazing. Excellent service! Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Tom Diehl
reviews.text: This is a beautiful resort that is well maintained and well staffed.  Our experience was nothing short of fantastic, and it was made even more special thanks to our concierge, Eriol.  I highly recommend him.  He allowed us to enjoy our time in paradise while he took care of the rest.  Thank you!  My family highly recommends!

reviews.author: Mike Watson
reviews.text: Everything about Paradisus Palma Real is 6*!  The service, the food, the accomodation, the beach and the excursions!  All top notch!  Special mention to the steakhouse, Mina and our server, Roberto!  The steak is awesome but don't overlook the grilled fish with truffle mash!  Sensational!  Such good value for an all inclusive resort! Well done, Paradisus!

reviews.author: Sarah D
reviews.text: Our stay was amazing ! Our concierge Starlin was top notch , he helped us with everything we needed . I had too much sun by the end of the trip , and needed a wheelchair to get to the front of the resort , he made it happen . He was very understanding, I am someone who suffers from panic attacks , and anxiety and he was beyond understanding. The staff here is amazing , we had no complaints at all . It is a small slice of heaven in the DR

reviews.author: Alison Parks
reviews.text: Great trip..Ginger Bar ..Antonio and staff were wonderful.Always made you feel welcome and always surprised us with a variety of coffees!  Antonio, Clari, Soranyi, Magda, Dominga, Olga..all incredible. Sante is the best restaurant by far ..the breakfast and lunch staff are top notch. Helpful, kind and friendly. We ate many meals here because they were so great!

reviews.author: Diane Pessinis
reviews.text: What a wonderful vacation... we will definitely be back!  A great crew to take care of all our needs!  First and foremost,  our concierge,  Eriol, was incredible!  Sending us the activities list for each day, making dinner reservations,  and checking in to see if everything was okay.   He was great!  From the beautiful smile of our housekeeper,  to Renaldo, our activities guy on our last day.   Exceptional service for the whole trip.   We sat at the same "station" every day for the breakfast buffet at The Lunch Box. Thank you to Yanira, Yafriesy, Maria & Delvin.  At the pool,  Teofilo took great care of us,  knowing our drink of preference after the 1st day.   Dinner at The Winery was special - thank you to Jonathan,  Juan & Maximo.  Thank you Paradisus Palma Real for an excelente` vacation!!

reviews.author: Amine Smires
reviews.text: We had an amazing trip, and an amazing service especially thanks to our concierge Eriol. He has been tremendously helpful for all our requests and have always managed to find a solution for us, no matter what we asked him. Always with a big smile!

reviews.author: Clare Abdallah
reviews.text: Our experience at Tokimeku Restaurant was incredible! Besides the late start to our reservation, the chief Jovani was phenomenal. His energy was contagious in the room, making our dinner super fun. The food was absolutely phenomenal, cooked fresh right in front of us. Probably one of the best meals we had here so far! Muchas gracias!!!!

reviews.author: Jessica Kennedy
reviews.text:
I came on a work trip that was paid for but I came a day early and paid for my own room and my view was of WEEDS. There was also people working outside my room so I couldn’t even have my curtains open. We didn’t have any patio furniture and if you wanted to talk on the phone and have someone good service you had to go outside.
Room service- food is gross and takes hours. One time it was ordered at 10:30pm and didn’t show up till 2:30am
Food at restaurants- good luck (steak house wasn’t bad, I recommend the NY STRIP with mash potatoes and order one below how you like it cooked)
Staff- staff was nice, BUT there wasn’t much staff. For 820ish people coming from Tuesday-Sunday and 2 bars open after 11 and 2 bartenders, it took forever to get a drink and there were barely any wait staff if you sat outside
HOTEL ITSELF- it’s very pretty and great views so if that’s all you want, it’s great for that. I asked for patio furniture on Tuesday and it came on SATURDAY (day before I left). It is close to the airport which was nice

Restaurants close from 4-6, so eat before then

reviews.author: Stephanie Lewis
reviews.text: Excellent facility! Beautiful and serene! My concierge Harry was the absolute best! Very attentive and responsive to our needs. I highly recommend this hotel. If your room comes with the concierge service, be sure to request Harry. You won't be disappointed.

reviews.author: Harbir Sawhney
reviews.text: The Sports bar has awesome music. The service at the bar and especially the supervisor Luis is exceptional. The whole team looks after the guests and go out of the way to accommodate their requests. They deserve speak accolades as iit makes the experience for the guests memorable.

reviews.author: Karolann Drouin
reviews.text:
34 degre bar, jose best waiter ! He is so Nice with the kids and the familly

Buffet : Juan Tores, Maria and Betty. Good service too.

reviews.author: James Reardon
reviews.text: I have bartended for over 10 years...I have been to plenty of resorts that "claim" they make craft cocktails. Maria at Rum Republic is absolutely amazing. Classic Cocktails, experimental drinks...absolutely blown away. 10/10

reviews.author: Doron Kapitulnik
reviews.text:
The location is amazing, the facility beautiful, clean and well maintained. Staff is kind and welcoming.
But - Food is terrible! Both buffet and restaurants. Ended up eating outside of the resort few times.
Although the staff is great, you are constantly in a tourist trap, even within the hotel. Gift shop selling at x4 $$, the comfy beds at the beach for additional cost and so many more similar experiences.
Won't come back.

reviews.author: Patricia Tavares
reviews.text: Jose and Ruby are the best at the Between Bar!! Always greet you with a big smile and a great cocktail!! You need to stop in and have a drink with them!!!

reviews.author: Rocio Alvarez
reviews.text: Went to Paradisus palma real for vacation for my husband birthday. Tomas our concierge helped us made the reservation for Mina stakhouse. Yude our server was very attentive and very professional and Reynaldo Martínez checked on us to make sure everything was great. The food was fenomenal and the drinks as well. Very happy with our experience.

reviews.author: Mark Bettis
reviews.text:
We have had the most memorable holiday with this hotel.
Rooms are clean & daily linen changed
Food (restaurants) exquisite
Beaches sandy & clean
And a special thanks to Eriol (concierge)
He made our stay very special attending to all our requirements;
Restaurant reservations
Special excursions
Everything we requested he came good
Even down to making sure we had breakfast in our room every morning at 8am. Nothing was to much for this guy
I wish we could give him more than a 5-stars review !!!
Eriol thanks for everything

reviews.author: Christina O'Sullivan
reviews.text:
Ismael, Franchesca, Maria, Nereida, and Clary at Bar Ginger are great!!

Luisa and cirilo at the all-day snack bar are super fun and the service is amazing!

reviews.author: Tamaris Hernandez
reviews.text: One of the best resorts I’ve ever been! The pool is amazing super clean environment, the staff always friendly amd the service is awesome, Lee at the bar by the pool he is the best! Jean Michael gave the best animation and the aerobics were super fun! Nixon he was so much fun and gave us an amazing service! Pamela she was always so helpful! The food was great! Overall an amazing experience and I cannot wait to come back! Thank you to the staff at Paradisus Palma Real you made my experience one to remember!

reviews.author: Gideon Zahler
reviews.text:
We had a wonderful stay! The staff at The Reserve are really terrific and that’s why we give the resort such high marks!
Our concierge Mariananyi was exceptional. Warm, competent, helpful, cheerful. Best resort concierge we ever encountered.
Leonardo Ramirez is a server at Aqua (he shows up EVERYWHERE!). This guy is a lot of fun. Find him when you go here so he can help you have a great vacation!
We met wonderful servers in the buffet, especially Domingo Perdono and Maria Fernandez. They always looked out for us and made us feel so welcome!
The grounds and the pools are super beautiful.
The resort beach was a little crowded, a little noisy from construction at Paradisus Palma Real, and the vendors were numerous (although very polite). We got our beach fix at Macao beach. We took a taxi. 25 minutes each way. 80$ US round trip. The driver hung out and waited for us all day pretty much.
The issues at the resort beach are temporary and related to extensive enormous renovations at the associated properties.
The Reserve is also scheduled for a renovation. The rooms are due for it. The grounds of this resort are so beautiful. The personnel who work here are exceptionally nice and lovely. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Adrienne Barge
reviews.text: Absolutely wonderful experience.  Jorge Rafael was the best entertainer who helped my uncoordinated self dance.  Most of all, a special and huge shout out to Juan Pena, who hands down made our stay and experience special and memorable.  (If you see this, again, thank you so much!)

reviews.author: Mike Duffek
reviews.text: We loved our time at Paradisas. Rossana was fantastic.  Very kind and gracious.   She took great care of us. Delvin, Rocio

reviews.author: Roxanne Sharp-Rodjius
reviews.text: Spent twi weeks and had a great time at 34 Degrees with the fantastic bartender/server Arisleida

reviews.author: Dalia Edward
reviews.text: Had a family reservation for 4 at Winery last week. Had Bogle White Chardonnay. Excellent choice they gave us. Service was excellent from Jhonatan, Juan Maxima. Cheese plate and meat platter was really good. But what made it special was the staff. Tx Guys

reviews.author: Lisa Tejeda
reviews.text:
It was a wonderful stay for me and my family!
Thankful for all the help from Mr. Innerarity and Edel for accommodating my second stay in this beautiful property.
Also for the assistance of Stephanie from guest services and our buttler Juan.
All the servers at all the restaurants, including the team at Kanna, Mr. Santo and team.
The rooms, facilicites and Services match the expected standards that the Melia brand has always offered for years.
Definitely recommend the property for families!

reviews.author: Danny Cedano
reviews.text: The staff was excellent and extremely attentive. Fior De La Cruz was amazing one of the most attentive persons on staff. The experience from a bar perspective was great. The pool was very cold and not enjoyable at all. The hibachi service was terrible. Overall it’s a great resort would like to see some sort of heater to heat the pool and the hibachi service could improve also.

Emmanuel Bautista and Pedro Reyes helped us so much upon entry and exit as well!

reviews.author: Larry Tse
reviews.text: Had a great time at the resort, rooms were clean and new. Fernando Chipa was an awesome guide, had a wonderful time at the workshops!

reviews.author: Christian Q

The service is superb our waiter was outstanding his Manager named Milton  also was outstanding. He came around made sure all was well food service comfort.

He works very hard and enjoys interacting with us. When I return to this beautiful hotel I will always look for Ramon to be our service provider. Thank you Ramon.

reviews.author: Chase Voss
reviews.text: The resort overall was great I have a lot to say but not much space to fit. A go to for all age groups activity's for all. The meals were good and service was good. Eriol was very helpful in translation and overall service and he was a big help to us!

In addition, John Nunez the chef was amazing!!!! Food was chefs kiss! Each bite was absolutely delicious!

Cassie P

reviews.author: Janet Sutherland Dekom
reviews.text:
The activities staff are awesome. Brandol made sure all were comfortable and enjoying the activity.  When he would see us in passing always asked if all was good and did we need anything.
Edgar presentation on Rum Tasting & Mixology was wonderful and very educational. Thank you for a wonderful trip.

reviews.author: Sydney Fama
reviews.text: Hotel was awesome!!! The rum republic was the best bar. Special shout out to Jose, Miguel, and Maria for making the best drinks and putting a smile on our faces!!!

reviews.author: Joel Fraser
reviews.text: Luis Rodriguez restaurant Kanna is the BEST! We have had good service all over the resort but he is NUMBER ONE!! He took excellent care of us everyday. He is friendly and is excellent at his job! Thank you, Luis!

reviews.author: Yoly Jimenez
reviews.text: Beautiful experience for the birthday dinner Rickki took care of our dinner service… the room are nice the only issue was that we had a water leak in my room and the front desk did not take care of the issue. Other than that the staff at the dinning buffet were very nice.

reviews.author: Jessica Baumgartner
reviews.text:
The unlimited golf was anything but we had to still pay $200 for cart fee that they forgot to mention til we were there. Then the adult only section was overflowing with kids the entire time we in the pool area.
The food options were subpar. We stay at all inclusives every year. This was by far our worst experience.
We only went there since the golf option seemed like a nice perk for our vacation without our children. We will not be returning.

reviews.author: Elizabeth Piergeti
reviews.text: My husband and I had dinner at the Sante restaurant at Paradisus Palma Real and it was truly scrumptious. Their bean soup is creamy and satisfying, popcorn shrimp, delicious and their coconut shrimp with coriander rice was rich, fragrant and satisfyingly delicious. Thank you for a wonderful dinner. The customer service is top notch and the wait staff is friendly, courteous and professional. A special shout out to Mercedes, Franklin, Misael, Nelson, Manuel and Hillenne. Thank you!

reviews.author: Roger Dessureault
reviews.text:
We are so happy to be back in Punta Cana at Paradisus Palma Real.  We look forward to our holiday here every year.  We remember one of the first years we came here and were treated royally by our young concierge, Lewis De la Cruz.  He has been so helpful and informative over the years even when he is not assigned as our concierge.  We value
his professionalism and wonderful sense of humour.
We definitely recommend visiting this wonderful place.
We can never forget mentioning the terribly magnificent, Odeybi Perez, (ha, ha) at the beach.  He looks after us very well and always with a smile or a joke.  We love it!

reviews.author: Amber Lu
reviews.text: Great resort and amazing food! Having a great experience and would highly recommend! Service was great by Frank & Yessica, Betty, Maria M, thanks! Also the Kidsdom (kids center) was amazing and all the teachers including Martha, Su-Su, yessica, Tania, Jayesmaily were so amazing. Our daughter had the best time playing and the staff was so nurturing & loving to her!

reviews.author: Lisa Lott
reviews.text:
Here’s my good/bad and suggestions. Good
- Beautiful property, beachfront.
- The Reserve upgrade is awesome and personal concierge service was amazing.
- Eriol was my concierge and he was fantastic!!!
- I had an oceanfront suite and it was stunning! Beautiful views, balcony, amazing soaking tub and comfy bed and pillows!
- 2 of the specialty restaurants are good (Blue Agave and Tokemiku). Blue Agave was my favorite and had the serious wow factor. The Asian was okay, maybe a bit salty and the meat was a little tough.
- The bartenders, specifically Teofilo, Ruby, Antonio and Juan, were awesome. (The reserve pool bar, in between bar, and the bar outside of Mina). There are others I’m forgetting also. So friendly, great service, and they remember you.

Bad
- Reserve beach service could be better. They dont come around much and mostly just stand up at the bar talking with each other. I saw people get up to go get a drink. They dont collect dirty cups either.
- Buffet wasn’t great (don’t get pizza, burgers, Alfredo pasta, or nachos). These were not even edible. However, the fresh fruit and gazpacho were delish.
- Not all restaurants were open. Malva was closed.
- Limited lunch options.
- Mina, the steakhouse was horrible. The steak was tough and rubbery even when medium rare and the mashed potatoes didn’t taste real. It would be nice to offer more steak options than just the one, New York strip, that’s included. No filets. Service was poor.
- Staff serving food at the buffet were kinda rude, except the nice lady at the pasta station.
- The water levels in the pools were very low, below the filters. They did come up after a couple days into my stay. The swim up bar was meh and water not high enough when sitting.
- Some areas of the reserve pool were dirty. Needed to be scrubbed.
- You are constantly asked to leave reviews at every meal and throughout your stay. I get it but it gets to be a little too much.

Suggestions
- Food service on Reserve side at the pool bar and beach would be an amazing thing to offer.
- More lunch options would be great.
- Overall, improve the food quality.

Overall, I had a great experience and would go back. The room was beautiful and clean. The resort grounds are beautiful. The reserve option is amazing and affordable too. Everyone was friendly throughout the resort and always asked how everything was. They really seemed to care and wanted to make sure you had a great time. I would probably eat at the Mexican restaurant for most dinners, it was that good!!! I highly recommend the reserve option also.

reviews.author: Anne-Marie Harden
reviews.text: Incredible experience !!!! Would love to come back again soon!!! Excellent service from Nathaniel, Eddie, Rosanna, and Mario at the adults only swim up pool bar!   I loved our adults only experience for our 40th girls birthday trip at this resort , but would also love to bring back my family back here to enjoy the other side as well!!!!

reviews.author: James Campbell
reviews.text:
We have traveled to many destinations and cruises. Hands down the Kidsdom at the Paradisus is the BEST ever.

Everyday we were shocked at the neverending events, jet ski in the pool for our 7 year old, Barbie party, carnival night, Movie on the beach and so much more.

Although the events they had were over the top, the staff really made it all that more special. Everyday they greeted my child with huge smiles and were so friendly. Luckily they allow the parents to observe the events or I may not have seen my child the entire week!

I can't say enough good things about this place!!! Definitely made our trip all that much more fabulous and the resort was the nicest I have ever seen.

James from Indiana

reviews.author: Ro Fabbricante
reviews.text: Our stay at Paradisus Palma Real was made all the more enjoyable by the wonderful service we received from Rosanna and Edito  everyday day at The Linch Box.They   greeted us  with a smile & joyfully cared for our every need  for our family of 9!!!  they are a wonderful asset to the hotel. And we look forward to seeing them next year !

reviews.author: Dana Kien
reviews.text: The restaurant Kanna was great! Our waiter Raphael was fantastic. He was super attentive to our table and the food came out fairly quickly.

reviews.author: Tony Palma
reviews.text: The service here is wonderful. So many people took such wonderful care of us - Yineiri Albuquerque, Ricki de la Cruz, Yudith Ciprian, Maria Ortiz, and Frank Felix at the buffet, and Raul Jimenez at the beach makes the best caipirinhas we have ever had. Juan Castillo, our concierge, worked to change our reservations and accommodate our group of 7. We have been coming here for years and loved this vacation as well.

reviews.author: Omkar Kulkarni
reviews.text: Had a great time making pizza with Brandol and Danyelo! The accompanying Aperol spritzes were also excellent! Rooms are spacious and the all inclusive is very nice. It is a little tough to get reservations for the restaurants, you have to line up really early.

reviews.author: cheri Getty
reviews.text: We had such a wonderful experience with Jose Ramos every morning at paradisis resort Bri Sas. He was extremely personable and welcoming. He is the main reason to come to this restaurant. Not to mention the food was fantastic. Can’t wait to come back to the Dominican and start our day with Jose.

reviews.author: Miguelina Butron
reviews.text: Excellent experience at Flora restaurant! Dismailin was so cute that got space for us without reservation. Our waitress Stefany was so nice and explained very well all the menu. Just a memorable experience!

reviews.author: Joaquin Gonzalez Picazo
reviews.text:
Hotel Paradisus Punta Cana, excellent. The views are overwhelming. service is top quality, specially Rina, Virginia y Alvaro (concierge).

Attended a Sushi workshop in a new visit to the resort. Great class given by sushi-chef  Felix and very well organised by Danyelo De Jesus and the other staff of the resort. Thanks to all of them for such a nice experience for my wife and myself.

reviews.author: Caro
reviews.text: My family loves Paradisus Palma Real. My family comes here every year. We love the service, the buffet/restaurants, the beach, etc. This is a second home to us. Our server, Yafreisi, treats us very well at the buffet every time we come and the supervisor, Eduardo Aquino, is very admirable and charismatic as well. Everything is excellent at this resort. Couldn’t recommend it more.

reviews.author: Gene McQueen
reviews.text: Our Concierge, Hector J was incredible!   He not only took care of our every wish, but he had special surprises for us since we were celebrating our anniversary.   He initiated our reservations for us, and took care of things before we asked, all while being very respectful of our privacy.   I would recommend you ask for Hector when staying at The Reserve area of Paradisus Palma Real!!

reviews.author: gerard mattera
reviews.text:
Service with our Concierge Cristian for the Win!!
June 2023
We stayed at the Paradisus Palm Real. Our room was the Swim Up Reserve room. I strongly recommend this resort. The service is impecable. I would suggest, if you are adults only, to upgrade to the reserve. The private pools and beach area is worth it alone. They also have their own restaurant. We had our private butler Cristian who was nothing short but amazing. He really made sure we were taken care of and didn’t have to deal with anything during our vacation. He made all our dinner reservations and made me feel really special for my birthday celebration! The service at the pool and beach was top notch! Everyone was super sweet and helpful. Pool was clean and super warm. The beach was clean and stunning!. The food was ok. A little better than good. Blue Agave has the best food and Menu. So don’t miss that.
Martin on the beach is the best! He and the rest of the staff goes the extra mile

reviews.author: Starr Alicia
reviews.text: The resort was overall standard. I wish we had better service with our concierge’s instead of seeking our own reservations or finding the daily activities. We only experienced turn down service 2 out of 7 nights. They restocked our mini bar inside the room twice fully. We had to ask the front desk for them to do it moving forward. We had errors on our air conditioning 3 days out of 7 where they had to fix it. We are part of the club Meliá and sat at the pool every day. Not once did we have consecutive service or drinks. At the end, what made our trip was our 3 wonderful bartenders at Kicks sports bar. Miguel, Andrianna, and Victor. If I could specifically rate the bar, 5 stars. 10 stars if I could.

reviews.author: Thomas Lemrow Jr
reviews.text:
Tokimeku restaurant was good. SANTO took care of us and made sure our reservation was perfect fornour Anniversary and my Birthday! Chef Amazing finished the night off right with keeping the family entertained and feed exceptionally well! I even got an amazing birthday cake that was delicious!

Buffet lunch Box Maira, Yantra, Maria were excellent server's!  They took great care to ensure our food and drinks!

reviews.author: Jacqueline Subramaniam
reviews.text: The beach service is great.  Marileisey is awesome. Super attentive all week and helped out our family the whole time. She made our trip and experience awesome!

reviews.author: Tiffany Tran
reviews.text:
Editing my review because I was coerced into rating 5 stars by Jordania. she hovered over me while I was writing the review, repetitively touched my phone and removed me from airplane mode because of the poor internet in the lobby but luckily I was paying attention and reverted it before I charged with roaming fees.

However, I must mention a few staff members who were AMAZING and went above and beyond for us:
- Yiri from ginger bar showed us a beautiful spot for a group photo
- Yensy del Rosario and Jairo were so helpful and passionate in their work during each workshop. I wish we could’ve attended more!
- From malva, stormin capitan, franklin Diaz and Maria Santana made our last dinner very special

My honest review of the resort is as follows:

Pros:
- The resort and master suite was beautiful, they were true to the photos online. We got a great deal.
- My friends and I came for the girls trip and were not disappointed.
- The restaurant and bar staff were great and friendly. Although a bit slow at times
- room service is good and attentive. Probably one of their best services
- the free mixology and pizza/aperol spritz workshop were so fun and we’re one of the highlights of our trip. Highly recommend
- Fine white sand beaches

Cons:
- no nightlife whatsoever. Mainly families
- food is just ok. Almost everywhere you go, the meats will always be a bit over cooked but each restaurant has at least 1 good dish. (I enjoyed the steakhouse and flora the most in terms of service, quality and flavour)
- cocktails and drinks are ok. Inconsistent but would recommend the main pool and indoor bars
- I’ve been to cleaner beaches but at least Paradisus is more well maintained than it’s adjacent resorts
- body sunscreen is EXPENSIVE at least 38-58USD per bottle so bring your own
-buffet was good but it’s 1/3 the size of other resorts I’ve been to and the breakfast staff there were very slow

Another friendly couple we met shared the same sentiment towards the resort. This is a beautiful resort and I liked my experience enough that I would consider coming back all things considered, if the price is right.

reviews.author: Nicole Emrich
reviews.text:
We are currently enjoying our stay in a two bedroom Nikte swim up suite. The room is modern and clean and our concierge, Yaleidi, has been wonderful since we arrived. She has taken care of any questions, made reservations and even provided a fantastic birthday celebration for my husband. Another all-star is Daiana, who serves as front of house for many of the restaurants. She is a joy to be around and always has a big smile on her face. Other fantastic staff are Marta and Olvi in restaurants and Luis at the pool bar.

Overall, we are very happy with the property, service and food. All of the staff is friendly and fun and we’d recommend this property to our friends.

reviews.author: Vilma Carolina Barbosa
reviews.text:
Kicks Sports bar is a great addition to Palma real. Andreina and Luis Rosario are great hosts and they go above and beyond to meet your expectations. Also our concierge Juan Castillo is amazing, always at your beck and call making you feel like VIP. I highly recommend This hotel.
Ginger bar is a fun bar. They have live music and the ambiance is super chill. The staff are so warm and attentive. Ismael, Antonio, Dominga,Grey,Clary,Leanni y Dryan Thank you for an amazing time.

reviews.author: Dominic Fonti
reviews.text:
We had dinner at Mascalzone Restaurant in Paradisus Palma Real. The service and the food were excellent, thanks is to the manager Milton.   For many years we have been coming to Paradisus and Milton has always demonstrated the the welcoming, friendly, accommodating, and professional attitude not just with us but with other guests.
Definitely go to Mascalzone or any other restaurant that Milton manages.

reviews.author: Deb Main
reviews.text: This has been an amazing experience.  The staff had been so friendly and helpful the entire time.  Jordania helped us with our prices to understand how to get back to the airport and check out.  The grounds have been immaculate the entire time,  they are always cleaning and keeping up the grounds.  I would highly recommend this resort and I plan to be back again.

reviews.author: Raj G
reviews.text: The kids club was absolutely amazing for my girls. Lots of good activities to keep them busy. They were very comfortable with the ladies.

reviews.author: Nickie Crumb
reviews.text:
The recipe for a perfect day...
Start your day at the Ginger Bar with ANTHONY! His charisma and happiness will begin your stay in heaven. The team of Dominga, Ismael, Nereida, Vianny, and Criseida are part of the reason our vacation was a pleasure.

Plan time to eat at Sante; its well worth the price of upgrade; the personal attention from staff (Juan, Frankie, and Luz ) provide the taste of every delicacy offered and never disappointed.

Blue Agave was delicious and  attentive. Highly recommended for an elegant Mexican meal.

The tapenyaki restaurant (Tokimeku) was an entertaining and delicious experience.

The Winery was a spectacular experience with Maximo and Jhonathan; if you get a chance to eat here, one entrée of meat charcuterie can easily feed 8.

Be sure to make reservations at Mina; Kelvin's smile is intoxicating and his attention to detail (new glass for wine, new napkins if dropped, etc.) is much appreciated. Our glasses were never empty and our smiles didn't fade.

If your stay includes The Water Journey at The Garden Suites (YHI), ask for Erika! She ensured we didn't stay in each area too long and had inscense throughout the area.

If you're lucky enough to have Basilo as a concierge, you have been blessed! We felt safe and comfortable our entire stay and plan to return as soon as possible.

reviews.author: Shane Raber
reviews.text: Our experience at the Paridisus Palma Real was amazing. Awesome service all around. Franklin and Rafael at Sante restaurant took very good care of us and made us feel at home. We had an awesome time!

reviews.author: Kenyatta McCan
reviews.text: Absolutely the best, hands down bartender. Maria, mama cita! Rum Republic to check her out. Great experience with specialtie drinks.

reviews.author: Marc
reviews.text: Our experience at Sante in Paradisus Palma real was exceptional. Barnelis always greeted us with a smile. From attention to detail to excellent service, Juan Alcantra was on top of everything during our breakfast and dinner service. He's very personable and we highly commend him. Edwin made our Sante dinner fun as he entertained us throughout the night with his jokes and bubbly personality. We definitely will come back.

reviews.author: Danny Guzman
reviews.text: Great location to vacation. Staff bartender Joel and Marelacey, and beach attendant Raul are very friendly and willing to help in anyway to make your experience great and mostly make you feel like family. Highly recommended hundred fold. Love coming here anytime I set my vacation. Kidsdom was great and we love how they treated our girls.

reviews.author: Dawn Jeter
reviews.text: Yamilet was a wonderful server and met all of the needs at blue agave. She was helpful to allergy needs

reviews.author: Misty Shulenburger
reviews.text: Mascalzone restaurant was amazing!!! Bernabe and Wilmina, our waiter and waitelress, we’re both very attentive to our tables needs and very polite.  Milton, the supervisor,  stayed on top of everything, making sure everyone had what they needed if the other staff was busy.  The food was very tasty and the wine selection was terrific!  So happy with this our experience here. Leninismo and Jose Ramirez were very helpful getting our luggage and assisting with special needs when we were checking out.

reviews.author: Janet Lexie
reviews.text:
Flora restaurant manger was very rude.
He stated that it was an adult only restaurant but the next day when I went. We saw children eating in the restaurant.

Jholfry and danyelo was very very nice and helpful they went above and beyond to Accomdate my family.
Great customer service

reviews.author: shoshana babaev
reviews.text: The food is great . Rosanna was so helpful in getting us all our drinks and giving us amazing service . They r on top of everything and making sure your taken care of

reviews.author: Matthew Vukojevic
reviews.text:
Editing my review: the food at the buffet for me was better than the restaurants. The resort is great during the day, just needs more night activities. Wilmer at the front desk was a huge help, best person at the resort. Great coffee bar called Ginger near thr lobby. The bars like Between and Rum Republic are basically waiting rooms for the restaurants (you might have to wait even if you have a reservation), but the drinks are legit. Overall a great stay and a really nice resort, the decor is world class.

Original review that was accosted: Tokimeku has great food! Good food, Santo and Maria provided great service.

reviews.author: Drayton Carter
reviews.text: Italian Restaurant Paradisus, Punta Cana. Excellent service by Yensen and Supervisor Milton. Very good food, truly satisfied.

reviews.author: Femme Fest Detroit
reviews.text: This trip has been excellent. We have had superior dining experiences. Tonight we  visited Flora for a Dominican Dining Experience and were greeted by Santo the head of dining, Minelva our waitress and Gene our server everyone was attentive and our food was filling. I am very please with the service and the experience at Flora is A-1.

reviews.author: Alicia I
reviews.text: The Flora restaurant is a wonderful place to have dinner. The food is delicious, the atmosphere is beautiful and the service here is superb. Andrea S. made sure we received top notch service!

reviews.author: Jhunelle Lyra Culala
reviews.text: The Italian restaurant Mascalzone was amazing. From the manager Milton and all the staff were very attentive. Our waiter, Fausto was very attentive. The food was delicious and came out very quickly. Five star all over!!!

reviews.author: Alexis Clinton
reviews.text: We have absolutely loved this resort so far!!  We ate at Flora and everything was out of this world!  Cesar was a wonderful waiter at this restaurant, very attentive!

reviews.author: Olivia Wu
reviews.text: This resort surprised us in so many ways! Outstanding service, beach view and service. The best surprise was that they had huge telescopes on site as entertainment which was the highlight of our trip. The guys with the telescopes were so knowledgeable about space and were eager to show us the wonders of the sky including the moon, Jupiter, Saturn, and Nebula. We got super lucky that our trip coincided with the longest lunar eclipse of this century, so we had the chance to gaze upon the lunar eclipse through the telescope which was a magical experience. Aside from this, food was amazing and the buffet had many selections. They also have 4 restaurants offering different cuisines and all were pretty great. The rooms come with large jetted hot tub that easily fits 2 people which helped us wind down from the day. Service was outstanding - every staff was super friendly and helpful. COVID testing was also seamless and hassle-free. Would definitely recommend this resort if you're looking for a relaxing getaway trip!

reviews.author: DD
reviews.text:
My family and I have come to the Paradisus Palma Real for several years now and always have an outstanding time here. The rooms are excellent and if there is anything amiss they are very responsive to resolve any and all issues you may have. They really make you feel like your experience is paramount.

In terms of the staff members, there is some really amazing people here who truly care about your experience. Special shoutout to the staff at the Ginger bar Lucia, Altagracia Jimenez and Luis - they always go above and beyond to ensure our pre-and post-dinner drinks are amazing and that our experience is great.

Last but certainly not least, Pedro, Wanda and Fiora always make us feel exceptionally welcome and are always a joy to speak with and catch up with as the years have gone on. I will continue to come back to this Palma Real and suggest it to others.

reviews.author: Todd Dillmon
reviews.text:
Wow!! The lunch box is such a great place to
Eat.  Maria and Yafreisy were so helpful and very attentive to our needs.  Daniela was great as well and took care of us as well.
I would recommend this resort and to eat at The Lunch Box

reviews.author: Ann Dolin
reviews.text: Nightly entertainment with dancing is amazing and so much fun!!! THE DANCERS, ESPECIALLY FREILYN (AY AY AY!!) is absolutely the BEST and gets the whole crowd dancing!  So much fun!!!

reviews.author: Rudell Richardson
reviews.text: We have thoroughly enjoyed our stay here at The Reserve. Our concierge Yaleidi Sims has been the perfect host. She was always responsive and attentive to our needs. Her personality was always engaging as well. We will definitely request her upon our return in the future. Thanks so much for making our vacation memorable and enjoyable!

reviews.author: Brooke Timms
reviews.text: Activities have been fun and entertaining! Jesus interacted well with all ages whether it was with volleyball, bracelet making, or inflatables. We are sad to be leaving tomorrow and will especially miss Jesus!

reviews.author: Stefanie Natelson
reviews.text: Just finished a wonderful lunch at kanna with Virginia! We have been coming back for 15yrs she treats us like family, she has the table set for us, pre orders our kids lunch, orders our kids drinks and prepares wine to cook as we review the menu! Virginia goes above and beyond to make our lunch amazing!!!

reviews.author: Angela Febles
reviews.text: The people here are dedicated to you for you to enjoy your vacations. They all deserve for me to mention. Lilian at the Gardens by Melia went beyond in order for us to have a great time at the bar. Miguel bar tender at the main hotel, Palma Real between the Mexican restaurant & the Italian prepared outstanding coffee martinis for us every night. Yuderi the best beach attendant we have had!!! He took care of us for the whole week. We had our towels on the chairs every morning. He give us advice to where to go. He is amazing!!! When we come back we will love to see him again!!!

reviews.author: Joni Cupp
reviews.text: Rosanna,Yanira , Maria were our helpers at the buffet every day.  We love them and they even had a birthday table for my husbands 60th birthday.   They made our trip fabulous and greeted us every morning with a smile and hug.

reviews.author: Ron Roth
reviews.text: Paradisus Palma Real is a wonderful place. My family has been coming for many years.    While the setting and rooms are great, I must say it’s the people that make this place special.
