The staff here becomes like family.  A special thank you to Delvin who takes care of us for breakfast and at Blue Agave for dinner.  He is a wonderful person and is now part of our family.  Also, Wily Mercado our concierge always does an awesome job.

reviews.author: Jennifer Taylor
reviews.text: Beautiful resort! We had a wonderful 4 days here. Everyone is so nice, great service and great food. Bellman Jose Ramirez provided great service as did everyone in the buffet restaurant where we ate most of our meals.

reviews.author: giuseppina troia
reviews.text:
Restuarant Mina excellent in service , the best food …
Our waiter Junior along with Melvin exceptionally courteous on point and respectful. We’re on point with drinks , bringing our food on time and to our request. Will definitely refer this restaurant to family and friends.

reviews.author: Catherine Perez
reviews.text:
Everything was amazing. The ambiance, the service all was great. Jorge Rafael was great to assist us with our pool activities and necessities as well and the Wanda as our amazing bartender Wanda and their assistants Teaofilo, Grey morel were amazing at he reserve pool/ bar.  My husband and I had great service by them and a great time.

The massage tech Gladys Domingues was also amazing.

Our amazing concierge Felix Gracia was amazing at tending to our needs and requests. I wound turly recommend this resort and the upgrade to reserve
All was amazin!!!

reviews.author: Paul Nguyen
reviews.text: Resort was good, newly renovated. As expected for Dominican, food was good at the restaurants, ok at the buffet. Jose, Manuel and John were great with the luggage. Service overall was good. Harry was a great concierge, Mack was inconsistent.

reviews.author: Mechelle Posner
reviews.text: Rosanna Yamuna Rocio.  She was amazing at the buffet.  She greeted us with a smile and a hug every morning and had our table waiting with our beverages.  Superior service!!!

reviews.author: Diana Pukhovich
reviews.text:
KIDSDOM: Absolutely Exceptional – A Must for Families!

Our experience at Kidsdom in Paradisus Palma was nothing short of incredible! From the moment our children stepped in, they were welcomed with warmth, enthusiasm, and genuine care. The staff at Kidsdom go above and beyond to make every child feel special, all the ladies who work here (Lisbeth, Luisa, Jessica, Masiel, Sugedy whom we had the pleasure of this week) are truly the heart of it all. Their kindness, patience, and energy are unmatched—they dont just supervise the children; they engage with them, play alongside them, and make every activity exciting and memorable.

Each day was packed with fun and creative activities, from arts and crafts, cookie and pizza making, and painting to keychain designing, T-shirt making, and pool games. They even hosted special celebrations for the Dominican Independence Day, adding a cultural touch to the experience. What impressed us the most was the personal attention given to every child. The staff remember each child by name, greet them with smiles and hugs, and genuinely make them feel like part of a big, loving family.

Our kids were so happy that they would often run over just to say hello and give hugs in between activities—a true testament to how much they adored the staff and felt at home. As parents, nothing is more comforting than knowing your children are in such caring and capable hands.

If you’re visiting Paradisus Palma with kids, Kidsdom is an absolute must! It’s a safe, engaging, and magical place where children can learn, create, and have endless fun. We are beyond grateful for the love and dedication of the Kidsdom team! Thank you!

reviews.author: Kevin Dymond
reviews.text:
The most fun and entertaining dinner! Kandy, Stormin and Luis not only provided a delicious meal but exceptional service! Highly recommend this dining experience!

Luis and the kicks bar team is a great a place to let loose and dance the night away! Great staff fast drinks, and a hell of a time to let loose!

Virginia and laicha at the kanna kitchen was delicious everyday! The service was great always; so kind and amazing!

The Italian restaurant was great and the calzones were outta of this world, best meals on the resort. Fausto was always the best server we had him in multiple restaurants, he was great, very attentive. Do be scared to ask for extra meals! You paid for it! 😂

reviews.author: Jeffrey Murray
reviews.text: Dinner at Mina: Mina is the steak house and was absolutely delicious. Daiana Rodriguez was out manager and Yudelki an Kelvin were our servers.  They were amazing. Food was served promptly and was amazing. The Veal pate was so tender and my steak was amazing without any of the sauces. Best dinner we had here on our last night here!

reviews.author: Lily Rapoz
reviews.text: Enjoyed lunch at the Gabi Beach restaurant and Bar. We had Dayhani as our server and she was fantastic and a breath of fresh air. Dayhani made our family feel very welcomed and went above and beyond to make our experience a great one. She even took the time to teach our kids to order their food in Spanish. Thank you Dayhani for everything ❤️

reviews.author: Selina Kron
reviews.text:
Relaxing week with truly great food and drinks (many options)! Hotel facilities are modern and nice. Everything is clean. Most of the people are very friendly.
Our concierge Eriol always gave us the necessary information about the daily activities and restaurant reservations in the morning. He also made us some nice surprises. All restaurants are good, but Flora (Melina y Eduardo) and Santé were spectacular. The staff at both were exceptionally friendly and helpful. The gin-ger bar is amazing (Dominga makes the best cocktails). In the Kicks bar there could be more Ambiente in the evening. The TVs are disturbing. It would be great if there was more latin music (actually everywhere). The shows are nice but mostly don't start at the indicated times (sometimes earlier and sometimes later).
There are many activities. Many of them only last a few minutes. However some of them, especially the ones led by Hairon or Brandol are longer and very fun! They really make an effort to make the people feel good.
Our trip with the catamaran was nice and the yoga session with Amy very relaxing. The private beach was beautiful and Yeison was exceptionally attentive.
Overall a very nice experience!  Huge thanks to Hairon for the authentic positive energy always!

reviews.author: Rob Dick
reviews.text: Cesar the server at Flora restaurant at Paradisus Melia was very knowledgeable and attentive to me and my wife’s requests. We will definitely come back and will request Cesar as our server.

reviews.author: Lindsey Stacy
reviews.text:
We stayed for our anniversary week and had the best time! Our concierge Marianyi went above and beyond for us to ensure we had a great time.

All the bartenders at Gabi Bar were excellent, Victor, Juan and Luis were so much fun and crafted amazing cocktails.

reviews.author: Sumintra Saitep
reviews.text:
We did merengue and Water aerobics and make your own pizza workshop with jorge Rafael. He was amazing and so attentive . Our family had an amazing time . Jorge was full of energy and made us feel so comfortable ! Thank you so much for an amazing experience.

Also, Jonathan at the Members Pool/bar was phenomenal. He was attentive and amazing with the kids. He went above and beyond with the service. He was friendly, and we got to share stories. Thank you Jonathan for your amazing work.

reviews.author: Stephen Tedeschi
reviews.text: Gin Ger was one of the best experiences !  The staff was superb !  Ismael, Antonio, dominga, metric, yeti and Chris were the bomb!  Always had my drink ready when they saw approaching!  Define need to stop by the Gin Ger when you come here!

reviews.author: Kirk Bryan
reviews.text: As a well traveled person I honestly can say this is one of the best resorts I've been to. The service was spectacular especially Micheal, Elizabeth, and Esmeralda. Our rooms were really nice and accessible. Overall the staff was super accommodating and made the trip excellent.

reviews.author: Neelima
reviews.text: Laura and Alexander Bryan were amazing staff! We wanted to celebrate our friend's birthday and they made it super special. They were incredibly attentive!

reviews.author: Clover F
reviews.text:
Having a wonderful time at Paradisus Palma Real Resort, Punta Cana. Gleny’s and Felix at  Flora Restaurant provided excellent service. In addition the food was amazing! Real Dominican cuisine. However our first encounter with Felix was at the Lunch Box Buffet where he was outstanding there too! Both were very  attentive and welcoming. Others that were very caring were during our meals at the breakfast buffet were Rosanna, Hidalgo and my man Edito. They knew were we wanted to be seated and our choice of beverages each morning. Loved the attention!

Daniela the hostess at several of the resort restaurants made us feel very special! She remembered us every time we dined with a loving greeting.

I would be remiss if I didn’t mention Zenovia! As soon as we arrived on our first day she took special care of us regarding a check in process. After which she made sure to greet us with her wonderful smile and personality EVERY DAY and to see how we were doing. A real darling!!!

And lastly, our concierge Ariel took care of from sunrise to sunset! Made sure our every need was taking care of. Much thanks Ariel. Hope to see you again.

reviews.author: Karen Teasdale
reviews.text: We just returned from a week stay and can’t say enough good things about this hotel - especially the staff!  The resort and room was beautiful and our concierge Yaleidi Sims went above and beyond!  One of our regular servers was Alexander Bryan - we got to know him while there - such an amazing person!  Lastly a shout out to Jairo for getting us dancing and doing yoga - lots of fun with him - can’t wait to return!

reviews.author: Eric Powell
reviews.text:
This resort is beautiful and our concierge “Hector” made it even better. He was available from the moment we arrived on the grounds. Very warm and personable. It was as if we has known him for years. He took care of all our dining reservations as well as any other accommodations we requested. Very detailed oriented  Dining was also awesome and food was delicious. Pool and ground areas were clean and just a beautiful beach scene. I would recommend this resort as well as our concierge Hector to all whom we meet. Thanks Hector for making our vacation a success!

Had dinner last nite at Mina's restaurant and the food as well as the crew was fantastic Daiana, Kelvin, Olvi, Almonte were the best. I recommend all to stop in and enjoy. I feel we have a new group of friends. They will be missed. Asta la vista!

Ginger bar was the best bar on the resort. Lucia,Olga1,Olga2,Nataneal and Walquirua, and the whole crew were the best host. I hope those of you whose names i have forgotten will forgive me.They will be truly missed. Say hello for us once you visit. hasta luego!

reviews.author: molney09
reviews.text: Our poolside waiter Raul was amazing! He took care of us all week and did a great job. Definitely find Raul when you get here, you will not regret it!

reviews.author: Betina Garcia
reviews.text:
We had amazing service at the Italian restaurant mascalzone, the food was excellent but the service was even better, friendly
and still completely efficient! Can’t ask for more!!
Junior Reyes,  Bernabe Guillén, Franklin Bautista (captain) Dayana Rodrigues (hostess) were the best  highly recommend!!

On another note, the beach service was always on point, we never had to look for our guy because he would be there before we even knew we needed him, Yuderi always found great spots and took care of every need we had, highly recommend him and this beach crew!!!

Our concierge Hector Rodriguez was a
Delight, made our stay wonderful and made sure we ate at every place we wanted and helped in any way we needed!!! Make sure to ask for him if you can!
Emmanuel, Melvin and Jose are just wonderful and took care of our luggage in the most efficient way!!!

reviews.author: Rachel Johnson
reviews.text: The entertainment is spectacular at the resort. Brandol and Jholfry are a great leads for these events, shows and activities. He makes everyday for my friends and I at the resort fun. Always happy to see us and gets the party going!

reviews.author: Riddhi Brahmbhatt
reviews.text: This resort is so beautiful it feels like paradise on earth. The view is awesome, the pool and bar , everything is great. The service is also good. They care about us and make sure they we are happy with the service and having a good time. The restaurants have a lot of options including vegetarian. I’d definitely recommend this resort if you’re looking for fun relaxing vacation.

reviews.author: Cesar Figueredo
reviews.text: Great place and scenery. Excellent service, the employees made sure we were well attended and hydrated. Provided us with various drinks, both alcoholic and non alcoholic. Isaias, Wilmer, Hansel, made sure that everyone was comfortable in their stay.

reviews.author: D Greene
reviews.text: Luis Desa, Luis Vilorio and Walkiria are simply the best the amazing customer service and attention to detail to the customer experience it completely worth the trip. Thank you to the entire Ginger team they are the best and will be my reason to return to the Palma Real. Thank you and thank you 1000 times over.

reviews.author: Michelle Ragusa- McBain
reviews.text:
Amazing rooms and service, beautiful venue for our conference in paradise.

The best restaurants were Flora and the Rest lunch  box which surely delivered- with delicious food, presentation and  amazing service by John and Yudit and supervisor Milton were superb!

Highly recommend!

reviews.author: muriel pena
reviews.text: The place is beautiful! From the food to the service it was all great. Yuderi was phenomenal!  He was Very attentive, polite, and had great suggestions for drinks. He had made my experience here one of a kind.

reviews.author: Regina McGovern
reviews.text: Harry is the best!!! He was super attentive to what we wanted and was always available!  His smile brightens you day and he’s always smiling. When he says he’s going to get something done he does it. We changed our plans sometimes with little notice. He took it in stride and made the new plans happen. We will be requesting him as our concierge next time we visit!

reviews.author: Larry Palmer
reviews.text: Dalmis and Cristian have been excellent hosts. Always available and friendly. We were here with a large group and our service in all the restaurants was very good. Our room was always done whenever we returned to it. Great vacation spot!

reviews.author: Cory Pontarollo
reviews.text: Angelo is the absolute best. He was one of the server’s/bartenders at the beach/pool. He treated you like family, and more importantly, a good man. Ask for him when you arrive!

reviews.author: William Nunez
reviews.text: Rocio,  Maira and Ricki were awesome as they attended to our every needs on a daily basis which made up for the service at the front desk which was horrible as they assign us a swim up roo. Which we reserved and when we arrived at the room we had no water at the swim up until we asked to speak to management.

reviews.author: Angel Martinez
reviews.text: Service is outstanding, Miguel and John and Melvin are very welcoming and make you feel at home. They greet it us and welcomed us and helped out right away. Our concierge Dali’s has been excellent! He has been great at arranging everything and very polite.

reviews.author: Nicole Martinez
reviews.text: We dined at Flora on our first night at Paradisus and it was a wonderful experience! Francisco and Bladimir were fantastic servers and each course was delicious, perfectly portioned. Highly recommend this restaurant for Caribbean cuisine during your stay!

reviews.author: Lisa Coburn
reviews.text: Flora restaurant was outstanding. A must have is the Dominican soup and the Salmon dinner. Bladimir has been the friendliest and by far the BEST server we have had during our stay at this gorgeous resort. Eduardo, the manager of Flora, is also very friendly and informative. If you want some delicious local Carribean style food, you must go to Flora.

reviews.author: Kaila Barbosa
reviews.text: Maira was very good she was attentive with everything

reviews.author: Frederique Canuel
reviews.text: Had a amazing week at Paradisus Palma Real, our first time in Punta Cana. Excellent and attentive service from our concierge Felix. Outstanding drinks from Maria and Juan at Rum Republic, they know real mixology. Food was great all around (maybe a bit less at Santé). Beach is beautiful with little to no sargassum. Service at the Reserve beach was great by Rafael and Gilberto. Room is spacious and luxurious. Will be back for sure.

reviews.author: Celina CN
reviews.text: Directly on the beach. Staff are wonderful. Beautiful well-kept grounds and facilities. 7 or 8 pools including swim-up bar and adults-only. Buffet is ample and delicious; otherwise the food is mediocre. Private Reserve is worth it.

reviews.author: Aurelio Solis
reviews.text: Stayed for 5 days 4 nights.  The staff at Lunch Box Rosanna, Gorgelys and Hilda were so attentive. Rosanna and Carolin at the adult pool bar took very well care of us! All their staff was amazing. Definitely will be coming back!!

reviews.author: mauro lagana
reviews.text:
Me and my wife spent our honeymoon at Paradisus Palma Real and it was a really nice stay! The place is beautiful, clean and well kept, the food is delicious but, above all, every member of the staff - from the people at the lobby to waiters and barmen - is very kind, polite and always smiling.
A special thank to Raul, who took care of us at the beach and made sure we had constantly something to drink!
The only defect was the experience with our concierge, especially during the chek-out: we would have needed a better help in order to organise our departure, furthermore we left without saying goodbye, cause he didn't show up during our last day...

reviews.author: Test Test
reviews.text: The 5 star reviews must be fake.  This place is 3 stars at best.  Grounds are kept well, the facility is nice BUT the staff is mediocre(not friendly) and the food is atrocious (like really bad).   Pool is not heated and cold!  This place may have been nice years ago but they are obviously doing significant cost cutting.   I would not recommend this resort.

reviews.author: Maria Jorge
reviews.text:
My family and I had an amazing stay at Paradisus reserve. The staff immediately welcomed us with drinks and snacks. Our concierge Ariel Benzo gave us a tour at the resort, showed us our fantastic swim up room. He was very professional  and promptly answered all my questions. He would send me daily activities and also made dinner reservation for us. The buffet, kids dorm, eating area at the pool were excellent. The buffet had a variety of delicious food, my kids enjoyed the food very much. All staff were excellent and willing to help. I love the fact that they had a smile on their faces at all times. I would like to name some of them. Maria, Luis, Frank, Dyones (buffet), Juan (Bar) Axel (activities) and Alexandra, Katiuska, Martina (Kids dorm). Kids miss you 😘 🤩
We did two amazing excursions and felt safe the whole time.

Overall,  we had a memorable experience!!!
I would definitely go back and  highly recommend it.

reviews.author: aliflago
reviews.text: This was our second time staying at Melia in the DR. First time at Paradisus. I can not recommend this place enough. Absolutely everything was spectacular, the main entrance is grand and opens up to a beautiful courtyard. The rooms were great and very comfortable and the amenities were fantastic. What really stood out though is the service. The employees here have been nothing but wonderful every step of the way. Every single person goes above and beyond to serve you and always do so with a smile and respect. The best bar with the best drinks and most phenomenal service are at Gin Ger. If you can get ahold of Ismael, Lucia, Antonio, Clari, Trinidad, Criseida, and Madelyn you will be very satisfied.

reviews.author: Apple Jacks
reviews.text: The service from the ginger bar is the best of the best! Ismael, both the Olga’s, Dominga, Clary were very attentive. The milkshakes and coffees were fantastic. You definitely want to stop here for your drinks!

reviews.author: Michael Basquette
reviews.text: We had the best time at paradisus!!   Jorge Rafael gave us tons of fun activities, including dance lessons, water aerobics, and  pizza making.  Everyone was great, also fior at the sports bar.  We had the most fun and will definitely come back!  Our butler Lewis was superb and hooked us up with everything.  Johnathon and Milagros were the most fun at the pool.

reviews.author: Kara H
reviews.text: We had the best experience! The service everywhere you go is phenomenal. Our concierge Starlin was so helpful, kind, & responsive! On the beach, Odebi and Raynelli are our favorite beach service guys! They are always in a great mood, fun, and helpful! They are our favorites!!!!

reviews.author: Katy Woodward
reviews.text: We just celebrated our honeymoon at the Paradisus Palma Real and it was awesome! Our amazing concierge Zenovia made sure everything was handled for us, from reservations, to spa treatments and excursions. I definitely recommend coming here if you are looking for a beautiful all inclusive experience. Also, we had a great experience at the spa we had amazing massages from Alma and Ironely. Definitely recommend visiting the spa when you come! Lastly, we loved the staff at the beach at pool on the reserve side of the hotel - Wanda, Pedro, Gilberto, Martin, Eddy, and others were so friendly and helpful! Thank you all for an awesome experience!

reviews.author: Zachariah Krieger
reviews.text: Beautiful resort! We are here for the second year in a row (we married here last year) and loved it so much we had to come back! The staff makes you feel right at home, definitely ask for Gregory in the buffet area he is too notch! Beaches are ridiculously gorgeous, and because I love golf the course is only a 5 min bus ride away where they will store your clubs all week (reasonable cart fees if staying on resort, if not expect to get gouged). Rooms are great, beds are comfortable, and the maid service keeps everything newt and clean. We will expect to be coming back here for years!

reviews.author: Amy butler
reviews.text:
Just got back from a fabulous vacation with our three grown kids at Paradisus Palma.  Can’t say enough about the incredible service, amazing rooms, reserve pools, beach, and food.  After shopping around for a resort that had great food, some nightlife, but not too wild, nice beach where you were able to swim.  We stayed at another resort about 40 mins from the airport back in March where water was too rough to swim so this was high on our list. We stayed in two junior suite garden reserve rooms.  They far exceeded our expectations, completely renovated with beautiful balconies providing amazing views of the ocean and a staff that kept our fridge and snacks stocked and towels plentiful.
Great food and drinks are high on our list when choosing where to spend our vacations and Paradisus didn’t disappoint.  All of the restaurants were excellent as well as the service we received.  The waiters made our nights!
No complaints where any of the bars are concerned… impressed with the drinks all around at the resort, but we spent most of our time at the reserve swim up pool.  Rosanna, Eddie, Silvia and Nathaniel were so much fun.  Great drinks and awesome music- they made it feel like a tropical vacation.  Will miss them!  One of our favorite spots was Ginger bar.  The staff and coffee/drinks were amazing.  Loved our morning Santo Domingo coffees!  We enjoyed a few fun nights there with the entertainment.  Great vibe.

The best thing about this resort was our concierge, Zenovia. We haven’t had a concierge on previous vacations, but when we booked the reserve rooms we were provided concierge service.  Highly recommend and will opt for that whenever possible in the future.  Zenovia made our vacation totally relaxing and absolutely amazing!  She made all of our dinner reservations at the times that worked for our family, booked massages and yoga excursion, checked on us wherever we were throughout the day, and arranged for our airport transfer for our trip home.   She was highly regarded by many of the staff in the restaurants.  On our last day she was able to get us a late check out which allowed us to stay in our  room until 5:00pm and at the pool until 4:30!  I can’t say enough about Zenovia, we will all miss her!

We would definitely return.  The resort  is absolutely beautiful with a relaxing tropical vibe.  Thanks for a great vacation.

reviews.author: Jaroline Ferreras
reviews.text: It was a really calm hotel, you could really really relax in here, I came here with my family and I can say that I definitely enjoyed my stay here. The rooms are really beautiful though the bathroom is a little bit too exposed for my liking. The staff was really nice and cordial to us and the restaurant we reserved at “flora” had some really good food, this is definitely a hotel to come if you want to relax.

reviews.author: Équipe Lauzon Team
reviews.text: The service at the Paradisius is incredible. Raul and Hansel on the beach are so helpful and will do anything to accommodate your needs. We always feel so welcome. We were in room 3022 Rosanna at the buffet was so kind and so lovely

reviews.author: Cody Recinos
reviews.text:
I recently stayed at the Paradisus Resort and I was amazed away by the amazing food and service! The staff was incredibly friendly and attentive, always making sure that I had everything I needed. The food was absolutely good and there were so many options to choose from. I especially loved the fresh seafood and the variety of international cuisine. Overall, I had an amazing experience at the Paradisus Resort and I highly recommend it to anyone looking for a luxurious vacation with top-notch food and service. yovanny gonzalez and ricki de la cruz gave amazing service, they were welcoming and very attentive, along with the great food.

Thank you to our concierge Alejandro and his friend Raul!!!

Staff overall is simply nice!

reviews.author: Marina M
reviews.text:
This past week, my family and I stayed at Paradisus Palms Real and it was such a great time.

This hotel was very accommodating to our needs and was very helpful! Our concierge throughout our stay was Kelvin. Every morning Kelvin would message us the activities for the day, booked our dinner reservations, and checked in to see how we’re doing. The location was perfect and beautiful. The beach was very clean and easily accessible. When you lay on the beach chairs make sure to ask for yuderi, he was so nice and attentive. One night for dinner, he we were at the Benihana style Japanese restaurant which was so fun!! The chef was amazing and made the atmosphere so enjoyable. The chefs name is Yovanny.

Right when we got here the staff was really helpful with our luggage’s and always took care of us. Jhon and Miguel helped us move our luggage’s comfortably. If you need help with your stuff make sure to ask for Jhon and Miguel!

At the hotel, there’s a bar called Gin Ger that’s opened 24 hours. All the staff were great and knew our favorite drinks. The staffs names were Ismael, Criceida, Antonio, Lisbeth, and Soranyy. They were all amazing!

reviews.author: Marcus Delgado
reviews.text: Luis Rodriguez restaurant Kanna, the best service in the world. He goes above and beyond to make sure me and my family are having the best experience! I wish I can give him 10 stars! He needs to train the whole staff cause he’s unbelievable! Maximo from the winery was amazing, he went above and beyond for me and my family. Edito is the best, he took care of us in every restaurant we had his service, excellent service!

reviews.author: Andrew Borges
reviews.text: As a customer who has been coming for almost 20 years (essentially since I was born) the quality has decreased dramatically. Our perks for being members have been taken away in an attempt to sell them back to us as part of an upgraded package. That is very disgusting and predatory marketing behavior. I can’t say that I will be returning next year. The activities on the hotel itinerary are not even accurate or guaranteed to happen. They’ll blame it on an event, but why should families suffer at the expense of a company retreat… Overall, very disappointed with the service. Only thing worth noting would be the activities team. One of the few hospitable people here attempting to spice up the atmosphere. We played volleyball with the activities team. Jorge Rafael, Rosa Mercedes, and Stephanie Ovalles are very good and hospitable.

reviews.author: Leanne K
reviews.text:
Laura, Alexander and Chef Engel were the amazing at Blue Agave. The service and food were amazing. We had the barbacoa tacos and they were amazing. Would recommend to anyone staying at Paradisus!

Jairo and Yensy were great hosts and the best part of our stay. The pizza making and mixology classes were very informative and fun.

We ate at Malva Restaurant on our last night and it was amazing. The service was excellent and we received drinks and great food the whole night. Big shout out to Franklin Diaz, Stormin, and Maria especially. They made sure we had a great night. Exceptional service, definitely the best dinner we had by far.

reviews.author: Yele Aluko
reviews.text:
Excellent ambience. Room was very nice and the mini bar was well stocked. Hotel staff were all professional, courteous and efficient. Will definitely return for a longer stay.
Special commendation to hotel concierge professionals
Edgar Rodriguez
Ramon Lorenzo
And to our personal concierge Miguelito Cuevas

reviews.author: Deborah Quillen
reviews.text: Beautiful room with beautiful view! Great amenities! Food at Mina, the steakhouse was superior. Our server, Oivi, was superior and the hostess, Damian’s, was so friendly and pleasant!! A beautiful smile and happy disposition! Great dining experience!

reviews.author: Caroline Gnesda
reviews.text: First time in DR, and booked Paradisus Palma Real very last minute. We booked here because they offered a Reserve experience with walk out pool with a really good rate. The resort is beautiful with lots of dining and pool options. The favorite for me was their beach! The beach offered crystal clear water, dig sand and no seaweed. It’s just absolutely stunning. There a plenty of dining options. The buffet was okay and the two A La Carte restaurants that we have dined at were very good! The service has also been outstanding! From the service by pool/beach, restaurants, bars and butler service, the Paradisus team did not disappoint. Alvaro our concierge was fantastic and I can’t miss mentioning the team at the Ginger Bar. Special shout out to Ismael who makes everyone feel so special, and also Criceido, Soranyy, Antonio and Libeth. They are the best of the best! Catamaran w/yoga was awesome as well! Jorge Rafael and Awilda Amparo were fantastic and amazing! I must do when staying here!

reviews.author: Maria P
reviews.text: Raul helped us at the beach everyday of our stay. His service was always excellent and he was always friendly. He has made our stay absolutely fabulous.

reviews.author: Lenin Gonzalez
reviews.text:
It is simply incredible. As soon as you step out of the car you are WOWED — first by the open architecture/breathtaking views and then by the amazing service/hospitality.
Dinner at Flora was delicious, to say the least. Decor, beautiful. It’s like you’re dining in a forest. Service fantastic. Minerba was attentive as a waitress. Daiana, the hostess, is superb. It’s like being welcomed by a friend. Dionis and Bladimir round out the group with excellent service and culinary skills. Flora is a must.
Dalmis is one of the best concierge at the hotel. If you’re booking a Reserve room and you get him you’ll be in very good hands. Very attentive and makes the entire stay even more wonderful.

Second Stay
This was my second time this year, this time with a group of friends. Originally went in June on a whim after seeing beautiful pictures and the kind of experience I wanted -- Adults Only.

Went to Cana for lunch. Great service, especially by Virginia and Wandel. Amazing food.

I went again this time to celebrate my birthday. I went in with no expectations and I feel like it exceeded even my wildest dreams of how it would've gone. I ended up making friends with people from Scotland, Chile, Argentina, and Canada.

The staff are attentive and friendly. If you stay on The Reserve (Adults Only) side, then you have to go to Wanda at the bar between the pool and the beach. She's always smiling and a good time. She has different servers working there, Yuriel (I called him Barahona) is attentive and funny.

The swim-up bar pool on The Reserve side I was served by Nathanael and Rosanna. I had one of the best times there. They were both great --  drinks flowing, dancing, joking. Just an incredible time, couldn't have asked for better.

In the Plaza you'll find Manuela working either the Tanqueray or Titos bar carts. You can't go wrong with either drink and Manuela is there to take care of you.

Santo killed it at Flora with my surprise bday cake. He went out of his way with making the night spectacular and memorable. Smile on his face and ready to make your night as amazing as it can be. Flora in general is delicious, it's my fave restaurant there. You have to try the octopus! tender on the inside and crispy/crunchy on the outside.

Our concierge was Alvaro. I cannot say enough good things about him. He is top tier. Above and beyond.

Overall, the place is magical. Make friends with people all over the world. Have the friendliest and most helpful staff. Eat delicious food (ceviche is a must). Drinks flowing. Beautifully located in front of a white sand beach.

reviews.author: G5trance
reviews.text: This message is for the resort manager at Paradisus palma real ” JUAN CARLOS LLORET” . Your hotels buffett food was horrible, whether it was breakfast, lunch, or dinner. You had no fresh juices, all were artificial and tasted horrible.  Simple drinks like pina coladas did not taste well at all. I say this to highlight the all inclusive fee for food and drinks of $150 per person per night. I guess this is where you cut costs so you can turn a profit. It’s so sad though because it delivers a horrible experience to the customer. The cheese is always out and sweating, the fish is not stored in ice until ready to be cooked, burnt pancakes, loafs of bread are stale and not changed for days and all this is left out for waves of different weekly customers. Absolutely no quality control at this place. If you read this review, i’m doing you a huge financial and physical health favor, stay away….. you’ll be wishing you were back home immediately if you go to this place.

reviews.author: dave morgan
reviews.text: Blue agave …. Gabriel absolutely best service. I am a tourist. We are here for our anniversary.….. Service was excellent food was outstanding We’ll definitely be back

reviews.author: Sam Guzman
reviews.text:
The aperol & pizza making experience was really good. You are welcome by Brandol who shows you to your station and walks you through the experience. Chef Miguel demonstrates how to make the pizza and helps you out he even saves your dough if necessary as it was for my gf 3 times haha….once done chef take the pizza to the oven and Brandol then brings out the pizza once finished.

Bartender Miguel shows you how to masterfully make your very own aperol spritz and if you’re not an aperol person like me you get some orange juice and make yourself a mimosa.

reviews.author: Robert Bache
reviews.text: Beautiful hotel, great beach! Did the all inclusive experience, had a great time with Wifey. The Mexican restaurant was our favorite. Eddie and Arisleida at the pool bar were super fun! Did a great job and added some great personality to our day at the pool bar.

reviews.author: Haley Casey
reviews.text: The hotel was very nice, and the food and drinks in the room were a nice surprise. The activities were my favorite part. I had most fun doing the Zumba class and swimming at the pool. My friend and I enjoyed the soccer tournament with Jorge Rafael! He’s the best!

reviews.author: Kayla Cain
reviews.text: Jean Micheal with Entertainment and Ariel (Butler) were amazing. Ariel made our reservations and made sure our stay was perfect. Jean checked in with us daily after meeting at the dance party the first night. It was nice to have a familiar face who remembered our names and made sure we were having a good time. The resort was beautiful. We will definitely be back! The beach was gorgeous. Wanda (bartender) was the best drink mixer. She also remembered our drinks of choice. Royal Service is the way to go! You have someone at all times to help with any needs and concerns.

reviews.author: Joe Lammers
reviews.text: We had an amazing time at Paradisus. Our concierge Yaleidi was the best. She booked our dinner reservation every night and even decorated our room for my wife’s birthday, even had a cake and bottle of wine.  We will definitely be back next year and request Yaleidi.

reviews.author: Alyssa
reviews.text:
Misael at Sante,
Thank you for being the best and nicest waiter. You are always so happy and smiling which made our day every day. You made our last dinner so special and we’ll never forget it. We will miss you so much. We can’t wait to see you next time we come back!

Randi at the Sante bar,
Thank you for taking care of us at the bar. You were always so kind and made us laugh. You made us the best drinks and always made sure we were taken care of.

Best,
Ryan & Alyssa

reviews.author: Maria Cocco
reviews.text: The Blue Agave restaurant was awesome, Marbin the manager was very nice, helpful and gave the extra mile to make us feel amazing. By far the best restaurant in Paradisus Palma Real. Also, i woud like to mention Customer Service Manager Stephanie who has been making sure we are satisfied with the services, F&B and hotel facilities. We really appreciate the extra mile given by these two marvelous members of the Meliá Family. Thank you!

reviews.author: Joanne
reviews.text: This is our second year at the Palma Real in Punta Cana. The buffet by the beach, the Lunch Box is amazing. The staff is absolutely incredible and part of the reason why we came back. Edito and Rosanna … come see them, you will leave as family !!! The absolutely most genuine and sweet people I have ever met.

reviews.author: Devon Capichiano
reviews.text: our stay at the Paradisus Palma Real was amazing. The staff was impeccable, the service, the restaurants, room service, cleaning staff was AMAZING. The food is amazing. There is not one complaint, from either of us for our week stay. We absolutely loved Jordania and Jose!! DEFINITELY recommend coming to the Paradisus Palma Real!

reviews.author: Stacy Hartzler
reviews.text:
Flora is incredible - we had a couple dinners here, the food was great but the service is EXCEPTIONAL! Highly recommend! Loved Eduardo and Melina :)

Jhon was incredible as well - the service is outstanding and with a smile!

reviews.author: K. Forrester
reviews.text: Our concierge, Jose, did a wonderful job of taking care of us.  He was in contact with us every day and booked all of our reservations at the restaurants we wanted to try as well as offering suggestions for daily activities.  Great service!!

reviews.author: Adriana Briguglio
reviews.text: Our concierge Yaleidi was absolutely amazing!  My boyfriend and i came to the paradisus palma real for a friends wedding, and throughout the whole experience she checked in with us everyday to make sure we had everything we need. She gave us a tour upon arrival and checked in everyday with us to let us know what what activities were for the day. One night we had an additional guest to our dinner reservation and she even went herself to the restaurant to make sure they knew and could accommodate!!  Exceptional service and i hope the paradisus can be happy knowing they have amazing staff like her. Highly recommend this resort to anyone!!

reviews.author: Natalie
reviews.text:
Our waitress tonight Virtrudes at blue agave was attentive and amazing. The service and food was excellent!

Manuela at the bar with the stellar drinks and consistent everyday.

reviews.author: Mairim Cosme-Velasco
reviews.text: Wow!!!! What a magnificent experience. Unfortunately we were only at Paradisus for 3 days, but in the short stay it was truly spectacular. We opted to stay in the Reserves section which is adults only and had a wonderful concierge named Zenovia who made everything extremely easy for us, from booking our diners, to booking massages and even getting smaller bills for us. She did all the running around so we didn’t have to. Highly recommend and we will be back in the future.

reviews.author: Ben Finch
reviews.text: We had an incredible week at Paradisus Palma Real. The service was incredible, especially Yuderi, who was so attentive each day at the beach. Also, was a huge fan of Irvin, our concierge. So relaxing and my wife said the Spa day was great. We hope to revisit soon!!!

reviews.author: Tom Greer
reviews.text: Raul, Hansel and Yaderi were excellent servers! They were consistent and very hospitable. Dalmis was the best concierge! Very helpful. I recommend Paradisus for your Punta Cana vacation. You won’t be disappointed!

reviews.author: Spencer Tippetts
reviews.text: Fantastic experience. The kids club was awesome. Might’ve been the kids favorite part.

reviews.author: J. Mota
reviews.text:
The property was BEAUTIFUL. The room was a nice size and clean. The food however, was horrible and sometimes unedible. The restaurants served small portions and service was slow. The buffet is all open to the outdoors so flies were in and on most of the food. The alcohol was cheap liquor and drinks were not consistent. My recommendation is to buy the real stuff and make your own drinks. The majority of the staff were friendly and very helpful. The other quality was the entertainment and activities they provide on the property.

Unfortunately, I won't be back anytime soon. I dreaded having to eat and when we ordered bottle service, it took them 45 minutes to bring it to us. It's an all inclusive so I guess that's what you get but I'd gladly pay more for quality food and drinks.

reviews.author: Rosemary Lagasse
reviews.text: Luis Alejandro Desa at Ginger bar is amazing. Very attentive and remembers your drinks. Excellent bar tender.

reviews.author: GEORGE OSZOLI
reviews.text: Our experience so far at Paradisus Playa Real has been elevated to the next level with the incredible efforts of Jose Simeon our concierge for everything from booking each and every restaurant including specific times which I found out a very difficult task. An excursion. taken care of immediately. We would like go shopping is not a problem. A return taxi set up ASAP. More water needed in our room and a case arrives within the hour. Thank you again for making this trip  for my wife and 17 year old daughter and I an  unforgettable experience.

reviews.author: Erik Salguero
reviews.text: Our experience at Paradisus Palma Real was great!! Starlin Tavarez helps us out during our entire stay. He was able to assist in restaurant reservations, luggage pick up,  transportation, and other special events. Our room was clean and comfortable. The service from the employees we interacted with was top notch.   This is my second time here and will return again.

reviews.author: Karina Inga
reviews.text: The sports bar kicks is fun and the finger food is delicious. Jose Rosario and Heridania gave us great service. We’ll be back later!

reviews.author: Haley Ruvalcaba
reviews.text: Anhelo was amazing very attentive always making sure we were well feed and had drinks would definitely recommend and come back, resort was clean, food was amazing!

reviews.author: Michael Nolan
reviews.text: KICKS :Yiri and Leanny, great experience in the restaurant/bar. Food and drinks are great. Service even better. Can’t stay at this resort and not come to Kicks… to end every night.

reviews.author: Ann Klein
reviews.text:
At blue agave restaurant  our hoss Felix and our service Alexander.
Service was amazing , highly recommend
My favorite was Flora!! Food was amazing and Stephania was so personal and went above and beyond. Also, her Mai Tai was best on the island

reviews.author: Cristabel Mascarenhas
reviews.text: Restaurant Tokimeku and their team , Santos made our son's birthday so special . The food was really good and the service was exceptional. We love Dominican Republic and for hibachi this is very nice place.

reviews.author: Frank Prasnal
reviews.text: Had the best service at Malva with excellent food and people , hostess Laura Bautista, supervisor Stormin Feliz, server Maria Santana, server Esther Rosario. Definitely will come back. Had fun at Paradisus Palma Real poolside ‘32  degrees bar’ with Joel Valdez bartender, Milagro Padua waitress, Raul Jimenez waiter , all great servers. Will be back to the Palma Real .Zenovia is our concierge and is doing a fantastic job with making sure we are updated on daily activities as well as getting us the dinner reservations. She is pleasant, attentive, and knowledgeable, as well as professional. We are very happy with our stay and happy with Zenovia. Daysi Gonzalez was very friendly and informative of the resort stopping to talk at the Kanna restaurant on the beach. Alex and Marta, our servers at the Kanna restaurant were excellent, and we were so happy to have such excellent servers. We stayed 1week early June at Paradisus Palma Real, the weather was hot 85/90F, but we blocked well. On night 6 we ate at Dominican restaurant ‘Flora’, servers Franklin Bautista, Alex Marte, Francisco Yani , Glenny Rodriguez, Daiana Rodriguez, Dayhani Batista made the dinner meal so memorable. Food was great as well as great service.

reviews.author: Diana Glubiak
reviews.text: Wonderful 5 days! Edgar, our butler, made our 30th anniversary very special. He was extremely organized and attentive to many details. Pedro and Martine took excellent care of us of at the beach. They were super friendly. Our favorite bartender was Yassuri. She made the best rum punches in all the resort. The rest of the care was five stars. Special shout out to Sally for keeping our room clean and Emmanuel for helping us with our bags.

reviews.author: Todd Ehrlich
reviews.text:
We're having a great trip with our grown kids.  So many highlights, but make sure you join in the pool side activities with Jorge Rafael.  He brings so much energy and a very friendly vibe, even when things were quiet.

The best bar at the resort is the Ginger.  Best mixologists, plus smoothies and coffee drinks all day or night.  All the bar tenders are great, but be sure to ask for Ismael lizardo Griselda.

My only knock on the resort is the lack of beach activities.  I was hoping for kayaks, SUP and sailboats to be included, but not here.

reviews.author: Sarkis Ohanian
reviews.text:
Beautiful hotel. Amazing service. Really enjoyed the coffee in the morning with my friends Ismael, Dominga & Creceida who always had a smiles on there faces day a night and really went out of there way to make us comfortable and happy.

Would highly recommend to anyone wants a nice peaceful week of sun, drinks and relaxation.

reviews.author: Britney Choina Bryson
reviews.text: We are enjoying our stay! Rina at the Celsius bar gave us great service! She was so friendly and attentive! She even remembered our names and drink orders. We love Rina! Great time so far at Paradisus

reviews.author: kelly marcello
reviews.text: Beautiful resort! The rooms are modern and clean, great views from all the rooms. The beach was also beautiful and classy…The food was delicious, especially at Mascalzones restaurant. Fausto, Yenseen, and Milton were great! The coffee lounge/bar was also really nice. Staff was friendly. I will definitely stay here again when I return to Punta Cana!

reviews.author: Meaghan McSorley
reviews.text: Had the best time this week. Shout out to Yiri, Olga, Walquiria!! We had the best time at the Ginger bar!! Would 10/10 recommend to friends and family. Plus ceasar at flora, he’s the best!!

reviews.author: Jain Kuruvilla
reviews.text: Great experience at the resort. Dined at the Mescalzone tonight and our waiter, Brailyn, and supervisor, Milton, were kind and attentive without being overwhelming. Food was delightful and ice cream was awesome. The resort staff were nice and helpful and our stay was enjoyable with good food and entertainment. Would definitely recommend this spot!

reviews.author: Roger Cervo
reviews.text: I had an issue with my lighting and Franklin Yael Santana came to my room to fix it.  Not only did he fix the light he went to my closet and reinstalled the LED lights so that I could see my clothes.   I didn’t even know there were LEDs until he showed me and spent 20 minutes reinstalling and fixing them.  Truly amazing service and such a nice touch of customer service.  Kindness like this make me want to come back to the hotel.

reviews.author: Paola Villegas
reviews.text:
The hotel and the stay in the hotel was amazing as usual.
We participated in the painting ( poñilon and sunset) , mamajuana and larimar   workshops and both were super fun!!
The crew is super friendly and fun ♡
Special mention to Martha, Yeison and Fernando !!!

reviews.author: Carol Gioia
reviews.text:
Had an amazing week celebrating life w/ my BFF. So glad we selected this resort for our biannual getaway.  Huge shout out to Luis Desa at the Ginger Bar for having my Johnie Walker Black ready for me after dinner every night. Primo service with a smile !!!! The crew at the Ginger Bar met expectations hands down.  Shout out to Vanessa at the main pool bar… friendly and kept  the cold cocktails flowing.  One of the hardest workers was Julia at the Nitike  building 40… she was nonstop hustling to please the vacationers.  Gladys at the spa has hands of gold, one of the best massages ever. Last but never least, a huge shout out to Harry our consigiere, he took such great care of us all week.  5 stars to all the crew mentioned at the resort.
Luis Desa, Luis Villasin, walquiria, altagracia, Lenny, Rosa.  Thanks for making our vacation experience exceptional!

reviews.author: Jill Zimm
reviews.text:
I am actually going to give a 'thoughtful' review of this place.  That is of course from my experience but also from the experience of the family.

1.  The property is lovely and well maintained.  Most of the rooms we were in were lovely and well stocked (Swim-ups).  My particular room was lovely - in theory - but did not have all the same amenities as the others and several things were broken and did not work most of the time we were there (Ocean View Suite).  Our concierge did a nice job responding when we said something but it would either happen again or we didn't want to bother with another room issue.

2.  Back to the concierge...MACK was his name and he was able to communicate and support our needs while we were there.  He's a 10/10.  It is such a helpful support especially when the resort is somewhat large and certain things can feel overwhelming...we always knew he would come through for us and we deeply appreciate his kindness and support.  He was honest and open as well.

3.  This is billed as a family resort for all ages.  And to some degree it is because they do have a kids club, teen club and like 2-3 activities in a day for adults - but it does feel a bit light on the activities.   Especially for the adults.  It would be nice to have more games and fun competitions during the day.  Whether it be in the pools or on the beach or inside the bar or courtyard...young adults who like their recreation might find it a bit less inviting.  It is relaxing and chill so if that is what you are looking for then maybe this is a good choice!  The only time this isn't the case is when a BIG conference comes through...you'll understand if this happens...

4.  The weather is absolutely the best.  Bring lots of sunscreen and bug spray to if you get bit easily...also a swim shirt might be your friend.  Never forget the hat and sunglasses either...to buy there - you can, but it is quite pricey.  OH and bring your own inflatables for the pools - lots of fun to relax and play with those...

5.  Bring a travel mug to fill your drinks at the bars - keeps them much longer and cooler.  If you like to tip bring more singles and fives then you think you'll need - lots of opportunity...tipping is always so precarious and individual.  Not sure what to say on this but would love to hear some thoughts on others and all-inclusives...

6.  The Ginger Bar.   Wow.  7/5 stars.   Smoothies and Coffee and Amazing Martinis - their espresso martini is a must.   And they are the most beautiful group of people.

7.  The Kicks Sports bar was fun but it might be nice to have more activities in there...more pool tables and darts and competitions and such...maybe expand it a bit.

8.  Not easy to navigate what area you can be in or not according to your 'status'.  It is embarrassing to be turned away from a bar or similar that you had no idea you could not go to b/c of your color of wristband.  I would expect that if I went to a sister resort but not at my own...and it is a bit odd to be the 'high-end' resort in the chain but not be able to go to activities and such at the other ones nearby...

9.  The food.  This is so subjective - but ultimately it depends on your own preferences.  We had such a nice time at the Mexican restaurant...and they treated us so well at the Italian one too.  But we loved the hibatchi experience too.  They treated us well at the Steak place too but we come from the land of steak - so the food was not always as we would like.  Buffet is, well a buffet.  Be aware there are certain times of day where food is not as readily available...but you will get the gist of it soon enough...

10.  There is tennis and we loved going there at times but we were told there was Pickleball and there was not...just an fyi.

A lovely time...if you go with relaxation in mind and a willingness to explore and ask questions - you will be so pleased...

reviews.author: Liz Rivas
reviews.text:
Amazing service!    Came here on a leisure trip with our company and the resort went above and beyond to keep us all very comfortable. There are many pools available and easily accesible from all over the resort.    We took the wine tasting class and it was wonderful.   Jorge Rafael, Juan and Jonathan directed us pretty well and were very knowledgeable about the subject.   Definitely recommend this place!

RESTAURANTE SANTE
Beautiful restaurant.   It is right next to the pool and can have ocean views if you seat by that area.    Food was delicious!     It has a mix if a la carte and buffet.   Came here for breakfast and I had the eggs Benedict and my husband had the croquette Frances. Great seasoning and the eggs Benedict were spot on! Thank you Jonas, Roberto and Jose (house chefs)     We also ordered  fresh juice and it could have not been fresher!    Sunirda, our hostess was great!   Jose Emilio Batista, Eduardo were great.
Gustavo, Luz Villa, Juan Torres, Kelvin Feliciano and Franklin Acevedo were AMAZING!!!   Over the top costumer service!!!

reviews.author: Damiana Harper
reviews.text: The hotel was beautiful, the beach was great ! Jholfry , Danyelo and robinson were so nice and very attentive with my group ! The bartenders at Ginger were so nice and sweet !! The only problem at this resort is you have to rsvp for dinner in the morning .

reviews.author: dapo ajisafe
reviews.text: Paradisus is an excellent place for fun and relaxation with wonderful good and service. Miguel at Kivks bar is absolutely  exceptional with a friendly attitude and an inviting aura. Makes awesome drinks and truly makes your night enjoyable. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Kyle Andreoni
reviews.text: I had an amazing time with my wife at this resort. The food was by far our favorite part of the trip. Huge shout out to Felix, Franklin and Eduardo for their amazing service. They treated us like family the entire time, which is why we kept going back to Sante for dinner and lunch during our stay.

reviews.author: Sharon Alegado
reviews.text: Ramon by the pool was great.  He was very attentive.  He even tracked us down in the pool to give us refreshed drinks.  He also saved our same seats from the day and had towels ready for us.

reviews.author: JC & ML Crowder
reviews.text: Miguel is the best bartender. He works evening at Kicks, sports bar. Ask for the Miguel Special drink. Jose the waiter is great too.

reviews.author: Sergio
reviews.text:
We are at the beginning of our vacation and this amazing hotel has already overcome our expectations. The front desk majestic majestic tram treated us like kings. What a super team led by their amazing leaders.

Now we are having dinner at the Italian Restaurant ( Mascalzone). Not a surprise, the capitain Milton bring his team together to deliver an excellent experience to the gest. Raider and Yenssen (I guess it’s written like this), helped us with great suggestions from the Menu. simpathy, kindnesses and great customer service. Thank you guys a lot.

reviews.author: Tyler Villa
reviews.text: Rafael and Harry were amazing, awesome service and hospitality.

reviews.author: julie zinke
reviews.text:
The hotel is beautiful with nice renovations, a great beach and incredible pools. We had great service from Luis at the swim up bar, Victor at Kicks kept us entertained and Fausto and Yeesan at the Italian restaurant were great! I had one of the best massages ever by Eva. She was wonderful!

We had a lot of trouble getting water and drinks restocked in our room. We requested drinks from our concierge 4 times and never got them. Finally another guest, Stephan, helped connect us to a manager and we had drinks by the time we got back to our room. It shouldn’t take 3 days for that to happen.   Our concierge Deysi Rodriguez was helpful getting reservations for the first 2 days until we went to listen to the Meliá sales meeting. After that she helped us with one more reservation and then “was off” with no  guidance as to who else to contact. After that I texted again and go no response. I guess we were ghosted.   We were supposed to get a certificate to come back to the resort and we have yet to receive that.  She told us that was her boss's responsibility. When I text a second time I got no response or clarification.

Aside from the concierge’s lack of service I would say we had a great visit.

reviews.author: Jennifer Butts
reviews.text:
What an amazing vacation in Punta Cana! This was my first time in the Dominican Republic and the experience from start to finish has been incredible. Our concierge, Fernando was absolutely wonderful!  I was celebrating my birthday and he made me feel like an absolute queen!  The entire day was full of special birthday surprises. From decorating my beach chair, to champagne, chocolate strawberries beachside, decorating my room and a special cake at dinner, my day was absolutely magical!
Also I must mention Olga, from the Ginger bar, Wanda and Jose’ from the adult side bars, Gladys from the Spa with her Magic hands, and Martin and Rafeal from the beachside lounge and bar. Everyone has been absolutely amazing and I would highly recommend staying at Paradise Palma Real.

reviews.author: Feli Lgn
reviews.text: Incredible experience, the service was one of the best I've ever had, specially at the Brisas restaurant. The cuisine was great and the menu was amazing. To highlight the workers, Jose Ramos and Rossana Paniagua did everything perfectly and with a lot of professionalism. Our conceirge Alejandro Gomez helped us with everything we needed and more, and he made our stay even better at this amazing hotel.

reviews.author: lewis de la cruz
reviews.text:
No words can describe all the sensations I have right now with the improvements that this hotel has done in the last few months. I will definitely come back again with more people. I have niticed that this incredible team have been working so hard to keep this property on top of the list of the hotels, all inclusive. Franklin, Héctor, dionis, Alex de Mina, Crismailyn y Melina  de flora, Joel, Los 2 Jonathan Maximo España y Juandy de winery and there’s A lot more people that I can keep talking about because of their incredible service for sure they will bring more people to repeat the experience in this property. Congratulations to you all and I hope to come back again. 🥂🥂🥂🎊🎊

Special Mention to Katherin her now from the CIRCLE experiences and Daniel, Gerent of the circle experiences José Jordania  and frank from guest service team And a lot of people that I can’t remember so much right now that day by day, make a lot of effort to give the best of the experiences to the guests.

I highly recommend this property and if they keep doing this hard job, this property will be back today, leading hotels of the world soon

reviews.author: Bridget Kardasz
reviews.text:
Great vacation had by our party of 12. Big plus, there were always chairs available at the pools and beach for our big group.
Eddy, Rosanna, and Mario gave us such great service at the 90 Degrees pool bar. Georgie and Marta always took care of us at the breakfast buffet.
Only downside was the dinner reservation process. It was next to impossible to get reservations. We were told reservations were not needed before we arrived. That is not accurate.

reviews.author: rich molinari
reviews.text:
Restaurant Flora has terrific authentic Dominican food.
The service by Francesca was excellent and Eduardo was exceptional in checking in with everyone eating in the restaurant.
This was the best restaurant in the resort.

reviews.author: Vivian Cornejo
reviews.text:
Flora restaurant was very nice, service was excellent and the food was delicious. Recommend the spicy short ribs.
Mina restaurant was delicious, JeanCarlo Sandoval was my server and he was excellent.

reviews.author: Wynika Williams
reviews.text: Fernando, Lenninsa, Miguel, Daisy and Olvi gave my family and I exceptional service. They went above and beyond to ensure we had everything that we needed and made our stay very comfortable & welcoming. Olvi made last minute arrangements for a dinner party of 12 people, so that was amazing. The food could be better, for a 5 star resort the food was average. The only restaurant we enjoyed was the Japanese restaurant. Overall everything else was nice…

reviews.author: Joyce Eng
reviews.text:
Overall, our stay was very good. The resort is beautiful and elegant - loved the open main plaza where are the restaurants were located.  The beach was very nice - white sand & plenty of beds due to low season.  There are constant vendors though, but that seems to be the norm in the Dominican Republic.  There was seaweed - some days were better than others.

The Nikte 2 bedroom swim up was gorgeous - more than spacious for family of 4.  Plenty of amenities in the room - 2 bars, alcohol, slippers, sandals was a nice touch.

Our concierge Wily was fantastic, super helpful and super nice - organized our dinners at different restaurants for family of 13, was responsive to all our inquiries, organized bali beds, and made sure we were taken care of.   He truly knows how to provide amazing customer service.

The one area needing most improvement is the food - the buffet at breakfast and lunch got tiresome with the same items daily.  There was no other lunch choice except the buffet, which was disappointing. Also, there was no snack bar - we had to make sure to eat something within the buffet opening times or wait till dinner. Other resorts have a snack bar that you can grab a snack in between buffet/resto hours.  The best dinners was Sante, Flora, and the Winery (which was a special arranged by Wily). Unfortunately, half our group got sick with stomach issues during the stay and also some got sick upon the return home.   Please make improvements in this area!

Ginger bar/lounge has great drinks and capuccino and mixology class was fun. Tito's outdoor mini bar was great too.

Overall, we had a good time but would likely not return due to the food.

reviews.author: jose antonio miranda valdez
reviews.text: We loved our stay at the Paradisus Palma Real. The service was excellent and the food really good. The Lunch Box was great and in particular the service provided by Maria Santos. I would definitely go back.

reviews.author: Arti Jurakhan
reviews.text: The pizza workshop and aperol tasting were great activities at Palma real. So entertaining to do it with the extended family! Pizza was delicious and the setting so lovely. Special shout-out to chef Wilson, Jorge Rafael , and Juan were amazing instructors and hosts!

reviews.author: Winston Hewes
reviews.text: The Paradisus Palma Real was amazing! The views and hotel grounds were stunning. The service was fantastic on every aspect. Hector, our concierge was extremely helpful and was willing to make our vacation as hassle free as possible. Overall, I would highly recommend this property to other families!

reviews.author: John Wood
reviews.text: My wife and I enjoyed our wedding here in June 2019. Our experience with Mariangel and the romance team was exceptional! Food was high quality, beach was clean and the service from the staff was on point. We were fortunate enough the have Wilfredo as our bartender on the royal service side. He made sure everyday was something special. The tasting menu at Passion is totally worth the price! I would highly recommend this resort to anyone looking for a fantastic way to get away and relax.

reviews.author: Sharon Fletcher
reviews.text: I had an amazing time as this was my first time in the Dominican Republic. The resort was amazing and beautiful. The staff were awesome and accommodating. I especially loved the activities group in particular Hairon Luis, Jairo , Brandelo and Danyelo, I had a great time learning dances and attending the different events. There’s so much I want to say - Thank you to the front desk staff - Ervia, Christopher and Wilmer. The final and last comment is that I wish that more of your staff knew basic English or at least conversational. It’s hard to communicate when they don’t understand you and you don’t understand them. You’re dealing with people from all over the world and not all of us speak fluent Spanish. Will return in the future.

reviews.author: sheena hall
reviews.text: Francisco Vilorio concierge was the guy who helped us to our room. He was so amazing and super friendly! Every time we saw him he said hello and showed us parts of the resort we hasent seen. Truly an extraordinary experience with Francisco. Absolutely love this resort we will be back!

reviews.author: Elizabeth Suero
reviews.text: Best food at Brisas. Loved the food and service. Staff went above and beyond to make us feel welcome and satisfied. We also thoroughly enjoyed Tokimechu restaurant and Kicks sports bar. Can't wait to come back next year.

reviews.author: Aaditi Joshi
reviews.text:
Hi, Starlin was our conceirge and from day 1 we had wonderful service.
We do come here to celebraete our birthdays almost each year. We really loved the service, views, beaches and food here.
We ll be happier next time if we get Indian vegetarian food options at restaurant.
But Starlin was amazing. He is very welcoming.

reviews.author: Chris Olivares
reviews.text: The resort has everything you could possibly ask for. From multiple restaurants to a ton of excursions. They do an amazing job and delivering hospitality. At the Sonte restaurant the manager Jose came by to check up on us as well as many of the waitresses. Franklin in specific did an outstanding job and making sure we had everything we needed before we left. Including mentioning a few places to go and explore. The hostess Sunirda was also extremely pleasant by the second day she knew us by name. I would recommend this place to anybody looking to vacation on the island.

reviews.author: Fanny Rizman
reviews.text: Excellent resort with great workers especially Lennison, Fernando, and Hector Rodriguez. Hector assisted us with all our dinner reservations and was extraordinary. Lennison was always there to assist us with our luggage arriving and departing. Great and hard workers. Will definitely return.

reviews.author: A. Mirkovic
reviews.text:
Pros
- had a beachfront suite, views are amazing
- so close to the beach and the main pool, location was great
- hotel had some modern features, when it was newer it must have looked beautiful
- main pool was great
- kidsdom - kids club on site was grear for kids with many fun activities planned
- most of the staff works very hard at keeping the hotel clean and presentable
- there was a lot of seaweed at the beach when we were there, staff was cleaning it up every morning, which was quite the task
- buffet place (lunch box) has some pretty good choices, but the staff there was inattentive and looked like they couldn't he bothered to help

Cons
- so disappointed with the room - it was very dated, pieces of the bathroom enclosure - wood framing is falling apart; the balcony door was almost impossible to slide to open; it couldn't close all the way there was a gap on top so we would hear wind howling most of the nights; we had sooo many ants in our room; we even had a gekko in our room, it was chirping at night; taps in the bathroom didn't work - one tap was almost falling out, the other sink wouldn't drain;  there was no hot water multiple times; hotel lost power a few times
- as other reviews noted, when we went to the front desk, they said they will look into this, of course no one ever did
- phone in our room didn't work - what if we had an emergency?
- they offer room service, but phone doesn't work so you can't order
- Melia app is a joke and does nothing
- apparently we had a concierge, who didn't do anything for us...kept booking random reservations at times and restaurants that didn't work for us

Overall...location is great but this is not a luxury hotel...maybe it was at some point. Overall resort is very dated but very clean an it's a huge complex to upkeep.
Waterpark for kids that was at another hotel at the complex about 15min walk away was amazing - they should offer shuttles to there people with kids would love it.

In summary, wouldn't return here, overpriced for the oferring. Other reviews really don't seem realistic to me.

reviews.author: Jenny Fuertes
reviews.text: Excellent service all around. Every single employee was great, and always happy. Food and entertainment were great, specially Daniel Rivera , Jose Ramirez  end Emmanuel Batista the bell boys, if you come, ask for them. In general amazing vacation, loved it.

reviews.author: Judith Hecht
reviews.text: We had an amazing week!!!  And the we had the very best Concierge ever!  Starlin Tavares treated us like royalty.  The resort is absolutely beautiful and the food was great. We loved the Gin ger coffee bar too!   We’ll be back again next year 🥰

reviews.author: Frank Robinson
reviews.text:
The service from Kelvin and Ebony at Asian Restaurant and support staff was excellent.

Emmanuel our Personal Concierge was outstanding.  He booked all of our reservations and cared for our every request!

reviews.author: Craig Grayson
reviews.text: Great hotel, super clean and amazing service. My favorite spot was Ginger coffee bar. The baristas and waitresses were amazing. Thank you Nataniel, Antonio, Clari, Olga, and Magda for great service with a smile and delicious lattes!

reviews.author: Noel Bonet
reviews.text: Stayed at the Paradisus Palma Real for our annual golf trip in April. Of all the resorts in the Punta Cana which we have stayed during our 15 + years of making the trip we enjoy this resort the best. The resort is just the right size and has a great swim up bar with Luis always taking care of us. The Breakfast buffet has many choices including a great omelette station. The staff is excellent with a special shout out to Yuderqui Javier and Rossana Hernandez that always greeted us with big smiles and made sure we had everything we needed. They were awesome and made our experience at the resort that much better. We will be back.

reviews.author: Erica Marchetti
reviews.text: Really pretty hotel and friendly people. Good vibes and atmosphere right on the beach. Concierge service was top notch! We had a gentleman by the name of Yoiner Josè and he was great! So attentive, helped with everything we needed. He was always there for any questions we had, very responsive to our messages. We had a late dinner reservation one night and he came up to our room and brought us up a big plate of fruit. We didn’t ask he just took the extra step! Ask for him when you go!!

reviews.author: ricardo hernandez
reviews.text: We just had dinner at tokimeko and the food and service was awesome we had Felix Mejia as our chef and we have Jose del Rosario as our waiter. And have to say that they took very good care of us and the food was awesome we definitely recommend this restaurant if you come to this resort you won’t be disappointed.

reviews.author: Kara Stevenson
reviews.text: We came with a group of 12 people and we stayed at the Reserve. Due to our large group, we had 3 concierge (Ralphy, Christian and Juan). We were celebrating an anniversary and a birthday and we couldn’t have asked for a better group of concierges. From decorating our rooms, singing happy birthday at the pool and providing fruit trays daily at the pool they were top notch!

reviews.author: Antonietta Aprile
reviews.text: The hotel is beautiful, the activities are super fun, the food is good. Our favorite place was Mascalzone where the staff was super friendly and really spoiled us with a yummy cake for my son’s birthday. About the activities, Brandol helped us during the workshop and he was very kind. Thank you to all the people of Paradisus Hotel for making our week a real dream!

reviews.author: Bruce Thorne
reviews.text: Restaurant Flora was outstanding. Good food and great service. Vladimir & Anna were very attentive and accommodating. They even served a chocolate dessert that wasn’t on the menu. Thoroughly enjoyed our experience.

reviews.author: Rick Ryall
reviews.text: We just had the most relaxing and amazing vacation imaginable! The property is absolutely beautiful, the amenities impeccable and the staff beyond wonderful! Our personal concierge Jose Simeon ensured every aspect of our week long stay was perfect. Simeon checked in with us each morning providing us with our daily itinerary, list of on property events, dinner reservations and personal advice on what dishes to try. Our favorite restaurant was definitely Flora, the loacal ingredients truly shined through in every dish we tried and i recommend yiu try them all! As our days unfolded, he would check in on us to make sure we were being taken care of and let us know we could count on him at any moment. This level of service is unheard of, Simeon went above and beyond in every way expected and unexpected. I personally could not have enjoyed our stay to the extent I did without his personal touch. Please, do yourself a favor, request Simeon when you visit the Paradisius Palma Real Resort, you will be truly impressed!

reviews.author: Anthony Malfitano
reviews.text:
I am here right now and I am so disappointed of the quality . I was here 2 years ago and it has totally went down hill.
Getting a reservation for dinner is impossible. Restaurant have changed  and they will not accommodate you no matter what. All the restaurants are catered to members and there is only a select few that a paying regular customer is allowed to go to. They have segregated sections for pool , beach and restaurants and if you’re not a member good luck using any of those  areas. Yesterday when we arrived we had lunch outside at a place called “the lunch box” . We were starving from a long day of traveling. A few items from the menu that we ordered were not available and the items that we did get were absolutely DISGUSTING . When I tell you the food looks like it was sitting out for hours and it was served cold . Hamburger , chicken and ribs were cold . They threw some sauce on them and served it to us . I would not recommend booking here. price is HIGH and service is very LOW.

reviews.author: Tiffany Farmer
reviews.text: I am low balling this review because of our overall experience but go find Jose at Between. (In between Blue Agave and Mascalzone). You will want to take him home with you- I promise!

reviews.author: Shahin Pirooz
reviews.text: I had dinner at Mascalzone tonight, everything was great. The food was amazing and the staff was outstanding. Daniela took great care of me from the moment I walked to the front desk. Maximo Helped me pick my wine before I sat down. Wilmina was by my side and tended to every need throughout the dinner. Yeensen served my food with impeccable timing, and Milton checked in with me to make sure everything was ok.

reviews.author: Kristina Martinez
reviews.text: This was our first trip to Punta Cana and it definitely won't be the last. We were celebrating our 6 year wedding anniversary, so we stayed in Royal Service. What a great choice! Our butler, Nicolas, went above and beyond to make this the best trip ever. Every day there was a great surprise in our room waiting for us. He took care of all our reservations and made sure we never had to ask for anything. His personality is very entertaining and it was GREAT having him as our butler. The beaches here are awesome and the staff at Paradisus are all so helpful and friendly. Thank you to all who made our trip unforgettable.  We cant wait to go back next year!

reviews.author: Ana
reviews.text: The chef Julian from the Tokimeku restaurant in Paradisus Palma Real was superb. The food was excellent. His personality was very charming and amusing. The waiter, Frank was very amigable and sweet. Loved the experience.

reviews.author: Nancy Dardenne
reviews.text:
We are spending our 30th anniversary at this beautiful place. My husband says he feels like a king and this is his castle 😂
The thing that really stands out to me is the staff. First of all our concierge Basilio.
Paradisus is very lucky to have employed such a capable person. He is a delight to spend time with as well.
Wanda and Yuderi took such very good care of us.They made our time at the pool and the beach even better!
We spent a lot of time in the Reserve’s restaurant Sante. We love the entire staff.
Gustavo and Juan… Thank you!

reviews.author: jason colon
reviews.text: Paradisus has been nothing but open arms and amazing workers. They are extremely friendly and can absolutely come to your aid when you need help. The room was beautiful and there are numerous activities and excursions here to enjoy. Jordania is at the front desk and she is amazing to speak to and can help you with anything. Also, as you check in stop by the ginger bar and meet Ismael Antonio. Very nice people and will serve you right.

reviews.author: Stacey Lonneman
