reviews.text: Mascalzone it was so great!! Food was so good from pizza to pasta . What I like best they are so friendly . We had  Celia, yessica,Milton, and Daniela. They are So welcoming!! Made us feel at home!! recommend this restaurant ❤️kicks is amazing great staff !! Fun drinks good music and wings .  We love their  great service ..  yiri and fiol ,Miguel and Nathanael . Happy and welcome us every night.

reviews.author: vita lala
reviews.text: This hotel was spectacular! The cleanliness, staff, beach, rooms, and food were all amazing. Jordania at Guest Services was extremely helpful in organizing activities on the resort for our group. Vikmar was a joy to work with at the Front Desk. All staff were incredibly helpful and pleasant to work with.

reviews.author: Aida Haile
reviews.text: Great resort! Service was outstanding. Everyone was very friendly and went out of their way to serve you. Make sure to visit Antonio,Ismael ,olga,Nereida and criseida the coffee bar! They gave us excellent service every morning.

reviews.author: Margaret-Anne MacLeod
reviews.text: Luciana is lovely! Friendly and provided excellent service!

reviews.author: Carlos Castillo
reviews.text: The pool and beach attendants, Rafael and Yuderi were very helpful and went above and beyond with their customer service.  Also restaurant staff, Jose and Kelvin also were very helpful.  We have no complaints.  The only problem that is with room cleaning service.  They took too long to clean the room and the pool porch area was vey wet and my wife almost felt due to the standing water.

reviews.author: Sarah Haidar
reviews.text:
Good is authentic. The service is amazing. Came here with my 1 year old daughter and the whole staff was friendly to her.
The supervisor Milton and waiter, jensen were excellent.

reviews.author: Anne Tobin
reviews.text: We had a fantastic time in our spectacular vacation and Ariel was a fantastic concierge!  He responded immediately to every question or need we had and was so friendly to deal with. Anyone who has the good fortune to have Ariel help them is very lucky!!

reviews.author: Ali Messick
reviews.text: The resort has been amazing for our honeymoon. There’s a lot of food options, things to do and activities at night. The pool bar staff has been amazing everyday! The resort is very clean and staff are friendly.  We’ll be back in the future. I’ll be  recommending this resort to friends and family!

reviews.author: Anuj Sharma
reviews.text: Loved the resort, food and beach. Pedro guy at the beach bar was very kind and helpful , he got us fresh Pina colada everyday at beach.  Would also mention Willey who was our concierge, he is a nice guy, very helpful. Will return with my kids next time

reviews.author: Peter tripp
reviews.text:
Upon arrival to this incredible vacation getaway, we were met by friendly staff. That set the tone.  We were then taken to our private reserve check-in air conditioned area, that process was seamless.
What came next was the most important part of our stay. Our concierge Zenovia, greeted us with a huge smile and hugs. From that point on, she was the backbone of our vacation, from booking all of our A- la-carte reservations. Zenovia responded to every one of my texts and calls without hesitation. It was definitely a pleasure working with her.
It's professional women like Zenovia that will keep us coming back to this hotel next year and every year after that.
We now think of Zenovia like part of our family. ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Sante , the private reserve restaurant was freaking fabulous as well. All staff were friendly and accommodating . Gustavo kept us happy at every service we attended.
Our beach guru was Pedro. This gentle teddy bear had our day beds on the beach set up for the four of us every single day. From fresh towels to drinks . He ROCKED !!!! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

Msscalzone,
The hostess Daniela greeted us with a huge smile, and was awesomly inviting.
We absolutely loved Milton and his staff at mascalzone. The service and food was AMAZING!!!! The teamwork that Milton and his team showed was exemplary.  It's no surprise that he is great at what he does and his team looks happy to work with him. ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️5 stars for gold service.

When you are looking for a vacation spot worth the $$$ YOU better consider this place. Upgrade to the reserve, or book reserve from the get go, and YOU will not be disappointed.  I GUARANTEE it !!!!! That's right, I GUARANTEE IT !!!
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

Peter Tripp ACP-Flight
CPT , Strength & Conditioning Specialist

reviews.author: Natalia Orrego
reviews.text: The service was amazing. Franklin Acevedo was exceptionally sweet and attentive to serve us throughout our stay.  He went above and beyond to accommodate my mothers dietary needs. Highly recommend him at Sante Restaurant here!

reviews.author: Petro Gushpit
reviews.text: What a great experience and friendly staff! The entire team at Ginger went above and beyond! Special thank you to Antonio, Dominga, Yenni, Nereida and Grey for making our stay so special and helping me to plan a surprise for my wife's birthday. Unforgettable memories!

reviews.author: Maya Williams
reviews.text:
The resort is nice and the food is very well done at the restaurants. The entertainment is nice and the service is amazing. The pool is nice and the swim up bar is very nice.
In entertainment Anderson Rodriguez was very good in entertainment and he taught the class very well. He was very nice and made the class easy for my Russian speaking aunt. Thank you to him.

reviews.author: Alysha Kubsh
reviews.text:
The positives:
-Kids Club is a great service and the staff in there have been wonderful with our kids. This has been the highlight of our trip.
-Rooms are nicely appointed and grounds are well maintained
-The aesthetics and intimate lounge spaces are visually beautiful
-The Gin-Ger coffee bar near the lobby is a great spot for smoothies and coffee service.

The Negatives:
-the *only* option for food before 6pm (when dinner restaurants open) is the buffet, which has very little variety from day to day and is 2/5 stars. At $800 USD per night for the “premium” Nikte experience, this is disappointing.
-We’ve tried ordering room service 3 times (since the only restaurant is often closed when our kids are hungry) and it takes 45+ minutes and always comes cold.
-The booking process for the evening restaurants is a nightmare. We are on our 4th night (with the “VIP” Nikte service) and still can’t get a reservation in the Mina steak house for our family of 4. It feels like you are entering a lottery to get a dinner reservation to avoid having to eat a third meal in a row at the same buffet.

We have 3 days left in our 7 day trip here at Paradisus and the family agrees that we wish we had spent our money elsewhere.

reviews.author: Steve Owens
reviews.text: We had the best time at Paradisus Real Spa and Golf Resort! The hotel is beautiful and wonderfully layed out. The beach, pools, drinks and food are all top notch and we can't wait to return. Our new friend Fernando did an amazing job making sure we felt at home in paradise. 5 stars and recommend if you are traveling to Punta Cana.

reviews.author: CAROLINE HANNA
reviews.text:
Ginger Bar is excellent way to start your day, best coffee and always greeted with a radiant smile by Ismael and Olga and Clary and beautiful Dominga .

Mascalzone restaurant is the best way to end your evening, Italian experience thanks to an amazing team Franklin, Daniela and awesome Yensen.

reviews.author: Summer Elam
reviews.text: Absolutely beautiful. Gorgeous resort. Huge. And activities for kids. Only issue is if you have picky kids with food it’s hard. Same buffet every day. My youngest lived on butter toast and apples. But…. She survived. Worth the trip.

reviews.author: Abhinav Mukherjee
reviews.text:
You walk into the resort and it takes your breath away. The way the resort is constructed is beautiful.

But that is not the best part.

We booked the Reserve Suite so we were greeted and taken to the Reserve check in area.

We were served a welcome drink which was amazing!!

Then we were introduced to Dalmis our private concierge.

He was there for us every step of the way. He even made our first nights restaurant reservation before we arrived! Knowing how much of a pain reservations are we were very grateful for that!!

Then we entered our room, the Reserve oceanfront suite.

It was like we stepped into a movie! Our room opened up to the beach and we were just awestruck

Food is amazing!

The bartenders here know what they are doing. The cocktails they served us were very delicious. I dont know their names but it was the best Espresso Martini and Negroni we have ever had! Shout out to the bartender at the Ginger and Flora and the bartender at the sports bar. You guys are amazing!!

The service was excellent!!

Dalmis and Angel made our trip the best trip in our lives till today!

Great job!!

Now for AMEX and Melia to figure out if this
resort is part of the hotel collection or not. Please clear this out.its not fun to find out after you are already in the resort..

But it doesn't take away from the staff here... They were excellent!!

reviews.author: Sandra McQuilkin
reviews.text: The Paradisus Palma Resort was fantastic, Beautiful resort. Our personal concierge,  Senrowny Sosa, was absolutely fantastic, fabulous, the absolute best!! Service above and beyond!!! He was a complete joy to be around!! The service provided to us by Senrowny was 5 ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ plus!!

reviews.author: Dan Cohen
reviews.text: We had dinner at the Italian restaurant tonight. Everything was just wonderful from our waitress Yessica to the manager Milton. They made our experience fantastic and cannot wait to return! Thank you again

reviews.author: Pasha Myrick
reviews.text:
Andriena was absolutely fabulous!! The best there is… she took care of us all vaca. Victor and Luis was also so so great!! Made our time great!

Also while at the beach the great staff Rafael, Isaias, Yuderi and Francis were so amazing!! Everyone took care of us, very friendly and made our vacation so much more special!! Love this hotel!!

Irvin & Juanlly were exceptional. Irvin was our concierge- he made sure all of our requests were met and extremely friendly. Loved this hotel and the employees.

reviews.author: Alexa Russell
reviews.text:
Tokimeko, Fanni and migel were fantastic. Santo was great. The food was fresh and fast. Happy to come back again!

Rafael at the pool has been great! We love coming here knowing he is going to be here. Pedro is also amazing and they both have been making our stay that much better!

Mascalzone the staff and food was great. Milton (the supervisor), Anna & Yeensen were all great. The food was fresh and very delicious!

reviews.author: Marina Polskaya
reviews.text: We enjoyed our stay in the resort. Its quite a spacious place with opportunities for privacy or participation in different activities. Staff is very nice, we had a great celebration of our daughter's birthday.   i would like to  specifically mention  our concierge Violeta, she was amazing and  helped us a lot with  accomodations and all requests.  The waitress Andrew provide us the best service for the dinners.  Pools beaches rooms everything is very clean. Jordania guest service  is great.

reviews.author: John Tasolides
reviews.text:
My wife and I just returned from a 6 night stay in the Reserve section of the Paradisus Palma Real Golf & Spa Resort by Melia and wanted to share our experience. The property was beautiful, steps from the beach with multiple pools, lounge chairs and day beds.  Housekeeping and grounds keeping staff kept everything clean and tidy.

Our room was large and well appointed,however it was not the room that we had reserved.  We reserved and paid for a premium ocean view suite with a king size bed.  Unfortunately the resort failed to honor our reservation and our room had two double beds.  We were told that a ground floor room without an ocean view with a king bed might become available the next day or two.   We were not willing to move and accept this downgrade.

We were not the only ones who experienced this problem as several guests were complaining of this same issue when we were checking in at the private “Reserve” check in lounge.

As the “Reserve” is an adults only section of the resort that presumably caters to couples it makes little sense why they would have double beds at all.

Our Concierge, Zernovia, was a delight and worked day and night to make our stay easy and enjoyable. She provided us with exceptional care and service during our stay.  This was our first visit to this resort and she took care of our reservations, transfers to the airport and luggage.  She is kind, knowledgeable and was one of the best part of our visit

The major weakness of this resort is the food and food service.  The food was plentiful and fresh however as a general matter it was poorly prepared, poorly presented and flavorless.  While there is a language barrier for many of the hardworking staff there is a level of disorganization, lack of supervision, and division of roles that resulted in unreliable service at almost every restaurant at the resort.  We had many instances of not receiving the correct food that we ordered, our ordered food not being delivered to the table as well as receiving food and drinks that we never ordered, which seemed so wasteful!  Most days whatever we ordered was not delivered, served cold, without a vegetable, and often over cooked and flavorless.

The buffet served the same food daily, and despite the variety it was extremely difficult to find anything palatable.  There is no place to get a snack at night or an ice cream if the buffet is closed.

When we went to daily activities the constant topic of conversation among the guests was the beauty of the facility and awful food being served.  The activities (candle making, soap making) were fun but class always started minutes to a half a half an hour late, and in locations that were difficult to find..

Other than the pastries which were tasty, reflecting a qualified pastry chef, the food reflected a lack of competence.  Two exceptions were the Hibachi restaurant which was a fun experience, and tasty, the wine cellar (a speciality upcharge restaurant) where the staff was professional and the limited menu of meats served family style was properly prepared.

When making your reservation you should inquire if there are any meetings or large groups scheduled to be at the resort.  There was a large business group there during the first half of our stay.  The sports bar was closed for this group’s private events for two nights leaving resort guests crowding the hallway peering through the windows outside the bar trying to watch the NFL playoff games.   On Saturday night the entire central plaza of the resort was closed to guests for a private concert, cocktail party and dinner for this group.

reviews.author: Stephanie Lozano
reviews.text: Excellent service. Always kind even when overwhelmed with people. So many food options to choose from in restaurants style and buffet style all with delicious food options. I personally loved their international buffet style The LunchBox for having a variety of food everyday and changing while you eat as it goes. Multiple bars everywhere including in the main pool, and each building had their own pool. Our room had a section where you can lay by the pool under the covered bed. And after all the drinking, you can go to Sante and have some delicious fresh juices brought to you with kindness by Gustavo and excellent service from Kelvin when it’s time to eat. We loved the PLS to cleanse the stomach. And Eduardo being on it to take the dishes you’re done with so you have more space on the table for you. Gorgeous and stunning time spent here! Highly recommend to come. I didn’t take many photos but here are the few.

reviews.author: Marion Olive
reviews.text: We had a wonderful vacation at the Palma Real. Impeccable service during the entire duration we received. Wily handled everything making such a plush worry free vacation. He went the extra mile and exceed our expectations. Also Jose Ramirez handled our bags attentively. We highly recommend this resort and service.

reviews.author: Wilfredo
reviews.text:
I have stayed with my family numerous occasions at Paradoisus Palma Real, each time gets better. Facilities are amazing and the staff is extremely friendly and professional.
Our concierge Alejandro Gomez has been amazing, very detailed oriented, he has provided an exceptional service.
Our family will continue to vacation in this beautiful facility.

At the beach Pedro and Rafael were also amazing. Beach was beautiful.

reviews.author: Adam Michel
reviews.text: Rafael! If you're in Reserve he is your guy! Whatever you want he will get it!

reviews.author: Kristina Fontanez
reviews.text: This is our idyllic slice of life. The Bali beds are worth the splurge to enjoy the beautiful blue ocean from comfort. The Flora restaurant is the best!

reviews.author: Jeni Asaba
reviews.text: We’ve had a wonderful time at the resort! Everyone was incredibly welcoming! We ate almost all of our meals at Sante Restaurant. If you appreciate great food, excellent service and a carefree atmosphere, come here! Many thanks to the staff: Milton, Sunirda, Gustavo, Luz, Wander, Felix and Zuleica for having us as your guests! We loved every meal and interaction! ❤️

reviews.author: Gabby Martinez
reviews.text:
My family and I spent the week here and it was absolutely lovely. Wonderful time and the workers were fantastic.

Rafael from the adult beach was incredibly helpful, funny and overall provided excellent service

The activities were also so much fun! We did a pizza making class and Soledad and Yisleni were hreat

reviews.author: Joe Scherder
reviews.text: Beautiful hotel- excellent food & service. Highly recommend. Shout out to Jose Reinoso- bar & pool server. Made it special with his excellent service. All the servers went above and beyond: Luis, Victor, and many more I wish I kept track of all their names.

reviews.author: Wes Gaither
reviews.text: Héctor, our concierge, was absolutely amazing! He made all of our dinner reservations, made sure we were taken care of to the highest standard! When we go back we will request Héctor! The food is amazing, multiple choices of restaurants, the beach was quiet and clean. We stayed on the Reserve portion of the resort and it was wonderful to not hear a bunch of kids running around. Paradisus Palma Real is unbelievable!

reviews.author: allen greenbaum
reviews.text:
Dining tonight at Sante restaurant. Lidiathe hostess welcomed us. So pleasant.
Edwin our waiter was fantastic. Funny and so pleasant. Made the dining experience fantastic. Food was the best at the resort. Can’t wait to return

reviews.author: Johan Liriano
reviews.text: Beautiful place with an excellent location, you can wake up and jump into the pool or the beach you don't have to take a long walk or wait for a golf cart. The people were very nice beginning with Katherine Mota which helps us with the restaurant reservations and some information about the resort, the bartender Victor in the poolbar, the server Luis in the snack bar next to the beach and plenty more who I can't recall. One hundred percent recommended.

reviews.author: Teresa Ragno
reviews.text:
We stayed at the Paradisus for our honeymoon. We had the Royal Services package and it was amazing. We did not have to lift a finger. We always had seats reserved for us and the man working the beach and pool, Carlos, always set our towels up and got our drinks.
Our butler, Juan Suarez, was wonderful. He constantly checked on us and made sure everything was the way we wanted. He made dinner reservations for us and set up a party boat reservation. He always made sure our room was clean and left fresh fruit and cheese plates for us when we got back from a day at the beach. We definitely recommend this resort and will come back in the future.
The food and drinks were also awesome.

reviews.author: Pedro Almeida
reviews.text:
Beautiful resort, but what makes it truly special is the staff. Their warmth, professionalism, and genuine care made our vacation perfect!
Thankkkk you all!

reviews.author: milana broytman
reviews.text: Everything from the service from our concierge Ernesto, to the pool bartender Jose was amazing. Every employee is super kind and accommodating. The property is clean and beautiful and the food is great! Highly recommend paying a visit here!

reviews.author: Emily Torres
reviews.text: This resort has been superb. I always love coming here, they are accommodating and the amenities are endless. The staff are excellent as well, Jordania for instance was kind and provided good service. Emmanuel was helpful and funny :) both catered to my family and I’s needs immediately. Overall I recommend!

reviews.author: Bruno Vaello
reviews.text:
Looking for relaxation, fun and great food and drinks in Punta Cana? we enjoyed exactly that during our week at the Reserve of the Paradisus Palma Real. The facilities are very nice and modern, everything is clean. most of the people are very friendly and food and drinks are broadly available and fantastically prepared.
First I would like to recommend the restaurant Sante where all service personal is amazing and restaurant Flora with special mention to Melinda and Eduardo. Additionally I would recommend the Ginger bar where Dominga prepared amazing Banana Mamas for us and Between bar where Miguel and the other barman/barmaid showed us how to prepare and drink multiple cocktails. As reserve guests, we enjoyed many drinks at the beach thanks to the good care of Yeison
Furthermore every day is full of activities such dancing lessons or yoga sessions (thanks Amy). However, most of them were too short except for the ones guided by Hairon and Brandol that spent effort to make it interesting and fun. During the evening there are shows and life music and DJ in Kicks bar till late (more latin music and less beisbol on TV will improve the mood).
Finally we had the support of our Concierge Eriol: always available, full of information (although a bit too short notice) and with attention to detail (we got a couple of nice surprises organized by him 👌🏻).
Overall a great experience and special mention to Hairon who brings lots of positive energy day and night.

reviews.author: Paul Sweitzer
reviews.text: Enjoying a great week. Fun activities and friendly staff for kids and adults. Plus my kids are learning some Spanish! Emmanuel was a wonderful concierge and helped make our trip wonderful!

reviews.author: Kathy Hamilton
reviews.text:
Super fun experience trying to actually make sushi ! I had no idea what to expect, and found myself behind the counter, actually making sushi for our group. They were so nice and patient for us newbies. Fresh tuna and salmon daily !
Yovanny Gonzalez and Jorge Rafael

reviews.author: Amy Keeler
reviews.text:
My husband, two kids (5 and 7) just got back from a five night stay at the Paradisus.
The summary: Book a room with a concierge if you can - Harry was wonderful!  We would highly recommend a swim out suite if you have water-loving kids - the master swim out suite was extremely spacious and worked well for our family of four.

----- Our Room -----
We booked the Master Swim Out suite with two beds so that my husband and I could have plenty of space to hang out after the kids were asleep.  The suite exceeded our expectations -- with plenty of room for our family of four to eat room service, two couches (one being a pull out), easy access to the bathroom and pool from either the bedroom or living area.  The swim out suite worked perfectly for our family - I'd highly recommend it for anyone with kids who love the water like ours do!  One thing to note is that if you book the master suite with two beds - they are both doubles vs. queens.  It wasn't a big deal for us, just something to note if you're used to a larger size bed.  You could totally opt for the king and use the pull out sofa as an alternative.

----- The Staff -----
The staff at the Paradisus were absolutely wonderful!  They went above and beyond to make sure that our needs were meet.  Our concierge Harry was incredible.  He gave us the warmest welcome and continued to blow us away throughout our stay.  As my husband and I were celebrating our 10 year wedding anniversary, Harry surprised us with a bottle of champagne out by our pool our 2nd afternoon there.  He made sure to send us the schedule of events every morning and when we saw him around the resort, he would always provide us and our kids with a warm greeting (greeting them by name every time).

Harry made sure that our nightly dinner reservations were taken care of and helped book massage appointments.  When our safe was erroring out the one night - we sent a message to Harry and he sent someone to our room right away to help us out.  He also personally delivered another bottle of champagne and treats for the kids on our last night when we weren't able to find service at supposedly open bar near our suite's pool.  At the time we booked our stay, there was a Nikte option which included the concierge services (which got us Harry), I'm not exactly sure how you opt for this moving forward -- but definitely look into it as Harry really helped make our vacation.

Some other wonderful staff members to mention:
Leonela C., Louis and Wander at the Kanna Beach Club, the kids club staff was also wonderful

reviews.author: Christopher Jastrzebski
reviews.text: Chef Felix was great and made an awesome hibachi experience.  Our waiter Jose Rosario was on point and took great care of us.  Terrific dinner and wonderful service

reviews.author: Caroline Ogle
reviews.text: Absolutely amazing. This resort is stunning located right on the beach with so many great restaurants with the best of foods. One of our favorites was Sante, where Edward, Hirlenne, Pamela, Felix, and Amanda served us with the absolute best service. Everything was delicious and we cannot recommend it enough.

reviews.author: Stephanie R.
reviews.text: We had the best time at The Reserve at Paradisus! The service and ambiance are top notch. Our children (ages 8,5,& 3) absolutely loved the kids club and the extremely friendly staff and we were beyond happy with the resort and the service we received over our week long stay. We definitely recommend this for families and couples alike. Five star service and amenities!

reviews.author: Erica Conti
reviews.text: Each morning we go to the buffet and have breakfast. This morning we had Rosanna helping us. She was such a delight and always making sure that we were taken care of cleaning up our items, refilling juice. It was a pleasure being helped by her.

reviews.author: Rich Johnston
reviews.text: Eriol did a great job attending to me during my stay. Very courteous and pleasant to work with. He  gave me VIP service and would highly recommend him and Palidisus Resort!

reviews.author: Lora Lanham
reviews.text: The Paradisus Palma Real was a beautiful resort with all the amenities you are looking for. Our concierge, Ralphy, was the absolute best. Always went above and beyond whatever we needed. Yennifer kept our room spotless and fully stocked. Gladys gave an exceptional massage at the spa. Wanda and Eddie were the best bartenders at the pool and made sure we were never without a drink in hand. Martin made sure our time on the beach was relaxing. Overall the staff was amazing. The food at every restaurant was delicious with a lot of variety. A great experience for everyone!

reviews.author: jillian Lazzara
reviews.text: the staff is wonderful and food is amazing!! Rooms and resort is very clean. I will definitely be back!! The night life is very fun and a relaxing day time environment. The manager Luis is great !

reviews.author: Ana Castro
reviews.text:
Unforgettable vacations.
Like every year my husband and I go on vacation to the Dominican Republic, this time we stayed at the Paradisus Palma Real Golf & Spa Resort. We were there from June 14 to June 28 and stayed in a Nikte Junior Suite Swim Up room. Before we start our review, it is good to clarify that we are members of the Circle by Melia vacation club, and our status as red members is a factor that influences our opinion and our experience.

Check in
The arrival at the hotel was an extremely pleasant experience because the beauty of this hotel is indisputable. We were immediately escorted to check in, treated to a cocktail, and introduced to our concierge. The check in process was fast and very nice thanks to Daisy Gonzalez. She took care of answering our questions and was very helpful every time we needed to know something.

Concierge
Our concierge was Starlin Tavarez. He made sure that our vacations were perfect, from the restaurant reservations to the perfect service in every part of the hotel. Recommendation #1, if you can ask for a concierge before you get there or when you are at check in, Starlin is the name to remember.

Restaurants
Our favorite restaurants were Brisas, Flora and Mascalzones. At Brisas we received first-class service, thanks to Jose Ramos and Rosanna. The food is delicious, and the treatment is personalized. They remember your name and preferences the next day. Recommendation #2, ask Jose to make you one of his cocktails. Flora was a pleasant surprise for us because of the beauty of the restaurant, because they serve Dominican food and because of the luxury service that Francisco offered us. In our opinion Francisco is one of the best waiters we have ever met. His attention to every detail made our dinners (we went to dinner 3 times) unforgettable memories. Recommendation #3, visit Flora restaurant for an authentic Dominican experience. Mascalzones is the Italian restaurant and we really liked it. Fausto is another of the luxury waiters at the Paradisus Palma Real. He waited on us at Mascalzones and at other resort restaurants.

Room
The room was clean. The hotel provides turndown service, if you request it. One problem was that there were mosquitoes in the room. Something curious is that there were no mosquitoes in other parts of the resort. Recommendation #4, you should bring insect repellent.

Beach and pool.
The beach was beautiful, there was no sargassum and Raul kept us hydrated all the time. Raul is one of the people who attends to the guests on the beach. He is fast and very nice. In the pool (our swim up) we had Julia. I had never seen someone as efficient, hard-working and friendly as Julia. We really enjoyed the beach and the pool and much of this was due to their excellent service.

Entertainment.
Every day our concierge sent us a notification with the activities that were going to happen in the resort. From what we read there are many activities for all ages, but in truth we did not participate in many because our interest was to relax on the beach and the pool.

In general.
We loved the remodel of the hotel, the service was excellent, the attention as Circle members was the best we have experienced. Many thanks to Gabriel Bobadilla member service manager, for his hard work and dedication. We are very satisfied with the service offered and we are sure that we will return very soon.

reviews.author: elizabeth ruiz
reviews.text:
Today I have dinner at the  winery at the paradius Palma real the service was excellent they got our dinner fast & hot
We ask from two different restaurants they was to happy to make us happy our night there was pleasant,
Thanks guys for your professionalism
Jhonatan, máximo & francisco

reviews.author: Jodi Fontenard
reviews.text: The hotel is lovely and very well maintained. There is a good variety of restaurants to choose from. I wish that the pools did not close so early or close at all. And the snack bar needs should offer more lighter snacks daily like pizza, and finger foods. Our concierge Starlin was very helpful and pleasant.

reviews.author: Robyn Cerone
reviews.text: Lizandro stocked our mini bar every day to the max! We had two little girls who he catered to the whole trip. He was amazing and we never needed to buy anything for the beach.

reviews.author: Lany Guillen
reviews.text: Had a great time at the Paradisus Palma Real. Ariel Benzo was our concierge and he was extremely responsive to all of our needs. The swim up room was excellent - very comfortable and had no complaints there. I’ve stayed at a few Melia resorts and I find that the only thing lacking is the quality/selection of the food.

reviews.author: SherRie Blango
reviews.text: I had breakfast and lunch at the Lunch Box today and the service was awesome. Rosannah, Xanira, and Hilda were the most friendly and their service was excellent. I recommend the Lunch Box for all of your daily meals.

reviews.author: MomTomKat
reviews.text: Amazing resort. My concierge Yaleidi Sims it was great helped me with Everything. Also l had Such a special dinner with Eduardo and team at Sante.  Food was delicious.  Service impeccable. Lovely table by the pool lit up at night. Just a great evening.

reviews.author: Jose Luiz Junqueira
reviews.text: Excellent hotel, excellent service, specially in the main Buffet. We were very well treated by steak chef Hostel (speaks, french, criolo, Spanish and English), Yendi, serving pasta for the kids, and the waiters that served us well by the table: Stormin, Andrea, Maria and Darling. Hopefully they extend this nice service at the pool and at the beach for the guests. This is the only thing missing for those used to visit Paradisus Cancun in "the reserve" (old Red level).

reviews.author: Erika Holguin
reviews.text: Perfect for a girls trip! The hotel is really beautiful, clean and the staff is amazing. If you are staying at the Reserve, request Leandra as your concierge as she is one of the best. At the beach make sure you find Obeidy because he will ensure you have a great time and will make you feel like family. All the bartenders are extremely friendly and make delicious drinks. I would definitely recommend staying there if you want to relax, have a nice family trip or drink and party as they have the best of everything!

reviews.author: Vanessa McClendon
reviews.text: This is our second time staying at this amazing resort. Our first time was five years ago, and since that time the resort has been renovated, and as if it was even possible, it is even more stunning than it was the first time. The property itself is immaculate. The service is exceptional. For example Jordania and Leandro, and the cook who does the omelettes …just awesome service! We are a party of 18 and everyone feels the same!

reviews.author: J b
reviews.text: Miguel and Nathaniel and Jeffrey at Rum Republic are amazing.  Their service was exceptional and you just can’t beat their personalities!!!

reviews.author: Kayla Marsh
reviews.text:
Most of the staff was very helpful and nice but we had a large group and some of us got moved to a different resort without being informed until we arrived and tried to check in. No one was helpful in getting it fixed until our concierge Juan was able to get the group placed at another resort passes to at least come over for meals and to spend time together. There was little to nothing for entertainment except for the last two days when they had evening entertainment from 7-10. It was extremely disappointing being they advertise as having lots of entertainment all day. Also they closed all but 3 restaurants for dinner, two of the 7 nights we were there, with little notice and we had to get reservations to eat. If you are looking to just lay on the beach or by the pool it’s a fine place but if you are looking for a fun trip with entertainment or activities I would go somewhere else. It is nothing like advertised. We also paid extra to have a jacuzzi tub …  it is just a tub. There is no hot tub/jacuzzi tub any where at this resort.

Jorge Rafael, Juan our concierge and the other great staff are the only reason I gave it 2 stars.

reviews.author: Frank Davey
reviews.text:
We stayed for a 3-day weekend after a work trip to Santo Domingo.

The weather wasn’t great but there’s so much to do that you hardly notice.

Yaleidi was our concierge and was fantastic.

Others of note include Victor our cook in the Asian restaurant/Japanese steakhouse.  He was funny and entertaining.

We took a Sushi making class and Manual was terrific.

Juan and Jonathon at the Winery were knowledgeable and helped us have a nice romantic dinner.

Jose and Fernando were awesome as bell hops with the luggage.

It’s our 2nd time here and they continue to invest and make it a nice experience.

reviews.author: Jose Espino
reviews.text: Our stay in Paradisus Palma Real was amazing. It has been our second time in the resort and we definitely are coming back. Everything about the place is amazing. Rooms are fully renovated and looks beautiful and clean. Pool was super clean. Food was great as well as drinks options. One of the highlights of the place is the people. Everyone is so welcoming and make you feel special. Our concierge Kenneth Nivar  went above and beyond. He was extremely helpful in every aspect and he made our experience even better. We highly recommend Paradisus Palma Real for everyone that wants to a dreams vacation.

reviews.author: Viet Nguyen
reviews.text: Dalmis was our concierge and his service was incredible! He was there to help with every little thing that we could have wanted and is literally the nicest human being. Ate at the Lunchbox during our stay and the waitstaff were amazing! We had Misael, Celia, and Gregorin and they were all super friendly and attentive! Great experience overall.

reviews.author: Bruno Lancellotti
reviews.text: It's my second time here, alongside my wife, after 10 years. The revamp a couple years ago definitely improved Paradisus Palma Real. We stayed at the adult-only sector called "The Reserve", which indeed imparts more privacy and quietness. Unlike the previous time, we went all in and stayed beach front (full sea view): in other words, that meant we had a private deck that took us right to the beach (that's the ground floor, guess it's out of luck and availability one gets those). Service-wise, it was on point and shout-out to our private concierge Eriol (included in this product tier offering) who made sure all our needs had been addressed throughout the stay. Food in general is good, and the Dominican people make it taste better with their kindness and joie de vivre.

reviews.author: makaila genilla
reviews.text:
I don’t know if it’s the staff or the food that’s better! Just ate at Mascalzone and everything was amazing! They served focaccia bread as soon as we sat, brought out pasta to try & the food came out within 15 minutes of ordering! Ordered the fettuccine and linguine and we’ll be back here before our trip ends! Thank you to both Daysi & Caleyvix who made sure our stay was as perfect and everything was taken care of!

Special thank you to Andino & Alexander at Blue Agave for amazing service and great food! Both went above and beyond to make sure our experience was positive! We’ll be back here before we leave for the service!

reviews.text: Laura was an excellent hostess at Malva and Blue Agave. She gave us excellent service and had a smiling face always. Maria Santana, Alendri Alcarez, and Franklin Acevedo did an excellent job serving us with smiling faces too! Thank you

reviews.author: angel gomez
reviews.text:
The good and bad

Unless I Miss read, they say that the beach is private, but you can tell there are people that shouldn't be there. Second, how pushy they are for tips and google reviews. You get one drink, and they expect a tip. If you dont tip, they never going to come back or insist you on anything. They just give you a nasty look. They bring your bag to your room, expect a tip, they bring you towels, they expect a tip, and they are forceful about it. One thing they left me a bad taste was we have the "VIP" service and we did the 3 hour day trip on a boat to do yoga and just relax. When we finished, they were forcefully asking for tips and google review to give a 5 star review. In the end, there was a lady who wanted to tip the captain but didn't have cash, so they had cashup, and she did it through there. But they were so pushy about the tip that they were asking proof. A screenshot of the tip sent like is mandatory. And when we headed back to the hotel, they kind of forced us to have a "free" drink ready for us, but it was a trick to tip them to for bringing the drinks and doing a google review to mention there name. and don't get me started when I was at the beach, and people were just coming nonstop to get you to sell you something over about 400% of the original price.

So in the end the resort was wonderful, the location was great,  the food was amazing, and the activities were available but I don't know if I could be coming to this resort again. If they can fix their salesperson, there employs about the non stop forcefully to tip them and ask for reviews. I think it would be a great resort.

reviews.text: Our family spent a week staying at the Nikita rooms.  We all loved spending time at our private pool. reviews.author: Maude Rheaume
reviews.text:
Before booking at this hotel, I read a lot of comments and reviews for other resorts and was a bit discouraged because they all felt old.

Finally, during Black Friday weekend, the Paradisus suddenly appeared at an incredible price for a lightning week in January 2023 in Transat's offers. Despite the lack of recent reviews, as it seemed to be the hotel's reopening following major investments and renovations, we decided to take a chance and go ahead. We were not disappointed!

The hotel's rooms, communal areas and restaurants have all been refurbished and are magnificent and up to date. I'm a stickler for cleanliness and the resort was clean and tidy.

Our favorites
- The beauty and size of the room. The design was WOW!
- Plenty of umbrellas on the beach and at the pool. We were always in the shade and very comfortable.
- Very quiet Adult-Only zone (accessible at no extra charge) at the pool and beach.
- The hotel was clearly not full, so it was very quiet.
- There's a barrier space in the sea to reduce the presence of Sargrasse so there's not an industrial quantity on the beach and in the water. We were able to swim in the sea every day.
- The ''à la carte'' restaurants were excellent and offered a wide variety of dishes.
- I don't have much comparison on the buffet side, but the food was good, fresh, hot and there was plenty of variety - it will never be as good as home but we were satisfied.
- The hotel was top quality and you felt it was superior
- Close to the airport we almost got a private transport to leave the hotel because we were only a small group leaving that day.

To be improved
- The staff really didn't speak English (or French) very well, it was very difficult to get understood for basic things.
- There are several levels of access and ranges of services in the hotel and it was never very clear what was included or not (especially for the à la carte restaurants)
- The restaurant reservation system: we had to turn up early in the morning to make a reservation for the following day, and yet they told us there were no more places available, even though the restaurants were empty in the evening. However, every evening when we didn't have a reservation, we arrived between 6 and 6.30pm and asked for a seat at the restaurant of our choice, and we were accommodated so I am kinde confused with their system.
- Two days in a row, the room service didn't show up, which I find deplorable for a 5-star hotel.
- We were never able to use the ATM machine so I recommend bringing more than less money for the tip.
- Drinks were pretty basic and didn't stand out

All in all, I highly recommend this hotel if you want something a little more luxurious, modern, quiet and eat something a little more upscale than a 3-4 star hotel. I'd go back without hesitation!
I wouldn't recommend it if you want to party!

As for restaurants, we were lucky enough to eat at Mira (steakhouse), Flora (Carabean Style), Mascalzone (Italian), Blue Agave (Mexican), Tokimeku (Japanese). My personal favorite was Flora for the fish, and my partner's was Mira for the steak.

reviews.author: Cara Kenney
reviews.text: We are loving our stay at Paradisus Palma! We are staying on The Reserve side and are enjoying everything! Martin at the beach has been wonderful at taking care of our every need. Nicolas is our concierge and he has catered to us perfectly!! Would definitely recommend!

reviews.author: Gordon Eanes
reviews.text: An amazing culinary experience!  Staff was so attentive!  Special commendations to:  Stormin Capitan, Andrea, Amanda, Jose and Roberto!  We’d like to come back again tomorrow!  5 stars to the restaurant and our servers!  We also received excellent service at Kicks Sports Bar with lively atmosphere and excellent service from Fior and Yiri!!

reviews.author: Dena Mabe
reviews.text: I love the Ginger Coffee Bar!! Ismael, Dominga, Maria,, Olga, Nereida, Clari were amazing and so helpful!! Plus, the coffee is amazing!! The iced coffee with Baileys was so good! Everyone is so friendly!!

reviews.author: G Woo Hoff (Peachynorth)
reviews.text: Though we stayed at the Reserve section, we love coming to the main resort. The restaurants are great and the buffet has a really nice selection of fresh foods. The beach is at the main resort and we love the pools. Service is friendly and helpful. Bartenders make very decent drinks like the Coco Loco. The beach has soft white sand and they maintain the beach area nicely. Sometimes there are bouncy castles for the kids.

reviews.author: Jorge Braceras
reviews.text: Francisco and Jonathon at The Winery were simply AMAZING! Along with amazing food and wine! 10/10 recommend.

reviews.author: Caitlin Yulan
reviews.text:
The resort is absolutely breathtaking. The resort was very close to the airport, which is very convenient.

Abraham, is one of the best servers on this resort. He was always available to serve us with all our needs. He was kind, generous, and super helpful. We were well taken care of our whole stay.

Gabriel and Jose were one of the best servers on the beach and pool area that helped us with all our needs. Gabriel, was the sweetest. Our expectations were met way beyond what we expected. I will definitely recommend coming to this resort, it was absolutely perfect.

I wish I could show how thankful I am to everyone that helped us, and catered to us. Everyone was very helpful, and always making sure we were well taken care of. Thank you, a million thank you’s to everyone working hard on this resort, it was greatly appreciated.

reviews.author: Laura Colflesh
reviews.text: Ginger bar was amazing Ismael gave wonderful fast service. They make the best smoothies, coffees, Frappuccino in the whole hotel. Definitely worth a visit each morning. 🤩

reviews.author: danielle hionis
reviews.text: The best time because Raul takes care of the kids and us! Most accommodating beach and pool access!   Values us like we are his own family!  We love it here!!!!

reviews.author: Marquel Howell
reviews.text: Had dinner at Mina and Wander was our server. It was amazing start to finish. Great food, ambience and service. After 3 days here, we have had the best meal yet!

reviews.author: Megan Bovy
reviews.text: The staff is very wonderful, they speak good English but if they did not understand what we were asking, they would go out of their way to find someone that could help us! The beaches are beautiful and they do a fabulous job of cleaning up the seaweed that would wash up on shore overnight! The cleaning service did a great job of cleaning our rooms daily and keep resort clean our whole stay! Our butler Yesica was a wonderful person and booked everything for us and checked in with us daily to make sure we didn’t need anything!

reviews.author: Nicole Sutton
reviews.text: Definitely a 10/10Minwas amazing service 🥰🥰🥰🥰🥰 Mina restaurant steak  had a blast. 💥 Made us feel welcomed and appreciated.

reviews.author: Brian Williams
reviews.text: Today we had the pleasure of being served at Rum Republic Bar by Maria and Deny. The service was spectacular! The creativity of the drinks was incredible! This bar was a must for us every evening!

reviews.author: Richard Phillips
reviews.text: Absolutely beautiful resort.  Everyone made us feel welcome, very respectful,  the best resort we have visited. Mr Raul is the best, if you need anything at all, he can help you out. Emmanuel and Richard took great care of us very well, they made sure that we got to our excursions on time and were very great.

reviews.author: Gerry Vorias
reviews.text: Paradisus Palma Real has been way above our expectations, from the luxurious premises to the exquisite beach. The service has been exceptional especially at the a la carte restaurant SANTE, where we had a fantastic waiter named Juan. At the beach all our needs were taken care of by another fantastic individual named Raphael, wherever you needed drinks or loungers to sunbath. If you want to spoil yourself you must try Paradisus PALMA REAL in the DR.

reviews.author: Mita Parekh
reviews.text:
Amazing food at Blue Agarva. They accommodated us straight away thanks to Laura.
Food was amazing even as a vegetarian. Santo was great at making us food off the menu.
Thank you so much for a great experience

reviews.author: Vinson Davis
reviews.text: Highly recommend!! The staff has been awesome the entire time. They make you feel like you're hanging out with your friends! Definitely will come back as soon as I can!!

reviews.author: Ara Soukiassian
reviews.text:
We were welcomed every morning from a wonderful cheerful waiter called Jose at the Brisas restaurant.  Always ready to please his guests. Food at this restaurant is amazing(members only restaurant).
Definitely a must go.

reviews.author: Eddie Ng
reviews.text:
Just recently stayed at Paradisus Palma Real in the swim up Nikte room and it was great! Service is outstanding and the staff was always nice, polite and accommodating. The location is also ideal with the beach nearby.

Our concierge Wily Mercado was amazing! He went above and beyond in setting us up with reservations, driving us around and ensuring we were taken care of. Thank you Wily!

The only thing that bothered us quite a bit was the pests. We had a few encounters with big roaches and my kids and I got brutalized by mosquitoes 🦟

reviews.author: Renata Almeida
reviews.text: Amazing hotel with the nicest, happiest and most welcoming staff. Must go to ginger bar for coffee and drinks (Ismael, Antonio, Dominga, Olga and Clari will take great care of you)  and steak house for dinner. Just make sure to always book a reservation in advance for the restaurants or else you’ll be disappointed when they tell you they are fully booked.

reviews.author: Stas
reviews.text: It is a great resort as they have top quality service and the atmosphere is great! The rooms are clean and the decor and area is really nice. Would recommend to anyone who is interested or looking for a great resort. Jordania tends to share a smile to others so if you see her around have a chat.

reviews.author: Ana Vierliza Mendez
reviews.text: We had an amazing experience at the hotel, specially with the kidsdom staff, they are very committed to their work and to caring for the children, giving their maximum effort so that the children feel at home and have a wonderful stay. We congratulate them and wish them all the best. Thank you very much for your attention.

reviews.author: Nichole Reynolds
reviews.text:
Amazing experience.  Zenovia was absolutely fantastic.  She was there for anything and everything we needed.
The resort is beautiful.  The food.. amazing. Would recommend to anyone looking for a nice getaway. Ask for Zenovia as your personal concierge.

reviews.author: Sandy Cyr
reviews.text: We are still enjoying our 7 days here at the Paradisus Palma real adults swim up room.. So far it has been a fantastic resort. The rooms are beautiful and modern. The service has been great and the food is good. More to come later when we leave.

reviews.author: Leonora Edmond
reviews.text: My husband and I had a 5 day 4 night stay at the Royal Service Paradisus Palma Real.  They lived up to their name and gave us excellent royal treatment and services.   Our room was beautiful and extra spacious.    Comfortable and clean.   Stand up shower and large tub with jets for jacuzzi like experience in our bathroom. Room got cleaned and restocked morning and evening.   Our Butler Armando  Minier took excellent care of us and was always available for whatever needs we had.  He took time to make our reservations for dinner and made sure we had nothing to worry about. He was only a text message away.  Everyone in the resort was attentive and willing to help and very lively. Made sure our experience was always amazing.   Many areas to hang out and relax, both indoors and outdoors.  Pedro (beach front attendant)made sure to have our beachfront Cabana ready for us every day and kept our cold drinks coming. Would definitely come back to this spot if the opportunity presents.  Awesome resort. Amazing experience.

reviews.author: Lou Mira
reviews.text:
Just had a wonderful dinner at Mina Restaurant which was delicious. The steak was tender and onion soup was very good.
The service was exceptional and would like to thank Wander for a very good experience.
Will submit a more detailed review at a later date.

reviews.author: Rosanna Batista
reviews.text: The food in general was good with a lot of variety of meats, salads and sides. There were instances of desserts not tasting good.

reviews.author: daniel cormier
reviews.text:
Reilyn has given excellent service to me and my friends all week so far! He's awesome. We always look for him at the buffet!!!! 😁

Bartolo was awesome helping us get around with ride service.. great guy

reviews.author: Magda Melena
reviews.text: Overall the food is great for an all inclusive resort. The hotel is beautiful and I’ve received very great service from everyone. Everyone is very friendly and exceptional service from Yorgelys, Lenny, Yuri, Melvin, Yensen, Miguel, Yésica, Julia at the pool bar, José at the bar, Rosanna at the adult bar, and Maximiliano.

reviews.author: Rosicela Black
reviews.text: Lucia and team at the “Gin Ger” bar were amazing! Their service was great very attentive and friendly.  They accommodated all of our requests with a smile. Lucia, Walquiria, Luis, Desa, Ana, y Carolina keep the great service. You guys made our stay very enjoyable.

reviews.author: Laura Nalder
reviews.text: Tonight we ate at the MASCALZONE. What an amazing experience.  We were greeted with a pleasant greeter who showed us to our table promptly with a fun personality.  Our smiling server came over and introduced himself as Fauto. He was personable and could joke around with you. He went up and beyond to get those simple things to make your dinner wonderful.  He had no balsamic vinegar for the bread.  Don’t worry he went to another restaurant to get some even though the restaurant was closed.  The supervisor Milton was so pleasant and wanted to make sure everything was great for our dinner experience.  I would highly recommend you to go and ask for Fauto and Milton you will not be disappointed. The Resort is very lucky 🍀 to have them because the PEOPLE working there build the relationship with the members and their friends and that’s how the Resorts become successful.  So they should be good to their staff.

reviews.author: Sandra Rodrigues
reviews.text: We had a nice time. Perfect weather. Had trouble for 2 nights with the HVAC. That wasn't fun. I thought the food was excellent,  the beach is beautiful with very soft sand.  I'd like to see more activities. Yoga only happened one time during my week, and the larimar craft wasn't a craft. It was to sell their wares. Loungers on our balcony would be an added bonus, but unfortunately, there were only two chairs. They randomly closed restaurants as well, without warning,  leaving everyone to scramble for other reservations. We never got into Malva or a second time to the steak house, We found the staff to be very friendly. I did have to call 3x to have our fridge refilled.  And the buffet was closed 2x for dinner!  Overall, it was a nice vacation. Now we wait for our delayed Swoop flight 🤦‍♀️

reviews.author: Jason Schoulte
reviews.text:
Great weather, drinks were great, food was good overall, and the employees were all very polite and provided great service.  Also had a number of adult activities in which we participated which were fun.

Only drawback is there was usually a few people walking around selling items and felt pressured to buy something, and the swim-up bar closed a bit earlier than we would have liked.  Some of the restaurants were also difficult to reserve due to lack of availability so we didn’t get to eat at one we hoped to.

reviews.author: Terry Toliver
reviews.text:
Paradisus Palma Real is absolutely beautiful. The white buildings make it so pristine. The staff (housekeeping, waiters, servers and beach bar staff) is very attentive, and the beach is so inviting.
I will definitely come back here again and again. I need to give and additional kudo to Luis Cadet, our concierge. He gave us the very best care, everyday. He arranged everything for us. Luis is the best.

reviews.author: Alicia A.
reviews.text: Restaurant Blue Agave was fantastic!! Santo, the boss was amazing! Th food was delicious and the staff’s service was very hospitable. Exceeded my expectations for food at a resort.

reviews.author: Olsi Dajti
reviews.text:
This place is trash !! Worse food , worse service, the rooms are freaking filthy.

Roaches everywhere 🤮.

Management team sucked so bad!!

We were group of 17 people.

I’m not mad and that’s why I’m saying all this . This is really all true !!

I have more pictures that will just make you 🤮

reviews.author: Jose Flores
reviews.text: Ariel and Raul are great hosts. Location is great. Service is great. Room is well decorated, clean and air conditioner is a must. Average temperature is in the high 80s in May.  Will definitely return. Thank you for opening your doors to us.

reviews.author: Kaly DLB
reviews.text:
I bought the "adults only" package.
Not my first time in punta cana,  so I was expecting to enjoy like I did last time in a different resort.
Here's what went wrong:
-They gave me at first a room in the kids area, I had to walk back to the lobby to let the lady know they're giving me the wrong room.
-She also mentioned they're not responsible if money gets stolen from the room so it's better to use the safe box 😲
- 1st night I had an upset stomach, something I ate for sure upset my stomach....Here's where all started...I called reception in the lobby around 11pm to see if they sell pills to ease my symptoms,  the guy said they have no pharmacy in the hotel but he can contact a pharmacy from outside the hotel and get medicine,  he will call me back,  never did.
- The next morning I contacted them again, and someone else mentioned there's a clinic in the hotel! I went to the clinic (a young lady opened the door with an unfriendly look) I explained to her what happened and she asked me where I'm coming from? I said USA ,after that she said there's a $195 charge just for consultation and the medicine it's another charge🤯 obviously I told her no and walk out.
- I went to the lobby again , this time I spoke to Jordania, I explained everything that happened and I told her that I remember years ago something similar happened in cancun and the resort had like a little pharmacy/store where I can find some pills for upset stomach.
She said they don't have that there.
So she suggested to get medicine from a pharmacy outside the hotel, she had the wassap contact in a cellphone,  so she was messaging with the pharmacy and telling me the prices of the medicine. They delivered it to me , I paid  $55 for an electrolyte drink and some 5 probiotics.
- A couple days pass by I felt better,  when it was almost time to do my check out, I stopped in the Boutique to buy souvenirs when I noticed they're selling stomacal pills for $2 !!
- I was obviously confused so I went to the lobby and spoke to Stephania who looked surprised and sorry for what happened to me.
-Advise for everyone: take medicine to your trips just in case something happens.
- I also mentioned to Stephania , how I noticed employees arguing to each other in front of customers, in the pool/bar area, in the buffet/breakfast area, looks unprofessional to me .
-They should probably focus more on the hygiene of the cooks and chefs,  since they use their bare hands .
-The hotel and the property is Beautiful, the ocean was amazing  but definitely they lack on customer service,  their employees lack respect to tourists.

reviews.author: Nidia Pacheco
reviews.text:
Excellent service! Everyone is there for you. Irving was so nice. He made us reservation for the Mina restaurant and Italian restaurant.
Definitely we will be back again. A great experience on the Paradisus Palma Real.

reviews.author: Lindsay Curtius
reviews.text: Our meal at Mascalzone was SO good! Really great Italian food and great service.  Milton checked on us several times and kept our glasses full. Highly Recommend!

reviews.author: Derek C
reviews.text: We were looking for a vacation to just relax and have everything taken care of - beautiful location, great accommodations,  amazing food and weather to write home about. We achieved all of these and more! The restaurant selections are pretty great offering Italian, Japanese, steakhouse, Mediterranean and always a buffet with a nice variety. Really had a great time with my family here and i will definitely be back. There is also a basketball court nestled between tennis and pickleball courts that is a 15 minute walk from our resort. I had asked about getting a ball to play and was redirected a few times until one great employee took it upon himself to find me a ball. Javier Rosario added me onto his WhatsApp contacts and said he would get me a ball. I was looking to play in a couple of hours and he told me he would find one for me. I don't know how he did it, but he ended up meeting me at the beach with a brand new ball. That's service!! I ended up playing for a couple of hours and made sure to get the ball back to him. I was thinking about providing a 4 🌟 review as the only pain is the limitation to book restaurents up to 2 days in advance, but upped it to 5 due to Javier's great service. Thank you Javier!!

reviews.author: Maria Grand
reviews.text:
Perfect family vacation!!!

We were a large group (12ppl) and had an awesome time. There are activities for everyone.

Beach is gorgeous, sevral huge pools. Night entertainment was very good (shows, dj, dancers, bands). Food very good too. We really enjoy the tepanyaki, the mexican restaurant, Brisas by the beach. All very good quality. Buffet had several stations with big variety of fresh food (sushi, grill, pasta, salads, pizza, fruits/ desserts).

Kids loved the KidsDom… they loved all activities… jets skis in the pool, foam party, wax hands, slime, they cooked pizzas and cookies, had a kids party, beach volley and more. They  had a blast! They didn’t want to miss an activity. The Kidsdom team was fantastic!!!

We loved this vacation! This is our 4th time here. And we hope to be back again soon.

reviews.author: Katie Ripka
reviews.text: Loved the hibachi restaurant! The staff were so friendly and had very quick service! Really good food too!! Hansel and Maria are amazing!!

reviews.author: Anmol Sadhwani
reviews.text: Amazing service. Jessica is super accommodating to dietary requirements, preferences and portion sizes. There is gluten free pasta. Milton also attentive that the service and food is good. Thank you

reviews.author: Jose Peraza
reviews.text: Great staff and management with disposition to make us feel comfortable even under unexpected circumstances. Kelvin Fernandez made a terrific job keeping us posted on daily activities and bookings. He was a great person who looked after us throughout our stay! Many tks Kelvin 😉

reviews.author: Gina
reviews.text:
We just had an amazing experience at Mascalzone!  The service was unmatched! Our waiter Fausto could not be nicer and stendere to every need. Milton, was amazing and knew everything.  Eliza was friendly and attended to our needs.
I highly recommend this restaurant when staying at the Palma Real. Service and food can’t be beat!

reviews.author: Danielle Spina
reviews.text:
We just came back from a week's vacation from the Paradisus Palma Real Golf & Spa. I wrote a list of the pros and cons of our experience. To give you background we went with our two children, a 5 year old and 1 year old.

Pros
*Food better than expected.
*Resort is well taken care of
*Rooms were clean
*Cleaned up the Sargassum on the beach. The ocean was not that clear. We walked down two hotels and found clear water. We know this isn’t the hotel's fault.
*11am daily fun kid activity
*Could go to the splash pad on the sister resort
*We had an issue with our first room but they were accommodating and moved our room.

Cons
*Main pool is deep. I am 5’6” and had to walk on my tippy toes to keep my head above water. Very difficult with two kids.
*Foot service on the beach is limited and non-existent at the large pool. We had the swim up room and there was one bartender most days for a decent amount of rooms.
*Our concierge checked in twice with us. He mentioned we were getting something special for our 10 yr wedding anniversary and we didn’t.
*The lunch box(buffet) and The Snack area are closed from 11am until they open for lunch at 12 & 12:30. If you need something for kids during that time there is the sports bar and ginger bar.

reviews.author: Gabriel Vasquez
reviews.text:
Ariel Benzo y Juan Castillo fueron lo mejor del viaje. La atención fue perfecta. Saludos a Rafael de la playa que fue maravilloso
Food was terrible; what was promised on the menu was not delivered and most of the seafood items were not available or the content was misrepresented
These complaints have been posted for years but looks like hotel has no interest in resolving the problems

reviews.author: Taylor Axley
reviews.text:
Resort is alright. Pretty much shuts down at 10pm and not much to do besides water aerobics and things like that. More if a place to relax and sit in the sun and not do much besides that.

Jorge Rafael was incredible!! Spent a bunch of time with our group teaching us Spanish in the plaza.

Juan Carlos Sierra is a great concierge and went out of his way to help our large group coordinate dinners.

reviews.author: Rachel Schmidt
reviews.text: We stayed for a business/vacation event. Though it was a little rocky in the beginning due to confusion with our room reservation we were able to get it sorted out with the help of our concierge, Hector. He was the most amazing help and went above and beyond to rectify the room situation. He assisted in our dinner reservations and made sure we had everything we needed. He even arranged for a little surprise to celebrate our upcoming anniversary. Hector is a diamond and the resort would be blessed to have more just like him managing things. As for the staff in the Reserve area, at the beach and the pool closest to the beach…Yuderi, Martin, Wanda and Rafael provided the best service. All of our needs were met and then some. Franklin at Sante for breakfast and lunch was awesome. Georgi at Blue Agave was like familia. We really appreciated all that they did as they made our stay very enjoyable.

reviews.author: Hannah McCardle
reviews.text: We’ve had a wonderful time staying here this week! The restaurant Mina has wonderful food & steaks! Santo & yudelquis were the best to help me celebrate my birthday!

reviews.author: Rachele Pereyra
reviews.text: We stayed at Paradisus Palma Real for my bachelorette party, which I highly recommend.  All of their staff were great!  Eriol was very helpful, he made sure everything was good and made couple of reservations for us.  He stayed in contact with us through our stay.  I would definitely stay here again in the future.

reviews.author: Veronica Chavez
reviews.text:
Fior, Víctor y Andreina are amazing at their craft! They've been so sweet and kind to us! They've gone above and beyond to provide quality service to my entire family. We are so happy to have spent the last few days here with them at
Kicks Bar. They have also been so helpful when we had questions.

Thank you so much for everything!  ♥️

reviews.author: Mark McPhee
reviews.text:
Five stars for our butler Juan. Always attentive and willing to help, made our stay  very enjoyable. He provided a couple of surprises for us in our room which were very nice touches.
The restaurants in the Royal Service were all good. Passion is an exceptional restaurant and very good value for money given the service and quality of the food and the experience is extremely high.
The hotel is very beautiful and the beach is stunning and the waters very warm.
Great vacation.

reviews.author: Crina Ciolacu
reviews.text:
I want to specially thank Stephanie Castillo-guest service/concierge for taking exceptional care of us throughout our stay here at Paradisos! She took care of us, she made sure we have reservations at our favorite restaurants, she looked for our comfort and enjoyment every day ! We love her and recommend her services wholeheartedly❤️

The Ciolacu’s

reviews.author: Caitlyn G
reviews.text:
Highly recommend! Ginger Bar (Ismael,Antonio, Gri , Dominqa, Neireida,Yenifer ) we’re all so great to us!!! It was our go to bar! The staff was amazing ! Fresh fruit and always looking out for us.

All the staff at the resort is very efficient , friendly and accommodating !

Way exceeded my expectations! Absolutely beautiful 😍

reviews.author: Shelly Harvey
reviews.text: We stayed in an oceanfront suite and it was absolutely beautiful.  Check out Wander at the steakhouse.  He has lots of personality and will take care of all you needs.  He’s very attentive and made sure we were satisfied with our meals.  Thank you Wander!!!

reviews.author: Justin Tanandar
reviews.text: Abraham Torres has made my stay this week an awesome experience! He made my group of 10’s dining experience at the Italian restaurant one to remember with his amazing service. He was also wonderful at breakfast as well and can’t forget about his amazing ice coffees!

reviews.author: Yolanda Segarra
reviews.text: My husband and I stayed at the Paradisus’  beautiful Reserve (Adults only). One of the restaurants we had dinner at was Sante. It was amazing! Great food, beautiful atmosphere and great customer service. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Nesreen Alshamli
reviews.text: MelQui is a very helpful employee and we very appreciate his service

reviews.author: alba nonaj
reviews.text: I had a delightful dining experience at the restaurant Tokimeku. The staff was exceptionally welcoming and Santo, true to his name, provided excellent service. The food was delicious, and the chef's specials were truly amazing.

reviews.author: Juan encarnacion
reviews.text:
Excellent customer service and very nice and clean resort,
All the staff is great, specially Jairo from the entertainment crew.

reviews.author: Zoryangelie Torres
reviews.text: The food was wonderful and the service was incredible! We had a concierge service and it was the best decision ever! I loved not having to worry about the dinner reservations or even making appointments for COVID testing because he handled it all! They make you feel like family and I am very grateful to Willie for his great service! We definitely will be back!

reviews.author: Burke Arielle Roberts
reviews.text: Our server Melina was wonderful! And Reynaldo took great care of us! Great food and lovely atmosphere.

reviews.author: Kaitlyn Hoeflich
reviews.text: Our stay at the Palma Real was amazing! From the time we got there our concierge, Starlin Taverez, was so accommodating and kind. He took great care of us all week and helped us with anything we needed. He reserved all of dinners and excursion. The place was gorgeous and everyone was so friendly, I highly recommend staying here and ask for Starlin as a concierge! He’s wonderful!!

reviews.author: Matt Guido
reviews.text: Overall it’s a great setup for all inclusive with the restaurants, beach, pools. Daysi Gonzalez in reception was fantastic, both upon our arrival and departure from the Reserve. My only comment would be to keep the sellers out of the Reserve beach area unless requested. It was constant all day.  Otherwise, a great experience.

reviews.author: Angelica Cassanova
reviews.text: Andrea has been the best waitresses we have had since we got here, she made us feel like at home and Andino did everything to make our night great at the Mascalzones Restaurant!!  Our first dinner was amazing!! Five stars for them.

reviews.author: Hersh DS
reviews.text: My boyfriend booked this trip for our first trip together as a couple, I must say, he did such a great job! Such a beautiful place and people are just amazing. We stayed at The Reserve and our concierge Bladimir took care of us from checking in, making reservations for our dinners and making sure that we’re getting nothing but the best treatment. Franklin and Meleidy at Santi restaurant, George at the Agave restaurant, and the cooks at the Malva restaurant that made us awesome omelets were all so great!!! The bar tenders by the beach and by the reserve pool Teofillo and Grey were very nice. We always come back to a clean room every night. Definitely recommend staying here. We want to thank everyone for such a great experience.

reviews.author: Donté N
reviews.text: Came here to celebrate my friends birthday and we had the most amazing time! From the food, to the service, the beautiful beach, and the swimup bars; loved it all. Our concierge, Alvaro was very helpful in making our stay comfortable and that we had everything planned out in a timely manner. We’ll miss Wanda and Nathanael at the swimup bars, and Santo’s for making us feel so warm and welcomed at Flora (fave restaurant). Highly recommend this for an extended weekend or even a lengthy getaway from the day to day norm.

reviews.author: Carlos R.
reviews.text: We absolutely love this resort. The Drinks, food and above all the staff makes you feel welcomed. The restaurant Tokimeku is amazing. Tomas, Santos and Kendy were great. We cannot wait to come back! Our concierge Francisco V. was great as well. He helped in every way during our trip. We also loved Flora. Francheska who was our waitress, was very attentive to us during our time here. Even the bartender whos name was Diogenis Parra even took the time to show us how he made the caipirinha drink which were addicting :). The mofogo con camarones and the pulpo asado (grilled octupus) were great as well. We cannot forget about our favorite person Rosanna who even remembered us from last December 2022 and quickly came up to us and gave us a great greeting. She usually worked the buffets area and knew our morning routine.  She would have a warm smile and a clean table waiting for us. Wanda the bartender and the rest of the beach staff were great too. We usually stayed in the adult section and Rafael had a beach bed waiting for us. The entire staff from the moment you arrive is extremely pleasant and go above and beyond to make a vacation worthwhile. We are sorry we did not get everyone’s name. The only thing to say is Thank you! 5 stars all the way.

reviews.author: Sergio Garcia
reviews.text: Great experience, all around world class service. Friendly and inviting staff. Made you feel like family. Definitely would recommend. Outstanding service from Jose Rosario y Fani Tejada. La cena fue deliciosa por el Chef José Guerrero.

reviews.author: amy justice
reviews.text: Rosanna was amazing at the lunchbox buffet!!' Go see her 😉

reviews.author: d
reviews.text: I had a lovely week long vacation at paradisus palma. Everyone was very welcoming, kind, and helpful. Teofilo was amazing and brought me beverages by the pool every day. Hairon was awesome. I walked miles along the beach and the ocean in front of this resort was by far the cleanest (no seaweed). Hotel is beautiful and the pool was lovely. The food is eh, but I expect that at all inclusive. Standouts were flora and the Italian restaurant. Would come back again in a heartbeat! I don’t think it’s worth it to pay for the higher tiers, just get regular

reviews.author: Ken K
reviews.text: Great resort in the Bavaro Beach area. The beach, pools and grounds were beautiful. I wanted to give a special recognition to Patricia Garcia Aquino, who handled a number of items to make my wife’s 50th birthday very special. She worked very hard for us that was very much appreciated.

reviews.author: Tray Lavo
reviews.text: Absolutely loved this hotel. Grounds are beautiful

reviews.author: Romil Sharma
reviews.text: Harry was a great host. He made our stay great. The hotel, and pool was extraordinary. Harry wanted us to go to the club presentation and was very nice about it but I wanted to decline since we are on vacation. Thank you very much.

reviews.author: Willicey Tynes
reviews.text: I'm going to attempt to give you a very unbiased viewpoint of this resort seeing that we spent only 2days there. So first off, let me say that the hotel grounds were very, very nice with mature trees and plants. It was well manicured and well taken care of. The entrance lobby area where you drive up to was also welcoming and very nice. The open lobby/foyer gives you a direct view to the back of the hotel towards the pool and the beach. We arrived a little bit early but they did the best to try to get us into a room half hour early. After Checking in you received a colored band. Ours were green and mind you these bands are key to this review. The hotel has a concierge service program. We didn't pay for or anticipated a concierge. And no one mentioned anything about a concierge to us. But we did have one of the concierge take note of us and attempted to be of service to us. But his intent was to make sure that we sat down in front of one of their sales representative and was given a full spiel on why it makes sense to invest 26000 into one of their "lifestyle " programs. While they were trying to hold our attention, our daughter with a disability was placed in a playroom with no supervision. We were skeptical but was assured that she would be okay,  granted we could see her through the all glass panels. Shortly there after our daughter fell hitting her head against the corner wall in room. With a lobby full of workers no one rushed to assist. I grabbed my now bruised and crying daughter and told them this meeting was over. When falling or hurting herself our daughter has to be given emergency drugs to counter act the initial trauma and they initially offered medical care but no one ever followed up with me or my wife. We then attempted to have a nice family dinner ( 3 persons) at a restaurant which  has to be reserved the day before or you cannot eat at any of the restaurants despite a ton of open seating that can be seen from the outside.  So we made reservations at a steak house but was told that depsite the fact that we were at an all inclusive, only somethings are available to you. Hence the green bands.
