I would need a black, red or purple band to be treated differently and receive better amenities. Okay I get that, I have elite status with other programs but that was never explained at check-in despite me telling them that this was my family's were first time as guest at their resort. I ordered from th UIP ( unimportant people) menu and asked for a dram of Barcelo Imperial, a very mid range bottle of local rum. They told me that it was not possible to get this rum. I asked why and they said that the hotel is out of it. Really??? I just enjoyed a glass of it in the lobby a half hr before. After a number of individuals including managers got involved and nothing was produced, I left my table and headed back to the open lobby bar and had a glass produced for me. I brought it back to my dinner table and then all hell erupts with servers arguing and managers running around wondering how could this happen. My server was caught in the middle because he saw his after dinner tip evaporating due to a bit of ignorance and on the spot made up rules it would seem. I shared this experience the next day with concierge manager Ermesto who attempted a heartfelt apology and said  that really, we ( the hotel ) should be trying to win you over as a first time guest. He said he would send us something for a future stay. Yep that never happened. This absolutely soured my family's stay at this resort. So do your homework, know what you are paying for and do not expect much if you are not a preferred guest.

reviews.author: Erica Carvajal Wong
reviews.text: What a wonderful stay. Everything about our visit was excellent. Our concierge was very good and attentive.   The kidsdom room staff were great. When I left my baby, I could tell she was in good hands. Thank you to everyone on staff!

reviews.author: Hamid Z
reviews.text:
One of the best Hotels that I have ever stayed in. Mr "Jackner Gilot" the supervisor of front desk, is really professional, very nice and generous. He helped me a lot by providing an exceptional service, as well as spending lots of time offering me great deals and services. I strongly recommend this hotel to everyone, especially for families. I will certainly be coming back.
Hamid Zareian

reviews.author: Ornela Aquino
reviews.text: I had an overall amazing experience. The service was exquisite, the people are very welcoming and loving. I had a great time at Malva Restaurant. With Rosanna and Georgi every time was very pleasant. Definitely will come back.

reviews.author: Dash Guerrero
reviews.text: The Dominican restaurant, Flora, was one of the best meals at Paradisus Palma Real! The food and service were 10/10. Cesar was so kind and amazing!

reviews.author: Bethany Miller
reviews.text: This resort was by far one of the best resorts I’ve stayed in. The customer service was outstanding. The employees always had a smile on their face and were so happy to help with anything we needed. In particular, Altagracia Cruz and Luis Rosario at the Avenue Bar were absolutely exceptional! Altagracia was so friendly and very attentive. She always went above and beyond for us. I can’t say enough great things about her! We will miss her and are looking forward to seeing her and this beautiful resort next year!

reviews.author: María Cristina Vásquez Portillo
reviews.text: I took the cocktail class and it was very good! The bartender Edgar Borrero is an expert in the cocktail area and the way to explain was easy to understand to everyone! I recommend you to take this class, very interesting and fun!

reviews.author: Adri Travieso
reviews.text: Great experience. The best food was in the Mexican restaurant, my family and I really enjoyed that. Laura the waitress was really nice and the chef did a great job, the best food ever! Thank you Laura, Francis and Engel the best chefs!

reviews.author: Josh Hedge
reviews.text:
We had such an amazing welcome to our holiday by Jhon and Melvin as our bell boys. We have 6 people in our family and a ton of luggage and they took great care of us. We’ve been here a few days and they both continue to treat us like family!  Love these guys!  Thank you for the warm welcome back to our home away from home!

Hanging out at the lobby bar with Ismael, Soranxi, Olga, and Clari this morning (Ginger bar). Great cafe latte’s and frappuccino’s.  These guys are awesome!

reviews.author: Moo-Hyun Chung
reviews.text: Beautiful spot, clean beaches, great service, delicious food, solid gym, and comfty beds.

reviews.author: Bryan Ogle
reviews.text:
This trip has been amazing.  The property was recently renovated and the rooms are spectacular.  We have enjoyed the beach, pools, food, and entertainment and will return again.

Our concierge, Osvaldo, has been great making us feel welcomed and taking care of anything we have needed.  Martin has been wonderful taking care of us at the beach.

We had a great dinner tonight at Flora and Daiana Rodriguez and Franckin Franscisco Bladimir really took care of us!

reviews.author: Ashley Blakley
reviews.text: We had amazing service from Natanael and the rest of the servers at the Tiki Bar the past couple days.  They kept us entertained and and our drinks full!  We couldn’t ask for a better group to have been serving us.  We had a great time!!

reviews.author: louise ballantyne
reviews.text:
The best experience and the best honeymoon we could ask for! Stunning white beaches and clear blue sea. Service second to none! Bar staff to waiting staff to entertainment nothing was to much to ask! Food was outstanding! Fresh and well seasoned and to your tastes! Our rooms were perfect! Clean and well maintained ❤️! Osvaldo our butler  was a gem! He looked after us from beginning to end! This is the most perfect place for people looking to escape the real world into paradise
Special mention to our cheeky Chaplin Andelson. From activities - he made us smile with his charm wit and characarer! Bless you all! X

reviews.author: Kendra Tym
reviews.text: Ate at the restaurant Flora. It is an amazing Dominican Republic food restaurant for adults only. Ask your server what they recommend and you won't be disappointed.

reviews.author: Doug Reilly
reviews.text:
Traveled with a group of friends for a birthday trip and we were in the reserve (adults only) section. Honestly, the whole experience was incredible. Our concierge Alvaro made sure to get our restaurants booked and even arranged special surprises for my friends birthday. There were 3 adults only pools, one with a swim up bar where we had a great time with Natanael and received great service.

At the pool bar Wanda and Yuderi were a godsend and were always there to make sure we had drinks and were having fun. They were incredible!

The restaurants were very good. My personal favorites were the French toast at Santé for breakfast. The Italian restaurant was also pretty good, but Flora was probably the best. The Chivo Guisado was very good, but the attentive service by Santo there was even better.

Would come back.

reviews.author: Edward Farrell
reviews.text: Nathanael was our concierge and he was the best. Restaurant Sante was amazing. So good and food is amazing. Service was amazing from Eduardo and Pamela were great. Chef Rafa did a great job

reviews.author: Byron Smith
reviews.text: While at this wonderful property please visit Ismeal at the Ginger bar. Cocktail/ coffee shop which seems to be a hidden gem in the back of the lobby area. Exquisite Dominican coffee, smoothies, pastries,  etc...Ismael, Domingo and Clari took great care of us during our stay. Also please visit Laura the hostess at blue agave. She's amazing❤️

reviews.author: Travis Townsend
reviews.text: It's an absolutely beautiful resort. The rooms are very open and comfortable. Makes for a nice relaxing experience even when you're not at the pool or beach. The service is good generally, but there were a few delays in response time for making dinner reservations. The food is also pretty average, but you can find a handful of staples that are delicious and will hold you over. They have all the amenities you need with a great spa and multiple workout facilities. Recommended.

reviews.author: Beatrice Terrero
reviews.text: Loved the experience, we just a had a family reunion, loved thr environment, one of my favorite places was the Kicks Sports Bar, you cant leave the hotel without going there, thenstaff is amazing, shout out to Luis, Andreina & Fior. They were amazing. Loved the Malva Buffet got served by Maria Santana and Glennys. They helped us with all our needs at the buffet.

reviews.author: jean Pierre Fontanot
reviews.text: The hotel is overall very nice and like most all inclusive resorts, very much designed for the masses. Our experience has been dominated by a series of mishaps, since the service is far from what you expect for a hotel this category and the personnel are very poorly trained. We were all very disappointed to the point that we just ended up laughing and making their blunders part of our trip.

reviews.author: Selea Hayes
reviews.text:
Awesome location with superior service from Olga, Clari, Dominga, Madelynand Lisbeth at Ginger Bar.

Absolutely phenomenal service.  Would recommend this resort to anyone.  Harry was the best.  He took care of all of our needs and was available at all hours no matter how small.  You cannot go wrong staying here❤️🫶🏽❤️

reviews.author: Osvaldo Fuentes
reviews.text:
Ingrid was so helpful and great and our concierge cris has been great with assisting us.
Also Jorge Rafael and Martha Russel were excellent on our catamaran experience! We did yoga and had a great time!

reviews.author: Alexbabelife
reviews.text:
I’ve traveled at really nice inclusive resorts around the world, so maybe I’ve been too spoiled. I am writing this review without bias and truly based on my experience day 1 of my 5 (and I like never write 1 star reviews)

Upon check in (445pm) I was not really properly shown how to get around the resort. I wasn’t helped with how to login to wifi. I wasn’t told about when the restaurants open or how to make reservations.

My room was super hot. The AC was off, no big, I turned it on. The room has a gorgeous bath tub. Went to run myself a relaxing bath, there’s no hot water. Went to order room service, the phone doesn’t work. Someone came by asking if I needed towels and I told her about the room phone issue. She said she was calling her supervisor. It’s been 4.5 hours and he never came to check on the phone.

I was super hungry and tried to walk to a buffet because none of the restaurants opened till 6, no one who worked here seemed really interested in helping me locate the right spot. I went ahead and made a reservation at the sushi restaurant and sat around 20 minutes to wait until the restaurant opened, no big. But as I sat there, one employee busted out laughing and speaking super loud across the room to 2 other employees and finally one of them hushed her like tone it down. Once sat at my table, I was met by a waiter who poured my water and answered my questions about the menu, but he seemed to not really be sure of the answer. And later, another server came over without an introduction and stood over his shoulder criticizing his use of the iPad without introducing herself or explaining why she was there (and the whole interaction occurred in Spanish, so although I should def understand Spanish while visiting in the DR, I don’t speak the language). There just seems to be a lot of fraternizing around the resort amongst employees. Food was meh.

Came back to my room hoping to order room service bc I was still hungry from the unappetizing meal. The phone room still isn’t working. The qr code and online site won’t allow me to sign in with my last name, room #, and check out date to order room service. I walked (long walk) all the way to the front desk to ask for help with the site and my phone. They said someone would come check my room phone. It’s been an hour since he said someone would come.

After 4.5 hours of attempting to eat at this resort, there seems to be no way to order room service no matter who I’ve asked. There seems to be no buffet despite who I’ve asked. There’s nowhere to get food quickly without a sit down restaurant and I was so unhappy with the lack of experience at the sushi restaurant that I’m scared to try another.

Call me hangry. But I’m pretty calm and just thinking this day 1 experience, SUCKS. So far, 0/10 would not recommend

reviews.author: Darin Powell
reviews.text:
Very beautiful resort. Very nice rooms, great water pressure. But definitely not an all inclusive resort.  The food at the restaurants iis average to really bad.  Sante has a few good dishes and a really good breakfast.  At Flora the food is almost inedible.   Our concierge has finally managed to get us into the Italian restaurant today so we’re  cautiously optimistic.  It seems that the better dishes at the restaurants you have to pay for.  $65 dollars for a basic steak etc. We paid for the Reserve package which is supposed to b the best package but couldn’t sit in the canopy beds on the beach without paying for them lol.  At least the chairs around the pool are free.   If you have to ask staff for something b prepared to ask twice.  The answer on the first try is always “uno momento” with a smile but then they never bring u what u asked for.  A few example;  extra hangars, face cloths, water at most of the restaurants,  etc.  Very simple requests but seemingly difficult here.  I will say that the staff at Sante were great and very attentive.   Again, incredibly beautiful reseort but unfortunately lacking in almost all other areas.

A quick update.  Third day at the resort and have had to ask for washcloths every day. Today asked at 10am and got “una momenta” with a nice smile.  Asked a different housekeeper around noon and got the same answer.  Called housekeeping at 2:30pm to again asked for a few washcloths. They said they’d send them.  At 3:30pm I went looking for housekeeping headquarters to see if I could get some. No one would tell me where it was located but I ran into our concierge and he took me into the main office and found two small cloths that would work ok for a washcloth.   How freaking hard can it be to supply a washcloth??   Have made 3 calls this afternoon asking for some Corona’s and still none delivered.  This place truly doesn’t give a single damn about their guests.

Next update. We got into the Italian place last night and it was worth the wait. Great food and service. Two washcloths came in at 8pm. Things r looking up

The Reserve beach is awesome.  Absolutely beautiful   Could live the rest of my days on this stretch of beach

Conceiere Irvin just confirmed Asian for tonight so hoping it’s as good as last night.  He’s been great

reviews.author: Charles Banks
reviews.text: This place is nice. One drawback is night life plus the drinks are just ok. My advice is for them to come up with a signature drink that is both acholic and non-alcoholic that they serve 24hours a day from one Bar. Room we have is very comfortable, has a large TV, freestanding bathtub, separate shower, double sinks and a desk with 4 drawers built in. Room has a ok mini bar that they KEEP stocked even has snacks that are included in the all inclusive price. Food around the resort is not bad just nothing outside of the Lamb at the steak house really made me want to double back. Every restaurant had good food.The staff at Mascalzone were the best, Milton was in charge and our waiter was Ryder and Anna were great even got me an extra scoop of the pistachio ice cream.

reviews.author: Shelley Forwell
reviews.text: We had such a wonderful experience at Mascalzone!  The hostess Daniela was exceptional and very accommodating.  Bernabe our waiter was also excellent.  And the food was fresh and flavourful.  We highly recommend!

reviews.author: Melissa Gomez
reviews.text:
UPDATE as a response to the manager: The beach was definitely not impressive, especially with all the algae and the food was definitely horrible. They still never offered to remedy THEIR errors and lack of customer service. Thank God for American Express.

Original Review:
I am so disappointed with this hotel. It's beautiful, but lacking in service, beach wasn't great, and the food is horrible. I would recommend for anyone visiting to check out a different hotel. I had a discrepancy with the hotel because their website is confusing. I booked a 2 bedroom suite on the website. When I get to the lobby, they inform me that I had booked 2 two bedroom suites. Ultimately, I had been charged twice. Naturally, I wanted my money back for the second room since I had only reserved 1 two bedroom suite. I went thru the scenario with multiple workers -some struggle with their English, and even though I speak Spanish as well, what they were saying in Spanish didn't match what they said in English. One of the workers told me this has happened many times for them in the past. So, they did seem familiar with the discrepancies from their online booking when it comes to the 2 bedroom suites. I kept asking to speak with a manager, but there was never one on premises. Ultimately, with a lot of back and forth, the front desk staff informed me that the hotel agreed to reimburse me for the second room and told me it would come back to my card within 15-20 days. A whole month later, they never returned my money. I have now filed a dispute thru my American Express card now. Thank God for American Express.

Add insult to injury, the door to our room looked like it had been broken into, the beach was one of the worst beaches I have ever been to on the island (my family is Dominican and I visit the island multiple times a year), the food was HORRIBLE (like I couldn't digest the empanada), and the people that work there seemed to look down on me because I'm Dominican American, not a regular tourist. I've heard that this hotel was amazing in the past, but even my friends who were there with me said that the caliber of the hotel had decreased a lot within the past few years. I've stayed in numerous 5 star hotels. This is not a 5 star hotel.

Apparently, there's a difference in the type of band they give you. Red vs Green. I can tell you that the difference wasn't much and my friends who are red circle members were upset with the hotel as well. I'm for real. The food was HORRIBLE. Only thing that could be digested was if they made it in front of you like a pasta or an omelet. Further, aside from the buffet, it would take FOREVER to have food brought to our tables when we did dinnertime.

Save yourself the anguish. There are plenty of hotels on this island. This shouldn't be an option anymore. They were supposedly amazing years ago, but definitely not anymore. I was there at the end of November 2023.

reviews.author: Tamirys Hernandez
reviews.text: Outstanding. Phenomenal. We love everything the staff, rooms, pools, beach, foods and drinks are amazing. My family and I had a fabulous time. This was our third time here. Thank you Starlin Tavarez And Yaleidi Sims for contacting us we appreciate all of you help during this trip.

reviews.author: jeremia chung
reviews.text:
Ginger bar : special here, great bartenders at place & team : Ismael, Olga, Nereida & Cri served patiently & very professionally all I need for cocktails drink during days & night per entertainments. They worked precisely on every ordered items, no matter what my heart like to , however, thanks for all during my stay in 'Hotel Ginger Bar" as part of hotel services. Kisses to all here in GingerBar  Hotel guest : T.Chung Room : 4220 , surely come back again with family. Tchao:) 💕

Also a special thanks to Junior at Reception, this young guy was impatiently too as my first time lodging here in the hotel, & granted me amazing assistance to book & supplied great help in admistration etc...as a helpless Hotel guest, thanks to his support, finally I got my good rest in your hotel . A great very recommendable employee for a future promotional posted inner the hotel.group  as well. Here I expressed specially my warm hearted thanks to Junior him as well. T.Chung Hotel guest room 4220..ps. also thanks to reception, granted me a handy chargeur for further travelling use.

reviews.author: Christiane Lima
reviews.text: Flora restaurant is spectacular! Services and food is amazing!! Please check it out! Santos and Andrea are very nice people!

reviews.author: Rick
reviews.text: Kicks Sports Bar never disappoints!!! Luis the General Manager,  Fiore & Adriana have sheets treated us like family from our very first trip in 2023 which this is our third time. Love this group at Kicks!!! They are those individuals that leave long lasting imprints on our hearts 💕!!!!

reviews.author: Kirstin Pesola McEachern
reviews.text: Had a fabulous visit with family. All inclusive drinks and food, and activities galore. We loved the family photo session we did and we took aqua aerobics classes with Nixon.  The groundskeepers were so friendly, too - Guido in particular always said hello to us and helped us practice our Spanish. Great visit!

reviews.author: C. Sanh
reviews.text:
The resort is a beautiful place where we can have a great vacation, specially in front of the Caribbean beach.

All the days at the beach, we stayed at the Bali experience in front of the beach and the attendant Loyda offered a fantastic service all the time. She was the best attendant that gave us a fantastic service and experience during our stay. I recommend this experience and especially Loyda services.

reviews.author: Mrudula P
reviews.text: First of all the staff were great and the location was perfect too. That is all that is going for this place. The rooms are bad, smelly and outdated. First thing you see when entering to your qaurters is the garbage. We booked a luxury suite and when we got there , the front desk said that they didn't have any available. So we had to be downgraded to a normal room. It was just not us, many families were having the same argument/discussion there. The hotel was definitely not well prepared for their bookings. Breakfast was decent and that's it. Lunch is passable. Except for the Italian restaurant all the others can be avoided. This was the first time I had a bad experience while booking my vacation from Costco. We always look at Costco travel first since I trust them . Going forward, I plan to be cautious and careful.

reviews.author: Jennifer Mak
reviews.text:
This was our second stay at Paradisus Palma Real and it was a wonderful stay. Our concierge Zenovia was great - she was extremely friendly and helpful.

The food was excellent, especially the passion fruit mamajuana drink recommended by Wilhima at Mascalzone.

The food and service at Flora (Santos was great) was excellent. It has such a great ambiance to it with the trees and the lights by the tables.

Pedro at the Reserve beach was excellent and friendly.

The grounds are beautiful - green and lush. The beach and pool was also great - not too busy yet not too quiet.

reviews.author: Cindy Maulick
reviews.text:
Our 13th visit to this resort, our home away from home
Rosanna, yanira,, Luis Diaz, Victor, Quintino, Antonio Ramirez, Jonathan, Edyy Jesus, Teofino, Gilberto Mejia, Martin, Wanda from the Wanda bar, Gladys, Dorka, Carina and many more
Dinner at Mascalzone was great. Yuleni, Yeensen, Milton and all the staff were excelente. Chef Tojeilin prepared our meal which was superb. We will come again next time we are here for sure.

reviews.author: Christian campanile
reviews.text: Ernesto was out concierge, he was amazing helped us with all our reservations as well as excursions. Jose was exceptional by the pool service wise. Everything was amazing would come back again 10/10!!

reviews.author: Christy Stiefel
reviews.text: The Italian restaurant took great care with our dinning experience. Ana and Yeensen and Daniela were very attentive and served us some wonderful food. Definitely a must.

reviews.author: Tom Gerstmyer
reviews.text:
Love this Resort!
Very nice accommodations, overall good food and friendly service. Language is a big of a barrier for non Spanish speaking Americans.
Biggest negative is their included wines are VERY low end! Their Virtuoso Cabernet Sauvignon is literally not drinkable. Their other wine is Fontera, not good but drinkable. At least two of the restaurants only have Virtuoso, including the steak house which does not even offer a Cab!
Good food with bad wine doesn’t work well!

reviews.author: Agustina Senger
reviews.text:
We had a wonderful experience!
Our concierge, Lewis, took care of us in the most attentive way. He made reservations to have dinner at every place we wanted and was undoubtedly the best host we could get!
Can’t wait to come back!

reviews.author: Gene Potempa
reviews.text: Milton the manager went out of his way to get us reservations at the Italian restaurant. Our servers, yessica and Wilmina were very helpful. The food and service was great. Much appreciation.

reviews.author: Rima Gniewek
reviews.text: Guerillmo made our experience very satisfying and was very helpful our entire stay at Palma Real we will definitely be back

reviews.author: Cheryl Choquette
reviews.text: Ramon Rivas was so amazing and very attentive! He made our days on the beach so enjoyable and relaxing. I’m beyond thankful for Ramon, he took our vacation to the next level! Thank you, Ramon, for taking such great care of us!

reviews.author: Heather Schroeder
reviews.text: We had an amazing time at Paradisus Palma Real. We are circle black members and really enjoyed having meals at Brisas.  The food was delicious but the service is what sets it apart. Jose Ramos and Rosanny Paniagua took care of us every day and were kind and very attentive to our group of 12. We could not have asked for two more amazing people. Thank you so much for taking care of us every day!  Sometimes twice a day!

reviews.author: Holly Romey
reviews.text: The food is inedible. 6 people in our group got food poisoning. This place is just a pretty picture. Our room keys didn’t work. Service was rude unless they wanted a review. People on beach are pushy. Oh, and be careful not to get locked out on your balcony.

reviews.author: carlos santos
reviews.text:
The hotel is amazing. 5 starts to Ginger Bar!! Antonio, Natanael, Clari, Olga, and Magda are outstanding.  You guys are awesome and provide an incredible experience! Thank you all to make Ginger Bar the best place at the hotel!!
The KIDS place is the best service ever!!!

reviews.author: Michelle Pettrey
reviews.text: The service at this resort is exceptional! Wanda, Yuderi, Martin and Rafael at the pool and beach bars go above and beyond to make your stay amazing! Franklin at Sante restaurant also provided excellent service with a smile! Juan, our Concierge, checked in with us daily to make sure we had everything we needed during our stay! Vincente at the Rum bar made fabulous drinks and was so fun! The staff at this resort  is impeccable!

reviews.author: Dale Loyd
reviews.text: Melgui, server at blue agavi was outstanding!

reviews.author: fatiha mecili
reviews.text: Great, I love it the hat Workshop thanks to Jorge ,Mabi and Estefani. The food was amazing daiana Rodriguez and leuris were so kind and made our stay so memorable! They were able to make a last minute celebration for my daughter’s birthday. The service here is outstanding!

reviews.author: Doramy Proctor
reviews.text: I loved every minute of it! Everyone was so friendly and welcoming.  Amenities and services were excellent. All the staff were amazing, shout outs to Ismael, Leticia, Walmidia,Merlin and Criseida for taking such great care of the guests.

reviews.author: INGA DAINIUS
reviews.text:
I am writing to share my recent experience at Paradisus Palma Real Resort in Punta Cana, booked through Apple Vacations, and to express my disappointment with several aspects of our stay.
While the exterior of the resort is undoubtedly impressive, the discrepancies between what was advertised and the reality inside were stark. Our family of two adults and two children encountered numerous issues throughout our five-night stay that significantly impacted our overall enjoyment.
Firstly, despite the resort boasting 16 restaurants and 12 pools on its website, only a limited number of these were accessible to families like ours. Many were reserved exclusively for adults or circle membership tiers, which was not clearly communicated beforehand. Additionally, the level of inclusivity varied, with certain amenities and menu items requiring additional payment beyond what we had initially expected.
Moreover, we were disappointed by the lack of communication from the concierge regarding scheduled events or family-friendly activities during our stay, leaving us feeling uninformed and underwhelmed.
Specific incidents during our stay further compounded our dissatisfaction. Our initial room booking was not honored upon check-in, and while a suitable alternative was eventually provided, it came at an additional cost. The condition of the room itself left much to be desired, with maintenance issues ranging from loose fixtures to a persistent foul odor and even a concerning encounter with a cockroach.
Furthermore, mishandling of our luggage resulted in the loss of a sentimental item, despite repeated attempts to rectify the situation with the concierge.
The dining experience was similarly disappointing, with limited options for reservations, lengthy wait times, and subpar food quality across various cuisines. Hygiene standards also fell short, with instances of dirty dishware and inadequate cleaning of utensils.
Additionally, the resort's amenities such as poolside supplies were overpriced, and inadequate protection against mosquitoes left us with numerous bites.

reviews.author: Gladys Diaz
reviews.text: Danyelo it's a great addition to this resort his energy and courtesy was a great highlight to the nightlife. He was respectful and let's not forget he has great dance moves. Danyelo thank you for making our stay pleasant and for being such a beam of energy

reviews.author: Britnee O'Dell
reviews.text: Sanyi was our server at the Mexican restaurant and we absolutely loved her! Very kind and attentive. 100% recommend and the food is DELICIOUS! MUST TRY! Food, drinks the ambiance! Everything! Promise, you will not be disappointed

reviews.author: Darlene Gilbert
reviews.text:
My husband and I traveled with a large group last week.  There were 16 of us total and we all had a great time.  Our concierge was Nikolas and he was amazing!!  He took care of all of us even though he was not the concierge for the entire group.  He made a point to check on us daily making sure everyone's needs were met.  When I needed a bathrobe or wash cloth all I had to do was tell Nikolas and the next time we were in the room, they were there.  He was able to get us in restaurants most nights.  He also booked our excursions for us.  We enjoyed his jokes and special attention.  He is very good at what he does and the Paradisus is lucky to have him.
The restaurant, The Winery, was very nice but you need to purchase a bottle of wine to go.  Not a problem, as we were told that ahead of time.  Great food at all the restaurants.  The buffet was plentiful with many options for all nationalities.  It was required to wear a mask in the buffet still but that I appreciated.
Our room was huge!  We had an Ocean front Junior Suite at the Reserve and the view was beautiful.  On our last night we came into a beautiful bath drawn with chocolates!
My husband and I took advantage of the Spa and enjoyed a couples massage.  The spa was so calming.
The adult pool and private bar was a great place to hang for the day.  Wanda, the bartender, worked very hard while our group was there.  Ha, Ha!  Our large group for most would have been tough to handle but she rocked it!  She never stopped moving and always worked hard!
Covid test process was seamless!
This resort is gorgeous in the day and night.  We would definitely stay at this resort again!
Geno and Darlene

reviews.author: Marty Rjo
reviews.text: As I sit here at Mascazone  restaurant at Paradiscus Palma Real, I can’t wait to commend Milton and Ana on great service, very professional and pleasant, actually all restaurants at this resort  have the best staff ever and I say that with all sincerity coming from NY, kudos to Paradiscus Resort,

reviews.author: Elias Sanchez
reviews.text: I continue to give credit where credit is due.  Jose Ramirez, Pedro Reyes and Starlin Tavarez was extremely helpful from the moment I arrived assisting us with our luggage to guiding us to where to pick up souvenirs for the best price and ensuring our stay would the most pleasurable experience. I have enjoyed my trip so much I’m already planning for the return trip.

reviews.author: Pat N
reviews.text:
Honestly can’t think of any complaints. Everything was perfect. The beach was excellent, the food was excellent, the resort itself was beautiful, and the staff were very welcoming. Would recommend this resort to anyone looking for a relaxing week off.

P.S. Shoutout to Milton and his staff at the Italian restaurant.

reviews.author: Donna Farwell
reviews.text: Blue Agave was awesome. Great service and great food. Delvin was the best and so was Laura getting us in on such short notice.

reviews.author: Fiona Hsiung
reviews.text:
We just finished a trip to Paradisus Palma Real with our family.

Shoutouts to Yaleidi, our conceirge for her excellent service. She helped us book our a la cartes for us and our extended family. I know how tough it was to get spots for a big group.

Olivi, Jorgi, Alexander , Yeison, Milkian Jean, Rafael, Kendric, Yorgelys, Editos, at The Lunch Box, Blue Agave, and the Asian and Italian a la cartes ( sorry forgot the restaurant names) for their excellent service.

Last but not least shoutout to all the staff at Kidsdom for their wonderful care and thoughtfulness of activities for my daughter. Thank you Janilda, Martha, Sujeidy, Johanna, Tinia, just to name a few. You truly made my daughters first to Dominican unforgettable.

reviews.author: Akyka Taylor
reviews.text:
Our stay here was very pleasant.
Transportation: you have to arrange your own transfer to and from the airport. The arrival however was nice. We were greeted with warm towels and escorted to the concierge office for check in. We did receive the incorrect room initially but hector/Diana was able to get us switched to another suite comparable to what we booked.

Amenities: this resort is not a party type of resort. It’s very quiet but they do have daily and nightly entertainment. The Gin Ger bar is the best. Luis made us the best drinks.

Food: The overall staff was always helpful and cheerful. All of the restaurants had great food but two stood out the most, the Sante for breakfast and the Tokimeku, it’s Japanese hibachi style for dinner. The buffet style The Lunchbox was okay, we preferred to eat lunch on the beach at the Kana.

Franklin, Sunirda, Diana, Bernabe, Juan, Marta and Luis were all 10/10. Anything we needed they provided a solution. If we ever decided to visit DR again this resort would be at the top of our list.

reviews.author: Maria Vinas
reviews.text:
It’s been a lovely experience. The service is outstanding and everyone caters to your needs!
Shout especially to Jose and Luis!! They are super nice and enjoy what they do!  Thank you!
I recommend coming as soon as possible!
Also, go to the Kids Club!  The staff was so wonderful.
Johana, Sujeidy, Yesmeily, Rosa, Martha they are the Best!  My granddaughter and grandson did not want to leave.  Exceptional ladies!!! So much love all of them.  Take your children to the kids club! ❤️❤️

reviews.author: Todd Murray
reviews.text: We stayed @ PR Building 9 (Swim Out) which was super new, clean and close to the beach. The staff were all friendly including our excellent host Mack who was proactive and helpful when needed but not overbearing. Buffet food was good enough but the various a la cartes were better. The only challenge we found was, at times, moving between the various Melia properties which are adjoining and appear very similar in nature. Beach vendors were also a touch annoying.  All things considered we will return again.

reviews.author: Shelli Erck
reviews.text:
Mina Steakhouse is fabulous! Food was good. Service was great!  Leudy Jimenez Franklin Diaz and especially Yuderqui was so fun!

Italian food was yummy! Yessica and Willmina were wonderful servers!! The best! The manager was extremely attentive.  We appreciated them!!

reviews.author: Siegfried Löffler
reviews.text: We had a great sales kickoff meeting, spent 4 days here, the staff is amazing, the food is excellent. The colors of the beach sea and pool are just incredible A special thank you to Altagracia Cruz for the very nice cocktails in the Sports Bar!

reviews.author: Luis Gonzalez
reviews.text: Honestly this resort was amazing we stayed at the paradises Palma real and the service was outstanding you were always attended and was super nice. The buffet was really good and Maria was the best she was attentive and super fun she was the highlight of our trip thank you Maria for everything u did and the fun time you gave us

reviews.author: Kareen Kien
reviews.text: Our first time at Paradisus and it was fantastic. The service was amazing, especially from Luciano, Melvin, Jhon! Olvi was one of our favorite waiters, super accommodating. If you want a place to relax and enjoy your days by the pool/beach, this is the perfect place:)

reviews.author: J K
reviews.text: The Reserve area is great for an adults-only trip! Sante is the best restaurant on the resort and exclusive to Reserve guests. Rafael was attentive and friendly, and made sure our preferred Balibeds and cabanas were ready every morning during our stay! 10/10 look out for him when you visit this property.

reviews.author: Stacy Pascale
reviews.text: We had dinner at Flora our second night at the resort and the food was amazing! The only thing better than the food was the service by Molina!!! She went above and beyond to make sure we had a great dinner…thank you!

reviews.author: Kwame Dix
reviews.text: Sujeidy, Janilda, and Yasmeidy were amazingly friendly to my family and I. They had activities for the kids, and one that my daughter went towards was painting. Overall, everyone was very friendly and patient if there were words or phrases in Spanish that we weren't familiar with. It's rare that I have the thoughts to visit a place again, yet those thoughts were definitely in my mind while there.

reviews.author: Ms T
reviews.text: This place is an excellent choice for stay in Punta Cana, DR. From the time we arrived until we departed, service was exquisite and punctual. The rooms were very nice and the property clean. Every detail is well thought out to make for a perfect stay. Job well done. Will recommend and will return. Thanks

reviews.author: Sha Ahmed
reviews.text:
This was our second time here, we had an amazing time here the first time around so we brought a bigger group. The food quality from the last time has gone down a little bit. Then my brother's room key kept on stopping to work everyday and their WiFi was slow but no problem with our rooms. The food reservation were not letting us in because they had big groups staying with them but after speaking to the manager we were able to try rare, aqua and another sea food place. Pool and the beaches are still amazing so is most of the staff.

Go see my man Israel at guest services and Mary Ala . They both were super helpful.

reviews.author: Sonia Spruill
reviews.text: The Blue Agave restaurant was awesome. Ulise Pacheco was so professional. The service was great the tacos, drinks and churros was amazing. Kudos to the manager Andino. His restaurant was well managed and the food was served timely and well prepared. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Gavin Cercek
reviews.text: I did a Margarita making class and had a fantastic experience with Engel, and Hairon. We had amazing classically made cerviche and a margarita with local tequila. Our experience was greatly improved by the smiles on everyone’s faces taking pride in sharing about their culture!

reviews.author: Vivianna Jugo
reviews.text: Food at Sante was great. Surprised for an all inclusive with octopus and seafood. Our Camareros Eduardo, Amanda, Saudy and Jose were great. First night here and food and good and the vibes here are so relaxing and amazing. Looking forward to our next few days here! The service at the beach has been amazing Pedro, Rafael, Manuela y Isais are amazing! Derny and Juan at the Rum Republic are our favorites for drinks!

reviews.author: Carmen Reyes
reviews.text: Once again Sante did not disappoint! This time around we had lunch and it was amazing. This is the only restaurant at the resort where the food actually comes out HOT!  Please do try the Salmon, Rice and Shrimp and if you are on the mood for a hamburger, this is the spot to be. The icing on the cake was the great service by Estabanni Carabello, Luz Villa, Juan Torres, and Milton Perez! They were attentive and made sure we had everything we needed throughout our entire meal which made it much more enjoyable! This restaurant is the place to be. Enjoy!

reviews.author: Mary Henderson
reviews.text:
Everyone at the ginger bar is fantastic! Great service, fun and friendly. Felt like I was leaving my family when we left.
Ismael, Antonio, Dominga, Criseyda and Nereida are all great!

reviews.author: Carlette Adams
reviews.text:
My husband and I had an amazing vacation, as always at Palma Real. Thank you so much to my amazing concierge, Anayely Rivera, for making us feel welcomed from the first day, making sure we had to worry for nothing, just enjoy. We truly appreciated Anayely, she’s the best, and we will ask for her always. Thank you again😎.

Also, a special thank you to Cleyvix De la Rosa, who we met when checking in. We truly thank you for taking care of us when first arriving and checking on us throughout our trip🥰

All the restaurants are amazing, but our last night was at Mascalzone, Italian. We truly enjoyed our dinner, and meeting our waiter Bernabe Guillen, what a delightful young man. All his recommendations were delish. The manager that night, Milton, checked on us throughout our dinner making sure our last night was special. We thank you all, and look forward to seeing you again!

reviews.author: Jennifer Thompson
reviews.text:
Everything is amazing.  Staff are very friendly and always polite. Rooms are recently renovated  and very upscale.
The two things that can be improved are the tiered  system that took us half our stay to figure out and the dinner reservation process.

reviews.author: Becky Burnett
reviews.text:
Beautiful resort snd great service.  Our concierge, Eriol was fantastic.  He contacted us throughout the day to see if we needed help with anything, made reservations for dinner each night and got our room changed to a ground floor.
Our pool bartender Wanda was also the best!  If you're in the adults only section make sure to bisit her.

reviews.author: Kylee Spicer
reviews.text:
We stayed at this property for 6 nights in November of 2023.

Resort Grounds:
The property itself is stunning. Spacious grounds with beautiful landscaping. Clean, comfortable, updated rooms. Comfortable pool & beach loungers. The in-room mini bar with snacks was always kept restocked. Also, the light switch to notify housekeeping the room is available to be cleaned is so clever!

Eriol was our concierge and he went above and beyond for us. He made sure to help us celebrate some birthdays in our group in really special ways.

Food:
The food across all the restaurants is presented beautifully. They really try to make it look like 5 star quality. However the taste never matched the looks. We are not a group of picky eaters by any means, but something was almost always missing in terms of flavor. And often, the description of the menu items either gets lost in translation or is just completely wrong. We never quite figured that part out, so we usually just laughed it off and ate it regardless to not be wasteful. But it's worth noting because I think if you're someone with strict food allergies it could get tricky. Still, there were plenty of options so you could get the job done and enjoy the meal. None of us went hungry.

Flora was the best restaurant we had for dinner. Santé was only good at breakfast or lunch, somehow the dinner menu was not enjoyable.

Drinks:
Drinks were good, plenty of options and the bartenders are all friendly and willing to make you whatever you want. Definitely a noticeable quality difference from the Reserve bars compared to the non-reserve bars. So, we typically stuck to only the Reserve side of the property once we realized the difference. The only exception to that was the Ginger Bar in the hotel lobby. Far and away they were the most consistent and quality in their presentations. The only downside is they are so far from the pools and beach, that we only got those drinks before/after dinner.

Wanda at the Reserve bar by the pool closest to the beach made the best drinks. She is just lovely and was the gold standard for all the drinks we had that week. Yeison and Rafael at the beach were very attentive and helpful to keeping our drinks refreshed and getting towels if we needed them.

Overall Impressions:
It is clear the Melia management places HEAVY pressure on employees to get guests to write reviews, with specific mention of the employee name. I do not fault any of the employees for this pressure, but I do blame management and the obvious stress it puts the employees under. This stress is then passed (unintentionally) to the guest, as it was to us for most of our trip.

It was almost every dinner that a restaurant manager would ask us to scan their QR code to write a review, and this was while we were still eating our meal. They were polite, but regardless, it was off-putting. Especially when you have already spent all day being approached by vendors on the beach and around the hotel property. And I do mean, all day. It is constant. A constant barrage of vendors approaching you.

Thankfully the interactions can usually be kept brief, but it is no exaggeration to say we were approached a minimum of 8-10 times per hour by different people trying to sell us something. The beach is the worst, sure, but you only get a slight break while around the pools as the hotel management has their own group of employees asking if you want to go on an excursion. Yes, there are much fewer of them around the hotel than compared to the beach but it was seriously too much. It got to the point that it felt like we couldn't find peace anywhere around the property except for our room. What a bummer.

We will not return to any Melia property, or the Dominican Republic because of the amount of pressure and interruptions we faced. We prefer to be able to relax on our vacations. We have been to more than a dozen destinations all around the Caribbean, some high-end and luxury, some not. But never have we felt anything close to the pressure we faced while staying at the Paradisus Palma Real.

reviews.author: Peter Cover
reviews.text:
It was a pleasure to have Ernesto Guerrero as our consierge. He was very attentive to our needs and followed through with his commitments. He addressed and escalated issues to the right people so they could get resolved. His daily follow-ups to ensure all was well was very well received by us. Ernesto is a very knowledgeable and honest person. He deserves high praise for his thorough and dedicated work to ensure his guests are happy and enjoying themselves. Ernesto is a super-star and deserves a 10 out of 10!
Good work Ernesto… it was a pleasure dealing with you .

reviews.author: Susan devere
reviews.text:
Paradisus Palma Real Golf Resort
Our favourite place in this relaxing, comfortable resort is GINGER!   Here you will find welcoming, friendly and attentive staff including Antonio and Ismael who will provide you with probably the best cappuccino  in the Caribbean.  We make several visits here during the day and enjoy the evening’s entertainment with coffee cocktails 🍸 or smoothies!
M and P

If you want a genuine Italian experience visit MASCALZONE Restaurant in Paradisus Palma Real Golf Resort.  My spouse and I have just dined at this restaurant for the third time during our vacation.  Tonight was especially good.  Excellent, friendly, professional attendance from Yeensen and Reynaldo. We have noted thoughtful and expert overseeing of service by Milton on each of our three dining experiences.  Thank you, everyone!

reviews.author: Oddette Roman
reviews.text: This hotel is beautiful but i have to say their service isn’t the greatest. I stayed at this resort back in May for my Indian friend’s wedding, I did my reservation in December of 2023 and they proceeded the payment for it a month before my stay (April 7th) which was explained on the policy and was totally fine, however when i arrived at the resort on May 7th i didn’t have the card i used to make the reservation physically on me and they made me give a new card and charged me AGAIN saying it was a mandatory policy or else they were not gonna be able to give me a room?? And that i was going to be automatically refunded within 2 weeks.. Makes no sense but whatever i had no choice but to do it… I ended up having to dispute it with my bank showing proof of the double charge on 2 different bank accounts, the hotel has not given me nor the bank a response and it has now been 4 months with no answer and no refund!!! That’s called stealing !!

reviews.author: Lisa Halloran
reviews.text:
The kids club ladies are the best thing about this resort! Sujeidy, Alexandra, Martha, Tania, Joana, Jesica and Janilda were so good with our kids and the only area of the resort that we felt provided 5 star service. They are phenomena and engaged our kids in a caring and fun way. My kids never wanted to leave kids club! They work so hard and put so much energy into their jobs. Can’t thank them enough.

The rest of the resort left alot to be desired. Front desk staff were inefficient and gave confusing and contradictory information. We had to fight for 5 hours to get the sofa bed made up, our concierge was absent and useless, you’d ask staff for something and they’d never follow through. We won’t be back and it’s such a shame cause the kids club is the best of any AI we’ve ever been to. The rest of the resort needs to get up to kids club standards.

reviews.author: Lisa Ditz
reviews.text:
Here with my daughter celebrating her 50th birthday. Had a great time. I plan to return with my husband. We are going to need Basilio and Martin when we return.  Thanks see you soon.
Alethea D.

reviews.author: Vanessa Esquijarosa
reviews.text: for my first time staying at the resort it has been a pleasant experience! great live music, amazing food, and great service as well! thank you for jordania service being so excellent, and the amazing ginger bar!

reviews.author: Richard Elwood
reviews.text: First time here and the resort exceeded our expectations in every regard especially the beautiful landscaping and the forum. Ariel was excellent in providing information and reservations. He also provided in room amenities such as bubble bath prep. With candles and white wine. Overall a great experience and we will be back. Loved the Royal Service area.

reviews.author: Ivee Donnell
reviews.text: Daysi Gonzalez was the front desk reception that helped us check in. She was the highlight of the trip! She was very knowledgeable, kind, and went the extra mile to help us out! She made us feel special and taken care of even though I know she had a ton of other people to support. She was in contact with us the entire trip and made sure we were able to have the best vacation. Give that girl a raise!

reviews.author: Alex Durham
reviews.text:
A great week! The food, service and atmosphere all made for a great time! Our concierge, Lewis, was extremely helpful in every aspect and we had constant communication and saw him everyday! Raule was very attentive in taking care of us at the Circle members beach area everyday with a cold bucket of Presidentes and other frozen drinks! Enjoyed all of our meals as we ate at every restaurant within the resort. Look forward to coming back.

I can’t recall all of the wait staff by name but everywhere had delicious food, great atmosphere and wonderful service! Vladimir, Eduardo, Hilenne, Saudys, Jose, and Felix to name a few took great care of us!

reviews.author: Kate Beardsley
reviews.text: Flora restaurant and the team there were amazing. The authentic food from the D Mar was so tasty and the best dinner of our vacation!

reviews.author: Jill Johnson
reviews.text:
Luciana in the Linch Box took great care of us!

Edgar and.Brandol at the Rum Tasting were fun and friendly and we learned all about rum making (and tasting!) 😁

Roberto was our waiter in Mina and Malva at different times and did a great job.

reviews.author: Christina Ting
reviews.text: Rosanna Yuderqi yorgelis Ricki was an amazing waitresss at the Lunch Box! She was attentive and very helpful with my son. She made our experience during meals fantastic. The resort is lucky to have Rosanna as a staff memeber.

reviews.author: Joyce Johnson
reviews.text:
Andrea Santana was our fabulous server at flora  restaurant . We tried some great dishes from the Dominican .  the monfongo was excellent!!! And I tried the octopus.

Felix Celeste yeensen (Anna) we had a great Italian dinner tonight I had a special order for gluten free pasta and they made it delicious for me with olive oil and Parmesano cheese!
Also the pizza was delicious and the lasagna.

reviews.author: Breanna O
reviews.text: Kicks is our favorite place to hangout! Great service!

reviews.author: Anne Hildebrand
reviews.text: Paradisus Palma Real was AMAZING!  Our room was perfect, amenities were beyond expectations and staff was phenomenal.  I had heard mixed reviews, but I assure you, all is up to date now.  Probably the best all-inclusive ice ever stayed at.  The layout is easy and makes sense.  Pool bar was great…Gerinaldo made amazing Painkillers!  They are THE TASTIEST tropical cocktail.  Altagracia Cruz, at Kicks Sports Bar….loved her! Super attentive, always greeted us with smiles…we went back often just to see her friendly face and be waited on in a timely fashion.  Don’t miss out and don’t hesitate to book!

reviews.author: Courteney Rodman
reviews.text: We traveled as a family of 5 for the first time to the Dominican Republic.  We loved it  and and will be back!  Our concierge was Alejandro Gomez.  He was out of this world!  My boys celebrated birthdays while we were away and Alejandro made it so special for them.  The best concierge by far!

reviews.author: Brenda Metts
reviews.text: Emmanuel Bautista was great! Wonderful vacation! Home away from home! ❤️. We had dinner at The Winery and it was wonderful! Intimate setting, wonderful wine and you have options on the food which was cool. Our service by  Maximus and Jaun was the best!

reviews.author: W Schneider
reviews.text: Blue Agava: It took 1:20 to get our food after we ordered. They only had one cook making the food. It was good though when it finally came.

reviews.author: Gail Malamut
reviews.text: Lewis de la Cruz was my concierge for the last 14 days of my stay here a Palma Real, and he was not supposed to be my concierge. I was very frustrated upon my arrival because my concierge was not available and we had difficulties with the concierge so I went up to the Palma real  Office and was rescued by Louis. He just adopted us here with two other friends and he adopted the three of us and just took over every step of our vacation. He knew what we needed before we even know what we needed, and I’ve never met anyone more special, more, authentic, more compassionate  Kinder, and such a gentleman than him. I feel that whoever is listening to this or reading it should know this, and understand that he is an asset to your corporation, and I feel that he should be acknowledged by raising him to the sky, because our vacation would not have been what it turned out to be because of him . He should be elevated to the guest experience manager position as soon as possible as it would help your corporation immensely. . He is the most special asset, and gentleman that you have in your cooperation.

reviews.author: Alondra Ramirez
reviews.text: We had an amazing time at this resort. We specially had a great service at the Celsius pool bar. The customer service was phenomenal from Victor, Mario, Jonathan and Luis. Highly recommend this place! At night we headed to Ginger bar and the service was top notch also. We were helped by Luis and Yiri, Luis desa and Walkiria. Run don’t walk to book this resort.

reviews.author: Sarah Walsh
reviews.text: Awesome time! Bartenders were amazing :) ask for Angelo at the bar and Yuderi at the beach! Will definitely be back.

reviews.author: Tetyana Pasulo
reviews.text: Gin ger bar made my stay unforgettable. Ismael, Olga, Clari and few more of the crew were outstanding. Having Italian roots and taste of great espresso, this bar was where majority of my time was spent. 😍

reviews.author: Jill Smiley
reviews.text: We had an amazing week with my large family - 27 of us! Eriol, our concierge, was especially helpful. We were able to contact him through WhatsApp for urgent needs, and he was always checking on us in person too. The grounds are beautiful with tons of food options. Every day, there was a new activity for the kids to try.  There was so much more to explore if we had the time. Eriol sent us the happenings every morning, so we didn’t need to go digging for information. When we were having trouble communicating about one of my children’s food, allergies, he made a card in Spanish for us to show it all of the restaurants. It was very helpful. We will definitely be back!

reviews.author: Brian Ortega
reviews.text: Amazing resort with great service all around. Arisleida and Pedro at the beach made the trip with their care and making sure we were always taken care of. The food and service  at the restaurants especially Flora were top notch and very accommodating.

reviews.author: Chelsea Wray
reviews.text: We have loved the resort so much!!! And the Italian place is sooo good! Our waiter Raider was very attentive and nice! The food was delicious and my wine glass was never empty! We loved the atmosphere as well!

reviews.author: Anujan Navaneshan
reviews.text: This was a wonderful resort to stay at with great food, service, and hospitality in general. Loved being here for the duration of my vacation. Really appreciated the service provided by Virginia, Milton, Raider, and Julia as they were excellent in making sure my family and I were satisfied with the services provided.

reviews.author: Kish Raveendran
reviews.text: Absolutely best guys!  I will be here again and again Luis volori is the best. Please go to GijGei bar and he will make the best spicy margarita.

reviews.author: Kerry-Ann Duberry
reviews.text: Hotel was beautiful, My concierge Ariel was so helpful took care of everything for me down to my restaurant reservations. Hotel does need more entertainment at night especially it being a family resort, after awhile my kids were bored. Please check out the Steakhouse amazing food and my kids loved the buffet, so many options. Other restaurants were just blahh.

reviews.author: Joseph Vernice
reviews.text: We came to Sante restaurant. We had an absolutely amazing dinner. Our waiter Stormin, Norman, his manager Andino and waitress Amanda and Jose  gave unbelievable service. The team was courteous, friendly, knowledgeable, and professional. Everything was great !!!!

reviews.author: John Z
reviews.text:
Fantastic experience at the Paradisus Palma real!

A few standout employees we’d like to mention
-
Ariel our butler did a fantastic job and took wonderful care of us! We’d highly recommend requesting Ariel if you can.

Lee our bartender at the royal service and pool bar was fantastic. Really great guy and does a great job.

Robert at the Avenue bar in the bottom of the lobby was also a top notch guy and great bartender.

Pedro, Luis, and Martin worked out by the pool and ocean every day and took excellent care of us.  Thank you guys!

Teddy (sp) at the red room disco was tons of fun and great to hang out with.  He kept the drinks flowing and we had a lot of fun.

Thanks Paradisus!

reviews.author: Akash Kadakia
reviews.text: Hector Hernandez, what is there not to say about this man. He knows I’m his way around both a conversion and an excellent cocktail. In fact, he even helped develop my Spanish speaking skills three fold in such a short amount of time knowing him. Highly recommend his services and the hotel as a whole just because of this man.

reviews.author: Rosita Lugo
reviews.text:
Restaurants Sante
Capitan: Eduardo, Felix
Hostess: Estebanni
Camareros: Franklin, Luz, Jean, Fausto, Juan.
Everyone greets us with a beautiful smile, always attentive to our needs. The food and service are great. I would totally recommend this resort.

The service by the beach was amazing thank you to Martin. He knew our names and always greeted us with a smile

I want to especially thank our concierge Edgar for making my birthday special, I had a birthday cake, wine flowers and balloons in my room. Our vacation stay was special because of Edgar. Thank you again 🥰🙏🏻

reviews.author: Nic Rogers
reviews.text: We had a short stay at this property but Paradisus is paradise! Our butler, Miguelito, went above and beyond to make sure my kids and I had an amazing stay! The kids said it was the best hotel ever! Would definitely recommend this property for families and people traveling without kids!

reviews.author: Jon Ackerley
reviews.text: Ismael, Dominga, Yenifer, Olga, Clary, Cris, and Nereyda at the Ginger Bar were SO AMAZING! They served the best coffee and cocktails at the entire resort. This is a must-see location at Paradisus Palma Real. Thank you!

reviews.author: Augusto Hurtado
reviews.text: Chef Rafael Marte and Jose de Rosario were amazing. We had a great time and the kids enjoy all the tricks while preparing the food. Delicious food and a great company.

reviews.author: Tatsiana Melnikova
reviews.text:
Staying at the Palma Real at the moment ,came here for the Members Fest, the celebration Club Melia organized for the members.
It has its ups and downs, but overall, we glad we came. Been here several times already, and have to say that after the renovation the hotel looks so much better!Lots of gastronomic choices, clean territory, nice beach, good service everywhere.  But this is our concierge who deserves a special thanks! Been with Melia for over 12 years, we had a lot of butlers and concierges, sometimes good sometimes not so much- wished we didn't have them at all. So, all that said, we have to say thanks to the hotel for assigning us Edgar Ridriguez. Great help! Very professional, polite, knowledgeable, always in a good mood! He's been so patient with us, always there to help. You have a question, he's got the answer! Made us feel very welcomed and very comfortable. Thank you, Edgar for everything!

reviews.author: Alexandre Santos
reviews.text:
I had such a great experience at the hotel in the first 4 days.  All the employees are great, very courteous and super friendly.  Called my attention the services in the pool and specially by the beach, where they exceeded my expectations. In the 5 th day though the room was not cleaned.  On 6th day we were awake at 7:30 am with a loud music.  It was a group doing gym!  Hotel should have done better managing that.
I also think they need to work on the “adults only” section, where some parents keeps taking kids to be there, and if you chose that is cause you dont want it…

reviews.author: Chris Shaffer
reviews.text:
Beautiful hotel.  Good food.  Great pools (a lot of them).

If you get a chance for a butler - ask for Fernando.  He made our trip spectacular and took care of our every need, even when he was technically off the clock.

reviews.author: Samuel Titus
reviews.text: Flora restaurant. Eduardo, Melina, Naomi were very helpful, accommodating, and professional.  Food was delicious! Great place! Celsius bar: Olga, Victor, Johnathan, Quintino  are very professional, helpful, and nice. We really appreciate them!! At the Lunch Box, Yantra Sosa and Yafreisi Soler both are awesome, very nice, attentive, professional. We appreciate them! The Bellboys, Miguel and Lennison were excellent!! They were very polite, accommodating, and professional.  They are a fine asset to the resort!!

reviews.author: lana kutuza
reviews.text: Restorante Blue Agave was awesome. Alexander is amazing  server today! We really enjoy it ! We will be back

reviews.author: Lynn Harter
reviews.text:
This hotel is very nice.   The staff here is very nice and very helpful.  Restaurants were good.

The activity staff are excellent.  Especially Nixon, Raphyel, Reinaldo, Luis.  They were very friendly and entertaining and good at including the people.  The dancing at Gabi beach with the activity staff was a lot of fun.   They do an excellent job.

I have been to many resorts in the Dominican and I would return to this one.

reviews.author: Cooper Emery
reviews.text:
Wanda the bartender by the reserve pool is amazing! Took care of us all trip. Martin is wonderful and took care of us while on the beach. Darlin and Edison were amazing. Delicious rum tasting! Heavy pour. Best hosts in the building !

So much fun!!

reviews.author: Dj Redz
reviews.text: Floral at Paradisus is a great experience— Very Aesthetic the food was great and our server Cesar was great. They even surprised us with a birthday cake!

reviews.author: juddith bishop
reviews.text: Hello..having the best time at Palma Real. The staff truly is Family. They remember your name and what you like to do. Our concierge Lewis is the best. I wanted a fan and he search high and low and found me several. With the heat I was so appreciative.  Lewis you are Family. See you later. With love❤️

reviews.author: Christopher Platin
reviews.text: We are having a blast at the Reserve!  Pedro at the beach is outstanding.  Every morning he greeted us with a smile.  Wanda the bartender took care of us and made us laugh, Isaias ensured we were having a great time.   Breakfast at Sante is a must!  Franklin’s smile would make our morning everyday!  Best cafe con leche!  Can’t wait to be back.  😎🏖️

reviews.author: Rima Haddad
reviews.text: Amazing resort! My second time at this location and it’s even better now than before. Service is fantastic at all the restaurants and bars. Rooms are clean and alcohol is generous. Everyone is always friendly and attentive. Special shout out to Miledys, Edito Luis, Jonathan (at the pool bar ), Frank and the restaurant managers Dionys and Maximo! We will be back :)

reviews.author: Terry Bronson
reviews.text: Ginger bar is fantastic. Morning coffee at the cafe is always made very well. The service is quick and really makes you feel taken care of. Particularly, Ismael Dominga was accommodating and kind.

reviews.author: Brian Healy
reviews.text: The Ginger Bar at lobby level is wonderful. Ismael makes amazing drinks, very friendly.  He and the team of Dominga, Lasdosolga and Clari provide great service. Stop by and meet them to kick off your holiday.

reviews.author: Abdul Sultani
reviews.text:
I just wanted to share my experience at Ginger Bar in Paradisus! Enjoyed great experience with Olga, Clari, Madelyn, Lisbect, Nathanael, and Dominga. If you want a good drink or coffee. See Olga. She makes an amazing Expresso. Harry Milor my concierge was wonderful he help us with our reservation and assisted us with our room change , our Daughter is having a great time at the kids club and our son is having fun too
We like our vacation it was very hot the temperature.our room was 2039, 9368
Lucia the Bartender was very nice and helpful.
We will be back at the resort.

reviews.author: Yaddelis Martinez
reviews.text: The Ginger Bar was great Ismael, Antonio, Olga, Soray, Clary gave great beverage recommendations, the drinks were delicious. This hotel has many different pools and multiple food options. Everyone at the resort is attentive and give great service. Quintino made the best tequila sunset and gave wonderful recommendations at the swim up bar, very friendly and knowledgeable. Definitely will be coming back to Paradisus Palma Real Resort, highly reccomend!

reviews.author: Ryan Scheurer
reviews.text: The people at the lobby bar were incredible and gave us excellent service. My fiancé asked for surprise drinks and the staff happily obliged. She loved them all. A few people In particular made our experience amazing. Luis Desa, Jose Martinez, Ana person,  Olga Martinez, Lucia Diaz and our concierge Darleni Alvarado made our stay very smooth.

reviews.author: Sarah Edmond
reviews.text:
We had a great week at Paradisus Palma Real!  We had a birthday and an anniversary during our family’s stay, and our concierge, Eriol, made both special for us.  He was a huge help with booking dinner reservations and activities as well as just helping us learn how to navigate the resort and all it had to offer.

Ramion was a beach attendant who we really enjoyed interacting with, and I spent a very relaxing afternoon at the spa being spoiled by Ironelis with a massage and facial. All employees were very friendly and welcoming.

We spent most of our time just relaxing in the pool and at the beach, but we did also enjoy parasailing and the included catamaran ride (yoga on the beach, swimming in the natural pool, and music/dancing on the ride back).

You will be warned about beach vendors by resort staff- listen to them.  That was the one minor annoyance; everywhere you turn someone is trying to sell you something, but the people are friendly and respectful when you decline.

That said, the “gift shop” employees (on the beach, not at the resort) will inform you they can hook you up with drugs- cocaine specifically- and one individual had to be told twice to leave us alone before he finally stopped approaching us and trying to show us what he had to offer.  Wasn’t a fan of that at all, but otherwise, it was the perfect week and I am so sad it came to an end!

reviews.author: Matt Gonsalves
reviews.text:
Another exceptional food restaurant called Mascalzones that the wife and I ate at tonight, our server Yeensen and Milton assisted us and treated us like royalties!
We will definitely be back!

reviews.author: Karina Rudnytsky
reviews.text: My fiance and I stayed at the resort for our pre-wedding Love at First Site inspection. It was one of our top resorts, and after staying here, we knew why. We did visit some other resorts, but it was obvious why this one stood out. The resort is beautiful and open. The staff is accommodating and friendly. We were upgraded to Royal Service and the experience was phenomenal. Our butler Carlos was the best. He was responsive and attentive and helped with everything. His services gave our stay that extra spark. We had a couple of issues and he was always on the phone or around the corner to help (like Superman). The romance team, Heinicy and Heidi, were also very good. They spent almost and entire day with us and surprised us with amazing service in our room. Given all of this, we will be booking our wedding here and cannot wait!

reviews.author: menita singh
reviews.text: Mascalzone restaurant was awesome! Delicious entrees  - loved the pizzas and pastas here !! Great service .. we enjoyed throughly!! Thanks to Raider for taking good care of us!! Supervisor Milton was on top of everything and made sure we got an excellent service.

reviews.author: Ming Cen
reviews.text: Blue Agave, good service and great Mexican food , Melvin a Santo is the best! There was a painting event, it was fun activities! Brandon and Jholfry was fun for the activities. Mina resturant very good food and our service was Wander great customer service!

reviews.author: Lou Agu
reviews.text:
Amazing resort ! Amazing stuff ! Food sooo good totally recommend this place! Cirilo tokimeku is the best
Ruddy and yafreisy at the buffet did an amazing  job !!!! What a beautiful service at the buffet from the stuff
Santo is so professional  helped me when i had a little accident ! Thanks to him and his team

reviews.author: Lisandy Mateo
reviews.text: I had an excellent experience during my stay in this resort. Is really beautiful, the rooms are modern and haver everything you need, even the toothbrush :D. Look for Jendry at the lobby and he will solve all your problems or issues.  I will  back to. this hotel for sure 💚💚.

reviews.author: Lourdes Roscino Sanchez
reviews.text: Excellent service! Yaleidi and all the staff members were helping us during our trip. Everyone is friendly and made us feel welcome! Food is great. Can’t wait to be back

reviews.author: Julianna Piloto
reviews.text: Ginger Bar was great!! Everyone that works at the bar is super friendly and helpful, makes you feel very welcomed. Our family spent a lot of time at the bar just drinking and talking with the employees.

reviews.author: Francois Pothier
reviews.text: Kicks bar is perfect ! Luis is very good

reviews.author: Gary Surowiec (Gary-CPS)
reviews.text:
This resort is awesome. This was our second year here in March. Both times we upgraded to the Royal Service (highly recommended).  The rooms are large, spacious and very clean. Grounds are meticulously  maintained and beautiful and the food is very good. What makes for the most enjoyable vacation are the people.

I cannot enough about the staff (kudos to the management).  Whether it was your butler, the bartenders, room service people, landscapers... all say hello, smile or ask how is your day.  Just makes it the most enjoyable experience.  When we arrived this March, all the same people that made our previous  vacation a wonderful experience were still all there.  They remember you and were happy to see you.  It was like a family reunion .

Our butler Carlos H is awesome.  Tends to your every need, understands your likes and dislikes and goes out of his way to make sure you have to most enjoyable vacation possible.  Not to mention he is the nicest, most genuine and pleasant person you could ever meet.  Wanda has to be to busiest and best bartender in the DR.  Order one drink and never have to tell her again, she remembers.  If she does not have something, she will make sure she gets it.  All the beach/pool guys are awesome also.  Rafael, Martin, Pedro and Carlos2 make sure you have everything you need at the beach and pool and keep you very well hydrated (if you know what I mean) throughout the day.

Cannot say enough good things about this resort.  Applause to Melia Resorts, their staffs and all of our above mentioned friends who made our vacation experience one of the best ever.

reviews.author: Randy Humphrey
reviews.text: Wonderful Dominican dining experience.  Andrea Santana is one of the very best wait staff we have had during our vacation stay.  Highly recommend.

reviews.author: paloma uria casatejada
reviews.text:
It has been a nice experience… super TOP!
Thanks to everyone who has made my stay unforgetable…
Best Restaurant and service: SANTE. Thanks to all the team… Eduardo, Juan, Franklin, Bladimir, kelvin and Hirlenne!

Also thanks to Antonio at the Ginger Bar, always being very kind and helpful.

And finally, i have to mention to the guys at the Reserve beach bar: Luis and Martin, thanks for taking care of my beach days!

I will come back very soon

reviews.author: Joel Zaidspiner
reviews.text:
As an avid traveler and lives to go to all-inclusives in Mexico, Dominica Republic, and throughout the Caribbean. this place had the view, the nice rooms swim up pools bars etc. but what it was lacking was fun activities, heated pools, and better quality food. The food was edible but lacked the quality you would expect in such a nice place like a Miele property. The best thing was the fresh made breakfast omelets, the Asian and the Italian was just ok and the best meal was the items we recommended the chef to make for us at the Mexican restaurant. One of the other items was the number of people trying to sell us add ons or excursions at the pool and beach or food upgrades in the restaurants. my favorite person was this big, tall man with a chef's hat. He was so nice and was able to get us ice cream when the ice cream section was closed.
Also, the chef at the Mexican restaurant is working, making the tacos. he was terrific! Sunrise views were amazing.

reviews.author: Brett H B
reviews.text: Beautiful property and spectacular beach. The service at the Lunch Box buffet is outstanding, especially Rosanna, Yahira, and Maria! They made it a wonderful experience.

reviews.author: Marc Awad
reviews.text: Daniella hostes was amazing also Jesus

reviews.author: Savitha Sunkara
reviews.text:
The buffet “the lunch box” is awesome!
Great food choices and friendly service! Servers always have a smile on their faces! Maria Santana, Gregory, and Silvania were excellent!

All the restaurants were great!

Activities were fun!  Jairo, Hairo, Samuel kept us laughing and entertained.

Jhon, Miguel and Luciano the bellmen were very helpful and friendly!

reviews.author: Kevin Moore

The ressort is big, but not much action, at least at this time of the year. There is a bar (ginger) but it’s too hot and not fun to do happy hour, not much action.

Hector, our concierge, was really helpful during our stay and very friendly

reviews.author: Claire Picard-Armstrong

Edito was amazing! So attentive and fun. Very hospitable! Great host! Made our stay so much more enjoyable.  He works in Blue Aguave and breakfast in the Lunch Box! Shout out to Félix as well!!
Emmanuel Batista very very punctual and friendly!

reviews.author: David Hudak

reviews.author: João Rosa
reviews.text:
Pizza Worshop was great! Thanks to Jorge Rafael and Juan Carlos!

And GinGer Bar is fantastic! Thanks Antonio, Dominga, Clari, Lisbeth, Sorangi, Olga

If you have a concierge option, opt for Irving. He made everything more agile during hosting, in addition to solving some problems. Really good! Fantastic.
