reviews.author: Veronica S
reviews.text: Awesome place with great daily activities. We had a great dinner experience at Flora between the food and the service we really enjoyed ourselves. Giovanni, Felix Uribe the waiter and Andino were very attentive. We will Definitely be coming back.

reviews.author: Ian Olsen
reviews.text: Jose Ramirez greeted me at the door and everyone lit up from his warmth. Every person we interacted with was a gem. I was working an event so my needs were different from a typical guest. I was unable to get my suit pressed, hair dryer wouldn't work, food was hit and miss (avoid the fish at blueagave). The overall experience of being here was just so incredible. I wish I could give a 5 out of 6 because my experience was not perfect but only against the service of other resorts of this class. They get the big things right and the people are just the best.

reviews.author: Donovan Charles
reviews.text: Our family of 8 enjoyed the experience at Palma Real. Concierge Miguelito and Bellman Jose were quick to address our every need. Our swim up suite felt like we had a corner of the resort all to ourselves. We loved the variety of the restaurants. Only wished the buffet was a little more consistent for some of the more finicky appetites in our group, but the Dominican style breakfast and lunches were a fun experience. I was able to golf, the wife visited the spa, the kids parasailed, and the in-laws enjoyed a memorable fishing trip, making this visit to Paradisus an easy, fun, weeklong set of unforgettable excursions. Thanks Palma Real staff for a great trip!

reviews.author: Christopher Ruppert
reviews.text: The whole experience is great the staff is very friendly. Mascarson is absolutely first class food. My server Jessica was very attentive and very friendly. She did a fabulous job.

reviews.author: JC G
reviews.text: The resort was beautiful and we stayed in the adults only area which was perfect because it was not crowded. The rooms were very clean and the resort was very well kept. The room service did take a little longer but we contacted our concierge and he would get it for us right away.

reviews.author: Tone Banks
reviews.text: My wife and I spent 7 days at the resort. Our room was very spacious and the service & hospitality was exceptional. However, we were extremely dissatisfied with the food for this all inclusive resort. For some reason all the food was cold from the buffet. The food from the some of the restaurants were served lukewarm as if it had been prepared well in advance. Some food tasted old or freezer burnt. That definitely put a damper on our stay.

reviews.author: Marie Morey
reviews.text: The customer service was amazing. Edgar was so helpful and accommodating. Everything was perfect. The entire staff waiting on our bridal party was exceptional. We will definitely return because of the customer service.

reviews.author: Hanna Overholt
reviews.text: So fun! We love Fernando and polito!

reviews.author: Bahar Z
reviews.text:
Ricki and Ruddy are great. They provided exceptional service .
Room was nice and clean , also Carlos at the front desk went above and beyond to help us.

reviews.author: Mason Davis
reviews.text: We ate at the Lunch Box buffet for breakfast and lunch every day of our stay, it was great! Love the food and loved our servers Delvin, Santo and Yanira even more! He always looks out for us and gets us everything we need. He makes the experience fun and easy!

reviews.author: Chris Gaston
reviews.text: The bar “KICKS” has excellent service. All of them are exceptional. The best one however is Yiri. She constantly went above and beyond for our every need.

reviews.author: 1stavenger
reviews.text:
Good - Villa with direct pool access is spacious. Food @ neighboring Grand Cana is superior than where we stayed @ the Reserve. Bar & room service were great. Fitness facility is nicer @ Grand Cana, which we got to via a short shuttle ride.
Bad - The 1st day our concierge, Irvin, said he would take care of all our dinner reservations. By the time he did this, restaurants were either full, or time was way later than we wanted. I strongly suggest that you do this on your own on the 1st day, otherwise you won’t eat where you want & will be scrambling like us. I did speak with the front desk manager, Grace, regarding this issue & she wasn’t much help either.  My wife, daughter, & cousin said that the massage was very disappointing (Grace approved a 15% spa discount, which I still had to speak to the spa manager to re-approve). If you really have to get a spa treatment I suggest you try the Grand Cana. We really liked the rooms & direct access to our pool @ the reserve, but for meals, gym & spa I strongly suggest that you jump on the shuttle to the Grand Cana. We did not like the beach because there was a ton of seaweed & kelp, again pretty disappointing. Good resort, but my family of 7 paid $9,000 for 3 villas with pool access, and we expected better service from the concierge. Otherwise we had a great time & I strongly suggest as an excursion, the all day trip to Escape Park. The zip lines & & pools were the highlight of our trip(take off your sunglasses for the zip line where you jump into the water). Btw, I used Viator to book this excursion on line. I also used High Quality Transfer for private airport pick up & drop off👍

reviews.author: Binny Malik
reviews.text:
We are on Day 3 of our vacation and want to share our experience while we are still here. We booked this resort after a memorable experience at the beautiful Paradisus Cancun last year. Honestly we were expecting same level of premium experience.
The Good:
1. It’s a beautiful resort!! We had an ocean front room and best thing we could have asked for with gorgeous views.
2. The kids club. We have a 20 month old very active toddler. I will probably come back to vacation at the resort just for the awesome staff at the kids club!  Shout out to Joanna who even helped us out with private baby sitting for few hours.
3. Activities. We could not participate in much of the activities but whatever few we did, they were great. I personally loved the painting class! I hope to try out their yoga and stretch class just because of the location they are set up at! Instagram able for sure!
The evening program is a class apart. We witnessed circus yesterday. The lady who plays the instruments is just incredible. She seems to be constant every evening we have been here. I loved every single performance and it felt soul soothing!
4. The Food: pretty decent. The fact that our very picky eater toddler ate well makes it all worth it. They have a decent choice of restaurants but I can’t say much for we could not try them at all. The only other restaurant we tried was Blue Agave. Delvin Martinez was great host and food excellent.
5. Gorgeous beach with plenty of chairs and Bali beds available. There seems to be issue with seaweed but I think Hotel did a phenomenal job in keeping the beach vacation able!
6. We did not feel pressured for any excursions or add on experience. There is no photographer chasing us around and luring us into photo sessions or some one insisting we get a spa. It is refreshing!

The Not so good:
1. The resort seems to be catering to “Circle” members better and we felt like non priority customers with our Green bracelets. Not to mention, I hardly saw a soul in the areas reserved for circle members.
2. We are picky about quality of alcohol in our all inclusive vacations. One reason Paradisus was our choice for this vacation was the premium quality liquor experience we had in Cancun. But little did we know that our choice of liquor here was reserved for “Circle”
Members only. Like WTH!!!
Honestly it made us feel so second class even when we think we had paid premium to vacation at this resort.
3. We expect and were actually informed that the mini bar will be restocked daily. What a lie! Day 1, we got full bar as expected at the check in. Day 2…. We had to call twice just to get water. Day 3…. We ended up calling 4 times and frustrated to at least get water forget rest of the mini bar supplies. Our complaint to our concierge did not make any difference. We have 2 more days to go…. And I am not optimistic for a different experience.
4. The room: We loved the room with all its luxury thrown in (big spacious setting, there are two showers in the bathroom, Jacuzzi in the balcony (although we cannot figure out how to turn it on), premium toiletries, more than enough towels, the mattress). The room wasn’t toddler friendly; but then that’s not hotel problem. Our little one loved to just keep turning on the water in the tub which seemed to be placed right in the middle of the room. And then the color of the floor is such that it’s hard to see if the floor is wet making it risky for us to let our toddler be! And who places TV right in the middle of the room blocking your view???
5. Communication Problem: the staff hardly speaks or understands English especially in the buffet area (that’s where we ate the most). But I don’t want to hold this against them as we are in their country. Glad we have some elementary Spanish language skills.
6. The Credits advertised for in app booking as basically worthless and all smoke and mirror if we can say so. F&B coupon does not apply to liquor we want and we are in all inclusive resort with an upgraded room. That’s $100 of advertised coupons. I can’t recall what rest were for but worthless for sure.

reviews.author: Rose T
reviews.text: Such a gorge place to stay and the food at the hotel is so good. The staff is lovely and our concierge Darleni has been totally amazing - so friendly and helpful! We always had everything we needed and she even helped us plan our excursions.

reviews.author: Shana Witter
reviews.text:
Family of 3 have been at Paradisus Palma Real for 3 days and are highly disappointed that we wasted our money.

The biggest issues have been poor service with the exception of jordania who was great.

We checked in and went to dinner, when we returned we noticed that money was stolen from our rooms!

One of the staff members even hid my sisters jewelry under the rug to retrieve at a later time.

When i brought our concerns to their attention. It appeared as if a thorough investigation would take place.

They said it would take 24 to 48 hours to investigate. Our attempts to escalate matters and seek resolution from the management team, were pointless.

The lack of accountability and urgency were dissapointing to say the least. Paradisus Palma Real let us down.

Beautiful resort but this terrible experience made us never want to visit Punta Cana ever again.

reviews.author: Lisa's Limo Service
reviews.text:
Martin tineo y Luis garces he done a amazing job couldn’t have done a better job love that guy we done a wonderful job for our whole family
Went to Hibachi grill tonight it was wonderful and it was my daughter’s birthday and they had her a beautiful yummy cake Alvaro was our butler and he arranged a wonderful Anniversary for us and also arranged a wonderful birthday for my daughter even had special stuff in our rooms the Italian restaurant was awesome. Steak house was amazing too thank you

reviews.author: Nessa Stinson

reviews.author: Tiffany Walker

And for my last breakfast/lunch I went to Sante restaurant and was helped by Felix Celeste & Luz who were wonderful!!

Raymundo from Paradisus Palma Real offered us a great customer service,really nice person and very pleasant.
Daiana Rodriquez from Kanna restaurant went above and beyond to accommodate us ,she has a great personality and was always available to help and give information.
