reviews.author: Allana Bowles
reviews.text: We just finished dinner at Mascalzone Restaurant.  Wilmina was our waitress and she was very kind and attentive.  I had delicious pizza and my husband had penned colognes.  Dessert was Tiramisu.  We will be back to Mascalzone before this visit to Paradisus is over!!

reviews.author: Ryan Dorman
reviews.text: I would have been happy to write an honest review of your facilities. Unfortunately, a member of your staff put a QR code in front of me and reached out to push buttons on my phone to get a good review. I finally just entered one so that I could return to my breakfast. I get you want to understand your customers but you need to let it happen organically.

reviews.author: Andrew Benjamin
reviews.text: Melvin & Rosa are the best! They make the best drinks at Rum Republic. Definitely recommend to go there! Delicious

reviews.author: Raymond Glaeser
reviews.text: Ginger bar is very nice .  The staff is very friendly and polite.  Ismael made me a great drink!  Antonio, Clari, Germari, Olgamartinez, and Dominga are all GREAT!!

reviews.author: M E
reviews.text: My husband and I have been coming to the Dominican Republic every year since 2021. Alvaro Fernandez was our concierge in 2021 during our first vacation. He has taken time to see us each year when we have come back to town even tho we haven’t stayed at his resort. My husband and I decided we’d like to see the resort he is at so we could book there next year so I reached out to Alvaro and he offered to take us on a tour last week while we were in town staying at another Meliá resort. We were so impressed with the Paradisus Palma Real that we decided to book our next trip at this resort! I love that Alvaro is still around when we come each year and that he always makes time to come visit us. He helped make the Dominican Republic special for us so we will always be grateful to him! We enjoy seeing him each year and we are looking forward to our stay at the Paradisus Palma Real!

reviews.author: Chris Baker
reviews.text: Rosanna Castillo was great and quick to get what what our family needed and was always checking on us. She was very polite and I look for her as my waitress at the LunchBox restaurant.

reviews.author: Anthony P
reviews.text:
At Resturant  Kanah I must say we have been here since last Saturday & I have not missed a bkfast or a lunch with out this crew ..@ 56 yrs old and out of all my vacations we have taken these guys along with Juan Carlos i'll concierge connection. I will post a photo of him later. Has been just an amazing  trip the best trip of my life .. this crew goes above and beyond for anything . Friendly , happy & just so happy to have a little small talk  u guys I have spent  5 days with & I love you all .
Last I had a special request for lunch & this chef has gone above and beyond  he is the absolute best chef experience .. track them all down u will love these guys ...you all fulfilled this vacation beyond any of my words .. last I must say from Juan Carlos to my dinning experiences  my self and my wife had moved forward and became  part of the Melia family experience . We are now members .. & for that you can go see Miguel Perez at the Circle club another professional at it's finest

reviews.author: Clint Pettrey
reviews.text: The services at the beach and pool is AWESOME! Yuderi, Martin, Raphael, Wanda are the best, and take such good care of you. The grounds are beautiful, and the rooms are very comfortable. Would highly recommend this resort.

reviews.author: NNoni
reviews.text: The staffs at kids club are super friendly, nice and love kids. You can just tell the minute you come in. Our kids 4 and 9 years old had so much fun with their activities like pizza making, cookies making workshop etc. The place is very clean, lots of toys to play with. One of the best :)

reviews.author: Luca DiPietro
reviews.text: I stayed at the paradisus palma real and it was a great time. More importantly when I went to the winery with my server Johnathon. Johnathon was fantastic, he truly knew what he was doing. Great service and personality. Also my concierge Lewis Dela Cruz was absolutely fantastic. Great service and even better people.

reviews.author: AK G
reviews.text:
We visited Paradisus palma real and stayed at the reserve (now known as Garden Suites) for a family trip. We had a great time and would recommend it to families.

A few things to note.

Pros:
- great pools
- had access to Grand Cana (more luxurious resort). I would recommend booking here instead of Garden suites for the reasons below (cons)
- water park is great for kids
- kids zone to keep kids entertained is also great
-food in Grand Cana is very good
- our concierge Ariel Benzo was great. He helped with reservations and was very responsive and attentive whenever we needed anything. He went the extra mile to make sure we were happy and just his smile alone can make you feel happy. Thank you my friend.

Cons:
- presentation to sell Melia rewards program subscription. The people involved were great. I just think it took too long it took an entire morning basically for a day. Also, my advice is to make this optional for guests that way you’re not wasting your time and theirs. If they opt to hear the presentation they’re more likely to be interested so you’re targeting your time effectively. Yes most people would opt out but that’s because most people aren’t interested. So why waste the time for both sides.

- the food is not great at the reserve. Only in Grand Cana is it really worth it. Although some items in Aqua and Mizu were good. And Gabi was good for breakfast (but not as good as Dominica at grand cana). Room service food was not good.

- the food is not very catered for kids. Young kids need to eat differently. Not many restaurants had options for them besides pasta and chicken nuggets.

- rooms need updating. Doors don’t close in washroom. Hot tub doesn’t fill. General west and tear very apparent. It needs a renovation.

All in all it was a great stay. Very satisfied for the price we got.

Thanks to all the great staff there! They deserve all the credit.

reviews.author: Elizabeth Williams
reviews.text: Luis Rodriguez at restaurant Kanna has been amazing! He is friendly and personable which is important to us in our experience at the resort. Luis remembers each of our favorite drinks and preferred flavors (all 8 of us)!  Luis is truly #1!!!

reviews.author: Timothy Guerrero
reviews.text: Fioro was great restaurant in the paradiso punta cana. The gnocchi was amazing. So was the mushrooms deep. A friend had the mofongo with the white fish which I tried and was extremely tasty. Our waiter was frank and he was on point

reviews.author: Kristen Hitner
reviews.text: The service was amazing all around - highly recommend upgrading to the Reserve for access to adult only sections (if applicable of course! Great family areas too) - this also grants you a private butler/concierge. We had Juan and he made the trip for us - from dinner reservations to sunscreen...just can't say enough good things. This resort has my highest recommendation.

reviews.author: Yara Pascal
reviews.text: Great trip! We’ve visited the property plenty of times and plan to continue to do so! Staff is pleasant and friendly our concierge Juan has been a pleasure to work with. Jordania along with other staff were also very pleasant.

reviews.author: Grant Rewega
reviews.text:
Vanessa and Maketi are the best servers on the beach!! They gave us chairs everyday and had fresh cool drinks for the whole family. We have been to many resorts (Beaches Turks & Caicos, Sandals brabados ( mulitple times), Jamaica Rose Hall (3 times), Paradisus in playa del carmen (last August), and people like this are why we travel. They are very personable and family oriented like we are. I brought my 78 year old parents here and they took care of everyone. We had ups and downs on the trip, but they made up for everything! I scrutinize trip advisor and people like this are often not mentioned.

Please tip them as this is how they make their living!

reviews.author: Joy Simmons (JoLé Simmons)
reviews.text: Ate at Mina restaurant and it was amazing. The food was delicious and service was amazing. We had Jean as a server and he was amazing and prompt. Hansel was awesome as well, made sure we were satisfied.

reviews.author: Robbin D'Auria
reviews.text: We are at the Paradisus in the DR and having a fabulous time. We love hanging out at the beach and Hansel our beach concierge has made our vacation over the top fabulous.  He is super attentive and goes above and beyond serving our needs.  If you come please look for him. You will not be disappointed.

reviews.author: Brigette Thoresen
reviews.text:
This resort is the closest to heaven you will ever get. The accommodations, the location, and the staff are truly magnificent. The grounds of the property are spectacular. The attention to detail was well thought out throughout the entire resort. The staff go above and beyond to cater to your every need, both the hotel staff and the restaurant staff.

Make sure to check out the BlueAgave restaurant and ask for Sanyi Acosta and Alexander Bryan, they will take extra special care of you.

By the poolside, look for Maximo Cedano. He’s always happy to help and make your stay more relaxing.

You will not regret staying here. Five star all around.

reviews.author: Mayret Padron
reviews.text:
In this hotel, employees work hard to make your experience memorable.
Rafael from the Melia Club, Beach Bar pampered us the whole week we were there. He even went to another bar to get us the green smoothies my friend and l liked to drink every day.
Dayhanira from the Mexican restaurant also made our night unique the day we had dinner there.
Maria from Rum Republic went the extra mile even when the smoky rum machine was broken.

reviews.author: Zhaniya Hill
reviews.text: Staying at this hotel has been an amazing experience all around. If you want great service Andrea Stormin and Maria are the best at Paradisus Palma Real Lunchbox Buffet. I would recommend this hotel and these people for anyone who visits. Truly had an amazing time

reviews.author: Ana Rodriguez
reviews.text: Andrea Santana  was an exceptional waitress. She was very attentive, and very professional. She assured that the whole table was taken care of. The restaurant (Flora)  was also excellent.

reviews.author: MARIA IGNACIA VIVEROS RUEDA
reviews.text: We stayed for a week at this hotel, and it was a horrible experience, the worst we’ve ever had at an “all inclusive” hotel, and we’ve been at least in 5-6 different Caribbean places. There was a convention that lasted 4 days, and they didn’t notify us in advance. They changed our room from deluxe to classic, the buffets were closed -without previous notice- almost every day at dinner (our baby has food allergies, one of the reasons for us to go “all inclusive”), service was rude and concerned only about the event assistants, with little exceptions. We don’t recommend this place, there’s no balance between the price they charge and the quality of rooms and service, they gave us terrible moments instead of relaxing vacations.

reviews.author: Bryce Kreiner14
reviews.text: Blue Agave restaurant, we had a big group and was served very efficiently, lots of food and great taste. Reynaldo, Jorgi, and Virtudes y Laura had great service and will definitely come back!

reviews.author: Andrew Gooch
reviews.text: Great experience at the Palma, Eriol was our dedicated concierge and he helped take all the administrative and busy work out of our hands.  Daily activities, restaurant reservations, regularly checking on our stay and if there is anything he can do to enhance our visit, like helping to reserve golf at Cocotal, sending a bottle of champagne to our room and shifting dinner times to accommodate the sleep schedule of our 1 year old.  Great hotel, excellent service. Thank you Eriol for a great experience and hope to see you again next time!

reviews.author: Karly Genovese
reviews.text: Ginger bar is amazing. We came every morning for our iced lattes. Antonio, Dominga, soranyi, Olga, clasidania and Raffael took great care of us everytime! Espresso martinis at night were great pre dinner drink! Love this place!

reviews.author: Apollo M
reviews.text: Had a beautiful breakfast each morning with Rosanna at the buffet.  She was very attentive and decorated the table nicely for us each day.   We’ve been seeing her at breakfast for 4 years now and she is always excellent.😊

reviews.author: Janice S.
reviews.text: Absolute paradise!!  The staff and service at the Reserve is exceptional!! In particular, our concierge Irvin Nolasco who went above and beyond to ensure that our stay was wonderful !  We will definitely be coming back very soon. Special thanks too, to our servers Jesus and Claudio Duran  Everyone so attentive and welcoming.  Thank you !!

reviews.author: Christian Cruz
reviews.text: Perfect couple, family,  business, and vacation get away! The "noche dominicana" is one of the many nights where you celebrate at Paradisus Golf and Spa resort Punta Cana! Huge thank you to Soranyi for all the help and dancing !!

reviews.author: Rafael Gonzalez
reviews.text: My wife and I went to the Paradisus in 2019 it was impressive but in this 2024 we wanted to return to this beautiful place, we were 8 days and 7 nights it was all wonderful starting with the welcome they gave us when we arrived at The reserves, our concierge Cristian Gonzalez was super friendly and super attentive to us and very respectful,   He was always attentive to us, i would like to add that on friday we went to an activities from the hotel in which me and my wife pay for some pictures at the Island that we went but never received the pictures fron the private company and we asked Cristian Gonzalez to help us with that and he got me all the pictures, i just want to say thank you Cristian Gonzalez,  thanks to the manager Juan Carlos who takes his time to answer us all, the truth is that the treatment they gave us pushes us to save more money to return to the Paradisus Palma Real where we feel at home. Shalom hugs family, thank you

reviews.author: Jane Sparks
reviews.text: What a lovely stay! Very relaxing and enjoyable vacation for me and my family. Zenovia (our concierge) made sure we had everything we needed and even helped decorate one of our rooms for a birthday, which went above and beyond. All needs are met and staff is very attentive, I would definitely recommend!

reviews.author: Leah Hutzel
reviews.text: We have had a fantastic stay at Paradisus Palma Real. They’ve done a beautiful job with the renovations to the hotel rooms and the restaurants. The beach is beautiful and expansive. Our concierge Juan Sierra has taken care of our every need while we’ve been here. Kudos to the super fun beach team of Martin Tineo, Gilberto Mejia, Pedro Cedano, and Rafael Guerrero! They have been so much fun and looked after us every day on the beach!

reviews.author: Psi Jenny Waldheim
reviews.text:
We had a wonderful big family vacation. Miguelito and Bladimir were excellent concierges that always answered our requests.
They made our stay feel like home. All the people working at Paradisus Palma Real were very nice with us. Juan and Ruby prepare the best cocktails 🍹and Antonio at Ginger bar the best iced capuccino.

reviews.author: DD'S Hairbraiding
reviews.text: Yamilet at the Mexican restaurant is an excellent server .As a resturant  owner her service was 100% . Keep up the great work Yamilet .much appreciated

reviews.author: Jose David Duran
reviews.text: Mascalzone reataurant: Ana was grateful with us, very nice service. In Blue Agave: Alquinio and Santo was definitely an awesome service.

reviews.author: greg turchetta
reviews.text: We had a Wonderful time the service was exceptional. Luciano Pedro and Edgar took care of us so well we will most certainly come back and spend more time here they truly care about what they do and they provide an amazing experience. I would highly recommend.

reviews.author: Athan
reviews.text: Regrettably, my stay at Paradisus Palma Real Golf & Spa was overshadowed by communication challenges with the staff, who struggled to comprehend English. The disturbing presence of roaches in both my initial and replacement rooms raised serious hygiene concerns. Furthermore, the disappointment extended to the limited evening food options, as the main buffets consistently closed early. Overall, this experience fell well below expectations, and I cannot in good conscience recommend this hotel.

reviews.author: Rafaela Ribeiro
reviews.text: Love this place! The food at the restaurants is really good! Miguel is definitely the best bartender! So funny and makes the best Moscow mule! Antony is also such a good person! We love them! So nice and funny!

reviews.author: Andreas
reviews.text:
This place is special. But not everyone may have the same experience.

The hotel is one of five by melia on that piece of land, but it is the closest to the sea. It has beautiful pools and fantastic rooms.

Our room/suite was actually a small apartment, very spacious, well kept, nicely decorated and fully equipped. There was nothing missing from it. It was also the closest one to the beach. We loved it.

What can be hit or miss is the service. There are lots of staff but not all are equally motivated. The ones who are, like Rozmary,our concierge (she introduced herself at check in but was our shadow making dinner reservations and solving all issues we were not even aware of), make a big difference. Others can be motivated with tips but that can get tiring. Other than that simple requests can take for ever, meal orders can get messed up, service you get one day be denied the next one etc.

Another issue can be the differences in service based on your status with their program. When you have paid a month's rent for few days in PC you feel strange if you are denied service that people next to you get. You can certainly live without a certain brand of beer or rum, but if the folks next to you get it and you are told they don't have it, some may not be thrilled.

Bottom line, if you have a high status with melia, are willing to tip all day long, and/or have patience this place is a paradise.  A real one! If not, you may want to look elsewhere.

reviews.author: Miguel Carvalho
reviews.text:
Awesome stay! Room are spacious and good is ok. Only issue is the algae in the beach.
Service is very good and special thanks to Antonio Ramirez from reception bar at Paradisus Palma Real . The best! Always a smile in is face and did I told you he makes the best Mojitos ever? Keep up the good work Antonio! Cheers
Miguel

reviews.author: KARLA SALAZAR
reviews.text: Good service in the kicks restaurant. The best in the hotel!!!

reviews.author: Casey Nath
reviews.text:
This resort is soooo much nicer than the pictures look online! Very clean, excellent service, very nice and comfortable rooms. Rosanna, edito, yorgelys helped us at breakfast and were was very attentive at The Lunch Box. I have a bad sunburn and they helped me find things to soothe it. The pools are excellent and the beach is very clean!
Teofilo was so attentive at the pool, we had a great time!!

reviews.author: Lucy Conant-Keim
reviews.text: The resort is so beautiful and breath taking. The staff is so welcoming and always happy to help with whatever you need. There’s tons of activities that the resort offers throughout the day as well as at night. There are a variety of options for food and they’re all unique and delicious. Our concierge, Yessica, was super helpful with reservations to each of the restaurants and staying on top of anything we needed help with. 5/5 would recommend if you are thinking about visiting Punta Cana.

reviews.author: Lon Passoff
reviews.text:
After leaving a one star review the resort management made contact with me (because we were still on property) and made sure that my family was spoiled front that point on. So I’m updating the review to 3-stars, and posting the pros and cons:

Cons:

My biggest concern for visitors is the food, because it has become trash. They’re serving really low quality stuff. It didn’t used the be like that.

Also, the bars are now serving lower quality drinks. If you want the good stuff you have to pay for it. It’s not that bad because I don’t mind paying if I have to, but all inclusive should include at least the stuff below top shelf.

The pool bar is closed but the bar facing away from the same pool is open. So you have to jump out to order a drink and then get back in. Plus, they only have one person walking around asking people if they want a drink. It’s a massive pool area that needs at least 4-5 servers.

There is not enough entertainment. It’s a very boring place, and it used to be a lot of fun. They need to bring back the real shows.

Pros:

Incredible pool and beach. Incredible views.  Very nice rooms. A/C works. Good beds and pillows. The staff are friendly and want to please.

They definitely showed that they are willing to make fast corrections, and are willing to go above and beyond to try and make their clients happy.

I want to give a huge thank you to our server, Abraham, for making our last meal memorable. He helped seal the deal on upgrading this review!

reviews.author: william thompson
reviews.text: Had a very pleasant stay during our time here at paradisus for a conference. A highlight was the amazingly friendly service from Bartolo. He was always around to help us get around the resort and was genuinely friendly.  Great guy and nice resort.

reviews.author: Nancy Jimenez
reviews.text:
A few days in Punta Cana’s all inclusive Paradisus Palma Real we have tried a few restaurants and by far Flora has been the best meal “the monfongo with chicken” special thanks to Rayda and Joel for making our stay extraordinary special!!

The reply mentions a “Virginia” not sure who that is!!

However I did want to also acknowledge “Victor”the bartender at Celsius extremely personable and attentive to ALL guests.

reviews.author: Rosa R
reviews.text: This hotel is great!  The servers are awesome!  Fior in the sports bar is amazing! Walkiria, Antonio, and Ismael in the Ginger bar are very friendly and attentive. In Kana Francisco and Luis. Yiri Silvestre had great recomendations for eating and entertainment!  The guys that greet you at the door Juanlly Robles and Richard Carpio were friendly and super informative. I highly recomend this place!

reviews.author: KRISTINA DEROBERTIS
reviews.text: It’s truly paradise at the paradisus. The food and drinks are amazing and the employees are so kind and helpful. I feel really safe staying here and the front desk was able to switch my room to be closer to the beach which was greatly appreciated. Being an all inclusive I was worried the food would be below average but that is not the case everhthing is truly delicious. Love it here

reviews.author: MARCELLA KRIEGER
reviews.text: I came here for my uncles wedding! Currently here at the moment! The stay has been lovely so far! We even got to witness a wedding fashion show where my uncle and his new wife opened it!

reviews.author: Emily Rabe
reviews.text:
Bri Sas restaurant - Miquelya and Felix were great!! They took care of our big boisterous family with humor and grace.
The kids on our trip had such fun with Sujeidy and Yesica in Kidsdom! They were wonderful.

reviews.author: Hillary Schultz
reviews.text: We thoroughly enjoyed our family vacation with our two teens. The last day we met Máximo who provided amazing pool side service and made recommendations based on our liking. We could tell he enjoyed his job and making customers happy. I hope we see him in a leadership position next time we visit.

reviews.author: Troy Thompson
reviews.text: We had an amazing time during our stay! Philippe was amazing from the start. We were nervous and almost didn’t book here because we read a few reviews stating the resort wasn’t friendly and it was hard to get into restaurants. We had NO issues and nothing but friendly service everywhere. We were so impressed with the hotel. The rooms are beautiful, the resorts is beautiful and clean. The ocean was perfect.

reviews.author: Karem Zafra-Vera
reviews.text:
Virginia , Yafreisy Soler y Glenys ! Okay people we have been three nights here.  I love the Dominican people.  They are most loving humans.  The services has been exceptional.  The treatment and their love to serve us all.  So I appreciate each for their passion ! So grateful !

Last night we celebrated my daughter’s birthday and it was perfection!
Kelvin sang and just made our family feel amazing singing happy Birthday to our daughter and the chef Kendy cooked up a delicious meal.  So grateful for all the service.

reviews.author: Emil Liggett
reviews.text: The food was great, the service was better. Bladmir, Nahomi and Andino took great care of us! See you tomorrow! Ariel and Emmanuel Bautista took care of us from the moment we arrived all the way until our pick up. The entry bar Ginger was definitely 👌 🔥.  Best expresso martini

reviews.author: Rebecca Gosevitz
reviews.text: We had a fantastic family holiday. Our 8 year old daughter made lots of friends. The Kidsdom was very well organized and they took very good care of the participating children. Emmanuel was excellent and super fun and responsible with the kids. We definitely recommend a vacation at this resort especially if you have young kids.

reviews.author: Nicole Peralta
reviews.text: We had the pleasure of spending 5 days at this beautiful resort.  Basílio was in charge of assisting our family during our stay and he was there every step of the way. Very efficient and helpful. We will definitely return.

reviews.author: Nattis Wesström
reviews.text: It was an incredible dinner. First we got an appetizer that was really delicious, then we got the main course which was Devine!!! The service was really genuine, and the wine restaurant it self was incredible. 5 starts from me. ///Sweden

reviews.author: fatima dalva
reviews.text:
The flora restaurant is one of the best one in Paradisus Palma Real in punta cana.
Service was excellent, the waitress Melina took care of our table and explained everything about the Dominican food and she was right.
Dismal in is the vistes was very helpful and courteous. And the food was the best

reviews.author: Catherine Kien
reviews.text: I had a great time during my stay :) The staff were very kind, such as Luciano, Melvin, and John. I would come again! I highly recommend dining at Flora as well. Good vibes

reviews.author: Mechelle M
reviews.text: Jose in Brisa’s restaurant is an excellent server! He is fast, effective, knowledgeable and kind. Our whole family got great service during our vacation!!!

reviews.author: Montserrat Gonzalez
reviews.text:
Excellent service in the buffets breakfast, lunch, and dinner. Thank you so much to Maria Mercedes, Betty, and Jessica.

Mascalzones: good food but hands down amazing service by fausto. He’s an exemplary employee along with Milton who was also wonderful!

Santé:
Gracias a Franklin Diaz y Nelson Romero por un excelente servicio en la cena! Muy atentos y eficientes!

reviews.author: Evelyn Allas
reviews.text: Experience was very nice lots of nice Dominican culture Marta gave us a tour of the Dominican day. We saw lots of beautiful art it was nice to experience my parents culture

reviews.author: Kali
reviews.text: Nixon and Felix as well as our housekeeper for room 1104 has been absolutely amazing. Nixon made us feel welcome and at home at the beach. Felix has been wonderful and made sure everything was perfect for our trip, great butler service. He booked our food reservations and spa reservations and left sweets for us every night. AMAZING!! Our housekeeper was the sweetest person. She had the most beautiful singing voice. Rare restaurant had amazing food. I would definitely come back here.

reviews.author: Andres Pazos
reviews.text: We had a great time at this hotel. We chose it because it offered daycare services that our 2 year old could use which was awesome for us. The food exceeded our expectations. We got a Nikte room which included a concierge service. Mackenson, our concierge, was fantastic and very responsive to our questions and needs.

reviews.author: Sarah Blakeman
reviews.text: Rafael  and Jhohan helped us at the pool and beach every day and the service was amazing!!

reviews.author: Naser Sadiki
reviews.text:
The staff is not friendly. They dindt say hello or anything. They even smile.
But the Barkeeper Eddy at the Poolbar is the best! He always smile and is very respectfull and friendly.
5 Stars and more for Eddy 90 & Roxana.
It was a pleasure to meet you.

reviews.author: Felicia Veasey
reviews.text: This is our 4th day at the resort. Our concierge Juan Carlos made us reservations at Bluagave tonight. From start (chips and salsa and other appetizers) to finish (tres leche and churros), we were enjoyed every item. We ordered seconds of some items. Andino, Laura, Alexander, Francis and Virtudes provided great customer service. Great food and great service!

reviews.author: Cosmin Sanovei
reviews.text:
Tonight at the Mascalzone restaurant we had a wonderful experience, our manager Milton, server Yuleni and Bernabet, the chef Roberto were unbelievable, the excellent service, delicious !
Special thanks to our concierge Stephany, who booked all our restaurants, very attentive with our needs , a wonderful person!
We’ll definitely come back!!!!

reviews.author: Tyler Southwick
reviews.text: Fila & Altagarcia at the sports bar were awesome servers

reviews.author: Fernando Rodriguez Alvarez Baseball & other Sports (Pase Usted Señor Jonrón)
reviews.text: Everything was wonderful! Supervisor Luis Rosario was particularly awesome once again. His leadership and customer service is outstanding! His two subordinates of Kicks bar sports, Fior and Andreina are the best in terms of going to the extra mile in their services.  Both made us felt better than with our own family.  Maria, from the bar next to restaurants Mina and Blue Agave is so good in her job! Emmanuel and Eladio from Canvas restaurant as well! Braison Torres is the best gastronomic we met there, he attended us in the Italian restaurant. Cirilo, from the Japanese restaurant too! Wanda, from the swimming pool bar at the reserve is a great bartender and person! Miss Cancun, Luis Rosario and Harry, our concierge,  trade us not as customer but as family! THANKS! GRACIASSSSS. August  20th, 2024

reviews.author: ryan pacana
reviews.text: Blue Agave was amazing!! Best dinner we had! Santo and Virtudes were great!

reviews.author: Christina Young
reviews.text:
Just got back from our first anniversary/delayed honeymoon and I could not be happier. The service was phenomenal. Our butler, Yesica Reyes, was amazing. She helped us plan a dinner on the beach, scheduled spa appointments, helped us schedule our covid test and was there for anything else we needed.
The hotel is gorgeous! Very photogenic and relaxing. The room was also stunning, very large, modern, clean and relaxing.
The food was good, we enjoyed the steak house and Olio the most.  We will definitely be back!!

reviews.author: Reggie Cole
reviews.text: Our stay at the Paradisus Palma Real was wonderful! We enjoyed all the RESTURANT's and participated in the daily activities. A special thanks to our concierge Luis Gabriel Cadet for making our stay effortless. He responded to all our needs quickly and efficiently. We will ask for him when we return!

reviews.author: Dennis Brown
reviews.text: Luis and his whole team at Kicks were absolutely wonderful. So friendly and personable. Made our trip that much more enjoyable. Thank you very much for a wonderful week.

reviews.author: Cameron Hart
reviews.text: Mina steak house has amazing service with even better food. Desserts are very refreshing and the perfect end to a long night. Jean is a wonderful person.

reviews.author: Steven Ruddy
reviews.text:
Short trip from the airport, minimal hassle checking in and well welcomed at the concierge.

We’re on day 3, zero issues, great service, food and weather. Tonight we dined at Mezcalzone, the Italian option. Good service by Milton, Yenssen and Yessica.

Everyone has been great. Would recommend and return!

reviews.author: Kyle Leydier
reviews.text: Amazing service today during lunch in The Lunch Box with Rosanna Castillo! Super attentive, inviting smile and went above and beyond. A nice way to end our time here as we leave tomorrow. Gracias!

reviews.author: Samri Basazinew
reviews.text: The restaurant Flora has one of the best food in the resort!! Eduardo, bladimir peguero, Ana (the host), elvis and the chef Jerand are such nice people. They make our dine in experience excellent. Thank you making our experience unforgettable. I will be back soon.

reviews.author: Angela
reviews.text: Terrible hotel with bought reviews! Some of the rooms my family stayed in had a whole ceiling of black mold which was huge, the AC was bugged and the room smelled terrible! The service also terrible, barely any staff speak English, only their language, barely any bilingual! The location is alright, beach was severely murky this time. Nothing for kids to do, except the basic swimming pools. Definitely if you travel with family go to a different place.

reviews.author: Maureen Thornborrow
reviews.text: Our stay at Paradisus was made awesome by our new friends at Kicks Sports Bar. Miguel, Taron and Yiri took great care of us.

reviews.author: MARICELA VELASCO
reviews.text: Paradisus Palma Real Golf & Spa Resort was absolutely amazing & beautiful! The entire vibe was chill & relaxing! Everything was there. No need to go out of the resort for anything. Beach is breathtaking…

reviews.author: Jack Evangelio
reviews.text:
Japanese restaurant (Tokimeku santo and yavany) Good food, great dancers fun times! Its a must when you go!

Kicks bar is lit!!!!  Everynight is a must! Bartender knows the good drinks! Victor ane Miguel one of the best bartender i have met! I always tell them to make me a good drink and they have never failed even once. Also to Luis, he knows how to take care of the Guest. But the biggest shoutout to Fior!!!, outstanding customer service! She takes care of us i mean going above and beyond.

To Jose and Emmanuel, ensuring that before and aftee our excursion, from the day we arrived to the day we departed they always ensure we are good to go always.

reviews.author: Parker Tavares
reviews.text: Arisleyda and Rosanna were the best! So sweet and helpful loved having them around to help us out! Would come back just for them!

reviews.author: Pamela Parker
reviews.text: Top level resort - beautiful property, great food, incredible service and attention to detail, professional and friendly. Our concierge Ralphy was amazing and went above and beyond! Reynaldo and Robinson at activities and pool were also super friendly and helpful! Absolutely great - 5 out of 5!

reviews.author: Erin Taylor
reviews.text:
Wide selection at the buffet. Good service and coffee! Beautiful location. Rosanna was very attentive at breakfast.

Brandon Perez and Danny were great at the soap making class.

reviews.author: Sandra Wyatt
reviews.text: Gorgeous resort with top notch service.  Everyone who works there were so friendly and outgoing. We stayed on the Royal Service side and had a private butler (Faustino) who was amazing.  We were entitled to premium drinks from the bar and seperate pool. One particular night, we came back from a day at the pool to find Faustino had prepared a rose petal bubble bath in our private jacuzzi.  Regardless of which part of this resort you stay in, you will not be disappointed.   The food was really good for an all inclusive resort. My only complaint were the people who harass you on the beach to purchase items. The resort pool was huge and well maintained.  I can not stress the importance of sunscreen.  The sun is strong here and my husband and I both came home with the worst sun burn of our life.

reviews.author: Alyssa O
reviews.text:
When my best friend invited me to her wedding in the D.R., I had no idea what to expect. Once the van doors opened up into the breath-taking entry of the main lobby until I had to depart for the airport; Luciano and Jimmy took great care of me and with a smile!

At the front desk, I'm not sure who was more excited for us to be there. Us or Wilmer Donastorg! Even though communication can be difficult- His uplifting spirit and knowledge of the resort made me feel so welcomed and excited! Along with his colleagues; Katherine Lantigua, Ervia Medina and Gorge!

In the evening, Ramon Lorenzo, Nathally and Robenson were there to help me with my ever need-- and I had a few! They went above and beyond to make my stay comfortable; one of my favorite trips.

At the Kanna Bar, Liz was always there to make me feel like a true VIP! I do not recall the lady that often was assisting her but together they kept the Tito's flowing! Make sure you also visit the Spa and ask for Eva! If you need your nails done with YHI, make sure to contact Katherine, she's friendly and helped pick out the perfect color!

Need a cigar? I forget her name, perhaps Taboqwina ? Regardless, she very helpful in picking out the perfect gifts for the wedding party celebrations!

These are just some of the other amazing staff members that you will run into here at the resort that make your experience in paradise something truly magical.

Thank you all and I will see you again soon <3 Alyssa O'Malia #3312 -> 4302# <3 <3 <3

Playas de Bavaro, Punta Cana 23000
Hotel Confirmation: 370orcNZNo & Aprobacion: 71755Z

(***helpful hint - at the very least practice Spanish and/or speak slowly and have patience. It's island time, and we're visiting. Be appreciative and respectful of people and the environment. EXCHANGE at the airport so everyone is happy. TIPS & leave reviews for those who really make your trip special***)

reviews.author: Roger Baranda
reviews.text: Tokimeku restuarant waiter frank and chef felix mejia and cirilio were great! great service and entertainment! Also Mina restuarant was awesome. Alex and Reynaldo Martinez was also great !

reviews.author: Maria Henry
reviews.text: This is our second trip here since we loved it so much the first time! Our concierge Anayely has been the best and so attentive to all of our wants and needs on this trip! Also the breakfast crepes at the breakfast buffet are my favorite every morning! Can’t wait to come back!

reviews.author: Shannon Anderson
reviews.text: The resort staff was mostly nice and the safety measures were complete and made us feel safe. Wanda at the Sunset Bar made fantastic drinks and provided excellent service!  Pedro at the reserve pool and beach was fantastic!  He made recommendations and anticipated our needs often setting up towels under our favorite umbrella and bringing us drinks before we needed to ask.

reviews.author: Alaina Zimmerman
reviews.text: We ate at Mina tonight and had Olvi as our server. He was very attentive and kind, very good at his job! The food was delicious and the experience was very classy. Would highly recommend Mina and Olvi!

reviews.author: EESHA SHANKAR
reviews.text: Had so much fun with Maria and Michael during the Mamajuana experience! I've never tasted rum before (I'm only 22!!) but they made it so fun and so informational! Thanks so much for a fun afternoon and  an amazing week!

reviews.author: Joseph Cruz
reviews.text: We stayed at a suite and it’s super spacious. We had an amazing time. The staff at Kidsdom were great with our kids, the buffet and restaurants were great, and we loved the drinks at Ginger Bar. Highly recommended for big groups of families.

reviews.author: Mary Vorias
reviews.text: Paradisus Palma Real is a fantastic resort we spent the last week here and didn’t have one negative thing to say I am a beach lover and for me I can’t think of a better place to get the sun and relax  Raphael and his team at the beach made sure everyday that we would have a sunbed and make sure that are glasses were never empty I will definitely be back as soon as possible

reviews.author: Cristy Garcia
reviews.text: Edward is the best! This trip was the first my friends were able to take post covid to finally celebrate their wedding! We were cared to from beginning to end. First rate service, extremely accommodating, and we created wonderful memories! Lucia, Gustavo, and Pedro are the most fantastic bartenders - the best mud slides I’ve ever had! Highly recommend the Reserve service for a top rate experience!

reviews.author: marinue briseno
reviews.text: Enjoyed the stay. Very clean and nice employees. Fun activities Ron Tasting with Jorge Rafael, Anthony Ortiz, Juan Vicente. Best service at ginger bar from Yiri and Lucia, best coffee on hotel.

reviews.author: Sanjay Parekh
reviews.text:
Overall we had an amazing experience!  The front desk made sure we liked the rooms
and by next day they changed our rooms so we can be next to our family.

This resort is beautiful with amazing service especially Yaleidi Sims who was our
Concierge. She coordinated with the Head Restaurant Supervisor,  Hipolito where they made sure the vegetarian meals were made for us in their restaurants.

Hipolito and Felix from the Flora Restaurant, went out their way to give is world class service! Especially when some restaurants were closed but with one request they delivered drinks and dishes of our liking.

Lastly the evening entertainment were very amazing; like singers, circus events, jazz band and other instrumental performers! Elvis Band was amazing!

The Paradisus Palma Real is definitely a high end all inclusive property!  Highly Recommend them in Punta Cana !

reviews.author: Aaron Dickens
reviews.text: Loved the resort. Everything was amazing. Beautiful property. Wonderful room. Great pools. The Mexican restaurant was the best of all the food. The service from Dayhani was incredible. She was wonderful! Definitely recommend coming here and spending a week!

reviews.author: Brent Clarke
reviews.text:
Yiri amazing very friendly , attentive and very good in treating all the guest .  Anytime we come to Ginger Bar she is always smiles and always take good care of us..

Flora restaurant
Andrea  amazing !! Excellent service, very friendly and attentive..

reviews.author: Daniel Flores
reviews.text: Amazing place, twice here! The staff are so great the service amazing. During our stay we had the pleasure of dining at Blue Aguve, Our waiter Delvin was incredible! @Tokimeku chef Chef Kelvin # 7, the bartenders Maria & Natanael were great and made us feel at home! Both places 5 out of 5 stars for service and comfort!!

reviews.author: Ron Melbourne
reviews.text: Went for a 5 day stay over New Years and loved it.  Nice rooms, good food, and a beautiful spot on the beach.  A little bit quiet on nightly entertainment, and only a few different options for restaurants on site.  Definitely worth the price for a relaxing all inclusive beach vacation.

reviews.author: Anna Vergara
reviews.text: Tokimeku so far the best food here at Paradisus.  Restaurant is clean.  Felix did a wonderful hibachi show and Jose our waiter is so attentive.  Higly recommend.

reviews.author: Lloyd McKinney
reviews.text: The sushi workshop  was an amazing experience. The team leading the workshop was full of positive energy and love. Shoutout to Jorge, Jovanny and Aida! You’ve got to check out Palma Real when you visit Punta Cana. Best resort in the Dominican Republic.

reviews.author: Vanessa Gallo
reviews.text: The palma real is great! The food and service is incredible. Irvin was a great concierge, he was very attentive to detail and worked super hard to make sure we were comfortable and had an incredible experience. Would highly recommend staying here!!

reviews.author: Rene Beites
reviews.text: We had an amazing trip! Specifically a special thanks to Daiana Rodriguez for making us feel like her family. Her smile and warm welcome whenever we would see her was so heartwarming. I hope to see her again someday!

reviews.author: Aliyah Thomas
reviews.text: Love love love this resort! Victor was amazingggg at the hibachi restaurant! Franklin at Sante was the absolute best and he helped me with my spanish every morning. The hospitality from everyone here my entire trip was unmatched! 10/10!!! All the way to when we left! Jose assisted us from the room to the car to the airport. Everyone needs to book here !!

reviews.author: Robin Smith
reviews.text: We really enjoyed having drinks at the Ginger Bar.  Yiri, Lucia, Jose and the guest service marielisa were all incredibly friendly and helpful. We had great Martinis, wonderful coffee and a fantastic time.

reviews.author: Judith Wartinbee
reviews.text: Our concierge named Starlin T was amazing. He catered to our every need. I needed to be near the ground floor and he made sure that that was done because of my disabilities. Everything here was extremely clean and nice. I couldn’t have asked for a nicer place to stay. Thank you and we will be back again, Judy and Craig Wartinbee

reviews.author: Raji Aubi
reviews.text: Kicks sports bar was amazing. They made me a local special drink which was delicious. Andreina, Miguel, Jose and LUIS took amazing care of us. They all added to a great experience

reviews.author: Sophia Artiles
reviews.text: Edward our butler was wonderful! He went above and beyond all week for us! Our trip was phenomenal! We had our wedding at the resort and we couldn’t have been happier with the execution and our wedding planner, Mariangel. Franklin also took amazing care of us all weekend! Service is on point. We will be back again!

reviews.author: Lou M
reviews.text: This is a huge complex with many amenities to choose from. The staff is extremely mannered and pleasant. The hotel, accommodation, food and drinks are impeccable and tasteful. Our concierge Anayely Rivera was always prompt to our requests and very attentive to our needs. She went above and beyond to accommodate our requests. My only disappointment was the distance from the hotel to the beach. It’s a 25 minute walk, no room with ocean views as I thought we had booked. Nevertheless, we were granted a Certificate of Stay for another vacation there. The only problem is you can’t get them on the phone to book it! lol

reviews.author: Madison Gilley
reviews.text: We absolutely loved our 7 day stay The Reserve Paradisus Palma Real! Our favorite part of the trip was the local people and wonderful staff! Our rooms were conjoining on the 3rd floor. We always had anything we needed thanks to our fantastic concierge, Jessica. She was very attentive to our needs and always incredibly friendly and approachable. We attended dance classes, cigar rolling, soap making, wine tasting, mixology, and more, each being uniquely fun. The evening dance/parties were energetic and created some of our favorite memories. We would like to give a special shout out to some of our favorite staff members and new found friends. All of the servers were fantastic - Domingo, Luis, Katy and Betty were some of our favorite servers, always welcoming us with big smiles, hugs, and happy personalities every morning at breakfast as well as pool side and at dinner reservations. They quickly recognized our favorite drink orders and daily requests. Of course, at an all inclusive resort, the Gabi club bar & swim up was where we spent the majority of our time. Our bartenders were very attentive, helpful, friendly, and accommodating of our "special" requests. Specifically Genmarie, Antonio, Gustavo and Diana. We also had a great time, and a lot of laughs at Wine Tasting with Johanna and Jonathan. All of the bartenders were not only incredibly professional and efficient but were genuinely likable, inclusive and welcoming. We were happy and upbeat all day, everyday (and night) in large part due to the efforts of Reynaldo, Alejandro/ "Happy boy", Axel and more. They kept us involved, energized and laughing everyday. From ping-pong "tournaments" with Reynaldo to dance lessons with Alejandro and axel, and a million other wonderful encounters in between. There were so many other people who made our trip so memorable, and we can't remember everyones name! This was our best ever vacation and truly was so memorable thanks to all the people mentioned in this post. We will most definitely return to The Reserve, and we are already looking forward to our next visit. We were all so sad to leave, tears were shed on the bus trip to the airport. We have never been surrounded by such a welcoming and positive environment. We could go on and on about our experience at this resort... These people truly became our friends and we want to thank them immensely for the wonderful memories they gave us. Hasta luego mi familla <3

reviews.author: Orisel Bejaran
reviews.text:
Went to Kick’s Sports Bar and Adreina and Fior treated us so well. If you make it down there, please check them out. Kind, professional and attentive.

We also had the pleasure of having Alvaro as our personal concierge while we were are Paradisus. He was able to accommodate any and all requests we had and nothing was too big or too small.

At our poolside tiki bar, we had the amazing, Wanda and Yuderi (aka Barahona) making sure that we had the coldest beers and tastiest drinks by the water. They were assisted by Grey and Gilberto and I cannot tell you how incredibly amazing they all truly were. Please come here and meet them to confirm for yourself ♥️

reviews.author: Mary Torres
reviews.text: Over all our stay was good. Food at the restaurants was great yet buffet was good but not enough variety. The hotel was clean and the room was specious but as long as the room was it need a little updating. People were very friendly and welcoming. One of the main reasons I give a 4 start is because if you booked for paradises Palma real you won’t be going to this actual hotel. They are remodeling it and you will have to stay next door at paradises the reserve. Our concierge simeon was very friendly and helped us with anything we need it, from making restaurant reservations to helping us book our covid test. This was not the resort I wanted to go but over all was good.

reviews.author: Christopher Harris
reviews.text: The restaurant Mas Calzones could not have left a better impression on us. Service and quality is clearly at the top of their priorities. 5 star service focused on the guests experience. If you want it it, they will make it happen. Special recognition for Alejandro, Raider, Bautista, and Yuleni Jose. We were never left without someone attending our every need and want. The food was top notch and we look forward to returning. They have left us without a desire to look elsewhere.

reviews.author: Chloe 96
reviews.text:
We're in the middle of our 12 day vacation at Paradisus Palma Real. The hotel and rooms are beautiful. The views and beach are spectacular.

The water is seaweedy, but that is a regional issue, not the hotel's. They do keep the beach clean with grooming machines. My husband has walked down the beach past other resorts and said this property has the best setup for sunbathing with lots of cabanas and large umbrellas.

Service is very good and if we have any issues or requests our concierge Ariel is extremely helpful and goes out of his way to make sure we get everything requested. If something is wrong they are sure to fix it.
Also online access on Melia app to make requests and WhatsApp communication to make it easy and free for everyone.

Food is good, same quality at all the restaurants and buffets. Ample choices. Also has 24hr room service with good quality food. Can get drinks and ice delivered as well.

Lots of activities to choose from.

Has a family section and an adults only section of hotel. We ended up in the family section because of the room type I wanted - Nikte with swim-up pool. Definitely worth it and bigger rooms in the family section.
Seems to be a quiet resort, not a party place which is exactly what we were looking for.

reviews.author: Tanja Radenkovic
reviews.text:
Edito is the best server in the resort. Always smiling and very helpful. I started saying super fantastico as much as he does!

Aeriol is the best concierge here. He is very helpful and always magically there whenever you need him! Made our first family vacation since Covid effortless easy and stress free.

The macrame class was alot of fun. Bonding experience with my daughter was awesome! The ladies were very helpful and friendly.

The mixology and sushi classes are a must-do! Hairon is friendly and always joking around making all activities so much fun.

Highly recommend Asian restaurant for a fun dining experience and the Mexican restaurant food was my favourite. Waiters were knowledgeable about gluten free requirements of our party and always willing to help make accommodations and recommendations.

reviews.author: Tiffany Richardson
reviews.text: We had a wonderful time at Paradisus Real.  Beautiful hotel, beach, and pool. Everyone was very friendly and welcoming. Jorge was so fun and helpful with wa fibrous.  Samuel was very friendly fun and welcoming.  We loved our stay!

reviews.author: Ilan Braude
reviews.text: Just finished up a wonderful dinner at Malva food bazar at the Paradisus Palma Real in Punta Cana. The food was delicious, the atmosphere was wonderful and the staff were delightful. Stormin (supervisor), Franklin, Juan, Carlo and Pamela made our night so special, including helping accommodate some picky eaters.

reviews.author: Angeles Alvarado
reviews.text: Exceeded expectations in every way! Super fun, delicious food, attentive staff! Definitely recommend! Jorge Rafael and Jennifer Amparo were especially exceptionally amazing and kind, always ready to serve by the pool!

reviews.author: Abi A
reviews.text:
Amazing experience @ this hotel. Shout out to Antonio & his crew(Angie, Dominga , Clari & Roysa)
@ Ginger that made the best cocktails!!!!!
Kudos!!!!!
I’ll be back!!!!

reviews.author: Felipe Herter
Lillian Sullo
reviews.text: Alll I can say is this resort is truly a 5 star hotel.  The moment we walked in we where greeted by our concierge Eriol Alix.  My boyfriend  and I went to celebrate my birthday that week and he made sure I celebrate everyday.   He even  went above and beyond to decorate my room and set up a cake and champagne.  He really made us feel special.  I would definitely recommend this place and hopefully you would be as lucky as I was to have Ariol as a concierge.

reviews.author: Jeff Dam
reviews.text: Vianny and Fior, our waitresses at Kicks sports bar,  provided us with great service during our stay. Even when busy, our group was provided with speedy service and great drinks and

reviews.author: Gabriela Rodriguez
reviews.text: This place is honestly great, not only is the food amazing but the service is even better. Makati is very attentive and nice. I came here with my family and every day we go to the beach he makes sure we are constantly taken care of. I highly recommend!

reviews.author: Jawad Afshari
reviews.text: The service was exemplary and the staff were super friendly. Maximo is a waiter he was very patient and understanding. And the manager Ariel was very helpful booking excursions and transportation. Overall the rooms and food were a 10/10

reviews.author: Sarah Ahmed
reviews.text:
Excellent service here from Milton and the whole staff.

Food came out perfectly cooked, and we enjoyed the amazing ambiance.

We will definitely be coming back!

reviews.author: MIRANDA BORGES FERRO
reviews.text:
This is a great hotel for people /families that like more of a quiet place. We found some great food like restaurant flora (amazing Dominican food) and the stake house where we celebrate a birthday. There are some amazing people Including Diana Rodriguez that was our host for 2 nights (I can't say enough good things about her!) Gleny that served us in Mina and Flora (also amazing) Kelvin and Dionys at the Mina restaurant.
We want to come back for sure!

reviews.author: hodaya levinger
reviews.text:
This review is about the restaurant Mina Dionys  was our guy. He was awesome! He got our food right and right away :) he gives as everything that we need
we come again amazing restaurant and amazing workers
Ginger Bar it’s amazing!!!
And Ismael Antonio dominqa clary nereida everyone was amazing!!!

reviews.author: Alexander Ney
reviews.text: We were so lucky to arrive and see our favorite bartender Edison Alcántara. His friendliness, attention to detail, and superior mixology set him apart from the rest of the amazing staff. His fellow bartender Lillian at the Lobby bar is also a joy. Overall the quality of the restaurants has improved since the last time we came here.

reviews.author: Divine Life Attendance
reviews.text: The food in the buffet was always great. Rosanna, Maria, Laicna, and Alexander were always on top of things and making sure we had everything we needed. 11/10 service!

reviews.author: Mike Cherry
reviews.text: Franklin Yael Santana and Luis came promptly when we had a problem with our lights in our room and some other electrical issues. They came right away and fixed all of our issues and also made our small children feel comfortable while fixing. Extremely friendly and accommodating when it could have been a long wait otherwise. Franklin Yael Santana also spoke very good English which made it a lot easier to communicate. Glad to have their help!

reviews.author: Laurie Ruotolo
reviews.text: Sunilda,Franklin misael Gustavo,Nilza and the rest of the staff, at the Sante restaurant on the Palma Real were amazing so accommodating friendly the service was five star, and the food was five stars highly recommend went to rum tasting this afternoon excellent service what a great activity. YIisleni from activity and Juan from the bar were outstanding we had a great time highly recommend

reviews.author: Del Nathan
reviews.text: Everything was great about Paradisus Palma Real. Great food overall including buffet. Mr Chef Rafiel Mates and Jose del rosario waiter served us well at teppanyaki.

reviews.author: Mary Foy
reviews.text:
I stayed there for 5 days.   It was wonderful.   The service is top notch.  The rooms are adequate but a little small.  The food in the all ages side is hit or miss but the all adults restaurant Sante is good and the service from the staff was impeccable.
It Is a beautiful all inclusive that i would recommend.

reviews.author: Eric Carter
reviews.text: Amazing! Is all I can say Jose Ramos and his assistant Benjamin Luis is by far the best servers I have ever had! My wife and I have traveled and eaten all over the world. Jose made our trip!! Without him I feel it would have just been OK. But nope it was fantastic!! Thank You is not enough. Of just a small portion of waitstaff in world were as good as Jose that serves the world be that much more amazing! Thank You!!!

reviews.author: Winifred Robinson
reviews.text: Francisco Rofe was excellent,  he serviced me and my guest like queens.  We truly appreciate all of his manurisms, it is hard to find people to consistently treat the guest with kindness, care and compassion. Because of him I would patronize The Lunch Box, or The Falcon on my return to the DR. Thank you so much Mr Rofe, I will never forget you🩷🩷🙏🏽🙌🏾🥳🥳 This was a Incentive Trip earned... I would also like to say even with the language bearer the staff was very accommodating and friendly.

reviews.author: Ohione Ilavbare
reviews.text: Milton and his team were excellent at the Italian restaurant Mascalzone. Yuleni served us and was very professional. I would highly recommend visiting here.

reviews.author: Bella
reviews.text: Paradisus was a great resort, very impressed by the rooms and service. The lobby’s Ginger Bar is highly recommended. Shout out to Jairo for the activity leading in both pizza making and mixology class and Yensy for leading our mixology class. Our favourite server was Franklin Diaz at Malva for dinner, he recommended great cocktails/shots and was attentive and personable from start to end

reviews.author: David Fraga
reviews.text: Ginger bar gets 5 stars for excellent coffee, exceptional service! Ismael, Antonio, Dominga, Olga, Yeni, y Clary are such excellent and happy baristas! Greatly enjoyed starting off our day at Ginger bar!

reviews.author: Charlie Hess
reviews.text: Flora - the service was great and food was delicious! Ana Michel was great and very helpful for us. Highly recommmend

reviews.author: Samantha Butler
reviews.text: Absolutely the best meal we have had at the resort! Would eat here everyday if possible. The service was great and the food was phenomenal. Would give 10 stars if possible. If you are at this resort this restaurant is an absolute must.

reviews.author: Scott Steward
reviews.text: Armando was our Butler while we stayed at this awesome resort! Armando was fantastic! Hands down, an absolute pleasure to deal with and made things super simple, and worry free! Armando was extremely attentive to our needs and requests. This was the first time I have ever stayed at an all inclusive resort, and definitely a decision I will make again with the Paradisus Palma Real Golf & Spa Resort!  Armando also went out of his way to make our stuff extra special as my wife and I were celebrating our birthdays/anniversary (was the only time we could get away)! The grounds were beautiful, and the pools were amazing, including the drinks! Bottom line, this trip was great, and the added touch of having a Butler was phenomenal, especially that we had the privilege to meet Armando!

reviews.author: Maria Kirsch
reviews.text: We’re here on vacation for a week and our first dinner was at a beautiful Italian restaurant, Mascalzone. The food was delicious and the service was excellent. Shoutout to Yessica, Milton, and Wilminia for their amazing service. They were very hospitable and friendly.

reviews.author: Mechelle Mutkoski
reviews.text: Lewis De LaCruz! My family of 8 was blessed this past week to have Lewis as our concierge. He walked us through a few bumps and in the end we were better off than we imagined. Lewis took the time to get to know my adult kids & senior parents and even surprised us all one night with very personalized gifts. We made excellent memories. Thank you Lewis!

reviews.author: Maya Yegorova
reviews.text: What a slice of heaven! Francesca in Flora and Victor the cocktail machine was AMAZING! Beautiful property, amazing daily activities, gorgeous beach with stunning water, great pool. A dream come true. I can cry. Gracias por todos!

reviews.author: Lino Sánchez
reviews.text: Maria and Cirilo gave us impeccable service at Tokimeku. Very attentive, they were very welcoming. Maria was very mindful about our allergies and accomodated us like kings. Top service!

reviews.author: Elysa Doyer
reviews.text: We stayed here from January 27th to February 3th. We were 6 people in The Reserve section with Zenovia for concierge. she was attentive and available. She prepared a special evening for my mother's birthday. whenever we needed something we could count on her! very nice week in a magnificent hotel with particular attention paid to cleanliness! we will return without hesitation!

reviews.author: Tanya Rapp
reviews.text: Our waiter Rafael and Stormin was excellent! They had a mariachi band that was amazing as well. Highly recommend eating here! The pasta station was top notch and so was the chef!!!

reviews.author: Carla Murcia
reviews.text:
Hands down the best hotel I’ve ever been too! The bars, the service, the food, location, Everything is top notch!! Clean, beautiful, aesthetically pleasing, gorgeous beach. One of the best vacation experiences of my life. Shout out to Magda Noruso at the main pool bar!! She is AMAZING!! The 2 women serving up drinks at the 90 degrees swim up bar had the party going, their energy is unmatched. they made the best Coco Locos.

The lobby bar, Ginger! Omg! Best coffee and pastries. Ask for Ismael! Friendliest barista around.

The Lunch Box buffet has delicious food but the service is what had us coming back for every meal. Yafreisi Soler, Yanira Sosa and Mary Tejada are the sweetest girls who made every dining experience so much fun.

The hardest part about this whole trip was leaving. Paradisus really is paradise.

reviews.author: Jennifer Hallam
reviews.text: Everyone that works at Paradisus Palma Real provided excellent service. They were attentive, energetic, interactive and overall excellent. The accommodations were beautifully designed, well maintained and enjoyable overall. The sports bar serves Yiri, Andreina, Fior and Victor provided excellent customer service, drinks and a fun atmosphere. Would definitely recommend to others.

reviews.author: Dani Maresky
reviews.text: Jordania welcomed us with open arms and was nothing but helpful. The resort is beautiful, fun and definitely worth while visiting…. Maybe even to live here ;) I love it here!! Very accommodating with food allergies as well. Thanks for the ever last memories Paradisus.

reviews.author: Caren Mikhail
reviews.text:
Excellent service, Rosanna and Yanira at the restaurant are the best!
We also had excellent service by Jean Carlo at Mina restaurant. Also at the Mexican restaurant Santo, Delvin and Alexander are exceptional!!

reviews.author: Pete Chan
reviews.text:
This is our first time visiting DR. The PARADISUS is a beautiful property and our room was beautiful. Very spacious, clean, new and the swim-up was great.

Our concierge was Harry Milor. He made our visit memorable. From making dinner reservations ( which books up very fast -this was a stressful process for someone on vacation) to helping us book excursion tours and being a great general guide around the property and send us daily activity schedules, Harry’s friendly service made our stay worthwhile.

One area for improvement is the food quality especially the buffet and snack bar (Kanna Beach club- half the items on the menu were not available).

Another is the App, it doesn’t provide much timely and useful info. Good thing Harry came through for us.

reviews.author: Cathy Gilham
reviews.text: we had an amazing time due to being so well taken care of by Starlin Tavares, an amazing Guest Services Concierge with the Paradisus.  He guaranteed restaurant reservations and made sure we were aware of all the amenities available to us.  He helped us arrange tour activities and just helped to make every day special

reviews.author: Gina Grimaldi
reviews.text: Ismeal did amazing with our drinks and everytime we get milkshakes. He was an absolute DARLING!!! this place is amazing at Ginger Bar - Shout out to Criceida, Antonio, Yenny! Great staff. thank you!

reviews.author: M. Parker
reviews.text: Thank you Mina! The food was delicious! The rib eye was huge! The wine was chill and Kelvin was especially great to us!

reviews.author: Colleen Horsley
reviews.text:
Very nice resort and the service is great. Sante restaurant… I don’t know where  to start …
… breakfast wonderful and nice … great staffing and ambiance … special thanx to Juan !!! He most definitely added to the ambiance and had us make the decision to come eat dinner there at Sante !!!

reviews.author: Jessica Masciarelli
reviews.text: Great resort! Only downside I noticed was the amount of seaweed the beach had, besides that, the staff and the service is really good and the hotel is beautiful. Was here with my husband celebrating our 10th anniversary and stayed at the royal service. Definitely worth the upgrade! Moises was our butler and took care of all our reservations and made sure we were having a great time with champagne, chocolate strawberries, cake and fruit delivered to us in the swimming pool.

reviews.author: Alfredo Fernandez, MD, FASMBS
reviews.text: Georgi in Italian restaurants, Zenovia our concierge, AMAZING, EXCELLENT!! Hands down best service ever. These two are the reason you want to come here. The service is beyond an explanation. They make you feel welcomed, are anxious to please, wonderful people. Come see them.

reviews.author: Aida R.
reviews.text:
The best place in Punta Cana to rest and enjoy vacations. Excellent customer services and great food quality!

Hector our concierge was a great helper in all of our needs.

All the team is working to make this the best of experiences.

Was there last year, went back this year and will definitely return soon.

#circlemember ✌🏽

reviews.author: michelle cedeno
reviews.text: Beautiful resort. The best service I received was at Flora restaurant. Stefania was exceptional, the best server I have ever had. 5 stars to Stefania.

reviews.author: Minal Shah Mathias
reviews.text:
Restaurant Blueagave is great for Mexican food.  The service by the staff was great.  Santo was very helpful.

Kidsdom is amazing.  Alexandra is amazing and takes great care of the kids.

reviews.author: Layla Gunning

reviews.author: Adrienne Gannon
reviews.text:
The food is awful! Punta Cana does not cater to Americans...it's more food you'd see in Europe. So, if you like corn on your pizza (yes, I said corn), or deli meat for breakfast, etc... than maybe you'd be okay. After speaking to countless people at the resort that were from U.S....everyone had the same takeaway "food is disgusting".

Hotel property is very nice and so is the beach. However, the panhandlers are terrible. They do not have any restrictions on the island and are able to come up right up to your beach chair. It's VERY annoying!

Entertainment at night is weak. They really don't have much going on at the hotel.

So, the resort was nice but I'm not sure I'd return to Punta Cana. I'd use your money toward another island in which you can get a better experience all together.

reviews.author: Mike Bronstein
reviews.text:
Absolutely Disgusting: A Nightmare Stay at Melia Paradisus Golf Resort

My recent stay at Melia Paradisus Golf Resort in Punta Cana was nothing short of a nightmare. From the moment I entered my room, I was plagued by an infestation of bedbugs. My entire body was covered in itchy, painful bites, and my skin was inflamed and raw.

The hotel's response to my situation was both shocking and disrespectful. When I reported the bedbug infestation, the staff initially denied its existence. It wasn't until I insisted that they finally agreed to move me to a different room. However, this was done far too late, as I was already suffering from severe bites and discomfort.

Throughout my ordeal, I was met with a lack of empathy and concern from the hotel staff and management. Their dismissive attitude towards my situation was truly appalling. I would strongly advise anyone considering staying at this resort to think twice. The Melia Paradisus Golf Resort is a disgusting establishment that clearly prioritizes profits over the well-being of its guests.

reviews.author: William Colona
reviews.text:
My family and I just got back from Paradisus Palma Real Golf and Spa Resort and we had an exceptional time! From the moment we landed in the Dominican Republic the hotel was already helping us. They arranged travel from the airport to the hotel, and we were met with a seamless check-in process. The folks at the front desk got us situated, explained how the property worked, and assigned us to a concierge (Wily) to help us out with reservations, excursions, or anything else we'd need. The property is stunning, clean and family friendly. We also felt very safe at this resort. The food was EXCELLENT. The staff are truly what make this place special. Ms. Luz of Houskeeping took note of when our family would come and go and would always make our room fresh for us to come back to. She was so, so, nice. The staff by the pool bar near Building 40, namely Edickson Morales and Ms. Tejada were our favorites, always making sure we had everything we needed the entire time. When we were ready to leave, Jose R. handled our luggage and cared for them as if they were his own.

All in all there is not a single thing to complain about from this dream vacation my family and I had. We very much look forward to the next time we go to the Dominican Republic, and it will ABSOLUTELY be at the Paradisus Palma Real.

reviews.author: zajale123
reviews.text:
We spent a wonderful week-long vacation at this all-inclusive resort on Bavaro Beach in Punta Cana, Dominican Republic. It's on a vast property owned by Melia with several other of their resorts accessible via a golf shuttle. You're greeted by bellman who take your bags and welcome you to an open-air, luxury lobby with accompanying lounge/bar [Ginger], and a well manicured view of the resort plaza and the ocean not far beyond. The view is absolutely stunning, and along with immediate beach access comes several pools flanking the housing areas on both sides of the resort and a giant one in the middle with a swim up bar.

Staff were incredibly attentive, warm, and professional. They are genuinely invested in every guest having an amazing stay. Service was prompt and with several dining options throughout the day and at night, even while waiting to be seated there are still places to go and things to keep you busy. Live entertainment, bars, shopping, you name it. One restaurant, the Tokimeku, requires reservation for their live dining experience. For standard dining, there are no reservations required for them or any of the other eateries. The hotel has several activities available daily, spaces and programs to entertain children, as well as couples packages and experiences available.

Every need was accomodated with hospitality and friendliness. As a non-Spanish speaker I found it easy to communicate with staff and someone was always willing to help translate. Even the housekeeping was considerate, organized, and honestly a blessing. We got to know several staff by name and these wonderful interactions have forever associated the Dominican Republic with nothing but positivity for us. There are people on the beach who attempt to interest you in excursions and various other purchases but even they were respectful when we declined interest! I never felt unsafe, disrespected, or discarded as a young Black woman. We had a blast! Good food, good people, and good liquor - prepare to have a great time!

Thank you Stephanie and Nikaury [The Lunch Box], Antonio and Ismael [Ginger], Ulise [Blue Agave], and directors Alan and Jorge for your time, your service, and your company! We had such a wonderful experience we are looking forward to visiting our newfound friends again next year :)

Additionally, the hotel partners with a tour company called Otium which you can reserve a ride to and from the airport to the hotel ahead of time. Highly recommend!! And please remember to tip and respect the environment!

reviews.text: Noche Dominicana was a lot of fun. Love seeing the artist selling local crafts. Food here is 👍🏼 good. 😊. Soranyi was always smiling and making activities fun.

reviews.author: Cassandra Gade
reviews.text: I came to the Paradisus Palma Real as a solo traveler and stayed in the Reserve area of the resort in an Oceanfront suite. My booking came with an airport transfer, which I arranged prior to my arrival which made the whole process seamless after arriving at the airport. It was chaotic in that area of the airport to say the least, but the Otium attendant spotted me and I was whisked away to their van as other travelers had to find transportation to their resorts. If your booking includes the airport transfer, you have to arrange it in advance. This was an easy process that involved filling out an online form with basic questions about your arrival/departure, etc. It will save you time and kick your vacation off on the right foot. It was maybe a 20 minute drive to the resort from the airport. I was checked in by the lovely Angel and escorted to my room and shown several points of interest on the property along the way. I was assigned a personal concierge, Zenovia, who was phenomenal. She made all my dinner reservations for each night I was there. She also helped me with extra stuff and checked in with me multiple times per day to make sure I was ok and didn’t need anything. I developed a severe toothache while I was there and not only did I learn that you can get medications like antibiotics without a prescription, but Zenovia even went to the pharmacy to get it for me and I was able to quickly continue on with my vacation. She consistently went above and beyond to ensure I was happy and had everything I needed. When I accidentally broke a glass just as I was about to jump in the shower to get ready for dinner, she showed up in her beautiful cream suit with her broom and dustpan in hand and cleaned it up. Having her was invaluable and truly elevated my experience, especially as a solo traveler. The beach was lovely and there were an abundance of seating options. No need to rush to the beach to grab an umbrella and chairs. The beach also had its own adults only section which was great. I did spend more time at the pool however because the vendors walking the beach selling stuff came to be quite annoying when I was just trying to relax. There was a vendor coming by every few minutes with something new to sell. The pools were great. I spent most of my time at the adults only pool. Wanda at the Fahrenheit Bar was amazing. After the first day she knew what I liked to drink and would check-in with me while I was in the pool or lying in the lounge chair to see if I needed anything. I rarely had to go up to the bar, which was nice. Overall, I had a great time and would definitely return to this resort and would recommend it to others. The staff were all kind and welcoming and anytime I was at the pool, beach, or really anywhere on the property, there were friendly staff greeting me and asking if I needed anything. It was truly the relaxing vacation I needed.

reviews.author: Norm Hewitt
reviews.text:
We are members for 35 years and this is the best vacation ever service was excellent, thorough and kind.  In particular, the staff at 32 degrees was like family.  Joel and serling were outstanding, particularly accommodating with safety of our young grandchildren.  These gentlemen were observant, and especially professional.  Our previous trips over the years were good, but our family said this was the best.
Gratfully
Norman Hewitt
Long time members

reviews.text:
