reviews.author: Jackelin Vanegas
reviews.text:
The best experience in the restaurant Lunch Box ! The food is unbelievable and the service of Franklin, yeison, Rocio y Rosanna Castillo was the best ! Thank you so much !
We definitely come back again !

reviews.author: Ali Marciano
reviews.text: We had a wonderful week in paradise. Our concierge, Yaleidi Sims, was the BEST! She took care of every reservation for us each night, brought our children beach toys, and even surprised them with a fun bubble bath and balloon art in the room. We really enjoyed the hibachi (ask for Chef Kevin) and the Mexican and steak restaurants. At the beach, look for Ramon for the hook up with drinks and Jonathan at the pool bar. They were both great all week. The highlight for us was the kids club. Joana and Jenni made my kids whole week with their fun activities! Highly recommend the Nikte swim up rooms for anyone with kids. We loved being able to jump in and out of the pool and into our room.

reviews.author: Steph Blodgett
reviews.text:
Sharing my letter that I sent to Paradisus  Palma Real in the DR-I never got a reply...
To management at Paradisus:
I can't tell you how disappointed my husband and I were with our eight day stay from Mar 22-29!  We have stayed at this property numerous times previously and have loved it. It was a completely different and certainly less enjoyable experience this trip.
We booked at the Reserve for our 20th anniversary. When I called the hotel directly to book, I was told the Reserve had been renovated and had all the same amenities-not true! There's one exclusive restaurant ( Sante) since the other part became The Falcon Hotel. Furthermore, when I book the Reserve for "adults only" and you book a large group of teenagers, 17/18 years olds in the Reserve, that is NOT acceptable. I booked the Reserve to have some tranquility-this was far from it. This group of kids took over all the pool space, the bar by the beach, the Sports Bar, etc. The door slamming from their rooms went on night after night. Most were drunk and inconsiderate everyday, along with their chaperones. They went into the restaurants often at lunch without shoes, and sometimes cover ups. I understand you need to book large groups, but they should not be booked in the Reserve area.
We did not find the food this trip to be exceptional either. It was just good.
On a good note, the hotel was well kept and staff service was excellent, especially the Reserve beach service and Sante.
We attended the Circle presentation, too and had considered joining, but we won't probably won't at this time. I even asked for the manager at check out and I was told she was at lunch.
I would appreciate a reply before I post my reviews online about my experience.
Whelp! They didn't reply-so now I'm posting for all to see.

reviews.author: Yoly Diaz
reviews.text: My husband and I stayed at Paradisus Palma Real in Punta Cana from 4/28/2018 to 5/2/2018.  We decided for the Royal Service because my husband has special needs and it was the best decision we have made!!!! First, I have to say that our Butler Alvaro is the best!!!!!  We received a great service from him with many attentions and details.  He not just did the daily reservations for dinner, but also he took care of every request or question that we had.  I told him that the 30st will be our anniversary and that I would like to do something special and he told me that he will take care of it, and he did it.  It was fabulous from the dinner at Rare to the special decoration of our room decorated with balloons, the bubbles at the bathtub and the bottle of wine!!!!!  We are happy with all the details and the way that Alvaro coordinated it.  As to Alvaro, I have to say that we were more than happy to have him during our short vacations.  I have also to say that we received a great service from all the personnel at the restaurants and the beach.  I have to mention Bienvenido, who was our waiter at Rare for our anniversary.  He gave us a great service since we stepped in.  At the time of the desert, he came with a cake singing “Happy Anniversary” to us.  It was memorable and we will remember it as one of our best anniversary celebrations.  I just have to say one thing regarding the royal service.  It was excellent from the beginning, but I believe that it needs a little improvement at the pool because once you are there you practically are by your own with no service at all because the guys are very busy at the beach.  It would be great if you don’t need to go to the bar to request a drink or snack, like when you are at the beach.  It is true that the bar is not far, but for example for my husband with special needs sometimes were a little bit difficult, and it was the reason for us to select the royal service.  Anyway, thank you so much for a great service, and please thanks Alvaro, Bienvenido, and all the personnel for their service and dedication.

reviews.author: Bruce B
reviews.text: Excellent service and good. Very friendly staff

reviews.author: Ilana Torjman
reviews.text: My family has been staying at another Paradisus resort for years, but we tried this resort for the first time and we were pleasantly surprised. We stayed in the Royal Service side with our fabulous butler, Nicolas. He blew our expectations away by tending to every single one of our needs. Also, at the Royal Service pool Carlos, Martin, and Pedro were very attentive. Nicolas made us feel very comfortable from the moment we met him until we had to leave for the airport. From always checking in how our meals were to helping us when we needed recommendations, he always went the extra mile. Our experience would not have been the same without him and I could not imagine coming back and not being able to have Nicolas accompany us along the way.

reviews.author: Denise Higney
reviews.text:
We had a great time with Brandol, Angel and Anthony! They did a great job teaching us the class and making sure we had a great time!

Jairo and Adreina were amazing in our mixology class!  They made it so fun and entertaining. We loved it!!

Brandol was so helpful! He was always coming by to check on us and to see if there was anything he could do to make our stay better! He was so fun and we had such a great time with him!

reviews.author: Pooja Tanwani
reviews.text:
I was travelling with my husband and 11 month old baby and booked to stay in a suite for 5 nights. The room was modern and recently renovated and the resort was right on the beach.

Overall we did enjoy our stay, but we really found the service to be lacking and would not return.
Despite asking for a baby cot at the time of our reservation and again a few days prior to our stay via email we got to a room with no cot and had to wait for 3 hours at 9pm at night after a 14 hour trip to receive one. This was particularly stressful with a sleepy baby who was not sage to sleep in a regular bed on her own. Only after repeatedly calling guest services and being told it would be "5 mins" did they admit that they were trying to locate one as they couldn't find one at that time of night.

I had another issue where the AC in our room stopped working and ,despite asking for maintenance on the Melia app three times and calling guest services twice and being assured we would get someone to come look at it, nothing was done about it.

The food at lunchtime leaves a lot to be desired - it's virtually the same buffet on offer and a beachfront restaurant which serves a very basic menu. Similarly, the room service menu is extremely limited with very slow service and poor quality of food - almost as if to dissuade one from ordering from there.

The dinner restaurants were all great and I can't fault any of the ones I tried (teppanyaki, mexican, steakhouse, Dominican). However, the process of booking them was ludicrous. You can only book a restaurant a day in advance and have to do it at a desk which opens at 9am with queues forming from 845am onwards. It seems like they intentionally inconvenience their non-reserve guests just so they can offer "concierge service" and "ease of booking" for those who pay for the premium package.

I also want to add that on two separate occasions, different staff members asked me to write them a Google review and then proceeded to take my phone off me and write the review themselves and then submit it on my behalf. I have since deleted these as they were insincere but wanted to highlight this as it may shape how prospective bookers see the resort - it certainly swayed me towards booking this particular hotel at the time.

All in all, the bones of the hotel are good, and the hotel could potentially be great if the poor level of service is remedied.

reviews.author: Claudia Dunn
reviews.text: I had a very relaxing vacation at this resort! The food was very good and the service was phenomenal. It is a very laid-back atmosphere but that is how it is advertised. Yafreisi Soler and Yanira Sosa were so sweet and helpful at the buffet. Arisleida Perez, Rosanna Aquino, and Eddy De Los Santos in the adult bar always welcomed us with big smiles. We were so happy with the service we received from these individuals that we had to write their names down so we could give them a shout-out. We truly enjoyed our experience at this resort!! One area of improvement is the WIFI service. I had no connection all trip; the few times we would get a connection, you could not move from that spot. Calls would drop at all times.

reviews.author: Michelle L
reviews.text:
We did it again...another GREAT experience with Melia in Punta Cana! This time it was at the  Paridisus Palma Real. Juan Castillo, our concierge went above and beyond to make our stay memorable. He checked on his "familia" everday, made our reservations for us, and kept us abreast of whatever activities was going on for the day. At one point my husband and I realize we were going to run out of distilled water for our medical devices. You know what... without us asking him to do so, Juan found a location off-site of the resort and purchased the distilled water for us. This is truly what customer service is all about.
Our one bedroom master suite was great! We travel a lot, so I was especially impressed when I walked around in white socks and the socks barely had dirt on them! The room was clean, in working conditions, well stocked and modern. There were various restaurants to choose from and the bars did not skimp on the alcohol. We still have 2 more days here...I'm going to hate leaving and return to reality. If you want a vacation that is truly enjoyable...come to paradise at the Paridisus Palma Real AND ask for Juan Castillo as your concierge!

reviews.text:
My wife and I just returned from a week at Paradisus Palma Real. While the resort is stunning and the overall experience was excellent, our only issue was the room. We weren’t too impressed with the old TV / mattress, the 80’s outdated decor and also the very low pressure shower— all in rough conditions and in need of a complete revamp —, especially considering that we booked the Royal Service.
Aside from the room, entertainment / food were very good and staff very friendly, nice and helpful. We’d like to give special thanks to our butler Alberto and also to Mr. Pedro Ceclano, as both were always very kind in arranging our requests in a professional manner!

reviews.author: Abdul Hadi Zubair
reviews.text:
I spent 5 days at this resort and here is my honest review:
Pros:
- The resort is very asthetic and picture friendly
- Although limited, the lunch and dinner food options taste good
-The staff are very nice and friendly however many of them do not speak English which can be quite challenging
Cons:
- There are very few breakfast options
- There are limited activities during the day
- There is no on site entertainment in the evenings (only a live singer)
- No smart TV in the rooms
- The massage and golf options are very expensive
- The Reserve Upgrade is not worth the money (our boat ride was canceled and the other perks do not make up for it)

If your are an older couple or a family with young kids, this resort may be for you. However if you are a young couple or a group of friends looking to have a great vacation, I would suggest to consider other resorts.

reviews.author: Wandering Spirit
reviews.text:
Good resort. Good Service. Good Experience. But ...

We stayed for 4 nights at this Punta Cana resort for the spring break week (April 1st week) of 2023.  It was a  family vacation.

Booking was directly through Melia. Total cost for all-inclusive for family of 4 people was ~3500/- USD approx. Transportation to hotel was complimentary. Included as complimentary was also 4x30 dollars off per spa and 2x15 USD towards any premium drink/beverage.

Punta Cana was nice and warm. The resort opens out straight to the beach and the ocean. Sand was fine-grained and well groomed. Tall coconut trees swayed majestically with the wind. The setting was pretty picturesque. The beach curved into a "C" with coconut trees lining up the entire stretch of the C.

Overall, a nice setting.

Resort itself is pretty well built and excellently maintained. It is kept nice and clean. Pool and other access areas were elegantly done. Excellent décor throughout.

Rooms were clean and well-furnished. We did not use any room service but that was included as well. In addition to regular towels, bathrobes, slippers and even razors were provided. Mini-fridge was kept well-stacked and was included as well. A locker was provided in the room for keeping valuables.

Buffet was pretty good. We are vegetarians but didn't have to struggle for options. There was enough to keep us full throughout. All chefs were very accommodating and served with a warm smile. The lady chef who kept creating fantastic fried-rice, fried pasta, fried noodles with mix of a dozen vegetables/condiments was my elder kid's favorite.

Entertainment was good as well. You had some song and dance activities through the day some special event like DJ or rock-shows or Circus and so on in the evening. There was no dearth of activities for kids and teenagers as well.

Most of our time was spent either at the pool sipping on cocktails while soaking in the water with a blazing sun right above, or by the beach feeling the raw ocean breeze on the face and enjoying the nature's canvas or dancing to the beats at the plaza. Pool has mini-bar with great service.

All in all, the stay was pleasant and refreshing.

Why the 3-star?

After 4-nights of a wonderful stay at the resort, we went to the checkout with a bagful of pleasant memories. We were informed that we had some extra-charges from the spa and the bar. We were aware of the spa and the premium drinks and were okay with the charges. We asked if they had adjusted the $15  complimentary drink/beverage that was part of our booking. Minor thing really and the expected answer was either "yes" or "let us see what we have here". Instead, we were asked "Did you use your coupon at the time of the drink?". We informed the manager Carlos that our booking only said "2x Food & Beverage Coupon - 15 $ - Included". There were no coupons. He pointed us to the fine-print under the section "Resort Coupon Conditions" that said "Coupons must be redeemed via Melia APP". We explained to the manager that it was not usual for people to read the fine-prints nor would a guest be trying to pull up some app while ordering a drink. Carlos told us that he was the manager and that he can't do anything and we have to pay those 15 dollars as well. It was somewhat amusing as well as shocking. Most resorts and hotels are quick to accommodate such things where there is confusion over coupons. At least reasonable accommodations. We were only asking to honor what was included in our booking.

There was a strange unwillingness to listen or resolve a genuine reason. The amount was trivial. We didn't feel like arguing beyond a point but did feel cheated and angry. It is like a hotel saying "Complimentary breakfast included" and then charging you for breakfast at the checkout under the garb of fine-prints. We suddenly felt we were dealing with a cheap management that lacks hospitality training. This was the moment that changed our entire perception. This was the moment that the wonderful and pleasant experience of our stay was blanked out by a sense of anger and helplessness.

reviews.author: Venkat Balu
reviews.text:
Fantastic service by the bar tending team. Starting with their star Miguel Liriano and the rest of the teams at Kicks Bar. Victor, Miguel Sole, Andreina, Flor. Superb team taking care of people.
Carlos our concierge was absolutely fantastic. Right from check-in thru Check out, he was there making daily activities reservation, dinner reservations, consulting on what to do daily. Just fantastic. Highly recommend and commend him. 5*

reviews.author: Dan Whitham
reviews.text: We have have had a wonderful experience at the Paradisus Palma Real. Kanna is a wonderful place for lunch. Service and the view has been excellent. Each day we have had Wander as our server and Virginia. They have been 5 star attentive!

reviews.author: Jocelyne Rivas
reviews.text: Love that hotel, but never tried an activity till today. Chef Cristian Rosario showed us how to make good ceviche! Jorge Rafael convinced us to join the fun while  Francis Javier showed us good hospitality! Made us want to look into more activities in the future. Thank you!!

reviews.author: Liza C
reviews.text: I dined at flor and had the best experience ever! My waiter cesar was very attentive and made amazing recommendations on food and drinks ! I highly recommend this restaurant and ask for Cesar as your waiter you will not be disappointed.

reviews.author: Priscilla Orozco
reviews.text: We had an amazing time here! The service was exceptional ! The location luxurious and breathtaking !! We received the best experience from Elvin (el capitán), Fani, Carlos, the Chef from the hibachi Kelvin, Angel and Wilkins Rojas. We will definitely be back again !!!

reviews.author: Craig Shepp
reviews.text:
First, I would like to send a HUGE THANKS to our concierge Hector, J. When the reservation desk really dropped the ball he was right there to straighten things out. Amazing how "the system" tries to put you into something less than you reserved and paid for. Wasn't until WE had to prove what we paid for and reserved, that they honored, and Hector was right there to assist. He also was in touch with us each day and continued to assist with our dinner reservations,  either for the two of us, or for all six of my family. Your website asked me for suggestions. Here they are: Honor what people pay for without question. Secondly,  when you pay $500+ a day, there should not be any issues. Your reservation system for dining is a joke. When you spend that kind of money you should be able to eat WHERE you want and WHEN  you want. Too bad that Hector and rest of the staff have limited power. I'm quite sure that THEY would do better if they were the owners.

Hi Roberto:

I do appreciate that you responded but that does not repair any of the damage already made. It is simply an acknowledgememt of a problem and doesn't do anything for us while we are still here in room 8310.
Acknowledging and correcting are two different things. I know since I have my own business with Generac Power Systems. I am hoping Generac agrees to not have their 700 guests here anymore. I feel very bad for the staff that works so hard to make the actual "Owner" so much money.
It also says that the owner responded, which I assume that you are not, just a paid responder. I am quite sure that the "Owner" is so happy just to bank the revenue with little care about people.
Matin at the beach bar was very kind and professional. Wanda an excellent bar tender. Angelo, well what can I say? He was friendly but got a little vulgar with speech. Perhaps he just needs a little direction. Over all a good week. Thanks to all of the staff for their hard work.

reviews.author: Daniel Makary
reviews.text: Please please please go to the wine bar with Jonathan Maximo and Juan taking care of you! They will make sure you get there best food from the hotel and give you a sophisticated night out. Beautiful ambience with selective wine and service. Thank you Jonathon for your service!!

reviews.author: Elana Same
reviews.text: stayed for 7 days and got a round trip from the airport to the resort and back to the airport, they never picked us up from the airport and we had to pay someone else to take us to the resort and we lost a lot of money and when we asked for a refund, they never gave it to us. Now it’s the end of our stay and we are trying to get a taxi to the airport and they aren’t giving it to us, plus there is nobody to talk to, everyone is “unavailable”.

reviews.author: Amy Nugent Haase
reviews.text: Yaleidi took great care of us as our concierge. She booked all our dinners as preferences, surprised our son with a birthday celebration in our room, coordinated tours and transfers and luggage seamlessly. We just relaxed and enjoyed our spacious nickte suite swim up with two rooms connected with teens. Perfect layout. Excellent entertainment every night as only dominicans can with the birthplace of bachata and merengue and juan luis guerra. We loved the bed at the beach for a day, and scuba off resort too. Will definitely return. Beautiful resort.

reviews.author: Carlos & Linda Perez
reviews.text: The service was exceptional.  Abraham and Jorge were wonderful. The food was delicious, the presentation of the food was a delight to the eye as well as to the palate.  I would highly recommend a visit to this restaurant. The experience was unique and fun.  Once again Jorge and Abraham made this a wonderful experience

reviews.author: Gabriella Fiumaro
reviews.text: Daiana Rodriguez was a great hostess with excellent service!! Rafael and Martin from the reserve beach have been extremely helpful and have set up our beach chairs beautifully. Franklin from Sante always got our orders right and made sure we were always pleased with our meals. Lioelis, Jose Ramirez, and Emmanuel, we’re courtesy in carrying our bags to and from the hotel.

reviews.author: Matthew Maresky
reviews.text: My time at the Paradisus Palma Real was unbelievable. Miguel( Bell Boy) made mine and my family’s stay here an unforgettable experience. He is amazing with the guests and know how to make them feel loved and special. Definitely will be back to this resort just for him!

reviews.author: Sheena Grewal
reviews.text: Beautiful resort. Amazing pool and ocean views. First day here and we ate the Flora restaurant. Dominican cuisine. Food and service were excellent.

reviews.author: Hardik Shah
reviews.text: Our stay at Paradisus Palma Real Spa and Golf Resort surpassed expectations. Helpful Ms. Karina at check-in, Eriol Alix's excellent concierge service, and the attentive restaurant staff made our experience memorable. Special mention for accommodating vegetarian preferences. The oceanfront room offered stunning views, and the well-maintained grounds and pool added to the charm. From kids activities, dance lessons to beachside art and craft activities, the day was filled with enjoyable events. The resort's vibrant atmosphere and friendly staff created a welcoming vibe throughout our stay.

reviews.author: Stacey Michaelson
reviews.text:
Upon arrival of the resort, it was beautiful. We decided to upgrade to the adult only side with swim up pool, although it was a big price difference. We were assigned a concierge. However, we maybe saw him 5 times the whole stay. He was not very personable. The first night, we saw a cockroach in our room. It disappeared into a small hole in the floor/wall. We understand being in this tropical  environment that not all critters can be kept out. On the second night, we saw another cockroach. We went to the front to ask to switch rooms, in which they accommodated. The food was subpar. Friends we made there also agreed that the food was less than average. The pool bars and beach bars close at 6PM which we found to be very frustrating. But the service from the bar staff and restaurant staff was excellent.
We were also called at our room phone at 8:15AM by what I am assuming is their "marketing" team. They wanted to meet with us urgently to discuss the time share options they sell. I found this very annoying being called so early while on vacation because the call did wake us up. The staff at KICKS bar are great, however, we found it annoying that they would go around and ask you to scan their QR code to leave a review and tap all 5 stars on your phone for you.
We booked an excursion to Soana Island through the resort, which ended up being a nightmare. Pickup was late and there were multiple vehicle changes to get to and from the island and a ton of confusion on how to get back to the resort. I understand this is a 3rd party company for the resort, but I would not suggest the Soana Island tour for anyone. The beach at the resort is better in my opinion. The resort and remodeled rooms are beautiful, but I do not see us coming back to revisit this resort.

reviews.author: Junior Morena
reviews.text:
Entertainment and activities were excellent. Buffet food could be warmer.
Harry Milor was excellent in guiding us thru everything/ Harry is the best concierge  Rooms were great in size.. Hotel surrounding with lots of trees and flowers were beautiful.

reviews.author: lunah
reviews.text: fun activities. danyelo and brandol and chef miguel helped us out with our activities!! great place! the kicks bar was a very nice vibe. victor was literally the best bartender we could’ve asked for!!

reviews.author: Juan Ignacio Lopez
reviews.text: Excellent experience, first time in Punta Cana and everything in Paradisus was top-notch. Accommodations, food, service and location from the airport is great. Look no further from here. Jose Ramirez was very warm with us.

reviews.author: KM Retrofits
reviews.text:
The service was wonderful. We had a awesome vacation and will be coming back  next year with the family. Hotel was very nice...so as the service.  The buffet was nice. It have different variety of food to choose from
Samuel was  awesome and very helpful throughout our Stay at the hotel and would recommend him...
Thank you.

reviews.author: Chad Case
reviews.text: Luis Mendez was great!! We ordered room service and he extremely pleasant and sooo friendly. 10/10 recommend.

reviews.author: Elizabeth Evans
reviews.text:
4/25: best meal of the trip (in a string of delightful meals) at Flora! Alex , Bladimir, Francisco, Melina, Jerry, and  Franklin served a delicious meal (coconut shrimp for me, chevo for husband) and the best ceviche!

Such wonderful service at Nikte! Jose, Felix,  Andino, Laicha, Saudys, Alex treated us like royalty and the food was excellent. Will recommend to all my friends.

reviews.author: jeffery hales
reviews.text: We spent the last three days here on vacation and were blown away by the service and quality of food. We had an exceptional server most of our time here Gregorio. At both the steak house and the company party. He not only knew my name and drink but found me and my wife tables everywhere we went. He was amazing!

reviews.author: Sierra Wesley
reviews.text: I had a great experience with Rosanna Hernandez, Yanira and Hilda at the lunchbox restaurant. They were very attentive and helpful during our stay. I would recommend coming to them.

reviews.author: James McGarvey
reviews.text:
Flora Restaurant
Great Restaurant.  Fresh fish have to try a mama juano.
Excellent service. My daughter did not want to filet fish so waiter brought her a piece of salmon instead.
Well done!

reviews.author: John and Kelly Pough
reviews.text: The food at Sante was amazing, exclusive to those staying at the Reserve. The experience is very elegant. The Staff: Eduardo, Jose, Felix and Pamela were very professional and attentive to our dining experience. Oh and the Black Forest cake was decadant indeed.

reviews.author: Lisa Zangari
reviews.text: Kelvin Fernandez was our exceptional concierge who took amazing care of us during our stay. He was very attentive and went out of his way to make sure we had what we needed to enjoy our time at the resort. Thank you Kevin and see you again soon!

reviews.author: Bryant Coates
reviews.text: Amazing service 5th time at a Meliá property and first time in Punta Cana. Andreina and Fior at Kicks Sports were amazing, will be back again. Food and service top notch, will be back next year!

reviews.author: Mark Walker
reviews.text: The staff is so friendly. The Colonial Plaza is pleasant at all hours, including the evenings with nightly entertainment. The  the restaurant blue gave personal is godd in Special George malbir Francis staff try to make your experience the best it can be, like Irvin. Thanks!

reviews.author: Austin Pamatat
reviews.text:
The Reserve quality service is second to none at any resort in Punta Cana. The food is very good, the service everywhere you go is completely unmatchable, the facilities are remarkably clean, new, and well designed, and I have absolutely no complaints.

If you are getting the reserve, ask for Ariel Benzo as your butler. The man is incredible.

Also ask for Pedro Martinez at the Vento restaurant, he is the best waiter I have ever seen.

If you want a place that is safe during covid, this is exactly what you will get. Everyone here takes it seriously but still allows for the best time possible. I am feeling both safe I will go home healthy and very, very happy with my experience.

reviews.author: Shelley Jones
reviews.text:
This place is ABBBsolutely Amazing!!! It is a beautiful property with 6-7 restaurants on it. But what makes this place the Most Amazing to me, is our concierge Osvaldo! I mean, when he meets you, he makes you feel like your family!!!! Who doesn’t want to be around family?  He takes care of anything and everything we need on the property.

This is my second time at Paradisus Palma Real and this is my second time having Osvaldo as my concierge. My husband and I are planning on coming back again next year! Why stop? When you have a beautiful resort, and great service, why you want to go anywhere else? 😃

reviews.author: cary carbonell
reviews.text: Rosanna, Yanira,,and Maria were spectacular! Amazing service from these three ladies. I would definitely come back. Very attentive. My glass was never empty.

reviews.author: Sean Firestone
reviews.text: Delvin, Yafreisy and Yanira are the BEST! They had us all set up every day at the lunchbox and made us feel welcome. They were always gracious and smiling. Delvin waited of us at the Blue Agave. It was our favorite dinner while on site.

reviews.author: Dave Park
reviews.text: Great grounds, great workers, great weather, easy ride from airport.  Room was clean however we had no air conditioning the first night and circuit breaker kept tripping but goes back on.      Pool service for drinks was plentiful but they will not serve food to pool.  The place where you have to eat is a single buffet location for lunch and breakfast.  If you like buffet style you may like it but if you are like me I rather be served on vacation and not have to walk around and bump into people to find my food that everyone touched (kids and not so clean adults I kept seeing walk out of the bathrooms without washing).  It reminded me of college cafeteria but not organized.  Dinners we were fortunate that we made reservations otherwise you may end up eating late or having to go to the buffet again.  Service at dinner is not so good,  they seemed understaffed and the food was just not that good.  All in cost was around 11k for my family of 5 with air, which makes this vacation acceptable but not great.  If I paid anymore I probably would not be happy.  My wife and I discussed we would not good back based on food quality and service at restaurants.

reviews.author: Rodney Black
reviews.text: We stayed at the Reserve Paradisus for a week in May 2022 and it was great!  Zenovia was our “butler” for the week and she was wonderful!  So friendly and took care of all of our reservations and making sure we were comfortable and having a carefree fun time!  Can’t wait to come back!

reviews.author: Lynne Alba
reviews.text: Maira is lovely. She knows us and gets our drinks ready at breakfast every morning! Kudos to her for being so attentive and sweet!!!

reviews.author: Haik Pounardjian
reviews.text: Miquella and Yorgelys gave an excellent service!!! 10/10

reviews.author: Doris Vasquez
reviews.text: Kicks restaurant was phenomenal!! Food was delicious and service was excellent. Yiri and Jose were very attentive and hospitable to me and my fiancé

reviews.author: AFRICANQUEEN
reviews.text: This was honestly the best resort I chose to stay for my birthday trip and couldn’t have imagined better. I got more than enough birthday surprises, wonderful service from zenovia and she made this trip worth while with always keeping us up to date on what’s going around the resort, to make sure the staff meets our needs, making reservations and just overall an infectious joyful and amazing person that made sure we enjoyed our stay. I can’t wait to come back!

reviews.author: Chris Littrell
reviews.text: What an amazing experience!!! My wife and I came to Paradisus for our 20 year wedding anniversary. As we arrived, we were treated as valued guests. The resort is beautiful. The rooms are beautiful. The endless food and drinks were delicious. All of these made this a 4 star experience. The staff made it a 5 star trip. All of the staff took great care of us, but there were a few that went over the top. Thank you Alejandro and "Dark Chocolate" for the dance lessons, ping pong, water classes, conversation, and laughter. Thank you Santo for being the #1 waiter! Victor was the best bartender at the GabiClub bar! Also thank you Irvin for taking care of our dinner reservations and answering our questions.

reviews.author: Madeline Bishop
reviews.text: This resort is beautiful, Hector, our bartender was great, attentive, and helped my husband with non alcoholic options. Though the food at this resort needs work, overall the place and service are great.

reviews.author: Katherine Fernandez
reviews.text:
Restaurant Malba
Manager / Jose Emilio Bastiata
Captain/ Felix Uribe
Hostess/ Surirda Joseph
Camarero/ Nahomi, Zuleila, Pamela, Jose Del Rosario ,Ge Lenny
Chef/ Jonas Jemene , Jose

The best service !!! Everyone is so friendly, they Definitely make you feel like family. From checking in to the restaurants, to meeting everyone it’s absolutely the best. I’m definitely coming back! Family friendly & you know won’t regret it.

reviews.author: Kelly Globuschutz
reviews.text: The Ginger Bar is great! It’s open 24 hours, the drinks they serve are delicious, and they have some snacks that are available as well. The staff at the Ginger Bar is very friendly, especially Ismael, Antonio, Dominica, Olgarosario, Soranji, and Clary. Very good service!

reviews.author: Ryann Berdar
reviews.text: Mr. Jose and Mr. Chef at Hibachi were great. Clean and beautiful resort. Everyone is so nice and accommodating! Ismael at the ginger bar was so kind and helpful!

reviews.author: Maria Tacelosky
reviews.text: Rafael at the beach was awesome.  Very attentive and always brought me a great drink and checked on us.  He is the best!

reviews.author: Meghan Day
reviews.text: Paradisus is always a great vacation. The hotel grounds are beautiful, the food is good and the service is outstanding.  We are members and are looking forward to future trips.  Thank you Jordania for ensuring everything was excellent!

reviews.author: bhargav patel
reviews.text:
This is hands down one of the best carriabian resort we have ever been to.
Great resort. Lots of entertainment activity all day long (kids and adults).
Never seen resort do these many events to keep you entertained all day long.
Restaurants are in amazing shape.
We were assigned a private Concierge (Luis). We would just whatsapp him for anything and everything and he would take care of it. E.g. we have an infant and we constantly text him for bannas and apples and milk and he would bring it. He took care of our restaurant reservations and  alot more. Truely exceptional service by him.
We are vegetarian and they did take care of us in every restaurant we went to. Lunch buffet also had few veg items and we never felt like we are missing out whole lot in food. One advice would be I wish they have (V) tag on all lunch buffet items to inform if its veg or not.
Beach service is excellent andjust amazing vibes here
Overall very satisfied. And highly recommend.

reviews.author: Amani Montaque
reviews.text: Rum Republic is a must!!! Jensy and Miguel are very knowledgeable and make the best drinks! I suggest the Smoked Rum Fashioned!!!

reviews.author: Aurora Brink
reviews.text: Everyone here was very friendly. All the bartenders and customer service was very helpful and nice. The rooms were very nice housekeeping kept everything nice and clean very friendly vibe and loved the entertainment. The sports bar was a fun place to dance. Definitely recommend.

reviews.author: Jovina Avakian
reviews.text: Paradisus Punta Cana is beautiful. The definition of a 5-star luxury hotel. It is very quiet so be prepared for little to no entertainment and nightlife on the resort. However, the food was impeccable and the cheesy services reps were beyond satisfactory. They really helped accomodate our stay and requests. Jordania is one of the guest services reps on site who organized our private beach dinner which turned out beautifully. She was patient and helpful in getting everything ordered and organized for us. There was a big mix up during our departure from the resort, but Jordania helped get us a shuttle car to the airport. Always kept a smile on her face and was met with laughter and happiness every time dealing with her.

reviews.author: Sheila Normil
reviews.text:
Laicha was a great server
Rosanna Maria was superb at the breakfast lounge give them 5 stars
The room didn’t have no shower soap all the bottles were empty. I don’t think they checked it before my checking.

reviews.author: Pam
reviews.text: Our butler Ariel was great!! The honeymoon surprise was amazing and greatly appreciated. Ariel was always pleasant and accommodating.  Unfortunately, the beach service was very poor. We sat for hours and noone offered us a drink. This level of service is not consistent with other resorts when you pay for premium service. Overall, the food at dinners  at Venco and Rare were very disappointing. Overall, a great experience.

reviews.author: Seun Odutola
reviews.text: The food was great, service superb(very attentive), and the views and ambience were spectacular. Alejandro (Happy Boy) is an outstanding entertainer, funny and very personable. Darlin, is very nice and very knowledgeable and helps the guests feel at home. Jairo is a great concierge and Yoiner is quite an outstanding gentleman and concierge All of the rest of the staff were outstanding and would without reservation recommend this resort to anyone looking for a Caribbean getaway.

reviews.author: Cyndi Sexton
reviews.text: We had a great experience here. The food the staff in the rooms were wonderful. Our concierge Eriol Alix helped us navigate everything seamlessly. Would highly recommend.!

reviews.author: David L
reviews.text: Shout out to Radhames, Yelitza, Antonio, Ismael, super sweet Olga 😉and the rest of the team at Ginger Lobby bar for mixing up all the awesome cocktails, frapuccinos and handcrafted coffee this week! We came several times a day because of the vast selection of drinks! Also gracias to my homeboy Rauol who took care of everyone at the beach all week, as well as Franklin, Michael and Amanda at Sante restaurant, and our sushi masters Kendy and Yovanny! So many hard working staff sorry if I forgot to mention you by name. Muchos Gracias 🙏

reviews.author: Mercedes Vega
reviews.text: The reserve exclusive restaurant Sante was absolutely amazing. We ate multiple times here and the meals did not disappoint. The team Eduardo, Daniela, Jose, Amanda, and Pamala were friendly, attentive and kind. If you stay at this reserve section please be sure to checkout Sante! Ralphy our concierge was the absolute best. He made everything so much easier from dinner reservations to snack request. If you stay in the reserve you will not regret it. I will definitely be coming back and requesting Ralphy!

reviews.author: Alicia Jurcisin
reviews.text:
Very happy with my stay here!!  Rosanny P. from Brisas is an incredible waitress. Very accommodating!
We had a great time dancing and she was very patient, kind, attentive.
Everything was impeccable.
- Audrey and Alicia

reviews.author: arnold rivas
reviews.text: An unforgettable luxurious experience. The best service i have had at an all inclusive. Jordiana at guest services was able to assist us on anything that we needed throughout our stay. The ginger bar is a must visit.

reviews.author: brian crookes
reviews.text: Food is amazing! Fettuccine de Marisol so fresh and delicious - Sante was the best, Felix Manuel, Musial and Edwin and Franklin made our first night so special!

reviews.author: Andie Vera
reviews.text: We had a great vacation at Paradisus. A big part of what made the vacation So great was our concierges Ralphy. He was wonderful, super attentive and accommodating! His service was very much appreciated and valued! Thank you RALPHY!! You rock!

reviews.author: Kasey Cullen
reviews.text: Beautiful resort with great rooms and activities for adults and children. Staff is friendly and our concierge Irvin was amazing as well as the friendly staff at the pool bar and our waiter Roberto at Mina steakhouse. Great family vacation!

reviews.author: Michelle Mazz
reviews.text: Yuderi is the best server on the beach. My cup was always full. We never had to call him over, he just came to check on us and make sure we were good. Amazing service.

reviews.author: King Omie
reviews.text:
Santo, Dionni, Laicha, Miledys, Harry and everyone in this hotel is phenomenal. The food, services, buffet and multiple restaurants are amazing.

Joel and team in Blue Agave were great, and food was fantastic!

reviews.author: Sabrina Childs
reviews.text:
Everything from check in to check out was EXCELLENT!!!!! From the time we stepped into the property and was greeted with smiles and a warm and friendly  “Hola,
buenas tardes” They had my heart. We then went to the lounge and had a drink and welcoming pastries. The redemption came to us and we did not have to sit at a desk for the check in but be relaxed after a long flight; was great. We were told we would have a concierge/butler for our needs but that surpassed my expectations. Harry Milor was our new family. He was there at every beck and call; If I needed a single band aid, he would make sure I received it. My daughter loved him and called him “My Harry/ I have a Harry”. Harry’s smile was infectious and if something was going wrong or I couldn’t figure something out his smile and calm demeanor put me at ease.
We ate at one of the Resturant's called Aqua and  Sanyi (waitress) and Manuel (cook) are
superb in the service department. The
food was EXCELLENT and sooo good in
the flavor. I will most definitely miss this
experience. I will highly recommend the fish as a main course. This was one of the best experience I have had during my stay. I could write a mini book about my fabulous stay; but I think you get the point.

Oh! I forgot to mention Emanuel the bell hop! Muaaaaah! He was excellent and such a nice soul and pleasant to see around and willing to help whenever  we needed.

reviews.author: Kori Coffey
reviews.text:
We stayed here for 6 nights, 7 days for the all inclusive experience as a family of 5. We have 3 kids (ages 10, 8 & 3). The resort itself is gorgeous and the staff is very friendly, professional and engaging. Food was great, although getting dinner reservations each night seemed a bit chaotic/unorganized. We loved the buffet for breakfast and lunch though. Highlights were our concierge (Ernesto) and the diverse entertainment in the main courtyard every evening after dinner. Rooms were outdated and furniture needs upgrading (couches were very uncomfortable).

We had adjoining rooms with a full living room & kitchen (with full set of cabinets yet they were completely empty… not a single cup/glassware, plate, etc). One of our TVs didn’t work & one bedroom door wouldn’t close. No coffeemaker, no microwave, just a refrigerator. Another odd thing was no washcloths. Only towels. But being that we didn’t spend much time in our room, none of this was that big of a deal to us because the rest of the resort was great… the pool, beach & staff.

I did take our 2 older kids on the SeaQuarium excursion one day and it was great for them as first timers (but I’d say overall disappointing for an experienced snorkeler). The crew on this was second to none though! Super lively, engaging and made the whole experience safe and fine my kids.

What made our experience the most enjoyable was our concerning Ernesto. He was always available to us via WhatsApp to answer any question or help us with any of our requests. He even made a few special deliveries of milk to our room for us while I was at the pool with the kids because my husband had to work most of the trip. Without him, this trip would’ve been a lot more work and stress for me! So I totally appreciated him!

While we agreed to sit through the Circle Melia sales presentation (as we knew it would help out our concierge in some way - we did it solely as a favor to him)… we found this experience to be a total turn off in the end. Our initial rep we dealt with (Josi) was very friendly and professional and we have no issues with her. But once the finance reps and managers got involved with the heavy sales pressure - they would t take no for an answer and kept us there for nearly 2.5 hours on our final full day of vacation (even though they committed to one hour). So that left a bit of a sour experience in the end.

reviews.author: Lorena Ferro
reviews.text:
This was a last minute trip for us but we were so lucky to find this place. The staff is friendly and the beach is just perfect.
The place we loved the most was the kids club. My 7 year old wanted to be there 24 hours a Day. The love they game to my kids was just so special. I felt confortable leaving them with them as they seem super profesionals and friendly. JOANNA SUJEYDI & JOSHUA THANK YOU for being such a special team! We will miss you

reviews.author: Mary Carey
reviews.text: Josias at checkout was such a sweet and very helpful person. He gave us a lot of insight about the Dominican Republic  that we didn’t know about. Such a good sense of humor, too! Checkout was very easy and we were so sad to leave!

reviews.author: John Russo
reviews.text:
Jeury and Gilda did a fantastic job at the Macrame event! Gilda was a fantastic teacher and walked us through everything. Great experience :)

Also, the pizza making workshop was great. Hairon and Juan were very fun and made it a great experience for us!

reviews.author: Nykell M
reviews.text: First time at a Melia resort. This resort was not really for us. Not much to do in the evenings; no shows or entertainment. The food was below average. This resorts audience is not younger couples, but more middle aged to older with kids or families. I called ahead to ask if they decorated the room for birthdays and was told yes. But this did not happen. Definitely disappointed with this resort.

reviews.author: Bryan Hagan
reviews.text: We had the most wonderful time. We want to say that Melqui was beyond helpful and went above and beyond for us! We will be back.

reviews.author: shawn sanderson

reviews.author: Daniel Cook
reviews.text:
TLDR: Dinner food is great, buffet food is average. Get the reserve package if you are an adults-only group for better food, beach access, service, and dinner reservations. The Ginger Bar has amazing coffee drinks & coffee cocktails.

I really enjoyed my stay and highly recommend staying at the Paradisus Palma Real Resort. The resort has recently been renovated and is very pleasant. There are a lot of options for food and the staff was extremely friendly. The resort has both a family side and an adults only side of the resort. If you are an adults only couple I highly recommend paying a little extra for "The Reserve" status of the resort. The reserve gives you access to adults only pools, special seating area of the beach, concierge services for making restaurant reservations, and access to Santé. The concierge will ensure you get restaurant reservations and access to Santé for lunch & dinner with give you a much better dining experience.

The room I stayed in was a Reserve Garden View located on the 3rd floor. There was a large amount of easily accessible electrical outlets as well as bed side USB ports. The room is a open concept with only a curtain separating the bathroom from the rest of the room. The bathroom had a large 1 person soaking tub, separate shower, and separate room for the toilet. The closet was spacious and contained two robes with slippers, an umbrella, blow dryer, and a cloths steamer. A well stocked mini bar that was restocked daily containing several beers, sodas, waters, and assorted snacks.

One wall in our room was extremely thin, which was an adjoining room wall. We could literally hear our neighbors walking around in flip flops, talking, music, everything. While we didn't spend a lot of time in our room this was pretty annoying because it feels like you have no privacy. A/C lowest temperature was maxed out at 71F, so if you are wanting it to be any lower it is not possible. When we first arrived all of the items in the mini bar had just been stocked and were still hot. It took more than 24 hours before the items had cooled down enough to be enjoyed so it seemed like half the time you were there you were just waiting on the mini bar items to cool down.

The food at the resort is pretty good for an all-inclusive resort. The dinner restaurants, which require reservations are the best food, while the buffet is a little underwhelming. The Lunch Box (family buffet) was about what you would expect, it is filled with a large amount of options but in the end it is cafeteria food that is "OK". During my stay, Malva (adults only buffet) was never open. If you have the reserve package you can eat at Santé for breakfast and lunch, which has a small buffet and serves al-a-cart meals. The little extra that it cost for the reserve in my option can be justified by access to Santé and dinner reservations. Room service food quality was the same as the buffet.

Pools - The largest pool in the middle of the resort has a swim up bar (shaded) and several built-in loungers. While the rest of the resort has been updated, it appears that they skipped updating the main pool. The main pool has several spots that were designed to be jacuzzies but none of the jets work in any of them. There are 3 adults only pools on the resort with 2 of those pools being restricted to guest of the reserve. None of the reserve pools have swim up bars or shaded areas. The other adults only pool does have a swim up bar and a small amount of shade from the swim up bar. There is also another pool for circle members which I believe is their time share program.

Beach - The beaches were great, even though we were there in peak seaweed season. The resort has a barrier out in the ocean that blocks a lot of the seaweed from reaching the beach. There is an extremely large amount of beach beds with umbrellas. If you have the reserve there is staff that will set up towels for you on your chairs and bring you drinks if requested. From my understanding if you don't have the reserve you have to set up your chairs and get the drinks yourself.

reviews.author: Rahul Kaushal
reviews.text: Had a great time at Paradisus Palma. Staff was really friendly and welcoming and out concierge, Ariel, made everything super smooth. Jimmy helped out with our luggage as well.

reviews.author: Morgan Schultz
reviews.text: Lovely resort. Absolutely check out the Gin Ger bar, their team is fabulous and the drinks are incredible. The espresso martini was delicious and made with real espresso!

reviews.author: Jenna Lee
reviews.text:
This resort looks brand new and has a picture perfect scenery.
The staff is funny and the buffet food is amazing, however, the Mexican restaurant and Hibachi restaurant really aren't good.

I am giving it 2 Stars because the scenery was amazing. Other then that this place gets real boring after a couple of days.

I wish the staff provided the guests with a daily list of activities, otherwise you will be out of the loop and just spend your days wandering around.
Also, I was placed in a room that I did not book, I had to tell the front desk that I was put in the wrong room (one without a balcony) and the receptionist rolled his eyes when I asked to be put in the correct room (one with a balcony & Jacuzzi). When I was put into the correct room the light next to the bed randomly dropped from the ceiling one night and the electricians had to come hang it back up to the ceiling.

Lastly, and most frustratingly, the front desk gave my boyfriend a booklet of "Resort Credits" consisting of free credits that can be used in the Casino , Restaurant and Spa on our LAST DAY.

He said he "forgot" to give them to us when we checked in. He explained you get resort credits if you are booked for a certain amount of nights.

However, we were never able to use these credits because they were given to us a few hours before we had to leave. If I received these Resort Credits on the first day I would have without a doubt used them during my stay and had more fun. So if you are staying at this resort for a while I recommend you ask about the credits booklet because this is the thing that really angered me the most.

Also, Room Service comes really early in the morning, they will lightly knock then let themselves in - Got woken up multiple times by them in the morning and walked in on while showering a couple times.

reviews.author: Lynette Brodsky
reviews.text: The royal service was amazing. We wish we would have upgraded right at the beginning. Bladimir  was our personal butler and went above and beyond. The resort is gorgeous and each meal was better than the one before even the buffet was delicious. The color of the water blew me away with the palm tree and amazing gardens with the warm tropical breezes. A must vacation

reviews.author: Nick Griffin
reviews.text:
A.ERIOL Was a fantastic help to us the whole trip.  Booked all of our meals and took extra care to us.  He is an asset to the property.  Great guy all around made it extra special for all of us.

Jose r services was great as well for baggage!

reviews.author: Amit Singer
reviews.text: We had a great time! The location and hotel was beautiful and the service was amazing. Ismael and his team at the ginger bar were fantastic! Great coffee and super friendly.

reviews.author: heather dwyer
reviews.text: Brendol and Reynaldo, aka GPS, are amazing at sharing their knowledge of ceviche and margaritas. They are both funny and personable. Come visit Blue Agave at Paradisus Real Golf Resort for a great meal!

reviews.author: Victor Hugo Castro Perrusquia

reviews.author: Mike Felipe

Milton who is the supervisor is great and we love Fausto the waiter. This restaurant is one of the best restaurants at Palma Real. If you stay here, I would really consider eating at this restaurant!

Thanks to all !!

reviews.author: Justin Giacoletti
reviews.text: Everything from top to bottom was amazing. Every single one of the staff members was so helpful and knowledgeable. I was very stressed about booking golf for me and my buddy and our wives spa day. Jordania walked us through the entire process and hooked us up!

reviews.author: Kelley Steinberg
reviews.text: Our stay was amazing, and we really enjoyed the food - the restaurant Flora was great for authentic Dominican food! We stayed in the Reserve, and our concierge was very helpful in booking our activities and dinner reservations, the beach was beautiful, and we had a great stay!

reviews.author: Scott Richardson
reviews.text: We have really enjoyed our stay here. The service is always very attentive and friendly.  We really liked the activities directors Samuel and Jorge who made sure we had a great time and knew about what was being offered for the day to do.

reviews.author: Harun Mohamed
reviews.text: We enjoyed our stay at Paradisus Palma real. The service and resort was amazing. Eriol was a great concierge and checked on us frequently, available for whatever we needed. Will definitely be back!

reviews.author: Angella Rodriguez
reviews.text:
This is a great hotel! Quintino, Gray, Teofilo will take care of you at the adults only bar. I highly recommended this hotel and the swim up Pool it’s a
Great addition! Service it’s top notch! Also at the baggage service the 3 members were awesome
Update! We like it so much that we are here again ! Victor it’s taking care of us at the Celsius Bar with the best Moscúw Mule and Blue Hawaiian and at the Sante Restaurant Gustavo it’s being awesome as well. At the beach bar you need to ask for Rafael for the best drinks he will make sure you get your palapas and the best spot ever!.

reviews.author: Arlene Hearn
reviews.text: This is my second review. My first was a 5 star for the lobby & common areas and server & entertainment staff. This review is for room & management. We requested a 3rd bed and unfortunately it had bed bugs. We reported it and it was dealt with right away. We were given another room and were upgraded. However, communication seems to get lost from management to housekeeping so we had keep calling back and reminding them. The bathrooms could be better maintained. So our room itself was not an ideal experience.

reviews.author: Sache Hood
reviews.text: Everyone is so warm, friendly and helpful!! Very beautiful place and people match! The food at Flora was AMAZING and Santo Avela was so kind and welcoming! Jean, Ana, Minelva made sure we had a full belly and glasses at all time!!

reviews.author: Jeff Carpenter
reviews.text: Exceptional experience at this resort. We stayed in the Reserve section that gave us access to an exclusive Reserve section guest only restaurant. The Sante restaurant in the Reserve was our absolute favorite, very clean, the food was exceptional and Juan at Sante (photo attached) provided next level service. This one will go on the list of places we would visit again.

reviews.author: Lauren Douglas
reviews.text: The Ginger bar was amazing every morning.  Great cafe and the staff was awesome.  Thanks so much to Olga, Clara, Dominga, Madeline, and Lisbeth you guys were such a pleasure!

reviews.author: Linda Perez
reviews.text: Hotel was absolutely beautiful but the service was seriously lacking. There is 0 sense of urgency, everything takes far longer than it needs to. Staff are constantly dangling service in exchange for reviews. My luggage was basically held hostage for a review, and I asked for a bandaid because my son got a cut and was told she could give it to me if I left a review about how wonderful her service was… for giving me a bandaid. I wasn’t told reservations were required for the restaurants when I checked in, we tried to go at 6 when they opened and were denied from 2 restaurants, only to see empty tables for the next 3 hours, they could have accommodated us if they had wanted to.  I had a hotel credit that wasn’t honored, called on  multiple  occasions for a golf cart and it never arrived. Any review you see with someone’s name mentioned was likely coaxed and pressured. Dominical republic isn’t what it used to be, and the service left a lot to be desired for. Beautiful property but the service really left a bad taste, it felt like they always resorted to a “no” rather than trying to actually help find a solution.

reviews.author: Maddy Walker
reviews.text: Review for Flora restaurant - served by Stephania who was great and chose a yummy cocktail for us! Fast service and beautiful restaurant. Short ribs were great! Thank you everyone!!

reviews.author: Claire O'Neill
reviews.text:
Absolutely beautiful top notch resort. Steak House was delicious. Antonia was the best at Ginger coffee bar. Drink were delicious as was all the fruit.
Best vacation ever!

reviews.author: Steve

reviews.text: Rosanna Castillo Jason and Myra service was amazing they were very attentive to our table!!!! LOVED HAVING THEM FOR BREAKFAST . Muy Amable !

reviews.author: Isaac Hayes
reviews.text: My experience at the hotel has been excellent. Willy, Emmanuel, Roberto, Antonio, Olga, Clari, Magda, Ismael, and Pedro have been amazing. Definitely, we will come back again. We had an excellent service!!! Thank you guys!!

reviews.author: Marty Paris
reviews.text: Jason was our beach server and fantastic!

reviews.author: Richard Lizardo
reviews.text:
We had an amazing time at this resort.  The service was the best we have ever had. That says a lot considering we have been to multiple resorts in the Dominican Republic. We repeatedly requested Glenys as our waitress. She was extremely tentative and would cater to our every need without hesitation. In addition, Altagracia Cruz are Danwin Zaliche from the Avenue Bar  were fantastic! You can tell they love you what they do and they want clients to have a great experience.

During our stay we had a concierge service. The person appointed to us was Eliezlar. He was great! He checked in with us daily and never made us feel like we were bothering him with our questions.

reviews.author: TIM HILDEBRANT
reviews.text: Paridisus Palma Real was a very beautiful place to stay, my wife and I had a wonderful time. The spa was great and they had plenty of activities and restaurants. Antonio Mazueta with guest service was very helpful with everything we needed.

reviews.author: Di Y
reviews.text: The ceviche was divine and the margarita was different and delicious! Our servers were exceptional. Thank you, Jairo, Edgar and Angel for excellent service. ❤️

reviews.author: Niurka Maldonado
reviews.text: I stayed at this resort a year ago and much has changed for the worse. The kids’ club last year was a wonderful and engaging place for my kids to spend time. They did a variety of workshops related to Dominican culture like learning about Larimar and dancing merengue and every day there were dozens of kids asking to go. This year it was so boring there were never more than a child or two attending and the sole day Dominican games and merengue were on the calendar the kids played Tag and had no dance lesson. They refused to go back. Plus the employees here are so eager to get positive reviews and be mentioned by name that they have you scan a QR code in their presence and watch as you input your review. This happened twice to me! The evening entertainment was not as good. Last year’s carnival was spectacular. The only highlight in evening entertainment was Dominican night. Unfortunately, the dancers began so late many people missed them altogether. Also, I hated that we couldn’t just relax on the beach, there were so many vendors approaching that there was never more than a minute of peace. Besides these things, I did enjoy myself. The property is beautiful, the service is fantastic - truly wonderful employees who work hard, and the food is delicious.

reviews.author: Noah Pacheco
reviews.text: Thanks to our amazing staff Jorge Rafael, Humberto morel , johan rondín and Andreiana marón made our stay 10/10. Find them at the Kicks bar, service 10/10, and they make the reservation experience personal, all shared their time to make our time that much better.

The service and food is wonderful at Mascalzone .. Milton and Junior Reyes very nice service!

reviews.text: Customer service was very good, specially Luisa Mejia .She was polite,professional and helpful. Management of Paradisus please take to consideration your excellent employee

reviews.author: Angela
reviews.text: Restaurants are great the service is always fast and friendly, refilling drink without request. I have an ocean view room and it's breathtaking. Everyone is so polite and accommodating. It's like being in heaven.

reviews.author: Crystal Murray
reviews.text:
We had a lovely trip. We had an ocean front room in the Reserve. We come back to PuntaCana for the beach and the beautiful  people who work there.

Juan Castillo was our concierge and he took care of us. I would recommend making dinner reservations for the week when you arrive and sample a little of everything. I think our favorite was Ceilo, the Mexican restaurant.

There are lots of excursions but we chose just to stay put and relax.

reviews.author: Lilia Rodriguez
reviews.text:
Great service from the checking in thru table service. Prompt with drinks food and very attentive with our three grandchildren.
A great place to eat and have a good time. Cuñis to Brailin Reynard y Felix Celeste the best.

reviews.author: Ronnie Pascale
reviews.text: Dinner at Flora was great! Service from Melina was amazing…she made sure we were taken care of from the second we sat down and the Caribbean food was fantastic!

reviews.author: Ayden Wary
reviews.text: The stay was great! Jose Ramos at BRI SAS was great and very friendly, we ate there everyday and loved it. Great service. Lewis took care of us at during our stay and did a wonderful job!

reviews.author: Tanya Thompson
reviews.text: Melina is a great place to stay! Our concierge, Diana Fortuna, made the experience extra special. The room was really clean and has high end features. The drinks were mixed well- not watered down like most all inclusives. Thanks to our favorite servers: Quintino Guzman, telofilo altagracias, gray morel. Each day there are many activities, my favorite was an aquatic pole dancing class which was a great workout but also so fun!

reviews.author: Anna Walsh
reviews.text: My daughter and I are staying in the reserve and go to the reserve pool every day. we have a great experience, the pool is not busy, and bartender Yuderi is always attentive and helpful. he makes amazing drinks.

reviews.author: Julian Lowe
reviews.text: Dined at Flora tonight. Our waiter Cesar was excellent. He suggested dishes that are native to the Dominican, and they didn’t disappoint.

reviews.author: 신현식
reviews.text:
I've been in many resorts in Dominican Republic and for sure this resort is one of the best.
The place is awesome and luxurious. The staff is great and specially the conceirge who attend us during our stay was very kind with very good attention on everything we do. He tried his best to make us feel comfortable (thanks Bladimir).

reviews.author: Joanna
reviews.text:
We spent a week at the Paradisus as I had read reviews of this resort being one of the best in Dominican to have a wedding and I wanted to do in-person research and possibly book the wedding.  The resort is architecturally beautiful and all of the main areas, pool and beach are kept as clean as possible. The wait staff and entertainment staff were very friendly especially Imael at the lobby bar who makes the best happy coffee, Ruby at Gabi Bar, Alejandro, Darlin and Jairo from the entertainment staff.  The hotel rooms are nice but the washrooms are open concept  There is a definite issue with the phones as some of them don't even work.  We had to use the phone in the bathroom to actually talk to someone.

I did not enjoy our interactions with hotel management especially after we found bed bugs in our room on our 2nd night.  They gave us a new room when we told them but it is hard to get prompt service.  We had no water in the room and had to make multiple calls to get something after 2 hours!  We asked for 2 double beds and the sofa bed to be opened up and that took many requests over 5 hours to actually get done.

I had to email for a wedding appointment and didn't get a response until the end of my 3rd day after going through the issues above.  I ended up never meeting with them as I was worried about the service after the attention we recieved after having bed bugs!  They upgraded us to The Reserve food and drinks after my friend posted publicly.  That is the level of service to expect here.

Lastly, there is a management practice that we really did not appreciate.  The entertainment staff who we had so much fun with knew when it was our last day and literally were forcing us to give the hotel a 5 star review.  I can't blame them for following the instructions they were provided but management has told them that if they don't get a 5 star review with their names mentioned, their jobs are in jeopardy.  You cannot give the hotel a 3 star review but mention their names and give them credit.  They went so far as leaning over you and hitting the 5 star button on your phone to make sure it gets done.  This really turned me off the hotel management as the final straw.  Exploiting their staff's connections to force a review.  I can easily say that I will not readily choose Paradisus again because of all of this even though I enjoyed the sun, the beach and the food!

reviews.author: Brittany Garner
reviews.text: You must eat at the Malva restaurant! The food was spectacular and the service was top notch!  Best food on the resort! Maria, Sandra, and John were wonderful and we felt so well taken care of! 10/10!!

reviews.author: Badger Taylor
reviews.text: Very disappointed in the quality of food and service offered for dining. The only options for breakfast and lunch are the buffet. At check in there were no openings for dinner reservations the entire stay. Often we would either have to pad pockets/tip to get a 930pm dinner reservation or just eat a the buffet. It’s supposed to be an all inclusive, but nothing is included and there is no service unless you want to HEAVILY tip everyone for water refills or just bring you’re own drinks from the room. The tub in the room wouldn’t hold water. We called for maintenance on day one, we wound up taking the stopper out as it was cross threaded to put it on correctly. They came our last day to check the tub. This was a constant struggle and fight to have anything organized or scheduled. I can’t wait to get home and relax.

reviews.author: Ducoudray
reviews.text:
Paradisus palma real was a great place to stay and enjoy the beach also the pool.

Food was great I tried all the restaurants thanks to my great concierge Fernando 'people's champ.  We want to see you again next time.

reviews.author: J. Williams
reviews.text: Martin and Wanda provided excellent service during our stay. They were always cheerful and accommodating. They made the stay enjoyable.

reviews.author: JD23
reviews.text: I had a an amazing time staying at Paradisus during my vacation. From the moment I arrived I was greeted with the upmost hospitality. Juanlly was extremely welcoming and help me with my bags and Sosa ensured that I had everything I need to enjoy my stay. These guys made it their mission to make sure I had the best vacation ever. Definitely coming back.

reviews.author: sarah steward
reviews.text: Armando was the best ever. We were here celebrating both our anniversary and birthdays. Armando set us up,with a birthday cake and a bubble bath for when we came back from dinner. The grounds at Paradisus were very beautiful abd having a butler was a nice added touch. Armando took really good care of us and made all of our dinner reservation. We also came back to our room everyday to either some fresh fruits or some meats and cheese.I will definitely be coming back and requesting Armando again!!!!

reviews.author: B Bogdan
reviews.text:
We just came back yesterday from The Reserve at Paradisus palma real and the vacation was amazing. The hotel is very nice and super clean, the food is very good and the staff..hmm...the staff is AMAZING. Our concierge Juan Sierra, took care of us, from the moment we stepped out of the bus in front of the hotel, to the very end of our trip. He made our vacation perfect. Luis Diaz and Victor Feliz at the lobby bar, are the best bartenders, i encourage you to taste as many cocktails as you can, they make the best ones, but especially Luis,  he is the soul of the party in The Reserve, he is so fun and genuine friendly, i've never seen anyone like him, in any place I've been.
At the beach, you have everything as well, good food, drinks and very nice staff that helps you with anything you need.
The only problem was the golf carts, that takes you from the lobby to the beach, as the distance is quite big (5 minutes cart drive ). Sometimes you get lucky and find them quick, but most of the time you wait  to much or, there are to many people waiting for them and not all fit.
Overall it was a 5 star vacation, the staff there, 10 star 🌟and we will surely return.

Thanks for taking your time to read this and i hope it helps.

reviews.author: Access Scanning Document Services, LLC
reviews.text: Services is good and food ok. Senrowny Sosa from customer service promised me a 1 certificate of stay for attending a meeting regarding Melia memebership. He completely ignored and did not want to send the certificate for unknown reasons that he did not mention. Do not go to this meetings if offered to you.

reviews.author: Kiana Paniagua
reviews.text: The service here was excellent. The food was well done. I requested a drink that the restaurant didn’t have and the waiter went out of his way to make sure it was made for me. Would recommend it to everyone. Waiters Frank, Claudio, & Dionis were friendly and attentive.

reviews.author: kelly fitzpatrick
reviews.text: Fior from the ginger bar is amazing! She helped us every evening all week long. She's quick and sweet! She's the best!

reviews.author: Drita Palushaj
reviews.text: I was here on my honeymoon. It was literally paradise like the name. The staff is so friendly even more so than in mexico, very personable and appreciative. reviews.author: Andrew Dalton
reviews.text:
My family and I had a great stay at this hotel. Our family concierge Lugo did everything he could to make our stay comfortable from getting us extra water, beach toys for the kids, reserving our restaurants and beach chairs. He was always easy to get a hold of and made the difference during our stay.

Food was excellent at each resturant and buffet. The Reserve buffet is a bit smaller but was great none the less. The pools at the Reserve were excellent for the children and the kids club staff were amazing as well.

All in all, it was an amazing vacation and we will be back!

reviews.author: Andrew Reynolds
reviews.text:
We had been to this resort years ago and really enjoyed our stay. We decided to come back and were ultimately disappointed. We had the regular package, not the exclusive club. Only writing this review because this should not be considered a 5 star hotel or have a 4.5 star ratings.

Pros:
Full bar, great bartenders. Absolutely no complaints here
Beach - very nice beach, great weather. Unfortunately, if you aren't in the exclusive club seating is limited. Exclusive club seating was widely empty most of our trip as well.

Cons:
Service - service was shockingly poor. Our room was bug filled, we called to complain and they sent us bug spray that was some knockoff that didn't even work. In order to sleep without getting eating alive with mosquitos, we had to go and buy Deep words spray.
Food - the food was terrible. We have been to all-inclusive places before so our standards were not set high. We get the drill. That being said, the lunch was absolutely inedible. The last two days we ate bread. The dinners were better, however they don't give you access to the best places. We decided to pay for one of them the final night and my girlfriend got food poisoning; not great.

Recap : Overall, we had a decent time. I would not recommend or ever come back, they treat you terribly and make no attempt to fulfill even basic hotel requirements. A huge letdown from what this place used to be.

reviews.author: Tom Tobin
reviews.text:
Our holiday experience has in my opinion been very misleading and disappointing.

I have 2 kids age 2 and 3 and the number one thing that I search for is kids facilities so when I came across this hotel I was happy there was sufficient facilities for my kids to be entertained. Pool and play area etc which is displayed on the photos only to find on arrival there was absolutely zero - I would not have booked this hotel if I knew there was nothing

Upon arrival I found the staff to be very abrupt there was a series of events we were not on their system as being
Booked - we got put in a room with one bed - there is 4 of us - I quickly highlighted that we booked a room with 2 beds so my 3 year old had somewhere to sleep -
So they moved us to a different room but wasn’t as nice as the one we had pre booked online - so we upgraded to a
Suite which was costly but we really wanted to have a nice suitable room for our family . Disappointed we had to pay more that same night it took the staff 8 hours to bring me a crib for my baby who was inconsolable from being
So tired - 2am they brought it - also there was people who could access our room it was clear
They had put us in someone else’s room
As there were people just walking in our room

The other issue was the food - we was so poorly I was vomiting and my partner had severe diarrhoea- the buffet area in the first few days had air con which was dripping from
The ceiling vents into the food on display.

The next few days I noticed the air con had been turned off most likely because of
The dripping but this meant that the whole buffet area was wet and food warm and condensated it really was vile and I’m certain this was the reason for the illness .The so called al la carte restaurants on site wasn’t upto much either the food served was vile served by rude and ignorant staff

Unfortunately by day 5 we just could not imagine spending the remainder of our holiday at this hotel so we spent a further £2,500 just to enjoy the rest of our holiday at another hotel
