reviews.author: Kamal Garg
reviews.text:
Back from the tropical heaven that Punta Cana is - and Paradisus Real Palma was a great place to spend the week plus that 8 of us enjoyed. The hotel layout is great, the pool and the beach areas are fantastic and the fact that there are many restaurants/bars  within the property is a plus. The garden trails are pretty and the staff is friendly and nice.

Rooms - we were not impressed - the beds were uncomfortable, and were on wheels that moved around. The mainbathroom had flimsy curtain separating the sleeping area from the bathroom with no expectation of privacy. We checked out next level of room that had privacy but that seemed cramped and additional $60 per night. Overall in room experience was below average with only saving grace being the balcony that overlooked lush green gardens.

However - this time around I found the staff to not be that effective - English language, their knowledge of the hotel, ability to be flexible wasn't the usual high level. The food always left us feeling not satiated - it was decent but never great. Similarly, the evening entertainment was a good effort but never quite reached "fun" level. The process of dinner reservations was painful - opens up Sunday for the week, is very slow, and there is Q. But come the dinner time the tables at the restaurants are empty, the wait for food is horrendous, and the menus arent what they were online. The food at these restaurants was average with maybe 1 dish standing out but others were missable. Many members of my party ended up going back to the buffet pr ordering in room, after the pain of reservations, waiting at these restaurants and then getting worse food than the main buffet.

In room service was in "island time" and expected. But most times the orders that were sent were wrong - just enough wrong to not be caught when delivered - example a different kind of soup or different sandwich etc. Nothing crazy but still leaves a  negative impression. Overall we ascribed it to lack of experienced/knowledgeable staff due to pandemic. Overall we were happy to be out in the nice weather during the Holiday time.

Shoutout to Lisette and Miguel in the buffet area, Victor in the pool bar, Antonio and Rijo in the lobby bar and our concierge, Leonela who tried their best.

We stayed at this resort for 7 days. The drinks were mostly watered down, the food tasted the same throughout all the restaurants.
I even noticed when the chefs prepare the food, they dont use gloves.
Its hard to communicate with the staff, they dont speak clear english.
They did not have many daily activities. You have to make reservations for the restaurants, the Italian restaurant was either always closed or too full.
We had a miscommunication with Patricia from reservations: she made dinner reservation for us at 8:30. Once we got to dinner at the Italian restaurant at 8:30, they told us our reservation was for 6:00.
The staff was incredibly rude, especially Fauslo and Dionys from the Italian restaurant, they were not accommodating at all and we had a horrible experience because Patrica made a mistake on our reservation time.
Also, at the pool closest to our room, the staff tried to steal $20.00 from me because I asked if we can use their floaty for the pool. Those floats are free to use for guests and they tried to steal from us. The rooms are also so far away from the ocean and restaurants. We will not be staying here ever again. We rented two rooms, You would assume service would be top notch, Unfortunately  it was not.

reviews.author: K. Theodos
reviews.text:
The resort has a lot going for it but at the same time some real disappointments. After spending eight days there I generally had a good time but will be trying a different resort next time I visit Punta Cana.

Upon arrival we were given a totally unacceptable room.   The furniture was damaged, the fridge was battered, there was dust everywhere, it smelled, the room safe didn't work, and the shower sprayed water out of a pipe connection when turned on.  That was a really bad first impression.  But in fairness the room they transferred us to was way way better.  It was still kind of old, but everything worked and everything was clean.  But being given the terrible room in the first place left a bad taste.  There was another family that came a day after us and apparently had a similar experience.  The woman was yelling at the top of her lungs that she was cancelling her reservation and going to the Hard Rock.

The next disappointment was the beach.  Hardly anyone swam in the sea because it was just filled with some kind of vegetation all along the shoreline and in the water.  And it was a lot!!  I realize that's nature and not much the resort can actually do much about, but people should be aware of it.  Maybe it's a seasonal problem.  But it made the beach completely undesirable for swimming.

The food was pretty good and the service was also good.  Most of the servers were friendly and helpful.  Of all the place I've been to in Punta Cana, Paradisus Real had the best tasting food so far.  But, although we really did enjoy our meals and drinks all four of us were sick with bad stomachs at least two to three days.

The pools are okay.  Nothing amazing but no complaints.

The public areas are beautiful and clean.  And the entertainment was pretty good too.  They had a great Queen tribute band that was damn good.

I thought when I booked the trip that the Paradisus was a cut above the competition.  But unfortunately it just wasn't.  I paid more but didn't feel it was justified.

reviews.text: We loved this resort! It was clean and beautiful. The service was amazing and the food was very good. We booked in the Royal Service suite and loved the extra serve and amenities we got like the private pool, reserved cabanas and the private restaurant Palazzo which was one of the best we ate at. Our butler Angelo was excellent and very responsive to our needs. It was so fun to have him as our “friend” and “Familia” during our stay! There was no restaurant that we didn’t like...even the buffet was better than others we have been to! We will be back...we will request Angelo as our butler and we highly recommend this resort and staff to everyone!!!

reviews.text: This is by far the worst resort I have been on! We are a family of 3 with an infant. First of all we had to wait till 5 pm for the room to get cleaned! With an infant it was very inconvenient because I would have to wait out in the sun till the room was cleaned for me to bathe my child. Second we gave a lot of tips out to the employee to get us water for the baby and we would wait hours and hours for them to get us the water. In order to make restaurant reservations it was a hassle always booked and they make you eat at the buffet. There’s no good hygiene the chef cooking eggs or making grill have no gloves on and would empty the cheese bare hand with nails dirty it was disgusting and it was repeated multiple of times by different employees. Every time you ask for a food as simple as cheese they say we don’t have anymore even though it would still be early in the day. They claim that you have a concierge that will do all the reservations and anything that was needed! Our concierge Deysi was absolutely the worst to deal with she would see us down the hall and turns her head away. We would ask her to make reservations for the restaurant she always has an excuse why she couldn’t do the reservation. THERES ABSOLUTELY NO NIGHT LIFE THERES NOTHING TO DO AT NIGHT! reviews.author: Edgar
reviews.text:
Overall, the facilities are in good shape but, they were starting to show a little wear and tear, perhaps due to the pandemic clausures.

The beach and pools are very clean and the staff around is always willing to serve you.

The food was very tasty and fresh. However, the buffet could benefit from a bit more variety for lunch and dinner; breakfast was more complete.

The restaurants that we tried (TOKIMEKU, VENTO, SAL STEAK CAVE) were all good but, Leandro at the steakhouse provided the best attentions and the food was delicious.

The bar service was pretty good also. Nonetheless some bars didn’t carry all the same spirits or they would run out of some; and, the pool bar had mostly generic brands which is more typical of lower category hotels.

That said, a special mention goes to the Lobby Bar staff: the bartenders, Lucia and Luis, were as super friendly and humble as well as amazingly talented and entertaining mixologists. Their supervisor, also Luis, always came around for a nice chat or recommendations.

As expected, the real “luxury” is reserved for upgraded guests so, don’t expect the standard all-inclusive package to blow your mind. Fortunately, our concierge Felipe took very good care of us!

Lastly, the Circle by Meliá staff should learn how to pitch their program in less time (or stick to the 40 to 50 minutes promise) instead of taking over 2 hours of your precious vacations.

reviews.text:
An amazing all inclusive hotel. If you're looking to go here as an "adults only" vacation then you need to SERIOUSLY consider Royal Service. We booked our trip here through Costco and the $300 upgrade to Royal Service for a week was well worth the price. Royal Service had their own bar, pool, huts that your butler reserves for you and a few extra restaurants. The beach the week we were there (End of Aug 2018) had lots of seaweed washing up on it and every morning had tractors and bucket loaders filling dump trucks full of seaweed. Which wasn't as big of an inconvenience as the construction at the motor lobby. The tent in the parking lot was nice that it was stocked with water but a beer or soda would've been nice too. Overall we had nice week lounging by the pool, eating endless food, and drinking.

I'd recommend not doing the time share because they'll make it fit your price range by halfing down until they can make it work for you. The drinks and hotel sound nice but with airfare not included it just wouldn't work for us. Also bring your own sunscreen.

reviews.text: Angelo made our trip just perfect!! He was so attentive and respectful! Anticipating what we wanted before we knew we wanted it!!

reviews.author: Fabiola Carrillo
reviews.text: Antonio at the reception desk was very helpfull. He took the time to find us a great room, Rodolfo our butler was very helpfull in doing reservations at restaurants and more, cesar at flora restaurant was very good service

reviews.author: Ruthie Diaz
reviews.text: Atmosphere was nice . But of course  the staff make It better!!  Darlin was the bomb. Great energy and very engaging. Anderson and   Altagracia from the Avenue bar were VERY ATTENTIVE. She had our drinks on the ready whenever  we wanted /needed them. Axel and Jairo  were both soooo friendly with all guest and gave the best dance lessons. Such a great experience with the staff alone!!!

reviews.author: Rebekah Worstell
reviews.text: Amazing place and beautiful. The ocean was incredible. They treat you like family. Go to lunchbox! Best place for breakfast and lunch. Alexander, Maria, and Yanelsi were great at breakfast.

reviews.author: Daniel Simon
reviews.text:
Japonais (Tokimeku) was phenomenal! Great service, great time. Fanny and Victor was great, and Santo too!!

Also, my kids loved the Kids Club. Joanna and Marta treated my kids so well that my son cried when it was time to leave! Highly recommended.

reviews.author: D Rodriguez
reviews.text: Had a wonderful anniversary trip. Our butler Kelvin was super helpful and attentive. He would often take care of accommodations without us even having to ask. For example, on our last day/night, he reserved a pool cabana for us to lounge and relax. And at night he arranged for a nice surprise waiting for us in our room, including a bubble bath, champagne, balloons and a cake. We had such a great time we are planning to bring the family next time

reviews.author: Ayim Jakypbek
reviews.text: Fransico at the restaurant Flora was a great server. Flora out of all the restaurants here was the best ! Everyone goes crazy over the super booked steakhouse Mina but honestly Flora was the best !

reviews.author: Jonathan Lora
reviews.text: I had a great time here at this hotel. Food was okay, but I think that comes with the territory of all inclusive. Jesus, Nathaniel, Jairo, and Darlin were all awesome. They were all able to keep us entertained on our stay here. We will definitely return because of the great customer service.

reviews.author: Neelam Hinduja
reviews.text: We visited this resort in April 2023. Resort was beautiful.  Lot of activities planned for kids and adults. Caretakers in the Kids room were super attentive, loving and caring. Every night there was some music event planned which was very entertaining.  Would love to come back to this resort.

reviews.author: Mark Haase
reviews.text: We have been to several Caribbean Islands and resorts, and have returned to Paradisus Palma Real the last eight years.   The renovations and upgrades are wonderful.   Though what keeps us coming back are the relationships we have established with Alvaro, Ariel, Wanda, Pedro, Yuderi, Rafael.   Seen him and he has been there in the past.    “Our home away from home”

reviews.author: Greg Schultz
reviews.text: Luis was a master of bartending at the ginger bar .. along with the Miiguel, and his brother from another mother Luis made for a great vacation .  Tha ks for the good times and drinks .. cheers

reviews.author: Nichelle Lee
reviews.text: The resort is beautiful and we are having an amazing time! Everyone is very nice! Jorge gave me flowers for my birthday and made me feel very welcome and special!

reviews.author: Heba Sayeda
reviews.text: The resort's impeccable maintenance complements its prime beachfront location. Luis Cadet, our dedicated personal concierge, embodied kindness, proactiveness, and exceptional assistance. He not only ensured we were informed about all the available benefits and activities but also went above and beyond, arranging a last-minute birthday cake for my son, seamlessly coordinating luggage drop-offs and pick-ups, ultimately making our trip utterly hassle-free.

reviews.author: Maria Bravo
reviews.text: Jairo y chef Jonas Jimenez treated us with a free wine tasting and meat tasting, ocean front, that was superb.  We were having lunch and saw the table to taste and join the group. It was magnificent!!!!!

reviews.author: IAMIMMORTAL
reviews.text: Amazing service in the whole hotel. In the lobby Caribe, Leonela Duran waitress always looked out for us, so that we didn't get thirsthy the time we spent in there. The drinks were also made very good.

reviews.author: J Medina
reviews.text: Maria Superville, Magda and Denis at the Ginger bar were super. Ms Superville represents her last name very well. She was superb. Thank you Ginger bar team for making our stay an enjoyable experience.

reviews.author: Will Sassack
reviews.text: Paradisus was a beautiful resort with great service. We were frequently checked on by many workers, and I consider some of them my amigos. Would definitely recommend to anyone looking for an all inclusive resort in the Caribbean.

reviews.author: JoDee Claussen
reviews.text:
Awesome place! Super clean and great staff! Beautiful beach and water!! Pools and drinks are wonderful too!
The steak house is amazing!
Nightly entertainment has been good too! Andelson is super nice and smells good!

reviews.author: Chen Noah
reviews.text:
I stayed in many all inclusive resort all over Mexico and the Caribbean, this is by far the worst one I stayed in.
Inside the building where all the regular rooms are there is a night club that is open until 2am. The music is so loud, no one can sleep in the noise.
If you want to upgrade to stay at a quieter building you need to be the Reserve which is adult only or The Reserve family section which is over 10 minutes walk from the beach with no view at all.
After many complaints they promised to reduce the music a little which helped, but every night we had the same problem again and again.
This hotel is very run down.
Food is average minus. The only good thing is the service, still cant compare the service to any of the Mexico resorts I have been to.

reviews.author: Alissa Lewis
reviews.text: Great family vacation experience at Paradisus! Loved everything. The ginger bar is super fun! Antonio made every experience there memorable and fun!

reviews.author: Anthony Palacios
reviews.text:
A Memorable Stay at Melia Paradisus Palma Real

Our recent stay at Melia Paradisus Palma Real was nothing short of exceptional, thanks to the outstanding service provided by our butler, Leonardo Cedeño. From the moment we arrived, Leonardo went above and beyond to ensure our comfort and satisfaction. His attention to detail, warm hospitality, and prompt assistance made our vacation truly memorable. Whether it was arranging special dining experiences or providing personalized recommendations, Leonardo’s dedication to excellence was evident in every interaction. We highly recommend Melia Paradisus Palma Real and commend Leonardo for his exemplary service.

reviews.author: Jennifer schwarz
reviews.text: We loved our stay at the reserve at Palma real!  Food was great and the service was amazing!   The kids absolutely LOVED kidsdom!  Emmanuel and the whole team at kidsdom was top notch!  High energy and so much fun.  The kids just wanted to keep going back for more.

reviews.author: Hannah Rumbaugh
reviews.text: We found a spot on the beach, but our butler found us mid-day and told us that we had special, reserved spots in a different area. The staff have been very attentive and accommodating. We loved room service our first morning here. We look forward to the rest of our stay!

reviews.author: Bethany Read
reviews.text: Excellent meal! Multiple people to ensure every course is covered. I have Celiac and dairy allergy = can be challenging. The staff was able to work around it.thank you!

reviews.author: Adela Pekic
reviews.text:
What amazing time my daughter had here. Ms.Rosa ,Stephanie,Martha and Joanna were the sweetest to my daughter.
Also Alexandra, Jenny And Awilda would play with her and make her feel very welcomed every morning. My daughter would spend all day at day care didn’t wanna go back to the room.

reviews.author: Mayra Mariscal
reviews.text: One of the best services we have received. Great place with family or on your own. LOVED Sante restaurant great food!!!! Serves was the best and Surinda was a great host!!! Our servers we very nice. This is a great place for vacation 👌 very beautiful and the people are the best!!!! Definitely recommend coming here!! Definitely coming again!!!

reviews.author: stephanie Alvarez

reviews.author: Rene Wills

reviews.author: Krishna Prasad

reviews.author: Shamorrow Jones
reviews.text: Great customer service from Harry Milor. He made this vacation one to remember. Thanks to him I’m already planning another trip here. Our stay here was nothing short of amazing. Harry was there for our every need and that was very much appreciated.

reviews.author: Noah Downer
reviews.text: Excellent service at Sante. Many thanks to a total team effort that made our experience memorable, especially Eduardo Aquino, Jose, Amanda, Saudy and Franklin. Enjoyed how each was able to advise of night activities at resort and even chatted about the birds at the sunset.

reviews.author: O'Neil Anderson
reviews.text: Melia resorts are top notch to begin with. But this time we had the pleasure of meeting Joel, our bartender. He was nothing short of amazing, friendly and his margaritas were top notch! Def recommend Paradisus Palma Real.

reviews.author: Nikki Cheung

Luis, Yuverky, Benjamin were a ton of fun!

reviews.author: Ryan Faith

reviews.author: Yanet C
reviews.text: VICTOR and this kicks sports bar makes the beat drinks in-the worlds !!was an amazing server . . recommended 100 percent.amazing dirnk the whole staff was amazing and very helpful at night it becomes a club and its so much fun!!

Amazing vacation! Lovely staff and services. Food and drinks are awesome! We had the best experience.

reviews.author: Kelly Dearhouse

reviews.author: Chris Grimes
reviews.text:
Restaurant Flora at the paradisius was fantastic. Our server Vladimir , Anna, Glenna were awesome!

reviews.text: Miguel is the absolute best bartender!!!! He makes the best drinks at Kicks Sports Bar. Make sure to stop by and ask him to make your drinks. He won’t disappoint.

reviews.author: Christina Langone
reviews.text: Fabulous the service was amazing the resort was clean and sanitized since we were worried about traveling during covid. We had an amazing Butler named Starlin Tavarez if you can request him he did everything from making reservations for dinner to booking massages and keeping us updated daily with activities and what is going on in the resort. It was my anniversary and he did something special for me and my husband. We had an amazing trip.

reviews.author: BAIZHOU XING
reviews.text: We had a very great time here, the food at Flora restaurant was surprisingly delicious and excellent customer service delivered by Melina, her positive attitude made the entire process a pleasure, highly recommended!

reviews.author: Tim Ozmina
reviews.text:
The paradisus palma real hotel has been excellent! There is a good chance that we will return next year.
5/5 would recommend for vacations.

And the best part about this hotel is our concierge Miguelito Cuevas. He has been very professional, attentive to requests, and has been helping us with everything from restaurant reservations to answering question, and helping us locate all of the different activities. Miguelito is the best of the best!

The Reserve Beach was fantastic! Rafael is the man. Make sure to ask for him when you come to the beach. Rafael and Wanda always made sure all needs were met and kept the good times going.

Candle workshop at paradisus palma real was amazing. Amy, Jason, Samuel, and Javier were great. They made the experience so fun!

reviews.author: Petra Šatavová
reviews.text: Very much appreciate Santos and Marta at the Malwa restaurant

reviews.author: Julian Rivera
reviews.text: Our trip to Punta Cana was amazing! Thank you to our concierge Nathaniel for his service and making our five night stay unforgettable. We look forward to coming back again soon!

reviews.author: andy gontarz
reviews.text:
Our overall stay at the reserve at paradisus Palma Real was superb.  Our concierge Yaleidi Sims made the trip.  She made all of our reservations and helped us during our multitude of flight cancellations.  Our original stay was for 8 days (7nights) and then we needed 2 additional days on last minute notice.  She helped to ensure we could stay in same room.
The overall site is beautiful.  The Reserve has a more natural feel versus the Gran Cana.  The Reserve has more mature landscaping and paths while the Gran Cana is more modern feel.
Thank you for a great time.

reviews.author: Amanda Downs
reviews.text:
It's a bummer that I got no response from the Hotel from the survey they sent me following the conclusion of my stay on June 6. We were hoping they would reach out to us on our feedback for them to try and recover some of our thoughts before writing a review online.
We stayed in the Reserve (adults only) part of the resort and came to relax, reconnect and celebrate our 30th birthdays. We were able to relax majority of the time.  The service from Wanda and Teofilo at the pool bar was incredible! Hairon Louis who handled the daily activities was one of the friendliest Team Members we encountered during our stay and checked in with us every day!

Unfortunately we were disappointed with more than we were really happy about in terms of the resort offerings as a whole:
- Online 5 Star Reviews being pressured from our first dining experience on our arrival day until we left. Servers would give us a QR Code to write a review, gave us a paper with all their names and were asked to see the review before we posted it. We did not write one review onsite.
- Food quality is not great. We only had one good dinner at the steak house on our last night throughout our 5 nights. Don't go to Hibachi and expect a great meal with somewhat of a fun dining experience. We sat for half the dinner with no entertainment and only got protien and rice. They served no vegetables.
- No poolside food. We had to leave the pool or beach every day to go dine in for lunch. I have never experienced this at an all inclusive.
- Were almost forced into a "sales pitch" lunch for the Circle Club. We were asked to meet our concierge for a walk through of the circle club benefits. When we reached out to say we were not intersted in the meeting, our concierge didn't really acknowledge that we just wanted to relax and enjoy our day. He said just come when we go to lunch. That is when he was going to have someone sit down and talk to us during our lunch and said it would be 45 minutes. We said absolutely not. We are here to enjoy our time together and not have a sales pitch meeting.
- We were not offered a dinner to the adults only dining restaurant (Flora) even though we were staying in the Reserve. We had to ask our concierge to try and arrange this for us.
- Spa ... with this being a "spa resort" I was surprised that there were no spa amenities. We had massages and facials which were great but no relaxation space before or after your treatment.
- Rooms ... got locked out on our balcony. We saw this happen to other guests as well. There is an issue with their door self latching and locking when you close the doors.

reviews.author: chad kastel
reviews.text:
This resort has a lot of 5 star features and some things that are not.

The rooms are very well done and spacious and great for a family.

The kids clubs is a 100/100 I can’t tell you how great the women are there. Sweet, attentive, attention to detail. It’s really hard to leave your children away but these ladies made it so easy. Our girls 2 and 4 had such a wonderful time.

Sujedi, yesmeily, Joanna, maths, alexdra are memorable. The hotel did a great job hiring and training

The location and closeness to the ocean is great.

The bad stuff:

Your concierge will try and upswell you on other locations. He told us he had a “surprise for us” wasted an hour of our vacation only to try to sell us on another property. This wasn’t his fault. Clearly the establishment is pushing this. Not something I’d expect from a 5 star resort

We had a very hard time getting dinner reservations. one of the ones we got was messed up internally.

When you’re on the beach you will be non stopped harassed by salesman who do NOT work for the resort.

There’s a lot of false advertisements by the staff. We originally on the beach resort. It was advertised as a 5 star but very clearly was not. We moved to the paradiso and were told it’s the nicest resort, that we could go to the falcon and use their facilities etc… lots of things ended up not being true.

Changing hotels isn’t ideal.

Overall good trip but likely won’t come back. I have a personal pet peeve with false advertisement and I don’t like being up sold constantly, especially by the hotel.

reviews.author: Kiara Cabezduo
reviews.text:
Love the service! Feels so personal for you and absolutely felt loved by everyone. Shoutout to Alba, Jairo, Wendy for being so kind and great at their work

Personal shoutout to Jose Ramires, for always being such a ray of sunshine to everyone around and being the sweetest person to my whole family. He truly treats us like a friend and is just amazing. I hope everyone can meet him during their stay

And a special shoutout to Raul. He has always been kind to my entire family in all of the years staying at the resort. He is always willing to help out and treats all guests with major respect. He is also super fast at getting any orders you ask for. He is simply the best, and everyone needs to meet Raul during their stay.

reviews.author: Anthony Torres
reviews.text: All I can say is wow.  Place is absolutely beautiful. Activities are OK. Service is top notch. They make you feel like royalty. Place is rocking on the weekends. Restaurants are hit and miss. Hibachi and Steakhouse were great.  The others were so so. Breakfast and lunch buffet are fantastic.

reviews.author: Allison K
reviews.text:
Rum Rebulic was informative and entertaining with Juana V and Brandall P presenting the Mamajuana workshop. The tasting offered a fair size of the liquor with a great background presentation.

Kicks sports bar had a really fun and exciting mixology experience. I highly recommend going and trying it out!

reviews.author: john neider jr
reviews.text: Luis is the best bartenter at the Ginger bar. Attention to detail and just a all around fun gr8 guy..

reviews.author: Bella Bella
reviews.text: Had a great vacation at Paradisus Palma Real in Punta Cana. The food at this resort was great. Especially at the restaurant Sante, Manager- Andino Jimenez, Hostess Nirlenne Jimenez, Waiters- Pamela, Jaudys, Amanda, Jose, Bartenders- Virgina. The service was wonderful, the staff was kind and attentive.

reviews.author: Margarita Malaspina
reviews.text: Angela and Juan Castillo made our vacation better! thanks for the attention and due diligence. Fitness classes are great! thanks to Joel Peralta for the cross fit class. It was excellent.

reviews.author: Kevin Larrison
reviews.text: Buffet is awful.    Dinner restaurants are half full but there’s supposedly no reservations available.    Room was nice and the ladies that cleaned our room were wonderful.   Minibar guy came some days but  never on the days when we were out of something.   AC unit broke one day. 80 degrees in the room.   First guy came to fix,  put the thermostat in bypass and said he fixed.    Still blowing hot air, so second guy came.    We left for dinner reservations.   Came back 4 hr later.  Room was still 80.    Called front desk 3 times.    Guy comes 30 mins later and tried the same trick.   I proclaimed the air blowing out of the supply is hot.    He left and said he would be back in 5 mins.    Additional call to the front desk and nothing.    No one came back.   So slept in my room with it being 80 degrees.   We were there with a very large corporate group.   Im totally surprised they picked this place.   Bar tenders were a mixed bag.  Literally some couldn’t make a vodka,sprite with a lime.   Heck some bars acted like they never heard of lime and insisted that a lemon was same thing..   I will say that the dinner restaurants were pretty decent, and our waiters George and Rosanna were absolutely amazing.  Lennison was our bellman and he was a shining star as well.   With the cost of this place I would highly encourage you to go to a newer and nicer resort.

reviews.author: Arthur Carlucci
reviews.text: Maria Ortiz is very professional and her service is also great.  Maria is very pleasureable and bubbly.  We always like to sit in her area at supper time.  She makes dining a pleasure.

reviews.author: Tim Kelley
reviews.text: The Ginger Bar at the Palma Real is the perfect place to grab a coffee treat or a before dinner cocktail. Love this place. Ismael is the best and gives us awesome service. This is my daily go to.

reviews.author: Elvis Santana
reviews.text: Very nice place with great food options and super friendly staff. Rooms are very nice and the resort is huge. Not very authentic for DR but great for a 4 day stay. Beach is ok but not Extoic at all with no fish in the water visible. Coffee bar is awesome.

reviews.author: Andrew Rivas
reviews.text: I had a amazing time at the Mina steak house. They made there steak so good. Idelka guerrero made sure to take care of us. Some of the best service I’ve ever had actually!

reviews.author: Nelson Gonzalez
reviews.text:
Service was excellent Luis and Natanael are excellent.
Always on point with drinks and service. They remember what you like and make sure you are comfortable.
Fiol and Andreina go where you are and bring good quality service all the time.

reviews.author: Maggie Moerdyke
reviews.text: Amazing resort!  Amazing Staff!  Shout out Edidito and the breakfast buffet extraordinaire!   Can’t say enough of Blue Agave and the Japanese dinner venue!  Over the top night acrobatics!

reviews.author: Josue Arroyo
reviews.text: I went to Gabi Beach bar Olga Martinez was our bartender and she made very awesome mojito, it was very delicious. The other staff that was working with her were very awesome as well Manuela Elbeis and Ruby Vallejo. I would recommend this bar to anyone.

reviews.author: Roland Chu
reviews.text: Kids club staff are excellent, special thanks to Joanna, Jesus, Tanya for taking care of the kids with many activities through out our 5 night stay. My kids love the arts and crafts and pool activities

reviews.author: Mike Neubauer
reviews.text:
Idelka & Jefry & Nila were great servers and the food was great at the Blue Agave restaurant. Beer was even delivered without prompting! Can’t beat that!

Emmanuel and Luciano were great that the front with the bags.

reviews.author: Brian Poller
reviews.text:
05/13/2019 review...we just stayed at this resort for the second year in a row. We were very happy with the resort . My two children had a wonderful time and I have no complaints. I want to give a special thank you to Heinicy from the romance department. She remembered we had our wedding there a year ago and she was so wonderful to us! She went out of her way just because she wanted to make our stay more enjoyable  then it already was! Thank you so much Heinicy!

05/13/2018 review My wife and I had our wedding at this resort on 5/5/2018. Everyone who attended our event was very happy with the resort/food and pool area. It was a beautiful resort and the wedding turned out really nice. Catherine was a wedding coordinator and we were extremely satisfied with all of her help she provided.

reviews.author: Margie & Rob Costello
reviews.text: Lewis De la Cruz, our concierge, was exceptional!!  We also loved the incredible service and knowledge of wines displayed by  Jhonathan Acosta at The Winery!! The entire team was incredible but we wanted to specifically mention Lewis and Jhonathan. We can’t wait until we return next year (perhaps with our children and grandchildren :-)!!

reviews.author: Lily Candelario
reviews.text: The team at the breakfast buffet is the best! Janira, Maria and Luis at the snack bar. Staff overall is well trained with the “customer first” mentality. This is our 6th time here.

reviews.author: Chris Isabell
reviews.text: I had an amazing experience at Paradisus. The food at all of the restaurants were great. Our concierge representative, Fernando Ducoudray provided my wife and I great hospitality.

reviews.author: Chris F
reviews.text: The resort was wonderful and the view is unbeatable! Starlin was our concierge and he made our trip perfectly effortless! Mario at The Reserve pool is the best bartender! I’ll definitely come back.

reviews.author: Ryan Thai
reviews.text: It was a good trip, aside from the weather when we went. Everything was accessible and it was okay. Slow on some restaurants for food but Ginger Bar was good. Jose Ramirez helped us out on the last day.

reviews.author: Larissa Trevino
reviews.text: Amazing resort and great service! Yafreisy Soleda and Maria Ortiz were amazing workers. The food was also very good. The rooms were very clean. There are many pools and didn’t feel crowded at all.

reviews.author: Mahek Dixit
reviews.text: Andelson was the best part of our vacation. He was so nice and welcoming and our trip wouldn’t have been the same without him. His friendship and service was absolutely amazing. We highly recommend this resort simply because of him.

reviews.author: Steve Myer
reviews.text: Great ocean, beach and pools, this is a relaxing getaway vacation.  I was pleased with the friendliness of the staff.  The facilities were great, although the shower was a bit odd (took awhile to figure it out).   The downfall to me was the food.   There were plenty of options, but for my palate, it wasn't that good.  Others said it was fine, so it really just depends on your taste.

reviews.author: Poochie Otero
reviews.text: Yanir and Rosanna were great. What a wonderful vibe. Great views of the beach and palm trees and upbeat and friendly vibes. Service with a smile. Check out the resort and see Yanir and Rosanna at the lunchbox.

reviews.author: Jessica Lledes
reviews.text: Paradisus Palma Real , the food is amazing , the grounds and pools are so beautiful and specially our concierge Anayely Rivera. She went above and beyond to make us feel special. We’re in love with this resort and Anayely’s service and attention ❤️❤️

Recommend anything Juan Vicente makes you!

reviews.author: Evangeline Coritsidis
reviews.text: Yafreisi soler y Maria Mercedes —these two girls were simply AMAZING. The service we received from them was beyond EXCELLENT!! Cannot say enough wonderful things about these women

reviews.author: Richard Serrano
reviews.text: I had an unbelievable time.  I would have given this five stars if I would not have had an irritating experience with my room key late at night.  No one seemed to care until I flagged down security so they could come let me in my room and reprogram my card.  Our Butler Armando was fantastic.  He was very attentive and made sure we had everything we needed.  He was accommodating to us and the other group of our friends.  I will definitely return and hope to have him as our personal butler.

reviews.author: Steven Anglin
reviews.text: The group was fantastic Mr wonderful makes us party  alll night. A lot of energy and fantastic interaction.. soranyi is very lovely and joyful

reviews.author: Lilly
reviews.text: I absolutely love the kidsdom and I have used the entire week in our stay. All of the staff were wonderful and my kids adores them all and wanted only to stay at the kids center. I truly appreciate the care and the affection they showed the kids and mostly they have learned to do so many things which it surprised me so much. You will truly feel that your kids will be very well taken care of. If I could I give them 10 stars

reviews.author: James Cook
reviews.text:
Thought I was staying at the Palma Real but room was moved to the garden inn which used to be the reserve. 90 minutes to check in and the place smells like a damp basement with the room being worse.  No towels, soap and mini fridge not stocked in the room. Toilet broken and tonight there is no running water in the room.  Dishes still here from two days ago, beds not made and floor unswept for two days.  Food is not good.  I never write bad reviews but I need to warn people because of how much this resort charges.  The garden inn property is a 2.5 star resort on its best day.  Don’t be looking for a beach either, you have to take a golf cart to the nice resort to see it

Thank you for the canned reply.  Unfortunately the stay got worse.  Last night topped it off when I went to bed and noticed blood stains on my pillow that had been changed with linens while we were out.  The absolute most disgusting thing I have ever experienced at a resort.  You should all be ashamed and embarrassed

reviews.author: Zaira Chappell
reviews.text: The food at Kicks was very good, and the service was excellent. Jose was a great server and Yiri had great service.

reviews.author: Thalia Flores
reviews.text: The restaurant Blue Agave had excellent service and the food was delicious. Alexander and Santo were very attentive and helped make our dining experience extraordinary.

reviews.author: Manuel Stephens
reviews.text:
Staff on bar ginger was super friendly, always greeting you with a big smile and a warm welcome.

Ginger bar was a really good experience during our stay.

reviews.author: Mateo Noguera
reviews.text: Great place to stay, beautiful location. But the all inclusive component is somewhat lacking in certain areas. For the price you would expect a bit better service at times. Some of the staff are amazing, and offer the best service ever, but the quality varies. Brandol was great.

reviews.author: Tenisha Williams
reviews.text: Zenovia and Anayely was absolutely amazing. They work so good together as a team. They went and got whatever we needed. They was very responsive. Fun. Great with all our needs. It was a party of 8 of us and we all liked them both. I just wish we had cash to tip them they deserve it.

reviews.author: Tatiana Quintanilla
reviews.text: Today we had the best experience at Toky Meku. The service provided by Alexander Santos, our waiter and Kendy Santana our chef, was more than excellent. Their energy and charisma made us feel at home. Thank you for all of your hard work it doesn’t go unnoticed! Dominican power! 😊

reviews.author: Temi Banjo
reviews.text: Marta Paulino was a very gracious hostess. Always ready to assist and with a very big smile on her face. Excellent service and good food.

reviews.author: Spencer Liu
reviews.text: Eating at the Blue Agave was an excellent experience with wonderful waiters there to guide me through the menu! Highly recommend eating here during your stay at Paradisus!

reviews.author: Lori Casson
reviews.text: Dined at Mazcalzone. Excellent experience.   Food was fresh and everything was prepared expertly.  Our server, Raider was attentive and anticipated our every need.  Highly recommend.  (Also shout out to H3ctor for the reservation!)

reviews.author: Ella Zimmermann
reviews.text: We had a great trip to Paradisus! Zenovia was the best concierge, extremely accommodating and truly made the vacation special. Rafael, Pedro, Yuderi, and Gilberto at the Reserve beach were also spectacular.

reviews.author: DJ Glez
reviews.text: Paradisus Palma Real Mascalzone restaurant, Fausto provided extra miles services, he modified the menu to satisfy our preferences creating in a flash great dishes. Very professional waitress. I deeply recommend this place.

reviews.author: Ellane Park Yook
reviews.text: We had a pleasant stay at Paradisus Palma Real. All the resort staff were hospitable and responsive to all our requests from our concierge Edgar Rodriguez to house keeping Berenice to the bell boys Melvin Mercedes, Miguel De la Rosa, and Emmanuel Bautista. They accommodated our specific needs and went out of their way to help us, even if it wasn’t part of their job description.

reviews.author: Diane Aiguier
reviews.text: We had the pleasure of working with the wedding event team. We worked with Patricia who was absolutely the most patient and pleasant individual. She was extremely professional and always had a smile on her face. If I could steal her to the US I would!!! This place is fabulous!!!!!!!

reviews.author: Persio Bencosme
reviews.text: We have had a splendid time here at Paradisus Palma Real, very improved from our last time here. The renovations they have done to Palma Real makes this resort one of our favorites in Punta Cana for sure. Don’t forget to stop by Mina Steakhouse for dinner, delicious food and the service is outstanding specially by Yudy and Junior. Ask for them, you won’t regret coming to Mina for the impecable service and their meat. Btw they also have fish of the day!!

reviews.author: Sarah Schneider
reviews.text: Ernesto is muy bueno!! He made our experience very relaxing and enjoyable. I give ernesto 5 stars along with the resort. We had reservations for dinners every night. The pools were amazing and everyone was very polite and kind. The food was also delicious. Being our honeymoon, he made sure we were taken care of. We will be coming back.

reviews.author: Vic Ram
reviews.text:
Staff is very friendly and helpful.   Resort needs to be better prepared for larger crowds or not to overbook.
Pool towels not available almost every day and No apple juice any day, wow.
Activities are subcontracted and not direct managed by resort, be very clear on what are you paying for and read fine print on your liabilities.
Rooms are clean, food is amazing and staff is the best.

reviews.author: Eliza
reviews.text: The resort is stunning. Came for a girls trip and had an amazing time. Fernando our concierge was fantastic! Excellent food, drinks and service. Definitely recommend.

reviews.author: Mabel Ocampo
reviews.text: Best vacation ever! The staff at the resort go above and beyond to ensure the guest receive their dream come true during their stay. Kuddos to Eriol (our lovely butler), Jesse (the amazing reserve manager), Stephanie (our maid) Juan, Franklin, and Gustavo (spectacular waiters at Sante), and Miledys (hostess) who always welcomed us with a big smile. Xo

reviews.author: Keatyn Lorenzen
reviews.text: Kicks Sports Bar is amazing! Jose del rosario is the best waiter and it’s such a fun place.

reviews.author: Golub Trbic
reviews.text: Mascalzones can be summarized in one word: amazing. From the staff to the menu, completely inspired by Italian cuisine. It is a place that you have to dine in. Everything on the menu looks amazing, but from personal experience, the mussels and the caprese salad were a perfect opener to a great meal. The pizza is to die for, with the perfect Neapolitan dough, and the toppings bring the whole thing together for a piece of authentic Italian experience. We finished our night off with a perfect slice of tiramisu. And it was beyond delightful. In conclusion, Mascalzones, from its amazing staff to its amazing food, is a place you have to check out.

reviews.author: John Monahan
reviews.text: Milton at the Italian restaurant was great. The service provided by Yeensen was top notch. Compliments to the kitchen, every course was phenomenal.

reviews.author: Olivia Harris
reviews.text: The italian restaurant was amazing! Milton took great care of us and it was a great experience, great food too!  Ana and Riley were great servers and were very kind!!

reviews.author: Anthony Soler
reviews.text: kicks was amazing and Luis I love them

reviews.author: Abalone Wolf
reviews.text: The restaurant service was excellent! Everyone was attentive inside the restaurant though when we sat outside to take in the view the service was lacking. Frankie and Josh took great care of us at the buffet which is really the best food out of all the restaurants, and we tried all of them.

reviews.author: jose torres
reviews.text: Kicks sport bar the best. Yiri and Miguel soler the best. They treat us great.  Best drinks in the house.   Felt like home.  🙌👏👏👏

reviews.author: Rosie Kosinski
reviews.text: Blue Agave was DELICIOUS and such sweet staff. Santo especially was the best 🥰 what a lovely evening!

reviews.author: Erick C
reviews.text: Paradisus Palma Real is a great place to relax. Bartenders are awesome and have the best customer service. Rafael, Gilberto, Martin, Isais, and Pedro offer the best friendliest service and always recommending something new to drink.

reviews.author: Lina Liberti
reviews.text: Makati is the best waiter in Puta Cana! We have been here several times and love that he’s here always available to ensure my husband and I are well taken care of!!!

reviews.author: Felix Pesa
reviews.text:
Fabulous Experience!!!

We just returned from a wonderful vacation at the Paradisus Palma Real in Punta Cana.
Can’t say enough good about this place.
Upon arrival we had a small issue with the room assigned but the front desk team , I want to mention here Jose Vargas, Emely Moran and Wally Pena, immediately took care of our issue.  We were upgraded to another suite, one of the best of the hotel, thank you .
From the minute we stepped onto the property, to the minute we left, everything was wonderful. The ocean front butler / personal concierge  suite in The Reserve section ( Panoramic Building) was comfortable and appointed nicely, and the view from the balcony was breathtaking. Our butler / personal concierge, Ariel Benzo, took great care of us.
All the staff enjoy conversation and making you feel at home.
We always had comfortable loungers at the pool and the beach, and the pool staff were always there to take care of our every day need .
The hotel is just beautiful - the grounds are so lush, clean and well-kept. The beach was also clean and very inviting with the palapas and cabanas.
All of the dining venues were great and the servers were pleasant and professional. FYI, our favorite restaurant was Sal the steak house and our favorite server was Adriel !
We loved our stay here.
I can't wait to come back to this beautiful property!

reviews.author: James Wyatt
reviews.text: A wonderful resort. Huge - over 500 rooms, but this an extensive range of restaurants to choose from. The beach service from Boni was fantastic. Our three teenage kids loved it. Although “all inclusive” some elements such as some water sports are extra. Decent golf course (compulsory cart fee payable). Happy staff keep the show rolling along day after day. This is our fourth visit - although not been for nine years and the property is kept in good shape. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Samantha Szopinski
reviews.text: Wonderful place!!! Very safe! Covid cautious! Love the people! Staff makes you feel so welcome. Food is great, pool and activities are awesome! Ariel our butler was the best!! He did everything for us! Amazing guy!

reviews.author: Armin Tinio
reviews.text: Had a great time. Staff are great and very respectful. Yuderi is amazing .  Great service at the beach and makes the vest drinks.

reviews.author: destinie rodriguez
reviews.text:
everything was beautiful and great service i would recommend everyone here. i will come again (:
come see ricki he is the best server here, and Lisaldo best cook out here.

reviews.author: Mary Perez
reviews.text: The waiter service at the Flora Restaurant was excellent. Mr. Cesar was professional and his recommendations made our visit a delightful experience.

reviews.author: Nadia Meyer
reviews.text:
The Paradisus Palma Real was amazing.  The hotel was beautiful, clean, and the staff was very friendly.  We had a memorable vacation and experience.
There were many activities and we had so much fun with Andelson Rodriguez.  He was always there to get the party started and get us involved in the activities.  He was always there to take our picture as well! Andelson was very friendly and provided excellent customer service!

reviews.author: Marie-Claude Rivard
reviews.text: Thank you for the amazing service and delicious drinks, Erickson! The 36 degrees - stay cool bar was our favourite place to hang out!

reviews.author: Andrea Begin
reviews.text: Restaurant Blue Agave was a great experience!  Providing good drinks and great food!  Santon and Devin helped orovide a fun birthday party:)

reviews.author: Erin McClure-Dotado
reviews.text: The staff has been absolutely wonderful!  Maira Rossana was so helpful at the lunchbox buffet and brought us lovely mimosas just the way we like it! 90% champagne

reviews.author: Rachel Steelman
reviews.text:
Andino at Sante provided us with top notch service. We had the ribs and lamb chops the first night & they were both delicious. Spring rolls for lunch are a must have!!! Would definitely
recommend.

reviews.author: Jordan Clark
reviews.text: As four 24 year olds, we had a blast at this hotel. We opted for the Royal Service and our butler Alberto was wonderful. He really went above and beyond to make sure we were happy and got everything we needed even if it meant going home and getting something from his home like a simple lighter or aloe to give us. We definitely recommend the royal service and the hotel as a whole and would love to come back soon.

reviews.author: lauren negri
reviews.text:
Hotel is beautiful, first time we are here we definitely will come back. Darlin and Jairo always get the party going and make everything fun!  Taught us how to meringue!
Luis is an unbelievable waiter and made every dinner beautiful!

reviews.author: Noah Vachon
reviews.text: Rosanna, Yanira and Rocio at the lunch box restaurant provided excellent service and were extremely friendly. They were very quick to assist us with whatever we needed.

reviews.author: Manish Gupta
reviews.text:
We booked THIS resort through Costco, but when checking in they bumped us to their Grand Cana property, which was so far away from the beach. We booked Palma Real only due to the proximity to the beach. At no point they notified us of the change in advance. They called it an “upgrade”, which to us was a downgrade.
Dinner reservations was a nightmare, it’s almost like they don’t want you to eat at their restaurants, and we felt like begging to get a spot. We are assigned a concierge, but as soon as he found we were not interested in their black bracelet memberships, he started ghosting us. Front desk employees are clueless about so many things. Lots of promises made by the guy who checked us in but not kept. Property otherwise is beautiful and clean.

reviews.author: Richard hector
reviews.text: This is my 8th time visiting and the hotel staff is always amazing. Maria, Frank & Betty went above and beyond to make sure my family was happy. Absolutely incredible! Highly recommended

reviews.author: Stephanie Green
reviews.text: Half way through our trip right now, so far very enjoyable as it isnt too overly crowded. Emmanuel was super helpful as was ariel and ricki. So many more to name but cannot remember everyone's names.  Food is good, pools are spacious, beech area well kept.

reviews.author: Jill Stock
reviews.text:
Just ate at the Tokimeku Restaurant! It was excellent. Chef Kendy performed cool tricks while cooking and kept us entertained. Our waiter Raffaele was very attentive.
Santo offered us anything we wanted..
GREAT EVENING!!!

reviews.author: Zach Lahey
reviews.text: RAUL is the most delightful, attentive, personable service professional we experienced in Punta Cana, 5 days in a row on the beach. We were so fortunate to have him looking after us!

reviews.author: Grow With Dallas
reviews.text:
My mother and I were a bit hesitant to come out tonight, to be completely honest we have been spending and spending. However Patricia was so nice and convincing that we decided to come out and have a nice steak and lobster dinner facing the beach. I don’t normally do reviews, however this was an amazing experience ,Jairo cepeda,
Wander matos,
Patricia garcia , Happy boy and wilmey our wonderful bartender made this even more special. Guys!!!!! Theirs also multiple beautiful performance, lastly it was my mother’s birthday and Patricia hoook it up.

Do me a favor and come and enjoy a night out with this amazing staff, you will not regret.

Beautiful dancers , beautiful people, amazing food and a even better staff ❤️  Thank you

reviews.author: Alanna Gomez
reviews.text: Came on a family vacation here. The hotel was beautiful and the employees were very attentive, especially Jairo Cepeda. He was the activity director and every night he had so much energy and encouraged everyone to come out onto the dance floor. He made sure everyone was having a good time always. Highly recommend this hotel for your next vacation.

reviews.author: Christina Almonte- Liranzo
reviews.text: Service at the Ginger Bar was amazing and friendly. Ismael and Dominga were fun and positive. The drinks were delicious. Definitely a perfect spot to go to day or night

reviews.author: Ali Raza Shaikh
reviews.text: Was at blue agave restaurant. Food tasted great! Laura and Alexander Bryant did a great job and were very cordial. Would recommend this to friends!

reviews.author: Carlos Huggins
reviews.text: Family Weekend at Paradisus Palma Real was excellent from the beginning to the end, Rooms with the best of comforts, we were in a Swing out room 'The Best' Our Butler Osvaldo helped us accommodate us in every way, Restaurant reservations and Everything else, thank you very much Osvaldo, very good Butler.

reviews.author: Jeff Ratkiewicz
reviews.text: Rosanna is the absolute best!  We love her!  Best service and best smile ever!

reviews.author: Marcus Wright
reviews.text: This place was the first resort for my teens. Unfortunately, there wasn't much to do for activities other than the beach and the pools. For my wife and I, that's fine, but the kids just got bored after 2 days of being there. Beautiful place, most of the staff was "OK" with some of the staff just not what you would expect from a Resort of this caliber.  This just wasn't exactly what we were looking for. This place may be for some, just not for us.

reviews.author: Erica McCollum
reviews.text: Jholfry and Juan Vicente did an excellent job with the Mixology workshop. They were friendly and welcoming. Just wish the guest could actually mix the drinks.

reviews.author: Dino Trevisani
reviews.text: Loved the sports bar Kicks to watch the Masters!  Jose Del Rosario kept us well watered and fed during the Masters.

reviews.author: Crystal Brown
reviews.text: Rafael was wonderful he helped us all week on the beach thank you for the wonderful time

reviews.author: Steva Tucker
reviews.text: Ismael at Ginger is amazing! As well as Dominga, Quintino, Clari, Olga, Nereida, and Yeneter. Best location, best bar and best service! Very friendly and they remembered our drink orders!

reviews.author: Joshua Pickett
reviews.text:
Jorge at the pizza making was great!
Very good fun and we got to eat our creations, plus a lesson for making cocktails! Antony and Jerry were good

reviews.author: Akshay Vasudevan
reviews.text: Jose and Julia were amazing l.

reviews.author: Cynthia Franco
reviews.text: Cesar in Flora restaurant gave us exceptional service. The whole staff actually was great. The restaurant is beautiful and the Bistec Encebollado was delicious

reviews.author: Suiyen Hung
reviews.text: Great experience and so much fun with friends and family. My friends, my son and I had such a fun experience. Great staffs. Our concierge (luis) went above and beyond with our request and his duties as concierge. Excellent ! As for the resort entertainer (Jorge fiesta), he was an excellent instructor and very funny. He made the class so much fun. My friends and I learned the bachata moves in just 1 class. However, I expected in the resort to have a nespresso coffee shop 24/7 like Melia in playa del calmen. Sometimes guests would want a midnight snack and coffee beside alcohol to stay up and spend time with friends while drinking coffee.

reviews.author: Ttiffany Smith
reviews.text: Rosanna, Yanira and Rocio were all so lovely at breakfast this morning! Hopefully we’ll be seated in their area tomorrow!

reviews.author: Alex Garriga
reviews.text: The wood workshop was perfect! Enjoyed out time very much and Jorge Rafael and Mabi were amazing. I am not a painter but really enjoyed this activity. Teofilo at the pool bar was outstanding as well. Very accommodating.

reviews.author: Борис Събчев
reviews.text: An amazing hotel! Good facility, fantastic food! The animation is amazing - dancing, training all day, unforgettable experience. The animators are friendly and so funny. Good contact with the guests. Palanco  and Jean maicor  are the best! Bony from the bar makes cool cocktails and mama Juana!

reviews.author: Dawn Young
reviews.text: MasCalzone at Paradisus Palm Real Resort was an amazing dining experience!  Reynaldo and Yuleni were wonderful servers! Food was amazing!

reviews.author: Prem Khosla
reviews.text: We were a group of 24 ages 1 year to 78.  Everything was to our expectations and we had a great time. The only thing missing was that there is no shallow pool. Staff was very polite and always willing to help.  Food choices were plenty

reviews.author: Andrea Harvey
reviews.text: I was very disappointed with my stay this time! It’s my fifth time coming to this resort and I absolutely love it! I made a reservation in October, for April and two weeks before I was leaving my reservation was changed numerous times. When I got to the resort, I checked in and got to my room. The room was disgusting!!! There was wet paint and no one told us that there was wet paint and one of my family members got paint all over her clothes! There were broken tiles on the floor that you could feel moving. The shower was a mess! They patched the shower and there was black mold inside the shower! The pull out couch had a piece of metal sticking out and the bed felt like it was going to collapse. I am thinking about not coming back because of my experience this time! I am very disappointed!

reviews.author: Adrian Hector
reviews.text: I loved Maria , Frank , and Betty that served at Lunch box. They were very nice and attended to us with care. Will definitely be back because of their hospitality!

reviews.author: Tony DiPede
reviews.text: Malcazone restaurant at the Paradisus real golf ..great experience...starting with the young lady at the door to the ..."just like Nonna makes" rice balls,  delicious snapper, amazing desert with Nutella and pistachio.   The staff, Milton and Wilmina topped it off making it best night only the trip.  Congrats to the team.

reviews.author: M.Sonny Oo
reviews.text: Restaurant Flora , is so good we plenty to come back for the following day.  The service is excellent, the food is unique especially fish main meal.    Goat curry is good to try.

reviews.author: Michael Vidal
reviews.text: Great resort.  Blue Agave was fantastic. Food and service from Jose Eusebio was excellent and the Patrón Silver Margaritas hit he spot.

reviews.author: Bob Moyer
reviews.text:
We loved the team at 32 Degrees bar. Senorita Jimenez, Senorita Vanessa and Senor Luis and Senor Raul.
Delicious drinks, tasty Mamajuana and more. Always 😊
Thank you for treating us to a wonderful vacation!
Muchas gracias.

reviews.author: Rhiannon Honeywill
reviews.text: Delicious food, friendly staff and fun activities. If you sit at Gabi Beach bar make sure to ask for Ruby. She was so kind and offered amazing service. Luis and Gustavo were also a pleasure to deal with.

reviews.author: Niarri Sorapuru
reviews.text: We had 30 people in our vacation party. We had non stop service by the staff. We had service at the pool and beach all day everyday! Drinks were amazing. Two staff members that stood out to us were Nixon and Edgard. Highly recommended resort. Kid friendly too.

reviews.author: Ryan Bickle
reviews.text: Fior is an amazing server but more importantly an amazing woman who treated us like family during our stay. We met her at the sports bar. Great service and watched a lot of hockey.

reviews.author: Doctor Aubie
reviews.text:
Jose Del Rosario , Alam and Carolina went above and beyond taking care
Of us

This is a fun, first class place

We watched the Final Four at
Kicks with Jose!!

reviews.author: Stephen Amodeo
reviews.text: Jose Ramirez has been very resourceful with our transport from the resort to the airport. He went out of his way to make sure we were set and ready for a safe ride as well.

reviews.author: Farid Kassam
reviews.text:
Both Jonathan's, Juan and Maximo were amazing hosts at the Winery at Paradisus Palma Real - if you haven't checked them out, you are missing. Amazing experience and we will be back soon.

Barman Luis Bilorio, Yiri, Jose Genao, Jorge Castillo at Ginger Bar are the best hosts as well. Very hospitable and best service!

Muchas Gracias.

reviews.author: Raymond Vargas
reviews.text: The hotel has been great! The service has been top notch! Special thanks to the team at Kicks Bar! Jorge Rafael, Andreina Moron, Humberto Morel, and Johan Rondon!! Thanks to Sanyi Acosta and Ana Casilla at the Lunch Box!!

reviews.author: Bessy Santiago
reviews.text: My husband and I have stayed in several Melia Hotels and Resorts. This time we came to Palma Real as we gear up to renew our vows and a short escape for my birthday. I most say the stay was nothing but exceptional. We decided to get a concierge this time and DO NOT REGRET IT. Our concierge Starling made our stay run smoothly and effortlessly. He provided amazing service and his charisma makes it even better. I really hope he is here when we return, because in his hand its a for sure WIN! He answered questions in a timely matter, solved any concerns immediately and made sure we were having nothing but a great time. Thank you; un million de gracias.

reviews.author: Lisette Llago Guerrero
reviews.text: We had an Amazing experience overall in the hotel our favor spot was the Sante restaurant the service was outstanding we definitely recommend it we got the best service thanks to Eduardo Estebania, Gustavo, Luz, Gleny, Cristal and definitely our favorite Franklin Acevedo. We are very grateful for out great experience.

reviews.author: Lori Harber
reviews.text: Loyda was Fantastic! She took such good care of us on the beach! Stocked our Cabana and brought us Coconut water, Champaign and we had someone give a foot massage! All for a great price!

reviews.author: Cherrise Smith
reviews.text: we had rafael serving us and it was the best thing experience ever. he’s absolutely the best if you go make sure to ask for him!! THANK YOU RAFAEL

reviews.author: Zak Laursen
reviews.text: Each night at the resort we had a very good time at kicks sports bar. Adreina, victor, luis, miguel shower us all a great time! They played Dominican music all night and it was a blast, super fun time. I highly recommend going here! And we will definitely be back!

reviews.author: Baylee Mello
reviews.text: We loved the painting experience and the sushi making! Brandol was amazing and super engaging & fun!! We can’t say enough good about the experiences.

reviews.author: Stephen McDowell
reviews.text: Good quality hotel services in a densely touristed location of package holidays

reviews.author: Jessica Mordo
reviews.text: Had 2 wonderful dinners at Mascalzone, the Italian restaurant. It was easy to get reservations, service was fast and food was delicious! Order the red snapper which is not on the menu and pana cotta for dessert - thank you Milton!

reviews.author: katerina williams
reviews.text: Andelson Rodriguez provides very good service for my family during the yoga session. I was able to take nice pictures and my kids and sister enjoyed the class a lot. The pools are clean and the water is very nice. The entertainment over all during the night is fun for all families and the service is amazing. Andelson also provides my kids any pool games so they can enjoy their time at Paradisus. Thank you so much!

reviews.author: James Mecaskey
reviews.text:
Luis was the very best Concierge are stay was fabulous. This resort is awesome. We will be back

miguel did a great job helping us with our bags and get to our transport. Thank you

reviews.author: Jordan Flynn
reviews.text:
We hav enjoyed our stay! The service has been wonderful, the staff is incredibly friendly, and it’s been a memorable trip.

Rafael was amazing and provided perfect service on the beach! He made our beach experience perfect!

reviews.author: Courtney Welch
reviews.text: Everything here at this resort was very good! The beach was perfect and our service at the beach was also very good! We had Rafael for our server everyday at the beach and he did an amazing job! Very pleased!

reviews.author: Kat P
reviews.text:
We stayed at Paradisus this week for six days five nights. The resort is very beautiful and great nightly entertainment and that’s about it. The service here was TERRIBLE. The worst customer service we have experience on any island or country we have ever traveled to. To begin our room was not ready for check in and we waited two hours. we were told if we upgrade to the reserve we will get better amenities personal butler private beach and high end drinks. We upgraded. What a joke. First off our butler Mack was supposed to meet us when we check in which we waited for him during our 2+ hour check in and he was a no show. We then were told he’d meet us where we eat. Never showed. Two days later he decides to grace us with his presence. He was asked one thing to book our reservations every night at a different place around 8/830 which ever was available. He said this is not a problem. Ok great. Except every single night every single restaurant there was an issue with our reservation that he didn’t book or he booked them two hours earlier or an hour later. One night the hostess even yelled at us and we called him and they argued back and forth on phone. Anyway we let it go. Every meal at the reserve or any dinner restaurant is a 30 minute to one hour wait to get in and then you wait for food for 1-2 hours. I have never experienced this on a trip in my life. And if you tried to speak to anyone for help NO ONE SPOKE ENGLISH. We used our translator apps and even then no one seemed to understand anything. We are vegetarians we would simply
Ask for meat to be removed from our orders without fail every time the meal came with meat even though every time they say they understand no meat. Several times they had to take meals back bc they put meat in it. Next you try to relax on beach but how can you when fifty times a day people are trying to sell you excursions or cigars or whatever. They are relentless you say no thank you they don’t leave you say maybe next time they try harder. Then we said ok well book speed boats. We spoke to one guy he offered us one price we wrote it down showed it to him he agreed. We show up at 2 pm and he tells us a price $60 more. We show him that is not the price we agreed on he said no. Ok so we said forget it as we walked away another guy tried to sell us same excursion except for the original price we agreed with the other guy. The excursion by the way promises boat ride to “natural pool, dolphin sightings, and snorkeling.l with starfish turtles and fish.” Literally sent to another side of beach blocked by fifty party boats loud as hell and we are hounded to buy drinks. Ok we do. Then we’re told come on we need to see dolphins we go and it’s literally caged in area in ocean run by Aquarium where our driver whistles for the dolphins to come to the fence which they never did and then he says oh well they’re not coming and says well leave. And we do. Then he stops the boat in middle of random area in ocean and when ask what happens now and we’re told we have to snorkel he throws some bread a few small white fish come sand thats it time to leave. What a joke. Then next day we’re hounded to book buggie excursion we said we weren’t interested because we didn’t want to waste the whole day we were told oh no it’s only three hours total very quick. Ok we book it they tell us meet on the beach and someone will pick you up. We walked one mile across beach to find this so called truck which was a dumpster with seats no air conditioning and multiple people
Crammed in to dry 50 min at 35 miles and hour. We get there and once again all they do is hound you to buy things before we even get into center. We asked to do a private tour.  We then are told we’ll visit natural cave the beach and come back. Instead the driver stopped us at every shop. The trip ended up being 5 hours long.

reviews.author: Kenneth Dyer
reviews.text:
We recently had the pleasure of experiencing a truly exceptional getaway at Paradisus Palma Real in Punta Cana. It was a wonderful experience!

The quality of the accommodations surpassed all expectations. The spacious and elegantly designed rooms provided a perfect blend of comfort and sophistication. The attention to detail in the decor and amenities truly elevated the overall experience.

Paradisus Palma Real boasts an array of top-notch amenities that cater to every need. Whether lounging by the swim-up pool, indulging in rejuvenating spa treatments, or taking part in the exciting on-site activities, there was never a dull moment. The resort's commitment to providing a diverse range of experiences is truly commendable.

One of the highlights of our stay was undoubtedly the exceptional dining options. The culinary offerings showcased diverse flavors and impeccable presentation. From the breakfast buffets to the gourmet dinners, each meal was delightful.

What truly set Paradisus Palma Real apart was the unparalleled level of service. Every staff member, from the friendly housekeeping team to the attentive restaurant staff, contributed to making my stay memorable. A special mention goes to our concierge, Miguelito, whose dedication and personalized assistance added an extra layer of warmth to our experience.

Miguelito went above and beyond to ensure our stay was seamless. From expertly arranging dinner reservations to providing insightful recommendations for local attractions, his commitment to ensuring our satisfaction was evident throughout. His professionalism, friendliness, and genuine care for guests truly made him a standout member of the Paradisus Palma Real team.

Paradisus Palma Real is more than just a destination; it's a sanctuary of luxury and hospitality. I wholeheartedly recommend this five-star haven to anyone seeking an unforgettable escape. My sincere thanks to the entire staff, with a special shoutout to Miguelito, for making this vacation truly extraordinary.

reviews.author: Kimberlee M
reviews.text:
We are a family of  5 that had the 2 bedroom suite with Nikte service.
Pros--beautiful grounds, buildings and rooms. The resort itself is gorgeous. The beaches are glorious and the view is breathtaking. It was not full, so there was always somewhere to eat or drink without too much waiting.

Cons--
Beaches--there are always people soliciting you and the resorts do nothing to curtail this activity. We were even woken up once to be asked if we want our hair braided. This made sitting on the beach very tedious and annoying at times. I think the resort could do a better job of protecting their guests from this constant bombardment. However, those people even found us back at our own private pool...so who knows!

Nikte--NOT worth it. Our "person" didn't do anything that a call to the front desk would have done. They cannot make reservations for you or grab you beach chairs or really be useful in any regard. He did get us water in the room a few times and called maintenance for us, but that's it. The real kicker was he tried to get us over to the timeshare resort (Falcon) and sell us that. As soon as we said no, he completely disappeared. We've been to other all-inclusive resorts with similar services that were much, much better. Do not waste your money on this service.

Food--just OK. You cannot get food on the beach or at the pool. They are fairly strict on your clothing at each restaurant. There aren't many choices for kids.  The pool bar was nice but would be better if they served snacks or bar food.  One of the beachside restaurants (Kanna) had no description of the food so we wasted a bunch of food when it was far from our expectations.  We found access to food and drinks limited around the resort in general. Several of the bars were for Circle members which was always empty and seemed like a waste.

Rooms--gorgeous but wonky. The toilet room door was too large so struck the wall instead of closing. Also had to keep the water in the sink running if you wanted a warm shower. Has great potential but they are missing the details of a 5-star resort.

Overall--we would go back to the DR but not to this particular resort for the reasons above. It's lovely on the surface but lacking in food and service that other 5-stars resorts have.

reviews.author: Amanda Fabiano
reviews.text:
If I could assign zero stars to this resort, I definitely would. Despite being a loyal visitor for many years, my recent experience has convinced me never to return. Traveling with a group of 13 people, I made multiple attempts to ensure our rooms were suitable, reaching out to the resort beforehand. Unfortunately, they were unhelpful and upon arrival, our rooms were not as requested.

Upon checking in, I was informed that my room, although an hour past the designated check-in time, was still not ready. The check-in staff displayed a shocking lack of courtesy.

The overall service was abysmal. Requesting basic amenities like water for the room required multiple calls, and the response was often that they wouldn't deliver until 9 AM. Dinner reservations were a nightmare, involving early morning waits only to be told there was no availability until 9:30 PM. Safety concerns at brunch included a lackadaisical approach, such as the grill person using the same tongs for raw chicken and then handling other food items. The food quality was subpar, and requests for simple items like tea at breakfast were denied. It seemed that "no" was the default answer for any reasonable request.

When inquiring about the noticeable decline in service, the resort attributed it to COVID, but I suspect it's more related to ongoing renovations and cutbacks on amenities.

During checkout, our group decided to leave a day early. However, the resort insisted on having me sign a document claiming my departure was for personal reasons, unrelated to their service. This tactic, along with literally stopping my Uber on the way out, exemplifies the resort's greed and commercialization.

Regrettably, what was once a great resort has fallen victim to profit-driven decisions. My advice: steer clear of this place.
