reviews.author: Leo Lisen Bai
reviews.text:
Avoid this resort at all cost, whether travelling as a couple, or as a family with a 13-month old (us), especially when you don't speak any Spanish!
1. Services requests of all kinds made in English, although repeated frequently, were not understood by the vast majority of resort staff, 90% of the time. Communications of any kinds were a MAJOR pain
2. Room keys frequently failed and we were locked out multiple times and had to get keys revalidated. Front desk staff were not even apologetic about this.
3. No concierge attended to our needs, we didn't even get one when we checked in
4. Quality of food was downright abysmal, if you get any at all. We were often left waiting 2+ hours at different dinner restaurants wondering where our orders have gone
5. Wifi in our room didn't work till the VERY last day of our 7-night stay
6. Downright FALSE info was frequently given out (such as opening hours of a theme park), again probably due to communication gap noted above. All we got was a simple "sorry" while we wasted hours with an infant in tow
7. Half the resort was under renovations and nothing was mentioned when we made the booking

The only shining spot was the staff at Kidsdom. They were fantastic and took great care of our baby when we needed their help. However, their great help isn't enough to make up for everything else that fell WAY short at this resort.

Leo

reviews.author: Ramiro Mayorga
reviews.text:
Been here 3 days of our 5 day trip and can say we are having a great time. The resort is really beautiful. Weather is warm and humid but the ocean breeze definitely helps. Came with a group of friends to celebrate a milestone birthday. The staff is great, everyone is really friendly and accommodating. They are all willing to do whatever to make your stay more comfortable. The rooms are nicely decorated and are cleaned daily. Food is good, buffet opens for breakfast and lunch has a good selection to appease even the pickiest eater. Is the food fantastic?  I don't think so, but what is made fresh to order is definitely better than the other items. The fruit is great, definitely eat the locally grown stuff that you can't get at home.
The restaurants on site that we have as dinner options are good, Fuego has a limited selection and the portions are small but it's definitely enough. Blue Agave was nothing to write home about. Rare steakhouse was great. But I'm a meat and potatoes kind of guy, so I may be partial to this one. Good portions and very tasty food. Trying the Italian place tonight, Olio. So we'll see.
Definitely need to give a shout out to the staff who have stood out to us on this trip: Alexis Angomas, the mini bar guy, has been great. Mini bar gets stocked only once a day but he makes sure you have what you need. Super outgoing and accommodating.
Leo the pool bar bartender has been outstanding. He's dealt with all our shenanigans and craziness and has also kept us highly entertained. Good sport and super funny. When he sees us out and about, he comes right up to us and gives us a hug.
Then you have the dance instructors: Loki Loki, Shaky Shaky, Shorty and Shanty, they are hysterical and super fun! They can teach anyone how to dance and it helps that they have great moves. All have super outgoing personalities and a great demeanor.
Will update later with the remainder of our trip. This place is definitely a place you should see. The definition of paradise.

reviews.author: Craig Stevens
reviews.text:
We booked our holidays through to a place called Paradisus Palma Real Gulf & Spa Resort in Punta Cana Dominican Republic which is supposed to be a 5 star resort.  Beforehand of course we went online to view all the pictures of the resort and it looked beautiful we did read some negative reports but there were more of the positive comments. I looked for a lot of the scenery that were in the photos online but unfortunately those pictures were of the Reserve area or Royal service area. For an all-inclusive resort unfortunately it did feel like everything was included because there is a major separation between Royal services and just the regular all-inclusive people.
Upon arrival it is beautiful to see in the resort for the most part is very well-kept. Unfortunately our room had some issues. Such as; our main door would not lock properly, the nightlight on the one side of the bed did not work, the TV would work for a while and then the screen would shut off and then there were just be sound (which is to be expected since it is an older TV). The radio did not work properly, the closet doors stuck so hard that my wife could not move them.  The shower head in the shower was about an inch taller than myself and I'm of average height of 6 foot tall.
To be fair, they are beautiful rooms but when we mentioned these issues to the front desk, the only thing that was resolved an additional clock radio was sitting next to her bed. Nothing else was resolved nor were we asked about anything. Kind of disappointed since the rest of the resort is beautiful.
There certainly was not a whole lot of things going on for entertainment in the evening nor was there much for sports in the day. I would recommend the resort at least investing in a set of horseshoes, pool volleyball and things like that. We have been to other resorts where the entertainment staff would help get together people to play volleyball but that didn't seem to happen either. Though the staff was very nice and pleasant to deal with we found it to be lacking entertainment.
The buffet was absolutely amazing! But the other food area that cooks hamburgers and french fries and other things all day long was horrible! The hamburgers were only half cooked, the fries were cold and just certainly was not very appetizing.
I would go back if the cost of the stay reflected a 4 star price point only and only for about 5 days as 7 was just too long. If some of those issues were not resolved or the price was not reduced, I would recommend elsewhere.

reviews.author: Tiffany Lundt
reviews.text:
I strongly discourage anyone from considering a stay at Paradisus Palma Real. Our experience at this resort was a complete nightmare, characterized by a shocking lack of customer service, accountability, and follow-through. Our family, a group of 9, embarked on an 11-hour journey to reach Punta Cana, eagerly anticipating our first-ever visit to this beautiful destination. We chose Paradisus Palma Real, believing it would live up to the exceptional standards set by its sister hotels, Paradisus Cancun and Paradisus Playa Del Carmen, which had provided us with memorable experiences during our previous trips (only a 4-hour flight away). Unfortunately, our decision to stay at Paradisus Palma Real turned out to be a grave mistake, and our vacation plans were negatively impacted in every way imaginable.
We had high hopes for our vacation, having purchased rooms through our Circle Melia Program and upgrading to what was promised to be an enhanced service and concierge experience. However, our dreams of a relaxing getaway were crushed as we spent our entire vacation battling with the hotel.
We had upgraded for benefits such as concierge
Services, tickets to the Katmandu Theme Park, dinner reservations, and a catamaran excursion that was included in our package. To our dismay, none of these promises were fulfilled. Instead, we found ourselves endlessly ping-ponging between different hotel staff throughout our 7-night/8-day stay.

From the moment we arrived, the confusion and disappointment began. Despite being promised a concierge service as part of our upgraded package, we were left in a state of bewilderment regarding who our concierge was supposed to be. When we finally managed to identify them as Lewis and Mack, their unhelpfulness was astounding. We ended up having to make most of our reservations ourselves, defeating the purpose of paying for an upgraded service.

Our attempts to escalate matters and seek resolution from the management team, which included individuals named Katerine, Danielle, and Yohanery, were equally fruitless. These individuals demonstrated an astonishing lack of accountability and a disheartening lack of urgency. They moved at a snail's pace, taking the entire week to address our concerns, only to provide vague and unapologetic responses. It was a deeply frustrating and disappointing experience throughout our entire 7-night/8-day stay.

If you value your time, money, and sanity, I urge you to steer clear of Paradisus Palma Real. This resort's woeful incompetence, lack of customer service, and inability to fulfill promises have left us with an unforgettable, but for all the wrong reasons, vacation experience. Save yourself the disappointment and find a more reputable and customer-centric destination for your next getaway.

reviews.text:

reviews.text: Great Vacation  Experience!!  Service has been excellent at the hotel. The room service has been great. In the pool area, the staff is very friendly. reviews.author: Rachel Weatherford
reviews.text:
I can not express how grateful I am for the above and beyond service at the Paradisus Palme Real.

My company booked an incentive trip at this property and I almost didn’t accept the trip due to severe food allergies. I had a lot of anxiety before the trip, but after I checked in I received a text from a private concierge, Nicholas, who was assigned to me. After meeting Nicholas, all my anxiety went away.

Nicholas translated to the wait staff and chef and ensure my food would be safe. To my surprised when I mentioned I love mangos, he found a whole mango for me, his availability and always checking if I needed anything, not even food related, added an extra special touch to this trip.

Thank you to Nicholas, chefs, and wait staff, especially Andino who waited on my most meals and remembered my allergies and added to making my time in Punta Cana magical.

The room was gorgeous and very clean, you can’t beat the view from my balcony!

If you have severe cross contact allergies, I highly recommend this property. I look forward to returning for a personal trip in the future.

reviews.text:
Exceptional Support from Mariaelisa Núñez at Meliá Hotel

I recently had the privilege of staying at the Meliá Hotel, and I wanted to take a moment to commend Mariaelisa Núñez for her exceptional assistance during our stay. We encountered some challenges involving an elderly person, and Mariaelisa’s dedication and support were truly outstanding.

Her genuine kindness and compassionate nature made a significant impact on our experience. She went above and beyond to ensure the comfort and well-being of the elderly person, and her efforts did not go unnoticed. Mariaelisa’s patience, professionalism, and problem-solving skills were truly commendable.

In a world where exceptional customer service can be rare, Mariaelisa’s commitment to helping guests is truly commendable. She turned a potentially difficult situation into a positive and memorable experience. Her actions reflect great credit upon herself and the Meliá Hotel.

Thank you, Mariaelisa, for your remarkable support and for making our stay at the Meliá Hotel a truly special one. Your dedication is greatly appreciated.

reviews.author: Samir Doshi
reviews.text: The resort rooms are good size, garden area is beautifully done and has a good relaxing area on beach with enough shacks. Other than that everything else seemed to be lacking thought. The overall organization from room assignment, room service, concierge allocation, daily programs etc is disorganised and chaotic. We had to change our room thrice before settling down. The overall food quality at lunch buffet is average and there are very few  veggie options. Fish was good but not many options. You need to wait in line and get the food cooked fresh by chefs there, to have decent tasting food. The breakfast is much better. You need to book resturants for dining even though it's all inclusive resort. There are no kiosks for self serve reservations. The food at restaurants was also a disappointment. We visited the oleo Italian restaurant and the acqua Greek restaurant. There were 2 gala events given the Christmas week and food was much better there. Entertainment programs at gala events could have been better. We didn't let the food situation spoil our vacation though and enjoyed what we could and had a good time.

reviews.text: We had an absolutely WONDERFUL experience at Paradesis Palma Real Resort.  The staff was so very friendly, and the hotel was clean with very spacious rooms.  I could not write this review without mentioning our Butler, Javier and bartenders, Lorenzo and Roberto at the Avenue Bar, Leonardo at the Royal Services pool bar and Ramon,  at the swim up bar. And, made a mom with an 18 yr old daughter feel very comfortable  about leaving her and her friends while their old parents got some R & R. They were always watching out for them. I would recommend this hotel to all. Families, Couples, friends, even a wonderful place for a destination wedding.  We will definitely be back!!

reviews.author: Nick Ondrus
reviews.text: The vacation is great, I love the pool and the food is really great. I came across Jonathan Germosen and he really lit up our trip with excitement and joy. He’s a great employee and really knows how to entertain the people at the resort.

reviews.author: Andy Laverghetta
reviews.text:
We have had a fantastic time thus far.  Boni, Junior, Ronaldo, and Freddy took great care of us while we were on the beach. Johan was wonderful and extremely helpful throughout our stay, setting reservations and helping us make plans for excursions or events.  The room itself had some issues, and occasionally the front desk would be somewhat indifferent, but the rest of the staff have been very attentive in trying to resolve any concerns.  We will definitely come back again.

UPDATED (about a month after returning):  We were at this resort for 11 nights, and we could not have had a better time overall.  The food far surpassed our expectations, particularly for an all-inclusive resort.  Passion was well worth the extra money spent, and may have been the best meal I've ever had.  Drink options were at expectations.  The overall value was excellent for what we received.  We loved the resort and will certainly return.

I had mentioned a few names above, but also need to specifically mention Yuleidy, Luis, and Victor.  Yuleidy typically greeted us in the buffet restaurant.  Luis was also routinely in the buffet restaurant, but also served us on several other occasions including the steakhouse restaurant.  Victor was a bartender in the lobby bar who was engaging, fun, and great conversationalist.  All were extremely professional and warm with us each day.

reviews.author: Haley DeNichols
reviews.text: This was an amazing experience!  The entire staff was friendly and always accommodating. We got lucky and had CARLOS as our Butler for the week. He should definitely be requested before arrival. I would recommend this resort to anyone coming to Punta Cana as the Paradisus resort was top notch in every aspect of being a resort.

reviews.author: Michelle Hacon
reviews.text:
Starlin was a wonderful resource while we stayed at Paradisus Palma Real. He looked after anything we needed, and looked after all of our dinner reservations.  He even helped to locate a mini-SD card off the property for us.

I would absolutely recommend this hotel and Starlin’s services.

reviews.author: Cassandra Wright
reviews.text:
Ginger Bar is awesome!  People and service is wonderful.  The beverages are excellent.

Ismael, Antonio, Dominga, Olga, Nereid, and Clary are the best!

reviews.author: Karina Resto
reviews.text:
The customer service at this resort has exceeded my expectations.
Special shout out to the amazing ladies at the Ginger bar: Yiris, Lucia, and Walkira. They were always attentive and spoiled us with their kindness and attention.
Dios las bendiga :)

reviews.author: Ricardo Santos
reviews.text:
Service to costumers fell  lot, and i mean A LOT on this last year. They make up a lot of excuses to justify the extreme low level of some workers, but continue to charge the same money.  And consider that the same money is, a much more above than average.
This was my favorite hotel in Dominicana. I came here 4 times, and another 6 to other Paradisus resorts. The management was informed and they did nothing but pretty words without any effect to try and solve their own problems. Paradisus is not anything special anymore and i will stop coming after this.

reviews.author: Nick Gioia
reviews.text: Hotel Paradiso Real has been wonderful so far! And the live music is great! Jorge Rafael is a fantastic entertainer from activities! The Ginger bar has great coffee drinks made by Ismael, Criceida and Elidania! We definitely recommend this resort! Hairon is excellent for activities and dancing!

reviews.author: Dave Stewart
reviews.text: Fantastic resort! Rosanna is a fabulous host!

reviews.author: T Davis
reviews.text:
Amazing experience. Friendly staff. Awesome accommodations. Truly a 5.5 star resort. A special thanks to Jordania for providing excellent customer service!
A big thank you to Laura, Minera, Franklin, awesome service at the Flora Restaurant.

reviews.author: Yan Corriveau
reviews.text:
Great experience with the staffs
In particular Rafael at the beach on the Reserve. The resort is very clean and the is also enough chairs with Palapa at the beach
The chairs are very comfortable

reviews.author: Maria Sanchez
reviews.text:
Andreina  and the rest of the staff Luis, both Miguels, and Fior were amazing. Thank you all for the wonderful service.

Starling Tavares was our Concierge, he was amazing. Definitely a wonderful vacay with great staff.

reviews.author: Evmorfea Savidis
reviews.text: We are still on the resort, but I needed to share my absolute happiness with Zuleica Rodriguez! We are here with 2 other families celebrating my daughter Kiki's 5th birthday. Zuleica has gone above and beyond for us, but especially to make our daughters birthday super special. She had a table decorated waiting for us, with balloons, an elaborate fruit platter and even gifts! She got her a cake and had everyone come sing happy birthday. Even the days after her birthday, she has made us all feel very special and has gotten us whatever we wanted (even fresh coconuts!). She truly made our stay at the resort amazing and so happy to have met her! Thank you Zuleica!

reviews.author: Tonya Patton
reviews.text: Luis Rodriguez restaurant kanna and gregorin arias Luis is AMAZING. He is such a kind person and an excellent server… He always bring a smile to our face when we see him…. Luis always wants to make sure your meal is amazing….

reviews.author: Tiffany Torres
reviews.text:
The hotel was beautiful, full of fun activities and great food and the staff always pleasant and helpful. We specially loved our concierge
Ms Yaleidi Sims, she was always available to assist us with everything and which made our vacation even better and easier to relax. I loved it all thanks

reviews.author: AnnaMaria Vargas
reviews.text: Flora restaurant ,the service was excellent and the food was superb. From the moment you step in and are greeted by a smiling Dismailin to the very attentive service from Cesar,  our waiter, excellent experience.

reviews.author: Ricardo Francis
reviews.text: I enjoyed my stay and I'll definitely come back. The hotel is beautiful and the location is great. I mainly enjoyed the great service and lovely hospitality. I would also like to mention and thank personally Daysi Gonzalez and Yohandri Santos from reception for their kindness, professionalism and great vibes! Thanks!

reviews.author: Israel Rosado
reviews.text: We stopped in Rum Republic at Melia Paradisus Punta Cana to have a drink.  Maria was the mixologist.. she was amazing making drinks very impressive.. Abraham Dominguez assisted her.. very friendly and outgoing.

reviews.author: Elton Sato
reviews.text: I'm part of the Sanofi group and have never had such great service as from our Butler JUAN Suarez. . If we wanted to golf he would make us reservations, figure out how to get us there and back, and if we decided to cancel he would take care of everything. He was always available to help us, he took care of all our dinner reservations for us, let us know what appropriate dress is for each place.  He is a lovely human being, with a kind heart and a sincere desire to take care of his guests.

reviews.author: Dawn Dabb
reviews.text: We enjoyed a delicious dinner at Mascalzone! The service provided by Raider was great! He was very attentive especially working with me being gluten-free!

reviews.author: Brandon Tuozzolo
reviews.text: This place is incredible. Second time we’ve been here and can’t wait to come back! The service is amazing, food is good and the resort is just breathtaking. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Julio Palma
reviews.text:
Roxana was oustanding on service at the restaurant, lunch box always giving extra help
Raul on the beach was the best ! Always ready to bring you anything , drinks , beers , snacks , excellent services , he will treat you like a king!

reviews.author: Daniel Calix
reviews.text: During my visit here at Palma Paradisus, my wife and I had a great experience, excellent customer service, Georgi and Rosanna took very good care of us at restaurant malva, a king with our consiente Eriol. I will definitely be coming back.

reviews.author: Tom Tardy
reviews.text:
Came here foe a conference, hotel couldn't handle.  Completely unorganized, front desk go any slower they would be in reverse.  Took over 45 minutes to check in and 30 minutes to check out.   They put us the furthest building from all the events.

Great for vacations, would never do another conference here

reviews.author: Melanie Kron
reviews.text: We went to Paradisus Palma Real for our annual family vacation and had Royal Service with Carlos, who was our butler for 7 days.  He was excellent! Carlos paid close attention to all of the details which made our experience a vacation to remember.  He checked in with us at the appropriate times during the day, and always followed through on any of the requests we made during the duration of our stay. Carlos definitely has a bright future in the hospitality industry. Also, thank you to Wanda, the bartender at the Royal Service pool, who was lovely, was an excellent mixologist - and always had a smile on her face.

reviews.author: Lindsey Gereghty
reviews.text:
My husband and I stayed at The Reserve with a swim up pool on our patio. The room was great and our "backyard" was nice and felt private with a cabana and bath tub too. The Reserve was the perfect way to be at the resort but still feel like we had our own private place away from the main lobby. It was a 3 min golf cart ride to the main lobby and the golf carts run 24 hrs a day. We never had issues. We would stay out late at the bars and club the resort had to offer.

As far as our experience with employees. WOW they were all so friendly, accommodating and always making sure we were taken care of! Happy Boy at the Reserve lives up to his name. Always smiling and making sure everyone knows about any activities going on and got us to get up and do the dance/zuma lesson by the pool. We had a blast. Our concierge Garrison was great too! Very friendly and made sure we had everything we wanted our entire trip.

The pools are everywhere and all so beautiful! Can't beat swim up bars too! The beach was beautiful as well and had plenty of cabanas to enjoy.

I would recommend to literally everyone! Best all inclusive I've ever had! Well worth it! Thank you to everyone for giving us a trip of a life time and we will spend years telling everyone back here in California to visit you!

reviews.author: Melissa Alvarez
reviews.text: Mazcalzones restaurant was delicious and the service was flawless. Raider attended to us and made us feel at home. Belnaber also was available for any questions we had. They both were great and the food was fantastic.

reviews.author: Chelette Webster
reviews.text: If you want a great cocktail a Paradisus  Palma Real Golf and Spa Resort find Hector Hernandez at the Tito's Bar in the plaza. The best handcrafted cocktails at the resort. Believe me you won't regret

reviews.author: andy garcia
reviews.text: Rosanna was very helpful and very nice resort!

reviews.author: Johnny Rodriguez
reviews.text: Vacationed at Paradisus May 2019 with three other couples and it was the BEST Ever.  The food and drinks were top notch! The guys played Golf for three days, then enjoyed the beach and pool at fantastic and beautiful Paradisus Palma Real.  We had this waiter named Jesus who made our trip super special. I would recommend to seek him out, but the staff at this resort were super nice as well.  Don’t forget to Tip, as that will make your vacation truly special.

reviews.author: Brad K
reviews.text: Ceviche and margaritas lessons with Jairo and Brandol was AMAZING!! Informative and great experience! Jairo and Brandol clearly work very hard to make the guests happy ❤️

reviews.author: Tracey Arena
reviews.text: Perfect vacation experience! The food was great the staff was amazing and so friendly and accommodating. Altagracia Cruz at the sports bar at Paradisus Palma ear was the most amazing server we had!

reviews.author: Castano Wack
reviews.text: NOTE to Google: Owner of this address did not post this review. Wonderful morning stretches on the beach and yoga on paddle boards. Food is great! Atmosphere is elegant and relaxed. Staff is very attentive. Entertainment is great. Enjoyed yoga stretch with Andelson!!

reviews.author: Lisa Lindstrom
reviews.text: Wonderful experience my 1st time out of the USA! I would recommend  this place to stay! I had a Fabulous time! We went to Malva Restaurant while we were there for breakfast  and lunch! Our waitress was Luciana she was Awesome!

reviews.author: Rocky Kenley
reviews.text: We had a wonderful time, absolutely gorgeous! Everyone is super friendly and just amazing.  Yanira, Yafreisy, and Barnelis are great in the mornings! Always smiling to start the day off right. We love it!

reviews.author: Victor Vinay Reddy
reviews.text:
Crew at Sante restaurant we’re very courteous and helpful.
Managed by Eduardo & Hostess Hirlenne very professionally.
At breakfast we were waited on us by Franklin, Gustavo n Sunirda for excellent service.
Special mention to Franklin a man with a smiling face who accommodated all our requests while waiting on us.

reviews.author: Gord Wong
reviews.text: What a great week we had in Paradisus Palma Real. We indulged ourselves and had the Royal Service and we were very happy that we did. Our butler Ariel was outstanding. He accommodated our every request and he was a pleasure to meet. I highly recommend this resort and Ariel. Also a great shout out to the beach guys who helped us all week with the Bali beds and cabanas. Pedro, Martin and Carlos were working hard for their guests the whole day. Can’t say enough nice things about the staff who work so hard in the hot sun and are so friendly. Thanks again Ariel. Mucho gracias Pedro.

reviews.author: Heather H.
reviews.text:
We just spent a week here. It was beautiful and so relaxing. We got a massage here, had free painting and dance and exercise classes, the food was phenomenal, the staff was friendly, the hotel was clean and the service was great, and the beaches were clean and beautiful. We got to see some wedding set ups and it makes me want to have my future wedding there.
We plan on going back very soon.

reviews.author: Stephanie Langlois
reviews.text: The Palma Real is a nice hotel and the staff is very kind and helpful. Our butler Juan Castillo was very helpful. Patrick and Valentina at The Circle office informed and welcomed us to the Melia family. They all made our stay fantastic. The Palma Real hotel needs a a bit of maintenance as it is showing it’s age.

reviews.author: Maria Rennert
reviews.text: Our stay at The Reserve was excellent. People like Alejandro Rivera made our stay that much better - he was very kind, welcoming, and respectful to the guests. We highly recommend coming here.

reviews.author: Manny Rodo
reviews.text: We attempted to have dinner in the Italian restaurant.Waited 1 hr for our starters that only came for 3 of 5 people. then we got the order of the table 3 away.  The meatballs were raw meat, tortini was cold. This won't end here. The trip advisor review will be precise. With every detail about the disappointing food at this resort. I felt sorry for the manager having to deal with the incompetent chef.

reviews.author: German Castro
reviews.text: We had the best vacation ever! Maria Ortiz, Yanira, Gregorin y Delvin privided us an amazing services! Room services was wonderful, pool and beach services were outstanding. We want to come back again. We highly recomend Paradisus!

reviews.author: Ian Gillett
reviews.text: This place is amazing! Great food, service, and the staff is amazing. They really pay attention to details and make you feel more than welcome as soon as you arrive. Will definitely come back! Jordania thanks for your help

reviews.author: Silvana Petrillo
reviews.text:
First, the most important thing, we made a reservation for The Reserve, on the beach and with special perks, and for the same price they sent us to gran Cana, far from the beach, waiting and Riding a cart every time we wanted to go to the beach or come. That wasn't what we wanted. We asked to changed our rooms to the other building and they refused. That was false advertisement ! Be careful if you made a reservation because that happened with many people we met there!

2- Room was nice but full of ants ! .Hotel was practically empty, and they sent us to the last building #4, last room !! so to go to the lobby, buffet, carts, we walked like 3 blocks !! that was tiresome and annoying !!

3- Restaurants, we couldn't make any reservation for the restaurants, nothing !! i went with my husband to celebrate his birthday and couldn't go to a restaurant in the whole stay !! Only buffet. BTH waiters must use gloves ! they serve food, and handle money ???!!! And they  forced us to use gloves to enter to the buffet? Service was bad, waiters asking for their tips...rude service, asking for things like sugar, etc many times !!

4- No entrainment for kids... Totally different to other all inclusive resorts. I've been in P Cana 3 times and never such a bad experience with a hotel.
I Dont recommend it at all!

reviews.author: JD William
reviews.text: We were part of the large group who takes yearly trips. This was by far the worse resort for service and food we have ever stayed at.  The grounds and building are beautiful, but what isn’t is the attitude and service we received. We could not get into any restaurants without tipping someone heavily - they kept saying everything is booked and it was a mess.  The buffet where they force you to eat is a poorly run school cafeteria. People taking your seats, people not using tongs, general lack of organization, we got our own water.  We had constant issues with our door and bath tub. Nobody ever came or seemed to care when we complained.  Our food experience was  horrible, ribeye at Rare was tough and sushi was all premade and blah.  After 5 nights we are at airport eating at Wendy’s and glad to be flying home. Totally a waste of money and easily could be avoided with better hotel management and restaurant management and someone to train employees how to be helpful and friendly.

reviews.author: Lorraine Ocasio
reviews.text: Jholfry and Fernando were the best entertainers and yefri was the best bartender!!

reviews.author: Klaudia Siutkowska
reviews.text: We had perfect time here in Dominikana, in Paradisus hotel. The kids club is great, lots of attractions every day and very nice people, especially thanks to Alexandra, Jennifer, Tania and Jesus. Jose was a great concierge.

reviews.author: J Marie
reviews.text:
Many issues with this resort. As an avid traveler and one that will pay good money for a positive experience, this was not a ‘you get what you pay for’ experience.

We won this trip though work and without knowing much, we assumed we would have an okay experience. We then upgraded our room and we are regretting it 100%. The room upgrade is not worth it at this resort. Do not do it.  The rooms are beyond filthy. There’s drainage issues in the sink and in the shower. Everything in the room looks clean but is filthy from the countertops to the floors. They never stocked our mini fridge with water - which is supposed to be included. The bed linens were questionable. They definitely have a detergent build up and between the towels and the sheets nothing ever seemed ‘dry’. It was 6 days of musty.

If you upgrade to the reserve, which we did, online it guaranteed things like a butler and turndown service. None of these things were included. The only exclusive thing there was a restaurant - which was low quality too. They boast that you can get premium drinks as well and they even display premium bottles at the bar but we were told we can only have their well drinks. There was no exclusivity realized at any of the bars.

The alcohol is severely watered down here. I never drink straight tequila but here I was able to as it was quite watered down.

The food is absolutely abhorrent. Any chicken dish had tons of bones in it. Almost every offering had more of a ‘mystery meat’ vibe to it. All of the food at the restaurants were sub par. Nothing was exceptional. They’re serving really low quality stuff.

Please tell me why everything is shut down between 11am-1pm. You cannot be served any food between then unless you get a hamburger or hotdog on the beach which tastes like briquets.

There is no entertainment whatsoever. It’s a very boring place.

I’ve stayed at many all inclusive and this was a 3/10. Only giving a 3 because the beach was pretty nice. This experience makes me never want to come back to the Dominican period.

reviews.author: Marina Pires
reviews.text: the trip was fantastic! I wanna thank olha. Ismael, Soranxi and Clari for being so nice. I had lots of fun and the best coffee the I’ve ever had. The ginger craft cocktais & coffee house is a perfect place

reviews.author: Kandy Houser
reviews.text: Resort is beautiful. We visited in the off season so it was not at all crowded. Great beach service - Mari Leicey was very attentive, checked in on us regularly and helped with whatever we needed. Lots of pools to choose from.

reviews.author: Andrea Marin
reviews.text: "I had an incredible dining experience at this steakhouse! The food was absolutely delicious, with perfectly cooked steaks and a great selection of sides. The atmosphere was cozy and welcoming, making it a perfect spot for a special night out. A special shoutout to Raynaldo and Jesus, who provided exceptional service throughout the evening. He was attentive, friendly, and made sure everything was just right. I highly recommend this place and will definitely be returning soon!"

reviews.author: Noah Burgos
reviews.text: Awesome. The experience was awesome. So many activities and they were all were great.  Jorge, Hairon, Anthony, El chef Gordo y Los demas. Margaritas  & Ceviche workshop was great. Rum tasting workshop was awesome

reviews.author: Alex Lopez
reviews.text: People are amazingly friendly, especially the crew at Brisa’s & the beach. Thank you to Jose, Rosanny & Fedelina. Will miss Joel, Raul, Hansel, Vanessa, Ivan, Movilessy & Odavey. Thanks & hopefully see you all again soon!

reviews.author: Steve S
reviews.text: We enjoyed our stay. We had an issue with our first room smelling moldy but it was resolved satisfactorily. We would recommend getting the Royal Service, otherwise, you may be disappointed without it. Making dinner reservations is pretty much impossible without the concierge service you receive with the Royal Service. The staff here are incredible for the most part. They really hustle and try their best to keep you happy, satisfied and wanting nothing. These people run around in the heat all day. You don’t HAVE to tip, but you absolutely should. Yes, you paid to be there but you get more than your $s worth so a couple bucks here and there goes a long way and helps the staff. We didn’t take everyone’s names but a few people truly stood out. Boni and Jendry were the ones who never left us wanting anything while at the pool or beach. Really nice hardworking guys. Abraham, one of the restaurant workers was fantastic. He always took care of us and always went out of his way for our son. Another staff member we need to mention would be Jose Vargas who really stepped up to help and make our experience great. We really enjoyed the food. The buffet was always plentiful, clean and organized as well as the restaurants. The beach is great and you don’t ever have to leave your seat or cabana for a drink. Plus, unlike other resorts, you can walk right onto the beach. No need to take any taxis or golf carts. Same around any of the pools. Yes there are vendors but the property seems to have everything under control. There aren’t too many and when you say no thanks, they leave you alone. Great value for the money

reviews.author: Scott Jones
reviews.text: Loved our time! The beach staff was amazing. Martin and Gilberto took great care of us all week!

reviews.author: Annie Trapp
reviews.text: Fior is the best ever. Andreina is the best they are so excellent and the drinks are amazing they are so beautiful at the kicks bar. Georgina, Laicha, maira were super helpful and had great service.

reviews.author: Lindsey Ransom
reviews.text: Very good experience. Both of my boys had an amazing time at kidsdom and made new friends as well!

reviews.author: Sophie Bolduc
reviews.text: The Paradisus Palma Real has been such an awesome resort, actually the best resort in the Caribbean that I’ve been to. We have had amazing service from everyone here, especially Jendry and his coworkers at the beach! They make great drinks and are always checking in to see if they can get you anything you need while you’re soaking up the sun. I can’t get enough of this place, I will definitely be back!

reviews.author: Smiley Smiles (Maggie)
reviews.text:
In love with this place is amazing the staff is so polite and welcoming me and my family had the best vacation ever will definitely come back 100%recomended.
Soranyi is amazing

reviews.author: Ysis Baez
reviews.text: What a great experience at Mina Restaurant. It first started with a drink at the bar by Maria: “Hemingway Daquiri”  then Daiana Rodríguez is so welcoming. My server Glenys and Yunior were wonderful. The food was delicious. 😋

reviews.author: Kelvin Brito Fabian
reviews.text:
I loved staying at Paradisus, Ismael made our days every time we went to Gin Ger bar in front of the lobby.

Antonio, Criseida, Dominga and Yeni were also great!

reviews.author: swati goel
reviews.text: Kidsdom is very nice for children. They keep children engaged and happy. It is very convenient for small families traveling by themselves as kids can play with other kids their age.

reviews.author: Nicole Woolsey
reviews.text: The Hydro Grill was exceptional. The food was amazing, especially the pumpkin soup, the rib eye steak, salmon, top sirlion made by Chef Orlando. Ulise our waiter was super attentive. We barely finished our drinks and we had fresh ones. Leuris one of the maitre des actually saw me struggling with my pork ribs and he came over and cut it off the bones for me!!!! Above and beyond! Highly reccommend!!

reviews.author: ROBERT RIGO
reviews.text:
I have stayed in many All Inclusive resort all over the world but have not had such a  great experience like I had here Paradisus Palma Real Golf Spa Resort in Punta Cana. The food was delicious and the service was great.
I want to mention our Concierge Eliezer Sanchez who did an awesome job. He was very responsive and attentive to our requests and always made sure we had everything we needed and always checked to make sure we were happy with everything while we stayed in this resort.
I had a chance to speak with Gabriel who is Eliezer supervisor/ manager and I made sure I let Gabriel know how great Eliezer service was and wanted to make sure Eliezer will be recognized and I highly recommend Eliezer for a raise and a promotion because he deserve it.
Thank you very much again for the great service Eliezer.
Keep up the great work.

Regards
Robert Rigo

reviews.author: Jackson Lamb
reviews.text: The service was absolutely amazing. Felt like I was treated like a king the entire time. Exceeded all expectations!!! Jessica is an absolute luxury and goes above and beyond with everything that she does. A++ Happy boy’s entertainment was of equal caliber.

reviews.author: Jennifer Klein
reviews.text:
Beautiful resort! Very nice staff. Enjoyed martinis at the gin ger bar this morning! Thank you Ismael, Criceida, Antonio, Lisbeth, and Soranyy!!

Also recommend 90 degrees Adult pool!! Arisleida takes great care of you with a smile!!

reviews.author: Christianne Saab
reviews.text: Great hotel, amazing service by the beach, Wilmer was very attentive and caring. The service is great, the beach is lovely, sending we come and it's been incredible!! Yanira, Yafreisy, Maria and Delvin were very attentive and caring, excellent service and kindness 😊

reviews.author: Md Shaheen
reviews.text: Yanira and Mariia have been really friendly while serving us breakfast! Checked on us every few mins whether we need anything! Nice people!

reviews.author: Julie Mulligan
reviews.text: Nixon made the trip along with our Butler Angelo. The facility is beautiful and the weather was great. The beach was nice and clean and there was always Cabanas at the pool. Every morning we were created by a butler who would also make our dinner reservations it made the trip very easy and relaxing.

reviews.author: Pia Klompmaker
reviews.text: Lunch box, Betty, Ricky, Maria M, Sandra were amazing to us and our baby. The food very good and the service even better.

reviews.author: Bhasker Dave
reviews.text:
Service... Resort clearly has not recovered from pandemic-related runoff.  Staff seemed inexperienced and very few spoke any english creating lots of opportunity for lost-in-translation issues. Butlers were good but could really only do so much.  Restaurant waitstaff was the low point - constant mistakes and lack of attentiveness.

Food... was hit or miss depending on the restaurant.  Both Japanese hibachi were good as was the mexican food.  The Gabi buffet was just ok - trick was to only order fresh made off the grill.  Fruit was amazing.  Buffet in the main resort was bettet.

Beaches and pools... were really good.  Only complaint was no pool bar except at the main resprt.

Rooms.  Suites were nice but showed some wear-and-tear (some damaged bathroom fixtures, inoperable room safes, room service inconsistently delivered, etc..).   Nothing that was a showstopper though.  Glad HVAC worked great as temps were warm.

reviews.author: Bessy Luque
reviews.text: omg! the best of the best! please your to go place has to be your to go place! best service ever 🙌 ❤️ Look for Dany Santana she makes the best mojitos ever! n Altagracia and Lucía have the best attitude. Such a a dreamy vacation!!

reviews.author: Zornitsa Beneva
reviews.text: The hotel is perfect. All the people, the food and the service. We like the service on the beach, Bony is a very friendly gay. The animation is on top level! We were here 7days and every day is so different, becaouse all the activities. If you like dancing-here is the place!!! Polanco and Jean Marco are the best animators and the beat dancers. These was our best vacation!!!! If we can, we will come every year 🙂🙂🙂

reviews.author: Wendy Waserman
reviews.text:
I spent the week of Feb 18-25 2018 at this resort, more specifically "The Reserve" side of the resort. I have to say I was a little disappointed overall. The first room we were put in after having to sign an agreement on accepting an upgrade that may not be offered to us in future visits. I was immediately a little suspicious it was in appreciation on this being our 4th visit to their group of hotels in the last 6-7 years.  The room was a lot bigger than what we had reserved however it was not well maintained, or cleaned and overlooked the new property they were building. I woke the next morning at 730 am to the sound of construction only to pull the curtains and get a full view of how the concrete would be poured for their next resort.
After an assertive conversation with several guest service reps and one supervisor, we were moved to a more suitable area of the resort.
5 star is not what it used to be....at least not in the Dominican Republic at the Paradisus chain of resorts. Both here and at their sister resort Paradisus Punta Cana, a little more attention needs to be paid with the basics. The rooms, amenities and menus are not keeping up with the increasing costs and at the same time the services is  decreasing

reviews.author: Julia Ben Yacoub
reviews.text: we had a beautiful stay at Paradisus Palma Real and we will definitely come back because of the great service of our Butler Armando who made our stay amazing.  I would definitely recommend the royal service because of the exceptional service. There is not a single thing we can complain about,everything was just perfect! Amazing food at every restaurant,great service,wifi everywhere even at the beach.

reviews.author: Stephen Jones
reviews.text: The restaurant Mascalzone has delicious pizza and a relaxing ambience.  Our host Milton and waiter Fausto were so attentive to my family during dinner.  They treated my family so kindly.  We’ll return again.

reviews.author: Robinson Cano
reviews.text: Starling was great he really helped us get around and always kept in contact with us. We will definitely think about returning all the staff and amenities here were great as well. Will let family and friends know about Meliá, Thank you 🙏🏾

reviews.author: Fern
reviews.text: By far the best part of PARADISUS PALMA REAL is the service and for me and my wife our concierge Luis Gabriel cadet was super helpful in everyway imaginable. He made sure the room we had was perfect for our honeymoon and would check on us everyday to make sure we had everything we needed. Very friendly and super helpful. I would definitely recommend this hotel to my friends and family.

reviews.author: Brandon Wolf
reviews.text: We stayed at the Reserve at Paradisus Palma Real. We booked family concierge for the week and were very happy with the experience! The rooms were amazing! We had second floor which we liked because of the glass balcony. Our other family members had third floor and didn’t enjoy it as much because they had a stucko wall that blocked their view of the pool. Our concierge Andy was fantastic! He left gifts and treats for the kids every day. He made all our restaurant reservations and took care of all of our needs. He even found tinfoil to fix my daughters corn rows that she had done on the beach! He answered all our questions and met us each evening at the restaurant we were eating at and he visited us on the beach each morning. The facilities were great at the reserve and the YHI spa was amazing, had a massage with Wendi and it was one of the best I have had! The only complaint I had all week was the wait staff can be slow at the restaurants and occasionally forgot to place orders. They were quick to correct their mistakes and always apologized. Food was great everywhere but we loved Fuego and Olio best. The big buffet at the beach was fantastic and offered all you could want for breakfast and lunch. They had sushi, Italian, American, Indian, and more. I was stuffed all week! Will definitely stay here again!

reviews.author: Thomas Grandoch
reviews.text:
We are regular guests in different Melia Hotels worldwide. We also visited other Melia properties in the Dominican Republic. So our expectations were already high. But Paradisus Palma Real managed to exceed them. Beautifully landscaped tropical gardens, luxury but still atmospheric “tropical“ architecture, great choice of restaurants, so we never get bored in our 10 days stay here.

We are currently still here so very excited what the next days will bring.

Especially the Reserve Adults Only service is great. Our concierge Darleni takes amazing care of us and organises everything - sometimes even before we ask 😀

Also really happy with the small but very special Reserve Adults Only pool and bar at the beach. Barkeeper Wanda is great and makes the best drinks and very friendly - always smiling.

Only thing which we think that can be improved is the reservation policy of sunbeds. The best beds are already reserved in the early morning - while people actually using them much later in the day. So most sunbeds are empty most of the time, but still not available. Would be great if the hotel would have a more restrictive policy here.

Speaking for all of our family, this was the BEST resort and experience that all of us have ever had!!! The accommodations, activities, and facilities were above average, TRULY!
However, even more superior was the food and staff!
We are culinary aficionados,  and were royally impressed.
But on the top of the list was the outstanding staff! Wherever we all went, whether pool, beach, restaurants, side trips, resort shuttles, or just walking through the resort, we were incredibly impressed with the courtesy, respect, and kindness of every staff person - always!
I'd like to mention two people in particular:
Our frequent shuttle driver - Julio (? - young, trim, clean cut), and the manager of all the kitchen staff, Keilin.
When I saw the entire group assembled before service holding hands and praying, I told him how very impressed we all were!
Thank you for the "Trip of a Lifetime!"

reviews.author: Amani Sofia
reviews.text:
I do not understand how there can be so many five star reviews for this resort. Please be sure to read all the 3 star and lower reviews because that is what you will experience. I have stayed at many resorts and this is my honest review. This resort is situated on beautiful grounds so for appearance it get five stars. However the actual service and food is three stars. The major place to get food is the buffet and it is a zoo .It is basically a free for all. Seat yourself and get your food. You will most likely finish your food before you even get a drink. The food while plentiful and of wide variety is very poor in taste. Lots of it is cold and undercooked. Two of the people in our party got sick from it. I would recommend the restaurants and do not do the buffet. You will need to make reservations for the restaurants and there is a long line that forms every day to make reservations for the restaurants. The food is only a little better but at least you will get some drinks.
There is also very little service by the pool and beach. You will basically have to get up and get your own drinks. The alcohol is lower tier alcohol. They display all these top shelf bottles at the bars however those are not available to you. This is very strange for a five star resort. They have 50 bottles of grey goose lined up on the bar but they don't give it to guests.
We booked the reserve package. We never met with our butler until we went and found him on the second day. He luckily did make our reservations for us. As a reserve member you can also eat at some restaurants and some buffets that are only for reserve members. The only good thing about these buffets for breakfast and lunch is that they are not super crowded. The food is about the same. I also learned later that there were a lot of extra benefits to reserve that we were never told about.
Also if you are expecting some crystal clear water that is no longer here. It appears the reef has died so while the water is blue it is very sandy and you cannot see through it. Very different then what is in the pictures. It still is a very beautiful beach though with soft sand.
Also of note is that if you do not speak Spanish you will have a hard time since many of the staff only speak only Spanish. Luckily I speak Spanish but I could see other guests frustrated by this.
There were many other issues that others discuss. I could go on and on but this is not a five star resort.
I was hoping this would be our new family vacation destination but after this experience it was a one time trip to Punta Cana.

reviews.author: Sarah Lee
reviews.text: Reynaldo Monegro and Ronil Reyes made our trip memorable. He made sure we had everything we needed.  We enjoyed wine tasting, painting classes, dancing, good conversation, and more. The beaches were beautiful and the nightlife was great. We did however have some not so great moments upon checkin we were told they were upgrading our room and we did not like the room we were put in, so had to change rooms after a long and delayed flight and we had not eaten since that morning. We decided to try the italian restaurant Vento. I ordered the arugula salad and it arrived with mustard on it and ravioli had oil sitting on the top of the marinara sauce. The bread was cold that they past out. My husband order a linguine that said it had sausage and it came out with cut up hotdogs on it. When we booked this resort it was said to be 5 stars, so we expected more out of the food. We tried all the restaurants that was offered in the all-inclusive and all disappointed and we ended up going to the buffet and putting a plate together. We did like the location of our suite and our room overall, but we did however have to kill two cockroaches and had to have maintenance turn on the cold water, and our jacuzzi did not work properly. We were told to use the WhatsApp to communicate and most of the time would get no response and most of the staff couldn't speak English so they were of no assistance or couldn't answer questions. They do have a lot of people working here, so I hope these kinks get worked out because we were told they have only been reopened for a few days. And I asked for washcloths several times and never received any. Thankfully I brought some of my own. The pillows were also very lumpy and I asked for better pillows and they did bring me semi better pillows. In closing this is not a 5 star resort but as far as the room and food/restaurants, but the beaches and exterior of the resort are pretty.

reviews.text:
My stay was less than enjoyable. I do not recommend this hotel and that is unfortunate because I had high hopes with how much money we spent.

On the first day, after I unpacked my bags, I went to leave my room and the door would not latch. I called the front desk and a security person was sent to fix the door about half hour later. It look him almost an hour to get the door to latch. Later that night when I was ready to go to bed I went back to my room and the deadbolt did not work. It took over 2 hours and 3 trips to the front desk (and my room was not close to the front desk) to get maintenance out. They eventually fix it but the door still looks not completely secure. After an hour the second time I asked to be moved to a different room but was denied.

For the first 3 days I did not have any chairs on my balcony. I finally came back to my room one afternoon and there were 2 chairs as there should be. The next morning I was excited to wake up and sit on my balcony. As soon as I sat down on the chair, it broke and I fell through the chair. I notified staff the chair was broken but if was never replaced.

The power went out multiple times. On my second last day it went out while I was in the shower and the water stopped as well. I stood in the shower for 10 mins covered in soap and shivering while I waited for the water to come back. Eventually I got enough cold water to rinse off.

At least one day my room was not cleaned.

The elevator to the side that I was on was in an area of the hotel that is being renovated. I had to use the stairs every time I left or came to my room on the 3rd floor. Because of the construction there was also no way to get to my room without getting rained on when the weather was wet.

The food was not good. Everything was cold at the buffets. It was impossible to get food anywhere between the breakfast and lunch swap over.

reviews.author: Matthew Murphy
reviews.text: We had our first post-pandemic holiday and wanted to stay somewhere that would suit the whole family. This choice was based on the recommendation from a friend and really has worked out for us; beach based location, 3 pools allowing for plenty of space for all guests, activities throughout the day for both adults and kids. The “Kidsdom” entertainment for kids has been fantastic with our son asking to go to bake cookies, finger paint, make puppets, etc. the entertainment continues at night with kids activities like ‘silent discos’, weaving, face painting and magic shows. The provision of a butler (when you book a Reserve room) is so so helpful - make sure that you ask for Starlin, he was so attentive without being intrusive, and a genuinely nice guy. I would highly recommend Paradisus Palma if you need somewhere to recharge the soul.

reviews.author: Katy O'Hara
reviews.text:
What to really expect...NOT 5 Star Service

Check-in: Our reservation was for "The Reserve" side of Paradisus Palma Real. The Reserve comes with several perks like exclusive and expedited check-in processes. None of this occurred. As a Platinum rewards member we are offered an opportunity to check-in virtually 48 hours prior to arrival to allow for an even quicker arrival, which we took advantage of. Upon arrival to the resort absolutely none of the early or quick check-in processes were observed. Took 40+ min for front desk staff to even begin to check us in. When we asked about all the information we sent during our virtual check-in, they had zero knowledge of the info or even the process which we used, so everything had to be redone. (**Let's also mention the manager on duty was in a loud verbal argument with another guest less than 10 feet away from multiple families checking in**) To their credit the front desk staff did their best to speed up the process and were able to make sure our rooms were neighboring as originally requested.

Concierge Service: DO NOT PAY FOR THIS. Plain and simple this was the biggest let down, regret, and overall waste of money at this resort. As part of "The Reserve" you are assigned (pay for) a personal concierge who is supposed to help make you stay as relaxing, fun, and stress free as possible. We got the opposite with our Concierge, Franklin. Franklin was not onsite the day of our check-in, but we were assured by staff that he would be in contact first thing the next day. It was nearly 24 hours later and after several trips to the front desk did Franklin finally make contact. After Franklin's initial contact getting ahold of him to even ask basic questions about the Golf course, excursions, or the spa was hard. He was less than responsive to texts and was not present around the resort. He did not share any special event info or kids club info. This was really a disappointment because we had read several reviews on TripAdvisor highlighting how awesome Franklin was...apparently, we didn't deserve the same level of service.

Room Service: Our first night we attempted the buffet, but they were nearly closing time and there were very few options left so we decided to settle in our rooms and order room service. We called and placed a simple order for some food and drinks and were told it would be 30-40min. About 90 min later the food had not arrived, so we called down, they had no record of the order so placed it again. Another 90min went by and we gave up and went to bed...no food on the first night! The next evening after a long day of sun, the kids requested a late-night snack so we tried room service again...and again the same wait times with zero food delivered.

Yhi Spa: The spa service left us asking so many questions about the management and customer service of this resort and overall, Melia properties. As a Melia Rewards member you can use points for spa services, it advertised this way. When we arrived, they presented us with a bill for $410, prior to service and we again told them we intended to use points. They told us they would need manager approval despite telling us they would do it the day prior. After waiting for 40min past our appointment time they finally allowed us to proceed with our treatments. Points were eventually deducted from my Melia Rewards account. Fast forward to check-out day and the spa had applied the $410 charge to our room/credit card while also deducting the points.

There were two saving graces to this whole trip. Raul at the pool bar - 10 out of 10 - he was the best! He provided quality drinks and information about things to do in the area. Also, Delvin at Vento - he was the only reason we had any options or plans for dinner when our concierge let us down. He is a true gem and really knows what good customer service looks like at a 5-star resort.

reviews.text:
We enjoyed our time here at Paradisus Palma.

Jose Del Rosario provided exceptional service at Kicks. Make sure you go see him.

reviews.author: Kelly English
reviews.text:
We stayed at the resort from January 6th to January 14th with friends and enjoyed our stay very much.  The weather was perfect, consistent temperature of approximately 78 degrees and rain showers at night. We golfed every day and found the course pleasantly quiet, and somewhat challenging. In the mornings and at lunch we would eat at the buffet and found it well stocked with a large variety of foods to satisfy any pallet. We were booked into the Royal suites and found the butler service provided by Fermin excellent. He made our dinner reservations every night and made certain that our visit was enjoyable and relaxing by drawing our afternoon bubble bath with champagne and chocolate covered strawberries! Our room was kept spotlessly clean and turn down service bed service was accompanied with a chocolate and pleasant note.
The food in the restaurants was for the most part above average and plate sizes were perfectly proportioned. We took part in a few of the scheduled activities, such as dance classes, painting and watched a few others and were very impressed with the schedule of different activities. Families around us all looked like they were having fun. The entire staff was pleasant and most helpful, especially Carolina Franco and all her staff at the hospitality desk. The pool and beach were definitely user friendly. We would return in the future.

reviews.author: Jennifer Land
reviews.text: The Cana restaurant was really good. My daughter has a gluten allergy and they were very helpful with that. Virgina was great. Excellent service!

reviews.text: My husband and I came to paradisus Palma real and stayed in the royal service section of the resort. The best thing about our stay was our butler Juan. Louis at the pool and beach area was also wonderful. He made sure to secure a seat for us at the beach and constantly was checking to see if we needed anything. reviews.author: Ali Emam
reviews.text:
Updating my review from 1 star to 4 stars as the management realized my issues, spoke to me about them, and did their best to alleviate the issue and make it right. I still can’t give this resort 5 stars, since there are some fundamental issues that can’t be overlooked.

Starting with one star deduction … Fundamental issues with the overall concept of multiple semi-independent resorts (Paradisus Palma, Grand Cana, The Reserve, Melia Caribe) under one umbrella is that although some amenities might be shared, but the benefits do not. Case in point … We stayed at the Paradisus Palma and the Kidsdom is at The Reserve. They are so far apart that you need to ride a golf cart to get from one resort to the other. We took our kids to the Kidsdom one day, but decided we didn’t want to leave them there alone. There is pool and a snack bar right there, so we decided to stay. When we went to get a water and soda from the snack bar they told us that our Paradisus Palma wristbands DO NOT give us food and drink access at The Reserve!!! So if we wanted to eat/drink then either we needed to pay cash or go back to our resort, again via a golf cart. This makes no sense!! At the minimum they should allow parents who’ve left their kids at the kids club to use the snack bar!

Back to the increase of stars … I have to personally thank Ms. Leandra in Guest Services for listening to our issues and, I believe, doing anything in her capacity to make it right, including connecting me with the Guest Services Manager, Mr. Castillo, who also took the time to meet with me and went above and beyond to make the rest of the experience for my family absolutely amazing. They were both in constant communication with me over WhatsApp as to how the issues would be resolved, and they were finally able to get us restaurant reservations for every night. Thanks!

———————————————————

We’ve been trying to make the best of the experience, but if the management keeps up this level of INservice, business will decline. Too many issues to even remember. Mismanagement of rooms (we arrived at 6pm and rooms were not ready), Minibar was empty even after calling multiple times. I finally had to find the cart myself and fill our fridge. Incompetence of employees, we had to drag the kids to different parts of the resort since no one knew which water parks were open. And the crème de la crème … six days, and five nights at this place and all the restaurants were full every night, so we could not enjoy any of the restaurants. I guess the conference going on here had more priority than the guests, since they had booked all the restaurants, and the Guest Service could not do anything and would not even give us access to a supervisor!! And we are only on Day 3 of our trip!!! One star for the nice garden.

reviews.author: Seth Waller
reviews.text: Probably deserves 2 stars, but so many other reviewers gave 5 stars I have to try to balance the average.  If you're considering this resort, please read some of the other lower-rated reviews on this site.  At best the resort is average, but we paid for all-inclusive 5-star.  Food was fair, people were friendly, unfortunately not terribly competent.  Pool closes at 7PM, but music stays rocking (loudly) until 10 PM.  Butler stocks bar on 2nd day and never returns.  Everyone speaks Spanish, and the answering machine is in French.  Jacuzzi on the balcony flooded the balcony before the pump broke altogether.  Showed the maids that someone had taken the English pages out of our hotel guide (the book that shows you services, restaurants, etc.), so they took the guide away and didn't bring one back.  I've heard GREAT things about the DR, so I can only conclude that I picked the wrong resort.

We are very thankful that we’ve hit it out of the park picking this place for our vacation and we will be sure to return as they have won not only mine, but my friend’s and family’s customer loyalty for years to come.

reviews.text: We had a wonderful time at Paradisus palm real! Everything was perfect! Delgis and Claritzel our concierges were fantastic. They were very helpful when needed.  If you choose  to be a Reserve Guest you are privileged to be assigned a personal concierge to assist you with your  experience. reviews.text:
This would be the second year I come to the resort, great as usual. Service is generally good, but the tip economy they've created is a bit annoying. There's a noticeable difference in friendliness before and after you tip. Tipping should not be mandatory, it should be a reward for good service. The food at the buffet was ok, the food at the a la carte restaurants was better. I highly recommend spending the money and going to Passion, the food there was amazing! Definitely get the Menu de Degustación. The beach was great, but the locals coming around every few minutes to try and sell you something can get a bit annoying. Luckily most of them will go away after a curt "no thank you". The butler system is great and very convenient. A big thanks to out butler this year, Juan Suarez, he was very kind, polite, and showed some great attention to detail (like leaving surprise cheese plates or chocolates in our rooms).

Overall this is a great hotel for families and friends. My only advice is to budget in not only the cost of the hotel itself, but at least ~ $50 a day in tips (yes, there's a lot of tipping).

reviews.author: Mark
reviews.text: This is a wonderful resort. The restaurants are all delectable. The chefs are talented and accommodating. If you want something, chances are they can make it. On one occasion, I requested the Chef at Olio to make pasta carbonara and it came out perfectly. My favorite restaurant was Palozzo. They had a beautiful menu, every item was fresh and delicious. Every step of the way the resort staff looked out for my comfort and safety. Every day our butler, Gabriel Bobadilla, would check in with us to see where we wanted to eat and when. If something wasn't quite right , he would make it right. The resort treats you like family. I truly felt at home here at Paradisus Palma Real. The pools are enormous and beautiful. The other guests were kind, polite and respectful. This is a lovely place for couples and couples that have children.
